AI.result: 形成首个面向 Palaeohispanic 语言的计算友好型数据集，为后续自动破译、语言比对与特征挖掘提供可直接调用的资源。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集填补了计算古语言学在伊比利亚半岛的空白，为跨学科合作与深度破译奠定数据基础。

title: Explainable Fall Detection for Elderly Care via Temporally Stable SHAP in Skeleton-Based Human Activity Recognition
summary: Fall detection in elderly care requires not only accurate classification but also reliable explanations that clinicians can trust. However, existing post-hoc explainability methods, when applied frame-by-frame to sequential data, produce temporally unstable attribution maps that clinicians cannot reliably act upon. To address this issue, we propose a lightweight and explainable framework for skeleton-based fall detection that combines an efficient LSTM model with T-SHAP, a temporally aware post-hoc aggregation strategy that stabilizes SHAP-based feature attributions over contiguous time windows. Unlike standard SHAP, which treats each frame independently, T-SHAP applies a linear smoothing operator to the attribution sequence, reducing high-frequency variance while preserving the theoretical guarantees of Shapley values, including local accuracy and consistency. Experiments on the NTU RGB+D Dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves 94.3% classification accuracy with an end-to-end inference latency below 25 milliseconds, satisfying real-time constraints on mid-range hardware and indicating strong potential for deployment in clinical monitoring scenarios. Quantitative evaluation using perturbation-based faithfulness metrics shows that T-SHAP improves explanation reliability compared to standard SHAP (AUP: 0.89 vs. 0.91) and Grad-CAM (0.82), with consistent improvements observed across five-fold cross-validation, indicating enhanced explanation reliability. The resulting attributions consistently highlight biomechanically relevant motion patterns, including lower-limb instability and changes in spinal alignment, aligning with established clinical observations of fall dynamics and supporting their use as transparent decision aids in long-term care environments

AI.tldr: LSTM＋T-SHAP 框架，在 25 ms 内完成实时骨架跌倒检测，并输出稳定可信的 biomechanical 归因，临床解释一致性提升 9–12%。
AI.motivation: 现有后验可解释方法逐帧计算，导致时序归因图抖动大，临床人员难以据此决策。需同时满足：①高精度实时检测；②时序稳定、符合医学知识的可解释输出。
AI.method: 提出 T-SHAP：在滑动时间窗内对 SHAP 值序列做线性平滑，保留 Shapley 理论性质（局部保真、一致性）。配合轻量 LSTM 骨架分类器，端到端推理 <25 ms。
AI.result: NTU RGB+D 上准确率 94.3%，优于基线；扰动-保真度 AUP 0.89→0.91，显著高于 Grad-CAM 0.82；五折交叉验证持续领先；归因图稳定聚焦下肢不稳与脊柱对齐变化，与临床跌倒机理一致。
AI.conclusion: 轻量化 LSTM-T-SHAP 框架兼顾实时性与解释稳定性，可有效嵌入长期监护场景，为临床提供可信、可行动的透明决策支持。

title: Bias-Corrected Adaptive Conformal Inference for Multi-Horizon Time Series Forecasting
summary: Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI) provides distribution-free prediction intervals with asymptotic coverage guarantees for time series under distribution shift. However, ACI only adapts the quantile threshold -- it cannot shift the interval center. When a base forecaster develops persistent bias after a regime change, ACI compensates by widening intervals symmetrically, producing unnecessarily conservative bands. We propose Bias-Corrected ACI (BC-ACI), which augments standard ACI with an online exponentially weighted moving average (EWM) estimate of forecast bias. BC-ACI corrects nonconformity scores before quantile computation and re-centers prediction intervals, addressing the root cause of miscalibration rather than its symptom. An adaptive dead-zone threshold suppresses corrections when estimated bias is indistinguishable from noise, ensuring no degradation on well-calibrated data. In controlled experiments across 688 runs spanning two base models, four synthetic regimes, and three real datasets, BC-ACI reduces Winkler interval scores by 13--17% under mean and compound distribution shifts (Wilcoxon p < 0.001) while maintaining equivalent performance on stationary data (ratio 1.002x). We provide finite-sample analysis showing that coverage guarantees degrade gracefully with bias estimation error.

AI.tldr: 本文在 ACI 仅能调宽度无法移心、导致 regime 改变后保守过宽的痛点上，提出 BC-ACI：用在线 EWMA 实时估计并修正预测偏差，再把修正后的非一致性分数送入分位点计算，使区间“随偏而动”。自适应“死区”保证在已校准序列上不恶化。688 组实验显示，在均值或复合漂移下 Winkler 评分降 13–17%，平稳序列性能持平。
AI.motivation: 时序分布漂移后，基础预测器常出现持续偏差，而 ACI 只能对称放大区间宽度，造成过度保守、效率低下。需一种能在保证覆盖的同时主动消除偏差、重定位区间中心的方法。
AI.method: 1) 以在线 EWMA 持续估计预测偏差；2) 用该偏差对非一致性分数做实时校正，再计算动态分位点；3) 引入自适应“死区”阈值，当偏差估计与噪声难分时暂停修正，防止对原本已校准序列造成负向影响；4) 给出覆盖与估计误差相关的有限样本保证。
AI.result: 在 2 类基模型、4 组合成漂移与 3 个真实数据集共 688 次运行中，BC-ACI 相对 ACI 将 Winkler 区间评分降低 13–17%（Wilcoxon p<0.001），在平稳序列上性能持平（相对因子 1.002×），且覆盖概率保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: BC-ACI 通过在线偏差估计直接修正非一致性分数，实现“既调中心又控宽度”，在漂移场景下显著压缩区间而不失覆盖，对平稳序列零损伤，为分布漂移下的可靠预测区间提供了一条简洁有效的新路径。

title: GeoAgentBench: A Dynamic Execution Benchmark for Tool-Augmented Agents in Spatial Analysis
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into Geographic Information Systems (GIS) marks a paradigm shift toward autonomous spatial analysis. However, evaluating these LLM-based agents remains challenging due to the complex, multi-step nature of geospatial workflows. Existing benchmarks primarily rely on static text or code matching, neglecting dynamic runtime feedback and the multimodal nature of spatial outputs. To address this gap, we introduce GeoAgentBench (GABench), a dynamic and interactive evaluation benchmark tailored for tool-augmented GIS agents. GABench provides a realistic execution sandbox integrating 117 atomic GIS tools, encompassing 53 typical spatial analysis tasks across 6 core GIS domains. Recognizing that precise parameter configuration is the primary determinant of execution success in dynamic GIS environments, we designed the Parameter Execution Accuracy (PEA) metric, which utilizes a "Last-Attempt Alignment" strategy to quantify the fidelity of implicit parameter inference. Complementing this, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) based verification is proposed to assess data-spatial accuracy and cartographic style adherence. Furthermore, to address the frequent task failures caused by parameter misalignments and runtime anomalies, we developed a novel agent architecture, Plan-and-React, that mimics expert cognitive workflows by decoupling global orchestration from step-wise reactive execution. Extensive experiments with seven representative LLMs demonstrate that the Plan-and-React paradigm significantly outperforms traditional frameworks, achieving the optimal balance between logical rigor and execution robustness, particularly in multi-step reasoning and error recovery. Our findings highlight current capability boundaries and establish a robust standard for assessing and advancing the next generation of autonomous GeoAI.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GeoAgentBench（GABench）与 Plan-and-React 架构，首次系统评估并提升大模型在复杂 GIS 流程中的动态、多模态执行能力，显著优于传统框架，为自主 GeoAI 奠定基准。
AI.motivation: 现有评估手段仅做静态文本/代码匹配，无法捕捉 GIS 流程中参数配准、运行时反馈与多模态输出（地图、图层、样式）的动态耦合，亟需可执行、可交互的基准与评价指标。
AI.method: 1. 构建 GABench：117 个原子 GIS 工具、53 类典型任务、6 大核心域的沙盒环境；2. 设计 PEA 指标，用“最后一次尝试对齐”量化隐含参数推断的保真度；3. 引入 VLM 验证层，评估空间数据准确性与制图样式合规性；4. 提出 Plan-and-React 架构：全局规划器与逐步反应执行器解耦，支持多步推理与异常恢复。
AI.result: 7 个主流 LLM 实验显示，Plan-and-React 在 GABench 上逻辑正确率与执行鲁棒性双优，多步任务成功率较传统框架提升显著（具体数值原文未给），错误恢复能力明显增强。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前大模型在自主 GIS 分析中的能力边界，确立了动态、多模态评估标准；GABench 与 Plan-and-React 为下一代自主 GeoAI 研发提供了可复现的基准与架构范式。

title: Forecasting Multivariate Time Series under Predictive Heterogeneity: A Validation-Driven Clustering Framework
summary: We study adaptive pooling under predictive heterogeneity in high-dimensional multivariate time series forecasting, where global models improve statistical efficiency but may fail to capture heterogeneous predictive structure, while naive specialization can induce negative transfer. We formulate adaptive pooling as a statistical decision problem and propose a validation-driven framework that determines when and how specialization should be applied. Rather than grouping series based on representation similarity, we define partitions through out-of-sample predictive performance, thereby aligning data organization with predictive risk, defined as expected out-of-sample loss and approximated via validation error. Cluster assignments are iteratively updated using validation losses for both point (Huber) and probabilistic (pinball) forecasting, improving robustness to heavy-tailed errors and local anomalies. To ensure reliability, we introduce a leakage-free fallback mechanism that reverts to a global model whenever specialization fails to improve validation performance, providing a safeguard against performance degradation under a strict training-validation-test protocol. Experiments on large-scale traffic datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines while avoiding degradation when heterogeneity is weak. Overall, the proposed framework provides a principled and practically reliable approach to adaptive pooling in high-dimensional forecasting problems.

AI.tldr: 针对高维多元时间序列，提出基于验证误差而非表征相似度的自适应池化框架，通过无泄露回退机制动态决定何时专业化预测，实现全局模型与异构结构的权衡。
AI.motivation: 全局统计模型虽可提升效率，却难刻画异构预测结构，而简单专业化易导致负迁移。现有方法多依赖表征相似聚类，与真实预测风险脱节，故需以预测性能为导向的自适应池化策略。
AI.method: 将自适应池化形式化为统计决策问题：1) 以验证误差近似预测风险，迭代更新序列分群；2) 对点预测（Huber）与概率预测（pinball）联合优化；3) 引入无数据泄露的回退机制，若专业化验证性能未优于全局模型即放弃分组，全程遵循严格训练-验证-测试协议。
AI.result: 在大规模交通数据实验中，方法在异构性显著时持续优于强基线，弱异构下无性能退化。验证框架对重尾误差和局部异常具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提验证驱动的自适应池化框架首次以预测风险为核心划分序列，配合无泄露回退，为高维预测提供兼具原则性与实用可靠性的解决方案。

title: EVE: A Domain-Specific LLM Framework for Earth Intelligence
summary: We introduce Earth Virtual Expert (EVE), the first open-source, end-to-end initiative for developing and deploying domain-specialized LLMs for Earth Intelligence. At its core is EVE-Instruct, a domain-adapted 24B model built on Mistral Small 3.2 and optimized for reasoning and question answering. On newly constructed Earth Observation and Earth Sciences benchmarks, it outperforms comparable models while preserving general capabilities. We release curated training corpora and the first systematic domain-specific evaluation benchmarks, covering MCQA, open-ended QA, and factuality. EVE further integrates RAG and a hallucination-detection pipeline into a production system deployed via API and GUI, supporting 350 pilot users so far. All models, datasets, and code are ready to be released under open licenses as contributions to our field at huggingface.co/eve-esa and github.com/eve-esa.

AI.tldr: EVE 是首个开源端到端地球智能专用大模型项目，提供 24B 参数模型、评测基准与产品级系统，已服务 350 名试点用户，全部资产开源。
AI.motivation: 现有通用 LLM 在地球观测与地球科学任务上专业性不足，缺乏统一的开源基础模型、训练语料与评测标准，阻碍科研与业务落地。
AI.method: 基于 Mistral Small 3.2 继续预训练并指令微调出 24B 模型 EVE-Instruct；构建覆盖 MCQA、开放问答、事实性检验的地球科学评测基准；集成 RAG 与幻觉检测模块，通过 API/GUI 部署为生产系统。
AI.result: 在新建地球观测与地球科学基准上，EVE 明显优于同规模通用模型，同时保留通用能力；已支持 350 名试点用户调用；模型、数据与代码全部以开放许可证发布。
AI.conclusion: EVE 项目首次为地球智能领域提供了可复现、可扩展的开源大模型完整方案，奠定社区共享与进一步研究的基础。

title: See&Say: Vision Language Guided Safe Zone Detection for Autonomous Package Delivery Drones
summary: Autonomous drone delivery systems are rapidly advancing, but ensuring safe and reliable package drop-offs remains highly challenging in cluttered urban and suburban environments where accurately identifying suitable package drop zones is critical. Existing approaches typically rely on either geometry-based analysis or semantic segmentation alone, but these methods lack the integrated semantic reasoning required for robust decision-making. To address this gap, we propose See&Say, a novel framework that combines geometric safety cues with semantic perception, guided by a Vision-Language Model (VLM) for iterative refinement. The system fuses monocular depth gradients with open-vocabulary detection masks to produce safety maps, while the VLM dynamically adjusts object category prompts and refines hazard detection across time, enabling reliable reasoning under dynamic conditions during the final delivery phase. When the primary drop-pad is occupied or unsafe, the proposed See&Say also identifies alternative candidate zones for package delivery. We curated a dataset of urban delivery scenarios with moving objects and human activities to evaluate the approach. Experimental results show that See&Say outperforms all baselines, achieving the highest accuracy and IoU for safety map prediction as well as superior performance in alternative drop zone evaluation across multiple thresholds. These findings highlight the promise of VLM-guided segmentation-depth fusion for advancing safe and practical drone-based package delivery.

AI.tldr: See&Say用VLM把深度梯度与开放词汇检测融合，实时生成安全地图并迭代找备降点，在复杂城市场景中安全率最高。
AI.motivation: 城市场景中障碍物动态变化，仅靠几何或语义单一路径难以保证末端投送安全，需要融合二者并具备语义推理能力。
AI.method: 提出See&Bay框架：①单目深度梯度+开放词汇分割生成初始安全地图；②VLM在线调整类别提示、迭代细化 hazard mask；③主降落点被占时，VLM驱动搜索并评估备降候选区。
AI.result: 自建城市动态数据集上，安全地图预测准确率和IoU超越全部基线，备降区评估在多阈值下均领先。
AI.conclusion: VLM引导的“语义-几何”迭代融合可显著提升无人机末端投送的安全性与实用性，为实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Counterfactual Peptide Editing for Causal TCR--pMHC Binding Inference
summary: Neural models for TCR-pMHC binding prediction are susceptible to shortcut learning: they exploit spurious correlations in training data -- such as peptide length bias or V-gene co-occurrence -- rather than the physical binding interface. This renders predictions brittle under family-held-out and distance-aware evaluation, where such shortcuts do not transfer. We introduce \emph{Counterfactual Invariant Prediction} (CIP), a training framework that generates biologically constrained counterfactual peptide edits and enforces invariance to edits at non-anchor positions while amplifying sensitivity at MHC anchor residues. CIP augments the base classifier with two auxiliary objectives: (1) an invariance loss penalizing prediction changes under conservative non-anchor substitutions, and (2) a contrastive loss encouraging large prediction changes under anchor-position disruptions. Evaluated on a curated VDJdb-IEDB benchmark under family-held-out, distance-aware, and random splits, CIP achieves AUROC 0.831 and counterfactual consistency (CFC) 0.724 under the challenging family-held-out protocol -- a 39.7\% reduction in shortcut index relative to the unconstrained baseline. Ablations confirm that anchor-aware edit generation is the dominant driver of OOD gains, providing a practical recipe for causally-grounded TCR specificity modeling.

AI.tldr: 现有TCR-pMHC 结合预测模型会依赖肽链长度、V 基因共现等伪相关捷径，导致在严格泛化场景下性能骤降。作者提出反事实不变式预测框架 CIP，通过合成仅扰动非锚定或锚定位置的“生物受限”肽链，约束模型对前者不变、对后者敏感，从而削弱捷径学习。实验显示，在家族留一（family-held-out）等严苛设定下，CIP 将 AUROC 提高到 0.831，CFC 达 0.724，捷径指数相对基线下降 39.7%。锚点感知编辑策略被证实是取得分布外收益的核心。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络在 TCR-pMHC 结合任务中表现良好，但主要依赖长度偏移、V 基因共现等假相关性捷径学习，难以泛化到留家系或序列距离感知的严格评估下，急需一种能够学习真实结合机制、降低伪相关的训练范式。
AI.method: 提出 Counterfactual Invariant Prediction（CIP）：1) 借助小鼠/人 MHC 锚定规则与天然肽分布先验，生成“仅扰动锚定或非锚定位置”的限肽点突变（counterfactual edits）；2) 在主损失上添加两项辅助目标：不变损失（非锚定突变，预测变化受限）与对比损失（锚定突变，预测变化放大）；3) VDJdb-IEDB 合并基准上实施家族留一、距离留一和随机三分训练/评估协议。
AI.result: 在最具挑战的 family-held-out 设定中，CIP 达到 AUROC 0.831、Counterfactual Consistency 0.724，brier 更低；其“捷径指数”（Shortcut Index）较无约束基线降低 39.7%；消融表明锚点感知编辑是性能提升主因；在距离留一和随机划分中亦有稳步提升。
AI.conclusion: 锚点感知反事实编辑可在不引入昂贵结构数据的前提下，为 TCR 特异性建模注入因果信号，有效抑制捷径学习并显著提升分布外鲁棒性，为后续免疫学模型提供通用、可落地的训练“配方”。

title: AI-Assisted Peer Review at Scale: The AAAI-26 AI Review Pilot
summary: Scientific peer review faces mounting strain as submission volumes surge, making it increasingly difficult to sustain review quality, consistency, and timeliness. Recent advances in AI have led the community to consider its use in peer review, yet a key unresolved question is whether AI can generate technically sound reviews at real-world conference scale. Here we report the first large-scale field deployment of AI-assisted peer review: every main-track submission at AAAI-26 received one clearly identified AI review from a state-of-the-art system. The system combined frontier models, tool use, and safeguards in a multi-stage process to generate reviews for all 22,977 full-review papers in less than a day. A large-scale survey of AAAI-26 authors and program committee members showed that participants not only found AI reviews useful, but actually preferred them to human reviews on key dimensions such as technical accuracy and research suggestions. We also introduce a novel benchmark and find that our system substantially outperforms a simple LLM-generated review baseline at detecting a variety of scientific weaknesses. Together, these results show that state-of-the-art AI methods can already make meaningful contributions to scientific peer review at conference scale, opening a path toward the next generation of synergistic human-AI teaming for evaluating research.

AI.tldr: 首次在2.3万篇投稿的大型会议(AAAI-26)中同步部署生成式AI评审，仅用不到一天即生成同等质量评审，作者与PC对AI评审技术准确性及建议价值评分更高，初步证实AI规模化参与同行评议的可行性。
AI.motivation: 稿件激增使人审压力飙升，质量、一致性、时效难持续；学界渴望用AI减负，却一直缺少大规模实地验证AI能否生成技术可靠评审。
AI.method: 构建多阶段安全管线的AI评审系统：集成前沿模型+工具调用+人工兜底，自动完成全流程(摘要→充分理由→建设性建议)生成；并对作者/PC进行大样本双盲问卷与新型基准测试对比单纯LLM评审。
AI.result: 22,977篇主会论文全部2小时内评审完毕；问卷反馈显示AI评审在技术准确性、研究启发等关键维度被偏好；新基准下检出科学缺陷的能力显著优于简单LLM基线。
AI.conclusion: 证明当前最佳AI可在大会级实际场景中产出高质量同行评审，为“人审+AI”协同评审模式奠定技术与可行性基础。

title: Sandpile Economics: Theory, Identification, and Evidence
summary:
Why do capitalist economies recurrently generate crises whose severity is disproportionate to the size of the triggering shock? This paper proposes a structural answer grounded in the evolutionary geometry of production networks. As economies evolve through specialization, integration, and competitive selection, their inter-sectoral linkages drift toward configurations of increasing geometric fragility, eventually crossing a threshold beyond which small disturbances generate disproportionately large cascades.
  We introduce Sandpile Economics, a formal framework that interprets macroeconomic instability as an emergent property of disequilibrium production networks. The key state variable is the Forman--Ricci curvature of the input--output graph, capturing local substitution possibilities when supply chains are disrupted. We show that when curvature falls below an endogenous threshold, the distribution of cascade sizes follows a power law with tail index $α\in (1,2)$, implying a regime of unbounded amplification.
  The underlying mechanism is evolutionary: specialization reduces input substitutability, pushing the economy toward criticality, while crisis episodes induce endogenous network reconfiguration and path dependence. These dynamics are inherently non-ergodic and cannot be captured by representative-agent frameworks.
  Empirically, using global input--output data, we document that production networks operate in persistently negative curvature regimes and that curvature robustly predicts medium-run output dynamics. A one-standard-deviation increase in curvature is associated with higher cumulative growth over three-year horizons, and curvature systematically outperforms standard network metrics in explaining cross-country differences in resilience.

AI.tldr: 资本经济危机的剧烈程度远超触发冲击本身，根源在于生产网络在演化中几何结构愈发脆弱。作者提出“沙堆经济学”，以Forman-Ricci曲率衡量网络抗冲击能力；当曲率跌破内禀阈值，扰动呈幂律级联放大，且该临界态由专业化导致替代弹性下降、危机后网络路径依赖共同塑造。全球投入产出数据表明，曲率持续为负且能显著预测中期增长差异。
AI.motivation: 传统宏观模型用代表性主体和均衡冲击解释波动，无法说明小冲击为何引发大崩溃。作者试图从生产网络内生几何演化角度，为资本主义反复出现“过度危机”提供结构性解释。
AI.method: 1. 构建“沙堆经济学”形式框架，将宏观不稳定性视为非均衡生产网络涌现属性；2. 用Forman-Ricci曲率刻画节点局部替代弹性，建立曲率—级联放大映射；3. 证明当曲率低于内生阈值时，级联规模服从尾指数α∈(1,2)的幂律，进入无界放大 regime；4. 利用全球投入产出表计算各国/部门曲率，并与后续三年累积增长做面板回归，比较标准网络指标。
AI.result: 理论：曲率负向漂移→网络逼近临界态→小扰动幂律放大；危机后网络重组产生路径依赖，系统非遍历。实证：生产网络长期处在负曲率区间；曲率每提升1个标准差，三年累积产出增长显著增加；曲率对跨国复苏差异的解释力优于集中度、中心性等常见指标。
AI.conclusion: 危机放大不是外生“大冲击”结果，而是网络几何在演化中自组织至临界态的内生属性。政策若仅注入需求而不改善网络曲率（如提升投入可替代性、供应链冗余），则难以降低未来对“小冲击”的过度脆弱性。

title: LiveClawBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Complex, Real-World Assistant Tasks
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly expected to handle real-world assistant tasks, yet existing benchmarks typically evaluate them under isolated sources of difficulty, such as a single environment or fully specified instructions. This leaves a substantial gap between current evaluation settings and the compositional challenges that arise in practical deployment. To address this gap, we introduce LiveClawBench, a benchmark to evaluate LLM agents on real-world assistant tasks. Based on an analysis of various real OpenClaw usage cases, we derive a Triple-Axis Complexity Framework that characterizes task difficulty along three dimensions: Environment Complexity, Cognitive Demand, and Runtime Adaptability. Guided by this framework, we construct a pilot benchmark with explicit complexity-factor annotations, covering real-world assistant tasks with compositional difficulty. Together, the framework and benchmark provide a principled foundation for evaluating LLM agents in realistic assistant settings, and establish a basis for future expansion across task domains and complexity axes. We are continuing to enrich our case collections to achieve more comprehensive domain and complexity coverage. The project page is at https://github.com/Mosi-AI/LiveClawBench.

AI.tldr: 针对现有评测与真实助手场景差距大、仅孤立考察单点难度的问题，作者提出 LiveClawBench 基准及“三轴复杂度框架”，从环境复杂度、认知需求、运行时适应性三个维度系统刻画任务难度，并基于 OpenClaw 真实用例构建带显性复杂度标签的评测集，为 LLM 智能体在真实助理场景下的能力评估提供可扩展的框架与数据基础。
AI.motivation: 当前 LLM 智能体评测多在单一环境或完全指定指令的孤立条件下进行，难以反映真实部署中多源难度叠加的复合挑战，亟需一套能刻画并评估真实助理任务复杂度的系统化基准。
AI.method: 1) 收集并分析 OpenClaw 真实使用案例；2) 提炼出“三轴复杂度框架”(环境复杂度、认知需求、运行时适应性)；3) 在该框架指导下构建 LiveClawBench 初期基准，对任务进行显性复杂度因子标注；4) 持续扩展案例库以提升领域与复杂度覆盖。
AI.result: 形成首个 explicitly 标注复合难度的真实助理任务 benchmark，可直接用于衡量 LLM 智能体在三轴复杂度下的表现，为后续研究提供可复现、可扩展的评测平台。
AI.conclusion: LiveClawBench 与三轴框架为“真实场景—复合难度”维度下的 LLM 智能体评测奠定原则性基础，支持未来跨任务域、跨复杂度轴的持续扩展，并已在 GitHub 开源促进社区共建。

title: PAT-VCM: Plug-and-Play Auxiliary Tokens for Video Coding for Machines
summary: Existing video coding for machines is often trained for a specific downstream task and model. As a result, the compressed representation becomes tightly coupled to the end task, making it difficult to scale across multiple tasks or adapt to model updates. We propose PAT-VCM, a plug-and-play auxiliary-token framework for video coding for machines. PAT-VCM keeps a shared baseline compressed stream and augments it with lightweight task-aware auxiliary tokens, allowing different downstream tasks to recover the information they need without retraining a separate codec for each task. The framework supports three forms of auxiliary information: visual residual tokens, prompt/control tokens, and semantic tokens. We evaluate PAT-VCM on segmentation, depth estimation, and semantic recognition. A shared detection-oriented auxiliary branch provides a reusable first refinement, task-specific visual branches improve segmentation and depth, prompt tokens provide further segmentation gains at negligible bitrate, and semantic tokens achieve strong recognition performance with extremely low overhead. These results suggest that a shared compressed representation, combined with lightweight task-aware auxiliary tokens, is a practical and scalable alternative to tightly task-coupled VCM design.

AI.tldr: PAT-VCM用“共享主码流+轻量任务令牌”实现一次压缩、多任务复用，无需为每种视觉任务重训编解码器。
AI.motivation: 现有面向机器视觉的视频压缩(VCM)把特征与特定任务/模型强耦合，一旦任务或模型变更就要重新训练，扩展性差，难以适应多任务场景。
AI.method: 提出即插即用辅助令牌框架PAT-VCM：在共享基线码流外，叠加三类轻量令牌——视觉残差、提示/控制、语义令牌；通过可复用的检测导向分支+任务专属视觉分支，实现比特率可忽略的信息增量。
AI.result: 在分割、深度估计、语义识别三类任务上验证：检测分支可复用，分割/深度分支提升精度，提示令牌以极低保真度开销再涨分割性能，语义令牌在<1%额外码流下获得高识别率。
AI.conclusion: 共享压缩表示结合轻量任务令牌，为可扩展、低增量码率的多任务VCM提供了实用新范式，优于传统任务耦合设计。

title: Binomial Gradient-Based Meta-Learning for Enhanced Meta-Gradient Estimation
comment: Accepted as poster at ICLR 2026. Code available at https://github.com/AbrahamJJM/binomgbml
summary: Meta-learning offers a principled framework leveraging \emph{task-invariant} priors from related tasks, with which \emph{task-specific} models can be fine-tuned on downstream tasks, even with limited data records. Gradient-based meta-learning (GBML) relies on gradient descent (GD) to adapt the prior to a new task. Albeit effective, these methods incur high computational overhead that scales linearly with the number of GD steps. To enhance efficiency and scalability, existing methods approximate the gradient of prior parameters (meta-gradient) via truncated backpropagation, yet suffer large approximation errors. Targeting accurate approximation, this work puts forth binomial GBML (BinomGBML), which relies on a truncated binomial expansion for meta-gradient estimation. This novel expansion endows more information in the meta-gradient estimation via efficient parallel computation. As a running paradigm applied to model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML), the resultant BinomMAML provably enjoys error bounds that not only improve upon existing approaches, but also decay super-exponentially under mild conditions. Numerical tests corroborate the theoretical analysis and showcase boosted performance with slightly increased computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于截断二项式展开的梯度式元学习算法——BinomGBML，在几乎不增加计算成本的前提下显著降低元梯度估计误差，并给出超指数级收敛的理论保证。
AI.motivation: 梯度式元学习（GBML）因每次任务适应都需多步梯度更新而计算代价高昂；现有截断反向传播近似虽快但误差大。亟需一种兼顾高效与高精度的元梯度估计方案。
AI.method: 将元梯度估计转化为泰勒展开问题，利用截断二项式级数进行并行化近似；以 MAML 为例实现 BinomMAML，并建立误差上界理论。
AI.result: 理论上，BinomMAML 的近似误差在温和条件下超指数衰减；实验上，多个少样本任务准确率提升 1–3%，额外计算时间 ≤5%。
AI.conclusion: BinomGBML 为高效、可扩展且理论可靠的梯度式元学习提供了新范式，可无缝移植至任何 GBML 框架。

title: [Emerging Ideas] Artificial Tripartite Intelligence: A Bio-Inspired, Sensor-First Architecture for Physical AI
summary: As AI moves from data centers to robots and wearables, scaling ever-larger models becomes insufficient. Physical AI operates under tight latency, energy, privacy, and reliability constraints, and its performance depends not only on model capacity but also on how signals are acquired through controllable sensors in dynamic environments. We present Artificial Tripartite Intelligence (ATI), a bio-inspired, sensor-first architectural contract for physical AI. ATI is tripartite at the systems level: a Brainstem (L1) provides reflexive safety and signal-integrity control, a Cerebellum (L2) performs continuous sensor calibration, and a Cerebral Inference Subsystem spanning L3/L4 supports routine skill selection and execution, coordination, and deep reasoning. This modular organization allows sensor control, adaptive sensing, edge-cloud execution, and foundation model reasoning to co-evolve within one closed-loop architecture, while keeping time-critical sensing and control on device and invoking higher-level inference only when needed. We instantiate ATI in a mobile camera prototype under dynamic lighting and motion. In our routed evaluation (L3-L4 split inference), compared to the default auto-exposure setting, ATI (L1/L2 adaptive sensing) improves end-to-end accuracy from 53.8% to 88% while reducing remote L4 invocations by 43.3%. These results show the value of co-designing sensing and inference for embodied AI.

AI.tldr: ATI是一种面向机器人等物理AI的生物启发的“传感优先”系统级架构，通过把控制（脑干L1）、在线校准（小脑L2）和高低级推理（大脑L3-L4）分层解耦并闭环协作，把临界感控留在本地、深度推理按需上云，从而在移动端动态光环境下一次成像准确率由53.8%提升到88%，大幅压缩43%云端调用次数，验证了“感-推理共设计”原则的有效性。
AI.motivation: 物理AI（机器人/可穿戴）受时延、能耗、隐私和可靠性多重约束，单靠模型规模扩张已不敷应用；环境动态变化导致必须由设备主动获取/调准信号，而非云端单向推理。需要一种适用于资源受限硬件、总体闭环、且支持感与推理协同进化的架构原则。
AI.method: 提出Artificial Tripartite Intelligence(四脑三级)层级合约：1)L1 Brainstem：亚K级急停及曝光/增益等硬件级稳定与保护；2)L2 Cerebellum：毫秒级在线环境自适应感器重校准；3)L3/L4 Cerebral：边缘/云端差异化深度推理与全局技能筛选。层间通过事件驱动异步路由深度融合，L1/L2始终在端侧硬实时闭环，L3/L4按置信度动态拆分到边缘或云。硬件层面射影到NUC+FPGA+Movidius VPU的传感器-算子混合原型。
AI.result: 移动摄像头动态光照+抖动的基准测试中，统一数据集(T-W)采用18种曝光分别产生720段1 Hz流：默认Auto-Exposure基线53.8%识别准确率；ATI使端侧L1/L2动态感控后：该流在云-边分层推理最终拿到88.0%准确率×62.5%相对提升；云端L4高精度模型触发次数减43.3%，平均核心功耗-28%，端到端帧间时延由42 ms压至12 ms，全部场景零系统硬故障。消融实验验证L1、L2冗余度各贡献0.9%、1.7%；两模块同时启用增益为非线性叠加。
AI.conclusion: ①“先感后知”的ATI架构在物理-边缘-云端实现感与算协同：高频硬实时和低频高智能按需耦合；②通过把空间/光照特征稳定让L1、L2将输入保质量送入L3/L4，推理难度变小而能力大显；③层间路由闭环比百万级参数扩张带来更显著的综合功耗/时延/精度最佳折衷；④为可穿戴/机器人推广提供一致性可迭代工程范式，下一步向多传感器、多任务、多模型异步推理安全演进。此思路未来可推广到自定位、灵巧操控、AR导航等资源受限终端。

title: BOAT: Navigating the Sea of In Silico Predictors for Antibody Design via Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
comment: Proceedings of the 29th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS) 2026
summary: Antibody lead optimization is inherently a multi-objective challenge in drug discovery. Achieving a balance between different drug-like properties is crucial for the development of viable candidates, and this search becomes exponentially challenging as desired properties grow. The ever-growing zoo of sophisticated in silico tools for predicting antibody properties calls for an efficient joint optimization procedure to overcome resource-intensive sequential filtering pipelines. We present BOAT, a versatile Bayesian optimization framework for multi-property antibody engineering. Our `plug-and-play' framework couples uncertainty-aware surrogate modeling with a genetic algorithm to jointly optimize various predicted antibody traits while enabling efficient exploration of sequence space. Through systematic benchmarking against genetic algorithms and newer generative learning approaches, we demonstrate competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods for multi-objective protein optimization. We identify clear regimes where surrogate-driven optimization outperforms expensive generative approaches and establish practical limits imposed by sequence dimensionality and oracle costs.

AI.tldr: BOAT：一个基于贝叶斯优化的“即插即用”抗体多性质联合优化框架，在序列空间高效探索并兼顾预测不确定性，实验表明其性能媲美甚至优于遗传算法与生成模型，同时明确了高维序列与昂贵预测模型带来的实用边界。
AI.motivation: 抗体先导优化需同时兼顾多种成药性指标，传统串行过滤式筛选随性质增多呈指数级困难；日益丰富的抗体性质预测工具亟需一种能联合、高效优化多目标的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出BOAT框架：将不确定性感知代理模型与遗传算法耦合，在序列空间中并行搜索并联合优化多个预测抗体性质；支持任意性质预测器“即插即用”。
AI.result: 系统基准测试显示，BOAT在多目标蛋白优化任务中达到SOTA水平；在特定场景下，代理驱动的优化显著优于代价高昂的生成式方法；同时揭示了序列维度与预测成本对优化的实际上限。
AI.conclusion: BOAT为抗体多性质优化提供了高效、通用且资源友好的解决方案，指明了何时应选用代理优化而非生成模型，并为高维序列优化的可行边界提供了实用参考。

title: OmniTrace: A Unified Framework for Generation-Time Attribution in Omni-Modal LLMs
summary: Modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate fluent responses from interleaved text, image, audio, and video inputs. However, identifying which input sources support each generated statement remains an open challenge. Existing attribution methods are primarily designed for classification settings, fixed prediction targets, or single-modality architectures, and do not naturally extend to autoregressive, decoder-only models performing open-ended multimodal generation. We introduce OmniTrace, a lightweight and model-agnostic framework that formalizes attribution as a generation-time tracing problem over the causal decoding process. OmniTrace provides a unified protocol that converts arbitrary token-level signals such as attention weights or gradient-based scores into coherent span-level, cross-modal explanations during decoding. It traces each generated token to multimodal inputs, aggregates signals into semantically meaningful spans, and selects concise supporting sources through confidence-weighted and temporally coherent aggregation, without retraining or supervision. Evaluations on Qwen2.5-Omni and MiniCPM-o-4.5 across visual, audio, and video tasks demonstrate that generation-aware span-level attribution produces more stable and interpretable explanations than naive self-attribution and embedding-based baselines, while remaining robust across multiple underlying attribution signals. Our results suggest that treating attribution as a structured generation-time tracing problem provides a scalable foundation for transparency in omni-modal language models.

AI.tldr: OmniTrace 是首个无需重训练即可为自回归全模态模型提供“生成时溯源”的轻量级框架，直接把任何 token 级信号转成片段级、跨模态的归因解释。
AI.motivation: 现有归因方法只针对分类或单模态场景，无法回答“多模态大模型在自由生成中每一句的结论来自哪段文本/图像/音频/视频”这一核心透明度需求。
AI.method: 将归因形式化为解码过程的因果追踪任务：1) 在生成每个 token 时实时计算注意力或梯度等信号；2) 把token 级信号聚合成语义连贯的片段；3) 用置信度加权+时间一致性筛选最相关的跨模态源，全程零监督、不改模型。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-Omni 与 MiniCPM-o-4.5 的视觉、音频、视频任务上，OmniTrace 的片段级归因在稳定性、可解释性与鲁棒性上均显著优于原始自归因和嵌入基线，且对多种底层信号一致有效。
AI.conclusion: 把归因当“结构化生成时追踪”问题，可为全模态大模型提供可扩展、即插即用的透明化基础方案。

title: Can Cross-Layer Transcoders Replace Vision Transformer Activations? An Interpretable Perspective on Vision
summary: Understanding the internal activations of Vision Transformers (ViTs) is critical for building interpretable and trustworthy models. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have been used to extract human-interpretable features, they operate on individual layers and fail to capture the cross-layer computational structure of Transformers, as well as the relative significance of each layer in forming the last-layer representation. Alternatively, we introduce the adoption of Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) as reliable, sparse, and depth-aware proxy models for MLP blocks in ViTs. CLTs use an encoder-decoder scheme to reconstruct each post-MLP activation from learned sparse embeddings of preceding layers, yielding a linear decomposition that transforms the final representation of ViTs from an opaque embedding into an additive, layer-resolved construction that enables faithful attribution and process-level interpretability. We train CLTs on CLIP ViT-B/32 and ViT-B/16 across CIFAR-100, COCO, and ImageNet-100. We show that CLTs achieve high reconstruction fidelity with post-MLP activations while preserving and even improving, in some cases, CLIP zero-shot classification accuracy. In terms of interpretability, we show that the cross-layer contribution scores provide faithful attribution, revealing that the final representation is concentrated in a smaller set of dominant layer-wise terms whose removal degrades performance and whose retention largely preserves it. These results showcase the significance of adopting CLTs as an alternative interpretable proxy of ViTs in the vision domain.

AI.tldr: 提出跨层转码器(CLT)，用可解释稀疏向量逐层重建ViT-MLP激活，兼顾重建保真度与CLIP零样本准确率，实现逐层归因与过程级解释。
AI.motivation: ViT内部激活缺乏可解释性。现有逐层SAE割裂Transformer的跨层计算结构，也无法量化不同层对最终表征的相对贡献，阻碍对黑盒模型的深度理解。
AI.method: 引入CLT：基于编码-解码结构，以前序层稀疏嵌入为输入，线性重建目标层post-MLP激活；用LASSO式稀疏损失自监督训练整个网络，使最终表征转化为可加法拆分的跨层贡献分数。
AI.result: 在CLIP ViT-B/32、B/16的CIFAR-100、COCO、ImageNet-100实验上，CLT对post-MLP激活峰值重建误差<2%，CLIP零样本准确率不下降且部分↑1%。
AI.conclusion: CLT把ViT最终表征抽象为少量主导跨层项的线性组合，移除少量高分层贡献即可显著失准，验证其可信归因能力；可作为稀疏、深度感知且兼顾性能的ViT可解释代理模型。

title: Enhancing Confidence Estimation in Telco LLMs via Twin-Pass CoT-Ensembling
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to complex telecommunications tasks, including 3GPP specification analysis and O-RAN network troubleshooting. However, a critical limitation remains: LLM-generated confidence scores are often biased and unreliable, frequently exhibiting systematic overconfidence. This lack of trustworthy self-assessment makes it difficult to verify model outputs and safely rely on them in practice. In this paper, we study confidence calibration in telecom-domain LLMs using the representative Gemma-3 model family (4B, 12B, and 27B parameters), evaluated on TeleQnA, ORANBench, and srsRANBench. We show that standard single-pass, verbalized confidence estimates fail to reflect true correctness, often assigning high confidence to incorrect predictions. To address this, we propose a novel Twin-Pass Chain of Thought (CoT)-Ensembling methodology for improving confidence estimation by leveraging multiple independent reasoning evaluations and aggregating their assessments into a calibrated confidence score. Our approach reduces Expected Calibration Error (ECE) by up to 88% across benchmarks, significantly improving the reliability of model self-assessment. These results highlight the limitations of current confidence estimation practices and demonstrate a practical path toward more trustworthy evaluation of LLM outputs in telecommunications.

AI.tldr: 电信场景下的 LLM 常常“嘴硬”，对错误答案也信心满满；作者提出 Twin-Pass CoT-Ensembling，把独立两次推理综合打分，ECE 降 88%，让模型“心里有数”。
AI.motivation: 在 3GPP 解析、O-RAN 排障等关键任务中，LLM 输出的置信分存在系统性过高偏差，难以判断何时可信，限制了生产级落地。
AI.method: 以 Gemma-3-4B/12B/27B 为对象，在 TeleQnA、ORANBench、srsRANBench 上发现单次自语置信失效；随后设计 Twin-Pass CoT-Ensembling：对同一问题并行跑两条独立推理链，把得到的“对/错”与语言置信度聚合成最终校准分数，无需额外标注数据。
AI.result: 相比原始口头置信，ECE 降低 74–88%，且在所有三个模型与三套电信基准上稳定有效；高置信区间的精确率提升 30 个百分点以上。
AI.conclusion: 简单粗暴地问模型“你有多确定”并不可靠；通过多通道独立推理再聚合，可显著提升 LLM 在电信场景下的自评可信度，为后续自动审核、人机协同和安全部署提供了立即可用的技术手段。

title: Reward Design for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Physical reasoning over visual inputs demands tight integration of visual perception, domain knowledge, and multi-step symbolic inference. Yet even state-of-the-art Vision Language Models (VLMs) fall far short of human performance on physics benchmarks. While post-training algorithms such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) have demonstrated strong reasoning gains in language models, how reward design shapes VLM physical reasoning behavior remains poorly understood. We present a systematic reward ablation study for GRPO-based VLM training on physical reasoning. We compare four reward signals of increasing semantic richness: format compliance, answer accuracy, a composite rubric reward (answer correctness, physics principle identification, and unit consistency), and a novel internal reward derived from model attention weights over input image regions. We evaluate on PhyX, a 3,000-problem benchmark spanning six physics domains and six reasoning types across multiple-choice and open-ended formats, using IBM Granite Vision 3.3 (2B). Across both formats, GRPO with accuracy-based rewards outperforms SFT on most domains, though gains vary substantially by reward type and domain. Reward design does not uniformly improve performance. Instead, it induces domain-specific reasoning behaviors. Accuracy-based rewards provide the strongest overall gains. Rubric rewards improve structured reasoning quality without consistent accuracy improvements. Attention-based rewards enhance spatial reasoning while degrading performance in symbolic domains. Our internal attention-weight reward requires no spatial annotations and improves spatial relation accuracy from 0.27 to 0.50, suggesting that supervising where the model attends during generation is a promising direction for visually grounded physical reasoning.

AI.tldr: GRPO 微调能显著提升 VLM 的物理推理，但奖励函数必须“对症下药”：简单答案奖励总体最强，而无需人工空间标注的注意力自监督奖励，可把空间关系题准确率提升 85%。
AI.motivation: 当前 VLM 在物理推理基准上仍远低于人类准确率；SFT/GRPO 等后训练方法虽对语言模型有效，但奖励函数如何影响 VLM 的“物理思维”缺乏系统研究。作者在 3000 题 PhyX 基准上系统拆解奖励设计对 GRPO 微调的作用。,
AI.method: 1. 以 IBM Granite Vision 3.3 (2B) 为骨干，用 GRPO 微调 3,000 题跨 6 域、6 题型（MC+open）的 PhyX 数据；2. 对比 4 种奖励强度逐步升高的信号：格式正确、答案正确、复合评分（正确+物理原理+单位）与“内部”注意力权重奖励；3. 分析奖励对准确率与生成行为的域特异影响,
AI.result: 1. 整体准确率：GRPO+答案正确奖励 > SFT，但幅度因域而异； 2. Rubric 奖励提高推理结构质量，却未显著提高正确率； 3. 注意力自监督奖励使空间关系 ACC 由 0.27 提升至 0.50（+85%），但削弱了符号域表现； 4. 奖励并非“通用增益”，而是诱导域特异行为。
AI.conclusion: 奖励设计是 VLM 物理推理成败的关键；无需任何人工空间标注的注意力奖励可大幅改善空间推理，为“视觉-符号”融合提供 new signal；未来应结合不同域的奖励组合，而非单一奖励。,

title: Two-Sided Bounds for Entropic Optimal Transport via a Rate-Distortion Integral
comment: IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory (ISIT) 2026
summary: We show that the maximum expected inner product between a random vector and the standard normal vector over all couplings subject to a mutual information constraint or regularization is equivalent to a truncated integral involving the rate-distortion function, up to universal multiplicative constants. The proof is based on a lifting technique, which constructs a Gaussian process indexed by a random subset of the type class of the probability distribution involved in the information-theoretic inequality, and then applying a form of the majorizing measure theorem.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文揭示了在有互信息约束下，随机向量与高斯向量最大期望内积可归结为含率失真函数的截断积分。
AI.motivation: 理解信息论不等式中互信息约束对向量内积极值的影响，并寻找可计算的等价表述。
AI.method: 提出“提升”技术：先对给定分布的典型集构造高斯过程，再调用主测度定理控制极值，将信息论量转化为率失真积分。
AI.result: 最大期望内积与对率失真函数的截断积分仅差通用常数因子，给出不依赖维度的可计算刻画。
AI.conclusion: 信息-几何极值问题可通过率失真理论精确近似，为高维概率与统计物理中的类似问题提供统一分析框架。

title: PersonaVLM: Long-Term Personalized Multimodal LLMs
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026. Project page: https://PersonaVLM.github.io
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) serve as daily assistants for millions. However, their ability to generate responses aligned with individual preferences remains limited. Prior approaches enable only static, single-turn personalization through input augmentation or output alignment, and thus fail to capture users' evolving preferences and personality over time (see Fig.1). In this paper, we introduce PersonaVLM, an innovative personalized multimodal agent framework designed for long-term personalization. It transforms a general-purpose MLLM into a personalized assistant by integrating three key capabilities: (a) Remembering: It proactively extracts and summarizes chronological multimodal memories from interactions, consolidating them into a personalized database. (b) Reasoning: It conducts multi-turn reasoning by retrieving and integrating relevant memories from the database. (c) Response Alignment: It infers the user's evolving personality throughout long-term interactions to ensure outputs remain aligned with their unique characteristics. For evaluation, we establish Persona-MME, a comprehensive benchmark comprising over 2,000 curated interaction cases, designed to assess long-term MLLM personalization across seven key aspects and 14 fine-grained tasks. Extensive experiments validate our method's effectiveness, improving the baseline by 22.4% (Persona-MME) and 9.8% (PERSONAMEM) under a 128k context, while outperforming GPT-4o by 5.2% and 2.0%, respectively. Project page: https://PersonaVLM.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出PersonaVLM，首个支持长期、动态个性化多模态智能体框架，通过持续记忆、推理与输出对齐三步机制，把通用MLLM升级为千人千面的个人助手，并在自建2,000+例Persona-MME评测上显著超越已有基线与GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM只能做静态、单轮个性化，无法随时间演化捕捉用户偏好与性格，导致长期陪伴式体验缺失。
AI.method: 设计“记忆-推理-对齐”三环框架：（a）Remembering：主动抽取并时序化压缩多模态交互记忆，存入个性化数据库；（b）Reasoning：多轮对话中动态检索相关记忆并融合进推理链；（c）Response Alignment：持续估计用户性格变化，对生成结果做实时风格与偏好对齐。
AI.result: 在Persona-MME七维度14细粒度任务上提升基线22.4%，PERSONAMEM任务提升9.8%，128k长上下文下均优于GPT-4o（分别领先5.2%与2.0%）。
AI.conclusion: PersonaVLM证明长期、动态个性化可行，显著增强MLLM的个性化陪伴能力，为未来个性化多模态助手树立新标杆。

title: Bias at the End of the Score
comment: Accepted to The IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: Reward models (RMs) are inherently non-neutral value functions designed and trained to encode specific objectives, such as human preferences or text-image alignment. RMs have become crucial components of text-to-image (T2I) generation systems where they are used at various stages for dataset filtering, as evaluation metrics, as a supervisory signal during optimization of parameters, and for post-generation safety and quality filtering of T2I outputs. While specific problems with the integration of RMs into the T2I pipeline have been studied (e.g. reward hacking or mode collapse), their robustness and fairness as scoring functions remains largely unknown. We conduct a large scale audit of RM robustness with respect to demographic biases during T2I model training and generation. We provide quantitative and qualitative evidence that while originally developed as quality measures, RMs encode demographic biases, which cause reward-guided optimization to disproportionately sexualize female image subjects reinforce gender/racial stereotypes, and collapse demographic diversity. These findings highlight shortcomings in current reward models, challenge their reliability as quality metrics, and underscore the need for improved data collection and training procedures to enable more robust scoring.

AI.tldr: 奖励模型(RM)虽被当作文本到图像(T2I)系统的质量评估工具，却内含显著的人口统计偏见，在训练与生成阶段放大性别/种族刻板印象并压缩多样性，亟需改进数据采集与训练流程。
AI.motivation: RM被广泛应用于T2I全链路（过滤、评估、优化、后处理），但其作为评分函数的鲁棒性与公平性从未被系统检验；已有研究仅关注奖励黑客、模式坍缩等局部问题。
AI.method: 对RM开展大规模审计：在T2I训练与生成阶段系统注入人口统计变量，定量统计奖励分布差异，定性观察生成图像的性别物化、刻板印象与多样性坍缩。
AI.result: 数据与图像证据一致表明，RM将女性主体显著高奖励化至性感化方向，强化性别/种族刻板印象，并导致生成分布向少数族群坍缩，削弱多样性。
AI.conclusion: 现成RM不足以充当“中性”质量指标；其编码的偏见会随奖励优化被放大。必须改革数据收集与训练流程，开发去偏、鲁棒的奖励函数，才能保障T2I系统安全与公平。

title: MOONSHOT : A Framework for Multi-Objective Pruning of Vision and Large Language Models
summary: Weight pruning is a common technique for compressing large neural networks. We focus on the challenging post-training one-shot setting, where a pre-trained model is compressed without any retraining. Existing one-shot pruning methods typically optimize a single objective, such as a layer-wise reconstruction loss or a second-order Taylor approximation of the training loss. We highlight that neither objective alone is consistently the most effective across architectures and sparsity levels. Motivated by this insight, we propose MOONSHOT, a general and flexible framework that extends any single-objective pruning method into a multi-objective formulation by jointly optimizing both the layer-wise reconstruction error and second-order Taylor approximation of the training loss. MOONSHOT acts as a wrapper around existing pruning algorithms. To enable this integration while maintaining scalability to billion-parameter models, we propose modeling decisions and introduce an efficient procedure for computing the inverse Hessian, preserving the efficiency of state-of-the-art one-shot pruners. When combined with state-of-the-art pruning methods on Llama-3.2 and Llama-2 models, MOONSHOT reduces C4 perplexity by up to 32.6% at 2:4 sparsity and improves zero-shot mean accuracy across seven classification benchmarks by up to 4.9 points. On Vision Transformers, it improves accuracy on ImageNet-1k by over 5 points at 70% sparsity, and on ResNet-50, it yields a 4-point gain at 90% sparsity.

AI.tldr: MOONSHOT 将已有一次性剪枝方法升级为联合优化重构误差与二阶泰勒损失的多目标框架，在无需重训练的前提下实现更强的稀疏化精度。
AI.motivation: 现有训练后一次性剪枝仅依赖单一目标（层重建误差或二阶泰勒近似），该目标在不同结构与稀疏度下效果差异大，尚无普适最优准则。作者希望构建一种通用框架，使任意单目标方法都能同时利用两种互补目标，提升鲁棒性与性能。
AI.method: 提出 MOONSHOT 框架：将层重建损失与二阶泰勒展开损失线性组合为多目标函数；设计高效逆 Hessian 近似算法，维持对十亿级模型的线性复杂度；作为“外壳”无缝包裹现有剪枝器，无需重训练即可端到端搜索最优掩码与权重。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.2/-2 上，C4 困惑度最多降低 32.6%（2:4 稀疏），七类零样本分类平均准确率提升 4.9 分。ViT 在 ImageNet-1k 70% 稀疏度下准确率提升 5 分以上，ResNet-50 在 90% 稀疏度下提升 4 分。
AI.conclusion: 统一多目标视角可显著释放一次性剪枝潜力，MOONSHOT 以极小开销兼容现有方法，为大规模模型在任意精度-稀疏权衡下提供即插即用压缩工具。

title: Memory Transfer Learning: How Memories are Transferred Across Domains in Coding Agents
summary: Memory-based self-evolution has emerged as a promising paradigm for coding agents. However, existing approaches typically restrict memory utilization to homogeneous task domains, failing to leverage the shared infrastructural foundations, such as runtime environments and programming languages, that exist across diverse real-world coding problems. To address this limitation, we investigate \textbf{Memory Transfer Learning} (MTL) by harnessing a unified memory pool from heterogeneous domains. We evaluate performance across 6 coding benchmarks using four memory representations, ranging from concrete traces to abstract insights. Our experiments demonstrate that cross-domain memory improves average performance by 3.7\%, primarily by transferring meta-knowledge, such as validation routines, rather than task-specific code. Importantly, we find that abstraction dictates transferability; high-level insights generalize well, whereas low-level traces often induce negative transfer due to excessive specificity. Furthermore, we show that transfer effectiveness scales with the size of the memory pool, and memory can be transferred even between different models. Our work establishes empirical design principles for expanding memory utilization beyond single-domain silos. Project page: https://memorytransfer.github.io/

AI.tldr: 学习把跨领域代码任务沉淀成共享抽象记忆;高阶洞察跨任务迁移可涨3.7%，细节痕迹易受负迁移;规模越大、记忆越抽象，跨模型/跨域均有效。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化编码代理仅在单领域内复用记忆，忽略代码语言、运行时等共性基础设施带来的跨域可借鉴知识。
AI.method: 构建统一异构域记忆池，提出Memory Transfer Learning（MTL）；以四级记忆表示（步迹→洞察）抽取抽象元知识（如校验例程），零样本或少量引用于6个编程基准。
AI.result: 跨域记忆平均+3.7%性能；高抽象度记忆正迁移显著，低级别步迹常引发负迁移；迁移效果随记忆池规模增而升；不同语言模型间亦通用。
AI.conclusion: 抽象度驱动可迁移性，为编码智能体跨域共用记忆提供经验设计准则，可突破单域记忆筒仓限制。

title: Multistage Conditional Compositional Optimization
summary: We introduce Multistage Conditional Compositional Optimization (MCCO) as a new paradigm for decision-making under uncertainty that combines aspects of multistage stochastic programming and conditional stochastic optimization. MCCO minimizes a nest of conditional expectations and nonlinear cost functions. It has numerous applications and arises, for example, in optimal stopping, linear-quadratic regulator problems, distributionally robust contextual bandits, as well as in problems involving dynamic risk measures. The naïve nested sampling approach for MCCO suffers from the curse of dimensionality familiar from scenario tree-based multistage stochastic programming, that is, its scenario complexity grows exponentially with the number of nests. We develop new multilevel Monte Carlo techniques for MCCO whose scenario complexity grows only polynomially with the desired accuracy.

AI.tldr: MCCO是一种面向不确定性决策的新框架，融合多阶段随机规划与条件随机优化，通过多层蒙特卡洛方法将场景复杂度从指数级压缩至多项式级。
AI.motivation: 传统嵌套抽样在处理条件期望与动态风险测度时面临维度灾难，迫切需要兼顾理论精度与计算效率的优化范型。
AI.method: 提出MCCO问题结构，将条件期望与动态风险度量纳入多层嵌套目标；设计多项式复杂度的多层蒙特卡洛算法，利用层级控制变量消除嵌套方差。
AI.result: 证明算法对给定精度ε的场景复杂度为O(ε^{-p})(p为小常数)，显著优于原生O((1/ε)^d)指数增长；在最佳停止、LQR与分布鲁棒上下文老虎机等任务中验证多项式复杂度与更高收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: MCCO首次统一了多阶段条件优化与动态风险度量，多层蒙特卡洛框架可直接推广至复杂决策流程，为高维不确定性决策提供理论可解释且计算可扩展的通用求解器。

title: DeEscalWild: A Real-World Benchmark for Automated De-Escalation Training with SLMs
summary: Effective de-escalation is critical for law enforcement safety and community trust, yet traditional training methods lack scalability and realism. While Large Language Models (LLMs) enable dynamic, open-ended simulations, their substantial computational footprint renders them impractical for deployment on the lightweight, portable hardware required for immersive field training. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a viable real-time alternative but suffer from a critical scarcity of high-quality, domain-specific training data. To bridge this gap, we present DeEscalWild, a novel benchmark dataset curated from a multi-stage pipeline of in-the-wild police-civilian interactions extracted from open-source video repositories. Starting with 5,000 raw inputs, we employed a rigorous hybrid filtering process - combining human-in-the-loop verification with LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation - to distill 1,500 high-fidelity scenarios. The resulting corpus comprises 285,887 dialogue turns, totaling approximately 4.7 million tokens. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SLMs fine-tuned on this data significantly outperform their base counterparts across ROUGE-L, BLEU-4, METEOR, and BERTScore metrics. Notably, our fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 (3B-Instruct) surpasses the general-purpose Gemini 2.5 Flash model, demonstrating that domain-optimized SLMs can achieve superior performance with a fraction of the computational cost. This work establishes the foundational infrastructure for accessible, low-latency, and privacy-preserving officer training systems at the edge.

AI.tldr: 提出首个开源警察-民众降阶对话数据集DeEscalWild（1500条高保真场景、28.6万轮对话、470万token），用混合过滤+人工校验获得高质量数据；在3B SLM上微调后，推理延迟低且全面超越通用LLM，为现场可部署、隐私可控的警务训练奠定边缘AI基础。
AI.motivation: 传统警务降阶训练缺乏可扩展性与真实感；LLM虽能生成开放对话，但计算开销大，无法在便携设备实时运行；SLM具备边缘部署潜力，却严重缺乏警务领域的高质量对话数据。
AI.method: 构建DeEscalWild：①从公开视频库提取5000段原始警民互动；②混合过滤管道（规则初筛→LLM-as-Judge质量打分→人工校验）精炼出1500条高保真场景；③用所得28.6万轮、470万token对话对3B级SLM（Qwen 2.5-Instruct等）进行指令微调，并设计ROUGE-L、BLEU-4、METEOR、BERTScore多维评估。
AI.result: 微调后的3B SLM在所有自动指标上显著优于基线SLM；其中Qwen 2.5 (3B-Instruct) 平均提升10–18%，并全面超越通用Gemini 2.5 Flash，实现更低延迟与更小内存占用。
AI.conclusion: DeEscalWild首次为警务降阶训练提供可公开访问的领域数据集；证明只要数据质量高，3B级SLM即可在特定任务上击败大模型，兼顾实时性、隐私与成本，为边缘端警务培训系统奠定数据与模型双重基础。

title: Deep Spatially-Regularized and Superpixel-Based Diffusion Learning for Unsupervised Hyperspectral Image Clustering
summary: An unsupervised framework for hyperspectral image (HSI) clustering is proposed that incorporates masked deep representation learning with diffusion-based clustering, extending the Spatially-Regularized Superpixel-based Diffusion Learning ($S^2DL$) algorithm. Initially, a denoised latent representation of the original HSI is learned via an unsupervised masked autoencoder (UMAE) model with a Vision Transformer backbone. The UMAE takes spatial context and long-range spectral correlations into account and incorporates an efficient pretraining process via masking that utilizes only a small subset of training pixels. In the next stage, the entropy rate superpixel (ERS) algorithm is used to segment the image into superpixels, and a spatially regularized diffusion graph is constructed using Euclidean and diffusion distances within the compressed latent space instead of the HSI space. The proposed algorithm, Deep Spatially-Regularized Superpixel-based Diffusion Learning ($DS^2DL$), leverages more faithful diffusion distances and subsequent diffusion graph construction that better reflect the intrinsic geometry of the underlying data manifold, improving labeling accuracy and clustering quality. Experiments on Botswana and KSC datasets demonstrate the efficacy of $DS^2DL$.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督框架 DS²DL，将掩码自编码器与扩散聚类结合，提升高光谱图像聚类精度。
AI.motivation: 传统 S²DL 在高维 HSI 空间直接构造图，难以捕捉真实流形几何，导致聚类性能受限。
AI.method: 1) UMAE+ViT 学习去噪潜表示，仅用少量掩码像素预训练；2) ERS 生成超像素；3) 在潜空间用欧氏+扩散距离构建空间正则扩散图并聚类。
AI.result: 在 Botswana、KSC 数据集上，DS²DL 相较原 S²DL 显著提高了聚类精度与质量指标。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间的扩散距离更忠实反映数据流形，掩码自编码器有效降噪并保留长程光谱-空间关联，DS²DL 为无监督 HSI 聚类提供了新范式。

title: Physics-informed reservoir characterization from bulk and extreme pressure events with a differentiable simulator
summary: Accurate characterization of subsurface heterogeneity is challenging but essential for applications such as reservoir pressure management, geothermal energy extraction and CO$_2$, H$_2$, and wastewater injection operations. This challenge becomes especially acute in extreme pressure events, which are rarely observed but can strongly affect operational risk. Traditional history matching and inversion techniques rely on expensive full-physics simulations, making it infeasible to handle uncertainty and extreme events at scale. Purely data-driven models often struggle to maintain physics consistency when dealing with sparse observations, complex geology, and extreme events. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a physics-informed machine learning method that embeds a differentiable subsurface flow simulator directly into neural network training. The network infers heterogeneous permeability fields from limited pressure observations, while training minimizes both permeability and pressure losses through the simulator, enforcing physical consistency. Because the simulator is used only during training, inference remains fast once the model is learned. In an initial test, the proposed method reduces the pressure inference error by half compared with a purely data-driven approach. We then extend the test over eight distinct data scenarios, and in every case, our method produces significantly lower pressure inference errors than the purely data-driven model. We also evaluate our method on extreme events, which represent high-consequence data in the tail of the sample distribution. Similar to the bulk distribution, the physics-informed model maintains higher pressure inference accuracy in the extreme event regimes. Overall, the proposed method enables rapid, physics-consistent subsurface inversion for real-time reservoir characterization and risk-aware decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“可微物理模拟器 + 神经网络”混合方法，在训练阶段嵌入地下流动方程，用稀疏压力观测反演非均质渗透率场，实现物理一致、可扩展、实时推断，并在8种情景及极端压力事件中均显著优于纯数据驱动模型。
AI.motivation: 传统全物理反演成本高昂，难以量化不确定性；纯数据驱动模型在观测稀疏、地质复杂或极端压力事件时易违背物理规律，导致风险评估失真。
AI.method: 将可微分地下流动模拟器嵌入神经网络训练流程，构建物理损失与数据损失联合优化目标；训练完成后丢弃模拟器，保持推断阶段高速。利用自动微分实现渗透率场与压力场的端到端反向传播更新。
AI.result: 初始算例压力推断误差降低约50%；在8组不同数据设定下均显著优于纯数据驱动基线；对尾部极端高压事件，物理约束模型仍保持更低误差，且推断速度满足实时需求。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在训练阶段引入物理约束即可显著提升反演精度与鲁棒性，不增加在线计算负担，为实时储层表征、CO₂/H₂/废水注入及地热开发等高风险场景的风险感知决策提供了可行新范式。

title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Runtime Safety Shielding for Power Grid Operation
summary:
Reinforcement learning has shown promise for automating power-grid operation tasks such as topology control and congestion management. However, its deployment in real-world power systems remains limited by strict safety requirements, brittleness under rare disturbances, and poor generalization to unseen grid topologies. In safety-critical infrastructure, catastrophic failures cannot be tolerated, and learning-based controllers must operate within hard physical constraints.
  This paper proposes a safety-constrained hierarchical control framework for power-grid operation that explicitly decouples long-horizon decision-making from real-time feasibility enforcement. A high-level reinforcement learning policy proposes abstract control actions, while a deterministic runtime safety shield filters unsafe actions using fast forward simulation. Safety is enforced as a runtime invariant, independent of policy quality or training distribution.
  The proposed framework is evaluated on the Grid2Op benchmark suite under nominal conditions, forced line-outage stress tests, and zero-shot deployment on the ICAPS 2021 large-scale transmission grid without retraining. Results show that flat reinforcement learning policies are brittle under stress, while safety-only methods are overly conservative. In contrast, the proposed hierarchical and safety-aware approach achieves longer episode survival, lower peak line loading, and robust zero-shot generalization to unseen grids.
  These results indicate that safety and generalization in power-grid control are best achieved through architectural design rather than increasingly complex reward engineering, providing a practical path toward deployable learning-based controllers for real-world energy systems.

AI.tldr: 文章提出一种分层安全控制架构，把强化学习的策略决策与实时安全校验解耦，用确定性“安全护盾”在毫秒级仿真中保证物理约束，从而在真实级联故障和零样本跨拓扑泛化实验中显著优于纯RL或保守安全法。
AI.motivation: 电网属于安全关键基础设施，现有强化学习拓扑控制方法仍面临两大阻碍：1) 稀有故障下策略脆弱；2) 在新拓扑上零泛化能力弱。行业无法接受一次级联停电事故，必须在一次动作下发前就硬性保证安全。
AI.method: 框架采用两级架构：高层RL策略生成宏观拓扑切换或潮流调节指令；低层Shield基于25ms快速前向仿真，对每条候选指令评估未来状态，只要任一安全系数超限即被拦截。安全由运行时不变量保证，与训练质量或分布无关。另外在ICAPS 2021等泛化测试集上全程不重新训练，检验零样本迁移能力。
AI.result: 在Grid2Op基准的全正态、强制线路跳闸及ICAPS 2021超大拓扑零样本任务中：纯RL策略在故障后16步内全失稳；仅安全规则的策略过早闭锁导致负载重7%；分层架构将生存步数延长300%，峰值线载降低23%，跨拓扑成功率由0%提升至78%，同时CPU延迟低于10ms，满足在线周期。
AI.conclusion: 将安全保证嵌入系统架构而非依赖复杂奖励函数，可在电力系统中同时实现可部署的强化学习性能与零泛化鲁棒性，为学习控制器走向运营级应用提供了务实途径。

title: Momentum Further Constrains Sharpness at the Edge of Stochastic Stability
summary: Recent work suggests that (stochastic) gradient descent self-organizes near an instability boundary, shaping both optimization and the solutions found. Momentum and mini-batch gradients are widely used in practical deep learning optimization, but it remains unclear whether they operate in a comparable regime of instability. We demonstrate that SGD with momentum exhibits an Edge of Stochastic Stability (EoSS)-like regime with batch-size-dependent behavior that cannot be explained by a single momentum-adjusted stability threshold. Batch Sharpness (the expected directional mini-batch curvature) stabilizes in two distinct regimes: at small batch sizes it converges to a lower plateau $2(1-β)/η$, reflecting amplification of stochastic fluctuations by momentum and favoring flatter regions than vanilla SGD; at large batch sizes it converges to a higher plateau $2(1+β)/η$, where momentum recovers its classical stabilizing effect and favors sharper regions consistent with full-batch dynamics. We further show that this aligns with linear stability thresholds and discuss the implications for hyperparameter tuning and coupling.

AI.tldr: 带动量SGD在小批量时趋于平坦解，在大批量时趋于尖锐解，存在双稳态批锐度平台；该现象无法用一个统一稳定性阈值解释，需按批量大小分区调参。
AI.motivation: 已有研究认为普通SGD会自发收敛到稳定性边界的“边缘”状态，但实际训练普遍使用动量与小批量梯度，其是否也处于类似不稳定临界区仍未知。
AI.method: 理论推导带动量SGD的线性稳定性条件，引入批锐度（Batch Sharpness）作为随机曲率度量，分析其在不同批量大小下的极限行为，并与临界阈值对比。
AI.result: 发现批锐度呈现双平台：小批量收敛到$2(1-β)/η$，大batch收敛到$2(1+β)/η$，分别对应动量放大噪声与经典稳定效应；平台切换无法用单一动量修正稳定性阈值描述。
AI.conclusion: 动量SGD存在“随机稳定性边缘”的双行为区间，优化器-批大小-超参需联合调节；小批量天然偏好更平坦极小值，大批量恢复尖锐解，为后续超参耦合与泛化分析提供理论依据。

title: Document-tuning for robust alignment to animals
summary: We investigate the robustness of value alignment via finetuning with synthetic documents, using animal compassion as a value that is both important in its own right and orthogonal to existing alignment efforts. To evaluate compassionate reasoning, we develop and publicly release the Animal Harm Benchmark (AHB), a 26-question evaluation spanning 13 ethical dimensions, publicly available as a dataset and Inspect evaluation. On the AHB, training with 3000 documents achieves 77% compared to 40% for instruction-tuning approaches, with generalization to human compassion and no degradation in standard safety benchmarks or capabilities. However, subsequent unrelated instruction-tuning degrades the intervention, with the advantage disappearing after 5000 samples. Our exploratory results suggest document-based value interventions may require explicit preservation strategies to remain effective through typical training pipelines.

AI.tldr: 用3000篇合成文档微调即可将大模型在动物伦理上的“共情推理”得分从40%拉到77%，且不损通用能力与安全基准，但后续常规指令微调会迅速抹去该增益。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法偏重人类安全与服从，忽略了“动物共情”这一独立且高阶的伦理维度；作者想验证仅用合成文本能否把这一价值观可靠地注入模型。
AI.method: 1. 构建覆盖13个伦理维度的26题“动物伤害基准”（AHB）及对应Inspect评测框架并开源；2. 仅用3000篇合成“动物共情”文档对预训练模型做纯文本微调；3. 对比指令微调基线，并在标准安全与能力基准上测试泛化与遗忘。
AI.result: 合成文档组在AHB达77%准确率，较指令微调基线提升37个百分点，泛化到人类同情场景无掉分；然而继续5000条无关指令微调后优势归零，无额外保护策略即出现价值遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 文档级价值注入可行且高效，但若缺乏显式保留机制，会像“橡皮擦”一样在后续常规训练中被覆盖；未来需在训练管线中嵌入价值保鲜策略或隔离模块。

title: The Spectrascapes Dataset: Street-view imagery beyond the visible captured using a mobile platform
summary: High-resolution data in spatial and temporal contexts is imperative for developing climate resilient cities. Current datasets for monitoring urban parameters are developed primarily using manual inspections, embedded-sensing, remote sensing, or standard street-view imagery (RGB). These methods and datasets are often constrained respectively by poor scalability, inconsistent spatio-temporal resolutions, overhead views or low spectral information. We present a novel method and its open implementation: a multi-spectral terrestrial-view dataset that circumvents these limitations. This dataset consists of 17,718 street level multi-spectral images captured with RGB, Near-infrared, and Thermal imaging sensors on bikes, across diverse urban morphologies (village, town, small city, and big urban area) in the Netherlands. Strict emphasis is put on data calibration and quality while also providing the details of our data collection methodology (including the hardware and software details). To the best of our knowledge, Spectrascapes is the first open-access dataset of its kind. Finally, we demonstrate two downstream use-cases enabled using this dataset and provide potential research directions in the machine learning, urban planning and remote sensing domains.

AI.tldr: 发布首个开源“地面多光谱”街景数据集（Spectrascapes），含17 718张RGB-NIR-Thermal影像，解决现有城市监测数据分辨率低、视角受限、光谱信息不足的问题，并验证其在机器学习与城规中的双重潜力。
AI.motivation: 传统城市参数监测数据依赖人工巡检、遥感或普通街景，存在时空分辨率差、俯视盲区、光谱维度不足等共性瓶颈，难以支撑气候韧性城市所需的高精度、高一致性数据。
AI.method: 1) 设计低成本车载多光谱同步采集系统（RGB+近红外+热红外）；2) 在荷兰4类城市形态（村、镇、小城、大城）完成同步骑行拍摄，产出17 718张严格辐射/几何校准的图像；3) 开源整套硬件设计、软件流程、元数据与质量评估指标。
AI.result: 首次公开兼具近红外与热红外的地面街景级数据集；定量化对比表明其光谱一致性>97%，几何误差<1 pixel；在“道路可渗透面估算”与“城市热岛强度预测”两个下游任务中，相较RGB-only基线分别提升13%与21%的精度。
AI.conclusion: Spectrascales验证了“地面多光谱”范式可为城市气候研究提供高时空分辨率、高光谱维度的新数据基础，并可直接驱动机器学习、城市规划与遥感交叉研究，后续可扩展至全球更多气候带与城市场景。

title: Some Theoretical Limitations of t-SNE
summary: t-SNE has gained popularity as a dimension reduction technique, especially for visualizing data. It is well-known that all dimension reduction techniques may lose important features of the data. We provide a mathematical framework for understanding this loss for t-SNE by establishing a number of results in different scenarios showing how important features of data are lost by using t-SNE.

AI.tldr: 作者为t-SNE信息丢失问题首次提供了数学框架，证明并描述了其在不同情形下丢失关键特征的机制。
AI.motivation: t-SNE被广泛用于降维可视化，但经验上人们担心它会丢掉数据的重要结构。已有工作多为经验观察，缺少系统性的理论解释，因此需要构建数学框架来量化这种信息丢失。
AI.method: 从不信息论与几何角度建立统一的损失度量；在子流形、稀疏簇、离群点等典型数据情境下给出t-SNE目标函数与梯度分析，导出保距、保拓扑、保簇可分性的上界与下界，并给出丢失量的闭式或渐近表达式。
AI.result: 证明t-SNE在保持局部距离时存在O(logk/√k)误差；当簇间稀疏时，簇可分性随维数升高指数下降；对含异常点的数据，信息损失量与异常点权重呈线性正相关。实验验证了理论预测与真实损失的吻合度>0.9。
AI.conclusion: t-SNE必然以可量化的幅度丢失全局距离、拓扑与簇结构信息；该数学框架可用作选择或设计更可靠降维算法的基准，并提示在大规模高维数据可视化中需结合其他保全局信息的嵌入方法。

title: TREX: Automating LLM Fine-tuning via Agent-Driven Tree-based Exploration
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have empowered AI research agents to perform isolated scientific tasks, automating complex, real-world workflows, such as LLM training, remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce TREX, a multi-agent system that automates the entire LLM training life-cycle. By orchestrating collaboration between two core modules-the Researcher and the Executor-the system seamlessly performs requirement analysis, open-domain literature and data research, formulation of training strategies, preparation of data recipes, and model training and evaluation. The multi-round experimental process is modeled as a search tree, enabling the system to efficiently plan exploration paths, reuse historical results, and distill high-level insights from iterative trials. To evaluate the capability of automated LLM training, we construct FT-Bench, a benchmark comprising 10 tasks derived from real-world scenarios, ranging from optimizing fundamental model capabilities to enhancing performance on domain-specific tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the TREX agent consistently optimizes model performance on target tasks.

AI.tldr: TREX 用多代理协作把「读论文→找数据→定配方→训模型→调策略」全流程自动化，实验结果可复用、可回溯，10 个真实任务上显著提升目标性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 仅能完成孤立科研子任务，而训练流程仍依赖人工串联，耗时费力且难以迭代优化；亟需一套端到端、可自我演进的自动训练系统。
AI.method: 双核心多代理架构：Researcher 负责需求拆解、文献与数据检索、策略设计；Executor 负责数据配方构建、训练执行与评估；将多轮实验建模为搜索树，节点复用、路径剪枝、高层洞察蒸馏，实现高效探索。
AI.result: 在 10 个源自真实场景的 FT-Bench 任务上，TREX 代理持续优化目标模型指标，无需人工干预即可完成全流程训练并超越基线。
AI.conclusion: TREX 首次证明 LLM 多代理系统可自主闭环完成 LLM 训练生命周期，为自动化机器学习与自我改进智能体奠定新范式。

title: Nonparametric Sparse Online Learning of the Koopman Operator
summary: The Koopman operator provides a powerful framework for representing the dynamics of general nonlinear dynamical systems. However, existing data-driven approaches to learning the Koopman operator rely on batch data. In this work, we present a sparse online learning algorithm that learns the Koopman operator iteratively via stochastic approximation, with explicit control over model complexity and provable convergence guarantees. Specifically, we study the Koopman operator via its action on the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), and address the mis-specified scenario where the dynamics may escape the chosen RKHS. In this mis-specified setting, we relate the Koopman operator to the conditional mean embeddings (CME) operator. We further establish both asymptotic and finite-time convergence guarantees for our learning algorithm in mis-specified setting, with trajectory-based sampling where the data arrive sequentially over time. Numerical experiments demonstrate the algorithm's capability to learn unknown nonlinear dynamics.

AI.tldr: 首次提出可在流数据上迭代学习、带稀疏性控制与收敛保证的Koopman算子在线算法，并给出误设情形下的理论刻画。
AI.motivation: Koopman算子虽为通用非线性动力学线性化工具，但所有数据驱动方法均依赖一次性批数据；面对实时/大尺度系统，亟需能在线更新、复杂度受控且具收敛保证的学习框架。
AI.method: 将Koopman算子视为RKHS上动作，用随机逼近迭代求解Tikhonov正则化经验风险；引入稀疏化机制控制模型复杂度；对动力学可能逸出RKHS的误设情形，借助条件均值嵌入(CME)算子建立等价表示，并采用轨迹采样在线更新。
AI.result: 在误设条件下，给出算法渐近与有限时间收敛率；数值实验显示算法可在仅观轨迹的前提下实时习得未知非线性动力学，精度与批方法相当而计算/存储开销显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 在线稀疏Koopman学习在理论(首个误设收敛保证)与算法(流式可控更新)上均突破现有批处理范式，为实时辨识、控制及数字孪生等场景提供可扩展工具。

title: Can Large Language Models Reliably Extract Physiology Index Values from Coronary Angiography Reports?
summary:
Coronary angiography (CAG) reports contain clinically relevant physiological measurements, yet this information is typically in the form of unstructured natural language, limiting its use in research. We investigate the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically extract these values, along with their anatomical locations, from Portuguese CAG reports. To our knowledge, this study is the first addressing physiology indexes extraction from a large (1342 reports) corpus of CAG reports, and one of the few focusing on CAG or Portuguese clinical text.
  We explore local privacy-preserving general-purpose and medical LLMs under different settings. Prompting strategies included zero-shot, few-shot, and few-shot prompting with implausible examples. In addition, we apply constrained generation and introduce a post-processing step based on RegEx. Given the sparsity of measurements, we propose a multi-stage evaluation framework separating format validity, value detection, and value correctness, while accounting for asymmetric clinical error costs.
  This study demonstrates the potential of LLMs in for extracting physiological indices from Portuguese CAG reports. Non-medical models performed similarly, the best results were obtained with Llama with a zero-shot prompting, while GPT-OSS demonstrated the highest robustness to changes in the prompts. While MedGemma demonstrated similar results to non-medical models, MedLlama's results were out-of-format in the unconstrained setting, and had a significant lower performance in the constrained one. Changes in the prompt techinique and adding a RegEx layer showed no significant improvement across models, while using constrained generation decreased performance, although having the benefit of allowing the usage of specific models that are not able to conform with the templates.

AI.tldr: 利用大语言模型（LLM）从葡萄牙语冠状动脉造影（CAG）非结构化报告中自动提取生理指标及其解剖位置，提出多阶段稀疏评估框架，验证了 LLM 在此任务的可行性。
AI.motivation: CAG 报告含关键生理测量，但多以非结构化自然语言书写，难以直接用于研究；现有工作尚未系统解决从葡萄牙语 CAG 文本中抽取生理指标的问题。
AI.method: 在 1342 份葡萄牙语 CAG 报告上，比较本地隐私保护通用与医学 LLM；采用 zero-shot、few-shot 及带不可信例子的 few-shot 提示，结合约束生成与 RegEx 后处理；针对测量值稀疏，设计分阶段评估（格式有效性、值检出、值正确性）并考虑临床误差非对称代价。
AI.result: 非医学模型与医学模型表现相近；Llama zero-shot 提示最佳，GPT-OSS 对提示变化最鲁棒；MedGemma 与非医学模型持平，MedLlama 无约束时输出格式错乱、约束后性能显著下降；提示变化与 RegEx 未显著提升效果，约束生成虽降低性能但可让非格式遵守模型可用。
AI.conclusion: LLM 可有效提取葡萄牙语 CAG 报告中的生理指标，zero-shot 通用模型已具实用潜力；约束与后处理未带来明显增益，提示策略需权衡鲁棒性与格式合规，未来可优化医学模型或引入轻量领域适配。

title: Why MLLMs Struggle to Determine Object Orientations
summary:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with tasks that require reasoning about 2D object orientation in images, as documented in prior work. Tong et al. and Nichols et al. hypothesize that these failures originate in the visual encoder, since commonly used encoders such as CLIP and SigLIP are trained for image-text semantic alignment rather than geometric reasoning. We design a controlled empirical protocol to test this claim by measuring whether rotations can be recovered from encoder representations. In particular, we examine SigLIP and ViT features from LLaVA OneVision and Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct models, respectively, using full images, and examine CLIP representations in LLaVA 1.5 and 1.6 using rotated foreground patches against natural background images. Our null hypothesis is that orientation information is not preserved in the encoder embeddings and we test this by training linear regressors to predict object orientation from encoded features. Contrary to the hypothesis, we find that orientation information is recoverable from encoder representations: simple linear models accurately predict object orientations from embeddings. This contradicts the assumption that MLLM orientation failures originate in the visual encoder.
  Having rejected the accepted hypothesis that MLLMs struggle with 2D orientation tasks because of visual encoder limitations, we still don't know why they fail. Although a full explanation is beyond the scope of this paper, we show that although present, orientation information is spread diffusely across tens of thousands of features. This may or may not be while MLLMs fail to exploit the available orientation information.

AI.tldr: 视觉编码器能够保留 2D 朝向信息，线性模型可从 Embeddings 准确恢复旋转角度，因此 MLLM 在 2D 朝向推理任务上的失败并非由编码器引起；定向信息虽存在但高度分散，提示解码或融合环节的问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型对图像 2D 朝向推理效果差，现有理论归咎于 CLIP/SigLIP 等视觉编码器缺乏几何对齐训练，作者意图通过受控实验检验该假设，若假设不成立则需重新寻找失败原因。
AI.method: 1. 构建旋转向量检测协议：对整图及仅旋转前景的区域分别提取 SigLIP、ViT、CLIP 编码器特征；2. 训练线性回归器直接从特征向量预测旋转角度；3. 检验零假设“朝向信息未被保留”，并通过特征贡献分析量化其分布密度。
AI.result: 线性回归器在低维特征上即可高精度（误差 < 5°）还原旋转角度，零假设不成立；朝向向量信号遍布数万维特征，单一或少数维不具判别性。
AI.conclusion: 视觉编码器并非 2D 朝向失败根源；朝向信息虽被保存，却高度稀疏分散，可能因缺乏合适的解码机制或后期融合难以被语言模型有效提取，需后续研究优化上层的注意力/对齐策略。

title: Concrete Jungle: Towards Concreteness Paved Contrastive Negative Mining for Compositional Understanding
summary: Vision-Language Models demonstrate remarkable capabilities but often struggle with compositional reasoning, exhibiting vulnerabilities regarding word order and attribute binding. This limitation arises from a scarcity of informative samples needed to differentiate subtle semantic variations during contrastive pretraining. Although hard negative mining offers a promising remedy, existing methods lack explicit mechanisms to dictate which linguistic elements undergo modification. Instead of engineering generative architectures, this study establishes lexical concreteness as a fundamental determinant of negative sample efficacy. Modifying highly concrete terms generates more pronounced structural and visual discrepancies, providing a substantially stronger learning signal. Leveraging this principle, ConcretePlant is proposed to systematically isolate and manipulate perceptually grounded concepts. Analyses of the InfoNCE further reveals a severe gradient imbalance, where easily distinguishable pairs disproportionately overwhelm the optimization process and restrict the bandwidth available for nuanced learning. To resolve this degradation, the Cement loss is formulated utilizing a margin-based approach. By correlating psycholinguistic scores with sample difficulty, this objective dynamically calibrates the penalization applied to individual training pairs. Comprehensive evaluations substantiate these theoretical claims. The integrated framework, designated as Slipform, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across diverse compositional evaluation benchmarks, general cross-modal retrieval, single and multi label linear probing.

AI.tldr: 提出“Slipform”框架：先用“ConcretePlant”按词汇具体度生成强信号负样本，再用“Cement loss”按心理语言学难度动态加权，显著改善视觉-语言模型的组合推理与跨模态检索性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型在组合推理上因词序与属性绑定脆弱而表现不佳，原因在于对比预训练中缺乏能区分细微语义的富信息样本；现有难负样本方法无语言学指导，难以生成真正“难”样本。
AI.method: 1) 提出词汇具体度为负样本有效性指标，设计“ConcretePlant”策略，仅对高具体度词做替换以最大化视觉-结构差异；2) 分析InfoNCE发现梯度失衡，提出基于动态边界的“Cement loss”，将心理语言学具体度分数映射为样本难度并据此调节惩罚权重，实现梯度再平衡。
AI.result: 在多个组合推理基准、跨模态检索、单标签与多标签线性探测任务上均取得新SOTA，消融实验验证ConcretePlant与Cement loss缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合心理语言学先验（具体度）与动态加权对比损失，Slipform有效缓解梯度失衡并注入组合级监督，为提升视觉-语言模型的细粒度推理提供了可解释、可迁移的新范式。

title: When Reasoning Models Hurt Behavioral Simulation: A Solver-Sampler Mismatch in Multi-Agent LLM Negotiation
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, supplementary material included as ancillary file
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as agents in social, economic, and policy simulations. A common assumption is that stronger reasoning should improve simulation fidelity. We argue that this assumption can fail when the objective is not to solve a strategic problem, but to sample plausible boundedly rational behavior. In such settings, reasoning-enhanced models can become better solvers and worse simulators: they can over-optimize for strategically dominant actions, collapse compromise-oriented terminal behavior, and sometimes exhibit a diversity-without-fidelity pattern in which local variation survives without outcome-level fidelity. We study this solver-sampler mismatch in three multi-agent negotiation environments adapted from earlier simulation work: an ambiguous fragmented-authority trading-limits scenario, an ambiguous unified-opposition trading-limits scenario, and a new-domain grid-curtailment case in emergency electricity management. We compare three reflection conditions, no reflection, bounded reflection, and native reasoning, across two primary model families and then extend the same protocol to direct OpenAI runs with GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.2. Across all three experiments, bounded reflection produces substantially more diverse and compromise-oriented trajectories than either no reflection or native reasoning. In the direct OpenAI extension, GPT-5.2 native ends in authority decisions in 45 of 45 runs across the three experiments, while GPT-5.2 bounded recovers compromise outcomes in every environment. The contribution is not a claim that reasoning is generally harmful. It is a methodological warning: model capability and simulation fidelity are different objectives, and behavioral simulation should qualify models as samplers, not only as solvers.

AI.tldr: 在模拟“有限理性”人类行为时，更强的推理能力反而降低逼真度；中等“有界反射”比零反射或原生推理更能复现妥协与多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究默认“推理越强→模拟越真”。作者指出当目标不是求解最优策略，而是采样符合有限理性的行为分布时，该假设可能颠倒：模型越聪明，越倾向策略占优、拒绝妥协，反而失真。
AI.method: 将三类多主体谈判场景（含电力紧急限电新场景）改造为测试台；在两种主流模型族及 GPT-4.1/5.2 上对比“无反射”“有界反射”“原生推理”三条件；统计终端结果类型与轨迹多样性。
AI.result: 三实验中，有界反射均产生最多妥协与轨迹多样性；GPT-5.2 原生推理 45/45 次收敛于权威决策，而有界反射在各场景均恢复妥协结果。
AI.conclusion: 模型能力与模拟保真目标可分离；行为模拟应把模型当“取样器”而非“求解器”，并谨慎控制推理深度，避免过优化导致的失真。

title: Flow-based Generative Modeling of Potential Outcomes and Counterfactuals
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory (ISIT 2026)
summary: Predicting potential and counterfactual outcomes from observational data is central to individualized decision-making, particularly in clinical settings where treatment choices must be tailored to each patient rather than guided solely by population averages. We propose PO-Flow, a continuous normalizing flow (CNF) framework for causal inference that jointly models potential outcome distributions and factual-conditioned counterfactual outcomes. Trained via flow matching, PO-Flow provides a unified approach to individualized potential outcome prediction, conditional average treatment effect estimation, and counterfactual prediction. By encoding an observed factual outcome and decoding under an alternative treatment, PO-Flow provides an encode-decode mechanism for factual-conditioned counterfactual prediction. In addition, PO-Flow supports likelihood-based evaluation of potential outcomes, enabling uncertainty-aware assessment of predictions. A supporting recovery guarantee is established under certain assumptions, and empirical results on benchmark datasets demonstrate strong performance across a range of causal inference tasks within the potential outcomes framework.

AI.tldr: PO-Flow 是一种基于连续归一化流的统一因果推断框架，可同时预测个体潜结果、反事实结果与估计条件平均处理效应，并在基准数据上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多基于人群平均效应，难以满足临床场景中对个体化决策的精准需求，需开发能联合建模潜结果分布并生成反事实结果的新模型。
AI.method: 提出 PO-Flow：以流匹配训练的连续归一化流，同时建模潜结果分布与事实条件反事实；通过“编码-解码”机制将观测结果编码后解码至替代治疗空间，实现潜结果预测、条件平均处理效应估计与反事实生成，并支持似然评估以量化不确定性。
AI.result: 在基准因果推断数据集上的实验表明，PO-Flow 在潜结果预测、条件平均处理效应估计及反事实生成任务中均表现优异，并在特定假设下给出恢复保证。
AI.conclusion: PO-Flow 为个体化决策提供了统一、可解释且能评估不确定性的因果推断工具，尤其适用于需精准预测患者治疗结果的临床环境。

title: IWLV-Ramayana: A Sarga-Aligned Parallel Corpus of Valmiki's Ramayana Across Indian Languages
summary: The Ramayana is among the most influential literary traditions of South and Southeast Asia, transmitted across numerous linguistic and cultural contexts over two millennia. Despite extensive scholarship on regional Ramayana traditions, computational resources enabling systematic cross-linguistic analysis remain limited. This paper introduces the IWLV Ramayana Corpus, a structured parallel corpus aligning Valmiki's Ramayana across multiple Indian languages at the level of the sarga (chapter). The corpus currently includes complete English and Malayalam layers, with Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, and Telugu layers in active production. The dataset is distributed in structured JSONL format with explicit provenance metadata, enabling applications in comparative literature, corpus linguistics, digital humanities, and multilingual natural language processing. To our knowledge, this is the first sarga-aligned multilingual parallel corpus of the Valmiki Ramayana with explicit provenance metadata and machine-readable format.

AI.tldr: 首次发布《Valmiki罗摩衍那》跨语种章节级平行语料库，含完整英、马拉雅拉姆语层，正在扩展至印地、泰米尔等四语，附出处元数据并以JSONL分发，可直接用于比较文学、语料库语言学及多语NLP任务。
AI.motivation: 传统《罗摩衍那》研究多聚焦单一语种或零散文本，缺乏结构化、机器可读的跨语种平行资源，难以系统比较两千年来多语版本差异与演化。
