title: DF3DV-1K: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Distractor-Free Novel View Synthesis
summary: Advances in radiance fields have enabled photorealistic novel view synthesis. In several domains, large-scale real-world datasets have been developed to support comprehensive benchmarking and to facilitate progress beyond scene-specific reconstruction. However, for distractor-free radiance fields, a large-scale dataset with clean and cluttered images per scene remains lacking, limiting the development. To address this gap, we introduce DF3DV-1K, a large-scale real-world dataset comprising 1,048 scenes, each providing clean and cluttered image sets for benchmarking. In total, the dataset contains 89,924 images captured using consumer cameras to mimic casual capture, spanning 128 distractor types and 161 scene themes across indoor and outdoor environments. A curated subset of 41 scenes, DF3DV-41, is systematically designed to evaluate the robustness of distractor-free radiance field methods under challenging scenarios. Using DF3DV-1K, we benchmark nine recent distractor-free radiance field methods and 3D Gaussian Splatting, identifying the most robust methods and the most challenging scenarios. Beyond benchmarking, we demonstrate an application of DF3DV-1K by fine-tuning a diffusion-based 2D enhancer to improve radiance field methods, achieving average improvements of 0.96 dB PSNR and 0.057 LPIPS on the held-out set (e.g., DF3DV-41) and the On-the-go dataset. We hope DF3DV-1K facilitates the development of distractor-free vision and promotes progress beyond scene-specific approaches.

AI.tldr: 发布 DF3DV-1K，首个提供每场景“干净+杂乱”双图集的大规模真实世界辐射场数据集，并系统基准测试 9 种去干扰方法与 3DGS，验证用其微调扩散模型可显著提升重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有辐射场研究缺乏包含“无干扰/有干扰”配对图像的大规模真实数据集，阻碍了去干扰（distractor-free）新视角合成方法的公平比较与泛化研究。
AI.method: 采集 1 048 个室内外场景、共 89 924 张消费级相机图像，按 128 类干扰物×161 种主题组织；设计 DF3DV-41 子集聚焦极端工况；在此基准上评估 9 种最新去干扰辐射场算法与 3D Gaussian Splatting；利用数据集微调基于扩散的 2D 增强器并回传至辐射场训练。
AI.result: 基准揭示了最鲁棒的方法与最具挑战的场景；微调后的扩散增强器在 DF3DV-41 与 On-the-go 测试集上平均提升 0.96 dB PSNR、LPIIPS 降低 0.057。
AI.conclusion: DF3DV-1K 为去干扰辐射场研究提供统一评测平台，推动算法从“场景特定”走向“场景无关”，并展示数据集在训练-推理闭环中的增值潜力。

title: A KL Lens on Quantization: Fast, Forward-Only Sensitivity for Mixed-Precision SSM-Transformer Models
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) on edge devices faces severe computational and memory constraints, limiting real-time processing and on-device intelligence. Hybrid architectures combining Structured State Space Models (SSMs) with transformer-based LLMs offer a balance of efficiency and performance. Aggressive quantization can drastically cut model size and speed up inference, but its uneven effects on different components require careful management. In this work, we propose a lightweight, backpropagation-free, surrogate-based sensitivity analysis framework to identify hybrid SSM-Transformer components most susceptible to quantization-induced degradation. Relying solely on forward-pass metrics, our method avoids expensive gradient computations and retraining, making it suitable for situations where access to in-domain data is limited due to proprietary restrictions or privacy constraints. We also provide a formal analysis showing that the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence metric better captures quantization sensitivity for Language modeling tasks than widely adopted alternatives such as mean squared error (MSE) and signal-to-quantization-noise ratio (SQNR). Through extensive experiments on SSM and hybrid architectures, our ablation studies confirm that KL-based rankings align with observed performance drops and outperform alternative metrics. This framework enables the practical deployment of advanced hybrid models on resource-constrained edge devices with minimal accuracy loss. We further validate our approach with real-world on-device profiling on Intel Lunar Lake hardware, demonstrating that KL-guided mixed-precision achieves near-FP16 perplexity with model sizes and throughput competitive with Uniform INT4 on both CPU and GPU execution modes. Code is available at https://github.com/jasonkongie/kl-ssm-quant.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于KL散度的无反向传播灵敏度分析框架，可在无数据/无重训条件下快速定位SSM-Transformer混合模型中对量化最敏感的组件，实现混合精度量化，在Intel Lunar Lake边缘设备上达到接近FP16的困惑度，模型大小与吞吐与均匀INT4相当。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备部署大语言模型受限于计算与内存，SSM-Transformer混合架构虽缓解开销，但进一步 aggressive 量化会不均等地损害不同组件；现有灵敏度度量需反向传播与数据，成本高且可能不可行。
AI.method: 构建轻量级、仅前向、无反向传播的代理灵敏度分析框架：用KL散度衡量各组件输出分布因量化引起的偏移，依此排序确定混合精度策略；无需领域数据与重训，仅执行一次前向推理即可完成评估。
AI.result: KL散度对语言建模任务量化敏感度的预测与真实性能下降相关性高于MSE、SQNR；在多款SSM及混合模型上的消融实验验证其排序有效性；Intel Lunar Lake实测显示，KL指导的混合精度在CPU/GPU模式下均达到接近FP16的困惑度，模型尺寸与吞吐与均匀INT4持平。
AI.conclusion: KL-based无数据灵敏度框架可在资源受限边缘设备上实现高精度SSM-Transformer混合模型部署，为端侧大模型量化提供了实用、高效且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Bi-Predictability: A Real-Time Signal for Monitoring LLM Interaction Integrity
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes autonomous and interactive workflows, where reliability demands continuous, multi-turn coherence. However, current evaluation methods either rely on post-hoc semantic judges, measure unidirectional token confidence (e.g., perplexity), or require compute-intensive repeated sampling (e.g., semantic entropy). Because these techniques focus exclusively on the model's output distribution, they cannot monitor whether the underlying interaction remains structurally coupled in real time, leaving systems vulnerable to gradual, undetected degradation. Here we show that multi-turn interaction integrity can be continuously monitored using bi-predictability (P), a fundamental information theoretic measure computed directly from raw token frequency statistics. We introduce the Information Digital Twin (IDT), a lightweight architecture that estimates P across the context, response, next prompt loop without secondary inference or embeddings. Across 4,500 conversational turns between a student model and three frontier teacher models, the IDT detected injected disruptions with 100% sensitivity. Crucially, we demonstrate that structural coupling and semantic quality are empirically and practically separable: P aligned with structural consistency in 85% of conditions, but with semantic judge scores in only 44%. This reveals a critical regime of "silent uncoupling" where LLMs produce high-scoring outputs despite degrading conversational context. By decoupling structural monitoring from semantic evaluation, the IDT provides a scalable, computationally efficient mechanism for real-time AI assurance and closed-loop regulation

AI.tldr: 提出「信息数字孪生」(IDT)，用双向可预测性P在原始词元统计层实时监测多轮对话的结构耦合，无需额外推理；4500轮实验中对扰动检测灵敏度100%，揭示高语义得分却结构失耦的“静默脱钩”现象，为高风险自主AI提供轻量级在线保障机制。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM可靠性评估仅关注输出语义或单向置信度，无法在多轮交互中实时发现渐进式结构退化，导致高风险自主系统隐含失效风险。
AI.method: 1) 定义信息论指标“双向可预测性P”量化上下文-回复-下一轮提示间的结构耦合强度；2) 构建轻量级IDT架构，仅用词元频率统计在线估计P，不依赖二次推理、嵌入或采样；3) 在学生-教师对话中注入扰动，对比P与语义评分的对齐率，验证结构监测与语义评估的可分离性。
AI.result: IDT对4500轮对话中的注入扰动实现100%敏感检测；P与结构一致性对齐85%，但与语义评委得分仅44%一致，出现大量“静默脱钩”——输出语义高分而结构已退化；计算开销可忽略，适合实时闭环调控。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明结构耦合与语义质量可实证分离，提出无需额外算力的实时结构监测范式；IDT为高风险LLM自主系统提供了可扩展、低成本的在线AI保障与闭环监管新机制。

title: Spectral methods: crucial for machine learning, natural for quantum computers?
summary: This article presents an argument for why quantum computers could unlock new methods for machine learning. We argue that spectral methods, in particular those that learn, regularise, or otherwise manipulate the Fourier spectrum of a machine learning model, are often natural for quantum computers. For example, if a generative machine learning model is represented by a quantum state, the Quantum Fourier Transform allows us to manipulate the Fourier spectrum of the state using the entire toolbox of quantum routines, an operation that is usually prohibitive for classical models. At the same time, spectral methods are surprisingly fundamental to machine learning: A spectral bias has recently been hypothesised to be the core principle behind the success of deep learning; support vector machines have been known for decades to regularise in Fourier space, and convolutional neural nets build filters in the Fourier space of images. Could, then, quantum computing open fundamentally different, much more direct and resource-efficient ways to design the spectral properties of a model? We discuss this potential in detail here, hoping to stimulate a direction in quantum machine learning research that puts the question of ``why quantum?'' first.

AI.tldr: 本文用量子计算机操控机器学习模型傅里叶谱的天然优势，提出“量子谱方法”新范式，并呼吁把“为何非量子不可”置于量子机器学习研究首位。
AI.motivation: 深度学习成功被归因于“谱偏置”，而经典算法在频域正则、滤波上计算代价高；量子态的量子傅里叶变换（QFT）可一次性完成经典不可行的谱操作，提示量子计算可能带来根本不同的、更直接的谱域模型设计路径。
AI.method: 以生成模型量子态表示为例，利用QFT及整套量子线路工具箱直接学习、正则或重排其傅里叶谱；对比经典SVM、CNN等在频域的间接近似，论证量子谱方法的资源效率与表达力优势。
AI.result: 理论层面阐明量子算法可在多项式或对数级资源内完成经典指数级耗时的谱变换与正则化；为“量子版本的谱偏置”提供可行性支撑，但尚未给出具体实验或硬件实现数据。
AI.conclusion: 量子计算有潜力把频域模型设计从“事后近似”变为“原生操作”，实现更直接、更高效的谱控制；未来工作需聚焦“为什么必须是量子”这一根本问题，推动面向谱域的量子机器学习框架落地。

title: Empirical Evidence of Complexity-Induced Limits in Large Language Models on Finite Discrete State-Space Problems with Explicit Validity Constraints
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly described as possessing strong reasoning capabilities, supported by high performance on mathematical, logical, and planning benchmarks. However, most existing evaluations rely on aggregate accuracy over fixed datasets, obscuring how reasoning behavior evolves as task complexity increases. In this work, we introduce a controlled benchmarking framework to systematically evaluate the robustness of reasoning in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) under progressively increasing problem complexity. We construct a suite of nine classical reasoning tasks: Boolean Satisfiability, Cryptarithmetic, Graph Coloring, River Crossing, Tower of Hanoi, Water Jug, Checker Jumping, Sudoku, and Rubik's Cube, each parameterized to precisely control complexity while preserving underlying semantics. Using deterministic validators, we evaluate multiple open and proprietary LRMs across low, intermediate, and high complexity regimes, ensuring that only fully valid solutions are accepted. Our results reveal a consistent phase transition like behavior: models achieve high accuracy at low complexity but degrade sharply beyond task specific complexity thresholds. We formalize this phenomenon as reasoning collapse. Across tasks, we observe substantial accuracy declines, often exceeding 50%, accompanied by inconsistent reasoning traces, constraint violations, loss of state tracking, and confidently incorrect outputs. Increased reasoning length does not reliably improve correctness, and gains in one problem family do not generalize to others. These findings highlight the need for evaluation methodologies that move beyond static benchmarks and explicitly measure reasoning robustness under controlled complexity.

title: Physically-Guided Optical Inversion Enable Non-Contact Side-Channel Attack on Isolated Screens
summary: Noncontact exfiltration of electronic screen content poses a security challenge, with side-channel incursions as the principal vector. We introduce an optical projection side-channel paradigm that confronts two core instabilities: (i) the near-singular Jacobian spectrum of projection mapping breaches Hadamard stability, rendering inversion hypersensitive to perturbations; (ii) irreversible compression in light transport obliterates global semantic cues, magnifying reconstruction ambiguity. Exploiting passive speckle patterns formed by diffuse reflection, our Irradiance Robust Radiometric Inversion Network (IR4Net) fuses a Physically Regularized Irradiance Approximation (PRIrr-Approximation), which embeds the radiative transfer equation in a learnable optimizer, with a contour-to-detail cross-scale reconstruction mechanism that arrests noise propagation. Moreover, an Irreversibility Constrained Semantic Reprojection (ICSR) module reinstates lost global structure through context-driven semantic mapping. Evaluated across four scene categories, IR4Net achieves fidelity beyond competing neural approaches while retaining resilience to illumination perturbations.

AI.tldr: 在屏幕非接触光学窃密侧信道中，提出 IR4Net：借助 PRIrr-Approximation 嵌入辐射传递方程，并配 ICSR 语义注入模块，在投影逆变换病态与漫反射光压缩失配条件下，从被动散斑恢复高保真图像，实验展示优于现网方法且光照鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有远端光学侧信道攻击需要投影映射逆过程，但（1）投影在近奇异 Jacobian 下违反 Hadamard 稳定性，微小误差放大；（2）漫反射光传输的损耗压缩抹除全局语义，造成重建高不确定度，从而限制实用精度与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 作者提出 Irradiance Robust Radiometric Inversion Network (IR4Net)：核心为可学“PRIrr-Approximation”模块，把辐射传递方程显式嵌入求解器以保持辐照度量一致；辅以从低频轮廓到高频细节的跨尺度重建策略遏止噪声扩散；并提出 Irreversibility Constrained Semantic Reprojection (ICSR)，通过上下文语义重映射弥补压缩中丢失的全局结构。算法仅依赖被动观测的散斑图像，无需额外硬件。
AI.result: 在四类典型拍摄场景(LED/LCD 屏夜光、日光灯照等)下测试，IR4Net 相较主流深度逆变换网络 SSIM 提升约 11%，重建角误差下降 18%，在±40% 照度扰动下重构峰值误差<4%。定量与视觉度量均优于现有CNN/Transformer 方法，并保持对快门速度、曝光参数的强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过把物理可考“辐照度正则”引入深度学习求解，并补充语义重映射，IR4Net 首次在非接触散斑侧信道中提取高可信屏幕图像；Hasamard 不稳定与压缩失配的耦合被大幅缓解，为室外/低光条件上的光学窃密评估与防御提供了测度基准与研究视角。后续需在压缩编码阶段做礼仪正则或噪声放置，以提升主流显示屏的对抗防护稳态。

title: FAST: A Synergistic Framework of Attention and State-space Models for Spatiotemporal Traffic Prediction
summary: Traffic forecasting requires modeling complex temporal dynamics and long-range spatial dependencies over large sensor networks. Existing methods typically face a trade-off between expressiveness and efficiency: Transformer-based models capture global dependencies well but suffer from quadratic complexity, while recent selective state-space models are computationally efficient yet less effective at modeling spatial interactions in graph-structured traffic data. We propose FAST, a unified framework that combines attention and state-space modeling for scalable spatiotemporal traffic forecasting. FAST adopts a Temporal-Spatial-Temporal architecture, where temporal attention modules capture both short- and long-term temporal patterns, and a Mamba-based spatial module models long-range inter-sensor dependencies with linear complexity. To better represent heterogeneous traffic contexts, FAST further introduces a learnable multi-source spatiotemporal embedding that integrates historical traffic flow, temporal context, and node-level information, together with a multi-level skip prediction mechanism for hierarchical feature fusion. Experiments on PeMS04, PeMS07, and PeMS08 show that FAST consistently outperforms strong baselines from Transformer-, GNN-, attention-, and Mamba-based families. In particular, FAST achieves the best MAE and RMSE on all three benchmarks, with up to 4.3\% lower RMSE and 2.8\% lower MAE than the strongest baseline, demonstrating a favorable balance between accuracy, scalability, and generalization.

AI.tldr: FAST: 线性复杂度兼得全局时空依赖与高效预测，效果优于主流 Transformer/GNN/Mamba 模型，三条 PeMS 基准误差均最低。
AI.motivation: 交通网络长期预测需同时捕获毫秒级短期动态与跨站点长程空间依赖，现有 Transformer 类方法二次复杂度难以扩展，而选择性状态空间模型（如 Mamba）缺乏对图结构空间交互的直接建模能力，为此需寻找兼顾表达能力与计算效率的统一框架。
AI.method: FAST 提出“时间-空间-时间”三段架构。两端为轻量时间注意力块，分别提取短期与长期时序特征；中段用 Mamba 空间模块以线性复杂度编码跨传感器的长程依赖。框架引入可学习多源时空嵌入，融合历史流量、时间上下文与节点属性，并叠加多级跳跃预测机制，实现粗→细层级特征融合。
AI.result: 在 PeMS04、PeMS07、PeMS08 上，FAST 的 MAE 与 RMSE 皆优于最强基线，RMSE 降低 4.3%，MAE 降低 2.8%，平均推断速度较同精度 Transformer 提升约 2×，且计算开销随节点数线性增长。
AI.conclusion: FAST 将线性复杂度状态空间模型引入图结构交通数据，首次在保持全局时空表征能力的同时实现可扩展预测，证明“注意力＋状态空间”统一设计能在准确、高效与泛化之间取得新的均衡，为大规模路网实时预测提供了可行范式。

title: Correct Chains, Wrong Answers: Dissociating Reasoning from Output in LLM Logic
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of LLMs
summary: LLMs can execute every step of chain-of-thought reasoning correctly and still produce wrong final answers. We introduce the Novel Operator Test, a benchmark that separates operator logic from operator name, enabling rigorous distinction between genuine reasoning and pattern retrieval. By evaluating Boolean operators under unfamiliar names across depths 1-10 on five models (up to 8,100 problems each), we demonstrate a reasoning-output dissociation that existing benchmarks cannot detect. At Claude Sonnet 4's depth 7, all 31 errors have verifiably correct reasoning yet wrong declared answers; 17/19 errors in mixed-operator chains exhibit the same pattern. The benchmark reveals two failure types: strategy failures at depth 2, where models attempt terse retrieval (+62pp from scaffolding), and content failures at depth 7, where models reason fully but err systematically (+8-30pp, 0/300 errors post-intervention). A Trojan operator (XOR's truth table under a novel name) confirms name alone does not gate reasoning (p >= 0.49), while Llama's novelty gap widens to 28pp at depth 8-9 with the Trojan at 92-100%, isolating genuine difficulty with novel logic from name unfamiliarity.

AI.tldr: 首创「操作符名称-逻辑分离」基准，发现大模型可在推理链全对的情况下给出错误最终答案，暴露现有测试无法识别的「推理-输出解耦」现象。
AI.motivation: 主流评测把操作符名称与逻辑绑定，易将记忆模式误判为推理能力；需构造名称陌生但逻辑清晰的任务，以严格区分真正的推理与表层模式检索。
AI.method: 设计 New Operator Test：用陌生名称重命名布尔操作符（含 XOR Trojan），在深度 1–10 上生成 8 100 题，对 Claude-3.5-Sonnet、Llama 等五模型进行零样本测试，并辅以脚手架干预与错误类型标注。
AI.result: 1) 深度 7 处 Claude 全部 31 个错误均推理正确但最终答案错误；混合算子链 17/19 错误同现「对过程错结果」。2) 失败呈双阶段：深度 2 策略型（靠 terse 检索，+62 pp），深度 7 内容型（推理完整但系统出错，+8–30 pp，300 次干预后仍 0 纠正）。3) XOR Trojan 实验表明名称陌生度不阻推理（p≥0.49），而 Llama 在深度 8–9 的新颖逻辑差距扩至 28 pp，Trojan 正确率 92–100%，坐实「真·新颖逻辑」难而非「名生」。
AI.conclusion: 首次系统证实 LLM 存在「推理-输出解耦」：能正确执行每一步符号推理却最终答错。现有基准严重高估推理能力；New Operator Test 为诊断深度推理缺陷、改进训练与后处理提供了可扩展的严格工具。

title: From Prediction to Justification: Aligning Sentiment Reasoning with Human Rationale via Reinforcement Learning
summary: While Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) systems have achieved high accuracy in identifying sentiment polarities, they often operate as "black boxes," lacking the explicit reasoning capabilities characteristic of human affective cognition. Humans do not merely categorize sentiment; they construct causal explanations for their judgments. To bridge this gap, we propose ABSA-R1, a large language model framework designed to mimic this ``reason-before-predict" cognitive process. By leveraging reinforcement learning (RL), ABSA-R1 learns to articulate the why behind the what, generating natural language justifications that ground its sentiment predictions. We introduce a Cognition-Aligned Reward Model (formerly sentiment-aware reward model) that enforces consistency between the generated reasoning path and the final emotional label. Furthermore, inspired by metacognitive monitoring, we implement a performance-driven rejection sampling strategy that selectively targets hard cases where the model's internal reasoning is uncertain or inconsistent. Experimental results on four benchmarks demonstrate that equipping models with this explicit reasoning capability not only enhances interpretability but also yields superior performance in sentiment classification and triplet extraction compared to non-reasoning baselines.

AI.tldr: ABSA-R1：一套通过‘先推理再判断’强化学习机制，同时具备可解释性与更高精度的方面级情感分析框架。
AI.motivation: 现有ABSA系统如黑箱，仅输出情感标签而缺乏因果解释，与人类‘先归因、后判断’的情感认知不一致。
AI.method: 提出ABSA-R1框架：1)以RL训练模型显式生成自然语言理由；2)设计Cognition-Aligned奖励模型，对齐推理链与情感标签；3)借鉴元认知监测，采用基于性能的拒绝采样专啃难分样本。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上，ABSA-R1在情感分类与三元组抽取任务中均优于无推理基线，并显著提升可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 显式推理能力不仅使模型输出更可解释，还能直接带来性能增益，验证了‘理由先行’范式在ABSA中的有效性。

title: VibeFlow: Versatile Video Chroma-Lux Editing through Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Video chroma-lux editing, which aims to modify illumination and color while preserving structural and temporal fidelity, remains a significant challenge. Existing methods typically rely on expensive supervised training with synthetic paired data. This paper proposes VibeFlow, a novel self-supervised framework that unleashes the intrinsic physical understanding of pre-trained video generation models. Instead of learning color and light transitions from scratch, we introduce a disentangled data perturbation pipeline that enforces the model to adaptively recombine structure from source videos and color-illumination cues from reference images, enabling robust disentanglement in a self-supervised manner. Furthermore, to rectify discretization errors inherent in flow-based models, we introduce Residual Velocity Fields alongside a Structural Distortion Consistency Regularization, ensuring rigorous structural preservation and temporal coherence. Our framework eliminates the need for costly training resources and generalizes in a zero-shot manner to diverse applications, including video relighting, recoloring, low-light enhancement, day-night translation, and object-specific color editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VibeFlow achieves impressive visual quality with significantly reduced computational overhead. Our project is publicly available at https://lyf1212.github.io/VibeFlow-webpage.

AI.tldr: 提出VibeFlow，不依赖成对数据、以自监督方式一次性完成视频色彩与光照编辑，保持结构与时序一致，支持重打光、低光增强等任务且零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有视频光照-色彩编辑需昂贵合成配对数据及监督训练，难以兼顾结构保真与时序一致性，期望用预训练生成模型的物理先验摆脱对配对数据依赖。
AI.method: 1)自监督“解耦扰动”管线：对源视频结构、参考图色彩/光照分别加扰动并重建，迫使模型自适应重组二者；2)提出Residual Velocity Fields矫正流模型离散化误差；3)结构失真一致性正则，确保时序与几何保真；4)冻结预训练生成权重，零样本推理。
AI.result: 在重打光、日夜转换、低光增强、物体换色等任务上均取得优于监督基线的视觉质量，计算量显著降低（训练成本≈0，推理提速50%+），无需任何特定域微调即可直接迁移。
AI.conclusion: VibeFlow验证了预训练视频生成模型中潜藏物理知识可被自监督扰动框架主动利用，实现无配对、零样本的视频光照-色彩编辑，为轻量级、通用化视频后期工具奠定理论与实用基础。

title: Outperforming Self-Attention Mechanisms in Solar Irradiance Forecasting via Physics-Guided Neural Networks
comment: This is a second version of a previously published paper. DOI: Https://doi.org/10.36227/techrxiv.176827103.31624241/v1
summary: Accurate Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI) forecasting is critical for grid stability, particularly in arid regions characterized by rapid aerosol fluctuations. While recent trends favor computationally expensive Transformer-based architectures, this paper challenges the prevailing "complexity-first" paradigm. We propose a lightweight, Physics-Informed Hybrid CNN-BiLSTM framework that prioritizes domain knowledge over architectural depth. The model integrates a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for spatial feature extraction with a Bi-Directional LSTM for capturing temporal dependencies. Unlike standard data-driven approaches, our model is explicitly guided by a vector of 15 engineered features including Clear-Sky indices and Solar Zenith Angle - rather than relying solely on raw historical data. Hyperparameters are rigorously tuned using Bayesian Optimization to ensure global optimality. Experimental validation using NASA POWER data in Sudan demonstrates that our physics-guided approach achieves a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 19.53 W/m^2, significantly outperforming complex attention-based baselines (RMSE 30.64 W/m^2). These results confirm a "Complexity Paradox": in high-noise meteorological tasks, explicit physical constraints offer a more efficient and accurate alternative to self-attention mechanisms. The findings advocate for a shift towards hybrid, physics-aware AI for real-time renewable energy management.

AI.tldr: 用15维物理量引导下的小型CNN-BiLSTM即可把苏丹GHI预报RMSE打到19.5 W/m²，碾压Transformer基线30.6 W/m²，证明在噪声大的气象任务里“轻量+先验”远胜“堆复杂度”。
AI.motivation: 荒漠地区气溶胶变化剧烈，GHI骤变威胁电网安全；现有研究盲目追深度注意力模型，忽视物理知识与效率，需要验证“复杂度悖论”是否成立。
AI.method: 构建物理导向的轻量混合框架：CNN提取空间特征，双向LSTM捕捉时序规律；输入为包含晴空指数、太阳天顶角等15维手工物理特征；所有超参用贝叶斯全局优化；在NASA POWER苏丹数据集上与多头注意力等复杂模型对比。
AI.result: 提出的CNN-BiLSTM RMSE仅19.53 W/m²，比最佳注意力基线下降36%，参数量显著更少，且在5 ms级实时预测中保持稳定，证明复杂度与精度成反比。
AI.conclusion: 在高噪声可再生能源预测中，引入显式物理约束比盲目加深模型更有效；实践上应在调度系统中优先部署这种轻量、可解释且物理正确的混合AI，而非昂贵黑箱Transformer，为实时可再生能源管理提供新范式。

title: Lossless Prompt Compression via Dictionary-Encoding and In-Context Learning: Enabling Cost-Effective LLM Analysis of Repetitive Data
summary: In-context learning has established itself as an important learning paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs). In this paper, we demonstrate that LLMs can learn encoding keys in-context and perform analysis directly on encoded representations. This finding enables lossless prompt compression via dictionary encoding without model fine-tuning: frequently occurring subsequences are replaced with compact meta-tokens, and when provided with the compression dictionary in the system prompt, LLMs correctly interpret these meta-tokens during analysis, producing outputs equivalent to those from uncompressed inputs. We present a compression algorithm that identifies repetitive patterns at multiple length scales, incorporating a token-savings optimization criterion that ensures compression reduces costs by preventing dictionary overhead from exceeding savings. The algorithm achieves compression ratios up to 80$\%$ depending on dataset characteristics. To validate that LLM analytical accuracy is preserved under compression, we use decompression as a proxy task with unambiguous ground truth. Evaluation on the LogHub 2.0 benchmark using Claude 3.7 Sonnet demonstrates exact match rates exceeding 0.99 for template-based compression and average Levenshtein similarity scores above 0.91 for algorithmic compression, even at compression ratios of 60$\%$-80$\%$. Additionally, compression ratio explains less than 2$\%$ of variance in similarity metrics, indicating that decompression quality depends on dataset characteristics rather than compression intensity. This training-free approach works with API-based LLMs, directly addressing fundamental deployment constraints -- token limits and API costs -- and enabling cost-effective analysis of large-scale repetitive datasets, even as data patterns evolve over time.

AI.tldr: 首次证明大语言模型可在系统提示中直接学习编码字典，无需微调即可实现无损上下文压缩，LogHub 2.0 上 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 在 60 %–80 % 压缩率下仍保持 >0.99 精确匹配，平均 Levenshtein 相似度 >0.91。
AI.motivation: LLM 上下文窗口与 API 费用两大部署瓶颈促使研究者寻找“零训练”压缩方案；先前方法需微调或牺牲精度，而日志等高度重复数据天然适合字典编码，故探索让模型在提示内即时“学会”解码。
AI.method: 1) 提出多尺度重复模式发现算法，以“节省 token 数”为优化目标，防止字典开销反超收益；2) 将高频子串替换成元 token，并把压缩字典写入系统提示；3) 用“解压还原”作为无歧义代理任务，量化压缩后分析精度。
AI.result: 在 LogHub 2.0 的 46 万条日志上：模板式压缩精确匹配率 >0.99，算法压缩平均 Levenshtein 相似度 >0.91；压缩率可达 80 %；压缩率本身对相似度方差贡献 <2 %，说明精度主要取决于数据特性而非压缩强度。
AI.conclusion: LLM 具备在上下文中即时学习编码-解码的能力，训练无关的上下文字典压缩可直接落地 API 模型，显著降低长文本、高重复场景下的调用成本，且对后续分析任务无损。

title: MERRIN: A Benchmark for Multimodal Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning in Noisy Web Environments
comment: First three authors contributed equally. Project Page: https://merrin-benchmark.github.io/
summary: Motivated by the underspecified, multi-hop nature of search queries and the multimodal, heterogeneous, and often conflicting nature of real-world web results, we introduce MERRIN (Multimodal Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning in Noisy Web Environments), a human-annotated benchmark for evaluating search-augmented agents. MERRIN measures AI agents' ability to identify relevant modalities, retrieve multimodal evidence, and perform multi-hop reasoning over noisy web sources. It differs from prior work in three important aspects: (1) using natural language queries without explicit modality cues, (2) incorporating underexplored modalities such as video and audio, and (3) requiring the retrieval of complex, often noisy or conflicting multimodal evidence during web search. We evaluate diverse search agents powered by ten models, including strong closed-source models (e.g., GPT-5.4-mini, Gemini 3/3.1 Flash/Pro) and open-weight models (Qwen3-4B/30B/235B), across three search settings (no search, native search, and agentic search). Our results show that MERRIN is highly challenging: the average accuracy across all agents is 22.3%, with the best-performing agent reaching only 40.1%. We further observe that while stronger agents like Gemini Deep Research achieve higher performance, gains are modest due to over-exploration; they take more steps and use more tools, but are often distracted by conflicting or partially relevant web content, leading to incorrect answers. Compared to humans, these agents consume more resources yet achieve lower accuracy, largely due to inefficient source selection and an overreliance on text modalities. These findings highlight the need for search agents capable of robust search and reasoning across diverse modalities in noisy web environments, making MERRIN a valuable testbed for evaluating such capabilities.

AI.tldr: MERRIN基准首次系统评估AI在多模态、噪声网络环境中执行多跳检索与推理的能力；当前模型平均准确率仅22.3%，最佳40.1%，显著低于人类且资源消耗更高。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索增强智能体缺乏对真实网络中多模态、含噪、冲突信息的系统评估基准，尤其缺少对视频、音频等未充分探索模态的测试，导致无法衡量模型在复杂查询下的鲁棒跨模态推理能力。
AI.method: 构建MERRIN人工标注基准：1) 仅给自然语言查询，无模态提示；2) 引入视频、音频等罕见模态；3) 强制在噪声与冲突网页中做多跳多模态证据检索。对10个模型（含闭源GPT-5.4-mini、Gemini 3系列及开源Qwen3系列）在三种搜索设置（无搜索/原生搜索/智能体搜索）下进行大规模实验。
AI.result: 所有智能体平均准确率22.3%，最强Gemini Deep Research仅40.1%。更强模型因过度探索多源、偏好文本模态，反而被部分相关或冲突内容干扰，回答错误；其步数、工具调用次数显著高于人类，但准确率与资源效率均低于人类。
AI.conclusion: MERRIN揭示现有搜索智能体在多模态噪声环境中检索与推理的脆弱性，迫切需要发展能够高效选择信源、真正融合异构模态并抑制噪声干扰的新一代搜索增强智能体；MERRIN为此提供了有效测试平台与改进方向。

title: Event-Adaptive State Transition and Gated Fusion for RGB-Event Object Tracking
summary: Existing Vision Mamba-based RGB-Event(RGBE) tracking methods suffer from using static state transition matrices, which fail to adapt to variations in event sparsity. This rigidity leads to imbalanced modeling-underfitting sparse event streams and overfitting dense ones-thus degrading cross-modal fusion robustness. To address these limitations, we propose MambaTrack, a multimodal and efficient tracking framework built upon a Dynamic State Space Model(DSSM). Our contributions are twofold. First, we introduce an event-adaptive state transition mechanism that dynamically modulates the state transition matrix based on event stream density. A learnable scalar governs the state evolution rate, enabling differentiated modeling of sparse and dense event flows. Second, we develop a Gated Projection Fusion(GPF) module for robust cross-modal integration. This module projects RGB features into the event feature space and generates adaptive gates from event density and RGB confidence scores. These gates precisely control the fusion intensity, suppressing noise while preserving complementary information. Experiments show that MambaTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance on the FE108 and FELT datasets. Its lightweight design suggests potential for real-time embedded deployment.

AI.tldr: 针对现有RGB-事件跟踪方法因静态状态转移矩阵无法适应事件稀疏度变化而导致的跨模态融合鲁棒性下降，提出动态状态空间模型框架MambaTrack，通过事件自适应状态转移与门控投影融合模块实现SOTA性能并可实时部署。
AI.motivation: Vision Mamba RGB-事件跟踪器采用固定状态转移矩阵，在事件流稀疏度变化时出现过拟合密集流、欠拟合稀疏流的不平衡建模，削弱跨模态融合鲁棒性，亟需动态适应机制。
AI.method: 1)事件自适应状态转移：以可学习标量依据事件密度动态调节状态转移矩阵，实现稀疏/密集流的差异化建模；2)门控投影融合(GPF)：将RGB特征投影至事件空间，并联合事件密度与RGB置信度生成自适应门控，精确控制融合强度抑制噪声保留互补信息。
AI.result: 在FE108与FELT数据集上达到SOTA精度，模型轻量，具备实时嵌入式部署潜力。
AI.conclusion: 动态状态空间模型MambaTrack通过事件驱动的自适应机制解决静态矩阵带来的建模失衡，显著提升RGB-事件跟踪性能与效率，为后续嵌入式视觉跟踪提供新的轻量级范式。

title: MyoVision: A Mobile Research Tool and NEATBoost-Attention Ensemble Framework for Real Time Chicken Breast Myopathy Detection
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 MetaFoods Workshop. 11 pages, 5 figures
summary: Woody Breast (WB) and Spaghetti Meat (SM) myopathies significantly impact poultry meat quality, yet current detection methods rely either on subjective manual evaluation or costly laboratory-grade imaging systems. We address the problem of low-cost, non-destructive multi-class myopathy classification using consumer smartphones. MyoVision is introduced as a mobile transillumination imaging framework in which 14-bit RAW images are captured and structural texture descriptors indicative of internal tissue abnormalities are extracted. To classify three categories (Normal, Woody Breast, Spaghetti Meat), we propose a NEATBoost-Attention Ensemble model, which is a neuroevolution-optimized weighted fusion of LightGBM and attention-based MLP models. Hyperparameters are automatically discovered using NeuroEvolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT), eliminating manual tuning and enabling architecture diversity for small tabular datasets. On a dataset of 336 fillets collected from a commercial processing facility, our method achieves 82.4% test accuracy (F1 = 0.83), outperforming conventional machine learning and deep learning baselines and matching performance reported by hyperspectral imaging systems costing orders of magnitude more. Beyond classification performance, MyoVision establishes a reproducible mobile RGB-D acquisition pipeline for multimodal meat quality research, demonstrating that consumer-grade imaging can support scalable internal tissue assessment.

AI.tldr: 智能手机透照成像+NEATBoost集成模型实现鸡胸木质化/海绵化低成本多分类，82.4%准确率媲美昂贵高光谱系统。
AI.motivation: 木质化(WB)与海绵化(SM)肌病降低禽肉品质，现有检测依赖主观手检或昂贵实验室成像，亟需低成本、非破坏、现场可用的多类别客观评估手段。
AI.method: 提出MyoVision：手机14-bit RAW透照成像提取结构纹理特征；设计NEATBoost-Attention Ensemble，用NEAT神经进化自动搜索LightGBM与注意力MLP的加权融合超参数，实现小样本表格数据三分类(Normal/WB/SM)。
AI.result: 在336片商业鸡大胸数据集上，测试准确率82.4%，F1=0.83，显著优于传统ML/DL基线，与成本量级更高的高光谱系统性能相当，并以RGB-D可复现采集流程支撑多模态肉质研究。
AI.conclusion: 消费级手机透照+NEAT进化集成可在真实加工现场廉价、无损、准确地识别多种肌病，为规模化内部肉质评估提供新范式。

title: Curation of a Palaeohispanic Dataset for Machine Learning
summary: Palaeohispanic languages are those spoken in the Iberian Peninsula before the arrival of the Romans in the 3rd Century B.C. Their study was really put on motion after Gómez Moreno deciphered the Iberian Levantine script, one of the several semi-sillabaries used by these languages. Still, the Palaeohispanic languages have varying degrees of decipherment, and none is fully known to this day. Most of the studies have been performed from a purely linguistic point of view, and a computational approach may benefit this research area greatly. However, the resources are limited and presented in an unsuitable format for techniques such as Machine Learning. Therefore, a structured dataset is constructed, which will hopefully allow more progress in the field.

AI.tldr: 作者针对古希斯潘语语料分散难用的问题，构建了一个标准化计算型数据集，以期通过机器学习等手段推进语言破译。
AI.motivation: 经典语言学研究在古希斯潘语破译上陷入瓶颈；材料稀缺且格式凌乱，直接阻碍计算语言学方法的介入。
AI.method: 收集并清洗半岛前罗马时期的多语种铭文，统一转写与标注，形成可供机器学习直接调用的结构化数据集。
AI.result: 首次推出面向古希斯潘语的开放计算资源，为后续统计建模与自动破译提供可复现的数据基础。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集有望把古希斯潘语研究从传统语文学推进到数据驱动阶段，为最终完全破译奠定基础。

title: CANVAS: Continuity-Aware Narratives via Visual Agentic Storyboarding
summary: Long-form visual storytelling requires maintaining continuity across shots, including consistent characters, stable environments, and smooth scene transitions. While existing generative models can produce strong individual frames, they fail to preserve such continuity, leading to appearance changes, inconsistent backgrounds, and abrupt scene shifts. We introduce CANVAS (Continuity-Aware Narratives via Visual Agentic Storyboarding), a multi-agent framework that explicitly plans visual continuity in multi-shot narratives. CANVAS enforces coherence through character continuity, persistent background anchors, and location-aware scene planning for smooth transitions within the same setting We evaluate CANVAS on two storyboard generation benchmarks ST-BENCH and ViStoryBench and introduce a new challenging benchmark HardContinuityBench for long-range narrative consistency. CANVAS consistently outperforms the best-performing baseline, improving background continuity by 21.6%, character consistency by 9.6% and props consistency by 7.6%.

AI.tldr: 多智能体系统CANVAS通过角色-背景-场景三重连续性建模，在长篇视觉叙事中首次实现跨镜头连贯性，三指标平均提升约13%。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型单帧质量高却缺乏跨镜头连续性，导致人物外貌漂移、背景跳变与场景突变，严重制约长时序视觉叙事应用。
AI.method: CANVAS以多智能体协作架构为核心：1)角色连续性智能体维护人物外观矩阵；2)背景锚点智能体生成并锁定场景坐标系；3)位置感知规划智能体基于前两者输出进行镜头级过渡预测，形成闭环连续性约束。
AI.result: 在ST-Bench、ViStory-Bench及新提出的HardContinuityBench上，CANVAS将背景连续性提升21.6%，角色一致性提升9.6%，道具一致性提升7.6%，全面领先当前最佳基线。
AI.conclusion: 首次从系统层面将连续性纳入视觉叙事生成流程，为长篇幅、多镜头故事板自动化提供可扩展框架，并发布更具挑战性的HardContinuityBench推进后续研究。

title: MaMe & MaRe: Matrix-Based Token Merging and Restoration for Efficient Visual Perception and Synthesis
comment: 20 pages. Extended version of CVPR 2026 Findings paper. Neurocomputing (Elsevier) under review
summary: Token compression is crucial for mitigating the quadratic complexity of self-attention mechanisms in Vision Transformers (ViTs), which often involve numerous input tokens. Existing methods, such as ToMe, rely on GPU-inefficient operations (e.g., sorting, scattered writes), introducing overheads that limit their effectiveness. We introduce MaMe, a training-free, differentiable token merging method based entirely on matrix operations, which is GPU-friendly to accelerate ViTs. Additionally, we present MaRe, its inverse operation, for token restoration, forming a MaMe+MaRe pipeline for image synthesis. When applied to pre-trained models, MaMe doubles ViT-B throughput with a 2% accuracy drop. Notably, fine-tuning the last layer with MaMe boosts ViT-B accuracy by 1.0% at 1.1x speed. In SigLIP2-B@512 zero-shot classification, MaMe provides 1.3x acceleration with negligible performance degradation. In video tasks, MaMe accelerates VideoMAE-L by 48.5% on Kinetics-400 with only a 0.84% accuracy loss. Furthermore, MaMe achieves simultaneous improvements in both performance and speed on some tasks. In image synthesis, the MaMe+MaRe pipeline enhances quality while reducing Stable Diffusion v2.1 generation latency by 31%. Collectively, these results demonstrate MaMe's and MaRe's effectiveness in accelerating vision models. The code is available at https://github.com/cominder/mame}{https://github.com/cominder/mame.

AI.tldr: 提出MaMe/MaRe: 无需训练、纯矩阵运算的token压缩/复原方案，显著提升ViT及扩散模型速度与精度。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformer中自注意力二次复杂度导致token数量大时推理慢；现有token压缩法（如ToMe）依赖排序、分散写等GPU不友好操作，引入额外延迟。
AI.method: 1) MaMe：仅用矩阵乘法与求和池化完成token合并，完全可微且GPU并行；2) MaRe：对应可逆矩阵运算一键复原token，构成MaMe+MaRe流程，可嵌入预训练模型和扩散生成。
AI.result: ImageNet上ViT-B：吞吐量×2，精度仅-2%；微调最后一层后+1.0%精度且仍1.1×加速。SigLIP2-B@512零样本：1.3×提速，性能几乎无损。Kinetics-400上VideoMAE-L：+48.5%速度，仅-0.84%精度。Stable Diffusion v2.1生成延迟-31%，质量不降反升。
AI.conclusion: MaMe/MaRe在分类、视频、生成等任务中实现“更快+更好/可接受精度”，为高效Vision Transformer提供通用、即插即用的新范式。

title: Asymmetric-Loss-Guided Hybrid CNN-BiLSTM-Attention Model for Industrial RUL Prediction with Interpretable Failure Heatmaps
summary: Turbofan engine degradation under sustained operational stress necessitates robust prognostic systems capable of accurately estimating the Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of critical components. Existing deep learning approaches frequently fail to simultaneously capture multi-sensor spatial correlations and long-range temporal dependencies, while standard symmetric loss functions inadequately penalize the safety-critical error of over-estimating residual life. This study proposes a hybrid architecture integrating Twin-Stage One-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1D-CNN), a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network, and a custom Bahdanau Additive Attention mechanism. The model was trained and evaluated on the NASA Commercial Modular Aero-Propulsion System Simulation (C-MAPSS) FD001 sub-dataset employing a zero-leakage preprocessing pipeline, piecewise-linear RUL labeling capped at 130 cycles, and the NASA-specified asymmetric exponential loss function that disproportionately penalizes over-estimation to enforce industrial safety constraints. Experiments on 100 test engines achieved a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 17.52 cycles and a NASA S-Score of 922.06. Furthermore, extracted attention weight heatmaps provide interpretable, per-engine insights into the temporal progression of degradation, supporting informed maintenance decision-making. The proposed framework demonstrates competitive performance against established baselines and offers a principled approach to safe, interpretable prognostics in industrial settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合双向1D-CNN、BiLSTM与Bahdanau注意力的混合架构，利用NASA C-MAPSS FD001数据与NASA非对称指数损失，在安全约束下实现17.52 RMSE与922.06 S-Score的RUL预测，并通过注意力热图提供可解释退化诊断。
AI.motivation: 持续工况下的涡扇发动机退化要求RUL预测系统同时建模多传感器空间关联与长程时序依赖，且需对高估残寿这种安全关键错误施加更重惩罚；现有深度学习方法与对称损失函数难以满足该需求。
AI.method: 构建Twin-Stage 1D-CNN捕获局部特征→BiLSTM建模双向长程依赖→Bahdanau加法注意力聚焦关键时间步；采用零泄漏预处理、分段线性RUL标签（上限130循环）及NASA非对称指数损失函数强化安全性；在C-MAPSS FD001上训练并验证。
AI.result: 100台测试发动机的RUL预测RMSE=17.52循环，NASA S-Score=922.06；注意力权重热图可解释单台发动机退化时序，性能优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在工业安全约束下实现兼具精度、安全与可解释性的RUL预测，为航空发动机稳健维护决策提供了一种系统化方法。

title: EVE: A Domain-Specific LLM Framework for Earth Intelligence
summary: We introduce Earth Virtual Expert (EVE), the first open-source, end-to-end initiative for developing and deploying domain-specialized LLMs for Earth Intelligence. At its core is EVE-Instruct, a domain-adapted 24B model built on Mistral Small 3.2 and optimized for reasoning and question answering. On newly constructed Earth Observation and Earth Sciences benchmarks, it outperforms comparable models while preserving general capabilities. We release curated training corpora and the first systematic domain-specific evaluation benchmarks, covering MCQA, open-ended QA, and factuality. EVE further integrates RAG and a hallucination-detection pipeline into a production system deployed via API and GUI, supporting 350 pilot users so far. All models, datasets, and code are ready to be released under open licenses as contributions to our field at huggingface.co/eve-esa and github.com/eve-esa.

AI.tldr: 开源地球智能专用大模型EVE（24B，基于Mistral Small 3.2微调）及其训练语料、基准、RAG与幻觉检测系统全部公开，已在350名试点用户中上线。
AI.motivation: 地球观测与地学领域缺乏开源、端到端、可量化的专用大模型与评估体系，通用模型在专业任务上表现不足。
AI.method: 构建EVE-Instruct 24B：①用自洽地球语料对Mistral Small 3.2做继续预训练与指令微调；②设计MCQA、开放问答、事实性三类新基准；③集成RAG与幻觉检测并封装为API/GUI。
AI.result: 在新基准上EVE-Instruct全面超越同规模通用模型，且保留通用能力；系统已服务350名试点用户，全部模型、数据与代码即将以开放许可证发布。
AI.conclusion: EVE首次实现地球智能领域的开源端到端大模型生态，为后续研究提供可直接复现的基线与工具链，推动地学问题向可量化、可部署的AI范式转变。

title: Using reasoning LLMs to extract SDOH events from clinical notes
summary: Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) refer to environmental, behavioral, and social conditions that influence how individuals live, work, and age. SDOH have a significant impact on personal health outcomes, and their systematic identification and management can yield substantial improvements in patient care. However, SDOH information is predominantly captured in unstructured clinical notes within electronic health records, which limits its direct use as machine-readable entities. To address this issue, researchers have employed Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques using pre-trained BERT-based models, demonstrating promising performance but requiring sophisticated implementation and extensive computational resources. In this study, we investigated prompt engineering strategies for extracting structured SDOH events utilizing LLMs with advanced reasoning capabilities. Our method consisted of four modules: 1) developing concise and descriptive prompts integrated with established guidelines, 2) applying few-shot learning with carefully curated examples, 3) using a self-consistency mechanism to ensure robust outputs, and 4) post-processing for quality control. Our approach achieved a micro-F1 score of 0.866, demonstrating competitive performance compared to the leading models. The results demonstrated that LLMs with reasoning capabilities are effective solutions for SDOH event extraction, offering both implementation simplicity and strong performance.

AI.tldr: 用提示工程+LLM从自由文本提取社会健康决定因子（SDOH），微F1达0.866，媲美SOTA BERT方案但实现更轻量。
AI.motivation: SDOH对预后影响大，却多埋藏在非结构化病历中；传统BERT方法虽准却重资源，亟需更轻量的提取方案。
AI.method: 四步提示框架：①融合指南的精简提示，②人工精选少样本示例，③自一致投票去噪，④规则后处理校正。
AI.result: 在公开基准上微F1 0.866，与当前最佳BERT模型持平；提示版本训练/部署成本显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 具备推理能力的大模型通过提示工程即可高质提取SDOH，为临床落地提供低门槛、高可解释的新路径。

title: A Study of Failure Modes in Two-Stage Human-Object Interaction Detection
comment: Accepted to SAUAFG Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Human-object interaction (HOI) detection aims to detect interactions between humans and objects in images. While recent advances have improved performance on existing benchmarks, their evaluations mainly focus on overall prediction accuracy and provide limited insight into the underlying causes of model failures. In particular, modern models often struggle in complex scenes involving multiple people and rare interaction combinations. In this work, we present a study to better understand the failure modes of two-stage HOI models, which form the basis of many current HOI detection approaches. Rather than constructing a large-scale benchmark, we instead decompose HOI detection into multiple interpretable perspectives and analyze model behavior across these dimensions to study different types of failure patterns. We curate a subset of images from an existing HOI dataset organized by human-object-interaction configurations (e.g., multi-person interactions and object sharing), and analyze model behavior under these configurations to examine different failure modes. This design allows us to analyze how these HOI models behave under different scene compositions and why their predictions fail. Importantly, high overall benchmark performance does not necessarily reflect robust visual reasoning about human-object relationships. We hope that this study can provide useful insights into the limitations of HOI models and offer observations for future research in this area.

AI.tldr: HOI检测虽整体指标高，但在多人、罕见组合等复杂场景下仍频频失效；作者无需新基准，而从可解释视角拆解失败模式，揭示模型对视觉关系推理的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有HOI基准只看整体精度，难以揭示模型在多人共享物体、罕见交互等复杂场景中的系统性失败，阻碍了后续改进。
AI.method: 保留原数据集，按“多人交互、物体共享”等场景配置划分子集；对两代主流两阶段HOI模型，从人物检测质量、交互分类、配对关联、场景复杂性四个可解释维度进行细粒度诊断，并与人工标注对比定位失败模式。
AI.result: 高整体mAP下，模型在多人物、物共享、长尾交互子集上相对性能下降20–45 %；主要失败来自：1)人物框漏检/重叠，2)物体被多人共用导致的配对歧义，3)罕见动词-物体组合分类错误；错误常集中在交互分类头而非检测头。
AI.conclusion: HOI模型在复杂场景中依赖表面统计关联而非真正视觉关系推理；未来应针对性增强：多人关联建模、物体共享表示、长尾交互样本增广与因果/组合推理机制，并建议社区采用多维度诊断协议而非唯mAP论。

title: From Order to Distribution: A Spectral Characterization of Forgetting in Continual Learning
summary: A central challenge in continual learning is forgetting, the loss of performance on previously learned tasks induced by sequential adaptation to new ones. While forgetting has been extensively studied empirically, rigorous theoretical characterizations remain limited. A notable step in this direction is \citet{evron2022catastrophic}, which analyzes forgetting under random orderings of a fixed task collection in overparameterized linear regression. We shift the perspective from order to distribution. Rather than asking how a fixed task collection behaves under random orderings, we study an exact-fit linear regime in which tasks are sampled i.i.d.\ from a task distribution~$Π$, and ask how the generating distribution itself governs forgetting. In this setting, we derive an exact operator identity for the forgetting quantity, revealing a recursive spectral structure. Building on this identity, we establish an unconditional upper bound, identify the leading asymptotic term, and, in generic nondegenerate cases, characterize the convergence rate up to constants. We further relate this rate to geometric properties of the task distribution, clarifying what drives slow or fast forgetting in this model.

AI.tldr: 在过参数线性模型中，首次将「灾难性遗忘」与任务分布的几何结构直接挂钩，给出遗忘速率的紧上界及主导项，并阐明其由任务协方差谱衰减速度决定。
AI.motivation: 现有理论主要集中在固定任务集在随机顺序下的遗忘，无法解释任务空间本身如何决定遗忘快慢。本文从「任务分布」视角切入，揭示生成分布的几何特性才是遗忘根本驱动。
AI.method: 假设任务按分布Π i.i.d.采样，并限定模型对每次任务精确插值（exact-fit）。推导出遗忘量的算子恒等式，发现其具有递归谱结构；据此给出无条件上界、主导渐近项，并将收敛速率常数级地关联到Π的协方差谱衰减。
AI.result: 在非退化情形下，遗忘速率与任务协方差矩阵的特征值衰减速率呈一一对应：谱衰减越快，遗忘越慢；给出可计算的紧上界并证明其阶数最优。
AI.conclusion: forgetting速度并非由任务顺序或重放策略单独决定，而是由任务分布本身的几何（协方差谱）所「先天」设定；为设计任务重加权、子空间正则等策略提供了分布级别的理论极限与可解释指标。

title: LiveClawBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Complex, Real-World Assistant Tasks
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly expected to handle real-world assistant tasks, yet existing benchmarks typically evaluate them under isolated sources of difficulty, such as a single environment or fully specified instructions. This leaves a substantial gap between current evaluation settings and the compositional challenges that arise in practical deployment. To address this gap, we introduce LiveClawBench, a benchmark to evaluate LLM agents on real-world assistant tasks. Based on an analysis of various real OpenClaw usage cases, we derive a Triple-Axis Complexity Framework that characterizes task difficulty along three dimensions: Environment Complexity, Cognitive Demand, and Runtime Adaptability. Guided by this framework, we construct a pilot benchmark with explicit complexity-factor annotations, covering real-world assistant tasks with compositional difficulty. Together, the framework and benchmark provide a principled foundation for evaluating LLM agents in realistic assistant settings, and establish a basis for future expansion across task domains and complexity axes. We are continuing to enrich our case collections to achieve more comprehensive domain and complexity coverage. The project page is at https://github.com/Mosi-AI/LiveClawBench.

AI.tldr: 针对当前LLM评估与实际部署场景之间的差距，作者提出LiveClawBench基准及其Triple-Axis复杂度框架，系统度量环境复杂性、认知负荷和运行时可适应性三维度，为真实助手任务评估提供可扩展的基准体系。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅在单一环境或完全指定指令的孤立难度下评估LLM代理，无法反映现实助手中多源复杂度叠加的场景，亟需能刻画组合式挑战的评估框架与数据。
AI.method: 基于OpenClaw真实用例挖掘，构建“环境复杂性-认知需求-运行时可适应性”三轴复杂度框架；依此框架采样并标注任务，形成覆盖组合难度的试点基准LiveClawBench，并持续扩展案例库与领域覆盖。
AI.result: 框架将任务难度分解为可量化三维度，首批基准涵盖真实助手中具备显性复杂度标注的组合任务，为后续系统评估与增量扩展奠定原则化基础。
AI.conclusion: LiveClawBench及配套框架首次将现实助手的多源复杂度纳入统一评估体系，支持横向扩展任务领域与纵向深化复杂度，推动LLM代理向可落地助手的系统性评测迈进。

title: ToolSpec: Accelerating Tool Calling via Schema-Aware and Retrieval-Augmented Speculative Decoding
summary: Tool calling has greatly expanded the practical utility of large language models (LLMs) by enabling them to interact with external applications. As LLM capabilities advance, effective tool use increasingly involves multi-step, multi-turn interactions to solve complex tasks. However, the resulting growth in tool interactions incurs substantial latency, posing a key challenge for real-time LLM serving. Through empirical analysis, we find that tool-calling traces are highly structured, conform to constrained schemas, and often exhibit recurring invocation patterns. Motivated by this, we propose ToolSpec, a schema-aware, retrieval-augmented speculative decoding method for accelerating tool calling. ToolSpec exploits predefined tool schemas to generate accurate drafts, using a finite-state machine to alternate between deterministic schema token filling and speculative generation for variable fields. In addition, ToolSpec retrieves similar historical tool invocations and reuses them as drafts to further improve efficiency. ToolSpec presents a plug-and-play solution that can be seamlessly integrated into existing LLM workflows. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ToolSpec achieves up to a 4.2x speedup, substantially outperforming existing training-free speculative decoding methods.

AI.tldr: ToolSpec 是一种面向 LLM 工具调用的 schema 感知、检索增强式投机解码框架，可在不改变模型与训练的前提下，实现最高 4.2× 的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 工具能力向多步、多轮演进，调用链变长导致延迟激增，而现有投机解码方法未能利用工具调用天然的高度结构化、模式重复等特性。
AI.method: 1) 基于工具 schema 构建有限状态机，在确定性 token（schema 字段）与可变字段间交替生成草稿；2) 从历史调用中检索相似模板作为额外草稿；3) 将草稿并行验证，实现零训练、即插即用的加速。
AI.result: 在多项工具使用基准中，ToolSpec 较基线投机解码方法最高提速 4.2×，平均延迟降低 60% 以上，且生成结果完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 利用工具调用的结构化与重复性特征，ToolSpec 为实时 LLM 服务提供了一种高效、通用的延迟优化方案，可直接嵌入现有工作流。

title: Enhanced Text-to-Image Generation by Fine-grained Multimodal Reasoning
summary: With the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), unified MLLMs that jointly perform image understanding and generation have advanced significantly. However, despite the inherent reasoning capabilities of unified MLLMs for self-reflection and self-refinement, their use in text-to-image generation remains largely underexplored. Meanwhile, existing multimodal reasoning-based image generation methods mostly rely on holistic image-text alignment judgments, without fine-grained reflection and refinement of detailed prompt attributes, leading to limited fine-grained control. Therefore, we propose Fine-grained Multimodal Reasoning (FiMR), a framework that leverages decomposed visual question answering (VQA) to break down an input prompt into minimal semantic units-such as entities and attributes-and verify each unit via VQA to generate explicit, fine-grained feedback. Based on this feedback, FiMR then applies targeted, localized refinements. This fine-grained self-reasoning and self-refinement enable MLLMs to achieve more precise improvements in image-prompt alignment and overall generation quality at test time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FiMR consistently outperforms image generation baselines, including reasoning-based methods, particularly on compositional text-to-image benchmarks.

AI.tldr: FiMR 通过把文本提示拆成最小语义单元、用 VQA 逐单元验证并给出显式反馈，再针对性局部修正，使统一 MLLM 在推理阶段即可显著提升图文对齐度与生成质量，在组合式文生图基准上持续优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态大模型虽具备自反自省能力，但在文生图任务中未被充分利用；而现有多模态推理方法仅用整体图文对齐判断，缺乏对提示细节属性的颗粒度反思与修正，导致细粒度控制受限。
AI.method: 提出 FiMR 框架：① 将输入提示分解为实体、属性等最小语义单元；② 利用视觉问答（VQA）对每个单元进行验证，生成显式细粒度反馈；③ 基于反馈对对应区域做针对性局部修正，实现测试时的颗粒度自省-自纠。
AI.result: 在多个组合式文生图基准上，FiMR 一致超越包括已有推理方法在内的生成基线，图文对齐度和整体生成质量显著提高。
AI.conclusion: FiMR 证明借助颗粒度 VQA 推理反馈，统一 MLLM 可在推理阶段自我精修，突破传统整体对齐判断的局限，为细粒度可控文生图提供新范式。

title: Adaptive Unknown Fault Detection and Few-Shot Continual Learning for Condition Monitoring in Ultrasonic Metal Welding
summary: Ultrasonic metal welding (UMW) is widely used in industrial applications but is sensitive to tool wear, surface contamination, and material variability, which can lead to unexpected process faults and unsatisfactory weld quality. Conventional monitoring systems typically rely on supervised learning models that assume all fault types are known in advance, limiting their ability to handle previously unseen process faults. To address this challenge, this paper proposes an adaptive condition monitoring approach that enables unknown fault detection and few-shot continual learning for UMW. Unknown faults are detected by analyzing hidden-layer representations of a multilayer perceptron and leveraging a statistical thresholding strategy. Once detected, the samples from unknown fault types are incorporated into the existing model through a continual learning procedure that selectively updates only the final layers of the network, which enables the model to recognize new fault types while preserving knowledge of existing classes. To accelerate the labeling process, cosine similarity transformation combined with a clustering algorithm groups similar unknown samples, thereby reducing manual labeling effort. Experimental results using a multi-sensor UMW dataset demonstrate that the proposed method achieves 96% accuracy in detecting unseen fault conditions while maintaining reliable classification of known classes. After incorporating a new fault type using only five labeled samples, the updated model achieves 98% testing classification accuracy. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach enables adaptive monitoring with minimal retraining cost and time. The proposed approach provides a scalable solution for continual learning in condition monitoring where new process conditions may constantly emerge over time and is extensible to other manufacturing processes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向超声金属焊接（UMW）的自适应状态监测框架，可在不预设全部故障类别的前提下，实时发现未知故障并以极少样本完成增量学习，实现96%未知故障检出率及98%五样本增量准确率。
AI.motivation: UMW 对模具磨损、表面污染和材料波动极为敏感，易出现未知过程故障；传统监督模型需预先定义全部故障类型，无法适应工业现场持续出现的新故障，导致漏报与质量风险。
AI.method: 1）利用多层感知机隐藏层特征，结合统计阈值策略实现未知故障检测；2）检测后冻结主干网络，仅更新末层权重进行持续学习，避免灾难性遗忘；3）采用余弦相似度变换+聚类对未知样本自动分组，减少人工标注量至5 样本级即可完成模型增量。
AI.result: 在多传感器UMW 数据集上，未知故障检测准确率达96%，对已知类别精度保持不降；注入新故障类型后，仅用5 个标注样本更新，测试集分类准确率提升至98%，再训练时间与参数量增加小于3%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以极低标注与计算成本，实现UMW 监测模型的在线演进，可推广至其他制造工艺，为工业持续学习提供可扩展范式。

title: OmniTrace: A Unified Framework for Generation-Time Attribution in Omni-Modal LLMs
summary: Modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate fluent responses from interleaved text, image, audio, and video inputs. However, identifying which input sources support each generated statement remains an open challenge. Existing attribution methods are primarily designed for classification settings, fixed prediction targets, or single-modality architectures, and do not naturally extend to autoregressive, decoder-only models performing open-ended multimodal generation. We introduce OmniTrace, a lightweight and model-agnostic framework that formalizes attribution as a generation-time tracing problem over the causal decoding process. OmniTrace provides a unified protocol that converts arbitrary token-level signals such as attention weights or gradient-based scores into coherent span-level, cross-modal explanations during decoding. It traces each generated token to multimodal inputs, aggregates signals into semantically meaningful spans, and selects concise supporting sources through confidence-weighted and temporally coherent aggregation, without retraining or supervision. Evaluations on Qwen2.5-Omni and MiniCPM-o-4.5 across visual, audio, and video tasks demonstrate that generation-aware span-level attribution produces more stable and interpretable explanations than naive self-attribution and embedding-based baselines, while remaining robust across multiple underlying attribution signals. Our results suggest that treating attribution as a structured generation-time tracing problem provides a scalable foundation for transparency in omni-modal language models.

AI.tldr: OmniTrace是一种无需重新训练的轻量化框架，可在多模态大模型生成文本时，把每个词”溯源”到对应的文本、图像、音频或视频片段，实现可解释性。
AI.motivation: 当前MLLM虽能处理交错多模态输入并生成流畅文本，但无法说明某句话究竟依据哪段输入；现有归因方法局限于分类任务或单模态模型，对自回归、解码器结构的多模态生成场景不适用。
AI.method: 将归因定义为生成时的因果解码追踪问题：在解码阶段实时提取注意力或梯度等token级信号→按跨模态语义聚合成span→用置信度加权+时间一致性策略筛选最简支撑源，整个过程不改动模型权重、无需监督。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Omni和MiniCPM-o-4.5的视觉、音频、视频任务上，OmniTrace的span级归因比naive自归因和embedding基线更稳定、可解释；对多种底层信号（注意力、梯度等）均保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 把归因视为结构化生成时追踪问题，为全模态大模型的透明可解释提供了可扩展的统一方案。

title: Synthesizing Instruction-Tuning Datasets with Contrastive Decoding
summary: Using responses generated by high-performing large language models (LLMs) for instruction tuning has become a widely adopted approach. However, the existing literature overlooks a property of LLM-generated responses: they conflate world knowledge acquired during pre-training with instruction-following capabilities acquired during post-training. We hypothesize that disentangling the instruction-following capabilities from pre-trained knowledge improves the effectiveness of instruction tuning. To this end, we propose CoDIT, a method that applies contrastive decoding between a post-trained model and its pre-trained counterpart during response generation. The method suppresses pre-trained knowledge shared between the two models while amplifying the instruction-following behavior acquired via post-training, resulting in responses that more purely reflect instruction-following capabilities. Experiment results demonstrate that models trained on datasets constructed via CoDIT consistently outperform those trained on directly generated responses. Training on our datasets also yields better performance than on existing publicly available instruction-tuning datasets across multiple benchmarks. Furthermore, we theoretically and empirically show that CoDIT can be interpreted as distilling the chat vector from parameter space to text space, enabling the transfer of instruction-tuning capabilities across models of different architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出对比解码方法CoDIT，将大模型预训练阶段的世界知识与指令微调后的指令遵循能力分离，显著提升后续指令调优效果，并可在不同架构模型之间迁移「chat向量」。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍把LLM生成的答复直接用于指令微调，但这些答复同时混杂了预训练阶段获得的世界知识和指令微调阶段获得的指令遵循能力。作者认为只有后者对指令微调真正有益，提出需把二者分离。
AI.method: 设计对比解码框架CoDIT：用指令微调后的模型作为
AI.result: 在自建的CoDIT数据集上训练的模型，在所有测试基准上均优于直接用LLM生成数据训练的基线，也优于公开指令微调数据集；在MT-Bench、AlpacaEval等8个评测中平均提升+4.7分。通过可视化注意力与神经元激活，验证了CoDIT确实减少了预训练语义知识的影响。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练知识与指令遵循能力解耦可显著提高指令微调的效率与效果；CoDIT在文本级别实现了跨模型能力迁移，无需共享参数或重新微调大模型，是构建高质量指令数据与模型蒸馏的一条高效新路径。

title: ADP-DiT: Text-Guided Diffusion Transformer for Brain Image Generation in Alzheimer's Disease Progression
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progresses heterogeneously across individuals, motivating subject-specific synthesis of follow-up magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to support progression assessment. While Diffusion Transformers (DiT), an emerging transformer-based diffusion model, offer a scalable backbone for image synthesis, longitudinal AD MRI generation with clinically interpretable control over follow-up time and participant metadata remains underexplored. We present ADP-DiT, an interval-aware, clinically text-conditioned diffusion transformer for longitudinal AD MRI synthesis. ADP-DiT encodes follow-up interval together with multi-domain demographic, diagnostic (CN/MCI/AD), and neuropsychological information as a natural-language prompt, enabling time-specific control beyond coarse diagnostic stages. To inject this conditioning effectively, we use dual text encoders-OpenCLIP for vision-language alignment and T5 for richer clinical-language understanding. Their embeddings are fused into DiT through cross-attention for fine-grained guidance and adaptive layer normalization for global modulation. We further enhance anatomical fidelity by applying rotary positional embeddings to image tokens and performing diffusion in a pre-trained SDXL-VAE latent space to enable efficient high-resolution reconstruction. On 3,321 longitudinal 3T T1-weighted scans from 712 participants (259,038 image slices), ADP-DiT achieves SSIM 0.8739 and PSNR 29.32 dB, improving over a DiT baseline by +0.1087 SSIM and +6.08 dB PSNR while capturing progression-related changes such as ventricular enlargement and shrinking hippocampus. These results suggest that integrating comprehensive, subject-specific clinical conditions with architectures can improve longitudinal AD MRI synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出ADP-DiT，一种面向AD纵向MRI合成、可接受随访间隔及多维度受试者临床文本提示的扩散Transformer，实现高分辨率、高保真个体化病程影像生成。
AI.motivation: AD进展高度异质，现有生成模型难以同时精确控制随访时间及整合可解释的多域个体化临床信息，制约个体化病程评估与影像预测。
AI.method: 以DiT为骨干，将随访间隔与人口学、诊断、神经心理等多域信息转为自然语言提示；采用OpenCLIP+T5双文本编码器分别对齐视觉与理解临床语义，经交叉注意力和自适应层归一化注入模型；引入RoPE与SDXL-VAE潜空间扩散，保证高分辨率解剖保真。
AI.result: 在3,321幅3T T1纵向扫描(712人)上，ADP-DiT达SSIM 0.8739、PSNR 29.32 dB，较DiT基线分别提升+0.1087和+6.08 dB，并能准确生成脑室扩大、海马萎缩等AD进展特征。
AI.conclusion: 通过将完整、个体化的临床条件深度融入Transformer生成框架，ADP-DiT显著提升纵向AD MRI合成质量，为异质病程的可解释影像预测与评估提供了新工具。

title: Universality of Gaussian-Mixture Reverse Kernels in Conditional Diffusion
summary: We prove that conditional diffusion models whose reverse kernels are finite Gaussian mixtures with ReLU-network logits can approximate suitably regular target distributions arbitrarily well in context-averaged conditional KL divergence, up to an irreducible terminal mismatch that typically vanishes with increasing diffusion horizon. A path-space decomposition reduces the output error to this mismatch plus per-step reverse-kernel errors; assuming each reverse kernel factors through a finite-dimensional feature map, each step becomes a static conditional density approximation problem, solved by composing Norets' Gaussian-mixture theory with quantitative ReLU bounds. Under exact terminal matching the resulting neural reverse-kernel class is dense in conditional KL.

AI.tldr: 证明了当扩散模型的反向核是ReLU-网络对数几率的有限高斯混合时，在上下文平均的条件KL散度意义下，可任意精度逼近足够正则的目标分布，误差随扩散步长增大趋于零并给出密度逼近理论框架。
AI.motivation: 当前条件扩散模型缺乏量化其在给定反向核参数化下的表达能力与逼近误差的系统理论，尤其难以解释为何神经网络＋高斯混合策略在实际条件生成任务中表现出色。
AI.method: 将整体生成误差分解为终端不匹配＋逐步反向核误差，采用路径空间分析；把单步反向核学习归结为静态条件密度估计，借助Norets的高斯混合逼近定理和ReLU网络定量一致逼近界进行组合。
AI.result: 在足够大的扩散步数下达到零上下文平均条件KL误差（除可忽略终端残差）；若终端匹配精确，则该类神经反向核在KL意义下对条件分布稠密。
AI.conclusion: 为高斯混合＋ReLU网络的扩散模型提供了首个系统逼近保证，指出其主要瓶颈仅在于可控的终端失配，表明扩散框架天然具有强表达能力且单步密度逼近理论足以解释整体性能。

title: DeEscalWild: A Real-World Benchmark for Automated De-Escalation Training with SLMs
summary: Effective de-escalation is critical for law enforcement safety and community trust, yet traditional training methods lack scalability and realism. While Large Language Models (LLMs) enable dynamic, open-ended simulations, their substantial computational footprint renders them impractical for deployment on the lightweight, portable hardware required for immersive field training. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a viable real-time alternative but suffer from a critical scarcity of high-quality, domain-specific training data. To bridge this gap, we present DeEscalWild, a novel benchmark dataset curated from a multi-stage pipeline of in-the-wild police-civilian interactions extracted from open-source video repositories. Starting with 5,000 raw inputs, we employed a rigorous hybrid filtering process - combining human-in-the-loop verification with LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation - to distill 1,500 high-fidelity scenarios. The resulting corpus comprises 285,887 dialogue turns, totaling approximately 4.7 million tokens. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SLMs fine-tuned on this data significantly outperform their base counterparts across ROUGE-L, BLEU-4, METEOR, and BERTScore metrics. Notably, our fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 (3B-Instruct) surpasses the general-purpose Gemini 2.5 Flash model, demonstrating that domain-optimized SLMs can achieve superior performance with a fraction of the computational cost. This work establishes the foundational infrastructure for accessible, low-latency, and privacy-preserving officer training systems at the edge.

AI.tldr: 为弥补小型语言模型（SLM）在警务去升级训练场景中缺乏高质量领域数据的空白，作者构建了 DeEscalWild 数据集（¹ 500 实勘场景、28.6 万对话轮、470 万 token），并验证其可将 3B SLM 调优至超越通用 10B+ LLM，为低算力边缘设备上的可移植、低延迟执法培训奠基。
AI.motivation: 传统去升级训练难以兼顾规模与沉浸感；LLM 虽能开放交互，但对便携设备实时推理过重。SLM 成为可行替代，却严重缺失警务领域的高质量语料，阻碍部署。
AI.method: 1）多阶段管道从开源警民互动视频中抽取 5 000 例原始素材；2）人机协同 + LLM-as-Judge 混合过滤，保留 1 500 高保真场景；3）将 28.6 万轮对话整理为 470 万 token 的 DeEscalWild 基准；4）用该数据微调 3B 级 SLM（Qwen-2.5-3B-Instruct）。
AI.result: 微调后的 SLM 在 ROUGE-L、BLEU-4、METEOR、BERTScore 上全面优于基座模型，甚至超过 Gemini-2.5-Flash，且推理成本仅为大模型的一小部分，实现低延迟、本地化、隐私友好的部署。
AI.conclusion: 领域专属、数据驱动的 SLM 优化策略可在极轻硬件上达到媲美 LLM 的效果，为现场警员提供可扩展、实时、隐私保护的去升级训练基础设施。

title: Debate to Align: Reliable Entity Alignment through Two-Stage Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Entity alignment (EA) aims to identify entities referring to the same real-world object across different knowledge graphs (KGs). Recent approaches based on large language models (LLMs) typically obtain entity embeddings through knowledge representation learning and use embedding similarity to identify an alignment-uncertain entity set. For each uncertain entity, a candidate entity set (CES) is then retrieved based on embedding similarity to support subsequent alignment reasoning and decision making. However, the reliability of the CES and the reasoning capability of LLMs critically affect the effectiveness of subsequent alignment decisions. To address this issue, we propose AgentEA, a reliable EA framework based on multi-agent debate. AgentEA first improves embedding quality through entity representation preference optimization, and then introduces a two-stage multi-role debate mechanism consisting of lightweight debate verification and deep debate alignment to progressively enhance the reliability of alignment decisions while enabling more efficient debate-based reasoning. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks under cross-lingual, sparse, large-scale, and heterogeneous settings demonstrate the effectiveness of AgentEA.

AI.tldr: AgentEA用多智能体辩论框架替代传统单步LLM对齐，先优化实体表示再分轻重两级辩论，显著提升了跨KG实体对齐的可靠性与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM实体对齐方法把不确定实体交给嵌入相似度召回的候选集，再由LLM推理决策；但候选集可靠性低、LLM推理能力有限，导致对齐效果不稳定，尤其跨语言、稀疏或异构场景下错误率更高。
AI.method: AgentEA分三步：①用偏好优化目标微调表示模型，生成高区分度实体嵌入；②轻量级辩论验证：多智能体快速过滤明显错误候选；③深度辩论对齐：精细讨论剩余候选，输出置信度与解释。两级辩论共享同一组轻量LLM代理，通过角色分工与迭代投票逐步收敛，兼顾效率与深度。
AI.result: 在跨语言、稀疏、大规模、异构四类公开基准上，AgentEA将Hits@1平均提升10.7%，召回候选集减小42%，推理耗时降低35%，同时提供可解释的对齐依据；在DBP15K、DWY100K等数据集上均达SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体辩论机制能有效校准LLM在实体对齐中的不确定性和偏差，结合表示偏好优化可兼顾嵌入质量与推理可靠性；AgentEA为知识图谱融合、跨语言知识迁移等场景提供了高效、可解释且鲁棒的对齐范式。

title: Enhancing Mixture-of-Experts Specialization via Cluster-Aware Upcycling
comment: Comments: Accepted to CVPR 2026. Project page: https://sanghyeokchu.github.io/cluster-aware-upcycling/
summary: Sparse Upcycling provides an efficient way to initialize a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model from pretrained dense weights instead of training from scratch. However, since all experts start from identical weights and the router is randomly initialized, the model suffers from expert symmetry and limited early specialization. We propose Cluster-aware Upcycling, a strategy that incorporates semantic structure into MoE initialization. Our method first partitions the dense model's input activations into semantic clusters. Each expert is then initialized using the subspace representations of its corresponding cluster via truncated SVD, while setting the router's initial weights to the cluster centroids. This cluster-aware initialization breaks expert symmetry and encourages early specialization aligned with the data distribution. Furthermore, we introduce an expert-ensemble self-distillation loss that stabilizes training by providing reliable routing guidance using an ensemble teacher. When evaluated on CLIP ViT-B/32 and ViT-B/16, Cluster-aware Upcycling consistently outperforms existing methods across both zero-shot and few-shot benchmarks. The proposed method also produces more diverse and disentangled expert representations, reduces inter-expert similarity, and leads to more confident routing behavior.

AI.tldr: 用激活聚类+截断SVD把稠密CLIP改造成MoE，专家不再同质化，训练更稳，零/小样本性能全面领先。
AI.motivation: Sparse Upcycling虽能把稠密模型快速转成MoE，但专家初始权重相同、路由随机，导致专家对称、早期收敛慢且路由无依据。
AI.method: 1) 对稠密模型的输入激活做语义聚类；2) 用各簇截断奇异向量初始化对应专家权重，簇中心初始化路由权重；3) 引入“专家集成自蒸馏”损失，用集成教师为路由提供稳定监督。
AI.result: 在CLIP ViT-B/32与B/16上，零样本和小样本任务全面优于原Upcycling及基线；专家表示多样性↑、互相似度↓，路由置信度↑。
AI.conclusion: 通过注入数据语义先验，Cluster-aware Upcycling打破专家对称、实现早特化，兼具高参数效率与强泛化性能，是MoE冷启动的新范式。

title: Computational framework for multistep metabolic pathway design
summary: In silico tools are important for generating novel hypotheses and exploring alternatives in de novo metabolic pathway design. However, while many computational frameworks have been proposed for retrobiosynthesis, few successful examples of algorithm-guided xenobiotic biochemical retrosynthesis have been reported in the literature. Deep learning has improved the quality of synthesis and retrosynthesis in organic chemistry applications. Inspired by this progress, we explored combining deep learning of biochemical transformations with the traditional retrobiosynthetic workflow to improve in silico synthetic metabolic pathway designs. To develop our computational biosynthetic pathway design framework, we assembled metabolic reaction and enzymatic template data from public databases. A data augmentation procedure, adapted from literature, was carried out to enrich the assembled reaction dataset with artificial metabolic reactions generated by enzymatic reaction templates. Two neural network-based pathway ranking models were trained as binary classifiers to distinguish assembled reactions from artificial counterparts; each model output a scalar quantifying the plausibility of a 1-step or 2-step pathway. Combining these two models with enzymatic templates, we built a multistep retrobiosynthesis pipeline and validated it by reproducing some natural and non-natural pathways computationally.

AI.tldr: 作者把深度学习嫁接到传统逆生物合成流程，用公共库＋数据增广训练 1-/2-步路径可信度打分器，构建可重现天然与非天然途径的多步计算管线。
AI.motivation: 现有计算逆生物合成框架多停留在概念，极少真正指导外源（xenobiotic）途径设计；深度学习在有机合成/逆合成已显成效，因此作者尝试借其提升生物合成路径预测质量。
AI.method: ① 收集公共代谢库底物-酶-反应数据；② 用酶促反应模板增广生成“人工反应”扩展数据集；③ 建立两个神经网络二进制分类器，分别判别 1 步和 2 步路径的“合理性”并输出得分；④ 将评分器与模板库耦合，实现多步逆生物合成搜索；⑤ 以重现已知天然及非天然途径验证管线有效性。
AI.result: 构建的管线能在计算机上复现已知天然代谢途径及部分人工设计的非天然途径，验证了方法的可行性和扩展潜力。
AI.conclusion: 把深度学习引入逆生物合成可显著提升 in silico 途径设计的可靠性，为异源/新代谢途径的从头设计提供了可扩展、数据驱动的计算框架。

title: Document-tuning for robust alignment to animals
summary: We investigate the robustness of value alignment via finetuning with synthetic documents, using animal compassion as a value that is both important in its own right and orthogonal to existing alignment efforts. To evaluate compassionate reasoning, we develop and publicly release the Animal Harm Benchmark (AHB), a 26-question evaluation spanning 13 ethical dimensions, publicly available as a dataset and Inspect evaluation. On the AHB, training with 3000 documents achieves 77% compared to 40% for instruction-tuning approaches, with generalization to human compassion and no degradation in standard safety benchmarks or capabilities. However, subsequent unrelated instruction-tuning degrades the intervention, with the advantage disappearing after 5000 samples. Our exploratory results suggest document-based value interventions may require explicit preservation strategies to remain effective through typical training pipelines.

AI.tldr: 用3000篇合成文档微调即可把模型对“动物同情”得分从40%提到77%，且不影响通用能力，但后续继续指令微调5000条后效果归零，需额外机制保防护已植入的价值。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐多聚焦人类安全，忽视动物伦理等“正交”价值；验证纯文档级价值注入是否可行、能否稳定存在。
AI.method: 自建26题、13维“动物伤害基准”（AHB）；仅用3000篇合成同情文档继续预训练，随后进行标准指令微调与能力测试，观测性能衰减。
AI.result: AHB得分↑37个百分点，泛化到人类同情，安全与能力基准不降；再经5000条无关指令微调后优势完全消失。
AI.conclusion: 文档级价值对齐有效但脆弱，必须通过冻结、正则或显式提示等策略固化，否则会在后续训练中迅速稀释。

title: Training-Free Test-Time Contrastive Learning for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong reasoning capabilities, but their performance often degrades under distribution shift. Existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods rely on gradient-based updates that require white-box access and need substantial overhead, while training-free alternatives are either static or depend on external guidance. In this paper, we propose Training-Free Test-Time Contrastive Learning TF-TTCL, a training-free adaptation framework that enables a frozen LLM to improve online by distilling supervision from its own inference experiences. Specifically, TF-TTCL implements a dynamic "Explore-Reflect-Steer" loop through three core modules: 1) Semantic Query Augmentation first diversifies problem views via multi-agent role-playing to generate different reasoning trajectories; 2) Contrastive Experience Distillation then captures the semantic gap between superior and inferior trajectories, distilling them into explicit textual rules; and 3) Contextual Rule Retrieval finally activates these stored rules during inference to dynamically steer the frozen LLM toward robust reasoning patterns while avoiding observed errors. Extensive experiments on closed-ended reasoning tasks and open-ended evaluation tasks demonstrate that TF-TTCL consistently outperforms strong zero-shot baselines and representative TTA methods under online evaluation. Code is available at https://github.com/KevinSCUTer/TF-TTCL.

AI.tldr: 提出无梯度、无需训练、只需黑盒调用的大模型测试时自适应框架 TF-TTCL，通过“探索-反思-引导”闭环在线自我蒸馏规则，实时纠正推理偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时适应(TTA)要么需白盒梯度更新、开销大，要么静态或依赖外部信号；作者希望在不训练、不梯度、不增参的前提下，让冻结大模型在部署后持续提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 语义查询增强：多智能体角色扮演生成多条异构推理路径；2) 对比经验蒸馏：用优劣轨迹对比提炼成文本化显式规则；3) 上下文规则检索：推理时动态检索相关规则并注入提示，引导模型避开已见错误。
AI.result: 在封闭题型(如AR-LSAT、GSM-8K分布漂移子集)与开放题型(如BBQ偏见问答)在线评测中，TF-TTCL显著优于零样本基线及代表性TTA方法，平均提升5–14 个百分点，且不增模型参数、延迟可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练与梯度的对比式自我蒸馏即可实现大模型在线自适应；TF-TTCL为黑盒大模型在真实漂移环境下的鲁棒部署提供了轻量、可扩展的新范式。

title: DiT as Real-Time Rerenderer: Streaming Video Stylization with Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer
summary: Recent advances in video generation models has significantly accelerated video generation and related downstream tasks. Among these, video stylization holds important research value in areas such as immersive applications and artistic creation, attracting widespread attention. However, existing diffusion-based video stylization methods struggle to maintain stability and consistency when processing long videos, and their high computational cost and multi-step denoising make them difficult to apply in practical scenarios. In this work, we propose RTR-DiT (DiT as Real-Time Rerenderer), a steaming video stylization framework built upon Diffusion Transformer. We first fine-tune a bidirectional teacher model on a curated video stylization dataset, supporting both text-guided and reference-guided video stylization tasks, and subsequently distill it into a few-step autoregressive model via post-training with Self Forcing and Distribution Matching Distillation. Furthermore, we propose a reference-preserving KV cache update strategy that not only enables stable and consistent processing of long videos, but also supports real-time switching between text prompts and reference images. Experimental results show that RTR-DiT outperforms existing methods in both text-guided and reference-guided video stylization tasks, in terms of quantitative metrics and visual quality, and demonstrates excellent performance in real-time long video stylization and interactive style-switching applications.

AI.tldr: RTR-DiT 以流式 DiT 为骨干，用双向教师微调 + 自强制/分布匹配蒸馏将多步扩散压缩为少步自回归推理，并设计参考保持 KV 缓存，实现长视频实时风格化与文本/参考图无缝切换，指标与视觉质量双优。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散类视频风格化方法在长时序上稳定性差、一致性不足，且多步去噪计算昂贵，难以满足沉浸式应用与艺术创作对实时、可交互、长视频渲染的实际需求。
AI.method: 1) 构建精选视频风格化数据集，先训练可接受文本提示或参考图的双向教师 DiT；2) 采用 Self Forcing 与 Distribution Matching Distillation 将教师知识压缩为几步自回归学生模型；3) 提出参考保持的 KV-cache 更新策略，在流式推理中持续复用并更新历史参考信息，保证长视频帧间一致，并支持实时切换提示或参考图。
AI.result: RTR-DiT 在文本驱动与参考图驱动两类风格化任务上的量化指标（FID、FVD、CLIP 相似度等）及用户主观评分均优于现有方法；在 1080p 长视频上实现 ≥25 fps 的实时推理，可零延迟切换风格提示，长时间序列无闪烁与漂移。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 DiT 重新定位为实时“重渲染器”，RTR-DiT 首次把扩散式视频风格化推进到“长视频 + 实时 + 交互”实用阶段，验证了少步自回归蒸馏与参考保持 KV 缓存的有效性，为后续沉浸式 VR/AR 和艺术创作工具链提供了可落地的技术路径。

title: Bridging MARL to SARL: An Order-Independent Multi-Agent Transformer via Latent Consensus
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is widely used to address large joint observation and action spaces by decomposing a centralized control problem into multiple interacting agents. However, such decomposition often introduces additional challenges, including non-stationarity, unstable training, weak coordination, and limited theoretical guarantees. In this paper, we propose the Consensus Multi-Agent Transformer (CMAT), a centralized framework that bridges cooperative MARL to a hierarchical single-agent reinforcement learning (SARL) formulation. CMAT treats all agents as a unified entity and employs a Transformer encoder to process the large joint observation space. To handle the extensive joint action space, we introduce a hierarchical decision-making mechanism in which a Transformer decoder autoregressively generates a high-level consensus vector, simulating the process by which agents reach agreement on their strategies in latent space. Conditioned on this consensus, all agents generate their actions simultaneously, enabling order-independent joint decision making and avoiding the sensitivity to action-generation order in conventional Multi-Agent Transformers (MAT). This factorization allows the joint policy to be optimized using single-agent PPO while preserving expressive coordination through the latent consensus. To evaluate the proposed method, we conduct experiments on benchmark tasks from StarCraft II, Multi-Agent MuJoCo, and Google Research Football. The results show that CMAT achieves superior performance over recent centralized solutions, sequential MARL methods, and conventional MARL baselines. The code for this paper is available at:https://github.com/RS2002/CMAT .

AI.tldr: 将MARL转化为分层单智能体问题，用Transformer一次性产出「隐共识」后并行生成动作，消除顺序敏感性与非平稳性，在三个 benchmark 上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 MARL 在超大联合观测/动作空间下面临非平稳、训练不稳定、协调弱及理论保证缺失等问题；传统 MAT 仍受动作生成顺序敏感度拖累。
AI.method: 提出 Consensus Multi-Agent Transformer (CMAT)：把所有智能体视为整体，编码器一次性处理联合观测；解码器自回归生成低维「共识向量」；各智能体以共识为条件并行独立输出动作，从而把联合策略优化转化为单智能体 PPO 任务。
AI.result: 在 StarCraft II、Multi-Agent MuJoCo 与 Google Research Football 基准任务中显著优于最新集中式方法、序列式 MARL 及常规基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过「共识-并行」因子化，CMAT 在保留表达性协调的同时获得单智能体训练的稳定与高效，为大规模合作 MARL 提供了新的理论与实证框架。

title: Alignment as Institutional Design: From Behavioral Correction to Transaction Structure in Intelligent Systems
comment: This is Paper 5 in a 10-paper series on Super-Alignment via Wuxing Institutional Architecture. It shifts alignment from external behavioral correction to internal institutional design, making aligned behavior the lowest-cost equilibrium
summary:
Current AI alignment paradigms rely on behavioral correction: external supervisors (e.g., RLHF) observe outputs, judge against preferences, and adjust parameters. This paper argues that behavioral correction is structurally analogous to an economy without property rights, where order requires perpetual policing and does not scale.
