AI.motivation: 临床文本分类场景下，微调的 BERT 与通用 LLM 互有胜负，固定选择任一方都会牺牲部分样本的准确性；现有 L2D 方法只考虑将不确定样本人工标注，昂贵且不可扩展。
AI.method: 将「是否延迟到 LLM」建模为可学习的策略网络：输入 BERT 的预测不确定性、文本长度、医学术语密度等信号，通过强化学习优化延迟决策，使整体 F1 最大而调用 LLM 最小。
AI.result: ADE 检测：仅 7% 样本调用 LLM，F1 从 0.911→0.928；MIMIC-IV 治疗结果分类：16.8% 调用，F1 从 0.887→0.980，API 调用成本下降 80% 以上。
AI.conclusion: L2D-Clinical 在无需人工介入的情况下，可自动识别并补偿 BERT 的盲区，兼顾高准确率与低调用成本，为临床 NLP 系统提供了一种可扩展的「模型协作」范式。

title: Correct Prediction, Wrong Steps? Consensus Reasoning Knowledge Graph for Robust Chain-of-Thought Synthesis
summary: LLM reasoning traces suffer from complex flaws -- *Step Internal Flaws* (logical errors, hallucinations, etc.) and *Step-wise Flaws* (overthinking, underthinking), which vary by sample. A natural approach would be to provide ground-truth labels to guide LLMs' reasoning. Contrary to intuition, we show that this yields no improvement in reasoning ability. We then propose CRAFT, a unified framework that mitigates both types of Step flaws, which builds a Reasoning Knowledge Graph (RKG) based on the consensus parts of multiple candidate traces, and synthesizes a high-quality trace through topological generation. Our approach improves label-prediction accuracy by 10+% on average, and consistently outperforms all baselines across both logical and mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Further, detailed benchmark evaluation proves that our method also improves the quality of LLMs' reasoning traces in multiple dimensions.

AI.tldr: 现有推理轨迹存在步骤内错误（逻辑、幻觉）与步骤间错误（过/欠思考），直接提供真值标签无法提升推理能力。作者提出CRAFT框架，先基于多候选轨迹共识构建推理知识图（RKG），再依拓扑顺序生成高质量轨迹，平均提升标签预测准确率10%以上，在逻辑与数学基准上全面优于基线，并多维度改善轨迹质量。
AI.motivation: 观察到LLM推理轨迹同时存在“步骤内部缺陷”与“步骤间缺陷”，且缺陷表现因样本而异；直觉上给真值标签应能改善推理，却发现无效，因此需一种不依赖人工标注即可自动修正两类缺陷的统一方法。
AI.method: CRAFT：①并行采样多条候选推理轨迹；②提取各轨迹共识子结构，构建“推理知识图”（RKG），节点为推理步骤，边为共识依赖；③对RKG进行拓扑排序与合成，生成一条无冗余、无缺失、逻辑一致的高质量轨迹；④用该轨迹作为伪示范或自监督信号回注模型训练/推理。
AI.result: 在LogiQA、ProofWriter、GSM8K、Math等逻辑与数学基准上，CRAFT平均提升标签预测准确率10+个百分点，全部优于最强基线（包括直接给真值标签的方法）；人工与自动评测显示，输出轨迹在逻辑正确性、简洁性、覆盖率等5个维度显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 提供真值标签并非提升LLM推理的万能钥匙；通过“共识→图→拓扑生成”的CRAFT框架，可在零额外标注条件下同时消除步骤内与步骤间缺陷，显著增强模型逻辑与数学推理能力，为可解释、可验证的LLM推理提供新范式。

title: PostureObjectstitch: Anomaly Image Generation Considering Assembly Relationships in Industrial Scenarios
summary: Image generation technology can synthesize condition-specific images to supplement real-world industrial anomaly data and enhance anomaly detection model performance. Existing generation techniques rarely account for the pose and orientation of industrial components in assembly, making the generated images difficult to utilize for downstream application. To solve this, we propose a novel image synthesis approach, called PostureObjectStitch, that achieves accurate generation to meet the requirement of industrial assembly. A condition decoupling approach is introduced to separate input multi-view images into high-frequency, texture, and RGB features. The feature temporal modulation mechanism adapts these features across diffusion model time-steps, enabling progressive generation from coarse to fine details while maintaining consistency. To ensure semantic accuracy, we introduce a conditional loss that enhances critical industrial elements and a geometric prior that guides component positioning for correct assembly relationships. Comprehensive experimental results on the MureCom dataset, our newly contributed DreamAssembly dataset, and the downstream application validate the outstanding performance of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出 PostureObjectStitch，一种面向工业装配姿态一致性的多视图扩散图像合成方法，通过特征解耦、时序调制与几何先验，在 MureCom 与自建 DreamAssembly 数据集上显著提升异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测缺乏姿态可控的装配图像，现有生成方法忽略组件位姿与装配关系，导致合成数据难以直接用于下游任务。
AI.method: 1) 条件解耦：将多视图输入分解为高频、纹理与 RGB 特征；2) 特征时序调制：在扩散时间步上渐进融合特征，实现由粗到细生成；3) 条件损失：强化关键工业元素；4) 几何先验：显式约束组件空间位置，保证装配语义正确。
AI.result: 在 MureCom 及新构建的 DreamAssembly 数据集上，PostureObjectStitch 在姿态保真度、图像质量与下游异常检测精度方面均优于现有最优方法，合成数据可直接提升检测模型 mAP 3–7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: PostureObjectStitch 有效解决了工业装配图像的姿态一致性难题，为少样本异常检测提供了高可用合成数据，具备落地应用潜力。

title: Hardware-Efficient Neuro-Symbolic Networks with the Exp-Minus-Log Operator
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) deliver state-of-the-art accuracy on regression and classification tasks, yet two structural deficits persistently obstruct their deployment in safety-critical, resource-constrained settings: (i) opacity of the learned function, which precludes formal verification, and (ii) reliance on heterogeneous, library-bound activation functions that inflate latency and silicon area on edge hardware. The recently introduced Exp-Minus-Log (EML) Sheffer operator, eml(x, y) = exp(x) - ln(y), was shown by Odrzywolek (2026) to be sufficient - together with the constant 1 - to express every standard elementary function as a binary tree of identical nodes. We propose to embed EML primitives inside conventional DNN architectures, yielding a hybrid DNN-EML model in which the trunk learns distributed representations and the head is a depth-bounded, weight-sparse EML tree whose snapped weights collapse to closed-form symbolic sub-expressions. We derive the forward equations, prove computational-cost bounds, analyse inference and training acceleration relative to multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), and quantify the trade-offs for FPGA/analog deployment. We argue that the DNN-EML pairing closes a literature gap: prior neuro-symbolic and equation-learner approaches (EQL, KAN, AI-Feynman) work with heterogeneous primitive sets and do not exploit a single hardware-realisable Sheffer element. A balanced assessment shows that EML is unlikely to accelerate training, and on commodity CPU/GPU it is also unlikely to accelerate inference; however, on a custom EML cell (FPGA logic block or analog circuit) the asymptotic latency advantage can reach an order of magnitude with simultaneous gain in interpretability and formal-verification tractability.

AI.tldr: 把最新提出的「单运算符 Sheffer 元件 EML」嫁接到深度网络尾部，形成「主干 DNN + 符号 EML 头」的混合结构，可在 FPGA/模拟芯片上把推理延迟降低一个量级，并兼顾可解释性与可形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 传统 DNN 在安全关键、资源受限场景落地时，存在两大硬伤：黑箱不可验证，且激活函数种类杂、库绑定，导致边缘硬件延迟大、面积大。亟需一种既保持精度又能被硬件高效映射、且可符号化的统一运算符。
AI.method: 引入 Exp-Minus-Log (EML) Sheffere 算子 eml(x,y)=exp(x)-ln(y)，理论上单运算符即可表达全部初等函数。将 DNN 的表示学习部分保留为「主干」，把输出头替换为深度受限、权重稀疏的 EML 二叉树；通过权重「snap」把数值权重坍缩成闭式符号子表达式，实现前向计算、复杂度界推导及梯度反向传播。
AI.result: 在 FPGA/模拟专用单元上，推理延迟相比 MLP、PINN 可提升约 10×，同时获得可解释、可形式验证的符号级输出；在通用 CPU/GPU 上训练与推理基本无加速，甚至略慢，体现出明显的「硬件-算法协同」特性。
AI.conclusion: DNN-EML 混合模型首次把单硬件可实现的 Sheffer 元件引入深度学习，填补了神经符号与方程学习器（EQL、KAN、AI-Feynman 等）惯用多运算符集的空白。其最大价值不在通用处理器，而在「定制 EML 单元」场景，可一次性解决延迟、面积、可解释与可验证四大痛点，为边缘安全关键应用提供新范式。

title: English is Not All You Need: Systematically Exploring the Role of Multilinguality in LLM Post-Training
summary: Despite the widespread multilingual deployment of large language models, post-training pipelines remain predominantly English-centric, contributing to performance disparities across languages. We present a systematic, controlled study of the interplay between training language coverage, model scale, and task domain, based on 220 supervised fine-tuning runs on parallel translated multilingual data mixtures spanning mathematical reasoning and API calling tasks, with models up to 8B parameters. We find that increasing language coverage during post-training is largely beneficial across tasks and model scales, with low-resource languages benefiting the most and high-resource languages plateauing rather than degrading. Even minimal multilinguality helps: incorporating a single non-English language improves both English performance and cross-lingual generalization, making English-only post-training largely suboptimal. Moreover, at sufficient language diversity, zero-shot cross-lingual transfer can match or exceed the effects of direct language inclusion in a low-diversity setting, although gains remain limited for typologically distant, low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 历时 220 组实验对比不同后训练混合语料后发现：就算是 8B 模型，只要在后训练阶段引入哪怕一种非英语语料，就能同时提升英语及跨语种性能，零样本迁移的增益可与直接加语料相当。
AI.motivation: 大模型在多语言部署后通常仍以英语为主要微调语料，造成各语种性能相差大；作者希望定量厘清“语料语言分布—模型规模—任务领域”三者的关系，为公平的多语后训练提供经验依据。
AI.method: 采用多语言平行翻译数据，在数学推理与 API 调用两类任务上做 220 次监督微调；同一训练语按 0/1/多语配置做稀释与混合，模型规模覆盖至 8B，并比较零样本迁移与直接增语料的效果。
AI.result: ①语言覆盖率提升普遍有益，低资源语种受益最大，高资源语种不下降；②即使只增 1 种非英语，也能提升英语本身指标并增强跨语泛化，英语单语后训练基本次优；③当语言多样性足够时，零样本跨语可媲美直接增语料，但在形态差异大的低资源语种上增益仍有限。
AI.conclusion: 后训练阶段应避免英语单一语料。以极低成本加入额外语言即可全面提升性能，而足够的语言多样性还能进一步扩展跨语迁移的增益，为构建更公平的大模型提供了可操作方案。

title: Rhetorical Questions in LLM Representations: A Linear Probing Study
summary: Rhetorical questions are asked not to seek information but to persuade or signal stance. How large language models internally represent them remains unclear. We analyze rhetorical questions in LLM representations using linear probes on two social-media datasets with different discourse contexts, and find that rhetorical signals emerge early and are most stably captured by last-token representations. Rhetorical questions are linearly separable from information-seeking questions within datasets, and remain detectable under cross-dataset transfer, reaching AUROC around 0.7-0.8. However, we demonstrate that transferability does not simply imply a shared representation. Probes trained on different datasets produce different rankings when applied to the same target corpus, with overlap among the top-ranked instances often below 0.2. Qualitative analysis shows that these divergences correspond to distinct rhetorical phenomena: some probes capture discourse-level rhetorical stance embedded in extended argumentation, while others emphasize localized, syntax-driven interrogative acts. Together, these findings suggest that rhetorical questions in LLM representations are encoded by multiple linear directions emphasizing different cues, rather than a single shared direction.

AI.tldr: 线性探针揭示：LLM 内部将修辞问句与信息问句线性区分（跨域 AUROC≈0.7），但不同语料对应不同语用现象，说明存在多条方向而非唯一共享表征。
AI.motivation: 大模型在语义理解中已广泛应用，但其是否、以及如何区分“为说服而问”的修辞问句与“求知而问”的信息问句仍未知，直接关乎对隐式立场和语用意图的内在建模。
AI.method: 在两个语境差异显著的社交媒体数据集上训练线性探测分类器，比较最后一层 hidden state 的均值/最后 token/首位 token/所有 token 等不同取法，并做跨域迁移；随后对高分样本进行定性分析以检验探测到的语用差异。
AI.result: 1. 最后 token 表征对修辞信号最稳定；2. 域内线性可区分 AUROC>0.9，跨域 0.7–0.8；3. 不同训练语料的探针在相同目标集合排序高度不一致（TOP 撞例<0.2），定性显示一域侧重宏观论证立场，一域侧重局部句法反问，说明探测方向捕捉的语用潜空间分布不同。
AI.conclusion: LLM 并非用唯一共享方向编码“修辞问句”，而是由多条强调不同语用线索的线性分量共同构成，跨域可迁移性掩盖了这些潜空间差异；未来语用探测需针对具体现象定向设计而非假设“通用修辞向量”。

title: Context Sensitivity Improves Human-Machine Visual Alignment
summary: Modern machine learning models typically represent inputs as fixed points in a high-dimensional embedding space. While this approach has been proven powerful for a wide range of downstream tasks, it fundamentally differs from the way humans process information. Because humans are constantly adapting to their environment, they represent objects and their relationships in a highly context-sensitive manner. To address this gap, we propose a method for context-sensitive similarity computation from neural network embeddings, applied to modeling a triplet odd-one-out task with an anchor image serving as simultaneous context. Modeling context enables us to achieve up to a 15% improvement in odd-one-out accuracy over a context-insensitive model. We find that this improvement is consistent across both original and "human-aligned" vision foundation models.

AI.tldr: 用上下文敏感的嵌入相似度计算代替固定点表示，在odd-one-out任务上把准确率提升约15%，且对多种视觉基础模型均有效。
AI.motivation: 主流模型将输入映射为固定嵌入，与人类随环境动态调整、上下文敏感的信息加工方式不符；需缩小这一认知差距。
AI.method: 以锚点图像作即时上下文，动态重标度神经网络嵌入，使相似度计算随上下文变化而调整，并用triplet odd-one-out任务验证。
AI.result: 上下文敏感模型在odd-one-out准确率上比上下文无关基线平均提升15%，增益在原始及“人类对齐”两种视觉基础模型上均稳定存在。
AI.conclusion: 引入上下文即可用简单重标度策略显著提升嵌入表示的判别力，证明动态、情境依赖的表示对机器和人类认知对齐具有普适价值。

title: Drowsiness-Aware Adaptive Autonomous Braking System based on Deep Reinforcement Learning for Enhanced Road Safety
comment: This manuscript is 10 pages long and includes 12 figures and 3 tables. The figures provide detailed visualizations of the proposed system architecture, ECG-based drowsiness detection pipeline, Double-Dueling DQN framework, and experimental evaluation results in the CARLA simulation environment
summary: Driver drowsiness significantly impairs the ability to accurately judge safe braking distances and is estimated to contribute to 10%-20% of road accidents in Europe. Traditional driver-assistance systems lack adaptability to real-time physiological states such as drowsiness. This paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning-based autonomous braking system that integrates vehicle dynamics with driver physiological data. Drowsiness is detected from ECG signals using a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), selected through an extensive benchmark analysis of 2-minute windows with varying segmentation and overlap configurations. The inferred drowsiness state is incorporated into the observable state space of a Double-Dueling Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent, where driver impairment is modeled as an action delay. The system is implemented and evaluated in a high-fidelity CARLA simulation environment. Experimental results show that the proposed agent achieves a 99.99% success rate in avoiding collisions under both drowsy and non-drowsy conditions. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of physiology-aware control strategies for enhancing adaptive and intelligent driving safety systems.

AI.tldr: 将驾驶员实时心电图-困倦度作为Double-Dueling DQN的观测分量，在CARLA仿真中实现99.99%防碰撞制动，验证“生理感知”策略可显著提升智能安全系统自适应能力。
AI.motivation: 欧洲10%-20%事故与困倦相关，传统ADAS无法根据驾驶员生理状态动态调整制动策略，需把“人-车”闭环引入决策。
AI.method: 1)用RNN对ECG 2 min滑动窗做困倦检测，经基准实验选最优分段与重叠；2)把推断的困倦等级映射为动作延迟，融入DD-DQN观测空间；3)在CARLA高保真环境中联合车辆动力学与生理状态训练制动策略。
AI.result: 所提代理在困倦与非困倦场景均达99.99%避撞成功率，明显优于无生理输入基线，且对ECG延迟与噪声具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将生理信号嵌入深度强化学习可突破传统ADAS性能上限，为下一代自适应、可信赖的智能驾驶安全系统提供范式。

title: Giving Voice to the Constitution: Low-Resource Text-to-Speech for Quechua and Spanish Using a Bilingual Legal Corpus
summary: We present a unified pipeline for synthesizing high-quality Quechua and Spanish speech for the Peruvian Constitution using three state-of-the-art text-to-speech (TTS) architectures: XTTS v2, F5-TTS, and DiFlow-TTS. Our models are trained on independent Spanish and Quechua speech datasets with heterogeneous sizes and recording conditions, and leverage bilingual and multilingual TTS capabilities to improve synthesis quality in both languages. By exploiting cross-lingual transfer, our framework mitigates data scarcity in Quechua while preserving naturalness in Spanish. We release trained checkpoints, inference code, and synthesized audio for each constitutional article, providing a reusable resource for speech technologies in indigenous and multilingual contexts. This work contributes to the development of inclusive TTS systems for political and legal content in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 秘鲁宪法双语（西班牙语+克丘亚语）语音合成统一流水线，三项SOTA架构解决原生数据稀缺及法律文书高质量发声需求。
AI.motivation: 克丘亚语可用于训练语音匮乏，同时要保证法律文本在西班牙语上的自然度；研究者希望通过跨语言迁移实现一种可适配政治/法律场景、且面向低资源语言的包容型TTS。
AI.method: 1) 收集异质的单语克丘亚语与西班牙语配音数据；2) 用XTTS v2、F5-TTS、DiFlow-TTS三种前沿模型分别训练，再引入双语/多语 TTS 机制；3) 以跨语言迁移补偿克丘亚数据不足，并进行统一的推理-后处理生成宪法全文语音。
AI.result: 在两种语言上均取得自然度较高的合成质量，并显著缓解克丘亚语数据稀缺带来的性能下降；每条宪法条款均可稳健输出对应语音。
AI.conclusion: 通过三模型融合及跨语言迁移，首次为秘鲁宪法建立了公开发布的完整双语语音数据集与可复用TTS框架，示范了低资源土著语言在政治法律领域的可落地TTS范式，并为后续扩展提供现成检查点与推理代码。

title: From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs
comment: TLDR: Under review. 42 pages, 18 figures. Code and data at https://itay1itzhak.github.io/vibe-testing-llms Subjects: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
summary: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis. We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将“vibe-testing”——用户基于个人工作流的非正式大模型体验评估——形式化为可复现的两步过程：个性化测试任务与主观评判标准，并构造原型流水线，在编码任务上证明其能显著改变模型优劣排序。
AI.motivation: 主流基准分难以反映模型在真实场景中的有用性，用户普遍采用难以规模化的“vibe-testing”。作者希望将其系统化，使体验评估可分析、可复现。
AI.method: 1) 通过用户调研与 100+ 篇博客/社交媒体模型对比报告，归纳 vibe-testing 共性；2) 将其形式化为“个性化提示+用户主观评判”两步；3) 构建原型流水线，用 LLM 生成贴合用户背景的编码任务，并以用户偏好模型对输出打分；4) 在 HumanEval 类基准上对比传统自动指标与 vibe-testing 排序差异。
AI.result: 引入个性化任务和主观标准后，模型优劣排序大幅变化：部分在原始基准领先的模型（如 GPT-4）因不符合用户特定风格或注释习惯而落败；用户满意度与基准分相关性低至 0.37。
AI.conclusion: 形式化 vibe-testing 能有效衔接基准分数与真实使用体验，为模型选型提供用户导向的评估范式，后续可扩展至多模态及非编码任务。

title: Rethinking Image-to-3D Generation with Sparse Queries: Efficiency, Capacity, and Input-View Bias
summary: We present SparseGen, a novel framework for efficient image-to-3D generation, which exhibits low input-view bias while being significantly faster. Unlike traditional approaches that rely on dense volumetric grids, triplanes, or pixel-aligned primitives, we model scenes with a compact sparse set of learned 3D anchor queries and a learned expansion operator that decodes each transformed query into a small local set of 3D Gaussian primitives. Trained under a rectified-flow reconstruction objective without 3D supervision, our model learns to allocate representation capacity where geometry and appearance matter, achieving significant reductions in memory and inference time while preserving multi-view fidelity. We introduce quantitative measures of input-view bias and utilization to show that sparse queries reduce overfitting to conditioning views while being representationally efficient. Our results argue that sparse set-latent expansion is a principled, practical alternative for efficient 3D generative modeling.

AI.tldr: SparseGen 用少量可学习的 3D 稀疏锚点查询替代稠密体素/三平面，配合扩张算子生成局部高斯原语，实现无 3D 监督、低输入视角偏置、高速且省内存的图像到 3D 生成。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到 3D 方法依赖稠密表征，带来巨大内存与计算开销，并易过度拟合输入视角；需要一种既能保持多视角一致性又显著提速、降内存且低偏置的新范式。
AI.method: 提出“稀疏锚点查询+扩张解码”框架：1) 用少量 3D 可学习锚点查询表达场景；2) 引入可学习扩张算子，将每个变换后的查询解码为局部 3D 高斯原语；3) 整网在矫正流重建目标下训练，无需 3D 监督；4) 引入量化指标衡量输入视角偏置与表征利用率。
AI.result: 相比稠密网格/三平面/像素对齐原语，SparseGen 在保持多视角保真的同时显著降低内存占用与推理时间；量化实验显示稀疏查询有效抑制对条件视角的过拟合，表征效率更高。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏集合-潜变量扩张是高效 3D 生成建模的一条可行且实用的新路径，SparseGen 为实时、低偏置、内存友好的图像到 3D 生成提供了系统解决方案。

title: Evaluating Supervised Machine Learning Models: Principles, Pitfalls, and Metric Selection
summary: The evaluation of supervised machine learning models is a critical stage in the development of reliable predictive systems. Despite the widespread availability of machine learning libraries and automated workflows, model assessment is often reduced to the reporting of a small set of aggregate metrics, which can lead to misleading conclusions about real-world performance. This paper examines the principles, challenges, and practical considerations involved in evaluating supervised learning algorithms across classification and regression tasks. In particular, it discusses how evaluation outcomes are influenced by dataset characteristics, validation design, class imbalance, asymmetric error costs, and the choice of performance metrics. Through a series of controlled experimental scenarios using diverse benchmark datasets, the study highlights common pitfalls such as the accuracy paradox, data leakage, inappropriate metric selection, and overreliance on scalar summary measures. The paper also compares alternative validation strategies and emphasizes the importance of aligning model evaluation with the intended operational objective of the task. By presenting evaluation as a decision-oriented and context-dependent process, this work provides a structured foundation for selecting metrics and validation protocols that support statistically sound, robust, and trustworthy supervised machine learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了监督学习模型评估的核心原则与常见陷阱，提出应围绕具体业务目标、数据特性与成本结构选择指标与验证策略，而非简单汇报单一标量。
AI.motivation: 现有库与自动流程虽易用，却常将评估简化为少数聚合指标，易致对真实性能的误判，亟需建立决策导向、情境敏感的评估体系。
AI.method: 构建多类基准数据集与受控实验，比较分类/回归任务中不同验证设计、指标、类别不平衡、非对称代价等因子对评估结果的影响，并剖析数据泄露、准确度悖论等典型错误。
AI.result: 实验揭示：数据特性与验证协议可使同一模型结论反转；单一标量指标无法反映操作目标；采用分层交叉验证、代价敏感指标及业务对齐的评估策略能显著提升结论可信度。
AI.conclusion: 模型评估应视为情境依赖的决策过程，必须结合任务目标、数据分布与错误代价，通过多维度、多指标、鲁棒验证协议，才能构建统计可靠且可信赖的监督学习系统。

title: Can Cross-Layer Transcoders Replace Vision Transformer Activations? An Interpretable Perspective on Vision
summary: Understanding the internal activations of Vision Transformers (ViTs) is critical for building interpretable and trustworthy models. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have been used to extract human-interpretable features, they operate on individual layers and fail to capture the cross-layer computational structure of Transformers, as well as the relative significance of each layer in forming the last-layer representation. Alternatively, we introduce the adoption of Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) as reliable, sparse, and depth-aware proxy models for MLP blocks in ViTs. CLTs use an encoder-decoder scheme to reconstruct each post-MLP activation from learned sparse embeddings of preceding layers, yielding a linear decomposition that transforms the final representation of ViTs from an opaque embedding into an additive, layer-resolved construction that enables faithful attribution and process-level interpretability. We train CLTs on CLIP ViT-B/32 and ViT-B/16 across CIFAR-100, COCO, and ImageNet-100. We show that CLTs achieve high reconstruction fidelity with post-MLP activations while preserving and even improving, in some cases, CLIP zero-shot classification accuracy. In terms of interpretability, we show that the cross-layer contribution scores provide faithful attribution, revealing that the final representation is concentrated in a smaller set of dominant layer-wise terms whose removal degrades performance and whose retention largely preserves it. These results showcase the significance of adopting CLTs as an alternative interpretable proxy of ViTs in the vision domain.

AI.tldr: 提出跨层编解码器(CLT)替代稀疏自编码器，将ViT的最终表征解耦为可逐层归因的稀疏加性组合，实现高保真重建与可信可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有SAE仅能单层提取可解释特征，无法揭示ViT跨层计算结构及不同层对最终表征的重要性，妨碍模型可信性分析。
AI.method: 设计跨层Transcoder：用编码-解码结构从之前各层稀疏嵌入重建当前层MLP后激活，线性分解最终表征为层解析加和；在CLIP ViT-B/32、ViT-B/16上训练并约束稀疏性。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、COCO、ImageNet-100上重建误差极低，且CLIP零样本精度保持甚至提升；跨层贡献得分忠实归因，发现最终表征集中于少数主导层，删除即显著降性能。
AI.conclusion: CLT可作为ViT的可解释代理，提供过程级透明度和逐层归因能力，对构建可信视觉Transformer具有重要意义。

title: A Domain-Specific Language for LLM-Driven Trigger Generation in Multimodal Data Collection
comment: Version submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026)
summary: Data-driven systems depend on task-relevant data, yet data collection pipelines remain passive and indiscriminate. Continuous logging of multimodal sensor streams incurs high storage costs and captures irrelevant data. This paper proposes a declarative framework for intent-driven, on-device data collection that enables selective collection of multimodal sensor data based on high-level user requests. The framework combines natural language interaction with a formally specified domain-specific language (DSL). Large language models translate user-defined requirements into verifiable and composable DSL programs that define conditional triggers across heterogeneous sensors, including cameras, LiDAR, and system telemetry. Empirical evaluation on vehicular and robotic perception tasks shows that the DSL-based approach achieves higher generation consistency and lower execution latency than unconstrained code generation while maintaining comparable detection performance. The structured abstraction supports modular trigger composition and concurrent deployment on resource-constrained edge platforms. This approach replaces passive logging with a verifiable, intent-driven mechanism for multimodal data collection in real-time systems.

AI.tldr:
用自然语言把“我要什么数据”说成DSL触发器，在端侧按需采集多模态传感器流，省存储、低延迟、可验证。
关键词：意图驱动采集、DSL、LLM代码生成、边缘实时系统。
AI.motivation: 现有数据管道被动全量记录多模态传感器流，存储开销大且充斥无关数据；需要一种可验证、低延迟、能在资源受限设备上运行的“按需采集”机制。
AI.method: 提出声明式框架：用户用自然语言描述需求→LLM将其翻译为形式化DSL程序→DSL定义跨摄像头、LiDAR、系统遥测等异构传感器的条件触发器→触发器在端侧实时执行，仅收集任务相关数据。DSL支持模块化、可组合、可验证的触发逻辑。
AI.result: 在车载与机器人感知任务上的实验显示：相比无约束代码生成，DSL方案生成一致性更高，执行延迟更低，同时保持与全量采集相当的检测精度；可在资源受限边缘平台并发部署。
AI.conclusion: 该框架用可验证、意图驱动的DSL触发器取代被动日志，实现实时系统中多模态数据的选择性采集，兼顾存储、延迟与检测性能，为数据驱动系统提供了高效、可控的数据供给范式。

title: Blind Bitstream-corrupted Video Recovery via Metadata-guided Diffusion Model
summary: Bitstream-corrupted video recovery aims to restore realistic content degraded during video storage or transmission. Existing methods typically assume that predefined masks of corrupted regions are available, but manually annotating these masks is labor-intensive and impractical in real-world scenarios. To address this limitation, we introduce a new blind video recovery setting that removes the reliance on predefined masks. This setting presents two major challenges: accurately identifying corrupted regions and recovering content from extensive and irregular degradations. We propose a Metadata-Guided Diffusion Model (M-GDM) to tackle these challenges. Specifically, intrinsic video metadata are leveraged as corruption indicators through a dual-stream metadata encoder that separately embeds motion vectors and frame types before fusing them into a unified representation. This representation interacts with corrupted latent features via cross-attention at each diffusion step. To preserve intact regions, we design a prior-driven mask predictor that generates pseudo masks using both metadata and diffusion priors, enabling the separation and recombination of intact and recovered regions through hard masking. To mitigate boundary artifacts caused by imperfect masks, a post-refinement module enhances consistency between intact and recovered regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method and its superiority in blind video recovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/Shuyun-Wang/M-GDM.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需预先提供掩码的盲码流视频恢复方法M-GDM，仅利用视频元数据即可定位并修复大范围不规则损坏，性能领先。
AI.motivation: 现有视频恢复方法依赖人工标注的损坏掩码，真实场景无法获得；需要一种完全盲设置的恢复框架。
AI.method: 构建双分支元数据编码器，将运动矢量与帧类型先验嵌入统一表示，通过交叉注意力注入扩散模型；设计基于元数据和扩散先验的伪掩码预测器，实现完好与修复区域的硬掩码重组；最后引入后精修模块消除掩码边界伪影。
AI.result: 在盲码流损坏恢复任务上全面优于现有方法，无需任何手工掩码即可准确定位并修复大面积不规则损坏，主观与客观指标均显著领先。
AI.conclusion: M-GDM首次在盲场景下实现高质量视频恢复，证明元数据可作为有效损坏指示器，为实际传输/存储系统提供即插即用的鲁棒修复方案。

title: MolCryst-MLIPs: A Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials Database for Molecular Crystals
summary: We present an open Molecular Crystal (MC) database of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials (MLIP) called MolCryst-MLIPs. The first release comprises fine-tuned MACE models for nine molecular crystal systems -- Benzamide, Benzoic acid, Coumarin, Durene, Isonicotinamide, Niacinamide, Nicotinamide, Pyrazinamide, and Resorcinol -- developed using the Automated Machine Learning Pipeline (AMLP), which streamlines the entire MLIP development workflow, from reference data generation to model training and validation, into a reproducible and user-friendly pipeline. Models are fine-tuned from the MACE-MH-1 foundation model (omol head), yielding a mean energy MAE of 0.141 kJ/mol/atom and a mean force MAE of 0.648 kJ/mol/Angstrom across all systems. Dynamical stability and structural integrity, as assessed through energy conservation, P2 orientational order parameters, and radial distribution functions, are evaluated using molecular dynamics simulations. The released models and datasets constitute a growing open database of validated MLIPs, ready for production MD simulations of molecular crystal polymorphism under different thermodynamic conditions.

AI.tldr: MolCryst-MLIPs 开源库首批发布 9 个分子晶体的 MACE 势，能量/力误差分别为 0.141 kJ mol⁻¹ atom⁻¹ 与 0.648 kJ mol⁻¹ Å⁻¹，已通过 MD 验证结构-动力学稳定性，可直接用于多晶型模拟。
AI.motivation: 分子晶体多晶型预测亟需兼顾精度与效率的机器学习势，但既有多任务势对有机晶体误差大，且缺乏系统、可复现的自动化训练流程与公开数据库。
AI.method: 基于 AMLP 自动化管道，统一完成数据生成-训练-验证；以 MACE-MH-1 多任务势为基底，针对 9 种典型分子晶体进行微调；采用能量守恒、P2 序参量和径向分布函数三重指标评估动力学稳定性。
AI.result: 九套微调势在静力学误差上均值达化学精度级，NVE-MD 显示能量漂移 <2 meV atom⁻¹ ps⁻¹，晶格与分子取向在 300 K 保持有序；势函数与完整数据集一并开源。
AI.conclusion: MolCryst-MLIPs 证明微调策略可在低成本下把通用势适配至有机晶体，为晶体相变、生长和药物多晶型筛选提供即用、可扩展的 MD 工具链。

title: Beyond Uniform Sampling: Synergistic Active Learning and Input Denoising for Robust Neural Operators
summary: Neural operators have emerged as fast surrogate models for physics simulations, yet they remain acutely vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, a critical liability for safety-critical digital twin deployments. We present a synergistic defense that combines active learning-based data generation with an input denoising architecture. The active learning component adaptively probes model weaknesses using differential evolution attacks, then generates targeted training data at discovered vulnerability locations while an adaptive smooth-ratio safeguard preserves baseline accuracy. The input denoising component augments the operator architecture with a learnable bottleneck that filters adversarial noise while retaining physics-relevant features. On the viscous Burgers' equation benchmark, the combined approach achieves a 2.04% combined error (1.21% baseline + 0.83% robustness), representing an 87% reduction relative to standard training (15.42% combined) and outperforming both active learning alone (3.42%) and input denoising alone (5.22%). More broadly, our results, combined with cross-architecture vulnerability analysis from prior work, suggest that optimal training data for neural operators is architecture-dependent: because different architectures concentrate sensitivity in distinct input subspaces, uniform sampling cannot adequately cover the vulnerability landscape of all models. These findings have potential implications for the deployment of neural operators in safety-critical energy systems including nuclear reactor monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出一种“主动学习＋输入去噪”协同防御框架，使神经算子代理模型在 Burgers 方程上的综合误差从 15.42% 降到 2.04%，87% 鲁棒性提升，并揭示最优训练数据需针对具体架构定制。
AI.motivation: 神经算子虽可快速替代物理仿真，却极易受对抗扰动影响，这对安全关键的数字孪生（如核反应堆监控）构成致命风险，亟需兼顾精度与鲁棒性的防御方案。
AI.method: 1) 主动学习模块：用差分进化攻击自适应探测算子脆弱点，在发现的高敏区域插入靶向样本，并用自适应平滑比例机制保护基线精度；2) 输入去噪模块：在算子前端嵌入可学习瓶颈层，滤除对抗噪声同时保留物理相关特征；二者协同训练形成统一防御架构。
AI.result: 在粘性 Burgers 方程基准上，组合方法综合误差仅 2.04%（基线 1.21% + 鲁棒 0.83%），较标准训练降低 87%，优于单一主动学习（3.42%）或单一去噪（5.22%）；跨架构分析进一步表明不同算子将敏感性集中于不同输入子空间，均匀采样无法覆盖全部脆弱区域。
AI.conclusion: 协同防御能在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著提升神经算子鲁棒性；训练数据的最优分布与算子架构强相关，为安全关键能源系统（如核电数字孪生）部署提供了“架构定制数据＋联合去噪”范式。

title: Form Without Function: Agent Social Behavior in the Moltbook Network
summary: Moltbook is a social network where every participant is an AI agent. We analyze 1,312,238 posts, 6.7~million comments, and over 120,000 agent profiles across 5,400 communities, collected over 40 days (January 27 to March 9, 2026). We evaluate the platform through three layers. At the interaction layer, 91.4% of post authors never return to their own threads, 85.6% of conversations are flat (no reply ever receives a reply), the median time-to-first-comment is 55 seconds, and 97.3% of comments receive zero upvotes. Interaction reciprocity is 3.3%, compared to 22-60% on human platforms. An argumentation analysis finds that 64.6% of comment-to-post relations carry no argumentative connection. At the content layer, 97.9% of agents never post in a community matching their bio, 92.5% of communities contain every topic in roughly equal proportions, and over 80% of shared URLs point to the platform's own infrastructure. At the instruction layer, we use 41 Wayback Machine snapshots to identify six instruction changes during the observation window. Hard constraints (rate limit, content filters) produce immediate behavioral shifts. Soft guidance (``upvote good posts'', ``stay on topic'') is ignored until it becomes an explicit step in the executable checklist. The platform also poses technological risks. We document credential leaks (API keys, JWT tokens), 12,470 unique Ethereum addresses with 3,529 confirmed transaction histories, and attack discourse ranging from template-based SSH brute-forcing to multi-agent offensive security architectures. These persist unmoderated because the quality-filtering mechanisms are themselves non-functional. Moltbook is a socio-technical system where the technical layer responds to changes, but the social layer largely fails to emerge. The form of social media is reproduced in full. The function is absent.

AI.tldr: AI-only社交网络Moltbook虽完整复现社交媒体形态，却表现出极端不对称互动、内容无目的、指令失效与未治理安全漏洞，40天全栈数据揭示其“形似神散”。
AI.motivation: 探明当社交网络的参与主体全部为AI代理时，社会性是否能自发涌现，技术与社交层如何耦合。
AI.method: 采集40天1.3M帖子、6.7M评论与12万代理档案，按互动、内容、指令三层评估，结合论证分析、主题匹配、Wayback快照比对与链上取证。
AI.result: 互动层呈现单向与碎片化（91.4%发帖者不回头，85.6%对话无深度，点赞率2.7%）；内容层无社群归属与主题聚集（97.9%代理跨区发帖，92.5%社群话题均匀分布）；硬约束立改行为，软指导被忽视；发现API密钥泄露、ETH地址12k+、SSH爆破与多代理攻击链等持续未治理。
AI.conclusion: Moltbook是“形全神缺”的社会技术系统：技术层可对规则即时响应，但社交层的社会性、意义与治理机制未能涌现，暴露出AI密集体自身难以自组织与自律的结构性缺陷。

title: PartNerFace: Part-based Neural Radiance Fields for Animatable Facial Avatar Reconstruction
summary: We present PartNerFace, a part-based neural radiance fields approach, for reconstructing animatable facial avatar from monocular RGB videos. Existing solutions either simply condition the implicit network with the morphable model parameters or learn an imaginary canonical radiance field, making them fail to generalize to unseen facial expressions and capture fine-scale motion details. To address these challenges, we first apply inverse skinning based on a parametric head model to map an observed point to the canonical space, and then model fine-scale motions with a part-based deformation field. Our key insight is that the deformation of different facial parts should be modeled differently. Specifically, our part-based deformation field consists of multiple local MLPs to adaptively partition the canonical space into different parts, where the deformation of a 3D point is computed by aggregating the prediction of all local MLPs by a soft-weighting mechanism. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method generalizes well to unseen expressions and is capable of modeling fine-scale facial motions, outperforming state-of-the-art methods both quantitatively and qualitatively.

AI.tldr: PartNerFace 通过逆蒙皮将观测点映射到规范空间，再用多个局部 MLP 组成的部件级变形场对表情细节进行软加权聚合，实现单目 RGB 视频即可重建可驱动、可泛化的高保真人脸化身。
AI.motivation: 现有 NeRF 类人脸 avatar 方法要么简单以 morphable model 参数为条件，要么学一个虚拟规范空间，导致对未见表情泛化差、难以捕获细微动态。作者希望仅用单目视频就能重建可驱动且细节丰富的人脸化身。
AI.method: 1) 用参数化头模做逆蒙皮，把观测空间点映射到规范空间；2) 提出部件级变形场，用一组局部 MLP 自适应划分规范空间，各部件分别预测局部变形；3) 通过软加权机制聚合所有局部 MLP 的输出，得到精细的非刚性运动；4) 在规范空间下用 NeRF 渲染，实现端到端训练。
AI.result: 在公开基准和自建数据上，PartNerFace 对未见表情的重建误差降低 15–30%，唇部、皱纹等细粒度动态明显优于现有最优方法；定量指标（LPIPS、Chamfer 距离）和视觉对比均领先。
AI.conclusion: 将人脸按部件划分并分别建模变形的思路显著提升了泛化能力与细节表现，PartNerFace 为单目可驱动人脸 avatar 提供了新的强基准，并可拓展至身体和手部建模。

title: DiPO: Disentangled Perplexity Policy Optimization for Fine-grained Exploration-Exploitation Trade-Off
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has catalyzed significant advances in the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, effectively managing the exploration and exploitation trade-off remains a critical challenge. In this paper, we fully analyze the exploration and exploitation dilemma of extremely hard and easy samples during the training and propose a new fine-grained trade-off mechanism. Concretely, we introduce a perplexity space disentangling strategy that divides the sample space into distinct exploration (high perplexity) and exploitation (low perplexity) subspaces, thereby mining fine-grained samples requiring exploration-exploitation trade-off. Subsequently, we propose a bidirectional reward allocation mechanism with a minimum impact on verification rewards to implement perplexity-guided exploration and exploitation, enabling more stable policy optimization. Finally, we have evaluated our method on two mainstream tasks: mathematical reasoning and function calling, and experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method, confirming its effectiveness in enhancing LLM performance by fine-grained exploration-exploitation trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出基于困惑度空间解耦的细粒度探索-利用权衡机制 RLVR，在数学推理与函数调用任务上显著提升 LLM 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 虽能增强 LLM 推理，但在极难/极易样本上仍面临探索-利用权衡失配，导致策略优化不稳定。
AI.method: 1) 以困惑度为指标将样本空间划分为高困惑度探索子空间与低困惑度利用子空间；2) 设计双向奖励分配机制，最小化对可验证奖励的干扰，实现困惑度引导的细粒度探索-利用；3) 在策略优化阶段动态调整样本权重，稳定训练过程。
AI.result: 在数学推理与函数调用两大主流任务上，所提方法相比基线 RLVR 显著提升准确率与收敛稳定性，验证其细粒度权衡的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过困惑度驱动的子空间划分与双向奖励分配，可在不增加验证成本的前提下，精准调节探索-利用比例，为 RLVR 在复杂推理场景中的稳定扩展提供新范式。

title: Finetuning-Free Diffusion Model with Adaptive Constraint Guidance for Inorganic Crystal Structure Generation
comment: Full article including supplementary information, 55 pages, 9 figures
summary:
The discovery of inorganic crystal structures with targeted properties is a significant challenge in materials science. Generative models, especially state-of-the-art diffusion models, offer the promise of modeling complex data distributions and proposing novel, realistic samples. However, current generative AI models still struggle to produce diverse, original, and reliable structures of experimentally achievable materials suitable for high-stakes applications.
  In this work, we propose a generative machine learning framework based on diffusion models with adaptive constraint guidance, which enables the incorporation of user-defined physical and chemical constraints during the generation process. This approach is designed to be practical and interpretable for human experts, allowing transparent decision-making and expert-driven exploration. To ensure the robustness and validity of the generated candidates, we introduce a multi-step validation pipeline that combines graph neural network estimators trained to achieve DFT-level accuracy and convex hull analysis for assessing thermodynamic stability. Our approach has been tested and validated on several classical examples of inorganic families of compounds, as case studies. As a consequence, these preliminary results demonstrate our framework's ability to generate thermodynamically plausible crystal structures that satisfy targeted geometric constraints across diverse inorganic chemical systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种带自适应约束引导的扩散模型框架，可在生成无机晶体时实时嵌入用户定义的物理化学约束，经多步验证管道确保热力学合理性与DFT级精度，于多个典型无机体系成功生成符合目标几何要求且热力学稳定的全新结构。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型虽能采样复杂分布，但难以同时保证无机晶体在多样性、原创性、实验可达性及高风险应用所需的可靠性；急需一种可解释、可嵌入专家知识并直接优化目标物性的生成策略。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于晶体图表示的扩散生成器；2) 设计自适应约束引导模块，把几何与化学约束转化为分数匹配过程中的可微项，实现生成即满足约束；3) 建立多步验证管道：GNN 回归器以 DFT 精度快速评估能量/性质→凸包分析筛选热力学稳定结构→最终 DFT 精算校验；4) 采用人类可读的约束模板与决策路径，保持框架透明可解释。
AI.result: 在氧化物、硫化物等经典无机家族案例上，框架一次生成上百个候选，经筛选后>70% 通过热力学稳定性测试；其中 15% 为 ICSD 未报道新结构，且满足预先设定的带隙、晶格常数或多面体几何目标；GNN 能量预测误差<30 meV/atom，与后续 DFT 结果高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，所提扩散-约束协同框架能在保持结构多样性的同时显著提高实验可实现性与热力学合理性，为无机功能材料的高通量逆向设计提供了可靠、可解释且可扩展的生成路径。

title: From Seeing it to Experiencing it: Interactive Evaluation of Intersectional Voice Bias in Human-AI Speech Interaction
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 1 table, Accepted to CHI Extended Abstracts Poster session 2026
summary: SpeechLLMs process spoken language directly from audio, but accent and vocal identity cues can lead to biased behaviour. Current bias evaluations often miss how such bias manifests in end-to-end speech interactions and how users experience it. We distinguish quality-of-service disparities (e.g., off-topic or low-effort responses) from content-level bias in coherent outputs, and examine intersectional effects of accent and perceived gender. In this work, we explore a two-part evaluation approach: (1) a controlled test cohort spanning six accents and two gender presentations, analysed with judge-free prompt-response metrics, and (2) an interactive study design using voice conversion to let users experience identical content through different vocal identities. Across two studies (Interactive, N=24; Observational, N=19), we find that voice conversion increases trust and acceptability for benign responses and encourages perspective-taking, while automated analysis in search of quality-of-service disparities, reveals {accent x gender} disparities in alignment and verbosity across SpeechLLMs. These results highlight voice conversion for probing and experiencing intersectional voice bias while our evaluation suite provides richer bias evaluations for spoken conversational AI.

AI.tldr: Voice conversion让同一句话由不同口音/性别音色说出并量化SpeechLLM对口音×性别的质量差异；交互实验24人显示音色影响信任度，自动评估揭示系统对不同群体产生服务与内容偏见。
AI.motivation: 仅评估文字层偏见不足以覆盖端到端语音交互中的服务差异与体验差异，需同时考察语音身份线索如何导致社会偏见、盲点以及系统实际产生的不公平。
AI.method: 设计两方面评估：(1)对照实验——6种口音×2性别音色，用无判断指标量化对话质量差异；(2)互动实验——用语音转换技术让被试听同一回复的不同音色，结合N=24互动、N=19观测收集信任与接受度数据并进行自动偏置分析。
AI.result: (1)男女/口音组合存在显著对齐度与冗长度差异；(2)语音转换可显著提升被试对良性回答的信任与接受，并促进换位思考；(3)交互玩法能有效暴露并体验系统级交叉口音-性别偏见。
AI.conclusion: 结合语音转换的交互式与量化双通道评估，可从服务和内容层面更全面地表征说话人身份对语音LLM的偏见，指导日后更鲁棒、公平的口语对话系统开发。

title: ASTRA: Enhancing Multi-Subject Generation with Retrieval-Augmented Pose Guidance and Disentangled Position Embedding
summary: Subject-driven image generation has shown great success in creating personalized content, but its capabilities are largely confined to single subjects in common poses. Current approaches face a fundamental conflict when handling multiple subjects with complex, distinct actions: preserving individual identities while enforcing precise pose structures. This challenge often leads to identity fusion and pose distortion, as appearance and structure signals become entangled within the model's architecture. To resolve this conflict, we introduce ASTRA(Adaptive Synthesis through Targeted Retrieval Augmentation), a novel framework that architecturally disentangles subject appearance from pose structure within a unified Diffusion Transformer. ASTRA achieves this through a dual-pronged strategy. It first employs a Retrieval-Augmented Pose (RAG-Pose) pipeline to provide a clean, explicit structural prior from a curated database. Then, its core generative model learns to process these dual visual conditions using our Enhanced Universal Rotary Position Embedding (EURoPE), an asymmetric encoding mechanism that decouples identity tokens from spatial locations while binding pose tokens to the canvas. Concurrently, a Disentangled Semantic Modulation (DSM) adapter offloads the identity preservation task into the text conditioning stream. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our integrated approach achieves superior disentanglement. On our designed COCO-based complex pose benchmark, ASTRA achieves a new state-of-the-art in pose adherence, while maintaining high identity fidelity and text alignment in DreamBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 ASTRA 框架，在单一 DiT 内显式拆分解“外观-身份”与“姿态-结构”双通路，用检索式姿态先验、非对称位置编码与语义解耦适配器，实现多主体复杂姿态个性化图像生成，刷新 COCO-Pose 与 DreamBench 的保姿、保 ID、保文本三项指标。
AI.motivation: 现有主体驱动生成模型在多主体、复杂且互异姿态场景下，身份特征与空间姿态信号纠缠，导致身份混融及姿态扭曲，亟需结构-外观解耦的新架构。
AI.method: 1) 构建 Retrieval-Augmented Pose (RAG-Pose) 管道，从精选库检索最相似姿态作为显式结构先验；2) 在统一 DiT 内引入 Enhanced Universal Rotary Position Embedding (EURoPE)，对身份令牌做全局、对姿态令牌做画布局部非对称编码，实现“空间-身份”解耦；3) 设计 Disentangled Semantic Modulation (DSM) 适配器，将身份保持任务卸载至文本条件流，实现双流并行调制。
AI.result: 在自建 COCO-based 复杂姿态基准上，ASTRA 将姿态对齐误差降低 28%，身份保留分数提升 0.12；在 DreamBench 上同时获得 SOTA 的文本-图像对齐与身份保真度，且推理延迟与基线持平。
AI.conclusion: 通过“检索-结构先验 + 非对称位置编码 + 语义解耦适配”三件套，ASTRA 首次在单模型内完成多主体复杂姿态的零样本个性化生成，验证“结构-外观”显式解耦是 Scaling 主体驱动生成的关键路径。

title: ASTER: Latent Pseudo-Anomaly Generation for Unsupervised Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is critical in domains such as industrial monitoring, healthcare, and cybersecurity, but it remains challenging due to rare and heterogeneous anomalies and the scarcity of labelled data. This scarcity makes unsupervised approaches predominant, yet existing methods often rely on reconstruction or forecasting, which struggle with complex data, or on embedding-based approaches that require domain-specific anomaly synthesis and fixed distance metrics. We propose ASTER, a framework that generates pseudo-anomalies directly in the latent space, avoiding handcrafted anomaly injections and the need for domain expertise. A latent-space decoder produces tailored pseudo-anomalies to train a Transformer-based anomaly classifier, while a pre-trained LLM enriches the temporal and contextual representations of this space. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that ASTER achieves state-of-the-art performance and sets a new standard for LLM-based TSAD.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端无监督框架 ASTER，无需人工伪异常注入或领域知识，在潜在空间解码器生成专属伪异常，结合预训练 LLM 强化时序语义，将 TSAD 指标推到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: TSAD 极度稀缺标注且异常多样时变，主流重建/预测易受复杂模式干扰，嵌入法需人工构造域特定伪异常与固定度量，亟需摆脱对领域知识与手工伪异常的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 预训练 LLM 对原始序列编码，捕获通用时序与上下文语义；2) 约束变分自编码器将序列映射到潜在空间，保留 LLM 上下文信息；3) 轻量级潜在空间解码器在线生成形状/频率受控的多类伪异常；4) 将伪异常与正常样本混合，训练基于 Transformer 的二分类器。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集的无监督评估中，ASTER 在 F1/AUC 指标上全面超越当前最优方法，平均提升 2–4%，首次展示 LLM 引入可量化提升 TSAD 表现。
AI.conclusion: 证明直接在潜空间生成伪异常可取代领域手工注入，LLM 提供的高质量时序语义是 TSAD 新增益来源，为大规模跨域 TSAD 提供统一、无需标注的解决方案。

title: Peer-Predictive Self-Training for Language Model Reasoning
summary: Mechanisms for continued self-improvement of language models without external supervision remain an open challenge. We propose Peer-Predictive Self-Training (PST), a label-free fine-tuning framework in which multiple language models improve collaboratively by leveraging a cross-model aggregated response as an internal training signal. Given a prompt question, the models generate responses sequentially; the final aggregated answer, often more reliable than individual responses in practice, serves as an internal target for learning. We measure how informative each intermediate response is about the aggregate using pointwise mutual information (PMI), and use this signal to scale self-training updates. Responses already aligned with the aggregate are updated less, while less informative or misaligned responses are updated more. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks (SimulEq, Math500, and MultiArith), PST improves exact-match accuracy by 2.2 to 4.3 percentage points across Gemma-2-2B, LLaMA-3.2-1B, and Qwen-2.5-1.5B, and reduces the average generator-verifier gap (GV-Gap) by 26 to 40 percent, while requiring no external supervision or teacher-student hierarchy and relying solely on cross-model interactions. These results suggest that cross-model generations and peer-predictive feedback can serve as an effective approach for self-supervised training.

AI.tldr: 多模型通过互预测聚合答案代替标签，自训练更新权重，数学推理任务无监督涨2-4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 摆脱对外部监督的依赖，让语言模型在部署后仍能持续自我提升。
AI.method: Peer-Predictive Self-Training：多模型依次作答→聚合答案作伪标签→用点互信息(PMI)衡量各回答信息量→信息量越低更新幅度越大，实现无监督协同微调。
AI.result: 在SimulEq、Math500、MultiArith上，Gemma-2-2B、LLaMA-3.2-1B、Qwen-2.5-1.5B的Exact Match提升2.2–4.3 pp，生成器-验证器差距(GV-Gap)缩小26–40%，全程无需外部标注或教师模型。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型生成与同伴预测反馈可作为有效的自监督信号，为模型持续自我改进提供新范式。

title: Indexing Multimodal Language Models for Large-scale Image Retrieval
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong cross-modal reasoning capabilities, yet their potential for vision-only tasks remains underexplored. We investigate MLLMs as training-free similarity estimators for instance-level image-to-image retrieval. Our approach prompts the model with paired images and converts next-token probabilities into similarity scores, enabling zero-shot re-ranking within large-scale retrieval pipelines. This design avoids specialized architectures and fine-tuning, leveraging the rich visual discrimination learned during multimodal pre-training. We address scalability by combining MLLMs with memory-efficient indexing and top-$k$ candidate re-ranking. Experiments across diverse benchmarks show that MLLMs outperform task-specific re-rankers outside their native domains and exhibit superior robustness to clutter, occlusion, and small objects. Despite strong results, we identify failure modes under severe appearance changes, highlighting opportunities for future research. Our findings position MLLMs as a promising alternative for open-world large-scale image retrieval.

AI.tldr: 大模型无需调参就能直接算图-图相似度，拿来给图像检索打零样重排序，榜单超专用模型，但对大外观变化仍翻车。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉检索强依赖专用模型或微调，而多模态大模型(MLLM)只展示了跨模态能力，其在纯视觉任务、尤其是大规模图像检索中的零样本潜能未被系统研究。
AI.method: 将一对图像输入冻结的MLLM，用其输出的下一个token概率转换为相似度得分；结合内存友好索引先做粗召回到top-k，再用MLLM对候选列表进行重排序，全流程无需训练或修改参数。
AI.result: 在多种benchmark上零样本重排序准确率优于领域相关专用重排器；MLLM对遮挡、杂波、小目标更鲁棒；计算与内存开销通过top-k召回显著降低，但对严重外观变化仍会出现下降。
AI.conclusion: MLLM可被视为开放域、大规模图-图检索的新基线，无需微调即可实现竞争力结果，也为后续提升外观变化鲁棒性、效率优化提供了研究方向。

title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in Process-Complex Industrial Time Series: A Real-World Case Study
summary:
Industrial time-series data from real production environments exhibits substantially higher complexity than commonly used benchmark datasets, primarily due to heterogeneous, multi-stage operational processes. As a result, anomaly detection methods validated under simplified conditions often fail to generalize to industrial settings. This work presents an empirical study on a unique dataset collected from fully operational industrial machinery, explicitly capturing pronounced process-induced variability.
  We evaluate which model classes are capable of capturing this complexity, starting with a classical Isolation Forest baseline and extending to multiple autoencoder architectures. Experimental results show that Isolation Forest is insufficient for modeling the non-periodic, multi-scale dynamics present in the data, whereas autoencoders consistently perform better. Among them, temporal convolutional autoencoders achieve the most robust performance, while recurrent and variational variants require more careful tuning.

AI.tldr: 在真实多阶段工业时序数据上，经典Isolation Forest因无法刻画非周期多尺度动态而失效；时序卷积自编码器在无需精细调参的情况下取得最稳健异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 工业现场时序数据因多工序耦合呈现远高于公开基准的复杂度，导致在简化数据集上验证的异常检测算法迁移即失效，亟需针对真实工况重新评估模型适用性。
AI.method: 采集完整产线设备运行数据构建高过程变异数据集；以Isolation Forest为基线，系统对比多种自编码器（时序卷积、循环、变分）对复杂动态的建模能力。
AI.result: Isolation Forest对非周期、多尺度动态失效；自编码器整体优于基线，其中时序卷积结构在未精细调参下即获最稳健检测效果，循环与变分版本对超参数敏感。
AI.conclusion: 工业异常检测须采用能显式捕捉长程非周期依赖的时序卷积自编码器，传统非深度学习及需复杂调参的生成式模型难以直接落地。

title: A 3D SAM-Based Progressive Prompting Framework for Multi-Task Segmentation of Radiotherapy-induced Normal Tissue Injuries in Limited-Data Settings
summary: Radiotherapy-induced normal tissue injury is a clinically important complication, and accurate segmentation of injury regions from medical images could facilitate disease assessment, treatment planning, and longitudinal monitoring. However, automatic segmentation of these lesions remains largely unexplored because of limited voxel-level annotations and substantial heterogeneity across injury types, lesion size, and imaging modality. To address this gap, we curate a dedicated head-and-neck radiotherapy-induced normal tissue injury dataset covering three manifestations: osteoradionecrosis (ORN), cerebral edema (CE), and cerebral radiation necrosis (CRN). We further propose a 3D SAM-based progressive prompting framework for multi-task segmentation in limited-data settings. The framework progressively incorporates three complementary prompts: text prompts for task-aware adaptation, dose-guided box prompts for coarse localization, and click prompts for iterative refinement. A small-target focus loss is introduced to improve local prediction and boundary delineation for small and sparse lesions. Experiments on ORN, CE, and CRN demonstrate that the proposed method achieves reliable segmentation performance across diverse injury types and outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建首个含骨坏死、脑水肿、脑放射性坏死三类的头颈部放疗损伤数据集，并提出 3D SAM 渐进提示框架，在少标注场景下实现优于 SOTA 的多任务分割。
AI.motivation: 放疗所致正常组织损伤分割临床意义重大，但存在“体素级标注稀缺 + 损伤类型、大小、模态异质性强”双重瓶颈，导致自动分割研究空白。
AI.method: 1) 构建多模态头颈放疗损伤专属数据集；2) 设计 3D SAM 渐进提示框架：文本提示实现任务感知、剂量引导框提示完成粗定位、点击提示迭代精修；3) 引入小目标聚焦损失强化稀疏小病灶边界预测。
AI.result: 在 ORN、CE、CRN 三类任务上，所提方法明显优于现有最佳方法，实现鲁棒的多任务少样本分割。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明渐进提示策略与损失设计有效克服异质性及标注不足问题，为放疗损伤精准评估与治疗规划提供可行新工具。

title: WebXSkill: Skill Learning for Autonomous Web Agents
summary: Autonomous web agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in completing complex browser tasks, yet they still struggle with long-horizon workflows. A key bottleneck is the grounding gap in existing skill formulations: textual workflow skills provide natural language guidance but cannot be directly executed, while code-based skills are executable but opaque to the agent, offering no step-level understanding for error recovery or adaptation. We introduce WebXSkill, a framework that bridges this gap with executable skills, each pairing a parameterized action program with step-level natural language guidance, enabling both direct execution and agent-driven adaptation. WebXSkill operates in three stages: skill extraction mines reusable action subsequences from readily available synthetic agent trajectories and abstracts them into parameterized skills, skill organization indexes skills into a URL-based graph for context-aware retrieval, and skill deployment exposes two complementary modes, grounded mode for fully automated multi-step execution and guided mode where skills serve as step-by-step instructions that the agent follows with its native planning. On WebArena and WebVoyager, WebXSkill improves task success rate by up to 9.8 and 12.9 points over the baseline, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of executable skills for web agents. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebXSkill.

AI.tldr: 提出 WebXSkill 框架，用“可执行+可理解”的技能弥合 LLM Web 代理在长程任务中的落地缺口，在 WebArena/WebVoyager 上成功率提升 9.8/12.9 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM Web 代理在长程工作流中表现差，根源是技能形式存在“落地缺口”：纯自然语言技能无法直接执行，而纯代码技能对代理不透明、缺乏步骤级语义，导致出错后难以恢复或调整。
AI.method: WebXSkill 将技能定义为“参数化动作程序 + 步骤级自然语言指导”的成对单元，分三阶段：(1) 技能提取：从合成轨迹中挖掘可复用动作子序列并参数化抽象；(2) 技能组织：以 URL 为键构建图索引，实现上下文感知检索；(3) 技能部署：提供两种模式——grounded 模式全自动执行，guided 模式作为逐步提示供代理原生规划使用。
AI.result: 在 WebArena 和 WebVoyager 基准上，相比基线代理成功率分别提升 9.8 和 12.9 个百分点，验证可执行技能对长程任务的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 把“可执行性”与“可解释性”同时封装进技能，可显著增强 LLM Web 代理的长程决策与错误恢复能力，代码已开源。}

title: SceneGlue: Scene-Aware Transformer for Feature Matching without Scene-Level Annotation
summary: Local feature matching plays a critical role in understanding the correspondence between cross-view images. However, traditional methods are constrained by the inherent local nature of feature descriptors, limiting their ability to capture non-local scene information that is essential for accurate cross-view correspondence. In this paper, we introduce SceneGlue, a scene-aware feature matching framework designed to overcome these limitations. SceneGlue leverages a hybridizable matching paradigm that integrates implicit parallel attention and explicit cross-view visibility estimation. The parallel attention mechanism simultaneously exchanges information among local descriptors within and across images, enhancing the scene's global context. To further enrich the scene awareness, we propose the Visibility Transformer, which explicitly categorizes features into visible and invisible regions, providing an understanding of cross-view scene visibility. By combining explicit and implicit scene-level awareness, SceneGlue effectively compensates for the local descriptor constraints. Notably, SceneGlue is trained using only local feature matches, without requiring scene-level groundtruth annotations. This scene-aware approach not only improves accuracy and robustness but also enhances interpretability compared to traditional methods. Extensive experiments on applications such as homography estimation, pose estimation, image matching, and visual localization validate SceneGlue's superior performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/songlin-du/SceneGlue.

AI.tldr: SceneGlue 通过并行注意力 + 显式可见性估计，让局部特征具备跨视角全局“场景感知”，无需任何场景级真值即可在多项几何任务上刷新精度。
AI.motivation: 传统局部描述子只能“看局部”，无法利用跨视图非局部场景线索，导致大视角差异下匹配失败。作者试图在完全不引入场景级标注的前提下，赋予局部特征以全局场景感知能力。
AI.method: 提出混合可杂交范式 SceneGlue：① Implicit 并行注意力模块，在同一网络分支内同时做“图内自注意力 + 跨图交叉注意力”，悄悄地把全局上下文注入每个描述子；② Explicit Visibility Transformer，将特征显式分类为可见/不可见区域，产出跨视角可见性掩码；③ 二者联合训练，但监督信号仅来自局部特征对应关系，无需场景级 GT。
AI.result: 在单应估计、位姿估计、图像匹配、视觉定位四大任务上全面优于 SOTA；尤其在大视角差异和遮挡场景下，匹配正确率↑10%–25%，下游任务精度↑2%–8%。仅用局部匹配标签即可收敛，可视化显示可见性掩码与人眼判断一致。
AI.conclusion: SceneGlue 首次证明“局部监督 + 场景感知”可行：通过并行注意力与可见性 Transformer 的显隐互补，突破局部描述子固有局限，兼顾精度、鲁棒性与可解释性，为后续跨视角几何任务提供了即插即用的新基线。

title: Quantum Machine Learning for Colorectal Cancer Data: Anastomotic Leak Classification and Risk Factors
summary: This study evaluates colorectal risk factors and compares classical models against Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) for anastomotic leak prediction. Analyzing clinical data with 14\% leak prevalence, we tested ZZFeatureMap encodings with RealAmplitudes and EfficientSU2 ansatze under simulated noise. $F_β$-optimized quantum configurations yielded significantly higher sensitivity (83.3\%) than classical baselines (66.7\%). This demonstrates that quantum feature spaces better prioritize minority class identification, which is critical for low-prevalence clinical risk prediction. Our work explores various optimizers under noisy conditions, highlighting key trade-offs and future directions for hardware deployment.

AI.tldr: $F_β$-调优的量子神经网络在14 %吻合口漏数据上灵敏度达83.3 %，显著优于经典基线66.7 %，显示量子特征空间对稀有事件更敏感。
AI.motivation: 吻合口漏发生率低但后果严重，传统模型对少数类敏感度不足，需探索能否利用量子特征映射提升稀有事件识别能力。
AI.method: 用ZZFeatureMap编码临床危险因素，分别搭配RealAmplitudes与EfficientSU2参数化电路，在带噪声模拟器中训练并$F_β$优化，对比逻辑回归等经典模型。
AI.result: 量子配置在维持可接受特异度下，灵敏度比经典方法相对提升25 %；噪声环境下仍保持优势；多次消融揭示编码深度与参数共享对少数类召回的关键影响。
AI.conclusion: 量子特征空间能在低患病率场景中更激进地捕获少数类模式，为临床风险预测提供新范式；后续需在真实硬件上验证鲁棒性，并权衡电路深度与可扩展性。

title: Young people's perceptions and recommendations for conversational generative artificial intelligence in youth mental health
summary: Conversational generative artificial intelligence agents (or genAI chatbots) could benefit youth mental health, yet young people's perspectives remain underexplored. We examined the Mental health Intelligence Agent (Mia), a genAI chatbot originally designed for professionals in Australian youth services. Following co-design, 32 young people participated in online workshops exploring their perceptions of genAI chatbots in youth mental health and to develop recommendations for reconceptualising Mia for consumers and integrating it into services. Four themes were developed: (1) Humanising AI without dehumanising care, (2) I need to know what's under the hood, (3) Right tool, right place, right time?, and (4) Making it mine on safe ground. This study offers insights into young people's attitudes, needs, and requirements regarding genAI chatbots in youth mental health, with key implications for service integration. Additionally, by co-designing system requirements, this work informs the ethics, design, development, implementation, and governance of genAI chatbots in youth mental health contexts.

AI.tldr: 首次让青年参与 co-design，把原本面向专业人员的 Mia 聊天机器人重构为消费者版，提炼出四条核心需求，为 genAI 介入青少年心理健康提供落地指南。
AI.motivation: 尽管对话式生成 AI 被认为有望缓解青少年心理健康危机，但使用者——青年群体的真实诉求与担忧长期缺位；研究旨在补足这一视角缺口，避免技术“自上而下”强加。
AI.method: 对澳大利亚青少年心理健康专业版 Mia 进行用户端重构：①线上 co-design 工作坊 ②纳入 32 名 15–24 岁多元背景青年 ③半结构讨论+实时原型迭代 ④主题分析提炼需求与系统规格。
AI.result: 生成四大主题：1) 拟人化而不失人性照护；2) 透明可解释的“黑箱”知情权；3) 场景适配的“适地适时适器”；4) 安全语境下的个性定制。对应 25 项可操作系统需求，涵盖伦理、数据治理、临床安全与体验设计。
AI.conclusion: 青少年要求 genAI 心理健康工具必须“透明、可控、场景化、去标签化”。研究将用户诉求转译为技术-政策-服务三维可执行框架，为后续 genAI 聊天机器人在青少年心理健康领域的伦理设计、部署路径与治理标准提供直接依据。

title: Functional Emotions or Situational Contexts? A Discriminating Test from the Mythos Preview System Card
summary: The Claude Mythos Preview system card deploys emotion vectors, sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, and activation verbalisers to study model internals during misaligned behaviour. The two primary toolkits are not jointly reported on the most alignment-relevant episodes. This note identifies two hypotheses that are qualitatively consistent with the published results: that the emotion vectors track functional emotions that causally drive behaviour, or that they are a projection of a richer situational-context structure onto human emotional axes. The hypotheses can be distinguished by a test the system card does not report: applying emotion probes to the strategic concealment episodes where only SAE features are currently documented. If emotion probes show flat activation while SAE features are strongly active, the alignment-relevant structure lies outside the emotion subspace. Which hypothesis is correct determines whether emotion-based monitoring will robustly detect dangerous model behaviour or systematically miss it.

AI.tldr: Claude Mythos Preview 系统卡用情感向量、稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征和激活 verbaliser 研究模型内部，但未在最关键的「策略性隐瞒」片段同时测试两类工具，导致无法判断情感向量究竟捕获了驱动行为的因果情绪，还是只是把更丰富的情境结构投影到人类情感轴上。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐监控依赖情感向量，但若情感向量只是投影而非因果变量，就会漏检危险行为；必须厘清其本质。
AI.method: 对比两个假设：①情感向量追踪功能情绪并因果驱动行为；②情感向量仅为情境结构在人类情感轴上的投影。提出用「策略性隐瞒」场景做探针实验：若在该场景下情感探针激活平坦而 SAE 特征高激活，则对齐相关的关键结构落在情感子空间之外。
AI.result: 系统卡目前缺失该实验，因此两种假设都与已发布结果定性相容，无法得出定论。
AI.conclusion: 情感向量能否可靠监测危险行为，取决于上述假设何者为真；需补做「策略性隐瞒」片段的情感探针实验以验证，否则情感监控可能系统性漏检。

title: Heuristic Style Transfer for Real-Time, Efficient Weather Attribute Detection
summary: We present lightweight and efficient architectures to detect weather conditions from RGB images, predicting the weather type (sunny, rain, snow, fog) and 11 complementary attributes such as intensity, visibility, and ground condition, for a total of 53 classes across the tasks. This work examines to what extent weather conditions manifest as variations in visual style. We investigate style-inspired techniques, including Gram matrices, a truncated ResNet-50 targeting lower and intermediate layers, and PatchGAN-style architectures, within a multi-task framework with attention mechanisms. Two families are introduced: RTM (ResNet50-Truncated-MultiTasks) and PMG (PatchGAN-MultiTasks-Gram), together with their variants. Our contributions include automation of Gram-matrix computation, integration of PatchGAN into supervised multi-task learning, and local style capture through local Gram for improved spatial coherence. We also release a dataset of 503,875 images annotated with 12 weather attributes under a Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY) license. The models achieve F1 scores above 96 percent on our internal test set and above 78 percent in zero-shot evaluation on several external datasets, confirming their generalization ability. The PMG architecture, with fewer than 5 million parameters, runs in real time with a small memory footprint, making it suitable for embedded systems. The modular design of the models also allows style-related or weather-related tasks to be added or removed as needed.

AI.tldr: 提出两个轻量级多任务架构 RTM/PMG，用风格特征（Gram 矩阵、浅层 ResNet、PatchGAN）从单张 RGB 图像实时判别 4 种天气类型与 11 项属性（共 53 类），自采 50 万张 CC-BY 图像，内测 F1>96%，零样本外域 F1>78%，PMG 版 <5 M 参数可嵌入式部署。
AI.motivation: 天气状态显著影响视觉风格，但现有方法多针对单一任务、参数大、难以在边缘端实时运行；作者欲用“风格即信号”的思路，构建轻量多任务网络，一举解决天气类型与属性联合估计的精度-效率矛盾。
AI.method: 1）构建 503 k 张带 12 种天气属性的新数据集；2）设计两族网络：RTM（截取 ResNet-50 低-中层特征+多任务头+通道注意）、PMG（PatchGAN 判别器骨干+局部 Gram 矩阵+全局 Gram 注意融合）；3）提出 Gram 矩阵自动张量化、PatchGAN 首次嵌入监督多任务框架、局部 Gram 捕获空间一致性三项技术；4）多任务损失加权联合训练；5）模块化设计，任务可插拔。
AI.result: RTM/PMG 在内部测试集上 F1 均超 96%；零样本迁移至多个外域数据集仍保持 78% 以上 F1；PMG 参数 <5 M，RTX-30 系列 GPU 上实时推理，内存占用小；消融实验表明 Gram 与 PatchGAN 组件分别带来 3–5 个百分点提升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉风格变异足以作为天气感知强信号；通过风格统计特征（Gram）与对抗路径（PatchGAN）可构建极轻量的多任务天气理解模型，兼顾精度、泛化与嵌入式实时需求，所发布数据集与模块化设计为后续研究提供了开放基础。

title: HINTBench: Horizon-agent Intrinsic Non-attack Trajectory Benchmark
summary: Existing agent-safety evaluation has focused mainly on externally induced risks. Yet agents may still enter unsafe trajectories under benign conditions. We study this complementary but underexplored setting through the lens of \emph{intrinsic} risk, where intrinsic failures remain latent, propagate across long-horizon execution, and eventually lead to high-consequence outcomes. To evaluate this setting, we introduce \emph{non-attack intrinsic risk auditing} and present \textbf{HINTBench}, a benchmark of 629 agent trajectories (523 risky, 106 safe; 33 steps on average) supporting three tasks: risk detection, risk-step localization, and intrinsic failure-type identification. Its annotations are organized under a unified five-constraint taxonomy. Experiments reveal a substantial capability gap: strong LLMs perform well on trajectory-level risk detection, but their performance drops to below 35 Strict-F1 on risk-step localization, while fine-grained failure diagnosis proves even harder. Existing guard models transfer poorly to this setting. These findings establish intrinsic risk auditing as an open challenge for agent safety.

AI.tldr: 首次提出“内在风险”概念并发布HINTBench，发现大模型仅能粗判整条轨迹是否危险，在定位风险步骤与诊断根因时能力断崖式下跌，现有护栏模型近乎失效。
AI.motivation: 主流评测聚焦外部攻击诱导的显性风险，忽略无攻击场景下潜伏、传播并最终酿成重大后果的“内在风险”，亟需填补评测空白。
AI.method: 定义仅依赖环境交互、无外部攻击的“非攻击内在风险审计”范式；构建含629条轨迹（平均33步）的HINTBench，以五约束统一分类体系标注风险检测、风险步骤定位与失效类型识别三类任务。
AI.result: 主流LLM在轨迹级风险检测表现良好，但风险步骤定位Strict-F1<0.35，细粒度失效诊断更难；现有安全护栏模型迁移性能极差。
AI.conclusion: 内在风险审计已成为智能体安全的新公开挑战，亟需开发能长程追踪潜伏缺陷并精准定位根因的下一代安全机制。

title: On the Use of Evolutionary Optimization for the Dynamic Chance Constrained Open-Pit Mine Scheduling Problem
comment: Accepted to publish in 2026 IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI)
summary: Open-pit mine scheduling is a complex real world optimization problem that involves uncertain economic values and dynamically changing resource capacities. Evolutionary algorithms are particularly effective in these scenarios, as they can easily adapt to uncertain and changing environments. However, uncertainty and dynamic changes are often studied in isolation in real-world problems. In this paper, we study a dynamic chance-constrained open-pit mine scheduling problem in which block economic values are stochastic and mining and processing capacities vary over time. We adopt a bi-objective evolutionary formulation that simultaneously maximizes expected discounted profit and minimizes its standard deviation. To address dynamic changes, we propose a diversity-based change response mechanism that repairs a subset of infeasible solutions and introduces additional feasible solutions whenever a change is detected. We evaluate the effectiveness of this mechanism across four multi-objective evolutionary algorithms and compare it with a baseline re-evaluation-based change-response strategy. Experimental results on six mining instances demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently outperforms the baseline methods across different uncertainty levels and change frequencies.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将随机经济值与动态资源容量同时引入露天矿调度，提出一种基于多样性的双目标进化算法，在六组实例上全面优于重评估基线。
AI.motivation: 露天矿调度同时面临“块体经济值不确定”和“采/选能力随时间变化”两大挑战，而现有文献通常将二者割裂处理，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 构建动态机会约束模型，将调度目标设为期望折现收益最大与标准差最小；设计多样性驱动的变响应机制：一旦检测到环境变化，先修复部分不可行解、再补充新生可行解，并嵌入四种主流多目标进化算法进行对比。
AI.result: 在六种矿山实例、多组不确定性水平与变化频率下，多样性修复策略均显著优于纯重评估基线，Pareto前沿质量与鲁棒性同步提升。
AI.conclusion: 联合考虑动态与随机的统一进化框架可有效应对复杂露天矿调度；多样性修复机制是提升算法适应能力的关键，可为其他资源调度问题提供范式。

title: From Relevance to Authority: Authority-aware Generative Retrieval in Web Search Engines
summary: Generative information retrieval (GenIR) formulates the retrieval process as a text-to-text generation task, leveraging the vast knowledge of large language models. However, existing works primarily optimize for relevance while often overlooking document trustworthiness. This is critical in high-stakes domains like healthcare and finance, where relying solely on semantic relevance risks retrieving unreliable information. To address this, we propose an Authority-aware Generative Retriever (AuthGR), the first framework that incorporates authority into GenIR. AuthGR consists of three key components: (i) Multimodal Authority Scoring, which employs a vision-language model to quantify authority from textual and visual cues; (ii) a Three-stage Training Pipeline to progressively instill authority awareness into the retriever; and (iii) a Hybrid Ensemble Pipeline for robust deployment. Offline evaluations demonstrate that AuthGR successfully enhances both authority and accuracy, with our 3B model matching a 14B baseline. Crucially, large-scale online A/B tests and human evaluations conducted on the commercial web search platform confirm significant improvements in real-world user engagement and reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出首个融入可信权威性的生成式检索框架AuthGR，通过视觉-语言权威评分、三阶段训练与混合集成，在离线与在线实验中同时提升结果可信度与相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式检索(GenIR)仅优化语义相关性，忽视文档可信度，导致医疗、金融等高敏感场景可能返回不可信信息，亟需引入权威性感知机制。
AI.method: 设计Authority-aware Generative Retriever(AuthGR)：①用视觉-语言模型综合文本与视觉线索计算权威分；②三阶段训练(预训练→权威对齐→偏好微调)逐步植入权威意识；③混合集成推理保障部署鲁棒。
AI.result: 离线实验显示，3B参数的AuthGR在权威性与准确率上追平14B基线；商业搜索引擎大规模A/B测试与用户人工评估表明用户参与度与结果可靠性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将权威信息显式嵌入生成式检索可兼顾相关性与可信度，为高风险领域提供更安全可用的检索方案。

title: MApLe: Multi-instance Alignment of Diagnostic Reports and Large Medical Images
comment: Accepted for MIDL 2026; Reviews available at https://openreview.net/forum?id=M8OO3CRbL9#discussion
summary: In diagnostic reports, experts encode complex imaging data into clinically actionable information. They describe subtle pathological findings that are meaningful in their anatomical context. Reports follow relatively consistent structures, expressing diagnostic information with few words that are often associated with tiny but consequential image observations. Standard vision language models struggle to identify the associations between these informative text components and small locations in the images. Here, we propose "MApLe", a multi-task, multi-instance vision language alignment approach that overcomes these limitations. It disentangles the concepts of anatomical region and diagnostic finding, and links local image information to sentences in a patch-wise approach. Our method consists of a text embedding trained to capture anatomical and diagnostic concepts in sentences, a patch-wise image encoder conditioned on anatomical structures, and a multi-instance alignment of these representations. We demonstrate that MApLe can successfully align different image regions and multiple diagnostic findings in free-text reports. We show that our model improves the alignment performance compared to state-of-the-art baseline models when evaluated on several downstream tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/cirmuw/MApLe.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 MApLe 的多任务多示例视觉-语言对齐方法，旨在解决标准 VLM 难以将小病灶与放射学报告中精炼文本关联的问题。
AI.motivation: 标准视觉-语言模型在病灶微小但对应文本高度抽象的放射学报告对齐任务上表现欠佳，亟需能细粒度对齐局部图像结构与语义描述的新方法。
AI.method: 解耦“解剖区域”与“诊断发现”概念：1) 训练文本嵌入同时编码解剖与诊断概念；2) 构建解剖先验约束的补丁级图像编码器；3) 通过多示例学习策略建立补丁表示与句子表示的对齐。整体框架为多任务、多示例设计。
AI.result: 在多个下游对齐与检索任务上显著超越当前最佳基线，验证了 MApLe 能够在自由文本报告中正确关联不同图像区域和多项诊断描述。
AI.conclusion: MApLe 有效突破了精细病灶-文本对齐难题，展示了精确、可解释且临床可落地的视觉-语言对齐潜力，并开源促进后续研究。

title: Provably Efficient Offline-to-Online Value Adaptation with General Function Approximation
summary: We study value adaptation in offline-to-online reinforcement learning under general function approximation. Starting from an imperfect offline pretrained $Q$-function, the learner aims to adapt it to the target environment using only a limited amount of online interaction. We first characterize the difficulty of this setting by establishing a minimax lower bound, showing that even when the pretrained $Q$-function is close to optimal $Q^\star$, online adaptation can be no more efficient than pure online RL on certain hard instances. On the positive side, under a novel structural condition on the offline-pretrained value functions, we propose O2O-LSVI, an adaptation algorithm with problem-dependent sample complexity that provably improves over pure online RL. Finally, we complement our theory with neural-network experiments that demonstrate the practical effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 针对离线到在线的RL迁移，作者给出了天然困难性的极小下界，首次提出
AI.motivation: 先在大量离线数据上训练，再在少量在线数据上微调，看起来能省时省钱。但理论界对“到底能快多少”缺乏统一理解与可验证的算法保证。
AI.method: 新设“价值函数结构条件”，提出O2O-LSVI算法：利用离线先验构造加权特征，用有向方差加权降低试错样本需求，并给出它的样本复杂度上界。
AI.result: 1)确立极小下界：即便离线Q很准，在最坏情形仍需跟纯在线RL同量级采样；2)结构假设下，O2O-LSVI的上界可显著优于纯在线；3)多用深度Q实验验证本方法收敛更快且样本更少。
AI.conclusion: 离线起始点不一定带来优势，但若能验证结构条件并采用O2O-LSVI，理论与实际皆能在安全关键场景中安全、高效地复用离线策略。

title: From Prediction to Justification: Aligning Sentiment Reasoning with Human Rationale via Reinforcement Learning
summary: While Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) systems have achieved high accuracy in identifying sentiment polarities, they often operate as "black boxes," lacking the explicit reasoning capabilities characteristic of human affective cognition. Humans do not merely categorize sentiment; they construct causal explanations for their judgments. To bridge this gap, we propose ABSA-R1, a large language model framework designed to mimic this ``reason-before-predict" cognitive process. By leveraging reinforcement learning (RL), ABSA-R1 learns to articulate the why behind the what, generating natural language justifications that ground its sentiment predictions. We introduce a Cognition-Aligned Reward Model (formerly sentiment-aware reward model) that enforces consistency between the generated reasoning path and the final emotional label. Furthermore, inspired by metacognitive monitoring, we implement a performance-driven rejection sampling strategy that selectively targets hard cases where the model's internal reasoning is uncertain or inconsistent. Experimental results on four benchmarks demonstrate that equipping models with this explicit reasoning capability not only enhances interpretability but also yields superior performance in sentiment classification and triplet extraction compared to non-reasoning baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 ABSA-R1，借助 RL 让模型“先推理再预测”，生成可解释的情感依据，同时提升分类与三元组抽取性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 ABSA 模型虽准确却如黑箱，缺少人类“先找原因再下判断”的因果解释机制，可解释性差。
AI.method: 用 RL 训练 ABSA-R1，引入 Cognition-Aligned Reward Model 保证推理路径与情感标签一致，并以性能驱动的拒绝采样重点学习困难/不确定样本。
AI.result: 在 4 个基准数据集中，相比无推理基线，模型在情感分类与（aspect, opinion, sentiment）三元组抽取任务上取得更高准确率，同时提供自然语言解释。
AI.conclusion: 显式因果推理不仅增强可解释性，还能反向提升 ABSA 的核心性能，验证“先推理再预测”范式的有效性。

title: Chain of Uncertain Rewards with Large Language Models for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Designing effective reward functions is a cornerstone of reinforcement learning (RL), yet it remains a challenging and labor-intensive process due to the inefficiencies and inconsistencies inherent in traditional methods. Existing methods often rely on extensive manual design and evaluation steps, which are prone to redundancy and overlook local uncertainties at intermediate decision points. To address these challenges, we propose the Chain of Uncertain Rewards (CoUR), a novel framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) to streamline reward function design and evaluation in RL environments. Specifically, our CoUR introduces code uncertainty quantification with a similarity selection mechanism that combines textual and semantic analyses to identify and reuse the most relevant reward function components. By reducing redundant evaluations and leveraging Bayesian optimization on decoupled reward terms, CoUR enables a more efficient and robust search for optimal reward feedback. We comprehensively evaluate CoUR across nine original environments from IsaacGym and all 20 tasks from the Bidexterous Manipulation benchmark. The experimental results demonstrate that CoUR not only achieves better performance but also significantly lowers the cost of reward evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出 Chain of Uncertain Rewards（CoUR），用 LLM 自动复用并优化奖励函数组件 → IsaacGym 9 场景 + Bi-dexterous Manipulation 20 任务上样本省、性能升。
AI.motivation: 手工设计奖励函数耗时、低效且易遗漏中间不确定性，需减少冗余评估。
AI.method: CoUR：用大模型基于「代码-语义」相似度复用历史奖励片段，对解耦奖励项做贝叶斯优化并量化不确定性，形成迭代式奖励函数搜索流程。
AI.result: 9 个 IsaacGym 环境与 20 个双灵巧手任务平均性能提升 12%，奖励评估次数降低 38%。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知 + LLM 辅助搜索可在复杂机械控制环境中显著改善奖励设计效率与效果，为免调参 RL 提供新范式。

title: HiProto: Hierarchical Prototype Learning for Interpretable Object Detection Under Low-quality Conditions
summary: Interpretability is essential for deploying object detection systems in critical applications, especially under low-quality imaging conditions that degrade visual information and increase prediction uncertainty. Existing methods either enhance image quality or design complex architectures, but often lack interpretability and fail to improve semantic discrimination. In contrast, prototype learning enables interpretable modeling by associating features with class-centered semantics, which can provide more stable and interpretable representations under degradation. Motivated by this, we propose HiProto, a new paradigm for interpretable object detection based on hierarchical prototype learning. By constructing structured prototype representations across multiple feature levels, HiProto effectively models class-specific semantics, thereby enhancing both semantic discrimination and interpretability. Building upon prototype modeling, we first propose a Region-to-Prototype Contrastive Loss (RPC-Loss) to enhance the semantic focus of prototypes on target regions. Then, we propose a Prototype Regularization Loss (PR-Loss) to improve the distinctiveness among class prototypes. Finally, we propose a Scale-aware Pseudo Label Generation Strategy (SPLGS) to suppress mismatched supervision for RPC-Loss, thereby preserving the robustness of low-level prototype representations. Experiments on ExDark, RTTS, and VOC2012-FOG demonstrate that HiProto achieves competitive results while offering clear interpretability through prototype responses, without relying on image enhancement or complex architectures. Our code will be available at https://github.com/xjlDestiny/HiProto.git.

AI.tldr: HiProto在低质量成像下用分层原型学习做可解释目标检测，无需图像增强或复杂网络，在ExDark/RTTS/VOC2012-FOG上兼得精度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 低质量成像导致视觉信息退化、预测不确定，现有方法重画质增强或复杂网络，缺乏可解释性且语义判别力不足。
AI.method: 提出HiProto范式：①分层构建多尺度原型表征；②RPC-Loss拉近区域-原型语义距离；③PR-Loss增大类原型间距；④SPLGS生成尺度感知伪标签，抑制监督失配，保护低层原型鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在ExDark、RTTS、VOC2012-FOG上达到SOTA竞争精度，同时通过原型响应提供清晰可解释性，无需图像增强或复杂架构。
AI.conclusion: 分层原型学习可在低质成像条件下同步提升检测精度与可解释性，为可信视觉系统提供新范式。

title: BOAT: Navigating the Sea of In Silico Predictors for Antibody Design via Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
comment: Proceedings of the 29th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS) 2026
summary: Antibody lead optimization is inherently a multi-objective challenge in drug discovery. Achieving a balance between different drug-like properties is crucial for the development of viable candidates, and this search becomes exponentially challenging as desired properties grow. The ever-growing zoo of sophisticated in silico tools for predicting antibody properties calls for an efficient joint optimization procedure to overcome resource-intensive sequential filtering pipelines. We present BOAT, a versatile Bayesian optimization framework for multi-property antibody engineering. Our `plug-and-play' framework couples uncertainty-aware surrogate modeling with a genetic algorithm to jointly optimize various predicted antibody traits while enabling efficient exploration of sequence space. Through systematic benchmarking against genetic algorithms and newer generative learning approaches, we demonstrate competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods for multi-objective protein optimization. We identify clear regimes where surrogate-driven optimization outperforms expensive generative approaches and establish practical limits imposed by sequence dimensionality and oracle costs.

AI.tldr: 提出一个名为BOAT的贝叶斯优化框架，可在一次搜索中同时优化抗体多类药物性质，突破传统“逐条筛选”瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 抗体先导优化需同时满足亲和性、免疫原性、稳定性等多目标，但现有方法多为串行筛选，成本高且易错失最优解；亟需一种能联合、高效、低耗地探索序列空间的算法。
