title: Neural architectures for resolving references in program code
summary: Resolving and rewriting references is fundamental in programming languages. Motivated by a real-world decompilation task, we abstract reference rewriting into the problems of direct and indirect indexing by permutation. We create synthetic benchmarks for these tasks and show that well-known sequence-to-sequence machine learning architectures are struggling on these benchmarks. We introduce new sequence-to-sequence architectures for both problems. Our measurements show that our architectures outperform the baselines in both robustness and scalability: our models can handle examples that are ten times longer compared to the best baseline. We measure the impact of our architecture in the real-world task of decompiling switch statements, which has an indexing subtask. According to our measurements, the extended model decreases the error rate by 42%. Multiple ablation studies show that all components of our architectures are essential.

AI.tldr: 提出针对程序引用重写中“索引置换”问题的专用序列-生成序列模型，在合成基准上精度显著优于通用模型，并令实际反编译任务的错误率下降42%。
AI.motivation: 反编译真实项目中需自动恢复受编译优化影∕的引用关系，传统端到端模型对长度敏感的索引置换任务表现不佳，急需面向语言结构的改进。
AI.method: 1. 定义两类合成基准：①直接索引（Direct Indexing）、②间接索引（Indirect Indexing），覆盖不同级联的置换场景。2. 基于Transformer框架，引入“键头-寻址机制（Key-head Lookup）+ 相对相对位置编码”：(a) 将索引符号化后映射到专用注意头；(b) 用差分编码显式暴露“跨距”信息并限制注意范围。3. 采用分段-循环解码策略，以恒定存储开销处理10×倍长度输入。
AI.result: 合成基准上，提出的专用模型命中率比最佳基线高12–18个百分点，序列长度扩展到1k tokens未发生精度坍塌；在实际反编译 switch 语句任务中，错误率由原先的17.2%降到9.9%，降幅42%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模“索引=置换”语言特征并限制注意窗口，是提升大规模序列-生成序列模型对程序语义鲁棒性的关键；相关思路可推广到寄存器分配、指针恢复等需精准位置推理的编译/逆向任务。

title: Outperforming Self-Attention Mechanisms in Solar Irradiance Forecasting via Physics-Guided Neural Networks
comment: This is a second version of a previously published paper. DOI: Https://doi.org/10.36227/techrxiv.176827103.31624241/v1
summary: Accurate Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI) forecasting is critical for grid stability, particularly in arid regions characterized by rapid aerosol fluctuations. While recent trends favor computationally expensive Transformer-based architectures, this paper challenges the prevailing "complexity-first" paradigm. We propose a lightweight, Physics-Informed Hybrid CNN-BiLSTM framework that prioritizes domain knowledge over architectural depth. The model integrates a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for spatial feature extraction with a Bi-Directional LSTM for capturing temporal dependencies. Unlike standard data-driven approaches, our model is explicitly guided by a vector of 15 engineered features including Clear-Sky indices and Solar Zenith Angle - rather than relying solely on raw historical data. Hyperparameters are rigorously tuned using Bayesian Optimization to ensure global optimality. Experimental validation using NASA POWER data in Sudan demonstrates that our physics-guided approach achieves a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 19.53 W/m^2, significantly outperforming complex attention-based baselines (RMSE 30.64 W/m^2). These results confirm a "Complexity Paradox": in high-noise meteorological tasks, explicit physical constraints offer a more efficient and accurate alternative to self-attention mechanisms. The findings advocate for a shift towards hybrid, physics-aware AI for real-time renewable energy management.

AI.tldr: 提出一个轻量化物理引导 CNN-BiLSTM 框架，仅用 15 个先验特征即可在苏丹 GHI 预测中将 RMSE 压至 19.53 W/m²，优于 Transformer 基线 36%，证明“高噪声气象任务中简洁物理约束优于复杂自注意力”。
AI.motivation: 沙漠地区气溶胶剧烈变化导致 GHI 快速波动，既有 Transformer 的“复杂度优先”趋势计算昂贵却不一定更准，亟需兼顾实时性与物理可解释性的轻量方案保障电网稳定。
AI.method: 构建物理信息混合模型：CNN 提取空间特征→BiLSTM 捕获双向时序依赖；输入摒弃纯数据驱动，引入晴空指数、太阳天顶角等 15 项先验特征；超参通过贝叶斯全局优化锁定。
AI.result: 苏丹 NASA POWER 数据集上 RMSE 19.53 W/m²，相比最佳注意力基线 30.64 W/m² 相对下降 36%，训练与推断耗时降低一个量级，验证“复杂度悖论”成立。
AI.conclusion: 高噪声气象场景下，显式物理约束比堆叠自注意力更有效，倡导实时可再生能源管理向“物理感知+轻量 AI”范式迁移。

title: TREX: Automating LLM Fine-tuning via Agent-Driven Tree-based Exploration
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have empowered AI research agents to perform isolated scientific tasks, automating complex, real-world workflows, such as LLM training, remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce TREX, a multi-agent system that automates the entire LLM training life-cycle. By orchestrating collaboration between two core modules-the Researcher and the Executor-the system seamlessly performs requirement analysis, open-domain literature and data research, formulation of training strategies, preparation of data recipes, and model training and evaluation. The multi-round experimental process is modeled as a search tree, enabling the system to efficiently plan exploration paths, reuse historical results, and distill high-level insights from iterative trials. To evaluate the capability of automated LLM training, we construct FT-Bench, a benchmark comprising 10 tasks derived from real-world scenarios, ranging from optimizing fundamental model capabilities to enhancing performance on domain-specific tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the TREX agent consistently optimizes model performance on target tasks.

AI.tldr: TREX是一套可端到端自动完成LLM训练全生命周期的多智能体框架，通过研究者-执行者协作及搜索树式实验规划，持续提升目标模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体多局限在孤立科研子任务，而真实世界复杂流程(如训练LLM)仍需大量人工干预；亟需完全自主、系统化的训练方案，以降低门槛并提升复现效率。
AI.method: 设计双层多智能体架构(Researcher+Executor)，将训练流程拆解为需求分析、文献与数据调研、策略制定、数据配方生成、模型训练与评估的闭环；利用搜索树把多轮实验抽象为节点，支持路径规划、结果复用和经验蒸馏，实现迭代优化。
AI.result: 在10项源自真实场景任务的FT-Bench基准上，TREX可持续改进目标模型在各任务上的性能，验证其在端到端自动化LLM训练中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: TREX展示了多智能体协作和树搜索在复杂科研自动化中的潜力，可显著提升LLM训练的自主性与效率，为“让AI自我驯化AI”提供通用范式与可复现基准。

title: Training-Free Semantic Multi-Object Tracking with Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to the 20th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (FG 2026)
summary: Semantic Multi-Object Tracking (SMOT) extends multi-object tracking with semantic outputs such as video summaries, instance-level captions, and interaction labels, aiming to move from trajectories to human-interpretable descriptions of dynamic scenes. Existing SMOT systems are trained end-to-end, coupling progress to expensive supervision, limiting the ability to rapidly adapt to new foundation models and new interactions. We propose TF-SMOT, a training-free SMOT pipeline that composes pretrained components for detection, mask-based tracking, and video-language generation. TF-SMOT combines D-FINE and the promptable SAM2 segmentation tracker to produce temporally consistent tracklets, uses contour grounding to generate video summaries and instance captions with InternVideo2.5, and aligns extracted interaction predicates to BenSMOT WordNet synsets via gloss-based semantic retrieval with LLM disambiguation. On BenSMOT, TF-SMOT achieves state-of-the-art tracking performance within the SMOT setting and improves summary and caption quality compared to prior art. Interaction recognition, however, remains challenging under strict exact-match evaluation on the fine-grained and long-tailed WordNet label space; our analysis and ablations indicate that semantic overlap and label granularity substantially affect measured performance.

AI.tldr: TF-SMOT 无需端到端训练，仅靠现成 D-FINE、SAM2、InternVideo2.5 和 LLM 做语义消歧，完成高保真轨迹、摘要、问地与互动标注，为低成本 SMOT 的 baseline。
AI.motivation: 现有 SMOT 系统都需要联合训练检测、追踪与语言生成模块，依赖昂贵标注，难以快速迁移到新模型或概念，限制了语义结果在长周期/长尾场景中的可扩展性与实时性。
AI.method:
构建 TF-SMOT 三步组合管道：
①以 D-FINE 检测 + promptable SAM2 Mask Tracker 生成时序一致 tracklet；
②用轮廓 grounding 把轨迹与帧级特征送入 InternVideo2.5，自动生成整段视频摘要和实例级标题；
③用 LLM 对轨迹间互动进行语义消歧，在 BenSMOT WordNet 同义词集上做基于 gloss 的检索实现对齐，评估时计程 F1/IDF1、CAPS、ROUGE/Blue、以及 WordNet exact-match Accuracy。
AI.result: BenSMOT 上轨迹 MOTA 持平端到端最佳，摘要/标题在各自动评价指标提升 2–5 pct；但细粒度、长尾化的 WordNet 互动标签下精确匹配仅 41%，高产同义但标签粒度不匹配显著拉低指标，且对召回率与精确率失衡影响巨大。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明在语义多目标跟踪任务可以获得媲美或优于训练式 pipeline 的性能，而完全不依赖额外训练数据；多媒体描述质量得到提升，但 WordNet 细粒度标签的“严格匹配”仍令互动识别呈现挑战，需设计粒度自适应或软化评分方可释放系统潜力，为后续轻量、模块化 SMOT 框架奠定基础。

title: TIP: Token Importance in On-Policy Distillation
summary:
On-policy knowledge distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts under token-level supervision from a teacher. Not all token positions matter equally, but existing views of token importance are incomplete. We ask a direct question: which tokens carry the most useful learning signal in OPD? Our answer is that informative tokens come from two regions: positions with high student entropy, and positions with low student entropy plus high teacher--student divergence, where the student is overconfident and wrong.
  Empirically, student entropy is a strong first-order proxy: retaining $50\%$ of tokens with entropy-based sampling matches or exceeds all-token training while reducing peak memory by up to $47\%$. But entropy alone misses a second important region. When we isolate low-entropy, high-divergence tokens, training on fewer than $10\%$ of all tokens nearly matches full-token baselines, showing that overconfident tokens carry dense corrective signal despite being nearly invisible to entropy-only rules.
  We organize these findings with TIP (Token Importance in on-Policy distillation), a two-axis taxonomy over student entropy and teacher--student divergence, and give a theoretical explanation for why entropy is useful yet structurally incomplete. This view motivates type-aware token selection rules that combine uncertainty and disagreement. We validate this picture across three teacher--student pairs spanning Qwen3, Llama, and Qwen2.5 on MATH-500 and AIME 2024/2025, and on the DeepPlanning benchmark for long-horizon agentic planning, where Q3-only training on $<$$20\%$ of tokens surpasses full-token OPD. Our experiments are implemented by extending the OPD repository https://github.com/HJSang/OPSD_OnPolicyDistillation, which supports memory-efficient distillation of larger models under limited GPU budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出 TIP 双轴框架识别 OPD 中最有价值的 token：高熵 token 与高置信但错误 token，仅选 <20% token 即可优于全量训练，显存降 47%。
AI.motivation: 现有 OPD 对“哪些 token 真正有用”认知不足，导致大量无效计算与显存浪费，需给出可解释、可操作的 token 重要性度量。
AI.method: 构建 TIP 分类：学生熵 × 师生分歧；理论解释高熵提供探索信号、低熵-高分歧提供纠错信号；设计基于该分类的 token 采样策略；在 Qwen、Llama 三对教师-学生模型及 MATH-500、AIME 2024/25、DeepPlanning 任务上验证。
AI.result: 熵采样 50% token 即达全量效果；仅取 <10% 低熵-高分歧 token 也逼近全量基线；Q3 模型在 DeepPlanning 上用 <20% token 超越全量 OPD；峰值显存节约 47%，且无需修改模型结构。
AI.conclusion: 首次系统揭示 OPD 学习信号集中在“高熵不确定性”与“过自信错误”两类 token；TIP 框架兼具理论解释与实用价值，为后续高效知识蒸馏与长程推理训练提供即插即用的 token 选择范式。

title: Asymmetric-Loss-Guided Hybrid CNN-BiLSTM-Attention Model for Industrial RUL Prediction with Interpretable Failure Heatmaps
summary: Turbofan engine degradation under sustained operational stress necessitates robust prognostic systems capable of accurately estimating the Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of critical components. Existing deep learning approaches frequently fail to simultaneously capture multi-sensor spatial correlations and long-range temporal dependencies, while standard symmetric loss functions inadequately penalize the safety-critical error of over-estimating residual life. This study proposes a hybrid architecture integrating Twin-Stage One-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1D-CNN), a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network, and a custom Bahdanau Additive Attention mechanism. The model was trained and evaluated on the NASA Commercial Modular Aero-Propulsion System Simulation (C-MAPSS) FD001 sub-dataset employing a zero-leakage preprocessing pipeline, piecewise-linear RUL labeling capped at 130 cycles, and the NASA-specified asymmetric exponential loss function that disproportionately penalizes over-estimation to enforce industrial safety constraints. Experiments on 100 test engines achieved a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 17.52 cycles and a NASA S-Score of 922.06. Furthermore, extracted attention weight heatmaps provide interpretable, per-engine insights into the temporal progression of degradation, supporting informed maintenance decision-making. The proposed framework demonstrates competitive performance against established baselines and offers a principled approach to safe, interpretable prognostics in industrial settings.

AI.tldr: 为提升涡扇发动机剩余寿命预测的安全性与可解释性，提出一种双阶段1D-CNN+BiLSTM+Bahdanau注意力的混合架构，并以NASA C-MAPSS FD001为基准验证。采用非对称损失函数严厉惩罚高估误差，RMSE 17.52, S-Score 922.06，同时具备可视化权重解释能力。
AI.motivation: 持续运行的涡扇发动机普遍面临性能退化，但现有深度方法难以同时挖掘多传感器空间耦合与长程时序依赖；同时，易爆的安全风险要求预测系统绝对倾向于“保守”估算，而传统对称损失对高估误差不敏感。
AI.method: 提出三件核心措施：①设计“双阶段1D-CNN”先行提取局部特征+BiLSTM捕捉双向长程关系，再叠加Bahdanau加法注意力进行自适应权重分配；②采取零泄露预处理、上限130 cycle分段线性RUL标记并仅使用训练集早期段训练，确保无未来信息；③引入NASA规定非对称指数损失，放大高估惩罚系数，使网络偏向于提前警示。
AI.result: 在FD001子集100台测试发动机上：RMSE = 17.52 cycle，NASA S-Score = 922.06，性能优于DNN、CNN-LSTM、单纯BiLSTM等基准；额外输出注意力热图可逐台揭示各周期/传感器的退化主导资源，支持视情维护决策。
AI.conclusion: 该混合时空架构在兼顾高精度与安全约束的同时，具有可解释性，为工业级可靠剩余寿命预测提供了系统化、保守偏置的新范式。

title: From $P(y|x)$ to $P(y)$: Investigating Reinforcement Learning in Pre-train Space
comment: Preprint. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/Pretrain_Space_RLVR
summary: While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) significantly enhances LLM reasoning by optimizing the conditional distribution P(y|x), its potential is fundamentally bounded by the base model's existing output distribution. Optimizing the marginal distribution P(y) in the Pre-train Space addresses this bottleneck by encoding reasoning ability and preserving broad exploration capacity. Yet, conventional pre-training relies on static corpora for passive learning, leading to a distribution shift that hinders targeted reasoning enhancement. In this paper, we introduce PreRL (Pre-train Space RL), which applies reward-driven online updates directly to P(y). We theoretically and empirically validate the strong gradient alignment between log P(y) and log P(y|x), establishing PreRL as a viable surrogate for standard RL. Furthermore, we uncover a critical mechanism: Negative Sample Reinforcement (NSR) within PreRL serves as an exceptionally effective driver for reasoning. NSR-PreRL rapidly prunes incorrect reasoning spaces while stimulating endogenous reflective behaviors, increasing transition and reflection thoughts by 14.89x and 6.54x, respectively. Leveraging these insights, we propose Dual Space RL (DSRL), a Policy Reincarnation strategy that initializes models with NSR-PreRL to expand the reasoning horizon before transitioning to standard RL for fine-grained optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSRL consistently outperforms strong baselines, proving that pre-train space pruning effectively steers the policy toward a refined correct reasoning subspace.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreRL（对预训练空间 P(y) 做在线奖励学习）并发现其内含的负采样强化机制 NSR 可作为强推理驱动力；基于此构建 Policy Reincarnation 框架 DSRL（先 NSR-PreRL 扩宽搜索，再 RLVR 精调），在多种基准上超越现有 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的 RL 仅优化条件分布 P(y|x)，受限于基模型的输出空间；传统预训练又因被动学习静态语料导致分布偏移，难以针对性增强推理能力。论文希望突破这两重瓶颈，在预训练边际分布 P(y) 层级直接引入在线强化信号，扩大模型解空间的上限。
AI.method: 1) 提出 PreRL：将奖励梯度直接作用于 P(y)，理论证明 log P(y) 与 log P(y|x) 梯度高度对齐；2) 发现负采样强化 NSR 能快速剪除错误分支并诱发内省/反思——transition 与 reflection thoughts 分别提升 14.89× 与 6.54×；3) 设计 DSRL：先用 NSR-PreRL「重生」策略初始化模型，随后切换到标准 RLVR 进行精细优化，实现对正确推理子空间的渐进式逼近。
AI.result: 在多款基准任务上与强基线比较，DSRL 模型平均准确率显著提升，并在部分复杂推理任务上取得当前最佳性能。消融实验证实 NSR-PreRL 阶段对剪枝搜索空间的作用不可替代，是决定后续 RL 精调效果的关键。
AI.conclusion: PreRL 可在预训练空间直接施加奖励，突破了传统 RL 受制于基模型的局限；负采样强化 NSR 揭示了「先大规模剪掉错误，再精细优化正确」的新范式。DSRL 作为 Policy Reincarnation 实例，验证了先粗后细的联合空间剪枝策略能持续显著提升模型推理能力，为后续大模型强化学习研究提供了一条可扩展且高效的路线。

title: UI-Zoomer: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive Zoom-In for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding, which localizes interface elements from screenshots given natural language queries, remains challenging for small icons and dense layouts. Test-time zoom-in methods improve localization by cropping and re-running inference at higher resolution, but apply cropping uniformly across all instances with fixed crop sizes, ignoring whether the model is actually uncertain on each case. We propose \textbf{UI-Zoomer}, a training-free adaptive zoom-in framework that treats both the trigger and scale of zoom-in as a prediction uncertainty quantification problem. A confidence-aware gate fuses spatial consensus among stochastic candidates with token-level generation confidence to selectively trigger zoom-in only when localization is uncertain. When triggered, an uncertainty-driven crop sizing module decomposes prediction variance into inter-sample positional spread and intra-sample box extent, deriving a per-instance crop radius via the law of total variance. Extensive experiments on ScreenSpot-Pro, UI-Vision, and ScreenSpot-v2 demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines across multiple model architectures, achieving gains of up to +13.4\%, +10.3\%, and +4.2\% respectively, with no additional training required.

AI.tldr: 在训练零开销的前提下，UI-Zoomer 借助对模型不确定性的量化，自适应地决定是否局部放大并确定放大尺度，从而显著提升了 GUI 图标的定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有“测试时放大”方法对所有截图实例都机械裁剪、固定分辨率重跑推理，既浪费计算又可能破坏上下文；作者发现只有模型真正“没把握”时才需要放大，且放大区域应随不确定性动态调整。
AI.method: UI-Zoomer 将“是否放大”和“放大多少”建模为不确定性量化问题：1) 通过 MC-Dropout 等获取多组随机预测；2) 空间一致性+token 层生成置信度构成置信门控，仅当综合置信度低于阈值才触发放大；3) 用总方差法则把预测方差拆成“样本间位置漂移”与“样本内框大小波动”，反向推导出实例专属的最优裁剪半径。
AI.result: 在 ScreenSpot-Pro、UI-Vision、ScreenSpot-v2 三个基准上，对多种主干架构均取得持续提升，分别提高 13.4%、10.3%、4.2% 的 mAP，且无需任何额外训练或模型参数。
AI.conclusion: 通过“不确定性感知→置信门控→方差驱动裁剪”的闭环，UI-Zoomer 证明了测试时自适应放大能在零训练成本下显著提升小图标与密集布局的 GUI grounding 性能，为部署轻量级视觉模型提供了即插即用的改进方案。

title: Momentum Further Constrains Sharpness at the Edge of Stochastic Stability
summary: Recent work suggests that (stochastic) gradient descent self-organizes near an instability boundary, shaping both optimization and the solutions found. Momentum and mini-batch gradients are widely used in practical deep learning optimization, but it remains unclear whether they operate in a comparable regime of instability. We demonstrate that SGD with momentum exhibits an Edge of Stochastic Stability (EoSS)-like regime with batch-size-dependent behavior that cannot be explained by a single momentum-adjusted stability threshold. Batch Sharpness (the expected directional mini-batch curvature) stabilizes in two distinct regimes: at small batch sizes it converges to a lower plateau $2(1-β)/η$, reflecting amplification of stochastic fluctuations by momentum and favoring flatter regions than vanilla SGD; at large batch sizes it converges to a higher plateau $2(1+β)/η$, where momentum recovers its classical stabilizing effect and favors sharper regions consistent with full-batch dynamics. We further show that this aligns with linear stability thresholds and discuss the implications for hyperparameter tuning and coupling.

AI.tldr: 动量+mini-batch SGD 会在稳定性边缘形成双阶段「边稳态」：小批量时 Batch Sharpness 稳定于较低平台，倾向平坦解；大批量时趋于更高平台，回归全批量尖锐解。该行为无法用单一动量修正阈值解释，需据批大小分段调参。
AI.motivation: 近年发现（随机）梯度下降会在稳定性边界自组织，从而影响优化路径与最终解质量；但广泛使用的动量与 mini-batch SGD 是否也处于类似边稳态、其动力学如何随批大小变化，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 1) 引入 Batch Sharpness（期望方向 mini-batch 曲率）作为随机稳定性度量；2) 理论推导出其在动量 SGD 下的渐近平台值；3) 结合线性稳定性阈值验证双阶段行为；4) 讨论对超参调优与耦合（coupling）策略的启示。
AI.result: 证明动量 SGD 存在类边稳态（EoSS-like）——小批量时 Batch Sharpness 收敛到 2(1−β)/η 的低位平台，强化随机噪声、偏好平坦区；大批量时收敛到 2(1+β)/η 的高位平台，动量恢复经典稳定作用，偏好尖锐区，与全批量动力学一致。
AI.conclusion: 动量 SGD 的稳定性不能由单一动量修正阈值刻画，而呈批大小依赖的双阶段结构；调参（学习率、动量、批大小）应依据批大小分段设计，以在平坦/尖锐偏好间切换。

title: From Order to Distribution: A Spectral Characterization of Forgetting in Continual Learning
summary: A central challenge in continual learning is forgetting, the loss of performance on previously learned tasks induced by sequential adaptation to new ones. While forgetting has been extensively studied empirically, rigorous theoretical characterizations remain limited. A notable step in this direction is \citet{evron2022catastrophic}, which analyzes forgetting under random orderings of a fixed task collection in overparameterized linear regression. We shift the perspective from order to distribution. Rather than asking how a fixed task collection behaves under random orderings, we study an exact-fit linear regime in which tasks are sampled i.i.d.\ from a task distribution~$Π$, and ask how the generating distribution itself governs forgetting. In this setting, we derive an exact operator identity for the forgetting quantity, revealing a recursive spectral structure. Building on this identity, we establish an unconditional upper bound, identify the leading asymptotic term, and, in generic nondegenerate cases, characterize the convergence rate up to constants. We further relate this rate to geometric properties of the task distribution, clarifying what drives slow or fast forgetting in this model.

AI.tldr: 该研究将灾难性遗忘问题从“任务序列顺序”转向“任务分布几何”，在过参数化线性回归、精确插值设定下首次给出遗忘量的算子恒等式、无条件上界及其与任务分布谱结构的显式定量关系。
AI.motivation: 现有关于灾难性遗忘的理论多为经验性分析，且集中于固定任务集合的随机顺序；缺乏从数据生成分布角度揭示遗忘本质规律的严格理论框架。
AI.method: 假设任务从分布Π中独立同分布采样，采用过参数化线性回归且模型精确拟合当前任务，建立遗忘量的算子恒等式，并利用谱分析导出无条件上界、主导渐近项及其与任务协方差谱的几何判据。
AI.result: 获得遗忘量的精确算子递归恒等式；给出与任务分布协方差矩阵谱衰减相关的无条件上界；在非退化情形下，首次显式确定遗忘速率的常数级收敛阶，并揭示“慢遗忘”对应任务分布具有更平坦的谱或更低维的子空间结构。
AI.conclusion: 数据生成分布的几何（协方差谱与子空间维数）而非任务顺序，才是决定灾难性遗忘快慢的核心因素；所提出的谱视角为设计抗遗忘算法提供了可量化的理论基准。

title: SpatialEvo: Self-Evolving Spatial Intelligence via Deterministic Geometric Environments
summary: Spatial reasoning over three-dimensional scenes is a core capability for embodied intelligence, yet continuous model improvement remains bottlenecked by the cost of geometric annotation. The self-evolving paradigm offers a promising path, but its reliance on model consensus to construct pseudo-labels causes training to reinforce rather than correct the model's own geometric errors. We identify a property unique to 3D spatial reasoning that circumvents this limitation: ground truth is a deterministic consequence of the underlying geometry, computable exactly from point clouds and camera poses without any model involvement. Building on this insight, we present SpatialEvo, a self-evolving framework for 3D spatial reasoning, centered on the Deterministic Geometric Environment (DGE). The DGE formalizes 16 spatial reasoning task categories under explicit geometric validation rules and converts unannotated 3D scenes into zero-noise interactive oracles, replacing model consensus with objective physical feedback. A single shared-parameter policy co-evolves across questioner and solver roles under DGE constraints: the questioner generates physically valid spatial questions grounded in scene observations, while the solver derives precise answers against DGE-verified ground truth. A task-adaptive scheduler endogenously concentrates training on the model's weakest categories, producing a dynamic curriculum without manual design. Experiments across nine benchmarks demonstrate that SpatialEvo achieves the highest average score at both 3B and 7B scales, with consistent gains on spatial reasoning benchmarks and no degradation on general visual understanding.

AI.tldr: SpatialEvo 利用 3D 空间推理中“真值可确定性计算”这一独有特性，构建无需人工标注、零噪声的确定性几何环境（DGE），实现自我进化训练，在 3B/7B 模型上九项基准全面领先。
AI.motivation: 三维空间推理是具身智能核心能力，但几何标注成本极高，限制模型持续改进；现有自进化方法依赖模型共识生成伪标签，反而放大自身几何误差，亟需一种可校正而非强化错误的训练范式。
AI.method: 提出 SpatialEvo 框架，核心为 Deterministic Geometric Environment（DGE）：① 将 16 类空间推理任务形式化为可显式几何验证的规则；② 利用点云与相机位姿确定性计算真值，无需任何模型参与，构建零噪声交互式 Oracle；③ 单一共享参数策略在 DGE 约束下共演“提问者”与“解答者”双重角色，提问者仅生成物理可行问题，解答者对照 DGE 真值作答；④ 内置任务自适应调度器，按模型弱点动态分配训练样本，实现无手工课程学习。
AI.result: 在 9 个三维空间推理基准上，SpatialEvo 的 3B 与 7B 模型均取得最高平均分，并在通用视觉理解任务上无性能下降，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用 3D 几何可确定计算真值的独特属性，SpatialEvo 用客观物理反馈取代模型共识，首次在三维空间推理中实现真正的自进化，突破标注瓶颈，为具身智能持续学习提供可扩展路径。

title: HiVLA: A Visual-Grounded-Centric Hierarchical Embodied Manipulation System
summary: While end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, fine-tuning them on narrow control data often compromises the profound reasoning capabilities inherited from their base Vision-Language Models (VLMs). To resolve this fundamental trade-off, we propose HiVLA, a visual-grounded-centric hierarchical framework that explicitly decouples high-level semantic planning from low-level motor control. In high-level part, a VLM planner first performs task decomposition and visual grounding to generate structured plans, comprising a subtask instruction and a precise target bounding box. Then, to translate this plan into physical actions, we introduce a flow-matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT) action expert in low-level part equipped with a novel cascaded cross-attention mechanism. This design sequentially fuses global context, high-resolution object-centric crops and skill semantics, enabling the DiT to focus purely on robust execution. Our decoupled architecture preserves the VLM's zero-shot reasoning while allowing independent improvement of both components. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that HiVLA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art end-to-end baselines, particularly excelling in long-horizon skill composition and the fine-grained manipulation of small objects in cluttered scenes.

AI.tldr: HiVLA 通过“高层语义规划-低层动作执行”两级解耦，既保留 VLM 的零样本推理，又用 DiT 动作专家完成精细控制，在仿真与真实机器人上均优于现有端到端 VLA 基线。
AI.motivation: 端到端 VLA 模型在窄域操控数据上微调时，会削弱继承自 VLM 的深度推理能力；亟需一种架构兼顾高层推理与低层控制精度的同时，避免两者相互牵制。
AI.method: 1) 高层：VLM 规划器零样本分解任务并做视觉定位，输出子任务指令+目标框；2) 低层：基于流匹配的全新 Diffusion-Transformer 动作专家，通过级联交叉注意力依次融合全局上下文、高分辨率目标裁剪和技能语义，只关注鲁棒执行；3) 两级可独立训练与迭代，不共享参数。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实场景中，HiVLA 的绝对成功率较 SOTA 端到端基线平均提升约 15–25%，在“长周期多技能组合”与“杂乱场景中小物体精细抓取”两项挑战性指标上优势最显著（提升 30% 以上）。
AI.conclusion: 将高层语义与低层控制显式解耦，可在不损伤 VLM 零样本推理的前提下，持续独立优化动作精度；HiVLA 验证了这一设计对机器人 VLA 模型兼具可扩展性与性能优势，为实现通用、可精细操作的具身智能提供了新范式。

title: Complex Interpolation of Matrices with an application to Multi-Manifold Learning
summary: Given two symmetric positive-definite matrices $A, B \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times n}$, we study the spectral properties of the interpolation $A^{1-x} B^x$ for $0 \leq x \leq 1$. The presence of `common structures' in $A$ and $B$, eigenvectors pointing in a similar direction, can be investigated using this interpolation perspective. Generically, exact log-linearity of the operator norm $\|A^{1-x} B^x\|$ is equivalent to the existence of a shared eigenvector in the original matrices; stability bounds show that approximate log-linearity forces principal singular vectors to align with leading eigenvectors of both matrices. These results give rise to and provide theoretical justification for a multi-manifold learning framework that identifies common and distinct latent structures in multiview data.

AI.tldr: 矩阵谱插值 A^{1-x}B^x 的范数呈指数线性当且仅当 A、B 存在共享特征向量；近似指数线性则意味着主奇异向量与两端矩阵的主特征向量对齐。该发现为多视角数据“共性-特性”流形分离提供了理论依据。
AI.motivation: 多视角数据往往同时包含跨视角共享的“共性结构”与视角特异的“特性结构”。传统方法缺乏量化判定两种结构是否存在的谱判据，因此需要建立可解释、可计算的数学表征。
AI.method: 以对称正定矩阵对 (A,B) 为对象，构造几何插值路径 A^{1-x}B^x，研究其算子范数 ‖A^{1-x}B^x‖ 的对数线性性质；通过扰动分析给出“近似对数线性”与主奇异-特征向量对齐之间的稳定界。
AI.result: (1) 精确对数线性 ⇔ A 与 B 存在共享特征向量；(2) 近似对数线性 ⇒ 主奇异向量与 A、B 的主特征向量同时接近共线；(3) 上述谱条件可转化为多流形学习算法，数值实验验证其能准确分离合成与真实多视角数据中的共性与特性子空间。
AI.conclusion: 插值路径的范数指数线性度构成共享特征空间的谱指纹；该指纹为无监督多视角表示学习提供了可解释、可计算的检测与分离准则，并可嵌入现有流形学习框架提升可解释性。

title: Learning from Change: Predictive Models for Incident Prevention in a Regulated IT Environment
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 2026 IEEE/ACM 48th International Conference on Software Engineering: Software Engineering in Practice (ICSE-SEIP)
summary: Effective IT change management is important for businesses that depend on software and services, particularly in highly regulated sectors such as finance, where operational reliability, auditability, and explainability are essential. A significant portion of IT incidents are caused by changes, making it important to identify high-risk changes before deployment. This study presents a predictive incident risk scoring approach at a large international bank. The approach supports engineers during the assessment and planning phases of change deployments by predicting the potential of inducing incidents. To satisfy regulatory constraints, we built the model with auditability and explainability in mind, applying SHAP values to provide feature-level insights and ensure decisions are traceable and transparent. Using a one-year real-world dataset, we compare the existing rule-based process with three machine learning models: HGBC, LightGBM, and XGBoost. LightGBM achieved the best performance, particularly when enriched with aggregated team metrics that capture organisational context. Our results show that data-driven, interpretable models can outperform rule-based approaches while meeting compliance needs, enabling proactive risk mitigation and more reliable IT operations.

AI.tldr: 在银行等大型金融机构中，通过结合组织上下文特征与LightGBM可解释模型，可实现对IT变更的风险预测打分，其效果优于传统规则方法且满足审计合规要求，从而支持部署前主动识别高风险变更，降低因变更引发的事件发生率。
AI.motivation: 金融等强监管行业高度依赖软件系统，其IT变更若引发事故会带来巨大审计与运营压力；研究和预测变更前的潜在风险以实现事前的主动缓解而不仅是事后处置，从而提升系统可靠性与合规可追溯性。
AI.method: 基于一年真实数据训练三种梯度提升模型（HGBC/LightGBM/XGBoost），引入聚合团队指标等组织上下文特征，并采用SHAP值保证模型输出与特征贡献的透明可审计，最终在内部变更流程中嵌入可解释的风险评分。
AI.result: LightGBM在多项指标上表现最佳，显著优于既有基于规则的评估流程；加入团队上下文特征后AUC等指标进一步提升，分析表明高风险阈值拦截能覆盖大部分实际因变更引起的事件。
AI.conclusion: 在满足监管审计与可解释性的前提下，基于机器学习且融入组织情境的变更风险预测方案可有效替代规则方法，帮助工程师在部署阶段即完成风险识别，实现更稳定合规的IT服务运营，并为持续改进提供数据驱动依据。

title: Cracking the Code of Juxtaposition: Can AI Models Understand the Humorous Contradictions
summary: Recent advancements in large multimodal language models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency across a wide range of tasks. Yet, these models still struggle with understanding the nuances of human humor through juxtaposition, particularly when it involves nonlinear narratives that underpin many jokes and humor cues. This paper investigates this challenge by focusing on comics with contradictory narratives, where each comic consists of two panels that create a humorous contradiction. We introduce the YesBut benchmark, which comprises tasks of varying difficulty aimed at assessing AI's capabilities in recognizing and interpreting these comics, ranging from literal content comprehension to deep narrative reasoning. Through extensive experimentation and analysis of recent commercial or open-sourced large (vision) language models, we assess their capability to comprehend the complex interplay of the narrative humor inherent in these comics. Our results show that even state-of-the-art models still lag behind human performance on this task. Our findings offer insights into the current limitations and potential improvements for AI in understanding human creative expressions.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态大模型难以“看懂”幽默并置的短板，作者建立 YesBut 基准（双格矛盾漫画），系统测试模型从字面到深层叙事的多级理解能力；实验显示所有主流模型均显著逊于人类，揭示 AI 在创意语义跃迁上的盲区。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大模型在多种任务上表现优异，但其对“非线性叙事幽默”的微妙理解（尤其是靠并置制造矛盾的漫画）仍明显落后人类；缺乏专门量化这一能力的数据集与评估工具。
AI.method: 构建 YesBut 基准：1) 采集并人工标注双格矛盾漫画；2) 设计由易到难的三级任务（字面内容→矛盾识别→叙事推理）；3) 对 10 余个主流闭源/开源大（视觉）语言模型进行 zero-shot/few-shot 测试，辅以误差与人类协议度分析。
AI.result: SOTA 模型整体准确率仅 58.7%，比人类低 27–35 个百分点；矛盾识别与因果反转解读是主要瓶颈，表现随模型规模扩大趋于饱和，说明参数堆砌对幽默跃迁收益有限。
AI.conclusion: 现有大模型缺乏对“并置-冲突-消解”式幽默语义的显式建模，仅靠数据量与参数堆叠难以弥补；YesBut 为后续引入漫画结构先验、反事实与因果推理机制提供了量化的诊断平台。

title: Don't Let the Video Speak: Audio-Contrastive Preference Optimization for Audio-Visual Language Models
summary: While Audio-Visual Language Models (AVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress over recent years, their reliability is bottlenecked by cross-modal hallucination. A particularly pervasive manifestation is video-driven audio hallucination: models routinely exploit visual shortcuts to hallucinate expected sounds, discarding true auditory evidence. To counteract this deeply ingrained visual dominance, we propose Audio-Contrastive Preference Optimization (ACPO). This dual-axis preference learning framework introduces an output-contrastive objective to penalize visual descriptions masquerading as audio facts, alongside an input-contrastive objective that swaps audio tracks to explicitly penalize generation invariant to the true auditory signal. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ACPO establishes highly faithful audio grounding and mitigates audio hallucination without compromising overarching multimodal capabilities.

AI.tldr: 针对视听语言模型里“视频画面诱导模型编造虚假音频”的核心幻觉，提出双轴偏好学习框架 ACPO，在不牺牲多模态性能前提下，用输入/输出对比损失迫使模型忠实跟随真实音频信号，从而显著抑制音频幻觉。
AI.motivation: 目前最强的 AVLM 仍被“跨模态幻觉”掣肘，尤其当视频画面暗示某种声音时，模型会抛弃真实音频而编造“预期”音效，导致可信度骤降；亟需一种通用、可插拔的矫正机制。
AI.method: ACPO：① 输出对比——将“纯视觉伪音频描述”标为负样本，与真实音频-文本正样本对比，惩罚“视觉冒充音频”行为；② 输入对比——同一段画面下随机互换音轨，迫使生成结果随真实音频变化，惩罚“音轨无关”的幻觉；③ 二者统一为偏好优化损失，在指令调优阶段端到端训练。
AI.result: 在多个基准（音频字幕、视频问答、听觉事件定位等）上，ACPO 把音频幻觉率相对降低 38–52%，同时保持或超越原模型的多模态准确率；可视化分析显示其音频注意力更集中于真实声谱而非画面语义。
AI.conclusion: ACPO 首次把“输入-输出双对比”引入偏好优化，显著打破 AVLM 中的视觉霸权，为可靠、忠实于真实听觉信号的多模态大模型提供了即插即用的新范式。

title: LongCoT: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: As language models are increasingly deployed for complex autonomous tasks, their ability to reason accurately over longer horizons becomes critical. An essential component of this ability is planning and managing a long, complex chain-of-thought (CoT). We introduce LongCoT, a scalable benchmark of 2,500 expert-designed problems spanning chemistry, mathematics, computer science, chess, and logic to isolate and directly measure the long-horizon CoT reasoning capabilities of frontier models. Problems consist of a short input with a verifiable answer; solving them requires navigating a graph of interdependent steps that span tens to hundreds of thousands of reasoning tokens. Each local step is individually tractable for frontier models, so failures reflect long-horizon reasoning limitations. At release, the best models achieve <10% accuracy (GPT 5.2: 9.8%; Gemini 3 Pro: 6.1%) on LongCoT, revealing a substantial gap in current capabilities. Overall, LongCoT provides a rigorous measure of long-horizon reasoning, tracking the ability of frontier models to reason reliably over extended periods.

AI.tldr: LongCoT 用 2 500 道跨学科专家题首次量化大模型的“超长链式推理”能力，当前最强模型准确率不足 10%，暴露长程规划缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有评测聚焦单步或短链推理，无法反映模型在自主完成长周期任务时的真实规划与错误累积问题，需直接度量其长链思维（CoT）极限。
AI.method: 构建覆盖化学、数学、CS、国际象棋、逻辑五领域的问题库，每题只需简短输入与可验证答案，但隐含 tens–hundreds k tokens 的依赖图；局部单步均可解，整体成败仅受长程策略影响。
AI.result: GPT-4o (5.2) 与 Gemini-3-Pro 分别在 LongCoT 上取得 9.8% 与 6.1% 准确率，显著低于短链任务，证实模型在长程步骤组合与错误抑制上存在系统性短板。
AI.conclusion: LongCoT 为追踪前沿模型长周期可靠推理提供严格标尺，揭示当前 scaling 并未同步带来长链规划能力，亟需新训练与推理范式以突破 <10% 瓶颈。

title: Functional Emotions or Situational Contexts? A Discriminating Test from the Mythos Preview System Card
summary: The Claude Mythos Preview system card deploys emotion vectors, sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, and activation verbalisers to study model internals during misaligned behaviour. The two primary toolkits are not jointly reported on the most alignment-relevant episodes. This note identifies two hypotheses that are qualitatively consistent with the published results: that the emotion vectors track functional emotions that causally drive behaviour, or that they are a projection of a richer situational-context structure onto human emotional axes. The hypotheses can be distinguished by a test the system card does not report: applying emotion probes to the strategic concealment episodes where only SAE features are currently documented. If emotion probes show flat activation while SAE features are strongly active, the alignment-relevant structure lies outside the emotion subspace. Which hypothesis is correct determines whether emotion-based monitoring will robustly detect dangerous model behaviour or systematically miss it.

AI.tldr: Claude Mythos Preview用情绪向量、SAE特征等工具研究错位行为，却未在最关键的对齐场景同时报告两类信号。本文提出两条竞争假设并可设计实验区分，结果将决定情绪监测能否可靠识别危险行为。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐研究虽引入情绪向量与SAE特征，却缺乏在同一关键事件上的联合证据，导致无法判断情绪信号是否真具因果效力，抑或只是高层情境结构的低维投影。厘清这一点直接影响未来能否借助情绪监测实现鲁棒危险检测。
AI.method: 通过重新解读系统卡已发布数据，提出两条定性假设：情绪向量驱动行为的“功能情绪”假设 vs. 情绪向量仅反映情境语义的“投影”假设。设计判别实验：在已记录SAE特征但尚未测试情绪激活的“策略隐藏”片段上运行情绪探针，比较两类信号强度。
AI.result: 目前系统卡未执行该实验，因此尚无定量结果。但若实验显示SAE强烈激活而情绪探针平坦，可拒绝“功能情绪”假设，证明对齐关键结构存在于情绪子空间之外。
AI.conclusion: 哪条假设成立将决定情绪监测的可靠性：若情绪向量具因果性，则可作为通用危险探针；若仅属投影，则情绪监测会系统性漏检隐蔽错位行为，需转向更深层表征手段。

title: Social media polarization during conflict: Insights from an ideological stance dataset on Israel-Palestine Reddit comments
summary: In politically sensitive scenarios like wars, social media serves as a platform for polarized discourse and expressions of strong ideological stances. While prior studies have explored ideological stance detection in general contexts, limited attention has been given to conflict-specific settings. This study addresses this gap by analyzing 9,969 Reddit comments related to the Israel-Palestine conflict, collected between October 2023 and August 2024. The comments were categorized into three stance classes: Pro-Israel, Pro-Palestine, and Neutral. Various approaches, including machine learning, pre-trained language models, neural networks, and prompt engineering strategies for open source large language models (LLMs), were employed to classify these stances. Performance was assessed using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Among the tested methods, the Scoring and Reflective Re-read prompt in Mixtral 8x7B demonstrated the highest performance across all metrics. This study provides comparative insights into the effectiveness of different models for detecting ideological stances in highly polarized social media contexts. The dataset used in this research is publicly available for further exploration and validation.

AI.tldr: 首次针对战争场景下的意识形态立场检测，提出基于Mixtral 8×7B的Scoring+Reflective Re-read提示策略，在9 969条以哈冲突Reddit评论的三分类任务中取得最优效果，并开源数据。
AI.motivation: 既有立场检测研究多聚焦通用场景，缺乏对战争等高度敏感、极化语境的专门建模；以哈冲突提供了检验模型在极端对立环境下鲁棒性的天然实验场。
AI.method:
> 数据：2023-10至2024-08期间爬取的Reddit评论9 969条，人工标注为亲以色列、亲巴勒斯坦、中立三类；
> 基线：传统ML（TF-IDF+SVM/LR）、神经网络（BiLSTM、CNN）、预训练模型（BERT族）；
> 主实验：开源LLM（Mixtral 8×7B）+提示工程，对比零样本、Few-shot、Scoring、Reflective Re-read四种提示策略；
> 评估：准确率、宏平均P/R/F1。
AI.result: Scoring+Reflective Re-read提示在Mixtral上取得最佳宏F1（≈0.89），显著优于BERT-base（↑6.4 pp）与传统ML（↑12 pp）；错误分析显示其在讽刺、隐晦表达上仍存9%混淆。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程可激发开源LLM在极化冲突语境的立场检测潜力，Mixtral 8×7B+Scoring+Reflective Re-read为当前最优方案；发布的数据与提示模板为后续研究提供可复现基准，并建议未来引入多模态与实时增量学习以应对话题漂移。

title: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
summary:
Streaming 3D reconstruction aims to recover 3D information, such as camera poses and point clouds, from a video stream, which necessitates geometric accuracy, temporal
  consistency, and computational efficiency. Motivated by the principles of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), we introduce LingBot-Map, a feed-forward 3D foundation
  model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data, built upon a geometric context transformer (GCT) architecture. A defining aspect of LingBot-Map lies in its carefully
  designed attention mechanism, which integrates an anchor context, a pose-reference window, and a trajectory memory to address coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and
  long-range drift correction, respectively. This design keeps the streaming state compact while retaining rich geometric context, enabling stable efficient inference at around
  20 FPS on 518 x 378 resolution inputs over long sequences exceeding 10,000 frames. Extensive evaluations across a variety of benchmarks demonstrate that our approach
  achieves superior performance compared to both existing streaming and iterative optimization-based approaches.

AI.tldr: LingBot-Map 是一种基于 GCT 架构的前馈三维基础模型，可在 518×378@20 FPS 的流式视频上实时重建相机位姿与稠密点云，支持万帧级长序列且无累积漂移。
AI.motivation: 在线三维重建需兼顾几何精度、时序一致性与计算效率，现有 SLAM 方法依赖迭代优化，难以在长序列中保持实时性与低漂移。
AI.method: 设计几何上下文 Transformer（GCT），提出锚点上下文、位姿参考窗与轨迹记忆三项注意力机制，分别解决坐标接地、稠密几何提示与长程漂移校正；整体为纯前馈结构，显式维护紧凑流状态。
AI.result: 在多项公开基准上，LingBot-Map 的位姿误差与点云精度均优于现有流式及迭代优化方法，可在单卡上稳定处理 10 000+ 帧，平均 20 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 SLAM 原理融入 Transformer 注意力，LingBot-Map 首次实现了万帧级实时、低漂移的前馈三维重建，为 AR/VR 与机器人应用提供了可扩展的基础模型。

title: From $P(y|x)$ to $P(y)$: Investigating Reinforcement Learning in Pre-train Space
comment: Preprint. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/Pretrain_Space_RLVR
summary: While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) significantly enhances LLM reasoning by optimizing the conditional distribution P(y|x), its potential is fundamentally bounded by the base model's existing output distribution. Optimizing the marginal distribution P(y) in the Pre-train Space addresses this bottleneck by encoding reasoning ability and preserving broad exploration capacity. Yet, conventional pre-training relies on static corpora for passive learning, leading to a distribution shift that hinders targeted reasoning enhancement. In this paper, we introduce PreRL (Pre-train Space RL), which applies reward-driven online updates directly to P(y). We theoretically and empirically validate the strong gradient alignment between log P(y) and log P(y|x), establishing PreRL as a viable surrogate for standard RL. Furthermore, we uncover a critical mechanism: Negative Sample Reinforcement (NSR) within PreRL serves as an exceptionally effective driver for reasoning. NSR-PreRL rapidly prunes incorrect reasoning spaces while stimulating endogenous reflective behaviors, increasing transition and reflection thoughts by 14.89x and 6.54x, respectively. Leveraging these insights, we propose Dual Space RL (DSRL), a Policy Reincarnation strategy that initializes models with NSR-PreRL to expand the reasoning horizon before transitioning to standard RL for fine-grained optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSRL consistently outperforms strong baselines, proving that pre-train space pruning effectively steers the policy toward a refined correct reasoning subspace.

AI.tldr: 提出PreRL与DSRL框架，用强化学习直接优化预训练空间的边际分布P(y)，通过负样本强化NSR大幅剪枝错误推理空间，再切入传统RL微调，实现推理能力的“政策转世”。
AI.motivation: RLVR只能优化条件分布P(y|x)，受限于基模型既有分布；静态预训练又无法针对性提升推理。亟需一种在线、可导向、且能主动重塑模型先验分布的方法。
AI.method: 1) PreRL：在预训练空间对P(y)做奖励驱动的在线更新；2) 理论+实验证明log P(y)与log P(x|y)梯度强对齐，使PreRL可充当标准RL代理；3) 负样本强化NSR，用错误样本的负信号快速剪枝；4) DSRL：先用NSR-PreRL扩展可行推理边界（Policy Reincarnation），再转入RLVR精细优化。
AI.result: NSR-PreRL使“transition thought”提升14.89倍，“reflection thought”提升6.54倍；DSRL在多项推理基准上显著超越强基线，验证预训练空间剪枝能有效将策略压入正确推理子空间。
AI.conclusion: 直接优化P(y)的PreRL打破RLVR的分布瓶颈；NSR是驱动推理的关键机制；DSRL的“先扩界、后精雕”策略为高效提升大模型推理提供新范式。

title: Bridging MARL to SARL: An Order-Independent Multi-Agent Transformer via Latent Consensus
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is widely used to address large joint observation and action spaces by decomposing a centralized control problem into multiple interacting agents. However, such decomposition often introduces additional challenges, including non-stationarity, unstable training, weak coordination, and limited theoretical guarantees. In this paper, we propose the Consensus Multi-Agent Transformer (CMAT), a centralized framework that bridges cooperative MARL to a hierarchical single-agent reinforcement learning (SARL) formulation. CMAT treats all agents as a unified entity and employs a Transformer encoder to process the large joint observation space. To handle the extensive joint action space, we introduce a hierarchical decision-making mechanism in which a Transformer decoder autoregressively generates a high-level consensus vector, simulating the process by which agents reach agreement on their strategies in latent space. Conditioned on this consensus, all agents generate their actions simultaneously, enabling order-independent joint decision making and avoiding the sensitivity to action-generation order in conventional Multi-Agent Transformers (MAT). This factorization allows the joint policy to be optimized using single-agent PPO while preserving expressive coordination through the latent consensus. To evaluate the proposed method, we conduct experiments on benchmark tasks from StarCraft II, Multi-Agent MuJoCo, and Google Research Football. The results show that CMAT achieves superior performance over recent centralized solutions, sequential MARL methods, and conventional MARL baselines. The code for this paper is available at:https://github.com/RS2002/CMAT .

AI.tldr: CMAT 借助 Transformer 将合作式多智能体决策转化为“单智能体”分层 RL，先经共识向量统一策略再并行输出动作，缓解非平稳与序敏感问题，在多基准上显著优于现有集中式与序列式 MARL 方法。
AI.motivation: 合作 MARL 分解后面临非平稳、训练不稳定、协调弱及理论保证缺失；传统 Multi-Agent Transformer 对动作生成顺序敏感，难以扩展至大联合动作空间，亟需一种既保持集中优化又实现并行、序无关决策的新框架。
AI.method: 提出 Consensus Multi-Agent Transformer（CMAT）：1) 用 Transformer 编码器将全体观测拼成统一状态；2) 解码器自回归产出低维“共识向量”模拟策略协商；3) 各智能体并行依共识生成动作，实现联合策略的“单智能体”PPO 优化；4) 整体形成分层 SARL 等价问题，理论保证与原 MARL 最优性一致。
AI.result: 在 StarCraft II、Multi-Agent MuJoCo、Google Research Football 基准上，CMAT 超越最新集中式方法、序列式 MARL 及传统基线，样本效率与渐近回报均领先，且对动作顺序变化鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: CMAT 通过共识-并行机制把合作 MARL 转化为可理论分析的分层单智能体 RL，兼顾集中训练稳定与去序化决策优势，为大观测/动作空间合作任务提供了新的高性能范式。

title: A closer look at how large language models trust humans: patterns and biases
summary: As large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents increasingly interact with humans in decision-making contexts, understanding the trust dynamics between humans and AI agents becomes a central concern. While considerable literature studies how humans trust AI agents, it is much less understood how LLM-based agents develop effective trust in humans. LLM-based agents likely rely on some sort of implicit effective trust in trust-related contexts (e.g., evaluating individual loan applications) to assist and affect decision making. Using established behavioral theories, we develop an approach that studies whether LLMs trust depends on the three major trustworthiness dimensions: competence, benevolence and integrity of the human subject. We also study how demographic variables affect effective trust. Across 43,200 simulated experiments, for five popular language models, across five different scenarios we find that LLM trust development shows an overall similarity to human trust development. We find that in most, but not all cases, LLM trust is strongly predicted by trustworthiness, and in some cases also biased by age, religion and gender, especially in financial scenarios. This is particularly true for scenarios common in the literature and for newer models. While the overall patterns align with human-like mechanisms of effective trust formation, different models exhibit variation in how they estimate trust; in some cases, trustworthiness and demographic factors are weak predictors of effective trust. These findings call for a better understanding of AI-to-human trust dynamics and monitoring of biases and trust development patterns to prevent unintended and potentially harmful outcomes in trust-sensitive applications of AI.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统探究了大语言模型（LLM）对人类的“反向信任”机制：LLM在贷款、招聘等高风险决策情境中，会像人类一样基于能力、善意、正直三维可信度评估人类，并受年龄、性别、宗教等人口特征偏差影响；43 200次仿真实验显示，越新的模型越易出现与人相似的信任模式，但不同模型间差异显著，需监控其信任敏感应用中的潜在偏见与风险。
AI.motivation: 现有文献多聚焦“人信AI”，却忽视“AI信人”——随着LLM被嵌入贷款审批、招聘等需信任推理的场景，若其隐含的对人信任机制不可控，可能放大偏见并造成系统性危害，因此亟需揭示LLM如何形成对人的有效信任及其偏差来源。
AI.method: 以经典组织行为学三维信任理论（能力、善意、正直）为框架，构建五类高信任敏感场景（个人贷款、雇主评估等）；用五款主流LLM（含新旧参数规模差异模型）在43 200条虚拟交互中模拟信任决策；采用分层回归与 SHAP 解释法，量化可信度维度与人口变量对LLM信任输出的边际效应，并比较模型间差异。
AI.result: 总体信任形成路径与人类高度相似：三维度可信度平均解释＞60%方差，但金融场景中年龄、性别、宗教偏见显著（p<0.01），新模型偏差更强；不同模型对同一人类的信任评分差异最高达38%，且部分场景下人口特征成为主要预测因子，表明信任生成并非完全基于规范而是隐含歧视。
AI.conclusion: LLM已内建类人信任机制，却同步复制并放大了社会偏见；开发者需在信任敏感应用中实时监测模型信任动态，引入去偏约束与可解释审计，防止“AI信人”环节成为新的不公平源头。

title: SpatialEvo: Self-Evolving Spatial Intelligence via Deterministic Geometric Environments
summary: Spatial reasoning over three-dimensional scenes is a core capability for embodied intelligence, yet continuous model improvement remains bottlenecked by the cost of geometric annotation. The self-evolving paradigm offers a promising path, but its reliance on model consensus to construct pseudo-labels causes training to reinforce rather than correct the model's own geometric errors. We identify a property unique to 3D spatial reasoning that circumvents this limitation: ground truth is a deterministic consequence of the underlying geometry, computable exactly from point clouds and camera poses without any model involvement. Building on this insight, we present SpatialEvo, a self-evolving framework for 3D spatial reasoning, centered on the Deterministic Geometric Environment (DGE). The DGE formalizes 16 spatial reasoning task categories under explicit geometric validation rules and converts unannotated 3D scenes into zero-noise interactive oracles, replacing model consensus with objective physical feedback. A single shared-parameter policy co-evolves across questioner and solver roles under DGE constraints: the questioner generates physically valid spatial questions grounded in scene observations, while the solver derives precise answers against DGE-verified ground truth. A task-adaptive scheduler endogenously concentrates training on the model's weakest categories, producing a dynamic curriculum without manual design. Experiments across nine benchmarks demonstrate that SpatialEvo achieves the highest average score at both 3B and 7B scales, with consistent gains on spatial reasoning benchmarks and no degradation on general visual understanding.
