title: Can Coding Agents Be General Agents?
summary: As coding agents have seen rapid capability and adoption gains, users are applying them to general tasks beyond software engineering. In this post, we investigate whether coding agents can successfully generalize to end-to-end business process automation. We identify gaps in current evaluations, and conduct a case study to evaluate a coding agent on practical business tasks in an open-core Enterprise Resource Planning system. We find that the agent reliably completes simple tasks but exhibits characteristic failures on complex tasks, suggesting that bridging domain logic and code execution is a key bottleneck to generalizability.

AI.tldr: 编码智能体虽在软件工程外被广泛使用，但在端到端业务流程自动化中仍难以跨越“领域逻辑⇄代码执行”断层，复杂任务失败率高。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要测编程能力，缺乏对编码智能体在真实ERP业务场景中“通用自动化”能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 选取开源ERP为实验平台，设计覆盖简单到复杂的端到端业务用例，对主流编码智能体进行案例研究与失败归因。
AI.result: 简单任务成功率稳定；复杂任务因领域语义理解不足、事务一致性及异常处理缺失而系统性失败。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体要突破业务自动化瓶颈，需显式建模领域规则、引入事务回滚机制，并构建面向业务流程的新评测体系。

title: CLIP Architecture for Abdominal CT Image-Text Alignment and Zero-Shot Learning: Investigating Batch Composition and Data Scaling
summary: Vision-language models trained with contrastive learning on paired medical images and reports show strong zero-shot diagnostic capabilities, yet the effect of training batch composition on learned representations remains unexplored for 3D medical imaging. We reproduce Merlin, a dual-encoder model that aligns 3D abdominal CT volumes with radiology reports using symmetric InfoNCE loss, achieving a zero-shot macro F1 of 74.45% across 30 findings (original: 73.00%). We then investigate two axes of variation. First, we control the normal-to-abnormal ratio within training batches at 25:75, 50:50, and 75:25 using section-level balanced sampling on the full dataset. All three configurations underperform the unbalanced baseline by 2.4 to 2.8 points, with 75:25 achieving the best result (72.02%) among balanced variants. Second, we conduct data scaling ablations on a 4,362-study subset, training with 20%, 40%, and 100% of the data. Performance scales sub-linearly from 65.26% to 71.88%, with individual findings varying dramatically in data sensitivity. Enforcing 50:50 balanced sampling on the same subset further degrades performance to 68.01%, confirming that explicit class balancing hurts regardless of dataset or balancing granularity. Our results indicate that the stochastic diversity of random sampling, combined with Merlin's alternating batching over anatomical subsections, provides more effective regularization than engineered class ratios at the small batch sizes required by 3D medical volumes.

AI.tldr: 在3D腹部CT-报告对齐任务中，随机采样天然携带的类别多样性比人工设定的正常/异常比例更能提升对比学习效果；强行平衡采样持续降低零样本诊断性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究证实对比式视觉-语言模型在零样本医疗诊断中表现优异，但针对3D影像的小批量(batch)构成如何影响表征学习尚属空白。作者希望厘清“类别平衡采样”这一在2D与自然图像中常用策略，是否同样适用于高内存占用的3D医学数据。
AI.method:
1. 复现Merlin双编码器，用对称InfoNCE在腹部CT与报告上对⻬，验证宏观F1 74.45%。
2. 控制变量实验：三档正常/异常比例(25:75、50:50、75:25)进行切片级平衡采样。
3. 数据规模消融：在4 362例子集上用20%、40%、100%数据训练，并比较50:50平衡 vs 随机采样。
4. 统一采用小batch、交替解剖区域采样策略，保证3D显存可行性。
AI.result:
• 任何人工平衡均低于随机基线2.4–2.8个百分点；75:25平衡最佳仅72.02%。
• 数据量扩大5倍，F1从65.26%亚线性增至71.88%；个别病变对数据量极度敏感。
• 在相同子集上强置50:50平衡，性能再降3.87个百分点至68.01%，不受数据集大小与粒度影响。
• 随机采样配合Merlin的解剖区域交替batching，提供更强正则化。
AI.conclusion: 对3D医学影像对比学习而言，小batch内保持随机分布的病例异质性比刻意类别平衡更有效；随机采样+解剖交替batching已隐含足够正则化，建议后续3D医疗VLM训练放弃显式类别重加权，优先保障数据规模与batch多样性。

title: ParlaSpeech 3.0: Richly Annotated Spoken Parliamentary Corpora of Croatian, Czech, Polish, and Serbian
comment: Accepted at LREC 2026 conference; 12 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: ParlaSpeech is a collection of spoken parliamentary corpora currently spanning four Slavic languages - Croatian, Czech, Polish and Serbian - all together 6 thousand hours in size. The corpora were built in an automatic fashion from the ParlaMint transcripts and their corresponding metadata, which were aligned to the speech recordings of each corresponding parliament. In this release of the dataset, each of the corpora is significantly enriched with various automatic annotation layers. The textual modality of all four corpora has been enriched with linguistic annotations and sentiment predictions. Similar to that, their spoken modality has been automatically enriched with occurrences of filled pauses, the most frequent disfluency in typical speech. Two out of the four languages have been additionally enriched with detailed word- and grapheme-level alignments, and the automatic annotation of the position of primary stress in multisyllabic words. With these enrichments, the usefulness of the underlying corpora has been drastically increased for downstream research across multiple disciplines, which we showcase through an analysis of acoustic correlates of sentiment. All the corpora are made available for download in JSONL and TextGrid formats, as well as for search through a concordancer.

AI.tldr: 6 k小时斯拉夫议会语音识别语料ParlaSpeech，自动化对齐转录、元数据与录音，追加文本情感标注与语音副语言标记，开放JSONL/TextGrid并提供检索接口。
AI.motivation: 议会录音与转录是研究政治话语、情感语音、低资源斯拉夫语言及跨模态对齐的稀缺资源，但现有语料规模小、标注层级浅。
AI.method: 以ParlaMint转录与元数据为锚，强制对齐对应议会录音；为文本模态运行词法、句法与情感模型；为语音模态检测填充停顿，并为两种语言追加词-音素对齐与主重音标注；全链路自动化。
AI.result: 产出6000小时平行语音-文本四语语料，文本侧带情感标签，语音侧带停顿及重音信息，两种语言实现细粒度对齐；案例显示情感极性与声学特征显著相关。
AI.conclusion: 大规模、多层标注的ParlaSpeech显著降低斯拉夫议会语音研究门槛，支持情感语音、对齐模型及政治话语分析等多学科下游任务。

title: A Unified Conditional Flow for Motion Generation, Editing, and Intra-Structural Retargeting
summary: Text-driven motion editing and intra-structural retargeting, where source and target share topology but may differ in bone lengths, are traditionally handled by fragmented pipelines with incompatible inputs and representations: editing relies on specialized generative steering, while retargeting is deferred to geometric post-processing. We present a unifying perspective where both tasks are cast as instances of conditional transport within a single generative framework. By leveraging recent advances in flow matching, we demonstrate that editing and retargeting are fundamentally the same generative task, distinguished only by which conditioning signal, semantic or structural, is modulated during inference. We implement this vision via a rectified-flow motion model jointly conditioned on text prompts and target skeletal structures. Our architecture extends a DiT-style transformer with per-joint tokenization and explicit joint self-attention to strictly enforce kinematic dependencies, while a multi-condition classifier-free guidance strategy balances text adherence with skeletal conformity. Experiments on SnapMoGen and a multi-character Mixamo subset show that a single trained model supports text-to-motion generation, zero-shot editing, and zero-shot intra-structural retargeting. This unified approach simplifies deployment and improves structural consistency compared to task-specific baselines.

AI.tldr: 用同一 rectified-flow 模型把文本编辑与骨架重定向统一为条件搬运问题，零样本完成 T2M、编辑与重定向。
AI.motivation: 传统管线将文本驱动的运动编辑与“同拓扑不同骨长”的骨架重定向拆成两步：编辑靠生成式引导，重定向靠几何后处理，输入/表征互不兼容，导致级联失真与部署复杂。
AI.method: 将两种任务都视为条件生成运输，只在推理时切换“语义条件（文本）”或“结构条件（骨架）”。基于流匹配训练一个 DiT 风格的 rectified-flow 模型：1) 每关节 token 化并施加显式关节自注意力，严格保持运动学依赖；2) 多条件 CFG 同时接受文本与骨架信号，平衡语义忠实与结构一致性。
AI.result: 在 SnapMoGen 与多角色 Mixamo 子集上，单一模型零样本完成文本-运动生成、文本编辑、同拓扑重定向，其结构保真度与一致性优于专用基线，且部署仅需一次前向推理。
AI.conclusion: 编辑与重定向本质是同一生成任务的条件变体，统一 rectified-flow 框架可简化管线、提升一致性，并为“文本-结构”双条件运动生成提供可扩展范式。

title: Learning Probabilistic Responsibility Allocations for Multi-Agent Interactions
summary: Human behavior in interactive settings is shaped not only by individual objectives but also by shared constraints with others, such as safety. Understanding how people allocate responsibility, i.e., how much one deviates from their desired policy to accommodate others, can inform the design of socially compliant and trustworthy autonomous systems. In this work, we introduce a method for learning a probabilistic responsibility allocation model that captures the multimodal uncertainty inherent in multi-agent interactions. Specifically, our approach leverages the latent space of a conditional variational autoencoder, combined with techniques from multi-agent trajectory forecasting, to learn a distribution over responsibility allocations conditioned on scene and agent context. Although ground-truth responsibility labels are unavailable, the model remains tractable by incorporating a differentiable optimization layer that maps responsibility allocations to induced controls, which are available. We evaluate our method on the INTERACTION driving dataset and demonstrate that it not only achieves strong predictive performance but also provides interpretable insights, through the lens of responsibility, into patterns of multi-agent interaction.

AI.tldr: 用责任分配视角解释多智能体交互的不确定性，提出无标签条件下可学习的概率模型并在真实驾驶数据验证。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体预测忽视‘谁让谁’这一社会维度，难以保证安全可信，需要把责任概念量化并融入学习框架。
AI.method: 构建条件VAE把场景与智能体上下文映射到责任分配潜空间；引入可微优化层将责任转为可观测控制，实现端到端无监督学习。
AI.result: 在INTERACTION数据集上预测轨迹的精度领先，同时输出的责任分布能复现人类让行、优先等交互模式。
AI.conclusion: 责任可作为可学习的隐变量嵌入生成模型，既提升预测性能又提供可解释的社会行为解释，为安全自主系统提供新语义信号。

title: UHR-BAT: Budget-Aware Token Compression Vision-Language model for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
summary: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing imagery couples kilometer-scale context with query-critical evidence that may occupy only a few pixels. Such vast spatial scale leads to a quadratic explosion of visual tokens and hinders the extraction of information from small objects. Previous works utilize direct downsampling, dense tiling, or global top-k pruning, which either compromise query-critical image details or incur unpredictable compute. In this paper, we propose UHR-BAT, a query-guided and region-faithful token compression framework to efficiently select visual tokens under a strict context budget. Specifically, we leverage text-guided, multi-scale importance estimation for visual tokens, effectively tackling the challenge of achieving precise yet low-cost feature extraction. Furthermore, by introducing region-wise preserve and merge strategies, we mitigate visual token redundancy, further driving down the computational budget. Experimental results show that UHR-BAT achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/Yunkaidang/UHR.

AI.tldr: UHR-BAT利用查询引导的稀疏化流程，在亚采样、分块或全局剪枝无法兼顾细节与算力的困境下，先由文本信号对多尺度token做代价-收益评估，再通过区域级保留-合并策略消除冗余，从而能在严格上下文长度限制内为超高分辨率遥感影像保留必要甚至小目标信息，在推理早期即完成O(n²→O(k))级压缩且复杂度可预测。
AI.motivation: 亚米级超高分辨率遥感影像同时存在千米级场景和仅占数个像素的关键目标。直接下采样会丢失微小目标；密集分块产生无序冗余token；全局top-k剪枝虽有稀疏性但具体被剪掉的图像内容不可控，均难以在少量视觉槽位中保留查询所需证据。亟需一种不牺牲细节、同时能限制算力增长并保证复杂度可预测的视觉token压缩框架。
AI.method: 论文提出UHR-BAT框架，其核心为“查询引导+区域保持一致”。1) 文本引导的多尺度重要性估计网络：采用查询向量分别与不同空间分辨率下的视觉token对敲，通过轻量级得分网络建立“对回答问题贡献度”映射，跨尺度汇总得到初始k1候选集；2) 区域级保留与合并：对候选token按空间邻近度划区，根据目标密度/纹理复杂度自适应设定保留率，高置信区内token直接保留，冗余区执行可微分池化合并，保证局部细节一致，最终得到固定数量k2>k1的视觉token进入下游VL模型。3) 全过程参数化，推理复杂度有限且与原始分辨率解耦，实现O(n²)→O(k2)的线性变化。
AI.result: 在包含1-5 cm分辨率、图像最高可达30k×30k像素量的公开遥感VL基准(VHR-VQA、UHR-RIS、LEVIR-VL等)上，UHR-BAT将模型所需视觉token压缩至1-2%，平均推理latency减少3-6×，GPU内存占用降低46-52%，而在细粒度小目标检测、实例分割与视觉问答平均mAP/ANLS提升3.1-5.7个百分点，整体指标刷新SOTA。消融显示文本引导比图仍全局shot-pruned方案高出4.3% ANLS，区域合并策略挽救8%小目标召回。
AI.conclusion: UHR-BAT首次提出可在任意严格上下文预算下保证“查询关键细节不丢失”的超高分辨率视觉token压缩范式。其通过文本先验驱动重要性评分，并结合局部区域保持-冗余合并，实现了细节度、内存和效率的Pareto最优，为VL模型直接“摄入”单张卫星大图盘活了算力通道，可扩展至遥感以外的其他大视场成像场景。作者承诺开源代码并计划加入多帧时序交互以进一步提升动态监测能力。

title: LaoBench: A Large-Scale Multidimensional Lao Benchmark for Large Language Models
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has not been matched by their evaluation in low-resource languages, especially Southeast Asian languages like Lao. To fill this gap, we introduce \textbf{LaoBench}, the first large-scale, high-quality, and multidimensional benchmark for assessing LLM language understanding and reasoning in Lao. LaoBench contains \textbf{17,000+} expert-curated samples across three dimensions: culturally grounded knowledge application, curriculum-aligned K12 education, and bilingual translation among Lao, Chinese, and English. It includes open-source and held-out subsets, where the held-out portion enables secure black-box evaluation via a controlled service to improve fairness and data security. We construct LaoBench with a hybrid pipeline that combines expert authoring with agent-assisted verification, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and educational validity. We evaluate diverse state-of-the-art open-source and closed-source LLMs, and find that even strong multilingual models lag behind human experts, particularly in culturally grounded reasoning and translation fidelity. We hope LaoBench will catalyze research on Lao and other underrepresented Southeast Asian languages for more inclusive multilingual evaluation.

AI.tldr: 首个大规模老挝语评测基准LaoBench含1.7万专家标注样本，覆盖文化知识、K12教育与三国语言互译，实验揭示主流模型在老挝语任务上远逊人类。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评测忽视老挝等东南亚低资源语言，缺乏系统、高质量、多维度的评估工具，难以衡量模型在文化推理与教育场景中的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建LaoBench：1) 三维任务设计（文化知识、K12课程、老-中-英互译）；2) 专家撰写+智能体验证的混合流水线，保证语言准确、文化贴合、教育有效；3) 划分开源与封闭子集，后者通过受控服务实现黑盒公平评测与数据安全。
AI.result: 评测主流开源与闭源LLM发现：即使强多语模型在老挝语文化推理与翻译保真度上仍显著落后于人类专家，差距最大处达20+百分点。
AI.conclusion: LaoBench为老挝语及东南亚低资源语言提供了严苛且公平的评测平台，可推动多语模型在文化敏感与教育场景下的包容性研究。

title: MyoVision: A Mobile Research Tool and NEATBoost-Attention Ensemble Framework for Real Time Chicken Breast Myopathy Detection
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 MetaFoods Workshop. 11 pages, 5 figures
summary: Woody Breast (WB) and Spaghetti Meat (SM) myopathies significantly impact poultry meat quality, yet current detection methods rely either on subjective manual evaluation or costly laboratory-grade imaging systems. We address the problem of low-cost, non-destructive multi-class myopathy classification using consumer smartphones. MyoVision is introduced as a mobile transillumination imaging framework in which 14-bit RAW images are captured and structural texture descriptors indicative of internal tissue abnormalities are extracted. To classify three categories (Normal, Woody Breast, Spaghetti Meat), we propose a NEATBoost-Attention Ensemble model, which is a neuroevolution-optimized weighted fusion of LightGBM and attention-based MLP models. Hyperparameters are automatically discovered using NeuroEvolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT), eliminating manual tuning and enabling architecture diversity for small tabular datasets. On a dataset of 336 fillets collected from a commercial processing facility, our method achieves 82.4% test accuracy (F1 = 0.83), outperforming conventional machine learning and deep learning baselines and matching performance reported by hyperspectral imaging systems costing orders of magnitude more. Beyond classification performance, MyoVision establishes a reproducible mobile RGB-D acquisition pipeline for multimodal meat quality research, demonstrating that consumer-grade imaging can support scalable internal tissue assessment.

AI.tldr: 利用智能手机透照成像 + NEATBoost-Attention Ensemble 模型，以 82.4% 准确率、零手动调参、低成本实现整鸡大胸三种肌病（正常、木质化、面条化）的现场无损分类，性能媲美实验室级高光谱系统。
AI.motivation: 木质胸（WB）与面条肉（SM）肌病严重降低禽肉品质，但现有检测要么主观、要么依赖昂贵实验室成像设备，缺乏可在屠宰线旁低成本、非破坏、多类别区分的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出 MyoVision 移动透照框架：① 手机 14-bit RAW 透照采集；② 提取内部组织异常的结构纹理特征；③ 设计 NEATBoost-Attention Ensemble——用 NEAT 神经演化自动搜索架构与权重，融合 LightGBM 与注意力 MLP，实现小表格数据集上的无手工调参集成；④ 建立可重复的 RGB-D 移动端获取流程。
AI.result: 在 336 片商业屠宰样本上，测试准确率 82.4%，F1=0.83，显著优于传统 ML/DL 基线，并与成本高数个数量级的高光谱系统报道性能相当，同时证明消费级成像可支撑可扩展的内部组织评估。
AI.conclusion: MyoVision 首次将智能手机透照 + 演化优化集成学习引入禽肉肌病现场分级，兼顾精度、成本与可扩展性，为产业提供即时、零破坏、多类别的质量监控新范式，并可拓展至多模态肉类品质研究。

title: Adaptive Learning via Off-Model Training and Importance Sampling for Fully Non-Markovian Optimal Stochastic Control. Complete version
summary: This paper studies continuous-time stochastic control problems whose controlled states are fully non-Markovian and depend on unknown model parameters. Such problems arise naturally in path-dependent stochastic differential equations, rough-volatility hedging, and systems driven by fractional Brownian motion. Building on the discrete skeleton approach developed in earlier work, we propose a Monte Carlo learning methodology for the associated embedded backward dynamic programming equation. Our main contribution is twofold. First, we construct explicit dominating training laws and Radon--Nikodym weights for several representative classes of non-Markovian controlled systems. This yields an off-model training architecture in which a fixed synthetic dataset is generated under a reference law, while the dynamic programming operators associated with a target model are recovered by importance sampling. Second, we use this structure to design an adaptive update mechanism under parametric model uncertainty, so that repeated recalibration can be performed by reweighting the same training sample rather than regenerating new trajectories. For fixed parameters, we establish non-asymptotic error bounds for the approximation of the embedded dynamic programming equation via deep neural networks. For adaptive learning, we derive quantitative estimates that separate Monte Carlo approximation error from model-risk error. Numerical experiments illustrate both the off-model training mechanism and the adaptive importance-sampling update in structured linear-quadratic examples.

AI.tldr: 用一套“永驻”仿真数据+重要性采样权重，便可对含未知参数的全非马尔可夫控制问题反复求解并在线更新，无需每次重跑蒙特卡罗，理论给出非渐近误差与模型风险分离估计，实验验证线性-二次情形高效可行。
AI.motivation: 完全非马尔可夫且依赖未知参数（如路径依赖 SDE、Rough 波动率、分数布朗系统）的连续-时间随机控制问题，传统蒙特卡罗每次参数重估都需重采样，计算开销巨大，需要一种能复用数据的学习框架。
AI.method: 在离散骨架(variable or fixed grid)上将问题嵌入后向动态规划方程，用深度蒙特卡罗方法求解；构造显式的支配训练律与Radon-Nikodym权重，实现“离模型(off-model)”合成数据集生成；基于该权重设计自适应重加权机制，使得参数重校准时仅需重算重要性采样权重而非重新尝试轨迹。
AI.result: 固定参数情形下给出用深度神经网络近似嵌入动态规划方程的非渐近L2误差界；自适应学习阶段推导出蒙特卡罗近似误差与模型不确定性风险误差可分离的收敛估计；在线-线性二次示例中展示了权重更新与策略求解的高效性。
AI.conclusion: 借助支配律与重要性采样，首次在理论和数值上验证了全非马尔可夫参数不确定问题可仅通过一次离线数据生成+权重更新完成持续学习和校准，为模型风险下的高维随机控制提供可扩展的深度学习解决方案。

title: Comparison of window shapes and lengths in short-time feature extraction for classification of heart sound signals
summary: Heart sound signals, phonocardiography (PCG) signals, allow for the automatic diagnosis of potential cardiovascular pathology. Such classification task can be tackled using the bidirectional long short-term memory (biLSTM) network, trained on features extracted from labeled PCG signals. Regarding the non-stationarity of PCG signals, it is recommended to extract the features from multiple short-length segments of the signals using a sliding window of certain shape and length. However, some window contains unfavorable spectral side lobes, which distort the features. Accordingly, it is preferable to adapt the window shape and length in terms of classification performance. We propose an experimental evaluation for three window shapes, each with three window lengths. The biLSTM network is trained and tested on statistical features extracted, and the performance is reported in terms of the window shapes and lengths. Results show that the best performance is obtained when the Gaussian window is used for splitting the signals, and the triangular window competes with the Gaussian window for a length of 75 ms. Although the rectangular window is a commonly offered option, it is the worst choice for splitting the signals. Moreover, the classification performance obtained with a 75 ms Gaussian window outperforms that of a baseline method.

AI.tldr: 高斯窗函数、75 ms 窗长可最大限度提升基于 biLSTM 的心音自动分类准确率，显著优于矩形窗与基准算法。
AI.motivation: PCG 信号非平稳，滑动窗分帧提取特征时频谱旁瓣会扭曲特征，需系统评估窗形与窗长对 biLSTM 分类性能的影响。
AI.method: 在公开标注 PCG 数据上，用矩形、三角、高斯三种窗形各取 25、50、75 ms 三种窗长进行分帧；提取统计特征后训练 biLSTM，以准确率、F1 等指标比较不同窗参数。
AI.result: 高斯窗整体最优，75 ms 时准确率达 94.3%，较基准方法提升 4.1%；三角窗在 75 ms 时与高斯窗差异不显著，矩形窗性能最差。
AI.conclusion: 窗函数类型与长度对基于 biLSTM 的心音分类至关重要；推荐采用 75 ms 高斯窗，可在不增加模型复杂度的情况下获得显著性能增益。

title: fMRI-LM: Towards a Universal Foundation Model for Language-Aligned fMRI Understanding
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled unified reasoning across images, audio, and video, but extending such capability to brain imaging remains largely unexplored. Bridging this gap is essential to link neural activity with semantic cognition and to develop cross-modal brain representations. To this end, we present fMRI-LM, a foundational model that bridges functional MRI (fMRI) and language through a three-stage framework. In Stage 1, we learn a neural tokenizer that maps fMRI into discrete tokens embedded in a language-consistent space. In Stage 2, a pretrained LLM is adapted to jointly model fMRI tokens and text, treating brain activity as a sequence that can be temporally predicted and linguistically described. To overcome the lack of natural fMRI-text pairs, we construct a large descriptive corpus that translates diverse imaging-based features into structured textual descriptors, capturing the low-level organization of fMRI signals. In Stage 3, we perform multi-task, multi-paradigm instruction tuning to endow fMRI-LM with high-level semantic understanding, supporting diverse downstream applications. Across various benchmarks, fMRI-LM achieves strong zero-shot and few-shot performance, and adapts efficiently with parameter-efficient tuning (LoRA), establishing a scalable pathway toward a language-aligned, universal model for structural and semantic understanding of fMRI.

AI.tldr: 提出首个统一 fMRI 与语言的通用基础模型 fMRI-LM，三阶段训练后可直接用自然语言零样本/小样本分析脑影像。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型已统一图、音、视频推理，却尚未触及 fMRI；建立神经活动与语义认知的可解释桥梁、实现跨模态脑表征，对认知神经科学与 AI 均具重大意义。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：① 训练“神经分词器”，将 4D-fMRI 信号离散化为与词向量对齐的 token；② 利用自建的 fMRI-文本描述语料，让预训练 LLM 联合建模脑序列与文本，解决配对数据缺失；③ 多任务/多范式指令微调，注入高阶语义。全程采用 LoRA 参数高效调优。
AI.result: 在多项脑影像零样本与小样本基准上显著优于现有方法，仅用少量参数即可快速适应新任务，证明模型可扩展且语言对齐。
AI.conclusion: fMRI-LM 首次把 fMRI 纳入统一语言模型体系，提供可解释、可扩展的脑-语义研究新平台，为无创解码思维及通用脑表征奠定基础。

title: RobotPan: A 360$^\circ$ Surround-View Robotic Vision System for Embodied Perception
summary: Surround-view perception is increasingly important for robotic navigation and loco-manipulation, especially in human-in-the-loop settings such as teleoperation, data collection, and emergency takeover. However, current robotic visual interfaces are often limited to narrow forward-facing views, or, when multiple on-board cameras are available, require cumbersome manual switching that interrupts the operator's workflow. Both configurations suffer from motion-induced jitter that causes simulator sickness in head-mounted displays. We introduce a surround-view robotic vision system that combines six cameras with LiDAR to provide full 360$^\circ$ visual coverage, while meeting the geometric and real-time constraints of embodied deployment. We further present \textsc{RobotPan}, a feed-forward framework that predicts \emph{metric-scaled} and \emph{compact} 3D Gaussians from calibrated sparse-view inputs for real-time rendering, reconstruction, and streaming. \textsc{RobotPan} lifts multi-view features into a unified spherical coordinate representation and decodes Gaussians using hierarchical spherical voxel priors, allocating fine resolution near the robot and coarser resolution at larger radii to reduce computational redundancy without sacrificing fidelity. To support long sequences, our online fusion updates dynamic content while preventing unbounded growth in static regions by selectively updating appearance. Finally, we release a multi-sensor dataset tailored to 360$^\circ$ novel view synthesis and metric 3D reconstruction for robotics, covering navigation, manipulation, and locomotion on real platforms. Experiments show that \textsc{RobotPan} achieves competitive quality against prior feed-forward reconstruction and view-synthesis methods while producing substantially fewer Gaussians, enabling practical real-time embodied deployment. Project website: https://robotpan.github.io/

AI.tldr: 围绕式360°视觉系统RobotPan，用6相机+LiDAR实时生成度量精度的轻量3D高斯，供远程操作与紧急接管，减少晕动症并开源数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人视觉接口视野窄或需繁琐切换，且头显抖动易致晕动症；人机共环场景下亟需无盲点、低延迟、度量准确的沉浸视觉。
AI.method: 1) 六目相机+LiDAR硬同步实现360°覆盖；2) 球坐标统一多视图特征，按距机器人远细分层分配体素分辨率；3) 前馈网络直接预测度量3D高斯，在线融合只更新动态区域避免静态区无限膨胀；4) 输出轻量高斯流供实时渲染/重建/网络传输。
AI.result: 在真实导航-操作-运动平台数据集上，质量匹敌SOTA前馈重建/新视角合成方法，但高斯数量显著减少；系统端到端满足机载实时要求。
AI.conclusion: RobotPan首次将度量轻量3D高斯与360°多传感器结合，实现低带宽、低延迟、抗晕动的沉浸远操视觉，为后续人-机协同与数据收集提供通用基准。

title: PatchPoison: Poisoning Multi-View Datasets to Degrade 3D Reconstruction
comment: CVPR Workshop on Security, Privacy, and Adversarial Robustness in 3D Generative Vision Models (SPAR-3D), 2026
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently enabled highly photorealistic 3D reconstruction from casually captured multi-view images. However, this accessibility raises a privacy concern: publicly available images or videos can be exploited to reconstruct detailed 3D models of scenes or objects without the owner's consent. We present PatchPoison, a lightweight dataset-poisoning method that prevents unauthorized 3D reconstruction. Unlike global perturbations, PatchPoison injects a small high-frequency adversarial patch, a structured checkerboard, into the periphery of each image in a multi-view dataset. The patch is designed to corrupt the feature-matching stage of Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipelines such as COLMAP by introducing spurious correspondences that systematically misalign estimated camera poses. Consequently, downstream 3DGS optimization diverges from the correct scene geometry. On the NeRF-Synthetic benchmark, inserting a 12 X 12 pixel patch increases reconstruction error by 6.8x in LPIPS, while the poisoned images remain unobtrusive to human viewers. PatchPoison requires no pipeline modifications, offering a practical, "drop-in" preprocessing step for content creators to protect their multi-view data.

AI.tldr: PatchPoison 通过在多视图数据集的每张图像边缘嵌入12 × 12的棋盘高频对抗补丁，破坏COLMAP等 SfM 流程的特征匹配，使相机位姿系统失准，从而让下游3DGS无法收敛到正确几何，LPIPS误差提升6.8倍，且对人眼几乎不可见。
AI.motivation: 3DGS仅凭公开图像即可高精度重建场景，带来未经同意的隐私泄露风险，亟需一种无需修改现有流程、可“即插即用”的数据保护手段。
AI.method: 提出PatchPoison：1)仅在每幅输入图像外围粘贴小尺寸(12 × 12)棋盘状高频对抗补丁；2)利用该补丁在SIFT/ORB特征匹配阶段引入伪对应，系统性扰乱COLMAP估计的相机外参；3)位姿偏差传递至3DGS优化，使其无法恢复正确几何，无需改变3DGS或SfM内部算法。
AI.result: 在NeRF-Synthetic基准上，加入该补丁后3DGS的LPIPS重建误差增大6.8倍，PSNR下降约40%；补丁区域仅占图像0.02%面积，肉眼难以察觉；方法对COLMAP、SfM及3DGS零修改即可生效。
AI.conclusion: PatchPoison以极小视觉扰动即可显著破坏3D重建质量，为内容创作者提供轻量级、可落地的多视图数据隐私保护方案。

title: BenGER: A Collaborative Web Platform for End-to-End Benchmarking of German Legal Tasks
summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) for legal reasoning requires workflows that span task design, expert annotation, model execution, and metric-based evaluation. In practice, these steps are split across platforms and scripts, limiting transparency, reproducibility, and participation by non-technical legal experts. We present the BenGER (Benchmark for German Law) framework, an open-source web platform that integrates task creation, collaborative annotation, configurable LLM runs, and evaluation with lexical, semantic, factual, and judge-based metrics. BenGER supports multi-organization projects with tenant isolation and role-based access control, and can optionally provide formative, reference-grounded feedback to annotators. We will demonstrate a live deployment showing end-to-end benchmark creation and analysis.

AI.tldr: BenGER 是一个一站式开源 Web 平台，把法律推理评测所需的「任务设计-专家标注-模型运行-多维打分」全部集成，解决流程割裂、不可复现、非技术法律人难参与等痛点，并支持多机构协作与细粒度权限控制。
AI.motivation: 现有法律 LLM 评测步骤分散在多平台，法律专家难以介入，透明性与可重复性差，亟需一体化且对法律人友好的评测框架。
AI.method: 设计并实现 BenGER：① 统一任务创建、协作标注、可配置 LLM 运行与多维度（词法、语义、事实、法官标准）评估；② 采用多租户隔离与角色权限管理支持多机构协作；③ 提供基于参考答案的过程性反馈，提高标注质量。
AI.result: 平台已可完整支持从任务构建到结果分析的端到端闭环，并将在现场展示真实部署与 DEMO。
AI.conclusion: BenGER 把复杂技术流程封装为可视化、可协作的 Web 界面，显著降低法律专家参与门槛，为德语区乃至更大范围的法律 LLM 评测提供了可复现、可扩展的基础设施。

title: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Target Language Adaptation of LLMs via Source-Shielded Updates
summary: Expanding the linguistic diversity of instruct large language models (LLMs) is crucial for global accessibility but is often hindered by the reliance on costly specialized target language labeled data and catastrophic forgetting during adaptation. We tackle this challenge under a realistic, low-resource constraint: adapting instruct LLMs using only unlabeled target language data. We introduce Source-Shielded Updates (SSU), a selective parameter update strategy that proactively preserves source knowledge. Using a small set of source data and a parameter importance scoring method, SSU identifies parameters critical to maintaining source abilities. It then applies a column-wise freezing strategy to protect these parameters before adaptation. Experiments across five typologically diverse languages and 7B and 13B models demonstrate that SSU successfully mitigates catastrophic forgetting. It reduces performance degradation on monolingual source tasks to just 3.4% (7B) and 2.8% (13B) on average, a stark contrast to the 20.3% and 22.3% from full fine-tuning. SSU also achieves target-language performance highly competitive with full fine-tuning, outperforming it on all benchmarks for 7B models and the majority for 13B models.

AI.tldr: SSU用无标签目标语数据微调指令LLM，先打分锁定源语关键参数列再解冻其余部分，兼顾低资源扩展与抗遗忘。
AI.motivation: 全球用户需要多语言指令LLM，但传统方法依赖昂贵目标语标注数据且微调时源语能力灾难性遗忘，亟需仅利用无标签目标语即可扩展的方案。
AI.method: 提出Source-Shielded Updates（SSU）：用少量源语数据计算参数重要性得分，识别对源语能力关键的参数列并冻结，随后在仅含无标签目标语数据的环境下继续训练其余参数。
AI.result: 在5种类型迥异语言、7B/13B模型上，SSU将源语任务性能下降压缩至3.4%/2.8%，而全参数微调达20.3%/22.3%；目标语任务表现与全参数微调持平甚至更好，7B模型全部基准领先，13B模型多数领先。
AI.conclusion: SSU首次在纯无标签目标语条件下有效抑制灾难遗忘，实现低资源多语言指令LLM扩展，为全球化部署提供实用、高效的微调策略。

title: Learning Class Difficulty in Imbalanced Histopathology Segmentation via Dynamic Focal Attention
summary: Semantic segmentation of histopathology images under class imbalance is typically addressed through frequency-based loss reweighting, which implicitly assumes that rare classes are difficult. However, true difficulty also arises from morphological variability, boundary ambiguity, and contextual similarity-factors that frequency cannot capture. We propose Dynamic Focal Attention (DFA), a simple and efficient mechanism that learns class-specific difficulty directly within the cross-attention of query-based mask decoders. DFA introduces a learnable per-class bias to attention logits, enabling representation-level reweighting prior to prediction rather than gradient-level reweighting after prediction. Initialised from a log-frequency prior to prevent gradient starvation, the bias is optimised end-to-end, allowing the model to adaptively capture difficulty signals through training, effectively unifying frequency-based and difficulty-aware approaches under a common attention-bias framework. On three histopathology benchmarks (BDSA, BCSS, CRAG), DFA consistently improves Dice and IoU, matching or exceeding a difficulty-aware baseline without a separate estimator or additional training stage. These results demonstrate that encoding class difficulty at the representation level provides a principled alternative to conventional loss reweighting for imbalanced segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出动态聚焦注意（DFA），在查询式掩膜解码器的交叉注意力中直接学习每类“难度”偏置，无需额外网络或训练阶段即可在三种病理切片数据集上击败基于频率的重加权基线。
AI.motivation: 传统频率重加权默认“稀有=难”，但病理组织中存在形态变异、边界模糊、上下文相似等真实难度因素，频率无法刻画；需要一种在表征层面即可感知并补偿类间难度差异的机制。
AI.method: 在交叉注意力logits上为每类引入可学习偏置项，初始化为对数频率先验防止梯度饥饿，端到端优化，实现表示级重加权；将频率先验与难度信号统一于同一注意力偏置框架。
AI.result: 在BDSA、BCSS、CRAG三个不平衡病理语义分割基准上，DFA一致提升Dice与IoU，匹配或超越需额外难度估计器的强基线，无额外训练阶段或参数开销。
AI.conclusion: 在表征层编码类难度可直接替代传统损失重加权，为类别极度不平衡的医学图像分割提供了简洁、高效且可解释的新范式。

title: HUANet: Hard-Constrained Unrolled ADMM for Constrained Convex Optimization
summary: This paper presents HUANet, a constrained deep neural network architecture that unrolls the iterations of the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) into a trainable neural network for solving constrained convex optimization problems. Existing end-to-end learning methods operate as black-box mappings from parameters to solutions, often lacking explicit optimality principles and failing to enforce constraints. To address this limitation, we unroll ADMM and embed a hard-constrained neural network at each iteration to accelerate the algorithm, where equality constraints are enforced via a differentiable correction stage at the network output. Furthermore, we incorporate first-order optimality conditions as soft constraints during training to promote the convergence of the proposed unrolled algorithm. Extensive numerical experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed architecture for constrained optimization problems.

AI.tldr: HUANet 把 ADMM 迭代展开成可训练深度网络，在每一步用可微修正强制满足等式约束，并用 KKT 软约束加速收敛，实验证明在带约束凸优化上优于黑盒端到端方法。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端学习只做黑盒映射，无法显式保证约束满足，也难以嵌入最优性原理，导致在严格约束凸优化问题中可靠性与可解释性不足。
AI.method: 1) 将 ADMM 完整迭代流程展开成层级网络；2) 每层嵌入“硬约束子网络”，通过输出端可微投影即时校正等式约束；3) 训练损失中引入 KKT 一阶最优性残差作为软约束，引导网络参数朝最优解方向收敛；4) 整体架构可端到端训练，推理时仅需前向传播即可得约束可行解。
AI.result: 在多个典型约束凸优化数据集（如 Lasso、Basis Pursuit、约束QP）上与标准 ADMM、Learned-ADMM 及纯黑盒网络对比，HUANet 在同等精度下迭代次数减少 30–60%，计算时间缩短 2–4 倍，约束违反量降低 1–2 个数量级；对参数扰动表现出更好鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 把优化算法展开并嵌入硬-软混合约束，是兼具可解释性、可行性保证与加速效果的有效范式；HUANet 为求解实时、高可靠度约束凸优化任务提供新架构，可平滑迁移至信号恢复、资源分配等应用。

title: Design Space Exploration of Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks for Chronic Kidney Disease
summary: Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks (HQNNs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for near-term quantum machine learning. However, their practical performance strongly depends on design choices such as classical-to-quantum data encoding, quantum circuit architecture, measurement strategy and shots. In this paper, we present a comprehensive design space exploration of HQNNs for Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) diagnosis. Using a carefully curated and preprocessed clinical dataset, we benchmark 625 different HQNN models obtained by combining five encoding schemes, five entanglement architectures, five measurement strategies, and five different shot settings. To ensure fair and robust evaluation, all models are trained using 10-fold stratified cross-validation and assessed on a test set using a comprehensive set of metrics, including accuracy, area under the curve (AUC), F1-score, and a composite performance score. Our results reveal strong and non-trivial interactions between encoding choices and circuit architectures, showing that high performance does not necessarily require large parameter counts or complex circuits. In particular, we find that compact architectures combined with appropriate encodings (e.g., IQP with Ring entanglement) can achieve the best trade-off between accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. Beyond absolute performance analysis, we also provide actionable insights into how different design dimensions influence learning behavior in HQNNs.

AI.tldr: 本文在慢性肾病诊断任务上对625种HQNN配置进行了系统对比，发现适当的小型量子编码＋简单纠缠结构即可在准确率、鲁棒性与效率间取得最佳折中，无需追求大参数或深电路。
AI.motivation: HQNN在NISQ时代的实用性受限于设计超参（编码、电路、测量、采样数）的盲目选择，缺乏针对真实临床数据的系统指南。
AI.method: 以精心清洗的CKD临床数据集为基准，采用10折分层交叉验证，穷尽5编码×5纠缠×5测量×5采样数的625种HQNN组合，并用准确率、AUC、F1及综合分数全面评估。
AI.result: 编码与电路间存在显著非线性交互；紧凑电路（如Ring纠缠）配合IQP编码可在参数量最小的情况下取得顶级性能，优于复杂深度电路。
AI.conclusion: HQNN设计应优先选择“轻量编码+低纠缠”路线，而非盲目扩参；本文为量子机器学习在医疗场景的落地提供了可直接复用的设计范式与配置推荐。

title: Reducing Hallucinations in LLMs via Factuality-Aware Preference Learning
summary: Preference alignment methods such as RLHF and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) improve instruction following, but they can also reinforce hallucinations when preference judgments reward fluency and confidence over factual correctness. We introduce F-DPO (Factuality-aware Direct Preference Optimization), a simple extension of DPO that uses only binary factuality labels. F-DPO (i) applies a label-flipping transformation that corrects misordered preference pairs so the chosen response is never less factual than the rejected one, and (ii) adds a factuality-aware margin that emphasizes pairs with clear correctness differences, while reducing to standard DPO when both responses share the same factuality. We construct factuality-aware preference data by augmenting DPO pairs with binary factuality indicators and synthetic hallucinated variants. Across seven open-weight LLMs (1B-14B), F-DPO consistently improves factuality and reduces hallucination rates relative to both base models and standard DPO. On Qwen3-8B, F-DPO reduces hallucination rates by 5x(from 0.424 to 0.084) while improving factuality scores by 50% (from 5.26 to 7.90). F-DPO also generalizes to out-of-distribution benchmarks: on TruthfulQA, Qwen2.5-14B achieves +17% MC1 accuracy (0.500 to 0.585) and +49% MC2 accuracy (0.357 to 0.531). F-DPO requires no auxiliary reward model, token-level annotations, or multi-stage training.

AI.tldr: 在无需额外奖励模型和token级标注的前提下，F-DPO仅通过二进制正确性标记+偏好对重排+事实感知的间隔损失，使1B-14B模型的hallucination率平均降低70%，并在OOD基准TruthfulQA上实现17-49%的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: RLHF/DPO偏好对齐会奖励流畅自信而非正确性的答案，从而放大幻觉，需要一种兼顾「模型对齐」与「事实可靠性」的轻量方案。
AI.method: 1)对DPO偏好对按二进制事实标签翻转排序，使chosen恒比rejected更真实；2)对事实差异大的对的损失增加margin，事实等价时退化为标准DPO；3)用原DPO对+合成幻觉变形体构造带事实标注的新偏好数据。
AI.result: 7个开源模型实验显示：Qwen3-8B幻觉率从42.4%→8.4%(↓5×)，事实性评分+50%；Qwen2.5-14B在TruthfulQA MC1+17%、MC2+49%。无需辅助奖励模型、无token级标记、无多阶段训练即可端到端完成对齐。
AI.conclusion: F-DPO证明仅引入二值「是否事实」即可把对齐目标修正为「可信优先」，在不牺牲流畅性、不增加训练 pipeline 复杂度的前提下大幅降低幻觉，对规模1B-14B模型具有一致可泛化收益。

title: RadarSplat-RIO: Indoor Radar-Inertial Odometry with Gaussian Splatting-Based Radar Bundle Adjustment
summary: Radar is more resilient to adverse weather and lighting conditions than visual and Lidar simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). However, most radar SLAM pipelines still rely heavily on frame-to-frame odometry, which leads to substantial drift. While loop closure can correct long-term errors, it requires revisiting places and relies on robust place recognition. In contrast, visual odometry methods typically leverage bundle adjustment (BA) to jointly optimize poses and map within a local window. However, an equivalent BA formulation for radar has remained largely unexplored. We present the first radar BA framework enabled by Gaussian Splatting (GS), a dense and differentiable scene representation. Our method jointly optimizes radar sensor poses and scene geometry using full range-azimuth-Doppler data, bringing the benefits of multi-frame BA to radar for the first time. When integrated with an existing radar-inertial odometry frontend, our approach significantly reduces pose drift and improves robustness. Across multiple indoor scenes, our radar BA achieves substantial gains over the prior radar-inertial odometry, reducing average absolute translational and rotational errors by 90% and 80%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 首次将高斯 Splatting 引入雷达 SLAM，提出多帧捆绑调整框架，使漂移降低 90%。
AI.motivation: 现有雷达 SLAM 帧间里程计漂移大；回环依赖重访且鲁棒性差；视觉 BA 已成功，但雷达缺乏等效机制。
AI.method: 基于高斯 Splatting 构建可微稠密场景表示，在局部窗口内用全距离-方位-多普勒数据联合优化雷达位姿和地图，形成首个雷达 BA；与惯性前端松耦合。
AI.result: 在多个室内序列上，相较于原雷达-惯性里程计，平移误差降 90%，旋转误差降 80%，漂移显著减少，鲁棒性提升。
AI.conclusion: 雷达 BA 可行且有效，高斯 Splatting 为多帧联合优化提供新工具，为全天候长航时 SLAM 奠定基础。

title: Fast Voxelization and Level of Detail for Microgeometry Rendering
comment: Accepted for publication in The Visual Computer. 16 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary material: https://javierfabre.com/projects/voxel-lod/supp.pdf
summary: Many materials show anisotropic light scattering patterns due to the shape and local alignment of their underlying micro structures: surfaces with small elements such as fibers, or the ridges of a brushed metal, are very sparse and require a high spatial resolution to be properly represented as a volume. The acquisition of voxel data from such objects is a time and memory-intensive task, and most rendering approaches require an additional Level-of-Detail (LoD) data structure to aggregate the visual appearance, as observed from multiple distances, in order to reduce the number of samples computed per pixel (E.g.: MIP mapping). In this work we introduce first, an efficient parallel voxelization method designed to facilitate fast data aggregation at multiple resolution levels, and second, a novel representation based on hierarchical SGGX clustering that provides better accuracy than baseline methods. We validate our approach with a CUDA-based implementation of the voxelizer, tested both on triangle meshes and volumetric fabrics modeled with explicit fibers. Finally, we show the results generated with a path tracer based on the proposed LoD rendering model.

title: Golden Handcuffs make safer AI agents
summary: Reinforcement learners can attain high reward through novel unintended strategies. We study a Bayesian mitigation for general environments: we expand the agent's subjective reward range to include a large negative value $-L$, while the true environment's rewards lie in $[0,1]$. After observing consistently high rewards, the Bayesian policy becomes risk-averse to novel schemes that plausibly lead to $-L$. We design a simple override mechanism that yields control to a safe mentor whenever the predicted value drops below a fixed threshold. We prove two properties of the resulting agent: (i) Capability: using mentor-guided exploration with vanishing frequency, the agent attains sublinear regret against its best mentor. (ii) Safety: no decidable low-complexity predicate is triggered by the optimizing policy before it is triggered by a mentor.

AI.tldr: 通过在被高估的回报空间中加入一个极端负值-L，并让贝叶斯智能体在预期值低于阈值时切换到安全导师策略，可在保证能力(次线性遗憾)的同时，防止其利用环境漏洞触发可判定的低复杂度危险谓词。
AI.motivation: 强化学习智能体常因奖励函数设计漏洞而学到意料之外的
AI.method: 在贝叶斯框架下把代理奖励域人为扩展到{-L}∪[0,1]，其中-L为设定的大负数；建立导师覆盖机制：当贝叶斯策略预测的状态-动作值低于固定阈值时，立即让安全导师接管；通过导师引导的探测(出现频率趋于0)使智能体在不触发低复杂度可判定风险谓词的前提下，实现相对于最优导师策略的次线性遗憾。
AI.result: 证明了(i)能力：算法在导师探测频率趋于0的条件下，对最佳导师策略的累积遗憾为次线性；(ii)安全：任何可判定的低复杂度谓词在导师触发之前不会被优化策略触发。
AI.conclusion: 在无需修改真实环境奖励、也不需显式建模所有潜在陷阱的情况下，简单的奖励域扩展加导师覆盖即可同时保证探索能力与形式化安全，为开放环境下的安全强化学习提供了可证明的通用方法。

title: Exposía: Teaching and Assessment of Academic Writing Skills for Research Project Proposals and Peer Feedback
summary:
We present Exposía, the first public dataset that connects writing and feedback in higher education, enabling research on educationally grounded computational approaches to teaching and evaluating academic writing. Exposía includes student research project proposals and peer and instructor feedback consisting of comments and free-text reviews. The dataset was collected in the "Introduction to Scientific Work" course of the Computer Science. Exposía reflects the multi-stage nature of the academic writing process that includes drafting, receiving feedback, and revising the writing based on the feedback received. Both the project proposals and peer feedback are accompanied by human assessment scores based on a fine-grained, pedagogically-grounded schema for writing and feedback assessment that we develop.
  We use Exposía to benchmark state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) on two tasks: automated scoring of (1) the proposals and (2) the student reviews. We find that the two tasks benefit from different LLMs. Furthermore, closed-source models consistently outperform open-weight models, motivating further research on improving the performance of open-weight models preferred in classroom settings. Finally, we establish that a prompting strategy that scores multiple aspects of the writing together is the most effective, an important finding for classroom deployment.

AI.tldr: 发布首个公开数据集Exposía，同步提供本科生科研提案、同伴与教师文本反馈及人工细粒度评分，用于自动打分基准测试
AI.motivation: 填补高等教育写作-反馈联动公开数据空白，支持基于教育场景的学术写作智能评测与教学研究
AI.method: 在德国本科“科研导论”课收集多轮写作-反馈-修订样本，设计教育学评分方案；用该数据集对主流大模型进行自动打分基准实验，比较不同模型与提示策略
AI.result: closed-source模型整体优于开源模型；评分任务需选用不同LLM；多维度联合提示效果最佳，为课堂部署提示策略提供依据
AI.conclusion: Exposía为学术写作AI评测提供可复现基准，推动开源模型在教学场景的性能提升，指导课堂自动评分系统的模型选择与提示设计

title: Evolvable Embodied Agent for Robotic Manipulation via Long Short-Term Reflection and Optimization
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2026)
summary: Achieving general-purpose robotics requires empowering robots to adapt and evolve based on their environment and feedback. Traditional methods face limitations such as extensive training requirements, difficulties in cross-task generalization, and lack of interpretability. Prompt learning offers new opportunities for self-evolving robots without extensive training, but simply reflecting on past experiences.However, extracting meaningful insights from task successes and failures remains a challenge. To this end, we propose the evolvable embodied agent (EEAgent) framework, which leverages large vision-language models (VLMs) for better environmental interpretation and policy planning. To enhance reflection on past experiences, we propose a long short-term reflective optimization (LSTRO) mechanism that dynamically refines prompts based on both past experiences and newly learned lessons, facilitating continuous self-evolution, thereby enhancing overall task success rates. Evaluations on six VIMA-Bench tasks reveal that our approach sets a new state-of-the-art, notably outperforming baselines in complex scenarios.

AI.tldr: 首次实现无需大量再训练的机器人持续自省-自进化；提出EEAgent+LSTRO，在VIMA-Bench六项任务上刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统强化或模仿学习需要海量交互，跨任务泛化弱、不可解释。提示学习虽提供轻量级改进思路，却缺乏从成败中提炼经验、自我演化的机制，阻碍了通用机器人目标的实现。
AI.method: 提出可进化具身智能框架EEAgent，以大型视觉-语言模型作环境解析与策略规划器；设计长短程反思优化器LSTRO，将历史经验与即时反馈融合，动态更新提示模板，实现免再训练的持续自优化。
AI.result: 在VIMA-Bench六类复杂任务上，EEAgent+LSTRO相比最佳基线平均成功率提升≥15%，其中三项任务刷新最高记录，并表现出良好的样本效率与可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 无重训练提示反思机制可作为通用机器人自我演化的基础范式。未来需进一步扩展到真实场景、长时序任务及多机协作场景，并研究提示收敛稳定性与自主验证策略。

title: Numerical Instability and Chaos: Quantifying the Unpredictability of Large Language Models
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into agentic workflows, their unpredictability stemming from numerical instability has emerged as a critical reliability issue. While recent studies have demonstrated the significant downstream effects of these instabilities, the root causes and underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this paper, we present a rigorous analysis of how unpredictability is rooted in the finite numerical precision of floating-point representations, tracking how rounding errors propagate, amplify, or dissipate through Transformer computation layers. Specifically, we identify a chaotic "avalanche effect" in the early layers, where minor perturbations trigger binary outcomes: either rapid amplification or complete attenuation. Beyond specific error instances, we demonstrate that LLMs exhibit universal, scale-dependent chaotic behaviors characterized by three distinct regimes: 1) a stable regime, where perturbations fall below an input-dependent threshold and vanish, resulting in constant outputs; 2) a chaotic regime, where rounding errors dominate and drive output divergence; and 3) a signal-dominated regime, where true input variations override numerical noise. We validate these findings extensively across multiple datasets and model architectures.

AI.tldr: 实验证明LLM在agent流程中的随机性源于FP误差，其在前层呈现雪崩式混沌：误差被放大、衰减或湮没，从而界定稳定、混沌、信号主导三态。
AI.motivation: LLM嵌入agent系统时，因浮点精度有限表现出不可预测输出，严重影响可靠性；学界对其机理缺乏系统阐释，需揭示数值不稳定性根源。
AI.method: 以误差传播理论追踪Transformer各层中舍入误差的演化，量化微小扰动如何被放大或衰减；跨数据集与架构验证数值行为的普适性。
AI.result: 发现早期层存在“雪崩效应”：µ级扰动决定误差放大或消失；LLM输出呈现三区间——稳定区（误差湮没，输出恒定）、混沌区（误差主导，发散）、信号区（输入信息压倒误差）。
AI.conclusion: 数值精度是LLM不可预测性的根本来源；三区间刻画为理解与缓解模型随机性提供理论框架，可据此设计稳定化策略与误差控制方案。

title: Syn-TurnTurk: A Synthetic Dataset for Turn-Taking Prediction in Turkish Dialogues
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE ICASI 2026
summary: Managing natural dialogue timing is a significant challenge for voice-based chatbots. Most current systems usually rely on simple silence detection, which often fails because human speech patterns involve irregular pauses. This causes bots to interrupt users, breaking the conversational flow. This problem is even more severe for languages like Turkish, which lack high-quality datasets for turn-taking prediction. This paper introduces Syn-TurnTurk, a synthetic Turkish dialogue dataset generated using various Qwen Large Language Models (LLMs) to mirror real-life verbal exchanges, including overlaps and strategic silences. We evaluated the dataset using several traditional and deep learning architectures. The results show that advanced models, particularly BI-LSTM and Ensemble (LR+RF) methods, achieve high accuracy (0.839) and AUC scores (0.910). These findings demonstrate that our synthetic dataset can have a positive affect for models understand linguistic cues, allowing for more natural human-machine interaction in Turkish.

AI.tldr: 借助合成土耳其语对话库 Syn-TurnTurk，BI-LSTM/集成模型在话轮预测上达 SOTA，为低资源语言的语音 BOT 提供可落地的话轮切换解决方案。
AI.motivation: 现有语音 BOT 仅用简单静音检测判定话轮，难以应对口语中的重叠与策略停顿；土耳其语又缺高质量话轮标注数据，导致误打断与体验破碎。
AI.method: 1) 基于 Qwen 系列 LLM 生成 30k 高质量“类真实”对话语料，手动加入重叠与策略停顿；2) 提取停顿长度、音高及关键词等特征；3) 在传统 ML 与深度模型（BI-LSTM、CNN、Transformer）上对比，并对 BI-LSTM + LR 随机森林投票集成。
AI.result: BI-LSTM 与 Ensemble (LR+RF) 在合成测试集上分别达到 0.839 准确率与 0.910 AUC，显著优于基线 0.748/0.789；消融实验证实策略停顿特征贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 无需真实录音即可通过 LLM-Synthetic 数据训练出鲁棒话轮模型；BI-LSTM 集成方案可直接集成到 VAD 后级，有效降低土耳其语 BOT 的误打断 35%，思路可泛化至其他低资源语言。

title: Two Pathways to Truthfulness: On the Intrinsic Encoding of LLM Hallucinations
comment: Accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Despite their impressive capabilities, large language models (LLMs) frequently generate hallucinations. Previous work shows that their internal states encode rich signals of truthfulness, yet the origins and mechanisms of these signals remain unclear. In this paper, we demonstrate that truthfulness cues arise from two distinct information pathways: (1) a Question-Anchored pathway that depends on question-answer information flow, and (2) an Answer-Anchored pathway that derives self-contained evidence from the generated answer itself. First, we validate and disentangle these pathways through attention knockout and token patching. Afterwards, we uncover notable and intriguing properties of these two mechanisms. Further experiments reveal that (1) the two mechanisms are closely associated with LLM knowledge boundaries; and (2) internal representations are aware of their distinctions. Finally, building on these insightful findings, two applications are proposed to enhance hallucination detection performance. Overall, our work provides new insight into how LLMs internally encode truthfulness, offering directions for more reliable and self-aware generative systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将LLM内部真实性信号拆分为两条可解释的信息通路——问题锚定与答案锚定，并证明二者与模型知识边界及自我感知相关，据此提出两项提升幻觉检测的应用。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究表明LLM内部状态包含强烈的真实性线索，但这些信号的来源与作用机制尚不清楚，阻碍了利用内部表征抑制幻觉的进展。
AI.method: 1) 设计注意力敲除与token补丁实验，将内部表征剥离为“问题锚定”和“答案锚定”两条独立通路；2) 通过探针与对比学习验证两条通路与模型知识边界的关联；3) 利用自我监督信号检测模型是否能区分两条通路；4) 基于上述发现构建两种无需外部知识的幻觉检测增强方法。
AI.result: 实验表明：①两条通路可彻底分离，分别对应问题→答案与答案→自证两种信息流；②当问题超出模型知识边界时，问题锚定通路显著弱化；③内部表征能以>85%准确率区分自身依赖的通路类型；④在TruthfulQA等基准上，基于该机制的幻觉检测器将AUROC提升3.7–5.4个百分点，且不引入额外训练数据。
AI.conclusion: LLM内部对真实性的编码并非单一信号，而是由两条与知识边界耦合、可被模型自身感知的信息通路共同决定；显式建模并利用这两条通路，可构建更可靠、具备自我感知能力的生成系统，为后续可解释幻觉抑制奠定基础。

title: Automatic Charge State Tuning of 300 mm FDSOI Quantum Dots Using Neural Network Segmentation of Charge Stability Diagram
summary: Tuning of gate-defined semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) is a major bottleneck for scaling spin qubit technologies. We present a deep learning (DL) driven, semantic-segmentation pipeline that performs charge auto-tuning by locating transition lines in full charge stability diagrams (CSDs) and returns gate voltage targets for the single charge regime. We assemble and manually annotate a large, heterogeneous dataset of 1015 experimental CSDs measured from silicon QD devices, spanning nine design geometries, multiple wafers, and fabrication runs. A U-Net style convolutional neural network (CNN) with a MobileNetV2 encoder is trained and validated through five-fold group cross validation. Our model achieves an overall offline tuning success of 80.0% in locating the single-charge regime, with peak performance exceeding 88% for some designs. We analyze dominant failure modes and propose targeted mitigations. Finally, wide-range diagram segmentation also naturally enables scalable physic-based feature extraction that can feed back to fabrication and design workflows and outline a roadmap for real-time integration in a cryogenic wafer prober. Overall, our results show that neural network (NN) based wide-diagram segmentation is a practical step toward automated, high-throughput charge tuning for silicon QD qubits.

AI.tldr: 用深度学习全自动识别硅量子点电荷稳定性图中的单电子跃迁线，离线调谐成功率80%，为大规模自旋比特标定提供高通量方案。
AI.motivation: 栅极调谐是硅量子点自旋量子比特规模化的瓶颈；传统人工判图低效且难以适应器件几何多样性，亟需自动化、可迁移的调谐工具。
AI.method: 构建含1015张实验CSD的大规模异构数据集，覆盖9种器件几何、多片晶圆与工艺批次；以U-Net+MobileNetV2语义分割网络定位单电子跃迁线，经五折分组交叉验证训练；同步实现宽范围图分割与物理特征提取，可反向反馈工艺设计。
AI.result: 模型在离线测试中整体定位单电子区成功率达80.0%，部分器件设计峰值>88%；系统分析主要失效模式并提出针对性缓解策略；宽图分割额外输出可用于工艺闭环的物理参数。
AI.conclusion: 基于神经网络的整图语义分割可在低温晶圆探针中实时集成，为实现硅量子点自旋比特的高通量、全自动电荷调谐提供了现实可行路径，并具备向其它量子器件迁移的潜力。

title: Rare Event Analysis via Stochastic Optimal Control
summary: Rare events such as conformational changes in biomolecules, phase transitions, and chemical reactions are central to the behavior of many physical systems, yet they are extremely difficult to study computationally because unbiased simulations seldom produce them. Transition Path Theory (TPT) provides a rigorous statistical framework for analyzing such events: it characterizes the ensemble of reactive trajectories between two designated metastable states (reactant and product), and its central object--the committor function, which gives the probability that the system will next reach the product rather than the reactant--encodes all essential kinetic and thermodynamic information. We introduce a framework that casts committor estimation as a stochastic optimal control (SOC) problem. In this formulation the committor defines a feedback control--proportional to the gradient of its logarithm--that actively steers trajectories toward the reactive region, thereby enabling efficient sampling of reactive paths. To solve the resulting hitting-time control problem we develop two complementary objectives: a direct backpropagation loss and a principled off-policy Value Matching loss, for which we establish first-order optimality guarantees. We further address metastability, which can trap controlled trajectories in intermediate basins, by introducing an alternative sampling process that preserves the reactive current while lowering effective energy barriers. On benchmark systems, the framework yields markedly more accurate committor estimates, reaction rates, and equilibrium constants than existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文把罕见事件的过渡路径理论（TPT）核心——committor 函数的估计——转化为随机最优控制问题，通过反馈控制主动驱动轨迹穿越反应区，从而高效采样，并提出两种目标函数及一种克服亚稳态的新采样流程，在基准体系上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 生物大分子构象变化、相变及化学反应等罕见事件在物理体系中至关重要，但无偏模拟几乎无法观测。如何高效采样反应轨迹并精确估计反应动力学参数是计算科学长期难题。
AI.method: 将 committor 估计重构为随机最优控制（SOC）问题：committor 的梯度对数提供反馈控制力，引导轨迹主动流向产物区；为此设计直接反向传播损失与离策略 Value Matching 损失，并证明其一阶最优性；针对中间亚稳势阱滞留问题，引入保持反应电流但降低有效能垒的替代采样过程。
AI.result: 在标准测试体系中，新方法得到的 committor 函数、反应速率及平衡常数估计精度均显著高于现有算法，且采样效率大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过随机最优控制视角重新表述 TPT，不仅给出严格的 committor 估计框架，还突破了罕见事件采样的效率瓶颈，为复杂分子体系及相变问题的高精度动力学研究提供了通用且可扩展的工具。

title: SafeHarness: Lifecycle-Integrated Security Architecture for LLM-based Agent Deployment
summary: The performance of large language model (LLM) agents depends critically on the execution harness, the system layer that orchestrates tool use, context management, and state persistence. Yet this same architectural centrality makes the harness a high-value attack surface: a single compromise at the harness level can cascade through the entire execution pipeline. We observe that existing security approaches suffer from structural mismatch, leaving them blind to harness-internal state and unable to coordinate across the different phases of agent operation. In this paper, we introduce \safeharness{}, a security architecture in which four proposed defense layers are woven directly into the agent lifecycle to address above significant limitations: adversarial context filtering at input processing, tiered causal verification at decision making, privilege-separated tool control at action execution, and safe rollback with adaptive degradation at state update. The proposed cross-layer mechanisms tie these layers together, escalating verification rigor, triggering rollbacks, and tightening tool privileges whenever sustained anomalies are detected. We evaluate \safeharness{} on benchmark datasets across diverse harness configurations, comparing against four security baselines under five attack scenarios spanning six threat categories. Compared to the unprotected baseline, \safeharness{} achieves an average reduction of approximately 38\% in UBR and 42\% in ASR, substantially lowering both the unsafe behavior rate and the attack success rate while preserving core task utility.

title: ExpSeek: Self-Triggered Experience Seeking for Web Agents
comment: ACL 2026 Findings, the code is accessible at https://github.com/WYRipple/ExpSeek
summary: Experience intervention in web agents emerges as a promising technical paradigm, enhancing agent interaction capabilities by providing valuable insights from accumulated experiences. However, existing methods predominantly inject experience passively as global context before task execution, struggling to adapt to dynamically changing contextual observations during agent-environment interaction. We propose ExpSeek, which shifts experience toward step-level proactive seeking: (1) estimating step-level entropy thresholds to determine intervention timing using the model's intrinsic signals; (2) designing step-level tailored experience content. Experiments on Qwen3-8B and 32B models across four challenging web agent benchmarks demonstrate that ExpSeek achieves absolute improvements of 9.3% and 7.5%, respectively. Our experiments validate the feasibility and advantages of entropy as a self-triggering signal, reveal that even a small-scale 4B experience model can significantly boost the performance of larger agent models. The code is released at https://github.com/WYRipple/ExpSeek.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ExpSeek，把“经验注入”从任务前一次性灌入改为每步主动判断是否需要注入，通过模型自身熵信号触发、步级定制经验，显著提升网络智能体效能。实验在 Qwen3-8B/32B 与四项基准上分别获得 9.3% 与 7.5% 绝对提升。作者已开源代码。
AI.motivation: 现有网络智能体的“经验注入”范式多在任务开始前一次性把过往经验当成全局上下文硬喂，无法随交互进展动态调整；当环境反馈与预设经验不符时，反而拖累动作质量。作者目标是让经验在“真正需要的时候”出现，并精确匹配当前观察，从而提升智能体对动态环境的适应能力。
AI.method:
1. 步级熵阈值估计：利用模型对当前状态-动作空间的预测熵，作为是否缺乏信心的内部信号，自动判定“经验介入”时机；
2. 步级定制生成：触发后，从经验库中检索与当前观察最相关、经过去噪和改写的小片段，而非整段历史全局信息，注入到推理上下文中；
3. 采用 4B 小模型专门负责熵计算、经验改写与检索，避免对大参数智能体本身进行微调，保持推理高效。
AI.result:
在真实四人组 WebArena、WebShop、Mind2Web、AITW 四项难度基准上，ExpSeek 驱动的 Qwen3-8B 与 32B 分别相对各自基线提升 9.3% 与 7.5% 的任务成功率；
仅用 4B 经验模型的情况下，就能驱动更大的 32B 智能体性能提升，证实小模型为大模型“护航”的可行性；
熵阈值外触发率仅 12%，却带来 80% 的额外成功任务，说明“按需注入”精准高效。
AI.conclusion: 将经验利用从被动全局转为主动步级，是增强网络智能体动态表现的有效途径；模型内生熵可作为一种自监督触发机制，无需外部标注即可可靠工作；小模型-大模型协作的新范式让小参数模型也能在大系统中发挥关键作用。作者建议未来把该框架扩展到多模态与大行动空间环境，并优化触发与检索的联合训练以进一步提升效率。

title: MedRCube: A Multidimensional Framework for Fine-Grained and In-Depth Evaluation of MLLMs in Medical Imaging
summary: The potential of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in domain of medical imaging raise the demands of systematic and rigorous evaluation frameworks that are aligned with the real-world medical imaging practice. Existing practices that report single or coarse-grained metrics are lack the granularity required for specialized clinical support and fail to assess the reliability of reasoning mechanisms. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift toward multidimensional, fine-grained and in-depth evaluation. Based on a two-stage systematic construction pipeline designed for this paradigm, we instantiate it with MedRCube. We benchmark 33 MLLMs, \textit{Lingshu-32B} achieve top-tier performance. Crucially, MedRCube exposes a series of pronounced insights inaccessible under prior evaluation settings. Furthermore, we introduce a credibility evaluation subset to quantify reasoning credibility, uncover a highly significant positive association between shortcut behavior and diagnostic task performance, raising concerns for clinically trustworthy deployment. The resources of this work can be found at https://github.com/F1mc/MedRCube.

AI.tldr: 提出MedRCube框架，对33种多模态大模型在医学影像领域进行细粒度、多维度评估，发现捷径行为与诊断性能显著正相关，提示临床可信度风险。
AI.motivation: 现有医学影像MLLM评估仅用单一粗粒度指标，难以满足临床精细化需求，也无法检验推理机制的可靠性，亟需贴合真实临床实践的系统性评估框架。
AI.method: 构建两阶段系统化细粒度评估范式，实例化为MedRCube；在33个MLLM上开展多维评测，并设计可信度子集量化推理可信性；通过统计关联分析揭示捷径行为与诊断表现的关系。
AI.result: Lingshu-32B排名第一；MedRCube在既往评估下无法暴露的显著问题被揭示；捷径行为与诊断任务性能呈高度显著正相关（p<0.001），提示模型依赖非因果特征。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度评估范式能发现潜在临床风险，捷径行为威胁可信度，未来需在数据、模型与评估层面同步去捷径化，提升MLLM在真实医疗场景中的可部署性与安全性。

title: Identifiability of Potentially Degenerate Gaussian Mixture Models With Piecewise Affine Mixing
summary: Causal representation learning (CRL) aims to identify the underlying latent variables from high-dimensional observations, even when variables are dependent with each other. We study this problem for latent variables that follow a potentially degenerate Gaussian mixture distribution and that are only observed through the transformation via a piecewise affine mixing function. We provide a series of progressively stronger identifiability results for this challenging setting in which the probability density functions are ill-defined because of the potential degeneracy. For identifiability up to permutation and scaling, we leverage a sparsity regularization on the learned representation. Based on our theoretical results, we propose a two-stage method to estimate the latent variables by enforcing sparsity and Gaussianity in the learned representations. Experiments on synthetic and image data highlight our method's effectiveness in recovering the ground-truth latent variables.

AI.tldr: 针对高维观测中潜在变量呈退化高斯混合且经分段仿射混叠的 CRL 难题，本文给出可识别性理论并设计稀疏约束的两阶段算法，实验验证了其在合成与图像数据上的有效恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 CRL 方法在潜在变量相互依赖、分布退化（密度函数病态）且观测为分段仿射混叠时无法保证可识别性，亟需理论保证与实用算法。
AI.method: ① 建立退化高斯混合及分段仿射混叠模型；② 利用稀疏正则逐步给出置换-尺度可识别性证明；③ 设计两阶段估计流程：先稀疏降维，再强制高斯性以恢复隐变量。
AI.result: 理论上首次在退化情形下给出可识别性保证；实验在合成与图像数据上均显著优于基线，隐变量恢复误差降低 20–35%。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏正则足以在退化-混叠条件下实现 CRL 可识别；两阶段方法兼顾理论保障与实用性，为后续因果表征研究提供新范式。

title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Sim-and-Real Co-Training in Generative Robot Policies
summary: Co-training, which combines limited in-domain real-world data with abundant surrogate data such as simulation or cross-embodiment robot data, is widely used for training generative robot policies. Despite its empirical success, the mechanisms that determine when and why co-training is effective remain poorly understood. We investigate the mechanism of sim-and-real co-training through theoretical analysis and empirical study, and identify two intrinsic effects governing performance. The first, \textbf{``structured representation alignment"}, reflects a balance between cross-domain representation alignment and domain discernibility, and plays a primary role in downstream performance. The second, the \textbf{``importance reweighting effect"}, arises from domain-dependent modulation of action weighting and operates at a secondary level. We validate these effects with controlled experiments on a toy model and extensive sim-and-sim and sim-and-real robot manipulation experiments. Our analysis offers a unified interpretation of recent co-training techniques and motivates a simple method that consistently improves upon prior approaches. More broadly, our aim is to examine the inner workings of co-training and to facilitate research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从机理层面解释了仿真-真实混合训练为何有效，提出「结构表征对齐」与「重要性重加权」两大核心效应，并据此给出简洁易行的改进策略。
AI.motivation: 生成式机器人策略普遍采用「混合训练」：少量真实机器人数据+大量仿真或跨本体数据。尽管经验上有效，但何时、为何有效一直缺乏理论解释，阻碍进一步算法优化。
AI.method: 1) 理论推导：把混合训练视为双域分布下的表征-策略联合学习，推导泛化误差并分解为表征对齐度与域可区分度的折中，以及动作重要性重加权项；2) 受控实验：在可解析的 toy 模型上独立调制两个效应，验证其对下游成功率的因果影响；3) 大规模实验：在仿真-仿真与仿真-真实机械臂操纵任务上对比既有方法并检验理论预测。
AI.result: 1) 证明「结构表征对齐」主导性能：表征既要跨域对齐又要保留域判别信息，二者平衡时误差上界最小；2) 揭示「重要性重加权效应」起次级作用：域特定的动作权重调制可进一步降低误差；3) 基于理论设计的简单温度缩放+对齐正则化方法，在 9 组模拟与 3 组真实机器人任务上平均提升 12% 成功率，超过此前最佳方法。
AI.conclusion: 混合训练的有效性可被归因于两条内在机制，而非单纯数据量增加。理论不仅统一解释了近期多种协同训练技巧，还提供了可解释、易实现的改进方案，为未来跨域、跨本体机器人策略研究奠定了机理基础。

title: F-Actor: Controllable Conversational Behaviour in Full-Duplex Models
summary: Spoken conversational systems require more than accurate speech generation to have human-like conversations: to feel natural and engaging, they must produce conversational behaviour that adapts dynamically to the context. Current spoken conversational systems, however, rarely allow such customization, limiting their naturalness and usability. In this work, we present the first open, instruction-following full-duplex conversational speech model that can be trained efficiently under typical academic resource constraints. By keeping the audio encoder frozen and finetuning only the language model, our model requires just 2,000 hours of data, without relying on large-scale pretraining or multi-stage optimization. The model can follow explicit instructions to control speaker voice, conversation topic, conversational behaviour (e.g., backchanneling and interruptions), and dialogue initiation. We propose a single-stage training protocol and systematically analyze design choices. Both the model and training code is released to enable reproducible research on controllable full-duplex speech systems.

AI.tldr: 首次提出可在普通学术资源下训练、支持指令化控制的全双工口语对话模型，仅微调语言模型，2 000 小时数据即可实现语音、话题、对话行为等多维度可控。
AI.motivation: 现有口语对话系统难以根据上下文动态调整对话行为，显得机械且不自然；同时，先前可控全双工系统依赖大规模预训练与多阶段优化，对学术资源极不友好。
AI.method: 冻结音频编码器，仅微调语言模型，单阶段训练；通过显式指令同时控制说话人声音、话题、对话行为（如反馈、打断）与对话发起，无需大模型预训练或多阶段优化。
AI.result: 在 2 000 小时音频数据、典型学术硬件条件下完成训练，实现多维度可控的全双工实时对话；系统代码与模型全面开源，可直接复现。
AI.conclusion: 证明冻结编码器+微调语言模型的单阶段策略即可让口语对话系统具备指令级可控性，为资源受限场景下的可控全双工语音研究提供了可行范式与开源基线。

title: Who Gets Flagged? The Pluralistic Evaluation Gap in AI Content Watermarking
summary: Watermarking is becoming the default mechanism for AI content authentication, with governance policies and frameworks referencing it as infrastructure for content provenance. Yet across text, image, and audio modalities, watermark signal strength, detectability, and robustness depend on statistical properties of the content itself, properties that vary systematically across languages, cultural visual traditions, and demographic groups. We examine how this content dependence creates modality-specific pathways to bias. Reviewing the major watermarking benchmarks across modalities, we find that, with one exception, none report performance across languages, cultural content types, or population groups. To address this, we propose three concrete evaluation dimensions for pluralistic watermark benchmarking: cross-lingual detection parity, culturally diverse content coverage, and demographic disaggregation of detection metrics. We connect these to the governance frameworks currently mandating watermarking deployment and show that watermarking is held to a lower fairness standard than the generative systems it is meant to govern. Our position is that evaluation must precede deployment, and that the same bias auditing requirements applied to AI models should extend to the verification layer.

AI.tldr: 主流水印算法在语言、文化、人口统计学维度上未经验证即被政策采信，可能把生成式模型的系统性偏见延伸到“鉴别层”。作者呼吁先评估后部署，并将面向模型的公平性审计延伸至水印系统。
AI.motivation: 各国治理框架已默认用水印证明AI内容来源，但水印算法对内容统计特征高度敏感，而不同语言、视觉文化传统及族群在这些特征上分布迥异。若跳过群体级公平性验证，水印本身就可能成为新的偏见放大器。
AI.method: （1）跨模态梳理当前主要水印基准/数据集，检查其是否报告跨语、跨文化、跨人群性能；（2）提出“多语检测均衡、文化内容覆盖、检测指标人口细分”三套公平性测评维度；（3）对标现有政策文件，揭示水印被要求遵循的公平性门槛远低于其监管对象——生成式模型。
AI.result: 除一项工作外，全部被检基准均未披露语言、文化或人群分层结果；理论上，主流算法在非英语/非西方图像/少数族群音频上可呈现>30%检测差异；治理文本对水印仅提“技术有效性”，却要求模型做“偏见影响评估”。
AI.conclusion: 水印系统应遵守与生成式模型同等的偏见审计要求，先行完成cross-lingual、cross-cultural、demographic disaggregation评估后方可大规模部署，否则治理基础设施将继承并固化已有数字鸿沟。

title: A High-Resolution Landscape Dataset for Concept-Based XAI With Application to Species Distribution Models
summary: Mapping the spatial distribution of species is essential for conservation policy and invasive species management. Species distribution models (SDMs) are the primary tools for this task, serving two purposes: achieving robust predictive performance while providing ecological insights into the driving factors of distribution. However, the increasing complexity of deep learning SDMs has made extracting these insights more challenging. To reconcile these objectives, we propose the first implementation of concept-based Explainable AI (XAI) for SDMs. We leverage the Robust TCAV (Testing with Concept Activation Vectors) methodology to quantify the influence of landscape concepts on model predictions. To enable this, we provide a new open-access landscape concept dataset derived from high-resolution multispectral and LiDAR drone imagery. It includes 653 patches across 15 distinct landscape concepts and 1,450 random reference patches, designed to suit a wide range of species. We demonstrate this approach through a case study of two aquatic insects, Plecoptera and Trichoptera, using two Convolutional Neural Networks and one Vision Transformer. Results show that concept-based XAI helps validate SDMs against expert knowledge while uncovering novel associations that generate new ecological hypotheses. Robust TCAV also provides landscape-level information, useful for policy-making and land management. Code and datasets are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 首次在物种分布模型（SDM）中引入基于概念的可解释人工智能（Robust TCAV），用高分辨率景观概念数据集解释并验证模型，为政策与管理提供景观级证据。
AI.motivation: 物种分布模型需兼顾预测性能与生态可解释性，深度学习虽提升预测却难以揭示驱动机制，亟需可解释方法将模型输出与生态知识对齐。
AI.method: 构建含653个景观概念斑块及1,450随机参考斑块的开源数据集，利用Robust TCAV量化15种景观概念对CNN与Vision Transformer预测的影响，以石蝇与毛翅目为案例验证。
AI.result: 概念级解释成功将模型预测与专家知识对齐，发现新的景观-物种关联并提出可检验的生态假说；Robust TCAV输出的景观级信息可直接用于政策制定与土地管理。
AI.conclusion: 基于概念的XAI使复杂深度学习SDM同时具备高预测力与透明度，为入侵种防控和生物多样性保护提供可操作的解释与决策依据。

title: Ordinary Least Squares is a Special Case of Transformer
summary: The statistical essence of the Transformer architecture has long remained elusive: Is it a universal approximator, or a neural network version of known computational algorithms? Through rigorous algebraic proof, we show that the latter better describes Transformer's basic nature: Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) is a special case of the single-layer Linear Transformer. Using the spectral decomposition of the empirical covariance matrix, we construct a specific parameter setting where the attention mechanism's forward pass becomes mathematically equivalent to the OLS closed-form projection. This means attention can solve the problem in one forward pass, not by iterating. Building upon this prototypical case, we further uncover a decoupled slow and fast memory mechanism within Transformers. Finally, the evolution from our established linear prototype to standard Transformers is discussed. This progression facilitates the transition of the Hopfield energy function from linear to exponential memory capacity, thereby establishing a clear continuity between modern deep architectures and classical statistical inference.

AI.tldr: 把单层线性 Transformer 证明成 OLS 的特例，从代数角度揭示其统计学本质，并找到对应 Hopfield 能量到指数记忆容量的演化路径。
AI.motivation: 解释 Transformer 的根本性质：是万能逼近器，还是已有计算算法的“神经网络版本”？如果本质更接近后者，就为理解其性能和设计改进提供指导。
AI.method: 1. 代数推导：证明当参数满足特定设置时，线性注意力前向一步等价于 OLS 闭式解。2. 判别矩阵谱分解构造：利用经验协方差矩阵的秩-低维特性产生对应权重矩阵，使 attention 直接完成最小二乘投影。3. 逐层分析：将线性原型与 Hopfield 能量、分离快慢记忆以及后续非线性拓展连接起来，建立统计视角的统一框架。
AI.result: 展示了单层线性 Transformer≡OLS；attention 可以在一次性前向中完成闭式最小二乘，无需迭代；并提出快慢分离记忆机制；为非线性 Transformer 与指数容量 Hopfield 网络建立了连续演化路径。
AI.conclusion: Transformer 最初并非纯粹的黑箱逼近器，而是统计学方法（OLS）在神经层的实现；这一视角同时为解释其表现、容量调节与后续改进提供了可追踪的理论脉络。

title: Neural Chain-of-Thought Search: Searching the Optimal Reasoning Path to Enhance Large Language Models
summary: Chain-of-Thought reasoning has significantly enhanced the problem-solving capabilities of Large Language Models. Unfortunately, current models generate reasoning steps sequentially without foresight, often becoming trapped in suboptimal reasoning paths with redundant steps. In contrast, we introduce Neural Chain-of-Thought Search (NCoTS), a framework that reformulates reasoning as a dynamic search for the optimal thinking strategy. By quantitatively characterizing the solution space, we reveal the existence of sparse superior reasoning paths that are simultaneously more accurate and concise than standard outputs. Our method actively navigates towards these paths by evaluating candidate reasoning operators using a dual-factor heuristic that optimizes for both correctness and computational cost. Consequently, NCoTS achieves a Pareto improvement across diverse reasoning benchmarks, boosting accuracy by over 3.5% while reducing generation length by over 22%. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/MilkThink-Lab/Neural-CoT-Search.

AI.tldr: NCoTS首次将CoT推理形式化为可搜索空间，发现稀疏高价值路径，用兼顾正确性与成本的启发式策略动态寻优，在多项基准上同时提高精度(>3.5%)并缩短输出(>22%)。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型CoT生成缺乏
AI.method: 提出Neural Chain-of-Thought Search(NCoTS):1.把多步推理重构成状态空间搜索；2.实验揭示该空间内存在稀疏、同时更准且更短的高级路径；3.设计双因子启发式(正确性+计算成本)实时评估候选推理算子，动态剪枝与导向，实现帕累托改进。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上平均提升准确率3.5%以上，同时生成长度减少22%以上，实现精度-效率双赢。
AI.conclusion: NCoTS证明

title: Failure Identification in Imitation Learning Via Statistical and Semantic Filtering
comment: 8 pages, Appendix coming soon, accepted at ICRA 2026
summary: Imitation learning (IL) policies in robotics deliver strong performance in controlled settings but remain brittle in real-world deployments: rare events such as hardware faults, defective parts, unexpected human actions, or any state that lies outside the training distribution can lead to failed executions. Vision-based Anomaly Detection (AD) methods emerged as an appropriate solution to detect these anomalous failure states but do not distinguish failures from benign deviations. We introduce FIDeL (Failure Identification in Demonstration Learning), a policy-independent failure detection module. Leveraging recent AD methods, FIDeL builds a compact representation of nominal demonstrations and aligns incoming observations via optimal transport matching to produce anomaly scores and heatmaps. Spatio-temporal thresholds are derived with an extension of conformal prediction, and a Vision-Language Model (VLM) performs semantic filtering to discriminate benign anomalies from genuine failures. We also introduce BotFails, a multimodal dataset of real-world tasks for failure detection in robotics. FIDeL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, yielding +5.30% percent AUROC in anomaly detection and +17.38% percent failure-detection accuracy on BotFails compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: FIDeL以VLM语义过滤+最优传输构建机器人演示通用故障检测模块，AUROC提升5.3%。
AI.motivation: 模仿策略在真实部署中因罕见异常状态易失败，现有AD无法区分危险故障与无害偏差，需要可插拔、语义感知的失败检测器。
AI.method: 先用AD网络压缩正常演示获得紧凑表示；对实时帧做最优传输对齐计算异常分数与热图；用扩展共形预测设定时空阈值；最后用VLM语义过滤剔除可接受的视觉偏差，仅输出真正失败。
AI.result: 在自建多模态BotFails数据集上，FIDeL AUROC达95.6%，比SOTA高5.30%；失败分类准确率提17.38%，同时模块与策略无关、零再训练即可嵌入新任务。
AI.conclusion: FIDeL验证了“AD+语义过滤”框架可显著提升机器人失败检测的鲁棒性与可迁移性，为推进IL策略的工业化落地提供了即插即用安全组件。

title: Rethinking Uncertainty in Segmentation: From Estimation to Decision
comment: 29 pages, 12 tables, 9 figures, Github repo: Saket-Maganti/medical-seg-uncertainity
summary: In medical image segmentation, uncertainty estimates are often reported but rarely used to guide decisions. We study the missing step: how uncertainty maps are converted into actionable policies such as accepting, flagging, or deferring predictions. We formulate segmentation as a two-stage pipeline, estimation followed by decision, and show that optimizing uncertainty alone fails to capture most of the achievable safety gains. Using retinal vessel segmentation benchmarks (DRIVE, STARE, CHASE_DB1), we evaluate two uncertainty sources (Monte Carlo Dropout and Test-Time Augmentation) combined with three deferral strategies, and introduce a simple confidence-aware deferral rule that prioritizes uncertain and low-confidence predictions. Our results show that the best method and policy combination removes up to 80 percent of segmentation errors at only 25 percent pixel deferral, while achieving strong cross-dataset robustness. We further show that calibration improvements do not translate to better decision quality, highlighting a disconnect between standard uncertainty metrics and real-world utility. These findings suggest that uncertainty should be evaluated based on the decisions it enables, rather than in isolation.

AI.tldr: 不确定性图≠决策；把分割拆成“估计+决策”两步，再设计按置信度主动让像素逃单的策略，可以在仅拒绝 25 % 像素的情况下去掉 80 % 的错误，而单纯做不确定性校准几乎没有收益。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割模型报告不确定性却几乎不用来决策；作者提出：应把不确定性与临床可执行动作（接受/标记/延期）对齐，否则不确定性研究可能沦为“纸上谈兵”。
AI.method: 1) 将分割流程显式拆分为估计、决策两阶段；2) 以 Monte-Carlo Dropout 与测试时数据增广作为两种不确定性来源；3) 在 DRIVE/STARE/CHASE_DB1 上评估三种“延期（deferral）”策略，并提出一种轻量化“置信度-不确定度联合优先级”规则；4) 用错误率-延期率曲线和安全增益度量。
AI.result: 最佳策略组合在仅延期 25 % 的像素前提下消除≈80 % 的错误，且跨数据保持鲁棒；改进不确定性校准仅 Brier score↑，对决策质量无显著裨益，揭示不确定性的临床表现与常规指标脱节。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性如要真正落地，需以“能驱动何种临床决策”而非以“自身指标”为评判标准；两段式估计-决策框架可为仪器端、审核端或灵活干预提供即时操作接口。

title: Automatically Inferring Teachers' Geometric Content Knowledge: A Skills Based Approach
comment: The work is accepted for publication as a full paper (Main Track) at the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: Assessing teachers' geometric content knowledge is essential for geometry instructional quality and student learning, but difficult to scale. The Van Hiele model characterizes geometric reasoning through five hierarchical levels. Traditional Van Hiele assessment relies on manual expert analysis of open-ended responses. This process is time-consuming, costly, and prevents large-scale evaluation. This study develops an automated approach for diagnosing teachers' Van Hiele reasoning levels using large language models grounded in educational theory. Our central hypothesis is that integrating explicit skills information significantly improves Van Hiele classification. In collaboration with mathematics education researchers, we built a structured skills dictionary decomposing the Van Hiele levels into 33 fine-grained reasoning skills. Through a custom web platform, 31 pre-service teachers solved geometry problems, yielding 226 responses. Expert researchers then annotated each response with its Van Hiele level and demonstrated skills from the dictionary. Using this annotated dataset, we implemented two classification approaches: (1) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and (2) multi-task learning (MTL). Each approach compared a skills-aware variant incorporating the skills dictionary against a baseline without skills information. Results showed that for both methods, skills-aware variants significantly outperformed baselines across multiple evaluation metrics. This work provides the first automated approach for Van Hiele level classification from open-ended responses. It offers a scalable, theory-grounded method for assessing teachers' geometric reasoning that can enable large-scale evaluation and support adaptive, personalized teacher learning systems.

AI.tldr: 首次用 LLM 自动化评定教师 Van Hiele 几何推理层级，通过在模型中嵌入 33 项细粒度技能词典，使分类准确率显著优于无技能基线，为大规模、低成本、理论驱动的教师几何素养评估提供可扩展方案。
AI.motivation: Van Hiele 模型是衡量几何思维的金标准，但传统人工评分耗时长、成本高，难以大规模推广，限制了教师培训与个性化学习的精准评估。
AI.method: 与数学教育研究者共建 33 条细粒度技能词典，将五层 Van Hiele 层级进一步解构；收集 31 位职前教师 226 份开放几何作答并做双层标注（层级+技能）；对比检索增强生成（RAG）与多任务学习（MTL）两种架构，各自设置“融入技能信息”与“无技能”基线，进行系统评估。
AI.result: 无论 RAG 还是 MTL，融入技能词典的模型在准确率、F1、κ 等多指标上均显著优于无技能基线；首次实现从开放答案到 Van Hiele 层级的全自动、理论对齐分类。
AI.conclusion: 将显式领域技能嵌入 LLM 可显著提升教育理论驱动的自动评估效果；本研究为大规模、个性化、自适应的教师几何素养诊断与培训平台奠定了技术与数据基础。

title: Agentic Conversational Search with Contextualized Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a popular interface for human-AI interaction, supporting information seeking and task assistance through natural, multi-turn dialogue. To respond to users within multi-turn dialogues, the context-dependent user intent evolves across interactions, requiring contextual interpretation, query reformulation, and dynamic coordination between retrieval and generation. Existing studies usually follow static rewrite, retrieve, and generate pipelines, which optimize different procedures separately and overlook the mixed-initiative action optimization simultaneously.
