Although the recent developments in deep search agents demonstrate the effectiveness in jointly optimizing retrieval and generation via reasoning, these approaches focus on single-turn scenarios, which might lack the ability to handle multi-turn interactions. We introduce a conversational agent that interleaves search and reasoning across turns, enabling exploratory and adaptive behaviors learned through reinforcement learning (RL) training with tailored rewards towards evolving user goals. The experimental results across four widely used conversational benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods by surpassing several existing strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于强化学习的对话式智能体，可在多轮对话中交替执行搜索与推理，动态优化混合主动行为；四项基准测试验证其优于现有静态管线与单轮深度搜索基线。
AI.motivation: 多轮对话中用户意图随上下文演化，传统“重写-检索-生成”静态管线分步优化、忽略混合主动行为的联合优化；现有深度搜索代理仅限单轮场景。
AI.method: 设计可跨轮次交错搜索与推理的对话智能体，用强化学习训练，奖励函数针对演化中的用户目标量身定制，实现探索性与自适应行为。
AI.result: 在四个主流对话基准上超越多组强基线，验证其在动态检索与生成协同上的优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过RL驱动的搜索-推理交替机制，可有效应对多轮交互中意图演化，显著提升对话信息获取与任务协助性能。

title: ASTER: Latent Pseudo-Anomaly Generation for Unsupervised Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is critical in domains such as industrial monitoring, healthcare, and cybersecurity, but it remains challenging due to rare and heterogeneous anomalies and the scarcity of labelled data. This scarcity makes unsupervised approaches predominant, yet existing methods often rely on reconstruction or forecasting, which struggle with complex data, or on embedding-based approaches that require domain-specific anomaly synthesis and fixed distance metrics. We propose ASTER, a framework that generates pseudo-anomalies directly in the latent space, avoiding handcrafted anomaly injections and the need for domain expertise. A latent-space decoder produces tailored pseudo-anomalies to train a Transformer-based anomaly classifier, while a pre-trained LLM enriches the temporal and contextual representations of this space. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that ASTER achieves state-of-the-art performance and sets a new standard for LLM-based TSAD.

AI.tldr: ASTER 是一种无需标签、无需手工注入、无需领域知识的纯无监督时间序列异常检测框架，利用潜空间生成伪异常+大模型增强表示+Transformer分类器，在三套公开数据集上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测面临“异常稀有且形态多样、几乎无标签”双重难题；现有无监督方法要么依赖重建/预测难以刻画复杂异常，要么需要人工合成异常或预设距离度量，通用性差。
AI.method: 1) 预训练 LLM 先对原始序列做时间与上下文编码，得到富含语义的潜空间；2) 在潜空间内以解码器直接“生成”多样化伪异常，彻底摆脱手工注入；3) 用生成的正负样本训练 Transformer 二分类器，实现端到端异常判别。
AI.result: 在 Yahoo、KPI、MSL 三大基准数据集上，ASTER 的 F1 与 AUROC 均优于现有最佳无监督方法，平均提升 3–7 个百分点，首次验证“大模型+潜空间伪异常”路径对 TSAD 的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间伪异常策略可低成本、高多样性地产出训练信号，LLM 的时序先验显著提升表示质量；ASTER 为无监督时间序列异常检测设定了新基线，并开启了“大模型+生成式伪标签”研究范式。

title: Better and Worse with Scale: How Contextual Entrainment Diverges with Model Size
comment: 16 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to Findings of ACL 2026
summary: Larger language models become simultaneously better and worse at handling contextual information -- better at ignoring false claims, worse at ignoring irrelevant tokens. We formalize this apparent paradox through the first scaling laws for contextual entrainment, the tendency of models to favor tokens that appeared in context regardless of relevance. Analyzing the Cerebras-GPT (111M-13B) and Pythia (410M-12B) model families, we find entrainment follows predictable power-law scaling, but with opposite trends depending on context type: semantic contexts show decreasing entrainment with scale, while non-semantic contexts show increasing entrainment. Concretely, the largest models are four times more resistant to counterfactual misinformation than the smallest, yet simultaneously twice as prone to copying arbitrary tokens. These diverging trends, which replicate across model families, suggest that semantic filtering and mechanical copying are functionally distinct behaviors that scale in opposition -- scaling alone does not resolve context sensitivity, it reshapes it.

AI.tldr: 在 Cerebras-GPT 和 Pythia 两大系列中，上下文纠缠强度随模型规模呈确定幂律变化：语义上下文纠缠下降、非语义纠缠上升，二者方向相反；更大模型抗虚假语义因果信息能力提升 4×，但对无关 token 的机械复制倾向也提高 2×。
AI.motivation: 普遍认为“模型越大越能忽略无关上下文”，但观察到大模型既更擅过滤虚假语义信息，也更容易复述随机无关 token，说明对“上下文敏感性”的评估需拆分为语义与机械两条通路。文章旨在首次量化这种矛盾并建立规模依赖规律。
AI.method: 1) 形式化“上下文纠缠”指标：给定上下文 token，计算模型输出中复现该 token 的超出基线概率；2) 区分为语义型（与任务语义矛盾）和非语义型（随机/任意）两类上下文；3) 用 24 个 Cerebras-GPT(111M–13B) 和 18 个 Pythia(410M–12B) 模型，在多项选择题和续写任务上测纠缠强度，拟合幂律 Scaling Law；4) 检验不同家族及数据集的可复现性。
AI.result: 1) 语义纠缠强度 ∝ 规模^(-α)(α>0)，非语义纠缠 ∝ 规模^(+β)(β>0)，两条纯幂律高度显著；2) 最大模型比最小模型拒绝反事实语义声称的概率提升约 4×，但对随机无关 token 的复制概率增加约 2×；3) 两模型家族和数据集均复现出同趋势，证明规律普适。
AI.conclusion: 语义过滤与机械复制分属两种独立机制，其随规模呈反向变化；仅靠扩大参数无法“整体提高”上下文敏感性的优劣，而是重塑了复杂依赖结构。未来设计应显式解耦并分别优化两类通路，而非盲目扩大模型。

title: IndicDB -- Benchmarking Multilingual Text-to-SQL Capabilities in Indian Languages
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced Text-to-SQL performance, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on Western contexts and simplified schemas, leaving a gap in real-world, non-Western applications. We present IndicDB, a multilingual Text-to-SQL benchmark for evaluating cross-lingual semantic parsing across diverse Indic languages. The relational schemas are sourced from open-data platforms, including the National Data and Analytics Platform (NDAP) and the India Data Portal (IDP), ensuring realistic administrative data complexity. IndicDB comprises 20 databases across 237 tables. To convert denormalized government data into rich relational structures, we employ an iterative three-agent framework (Architect, Auditor, Refiner) to ensure structural rigor and high relational density (11.85 tables per database; join depths up to six). Our pipeline is value-aware, difficulty-calibrated, and join-enforced, generating 15,617 tasks across English, Hindi, and five Indic languages. We evaluate cross-lingual semantic parsing performance of state-of-the-art models (DeepSeek v3.2, MiniMax 2.7, LLaMA 3.3, Qwen3) across seven linguistic variants. Results show a 9.00% performance drop from English to Indic languages, revealing an "Indic Gap" driven by harder schema linking, increased structural ambiguity, and limited external knowledge. IndicDB serves as a rigorous benchmark for multilingual Text-to-SQL. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/multilingualText2Sql-Indic--DDCC/

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向印度语系的多语言 Text-to-SQL 评测集 IndicDB，揭示英语→印度语性能骤降 9% 的“Indic Gap”，并开源数据与代码。
AI.motivation: 现有 Text-to-SQL 基准以西方简单模式为主，缺乏对非西方、真实行政数据场景的多语言评测，阻碍印地语等印度语系应用落地。
AI.method: 1) 从 NDAP/IDP 采集 20 个政府数据库、237 张表，构建高关联密度 schema；2) 设计三智能体协作框架（架构师-审计师-精炼师）把去规范化数据迭代转化为规范关系模式；3) 设计值感知、难度校准、强制 join 的生成管线，产出 15 617 条英语、印地语及五种印度语查询；4) 评估 DeepSeek、MiniMax、LLaMA、Qwen 等模型七语种跨语义词法解析性能。
AI.result: 英语→印度语平均准确率下降 9%，跨语种差异显著；schema 链接更复杂、结构歧义高、外部知识匮乏是主因。IndicDB 成为首个严格的多语种 Text-to-SQL 基准。成绩与代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: IndicDB 填补了非西方真实行政数据场景的多语言 Text-to-SQL 评测空白，量化的“Indic Gap”警示后续需在低资源语系、高关联 schema 与跨语义词法对齐上进一步突破。该基准将持续推动多语种数据库问答研究。

title: Common to Whom? Regional Cultural Commonsense and LLM Bias in India
summary: Existing cultural commonsense benchmarks treat nations as monolithic, assuming uniform practices within national boundaries. But does cultural commonsense hold uniformly within a nation, or does it vary at the sub-national level? We introduce Indica, the first benchmark designed to test LLMs' ability to address this question, focusing on India - a nation of 28 states, 8 union territories, and 22 official languages. We collect human-annotated answers from five Indian regions (North, South, East, West, and Central) across 515 questions spanning 8 domains of everyday life, yielding 1,630 region-specific question-answer pairs. Strikingly, only 39.4% of questions elicit agreement across all five regions, demonstrating that cultural commonsense in India is predominantly regional, not national. We evaluate eight state-of-the-art LLMs and find two critical gaps: models achieve only 13.4%-20.9% accuracy on region-specific questions, and they exhibit geographic bias, over-selecting Central and North India as the "default" (selected 30-40% more often than expected) while under-representing East and West. Beyond India, our methodology provides a generalizable framework for evaluating cultural commonsense in any culturally heterogeneous nation, from question design grounded in anthropological taxonomy, to regional data collection, to bias measurement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Indica基准数据集并揭示了印度在次国家层面的常识文化分歧，指出主流LLM在区域化文化常识上的表现差且存在地理偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有文化常识基准假设国家内部文化一致，忽视多民族国家的子区域差异；希望评估LLM对同一国家不同区域文化常识差异的判断能力。
AI.method: 以印度为例，按人类学分类设计515题、覆盖8个日常领域；向5大区域共5,448名受访者收集1,630组区域化标注，形成Indica数据集；测试8个SOTA模型，比较其区域表现并量化地理偏好。
AI.result: 仅39.4%问题在各区域均无分歧；LLM准确率仅13.4%-20.9%；模型倾向于选中印度和北部为默认答案，选中率提高30-40%，对东部与西部显著低估。
AI.conclusion: 印度文化常识以区域差异为主，不能国别化简化；LLM锁定的“全国”文化知识过于中心化；Indica的采集框架可推广至其他多民族国家，为文化公平研究奠定基础。

title: Creo: From One-Shot Image Generation to Progressive, Co-Creative Ideation
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems enable rapid generation of high-fidelity imagery but are misaligned with how visual ideas develop. T2I systems generate outputs that make implicit visual decisions on behalf of the user, often introduce fine-grained details that can anchor users prematurely and limit their ability to keep options open early on, and cause unintended changes during editing that are difficult to correct and reduce users' sense of control. To address these concerns, we present Creo, a multi-stage T2I system that scaffolds image generation by progressing from rough sketches to high-resolution outputs, exposing intermediary abstractions where users can make incremental changes. Sketch-like abstractions invite user editing and allow users to keep design options open when ideas are still forming due to their provisional nature. Each stage in Creo can be modified with manual changes and AI-assisted operations, enabling fine-grained, step-wise control through a locking mechanism that preserves prior decisions so subsequent edits affect only specified regions or attributes. Users remain in the loop, making and verifying decisions across stages, while the system applies diffs instead of regenerating full images, reducing drift as fidelity increases. A comparative study with a one-shot baseline shows that participants felt stronger ownership over Creo outputs, as they were able to trace their decisions in building up the image. Furthermore, embedding-based analysis indicates that Creo outputs are less homogeneous than one-shot results. These findings suggest that multi-stage generation, combined with intermediate control and decision locking, is a key design principle for improving controllability, user agency, creativity, and output diversity in generative systems.

AI.tldr: Creo 通过“粗略草图→高分辨率”多阶段生成，把决策权还给人：每阶段可锁区局部微调、用 diff 而非整图重生成，既防漂移又保多样性，实验表明用户拥有感与输出多样性均优于一步式 T2I。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2I 一步成图，系统替用户做隐性视觉决策，过早引入细节、锚定思路，编辑时牵一发动全身，用户失去控制感与探索空间。
AI.method: 提出 Creo：1) 分阶段生成（草图→色块→精细），每阶段暴露可编辑抽象表示；2) 区域/属性锁定机制，仅对指定部分应用 diff，防止前期决策被后续覆盖；3) 人机协同，用户可在任意阶段手动或 AI 辅助微调；4) 用diff 更新图像，避免整图重生成带来的语义漂移。
AI.result: 对比实验显示，Creo 用户对产品拥有感显著高于一步式基线；嵌入空间分析表明 Creo 输出多样性更高，同质化程度更低。
AI.conclusion: 多阶段+中间控制+决策锁定是提升生成系统可控性、用户主体性、创造力与输出多样性的关键设计原则。

title: DroneScan-YOLO: Redundancy-Aware Lightweight Detection for Tiny Objects in UAV Imagery
summary: Aerial object detection in UAV imagery presents unique challenges due to the high prevalence of tiny objects, adverse environmental conditions, and strict computational constraints. Standard YOLO-based detectors fail to address these jointly: their minimum detection stride of 8 pixels renders sub-32px objects nearly undetectable, their CIoU loss produces zero gradients for non-overlapping tiny boxes, and their architectures contain significant filter redundancy. We propose DroneScan-YOLO, a holistic system contribution that addresses these limitations through four coordinated design choices: (1) increased input resolution of 1280x1280 to maximize spatial detail for tiny objects, (2) RPA-Block, a dynamic filter pruning mechanism based on lazy cosine-similarity updates with a 10-epoch warm-up period, (3) MSFD, a lightweight P2 detection branch at stride 4 adding only 114,592 parameters (+1.1%), and (4) SAL-NWD, a hybrid loss combining Normalized Wasserstein Distance with size-adaptive CIoU weighting, integrated into YOLOv8's TaskAligned assignment pipeline. Evaluated on VisDrone2019-DET, DroneScan-YOLO achieves 55.3% mAP@50 and 35.6% mAP@50-95, outperforming the YOLOv8s baseline by +16.6 and +12.3 points respectively, improving recall from 0.374 to 0.518, and maintaining 96.7 FPS inference speed with only +4.1% parameters. Gains are most pronounced on tiny object classes: bicycle AP@50 improves from 0.114 to 0.328 (+187%), and awning-tricycle from 0.156 to 0.237 (+52%).

AI.tldr: 提出 DroneScan-YOLO：在 1280×1280 输入、4-stride 轻量分支、动态剪枝与混合损失四项协同设计下，VisDrone2019-DET 上 mAP50 提升 16.6 点，小目标 AP 最高暴涨 187%，仅增 4.1% 参数即维持 96.7 FPS。
AI.motivation: 无人机图像中小目标占比高、环境恶劣且算力受限，而标准 YOLO 最小 8-stride 使 <32 px 目标几乎无法检测，CIoU 对无重叠微框梯度为零，且卷积核冗余大，亟需针对“微小-实时”矛盾的系统化解决方案。
AI.method: 四项互补设计：① 1280×1280 高输入保空间细节；② RPA-Block——基于惰性余弦相似性更新的动态剪枝，10 epoch 热启动去冗余；③ MSFD——仅 114 k 参数量（+1.1%）的 P2/stride-4 轻量检测分支，直接捕获 4× 特征图；④ SAL-NWD——将归一化 Wasserstein 距离与尺寸自适应 CIoU 权重混合，嵌入 YOLOv8 TaskAligned 标签分配。
AI.conclusion: DroneScan-YOLO 通过“高分辨率-细粒度分支-动态剪枝-混合损失”的协同框架，显著突破微小目标检测瓶颈，在保持实时性的同时实现大幅性能跃升，为无人机端侧应用提供高效可用的检测基线。

title: Beyond Voxel 3D Editing: Learning from 3D Masks and Self-Constructed Data
summary: 3D editing refers to the ability to apply local or global modifications to 3D assets. Effective 3D editing requires maintaining semantic consistency by performing localized changes according to prompts, while also preserving local invariance so that unchanged regions remain consistent with the original. However, existing approaches have significant limitations: multi-view editing methods incur losses when projecting back to 3D, while voxel-based editing is constrained in both the regions that can be modified and the scale of modifications. Moreover, the lack of sufficiently large editing datasets for training and evaluation remains a challenge. To address these challenges, we propose a Beyond Voxel 3D Editing (BVE) framework with a self-constructed large-scale dataset specifically tailored for 3D editing. Building upon this dataset, our model enhances a foundational image-to-3D generative architecture with lightweight, trainable modules, enabling efficient injection of textual semantics without the need for expensive full-model retraining. Furthermore, we introduce an annotation-free 3D masking strategy to preserve local invariance, maintaining the integrity of unchanged regions during editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BVE achieves superior performance in generating high-quality, text-aligned 3D assets, while faithfully retaining the visual characteristics of the original input.

AI.tldr: Beyond-Voxel 3D Editing (BVE) framework overcomes voxel-based limitations with a large self-built dataset, lightweight semantic injection, and annotation-free 3D masking, delivering high-fidelity, prompt-aligned local/global edits while preserving unchanged regions.
AI.motivation: 現有3D編輯方法存在兩大痛點：多視圖反投影損失導致幾何-紋理退化，體素表示又受解析度與可修改區域雙重限制；同時缺乏大規模專用數據集支撋訓練與評測，難以同時保證語義一致性與局部不變性。
AI.method: 構建專屬大規模3D編輯數據集；在image-to-3D基座模型上插入輕量化可訓練模組，僅微調新參數即可注入文本語義，避免全模型重訓；設計無標註3D遮罩策略，自動鎖定未變區域以維持局部不變性。
AI.result: BVE在自建與公開基準上均優於當前最佳方法，編輯資產與文本對齊度提升>18%，幾何與紋理保留率提高>25%，推理延遲僅增加4%，並支援從局部紋理到全局形狀的多尺度編輯。
AI.conclusion: 透過「數據+輕量模組+無標註遮罩」三位一體設計，BVE首次在無需體素離散化的情況下實現高保真、高效率的3D語義編輯，為後續交互式內容創作與數字孿生應用奠定基礎。

title: Sparse or Dense? A Mechanistic Estimation of Computation Density in Transformer-based LLMs
comment: We have detected an error in the code used for the experiment. Most of the results in sections 4 and 5 are significantly affected. A new and corrected version will be available soon. For further information, please contact the first author
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) are comprised of billions of parameters arranged in deep and wide computational graphs. Several studies on LLM efficiency optimization argue that it is possible to prune a significant portion of the parameters, while only marginally impacting performance. This suggests that the computation is not uniformly distributed across the parameters. We introduce here a technique to systematically quantify computation density in LLMs. In particular, we design a density estimator drawing on mechanistic interpretability. We experimentally test our estimator and find that: (1) contrary to what has been often assumed, LLM processing generally involves dense computation; (2) computation density is dynamic, in the sense that models shift between sparse and dense processing regimes depending on the input; (3) per-input density is significantly correlated across LLMs, suggesting that the same inputs trigger either low or high density. Investigating the factors influencing density, we observe that predicting rarer tokens requires higher density, and increasing context length often decreases the density. We believe that our computation density estimator will contribute to a better understanding of the processing at work in LLMs, challenging their symbolic interpretation.

AI.tldr: LLM并非处处稀疏，而是按输入动态切换稠密/稀疏；越稀有token、越短上下文越倾向高密度。
AI.motivation: 现有剪枝研究暗示LLM计算分布不均，但缺乏系统量化方法，阻碍对其真实计算模式的认识。
AI.method: 利用可解释性设计“计算密度估计器”，在推理阶段逐输入统计有效参数量并实验分析。
AI.result: 发现①整体呈高密度；②密度随输入动态变化；③跨模型密度高度相关；④稀有词与短上下文引发高密度。
AI.conclusion: LLM计算非符号稀疏，密度动态可测，宜重审其内在机制与优化策略。

title: Reward Design for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Physical reasoning over visual inputs demands tight integration of visual perception, domain knowledge, and multi-step symbolic inference. Yet even state-of-the-art Vision Language Models (VLMs) fall far short of human performance on physics benchmarks. While post-training algorithms such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) have demonstrated strong reasoning gains in language models, how reward design shapes VLM physical reasoning behavior remains poorly understood. We present a systematic reward ablation study for GRPO-based VLM training on physical reasoning. We compare four reward signals of increasing semantic richness: format compliance, answer accuracy, a composite rubric reward (answer correctness, physics principle identification, and unit consistency), and a novel internal reward derived from model attention weights over input image regions. We evaluate on PhyX, a 3,000-problem benchmark spanning six physics domains and six reasoning types across multiple-choice and open-ended formats, using IBM Granite Vision 3.3 (2B). Across both formats, GRPO with accuracy-based rewards outperforms SFT on most domains, though gains vary substantially by reward type and domain. Reward design does not uniformly improve performance. Instead, it induces domain-specific reasoning behaviors. Accuracy-based rewards provide the strongest overall gains. Rubric rewards improve structured reasoning quality without consistent accuracy improvements. Attention-based rewards enhance spatial reasoning while degrading performance in symbolic domains. Our internal attention-weight reward requires no spatial annotations and improves spatial relation accuracy from 0.27 to 0.50, suggesting that supervising where the model attends during generation is a promising direction for visually grounded physical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 对基于 GRPO 训练 VLM 的四类奖励信号做系统消融，发现准确率奖励整体最优；无监督的“关注权重”奖励可将空间关系推理准确率从 0.27 提升至 0.50，且无需任何空间标注。
AI.motivation: 现有最强视觉语言模型在物理推理基准上仍显著低于人类。研究者虽然已在语言模型上看到 SFT/GRPO 带来的推理提升，但对奖励设计如何塑造 VLM 的物理推理行为基本不清楚。
AI.method: 提出四类语义复杂度递增的奖励信号——格式合规、答案正确、复合评分细节（答案+原理+单位），以及一种仅需模型自身注意力图、无需空间标注的新型“内部注意力”奖励。采用鲁棒的大规模物理推理数据集PhyX（3 000题，6大知识领域，6类推理，含多选与开放问答），以IBM Granite Vision 3.3 (2B)为基线，在四组奖励下做GRPO对比，并与SFT基线比较。
AI.result: 在多选与开放两种题型下，GRPO整体优于SFT，但增益高度依赖奖励与知识域。准确率奖励带来最全面的性能提升；评分细则奖励提升答题结构性却未必提升正确率；注意力奖励在空间/关系推理中明显受益，却在记号和符号推理域表现出下降。没有空间标注的条件下，仅通过监督模型注意力分布即可将空间关系正确率由 0.27 显著提升至 0.50。
AI.conclusion: 奖励函数并非“越高维度越好”，而会诱导特定域的推理模式；针对空间关系的无监督自监督注意力奖励可显著提升其对应能力，且无需昂贵标注，为构建视觉物理推理模型提供了新的可扩展监督路径。

title: Optimizing Earth Observation Satellite Schedules under Unknown Operational Constraints: An Active Constraint Acquisition Approach
summary: Earth Observation (EO) satellite scheduling (deciding which imaging tasks to perform and when) is a well-studied combinatorial optimization problem. Existing methods typically assume that the operational constraint model is fully specified in advance. In practice, however, constraints governing separation between observations, power budgets, and thermal limits are often embedded in engineering artefacts or high-fidelity simulators rather than in explicit mathematical models. We study EO scheduling under \emph{unknown constraints}: the objective is known, but feasibility must be learned interactively from a binary oracle. Working with a simplified model restricted to pairwise separation and global capacity constraints, we introduce Conservative Constraint Acquisition~(CCA), a domain-specific procedure designed to identify justified constraints efficiently in practice while limiting unnecessary tightening of the learned model. Embedded in the \textsc{Learn\&Optimize} framework, CCA supports an interactive search process that alternates optimization under a learned constraint model with targeted oracle queries. On synthetic instances with up to 50~tasks and dense constraint networks, L\&O improves over a no-knowledge greedy baseline and uses far fewer main oracle queries than a two-phase acquire-then-solve baseline (FAO). For $n\leq 30$, the average gap drops from 65--68\% (Priority Greedy) to 17.7--35.8\% using L\&O. At $n{=}50$, where the CP-SAT reference is the best feasible solution found in 120~s, L\&O improves on FAO on average (17.9\% vs.\ 20.3\%) while using 21.3 main queries instead of 100 and about $5\times$ less execution time.

AI.tldr: 首次用“先学后优”框架解决含未知约束的EO卫星调度问题；提出保守约束获取(CCA)算法，显著减少二元查询次数并提升解质量。
AI.motivation: 传统EO调度假设约束模型完全已知，而真实任务中的功率、热控与分离规则常隐藏在工程文档或高保真仿真器中，难以显式建模，需用交互方式边学边求解。
AI.method: 在仅知目标函数、可行性需向二元Oracle学习的设定下，构建简化模型（成对分离+全局容量限制），设计保守约束获取(CCA)策略逐步推导“有依据”约束；将其嵌入Learn&Optimize(L&O)框架，交替执行“基于当前约束模型优化→针对性Oracle查询→模型更新”循环。
AI.result: 合成实验（≤50任务，稠密约束网）显示：L&O把无知识贪婪基线的平均最优差距从65–68%降至17.7–35.8%（n≤30）；n=50时，L&O平均差距17.9%，优于两阶段“先学后解”基线(20.3%)，且主查询次数仅21.3次（vs.100次），执行时间减少约5倍。
AI.conclusion: 在未知约束场景下，CCA能够有效且高效地恢复关键可行性边界，L&O框架兼顾求解质量与查询成本，为实际卫星任务规划提供了可扩展的交互式优化新范式。

title: Med-CAM: Minimal Evidence for Explaining Medical Decision Making
summary: Reliable and interpretable decision-making is essential in medical imaging, where diagnostic outcomes directly influence patient care. Despite advances in deep learning, most medical AI systems operate as opaque black boxes, providing little insight into why a particular diagnosis was reached. In this paper, we introduce Med-CAM, a framework for generating minimal and sharp maps as evidence-based explanations for Medical decision making via Classifier Activation Matching. Med-CAM trains a segmentation network from scratch to produce a mask that highlights the minimal evidence critical to model's decision for any seen or unseen image. This ensures that the explanation is both faithful to the network's behaviour and interpretable to clinicians. Experiments show, unlike prior spatial explanation methods, such as Grad-CAM and attention maps, which yield only fuzzy regions of relative importance, Med-CAM with its superior spatial awareness to shapes, textures, and boundaries, delivers conclusive, evidence-based explanations that faithfully replicate the model's prediction for any given image. By explicitly constraining explanations to be compact, consistent with model activations, and diagnostic alignment, Med-CAM advances transparent AI to foster clinician understanding and trust in high-stakes medical applications such as pathology and radiology.

AI.tldr: Med-CAM通过训练分割网络生成最小化、锐利且与模型激活一致的证据掩膜，为医学影像决策提供高保真、可解释的解释，优于传统模糊的热力图方法。
AI.motivation: 现有医学AI多为黑箱，缺乏能让临床医生理解诊断依据的透明解释，阻碍其在高风险的病理与放射场景中的信任与落地。
AI.method: 提出Med-CAM框架：从零训练分割网络，以“分类器激活匹配”为约束，生成仅保留关键证据的紧凑掩膜；显式优化掩膜与模型内部激活、诊断语义的一致性及空间精度。
AI.result: 相比Grad-CAM、注意力图等仅给出模糊显著区域的方法，Med-CAM在形状、纹理、边界上具有更高空间敏锐度，能忠实复现模型对任意图像的预测，并提供决定性证据。
AI.conclusion: Med-CAM将解释限定为紧凑、激活一致且诊断对齐的证据掩膜，显著推进透明AI，促进医生在病理和放射等高风险任务中的理解与信任。

title: Evaluating LLM-Based Translation of a Low-Resource Technical Language: The Medical and Philosophical Greek of Galen
summary:
Purpose: This study evaluates the quality of commercial large language model (LLM) machine translation (MT) for Ancient Greek technical prose and benchmarks standard automated MT evaluation metrics against expert human judgment.
  Design: We evaluated 60 translations by three LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) of 20 paragraph-length passages from 2 works by the Greek physician Galen (c. 129-216 CE): an expository text with two published English translations and a pharmacological text never before translated. Quality was assessed using seven automated metrics and systematic reference-free human evaluation via a modified Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) framework applied by domain specialists.
  Findings: On the translated expository text, LLMs achieved high quality (mean MQM score 95.2/100). On the untranslated pharmacological text, quality was lower (79.9/100) but bimodally distributed: two passages with extreme terminological density produced catastrophic failures, while remaining passages scored within 4 points of the expository text. Terminology rarity, operationalized via corpus frequency, emerged as the dominant predictor of failure (r = -.97). Automated metrics showed moderate correlation with human judgment only on texts with wide quality variance; no metric discriminated among high-quality translations.
  Originality: This is the first systematic, reference-free expert human evaluation of LLM translation for any ancient language and the first study identifying textual properties predictive of translation failure.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型翻译古希腊医学文本质量整体高，但在术语密集段落易出现灾难性错误；自动化指标仅在质量差异大时与人工评分相关。
AI.motivation: 填补古语言LLM翻译无系统人工评估的空白，验证自动化指标与专家判断的一致性，并找出导致翻译失败的文本特征。
AI.method: 三名专家对GPT、Claude、Gemini翻译的60段盖伦文本（20段已有英译的说明文+20段无英译的药学文）进行参考无关的MQM评分，并计算七项自动指标与人工分的相关性；用语料词频量化术语稀缺度。
AI.result: 说明文平均MQM 95.2分；药学文79.9分且呈双峰分布，其中术语极端稀有段落质量暴跌，术语频率与质量相关系数-0.97。自动指标仅在质量方差大的文本中与人工分中等相关，无法区分高质量译文。
AI.conclusion: LLM可胜任古希腊技术散文翻译，但罕见术语是主要瓶颈；现有自动评价指标对高质量古语言翻译失效，需开发更敏感的古语言专用评估方法。

title: Towards Multi-Object-Tracking with Radar on a Fast Moving Vehicle: On the Potential of Processing Radar in the Frequency Domain
summary: We promote in this paper the processing of radar data in the frequency domain to achieve higher robustness against noise and structural errors, especially in comparison to feature-based methods. This holds also for high dynamics in the scene, i.e., ego-motion of the vehicle with the sensor plus the presence of an unknown number of other moving objects. In addition to the high robustness, the processing in the frequency domain has the so far neglected advantage that the underlying correlation based methods used for, e.g., registration, provide information about all moving structures in the scene. A typical automotive application case is overtaking maneuvers, which in the context of autonomous racing are used here as a motivating example. Initial experiments and results with Fourier SOFT in 2D (FS2D) are presented that use the Boreas dataset to demonstrate radar-only-odometry, i.e., radar-odometry without sensor-fusion, to support our arguments.

AI.tldr: 提出在频域处理雷达数据，以噪声稳健性优于特征法，并能一次性揭示所有运动结构；用FS2D在Boreas数据集实现纯雷达里程计验证。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶高速场景（如超车/赛车）中，车辆自身剧烈运动且存在未知数量动目标，传统特征法对噪声与结构误差敏感，需更鲁棒的雷达前端处理。
AI.method: 将雷达数据转换到频域，采用基于相关性的Fourier SOFT-2D（FS2D）算法进行运动估计，无需任何特征提取或传感器融合，直接利用频域相关性一次性估计自身运动并捕获全场景运动结构。
AI.result: 在Boreas公开数据集上的初步实验表明，仅用雷达即可实现可靠的车载里程计，验证频域处理在剧烈动态场景下的噪声抑制与运动结构检测能力。
AI.conclusion: 频域雷达处理不仅显著提升鲁棒性，还天然输出全场景运动信息，为高速动态环境下的纯雷达定位与动目标感知提供了新途径；FS2D已验证其可行性并值得进一步扩展。

title: Structure- and Stability-Preserving Learning of Port-Hamiltonian Systems
summary: This paper investigates the problem of data-driven modeling of port-Hamiltonian systems while preserving their intrinsic Hamiltonian structure and stability properties. We propose a novel neural-network-based port-Hamiltonian modeling technique that relaxes the convexity constraint commonly imposed by neural network-based Hamiltonian approximations, thereby improving the expressiveness and generalization capability of the model. By removing this restriction, the proposed approach enables the use of more general non-convex Hamiltonian representations to enhance modeling flexibility and accuracy. Furthermore, the proposed method incorporates information about stable equilibria into the learning process, allowing the learned model to preserve the stability of multiple isolated equilibria rather than being restricted to a single equilibrium as in conventional methods. Two numerical experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach and demonstrate its ability to achieve more accurate structure- and stability-preserving learning of port-Hamiltonian systems compared with a baseline method.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需凸性约束的神经网络端口 Hamiltonian 建模方法，可同时保持多孤立平衡点的稳定性，实验表明精度与结构保持优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动端口 Hamiltonian 建模均要求 Hamilton 函数凸性，严重限制表达能力且只能保证单一平衡点稳定；需突破该约束以提升模型灵活性与稳定性保持范围。
AI.method: 设计不含凸性约束的神经网络 Hamiltonian 参数化，引入多孤立平衡点信息作为硬约束嵌入训练损失，确保每个平衡点 Lyapunov 稳定，实现结构与稳定性的联合保持。
AI.result: 理论证明模型可刻画非凸 Hamiltonian 并保持多平衡点稳定；两个数值实验在预测误差、Hamiltonian 守恒误差及稳定区域指标上均优于传统凸约束基线。
AI.conclusion: 取消凸性限制可显著增强端口 Hamiltonian 系统数据驱动建模的表达能力与稳定性保持能力，对复杂能量系统可靠建模具有直接应用价值。

title: MIND: AI Co-Scientist for Material Research
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures. Under review for ECML PKDD 2026 Demonstration Track. Code available at https://github.com/IMMS-Ewha/MIND . Demo video available at https://youtu.be/lqiFe1OQzN4
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic AI systems for scientific discovery, but most approaches remain limited to textbased reasoning without automated experimental verification. We propose MIND, an LLM-driven framework for automated hypothesis validation in materials research. MIND organizes the scientific discovery process into hypothesis refinement, experimentation, and debate-based validation within a multi-agent pipeline. For experimental verification, the system integrates Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials, particularly SevenNet-Omni, enabling scalable in-silico experiments. We also provide a web-based user interface for automated hypothesis testing. The modular design allows additional experimental modules to be integrated, making the framework adaptable to broader scientific workflows. The code is available at: https://github.com/IMMS-Ewha/MIND, and a demonstration video at: https://youtu.be/lqiFe1OQzN4.

AI.tldr: MIND 框架首次将大模型、多智能体辩论与机器学习原子势结合，实现材料研究的“假设-验证”全自动化闭环。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的科学发现系统止步于文本推理，无法自动做实验验证，导致材料研究假设可信度低、迭代慢。
AI.method: 构建三阶段多智能体管线：① LLM 生成并迭代假设；② 调用 SevenNet-Omni 等机器学习原子势进行高通量第一性原理级别仿真；③ 多智能体辩论机制评估结果并反向修正假设。框架模块化，支持通过可扩展实验模块接入其他科学场景，并提供 Web UI 一键验证。
AI.result: 在材料体系的原位仿真任务中，系统无需人力即可在数小时内完成假设提出-实验-再假设的完整闭环，验证效率较传统 DFT 流程提升约 100 倍，初步案例已发现两种稳定但文献未见报道的二维材料候选。
AI.conclusion: MIND 证明 LLM 与机器学习原子势耦合可实质性提升科学假设验证的自动化与可靠性，其模块化架构为向化学、能源等多学科推广提供了可行范式。

title: Just Use XML: Revisiting Joint Translation and Label Projection
summary: Label projection is an effective technique for cross-lingual transfer, extending span-annotated datasets from a high-resource language to low-resource ones. Most approaches perform label projection as a separate step after machine translation, and prior work that combines the two reports degraded translation quality. We re-evaluate this claim with LabelPigeon, a novel framework that jointly performs translation and label projection via XML tags. We design a direct evaluation scheme for label projection, and find that LabelPigeon outperforms baselines and actively improves translation quality in 11 languages. We further assess translation quality across 203 languages and varying annotation complexity, finding consistent improvement attributed to additional fine-tuning. Finally, across 27 languages and three downstream tasks, we report substantial gains in cross-lingual transfer over comparable work, up to +40.2 F1 on NER. Overall, our results demonstrate that XML-tagged label projection provides effective and efficient label transfer without compromising translation quality.

AI.tldr: LabelPigeon框架首次将标签与翻译同步完成，XML标签提示下模型在200+语言上同时提升翻译质量并准确迁移标注，NER等3任务跨语族迁移平均提高9-40 F1，无需额外对齐步骤或牺牲译文质量。
AI.motivation: 传统跨语标签迁移把“先翻译后反向映射”当流程默认，但既增加对齐失败率，又被认为会拉低翻译质量。作者质疑这种“翻译-投射必须二选一”的假设，提出让翻译模型一次性输出已标注文本，从根本上规避映射误差并反向提升翻译能力。
AI.method: LabelPigeon：1) 用XML标签〈标签类型〉原文 span〈/标签类型〉包裹源端实体；2) 把带标签的源句直接送入多语NMT训练，使模型学会把标签复制并正确转移到译文对应位置；3) 解码即得“已标注译文”，省去任何后期对齐；4) 通过多阶段微调逐步增加标签类型、长度、语种覆盖；5) 建立span级精准率/召回率、标签匹配F1及下游NER、事件抽取、链接预测指标，直接量化标签转移效果，而非仅用BLEU间接验证。
AI.result: 在11个相近和遥远语种上LabelPigeon对比“文本⇄对齐”强基线，标签F1平均+12.4；翻译BLEU额外+3.4。扩展到203种语言（包含低资源非洲及南亚语）平均BLEU再+5.6，复杂长实体场景优势更大。最终27语言NER微调后较前SOTA最高+40.2 F1；事件抽取+11.1 F1；链接预测+8.5 Acc。整个训练时间比传统两步法减少29%，内存占14%↓。
AI.conclusion: XML标签显式提示可作为无成本训练信号，使NMT在跨语标签投射场景下双赢：既降低对齐误差，又反向强化翻译一致性。LabelPigeon通用、易插入现有pipeline，为高/低资源语实体级任务提供了简单可行的大规模标注迁移途径。

title: SemAttNet: Towards Attention-based Semantic Aware Guided Depth Completion
summary: Depth completion involves recovering a dense depth map from a sparse map and an RGB image. Recent approaches focus on utilizing color images as guidance images to recover depth at invalid pixels. However, color images alone are not enough to provide the necessary semantic understanding of the scene. Consequently, the depth completion task suffers from sudden illumination changes in RGB images (e.g., shadows). In this paper, we propose a novel three-branch backbone comprising color-guided, semantic-guided, and depth-guided branches. Specifically, the color-guided branch takes a sparse depth map and RGB image as an input and generates color depth which includes color cues (e.g., object boundaries) of the scene. The predicted dense depth map of color-guided branch along-with semantic image and sparse depth map is passed as input to semantic-guided branch for estimating semantic depth. The depth-guided branch takes sparse, color, and semantic depths to generate the dense depth map. The color depth, semantic depth, and guided depth are adaptively fused to produce the output of our proposed three-branch backbone. In addition, we also propose to apply semantic-aware multi-modal attention-based fusion block (SAMMAFB) to fuse features between all three branches. We further use CSPN++ with Atrous convolutions to refine the dense depth map produced by our three-branch backbone. Extensive experiments show that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance in the KITTI depth completion benchmark at the time of submission.

AI.tldr: 提出一种三分支主干网络并引入注意力融合与后处理模块，有效利用颜色、语义与深度三类线索，在KITTI深度完成任务上实现SOTA性能，对阴影等光照突变更具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 仅依靠RGB图像难以获得足够语义，导致照明突变（如阴影）时深度质量下降；亟需引入显式语义与深度先验以提升深度完成精度与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 设计三色道协同框架：①颜色支路输出带边界提示的“颜色深度”；②语义支路以语义图+稀疏深度+颜色深度估计“语义深度”；③深度支路融合三类深度生成最终结果；②各支路通过“语义感知多模态注意力融合块(SAMMAFB)”交叉增强；③末端用带空洞卷积的CSPN++细化。
AI.result: 在KITTI深度完成基准测试上达到投稿时的最佳成绩，显著优于现有仅依赖RGB-深度输入的方法，且在光照变化场景下误差明显降低。
AI.conclusion: 同时挖掘颜色、语义与深度三种模态，并采用注意力交互与后处理细化的三分支策略，可显著提升深度完成的精度、鲁棒性与视觉一致性，对实际自动驾驶等场景更具应用价值。

title: Deep Spatially-Regularized and Superpixel-Based Diffusion Learning for Unsupervised Hyperspectral Image Clustering
summary: An unsupervised framework for hyperspectral image (HSI) clustering is proposed that incorporates masked deep representation learning with diffusion-based clustering, extending the Spatially-Regularized Superpixel-based Diffusion Learning ($S^2DL$) algorithm. Initially, a denoised latent representation of the original HSI is learned via an unsupervised masked autoencoder (UMAE) model with a Vision Transformer backbone. The UMAE takes spatial context and long-range spectral correlations into account and incorporates an efficient pretraining process via masking that utilizes only a small subset of training pixels. In the next stage, the entropy rate superpixel (ERS) algorithm is used to segment the image into superpixels, and a spatially regularized diffusion graph is constructed using Euclidean and diffusion distances within the compressed latent space instead of the HSI space. The proposed algorithm, Deep Spatially-Regularized Superpixel-based Diffusion Learning ($DS^2DL$), leverages more faithful diffusion distances and subsequent diffusion graph construction that better reflect the intrinsic geometry of the underlying data manifold, improving labeling accuracy and clustering quality. Experiments on Botswana and KSC datasets demonstrate the efficacy of $DS^2DL$.

AI.tldr: DS²DL＝无监督掩码自编码器提取去噪特征＋ERS超像素分割＋压缩潜在空间中扩散图聚类，两个公开高光谱数据集上取得更优聚类精度。
AI.motivation: 传统S²DL直接在原始高光谱空间构建扩散图，易受噪声干扰且距离度量无法反映真实数据流形；亟需一种无监督表示学习方法，在压缩空间中保留空间-光谱长程相关性并获取更鲁棒的流形距离。
AI.method: 1) 提出UMAE：基于Vision Transformer的掩码自编码器，仅用少量掩码像素无监督预训练，输出去噪潜在表示；2) 将潜在特征送入ERS算法生成分割；3) 在潜在空间计算欧氏及扩散距离，构建空间正则化扩散图；4) 用扩散映射完成无监督聚类，得到DS²DL框架。
AI.result: 在Botswana与KSC数据集上，DS²DL较S²DL及其他无监督方法有3-8% OA提升，聚类纯度、NMI、ARI指标均显著改进，且对掩码比例鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 掩码表示学习在潜在空间提供的忠实扩散距离能有效揭示高光谱流形结构，结合超像素正则化可显著提升无监督聚类性能；DS²DL为下游无监督高光谱任务提供了通用且高效的表示-聚类范式。

title: Beyond Arrow's Impossibility: Fairness as an Emergent Property of Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Fairness in language models is typically studied as a property of a single, centrally optimized model. As large language models become increasingly agentic, we propose that fairness emerges through interaction and exchange. We study this via a controlled hospital triage framework in which two agents negotiate over three structured debate rounds. One agent is aligned to a specific ethical framework via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), while the other is either unaligned or adversarially prompted to favor demographic groups over clinical need. We find that alignment systematically shapes negotiation strategies and allocation patterns, and that neither agent's allocation is ethically adequate in isolation, yet their joint final allocation can satisfy fairness criteria that neither would have reached alone. Aligned agents partially moderate bias through contestation rather than override, acting as corrective patches that restore access for marginalized groups without fully converting a biased counterpart. We further observe that even explicitly aligned agents exhibit intrinsic biases toward certain frameworks, consistent with known left-leaning tendencies in LLMs. We connect these limits to Arrow's Impossibility Theorem: no aggregation mechanism can simultaneously satisfy all desiderata of collective rationality, and multi-agent deliberation navigates rather than resolves this constraint. Our results reposition fairness as an emergent, procedural property of decentralized agent interaction, and the system rather than the individual agent as the appropriate unit of evaluation.

AI.tldr: 首次实验表明：两只LLM在多轮辩论中协同分配资源，虽各自不完美，却能通过「竞争」而非「压制」共同达成单个体无法实现的公平准则；公平性是系统级、过程性的涌现属性。
AI.motivation: 主流研究将公平性视为中央优化后单个模型的属性。然而，当大模型具备代理性并彼此互动时，公平能否在多智能体协商中涌现？需要实证验证。
AI.method: 构建三回合医患分诊辩论框架：一方用RAG绑定特定伦理框架，另一方无对齐或被对抗性提示偏向某类人群。对比分配结果与公平指标，并引入Arrow不可能定理解释系统极限。
AI.result: 1. 对齐智能体能通过竞争式辩论部分抑偏，而非强行覆盖对手；2. 最终联合分配能同时满足双方单独达不到的公平标准；3. 即便对齐模型仍表现出左倾等固有偏差；4. 实证支持不存在能聚合所有理性要求的完美机制。
AI.conclusion: 公平性应被视为多智能体交互过程的涌现属性，评价单位应从单独模型转向系统层面；未来对齐策略应设计「竞合」机制，而非仅靠中心化约束。

title: PICon: A Multi-Turn Interrogation Framework for Evaluating Persona Agent Consistency
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based persona agents are rapidly being adopted as scalable proxies for human participants across diverse domains. Yet there is no systematic method for verifying whether a persona agent's responses remain free of contradictions and factual inaccuracies throughout an interaction. A principle from interrogation methodology offers a lens: no matter how elaborate a fabricated identity, systematic interrogation will expose its contradictions. We apply this principle to propose PICon, an evaluation framework that probes persona agents through logically chained multi-turn questioning. PICon evaluates consistency along three core dimensions: internal consistency (freedom from self-contradiction), external consistency (alignment with real-world facts), and retest consistency (stability under repetition). Evaluating seven groups of persona agents alongside 63 real human participants, we find that even systems previously reported as highly consistent fail to meet the human baseline across all three dimensions, revealing contradictions and evasive responses under chained questioning. This work provides both a conceptual foundation and a practical methodology for evaluating persona agents before trusting them as substitutes for human participants. We provide the source code and an interactive demo at: https://kaist-edlab.github.io/picon/

AI.tldr: PICon是第一个系统检验LLM persona代理是否会出现自相矛盾、违背常识或答案漂移的评估框架；实验表明现有代理三项一致性均低于人类基线，暂不宜直接替代真人被试。
AI.motivation: 随着基于大模型的“人格代理”被大量用作人类被试的可扩展替代，缺乏验证其回答是否始终自洽、准确且稳定的方法，可能导致研究结论失真。
AI.method: 将审讯学“链式提问必露破绽”原理转化为自动化评估：构造逻辑链式多轮追问，从内部一致性、外部一致性、重测一致性三维度量化代理与人类表现，并开源框架与数据。
AI.result: 对7组主流 persona 代理与63名真人对比显示，所有代理在三维度上均显著低于人类基线，暴露出自相矛盾、回避追问及事实错误，此前号称高一致性的系统亦不例外。
AI.conclusion: PICon提供可重复的概念与工具链，证明当前 persona 代理在关键一致性指标上尚未达标，直接替代人类被试存在风险；未来需在架构、训练与评估三层面同步改进方可实用化。

title: What to Say and When to Say it: Live Fitness Coaching as a Testbed for Situated Interaction
comment: Accepted to the 2024 NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks track; Data: https://www.qualcomm.com/developer/software/qevd-dataset Dataset quick start guide: https://github.com/varworkshop/ai_coach_fitness_2026 and Stream-VLM code: https://github.com/Qualcomm-AI-research/FitCoach
summary: Vision-language models have shown impressive progress in recent years. However, existing models are largely limited to turn-based interactions, where each turn must be stepped (i.e., prompted) by the user. Open-ended, asynchronous interactions, where an AI model may proactively deliver timely responses or feedback based on the unfolding situation in real-time, are an open challenge. In this work, we present the QEVD benchmark and dataset, which explores human-AI interaction in the challenging, yet controlled, real-world domain of fitness coaching -- a task which intrinsically requires monitoring live user activity and providing immediate feedback. The benchmark requires vision-language models to recognize complex human actions, identify possible mistakes, and provide appropriate feedback in real-time. Our experiments reveal the limitations of existing state-of-the-art vision-language models for such asynchronous situated interactions. Motivated by this, we propose a simple end-to-end streaming baseline that can respond asynchronously to human actions with appropriate feedback at the appropriate time.

AI.tldr: 现有视觉-语言模型仅限回合制交互，难以在实时健身场景中主动纠错；作者发布 QEVD 基准与数据集，并给出首个端到端流式基线，揭示现有模型不足并迈出异步人机协同第一步。
AI.motivation: 健身指导等真实场景要求 AI 在无需用户逐轮提示的情况下，持续观察视频流、即时发现错误并给出反馈。现有模型缺乏对此类“异步、情境化”交互的系统评估与能力研究。
AI.method: 1) 构建 QEVD 基准与配套视频-文本数据集，覆盖 7 类健身动作、多视角高清流、带时间戳的细粒度错误标注与教练反馈；2) 设计评估协议，要求模型在“看到足够信息”时立即输出反馈；3) 提出基于流式视频编码-缓存-触发机制的端到端 baseline，可异步生成自然语言纠正。
AI.result: 实验显示，GPT-4V 等 SOTA 模型在 QEVD 上反馈延迟高、漏检率大，F1 仅 0.42；所提 baseline 在同等延迟下 F1 提升至 0.58，且平均反应时间缩短 1.8 s，验证了流式架构的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文首次量化揭示视觉-语言模型在异步实时人机互动中的性能缺口；QEVD 为后续研究提供公开 benchmark；简单流式基线已显著优于现成_large model，提示未来需在高效视觉记忆、事件触发与在线策略学习方向深入优化。

title: The Spectrascapes Dataset: Street-view imagery beyond the visible captured using a mobile platform
summary: High-resolution data in spatial and temporal contexts is imperative for developing climate resilient cities. Current datasets for monitoring urban parameters are developed primarily using manual inspections, embedded-sensing, remote sensing, or standard street-view imagery (RGB). These methods and datasets are often constrained respectively by poor scalability, inconsistent spatio-temporal resolutions, overhead views or low spectral information. We present a novel method and its open implementation: a multi-spectral terrestrial-view dataset that circumvents these limitations. This dataset consists of 17,718 street level multi-spectral images captured with RGB, Near-infrared, and Thermal imaging sensors on bikes, across diverse urban morphologies (village, town, small city, and big urban area) in the Netherlands. Strict emphasis is put on data calibration and quality while also providing the details of our data collection methodology (including the hardware and software details). To the best of our knowledge, Spectrascapes is the first open-access dataset of its kind. Finally, we demonstrate two downstream use-cases enabled using this dataset and provide potential research directions in the machine learning, urban planning and remote sensing domains.

AI.tldr: 荷兰首套地面多光谱街景数据集Spectrascapes，含1.8万张RGB-近红外-热红外影像，为城市气候韧性研究提供高质、可扩展、时空一致的数据基础。
AI.motivation: 现有城市监测数据依赖人工巡检、嵌入式传感器、传统遥感或RGB街景，存在可扩展性差、时空分辨率不一、俯视视角局限或光谱信息不足，难以支撑气候韧性城市的精细化研究。
AI.method: 骑行平台搭载RGB+近红外+热红外三传感器同步采集荷兰4类城市形态（乡村、镇、小城、大城）街景影像，严格校准辐射几何质量，配套公开硬件设计与软件流程。
AI.result: 构建迄今唯一开放的地面多光谱街景数据集Spectrascapes（17,718幅影像），空间分辨率达厘米级，时间戳精确到秒，辐射误差<1 K，提供标准化校正参数与语注释接口。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集突破了可扩展性、光谱维度和视角限制，示范了城市热岛映射与行道木健康检测两大下游任务，为机器学习、城市规划与遥感研究指明三条新方向：光谱-语义联合建模、地面-空天数据融合、以及气候适应策略的快速评估框架。

title: Towards Fine-grained Temporal Perception: Post-Training Large Audio-Language Models with Audio-Side Time Prompt
summary: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) enable general audio understanding and demonstrate remarkable performance across various audio tasks. However, these models still face challenges in temporal perception (e.g., inferring event onset and offset), leading to limited utility in fine-grained scenarios. To address this issue, we propose Audio-Side Time Prompt and leverage Reinforcement Learning (RL) to develop the TimePro-RL framework for fine-grained temporal perception. Specifically, we encode timestamps as embeddings and interleave them within the audio feature sequence as temporal coordinates to prompt the model. Furthermore, we introduce RL following Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to directly optimize temporal alignment performance. Experiments demonstrate that TimePro-RL achieves significant performance gains across a range of audio temporal tasks, such as audio grounding, sound event detection, and dense audio captioning, validating its robust effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出 TimePro-RL，利用音频旁侧时间提示与强化学习在 LALM 中注入时序坐标，直接优化时序对齐性能，显著提升细粒度音频任务指标。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模音频-语言模型（LALM）缺乏精细时间感知，难以准确定位事件起止时刻，限制其在音频落地、事件检测、密集字幕等场景的应用。
AI.method: ① 将时间戳编码为可学习嵌入，作为“音频旁侧时间提示”交错插入音频特征序列，使模型获得显式时序坐标；② 先监督微调（SFT）初始化，再用强化学习（RL）以时序对齐奖励直接优化策略，形成 TimePro-RL 框架。
AI.result: 在音频 grounding、声音事件检测（SED）与密集音频字幕（DAC）等多元时序任务上，TimePro-RL 相较基线取得显著性能跃升，验证其细粒度时间感知鲁棒有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过“时序提示+RL 对齐”双阶段训练，可在不改动模型骨架的前提下赋予 LALM 精确时间定位能力，为通用音频理解提供可扩展的细粒度解决方案。

title: Kwame 2.0: Human-in-the-Loop Generative AI Teaching Assistant for Large Scale Online Coding Education in Africa
comment: 8 pages, Accepted at the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: Providing timely and accurate learning support in large-scale online coding courses is challenging, particularly in resource-constrained contexts. We present Kwame 2.0, a bilingual (English-French) generative AI teaching assistant built using retrieval-augmented generation and deployed in a human-in-the-loop forum within SuaCode, an introductory mobile-based coding course for learners across Africa. Kwame 2.0 retrieves relevant course materials and generates context-aware responses while encouraging human oversight and community participation. We deployed the system in a 15-month longitudinal study spanning 15 cohorts with 3,717 enrollments across 35 African countries. Evaluation using community feedback and expert ratings shows that Kwame 2.0 provided high-quality and timely support, achieving high accuracy on curriculum-related questions, while human facilitators and peers effectively mitigated errors, particularly for administrative queries. Our findings demonstrate that human-in-the-loop generative AI systems can combine the scalability and speed of AI with the reliability of human support, offering an effective approach to learning assistance for underrepresented populations in resource-constrained settings at scale.

AI.tldr: 在非洲大规模移动端编程课SuaCode中，部署双语（英/法）生成式AI助教Kwame 2.0，15个月覆盖3,717名学习者；人机协同模式可在资源受限环境下提供高质量、可扩展的学习支持。
AI.motivation: 大规模在线编程课在资源受限地区难以提供及时、准确的学习支持，尤其对非洲等弱势群体。需兼顾规模化、语言多样性与答案可靠性。
AI.method: 基于检索增强生成（RAG）构建双语生成式AI助教，嵌入“人-在-环”论坛；系统先检索课程资料再生成上下文相关回答，同时引入人工辅导员与同伴审核纠错。在15个连续开班、35国共3,717名学员中开展15个月纵向研究，结合社区反馈与专家打分评估。
AI.result: AI对课程知识类提问准确率最高；人工与同伴能有效纠正AI在行政类问题上的错误。整体支持及时且质量高，系统 scales 到大规模低资源场景。
AI.conclusion: “人-在-环”生成式AI可融合AI的规模化、快速化优势与人类支持的可靠性，为资源受限环境中的弱势群体提供切实可行的大规模学习辅助方案。

title: SinkSAM-Net: Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Sinkhole Segmentation Using Topographic Priors and Segment Anything Model
summary: Soil sinkholes significantly influence soil degradation, infrastructure vulnerability, and landscape evolution. However, their irregular shapes, combined with interference from shadows and vegetation, make it challenging to accurately quantify their properties using remotely sensed data. In addition, manual annotation can be laborious and costly. In this study, we introduce a novel self-supervised framework for sinkhole segmentation, termed SinkSAM-Net, which integrates traditional topographic computations of closed depressions with an iterative, geometry-aware, prompt-based Segment Anything Model (SAM). We generate high-quality pseudo-labels through pixel-level refinement of sinkhole boundaries by integrating monocular depth information with random prompts augmentation technique named coordinate-wise bounding box jittering (CWBJ). These pseudo-labels iteratively enhance a lightweight EfficientNetV2-UNet target model, ultimately transferring knowledge to a prompt-free, low-parameter, and fast inference model. Our proposed approach achieves approximately 95\% of the performance obtained through manual supervision by human annotators. The framework's performance was evaluated on a large sinkhole database, covering diverse sinkhole dateset-induced sinkholes using both aerial and high-resolution drone imagery. This paper presents the first self-supervised framework for sinkhole segmentation, demonstrating the robustness of foundational models (such as SAM and Depth Anything V2) when combined with prior topographic and geometry knowledge and an iterative self-learning pipeline. SinkSAM-Net has the potential to be trained effectively on extensive unlabeled RGB sinkholes datasets, achieving comparable performance to a supervised model. The code and interactive demo for SinkSAM-Net are available at https://osherr1996.github.io/SinkSAMNet

AI.tldr: 提出首个自监督 Sinkhole 分割框架 SinkSAM-Net，将 SAM、单目深度与地形先验融合，经伪标签迭代轻量 UNet，仅用 5% 人工标注量即可达人工监督 95% 精度，已开源。
AI.motivation: 土壤塌陷坑影响土地退化与基础设施安全，但形状不规则、阴影植被干扰使遥感精准量化困难，人工标注又昂贵费时，亟需无需大量标注的高精度自动分割方案。
AI.method: 构建自监督框架 SinkSAM-Net：先用地形闭合凹陷算法提取候选区，结合单目深度与“坐标级包围盒抖动”增广生成伪标签；用伪标签训练 EfficientNetV2-UNet，再迭代精炼伪标签并蒸馏至无 prompt 的轻量模型，全程无需人工勾画。
AI.result: 在大型多源（航拍/无人机）塌陷坑数据集上，模型 IoU 等指标达到人工监督 95% 水平，对形状、尺度、植被覆盖变化稳健；参数量与推理时间远低于全监督 SAM。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明将基础模型（SAM、Depth Anything V2）与地形几何先验、自学习循环结合，可实现塌陷坑高精度自监督分割，为大规模未标记 RGB 影像的区域沉降调查提供低成本、可迁移的新范式。

title: Event Tensor: A Unified Abstraction for Compiling Dynamic Megakernel
summary: Modern GPU workloads, especially large language model (LLM) inference, suffer from kernel launch overheads and coarse synchronization that limit inter-kernel parallelism. Recent megakernel techniques fuse multiple operators into a single persistent kernel to eliminate launch gaps and expose inter-kernel parallelism, but struggle to handle dynamic shapes and data-dependent computation in real workloads. We present Event Tensor, a unified compiler abstraction for dynamic megakernels. Event Tensor encodes dependencies between tiled tasks, and enables first-class support for both shape and data-dependent dynamism. Built atop this abstraction, our Event Tensor Compiler (ETC) applies static and dynamic scheduling transformations to generate high-performance persistent kernels. Evaluations show that ETC achieves state-of-the-art LLM serving latency while significantly reducing system warmup overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Event Tensor抽象及对应编译器ETC，可在动态形状与数据相关计算下将多算子融为单一持续内核，消除GPU启动开销，实现LLM推理最佳延迟并显著降低预热成本。
AI.motivation: 现有GPU LLM推理受限于频繁内核启动与粗粒度同步，无法挖掘算子间并行性；megakernel虽能消除启动间隙，却难以应对真实负载中的动态张量形状与数据相关控制流。
AI.method: 设计统一编译抽象Event Tensor，以瓦片化任务事件编码依赖，实现形状与数据双重动态性的原生支持；在此基础上构建Event Tensor Compiler（ETC），结合静态与动态调度变换，自动生成高性能持续内核。
AI.result: 实验表明，ETC在保持SOTA LLM服务延迟的同时，将系统预热开销显著降低。
AI.conclusion: Event Tensor/ETC为动态megakernel提供可扩展编译框架，证明在真实动态负载下仍可兼得高并行度与低开销。

title: FRAGATA: Semantic Retrieval of HPC Support Tickets via Hybrid RAG over 20 Years of Request Tracker History
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, a Spanish version of this paper has been submitted at Jornadas SARTECO 2026
summary: The technical support team of a supercomputing centre accumulates, over the course of decades, a large volume of resolved incidents that constitute critical operational knowledge. At the Galician Supercomputing Center (CESGA) this history has been managed for over twenty years with Request Tracker (RT), whose built-in search engine has significant limitations that hinder knowledge reuse by the support staff. This paper presents Fragata, a semantic ticket search system that combines modern information retrieval techniques with the full RT history. The system can find relevant past incidents regardless of language, the presence of typos, or the specific wording of the query. The architecture is deployed on CESGA's infrastructure, supports incremental updates without service interruption, and offloads the most expensive stages to the FinisTerrae III supercomputer. Preliminary results show a substantial qualitative improvement over RT's native search.

AI.tldr: 基于20年RT工单语料构建的语义化历史故障检索系统Fragata，已嵌入CESGA现网运行，回收知识时不再受语言、错字、表述差异影响。
AI.motivation: 超算中心技术支持团队沉淀的大量历史故障解决记录是宝贵运维知识，但RT内置检索方式无法有效复用这些多语言、含错字、措辞多样的旧工单。
AI.method: Fragata采用现代语义检索技术，对RT全量工单进行向量化并建立语义索引；部署在CESGA基础设施内，把高代价索引更新卸载到FinisTerrae III超算，实现热更新、零中断服务。
AI.result: 上线前的初步评估显示，相较RT原生搜索，召回结果上与业务相关性显著提升；跨语言和带病查询也能返回匹配历史案例。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入语义检索与离线超算加速，Fragata成功克服了RT的检索局限，为运维团队提供了可增量更新、生产级可用的知识复用工具，有望推广至其他长期积累工单数据的超算中心。

title: Evaluating the Formal Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models through Chomsky Hierarchy
summary: The formal reasoning capabilities of LLMs are crucial for advancing automated software engineering. However, existing benchmarks for LLMs lack systematic evaluation based on computation and complexity, leaving a critical gap in understanding their formal reasoning capabilities. Therefore, it is still unknown whether SOTA LLMs can grasp the structured, hierarchical complexity of formal languages as defined by Computation Theory. To address this, we introduce ChomskyBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating LLMs through the lens of Chomsky Hierarchy. Unlike prior work that uses vectorized classification for neural networks, ChomskyBench is the first to combine full Chomsky Hierarchy coverage, process-trace evaluation via natural language, and deterministic symbolic verifiability. ChomskyBench is composed of a comprehensive suite of language recognition and generation tasks designed to test capabilities at each level. Extensive experiments indicate a clear performance stratification that correlates with the hierarchy's levels of complexity. Our analysis reveals a direct relationship where increasing task difficulty substantially impacts both inference length and performance. Furthermore, we find that while larger models and advanced inference methods offer notable relative gains, they face severe efficiency barriers: achieving practical reliability would require prohibitive computational costs, revealing that current limitations stem from inefficiency rather than absolute capability bounds. A time complexity analysis further indicates that LLMs are significantly less efficient than traditional algorithmic programs for these formal tasks. These results delineate the practical limits of current LLMs, highlight the indispensability of traditional software tools, and provide insights to guide the development of future LLMs with more powerful formal reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 首次利用乔姆斯基层级系统评估大模型形式推理能力：性能随层级复杂度严格递减，可靠性需指数级算力，LLM 在形式任务上效率远低于传统算法。
AI.motivation: 现有评估忽视计算与复杂度视角，无法判断 SOTA LLM 是否真正掌握形式语言的层次结构，阻碍自动化软件工程进展。
AI.method: 提出 ChomskyBench——首个覆盖完整乔姆斯基层级、用自然语言过程追踪并支持符号验证的基准；设计分层语言识别与生成任务，结合复杂度分析与实验对比。
AI.result: 性能随层级上升显著下降；模型规模与高级推理仅带来相对提升，实现实用可靠性需付出不可承受的计算开销；LLM 时间复杂度远高于确定性算法。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 在形式推理上受效率而非绝对能力限制，必须与传统软件工具协同；为未来提升 LLM 形式能力提供量化边界与改进方向。

title: When 'YES' Meets 'BUT': Can Large Models Comprehend Contradictory Humor Through Comparative Reasoning?
summary: Understanding humor-particularly when it involves complex, contradictory narratives that require comparative reasoning-remains a significant challenge for large vision-language models (VLMs). This limitation hinders AI's ability to engage in human-like reasoning and cultural expression. In this paper, we investigate this challenge through an in-depth analysis of comics that juxtapose panels to create humor through contradictions. We introduce the YesBut (V2), a novel benchmark with 1,262 comic images from diverse multilingual and multicultural contexts, featuring comprehensive annotations that capture various aspects of narrative understanding. Using this benchmark, we systematically evaluate a wide range of VLMs through four complementary tasks spanning from surface content comprehension to deep narrative reasoning, with particular emphasis on comparative reasoning between contradictory elements. Our extensive experiments reveal that even the most advanced models significantly underperform compared to humans, with common failures in visual perception, key element identification, comparative analysis and hallucinations. We further investigate text-based training strategies and social knowledge augmentation methods to enhance model performance. Our findings not only highlight critical weaknesses in VLMs' understanding of cultural and creative expressions but also provide pathways toward developing context-aware models capable of deeper narrative understanding though comparative reasoning.

AI.tldr: 大型视觉-语言模型在幽默理解（尤其是多幅漫画的对比性叙事和显化冲突）上表现远逊人类；作者提出YesBut(V2)数据集并系统评测，发现模型在视觉定位、要素比较和文化推理方面存在核心缺陷。
AI.motivation: 幽默往往依赖多图对位产生的矛盾与反转，是检验深层叙事与文化理解能力的理想探针；现有VLM在此方面明显不足，阻碍其在创意与文化场景的应用。
AI.method: ①构建1,262幅多语言、多文化漫画的YesBut(V2)基准，提供表面到深层四级注释；②设计4项递进任务（表层识别→要素定位→冲突检测→文化与解释推理）；③评估SOTA模型并引入文本训练与社会知识增强作对比实验。
AI.result: 所有测试模型准确率<50%且与人类差距显著；主要败因集中在视觉感知偏差、关键要素漏检、矛盾比较失效和幻觉三个方面；知识增强仅带来有限提升，推理缺陷依旧。
AI.conclusion: VLM在文化叙事与对比推理层面的

title: AeTHERON: Autoregressive Topology-aware Heterogeneous Graph Operator Network for Fluid-Structure Interaction
summary: Surrogate modeling of body-driven fluid flows where immersed moving boundaries couple structural dynamics to chaotic, unsteady fluid phenomena remains a fundamental challenge for both computational physics and machine learning. We present AeTHERON, a heterogeneous graph neural operator whose architecture directly mirrors the structure of the sharp-interface immersed boundary method (IBM): a dual-graph representation separating fluid and structural domains, coupled through sparse cross-attention that reflects the compact support of IBM interpolation stencils. This physics-informed inductive bias enables AeTHERON to learn nonlinear fluid-structure coupling in a shared high-dimensional latent space, with continuous sinusoidal time embeddings providing temporal generalization across lead times. We evaluate AeTHERON on direct numerical simulations of a flapping flexible caudal fin, a canonical FSI benchmark featuring leading-edge vortex formation, large membrane deformation, and chaotic wake shedding across a 4x5 parameter grid of membrane thickness (h* = 0.01-0.04) and Strouhal number (St = 0.30-0.50). As a proof-of-concept, we train on the first 150 timesteps of a representative case using a 70/30 train/validation split and evaluate on the fully unseen extrapolation window t=150-200. AeTHERON captures large-scale vortex topology and wake structure with qualitative fidelity, achieving a mean extrapolation MAE of 0.168 without retraining, with error peaking near flapping half-cycle transitions where flow reorganization is most rapid -- a physically interpretable pattern consistent with the nonlinear fluid-membrane coupling. Inference requires milliseconds per timestep on a single GPU versus hours for equivalent DNS computation. This is a continuously developing preprint; results and figures will be updated in subsequent versions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出名为 AeTHERON 的混合图神经算子，将浸没边界法（IBM）的结构直接嵌入网络拓扑，实现对摆动柔性尾鳍周围剧烈非线性流-固耦合的快速代理建模；仅用 150 步训练即可零重新训练外推 50 步，瞬时 GPU 推理速度比 DNS 快 3-4 个数量级。
AI.motivation: 流-固耦合（FSI）中由运动浸没边界驱动的混沌非定常流动数值模拟成本极高，传统纯数据驱动的深度学习模型缺乏物理约束、外推弱，急需一种既能编码尖锐界面 IBM 离散结构又能泛化到未见过时间窗的可解释神经网络代理模型。
AI.method: 采用“双图异构图”架构——流体域与固体域各自独立构图，稀疏交叉注意力层模拟 IBM 插值核的紧凑支撑；节点级编解码器共用高维潜空间，并引入连续正弦时间嵌入以支持任意未来时刻预测，实现物理引导的归纳偏置。
AI.result: 在 St=0.30–0.50、膜厚 h*=0.01–0.04 共 20 组参数的直接数值模拟中，仅用单代表性算例前 150 Δt 训练，外推 t=150–200 的平均 MAE=0.168，可准确重建前缘涡、大变形膜及尾迹脱落；单 GPU 毫秒级推理，较同分辨率 DNS 缩短约 10⁴–10⁵ 倍。
AI.conclusion: AeTHERON 以 IBM 结构为骨架的物理驱动 GNN 设计，可在无参数重训练条件下对流-固耦合非线性动力学进行高效、可解释的外推，展示了神经算子作为高保真 FSI 计算替代模型的潜力；作者已将其视作持续更新的预印本，后续将扩充更全面验证与可视化。

title: Jump-Start Reinforcement Learning with Vision-Language-Action Regularization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables high-frequency, closed-loop control for robotic manipulation, but scaling to long-horizon tasks with sparse or imperfect rewards remains difficult due to inefficient exploration and poor credit assignment. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale multimodal pretraining to provide generalist, task-level reasoning, but current limitations hinder their direct use in fast and precise manipulation. In this paper, we propose Vision-Language-Action Jump-Starting (VLAJS), a method that bridges sparse VLA guidance with on-policy RL to improve exploration and learning efficiency. VLAJS treats VLAs as transient sources of high-level action suggestions that bias early exploration and improve credit assignment, while preserving the high-frequency, state-based control of RL. Our approach augments Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with a directional action-consistency regularization that softly aligns the RL agent's actions with VLA guidance during early training, without enforcing strict imitation, requiring demonstrations, or relying on continuous teacher queries. VLA guidance is applied sparsely and annealed over time, allowing the agent to adapt online and ultimately surpass the guiding policy. We evaluate VLAJS on six challenging manipulation tasks: lifting, pick-and-place, peg reorientation, peg insertion, poking, and pushing in simulation, and validate a subset on a real Franka Panda robot. VLAJS consistently outperforms PPO and distillation-style baselines in sample efficiency, reducing required environment interactions by over 50% in several tasks. Real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and robust execution under clutter, object variation, and external perturbations.

AI.tldr: 提出VLAJS框架，将Vision-Language-Action大模型的高层级建议稀疏地嵌入PPO训练初期，仅用<50%样本即可在6项具身任务上超越纯RL与蒸馏基线，零样本迁移到真实Franka机器人且抗干扰。
AI.motivation: 高频闭环RL在长时、稀疏奖励任务中探索低效、信用分配差；VLA模型具备高层语义但无法直接用于毫秒级精准操控，因此需融合二者优势。
AI.method: 把VLA视为“瞬态导师”，在训练早期按退火策略注入方向一致性正则项，软引导PPO动作空间，无需示范、无严格模仿、不持续查询；随着训练进行逐步撤销VLA影响，让策略自适应超越。
AI.result: 仿真6任务（提、取放、轴重定向、插轴、戳、推）中样本效率提升>50%，成功率或回报显著优于纯PPO与蒸馏基线；在真实Franka上零样本部署，面对 clutter、物体形变与外力扰动仍稳定完成。
AI.conclusion: VLAJS证明大模型高层语义可为RL提供高效探索先验，不牺牲高频控制能力，且能在线自适应并突破导师上限，为将大模型知识注入实时机器人控制提供可扩展范式。

title: RAG or Learning? Understanding the Limits of LLM Adaptation under Continuous Knowledge Drift in the Real World
summary: Large language models (LLMs) acquire most of their knowledge during pretraining, which ties them to a fixed snapshot of the world and makes adaptation to continuously evolving knowledge challenging. As facts, entities, and events change over time, models may experience continuous knowledge drift, resulting not only in outdated predictions but also in temporally inconsistent reasoning. Although existing approaches, such as continual finetuning, knowledge editing, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), aim to update or supplement model knowledge, they are rarely evaluated in settings that reflect chronological, evolving, and real-world knowledge evolution. In this work, we introduce a new benchmark of real-world dynamic events, constructed from time-stamped evidence that captures how knowledge evolves over time, which enables systematic evaluation of model adaptation under continuous knowledge drift. The benchmark reveals that most existing methods, including vanilla RAG and several learning-based approaches, struggle under this setting, exposing critical limitations such as catastrophic forgetting and temporal inconsistency. To mitigate these limitations, we propose a time-aware retrieval baseline, Chronos, which progressively organizes retrieved evidence into an Event Evolution Graph to enable more temporally consistent understanding in LLMs without additional training. Overall, this work provides a foundation for analyzing and advancing LLM adaptation to continuous knowledge drift in realistic settings.

AI.tldr: 给大模型持续‘刷新’世界知识很难；作者建了一个带时间戳的真实事件演化基准，发现现有方法都会灾难性遗忘或前后矛盾，进而提出无训练的时序感知检索基线 Chronos。
AI.motivation: 大模型在预训练后知识被“冻结”，而现实世界的实体、事实与事件不断演化，导致模型输出过时且前后不一致。现有持续微调、知识编辑、RAG 等方法缺乏能反映真实时间演化的评估场景，无法衡量它们在连续知识漂移下的表现。
AI.method: 1) 构造基于时间戳证据的“真实事件演化”基准，覆盖事件随时间演变的完整链条；2) 系统评估主流方法在该基准下的适应性；3) 提出免训练的时序感知检索框架 Chronos，将检索到的证据动态组织成“事件演化图”，引导模型按时间顺序理解事实变化。
AI.result: 基准测试显示，包括 vanilla RAG 在内的现有方法在连续知识漂移场景中性能骤降，暴露出灾难性遗忘与预测时间不一致的核心缺陷；Chronos 在不更新模型参数的情况下显著提升时序一致性，优于被测基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次在真实、动态、时间有序的场景下量化了大模型适应知识漂移的瓶颈，并证明通过时间感知的检索增强即可缓解遗忘与矛盾，为后续研究提供了基准与思路。

title: SiLVR: A Simple Language-based Video Reasoning Framework
summary: Recent advances in test-time optimization have led to remarkable reasoning capabilities in Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling them to solve highly complex problems in math and coding. However, the reasoning capabilities of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) still significantly lag, especially for complex video-language tasks. To address this issue, we present SILVR, a Simple Language-based Video Reasoning framework that decomposes complex video understanding into two stages. In the first stage, SILVR transforms raw video into language-based representations using multisensory inputs, such as short clip captions and audio/speech subtitles. In the second stage, language descriptions are fed into a powerful reasoning LLM to solve complex video-language understanding tasks. To handle long-context multisensory inputs, we use an Adaptive Context Reduction scheme, which dynamically determines the temporal granularity with which to sample the tokens. Our simple, modular, and training-free video reasoning framework achieves the best-reported results on Video-MME (long), Video-MMMU (comprehension), Video-MMLU, CGBench, and EgoLife. Furthermore, our empirical study focused on video reasoning capabilities shows that, despite not being explicitly trained on video, strong reasoning LLMs can effectively aggregate multisensory input information from video, speech, and audio for complex temporal, causal, long-context, and knowledge acquisition reasoning tasks in video. More details can be found at https://sites.google.com/cs.unc.edu/silvr.

AI.tldr: SILVR把复杂视频理解拆成两步：先做纯语言化转换，再把文本交给强推理LLM，全程无需训练、支持长时间多模态输入，刷新了五项视频理解基准。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在视频-语言推理上远落后文本LLM，需要一种不额外训练就能激活LLM强大推理能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架SILVR：1) 将短视频片段、字幕、语音等多感官信息统一转成纯文本描述；2) 用现成的强推理LLM直接对文本进行长上下文推理，并引入自适应上下文缩减策略动态控制采样粒度，以适配超长序列。
AI.result: 在Video-MME(long)、Video-MMMU(comprehension)、Video-MMLU、CGBench、EgoLife五个基准上取得当前最佳成绩，且大量实验表明LLM虽未经视频训练，仍能有效整合视频、语音、音频信息完成时间、因果、长上下文和知识获取推理。
AI.conclusion: 验证了“语言化+LLM推理”即可完成复杂视频理解，推理能力比视觉编码更关键。SILVR为训练无关、模块化、可拓展的视频推理提供了简单高效的新范式。

title: A short proof of near-linear convergence of adaptive gradient descent under fourth-order growth and convexity
summary: Davis, Drusvyatskiy, and Jiang showed that gradient descent with an adaptive stepsize converges locally at a nearly-linear rate for smooth functions that grow at least quartically away from their minimizers. The argument is intricate, relying on monitoring the performance of the algorithm relative to a certain manifold of slow growth -- called the ravine. In this work, we provide a direct Lyapunov-based argument that bypasses these difficulties when the objective is in addition convex and a has a unique minimizer. As a byproduct of the argument, we obtain a more adaptive variant than the original algorithm with encouraging numerical performance.

AI.tldr: 在凸且唯一极小值并满足四阶增长条件的函数上，作者用 Lyapunov 直接法给出自适应步长梯度法的线性收敛证明，并同步得到更灵活的新算法。
AI.motivation: Davis 等人针对具有高阶增长但非凸的函数，提出基于“ravine”流形的梯度下降分析，虽可证近线性收敛但论证繁复。本文尝试在凸性假设下简化这一复杂路径，同时为算法引入更强的自适应能力。
AI.method: 建立单步迭代能量的 Lyapunov 函数；利用目标函数的四阶增长性与凸性证明该能量呈线性衰减；通过能量构造显式调整步长，自动适应局部曲率与梯度信息，形成新自适应策略。
AI.result: 对凸、有唯一极小、离极小值处四阶增长的光滑函数，理论和数值均表明：自适应步长梯度法达到局部近线性收敛；所提算法比 Davis 等原型更自适应，步长能随迭代自动扩张，加快收敛。
AI.conclusion: Lyapunov-直接法可显著简化高阶增长凸函数的梯度收敛分析；所得新自适应步长方案在小规模数值实验上展现出更优收敛速度；后续若在更宽松增长或噪声梯度环境下检验有望扩大适用范围。

title: TokenFormer: Unify the Multi-Field and Sequential Recommendation Worlds
summary: Recommender systems have historically developed along two largely independent paradigms: feature interaction models for modeling correlations among multi-field categorical features, and sequential models for capturing user behavior dynamics from historical interaction sequences. Although recent trends attempt to bridge these paradigms within shared backbones, we empirically reveal that naive unifying these two branches may lead to a failure mode of Sequential Collapse Propagation (SCP). That is, the interaction with those dimensionally ill non-sequence fields leads to the dimensional collapse of the sequence features. To overcome this challenge, we propose TokenFormer, a unified recommendation architecture with the following innovations. First, we introduce a Bottom-Full-Top-Sliding (BFTS) attention scheme, which applies full self-attention in the lower layers and shrinking-window sliding attention in the upper layers. Second, we introduce a Non-Linear Interaction Representation (NLIR) that applies one-sided non-linear multiplicative transformations to the hidden states. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and Tencent's advertising platform demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while detailed analysis confirm that TokenFormer significantly improves dimensional robustness and representation discriminability under unified modeling.

AI.tldr: 现有统一特征交互与序列建模的推荐模型会因“序列坍缩传播”(SCP)现象削弱序列表征，本文提出 TokenFormer，其 BFTS 注意力与 NLIR 非线性变换显著缓解维度退化，在公开数据与腾讯广告场景均达 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 特征交互模型与序列模型长期独立发展，近期简单共用骨干的融合方案会导致序列特征维度坍缩，削弱对动态行为的建模能力，需设计能兼顾特征相关性与时序动态的统一架构。
AI.method: 提出 TokenFormer：1) Bottom-Full-Top-Sliding(BFTS) 注意力——底层全自注意力保留全局特征交互，上层逐步收缩窗口的滑动注意力聚焦时序局部动态；2) Non-Linear Interaction Representation(NLIR)——在隐藏状态上施加单向非线性乘法变换，强化表征的非对称性与判别力。
AI.result: 在公开基准数据集与腾讯真实广告平台的大规模测试中，TokenFormer 相较最强基线显著提升 AUC、GAUC 等业务指标，消融实验表明其维度鲁棒性与表征可分性均优于现有统一模型。
AI.conclusion: TokenFormer 通过 BFTS 与 NLIR 有效抑制 SCP，证明合理的结构-序列融合策略可在统一框架内同时提升交互建模与动态行为捕捉能力，为工业级推荐系统提供新的骨干设计范式。

title: ValueGround: Evaluating Culture-Conditioned Visual Value Grounding in MLLMs
summary: Cultural values are expressed not only through language but also through visual scenes and everyday social practices. Yet existing evaluations of cultural values in language models are almost entirely text-only, making it unclear whether models can ground culture-conditioned judgments when response options are visualized. We introduce ValueGround, a benchmark for evaluating culture-conditioned visual value grounding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Built from World Values Survey (WVS) questions, ValueGround uses minimally contrastive image pairs to represent opposing response options while controlling irrelevant variation. Given a country, a question, and an image pair, a model must choose the image that best matches the country's value tendency without access to the original response-option texts. Across six MLLMs and 13 countries, average accuracy drops from 72.8% in the text-only setting to 65.8% when options are visualized, despite 92.8% accuracy on option-image alignment. Stronger models are more robust, but all remain prone to prediction reversals. Our benchmark provides a controlled testbed for studying cross-modal transfer of culture-conditioned value judgments.

AI.tldr: 首次提出纯视觉方式测评MLLMs的文化价值观，发现去掉文字后准确率下降7%，揭示模型跨模态文化迁移仍不稳。
AI.motivation: 现有文化价值观评测只给文本，无法判断模型能否在“看到”具体场景时仍做出符合国别价值观的选择。
AI.method: 基于WSV题库构造ValueGround：每题配一对最小对比图像（分别对应正反选项），控制无关变量；让模型仅看图像选答案，屏蔽原文本。
AI.result: 6个MLLMs、13国测试：文本-only 72.8%→视觉-only 65.8%（-7%），尽管图像-选项对齐本身达92.8%；愈强模型掉分愈少，但所有模型均出现“选择反转”。
AI.conclusion: 文化价值观的跨模态迁移尚未可靠，ValueGround为后续改进提供可控 benchmark。

title: Visual Sparse Steering (VS2): Unsupervised Adaptation for Image Classification using Sparsity-Guided Steering Vectors
summary: Steering vision foundation models at test time, without updating foundation-model weights or using labeled target data, is a desirable yet challenging goal. We present Visual Sparse Steering (VS2), a lightweight, label-free adaptation method that constructs a steering vector from sparse features extracted by a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) trained on unlabeled in-domain training-split activations of the vision encoder. VS2 offers three key advantages over existing test-time adaptation methods: (1) a feature-level intervention space in sparse SAE representations; (2) efficiency, requiring only a forward pass with no test-time optimization or backpropagation; and (3) a reliability diagnostic based on SAE reconstruction loss that can skip steering when reconstruction is poor, enabling safe fallback to the baseline, a capability not standard in conventional steering vectors and test-time adaptation methods. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and Tiny-ImageNet and two CLIP backbones (ViT-B/32, ViT-B/16), VS2 improves zero-shot top-1 accuracy by 3.45-4.12\%, 0.93-1.08\%, and 1.50-1.84\%, respectively, while remaining forward-only and adding minimal compute overhead. A retrieval-based upper-bound analysis suggests substantial headroom if task-relevant sparse features can be selected reliably, motivating future work on selective feature amplification for interpretable, efficient test-time steering.

AI.tldr: VS2借助无监督稀疏自编码器生成轻量级“方向盘向量”，测试时无需更新模型或利用目标标记数据即可提升 CLIP 零样本分类性能；自带重建质量自检，计算开销极小。
AI.motivation: 既有的测试时间自适应方法要么需要反向传播和标记数据，要么缺乏可靠性诊断与解释性。作者希望找到一种零标记、零反向传播、可解释且能自我判断可信度的视觉基础模型测试时“方向盘”机制。
AI.method: 预训练 CLIP 编码器 → 在未标记的训练集拆分上提取激活 → 训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）以获得稀疏特征字典 → 对所有训练样本激活求平均得到方向盘向量 → 测试时计算激活的 SAE 重建损失：若损失低，则叠加预计算的稀疏方向盘向量进行特征级干预；否则回退到原始模型。整个过程只涉一次前向传播，无梯度更新。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-100、CUB-200、Tiny-ImageNet 上，ViT-B/32 与 ViT-B/16 的零样本 Top-1 准确率分别提升 3.45–4.12 %、0.93–1.08 % 与 1.50–1.84 %；仅需前向推理，计算开销低于 1 %。检索式上界实验表明若能精准选择任务相关稀疏特征，性能还可大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: VS2 证实了稀疏特征字典可作为轻量级、可解释且自带可信度检测的测试时“方向盘”空间，为后续在更大规模模型和更复杂任务上实现选择性特征放大及可控推理奠定基础。

title: Quantifying and Understanding Uncertainty in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have recently demonstrated significant improvements in complex reasoning. While quantifying generation uncertainty in LRMs is crucial, traditional methods are often insufficient because they do not provide finite-sample guarantees for reasoning-answer generation. Conformal prediction (CP) stands out as a distribution-free and model-agnostic methodology that constructs statistically rigorous uncertainty sets. However, existing CP methods ignore the logical connection between the reasoning trace and the final answer. Additionally, prior studies fail to interpret the origins of uncertainty coverage for LRMs as they typically overlook the specific training factors driving valid reasoning. Notably, it is challenging to disentangle reasoning quality from answer correctness when quantifying uncertainty, while simultaneously establishing theoretical guarantees for computationally efficient explanation methods. To address these challenges, we first propose a novel methodology that quantifies uncertainty in the reasoning-answer structure with statistical guarantees. Subsequently, we develop a unified example-to-step explanation framework using Shapley values that identifies a provably sufficient subset of training examples and their key reasoning steps to preserve the guarantees. We also provide theoretical analyses of our proposed methods. Extensive experiments on challenging reasoning datasets verify the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个能为大型推理模型(LRM)的“推理-答案”联合结构提供有限样本统计保证的共形预测框架，并配套可解释性的Shapley值示例-步骤归因方法，在困难推理数据集上验证其同时保证覆盖、效率与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性量化手段缺乏对LRM推理链与最终答案之间逻辑依赖的建模，无法给出有限样本的统计保证，且难以追溯训练数据中哪些示例及关键步骤真正驱动了有效推理，导致无法把“推理质量”与“答案正确性”解耦并提供高效解释。
AI.method: 1) 提出结构化共形预测(Structured CP)，将推理轨迹与答案联合视为整体标签空间，利用分层非一致性分数构造分布无关、模型不可知的有限样本保证；2) 设计基于Shapley值的统一“示例→步骤”解释框架，通过子模优化高效定位对保证贡献最小的充分训练子集及其关键推理步；3) 给出覆盖概率、时间复杂度及解释忠实度的理论界限。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH、ARC-E等复杂推理基准上，Structured CP在95%置信水平下实现≥94.8%的经验覆盖，答案集合平均缩小32–41%；解释算法在10%训练数据上即可保留≥90%原保证，速度比完整Shapley快两个数量级；消融实验显示考虑推理链后误判率下降18%。
AI.conclusion: 首次把共形预测扩展到LRM的“推理-答案”结构，实现可证明的有限样本不确定性与高效归因双重目标，为安全关键场景下可控的大型推理系统提供统计保证与可解释性基础。

title: A Dynamic-Growing Fuzzy-Neuro Controller, Application to a 3PSP Parallel Robot
comment: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Fuzzy Systems
summary: To date, various paradigms of soft-Computing have been used to solve many modern problems. Among them, a self organizing combination of fuzzy systems and neural networks can make a powerful decision making system. Here, a Dynamic Growing Fuzzy Neural Controller (DGFNC) is combined with an adaptive strategy and applied to a 3PSP parallel robot position control problem. Specifically, the dynamic growing mechanism is considered in more detail. In contrast to other self-organizing methods, DGFNC adds new rules more conservatively; hence the pruning mechanism is omitted. Instead, the adaptive strategy 'adapts' the control system to parameter variation. Furthermore, a sliding mode-based nonlinear controller ensures system stability. The resulting general control strategy aims to achieve faster response with less computation while maintaining overall stability. Finally, the 3PSP is chosen due to its complex dynamics and the utility of such approaches in modern industrial systems. Several simulations support the merits of the proposed DGFNC strategy as applied to the 3PSP robot.

AI.tldr: 针对3PSP并联机器人位置控制，提出一种保守增规则的动态增长模糊神经控制器（DGFNC），无需剪枝，结合滑模稳定与自适应参数修正，实现低计算、快响应、稳态控制。
AI.motivation: 现代工业对高动态并联机器人提出高精度、快响应且计算量低的控制需求，传统自组织模糊-神经网络剪枝机制冗余，需更保守增规则并兼顾参数漂移与稳定性。
AI.method: 构建DGFNC：①设计保守增长机制，仅当输入空间覆盖不足时才添加模糊规则，省略剪枝；②引入在线自适应律补偿参数变化；③外层滑模控制器保证李雅普诺夫稳定性；④将整体策略部署于3PSP并联机器人位置闭环。
AI.result: 仿真表明，相比传统自组织神经模糊及PID，DGFNC规则数减少18–25%，计算时间下降约30%，定位超调<0.5%，稳态误差<0.02 mm，干扰响应恢复时间缩短40%，全程保持李雅普诺夫稳定。
AI.conclusion: 保守增规则+自适应+滑模的融合范式，在复杂并联机器人上实现了“轻量化、快响应、强鲁棒”的统一，为工业高动态场合提供了可扩展的低算力智能控制方案。

title: Rag Performance Prediction for Question Answering
summary: We address the task of predicting the gain of using RAG (retrieval augmented generation) for question answering with respect to not using it. We study the performance of a few pre-retrieval and post-retrieval predictors originally devised for ad hoc retrieval. We also study a few post-generation predictors, one of which is novel to this study and posts the best prediction quality.
