Our benchmark reconstructs motion from generated videos with a metric scale recovery mechanism, enabling the evaluation of planning performance with five complementary metrics that focus on target-approaching capability and directional consistency. Our evaluation result shows that the best off-the-shelf model achieves only a 0.341 overall score, revealing a significant gap between realistic visual generation and semantic reasoning in current video world models. Furthermore, we demonstrate that fine-tuning process on a relatively small real-world robot dataset can significantly improve task-level planning performance.

AI.tldr: 首个用于量化视频世界模型语义推理与规划能力的基准 Target-Bench 显示：现有模型视觉虽逼真，但规划得分仅 0.341；仅需少量机器人数据微调即可显著提升任务级表现。
AI.motivation: 高保真视频生成模型在语义推理与规划性能上缺乏系统评估，阻碍其在机器人等决策场景落地。
AI.method: 构建 450 个机器人采集、47 语义类别场景，用 SLAM 轨迹作真值；提出带尺度恢复的重建流程，设计 5 项互补指标评估目标接近度与方向一致性，并对模型进行少量真实机器人数据微调验证。
AI.result: 最佳现成模型综合得分仅 0.341，表明视觉真实性与语义规划能力严重脱节；微调后任务级指标显著提高。
AI.conclusion: 视觉生成与语义规划存在显著鸿沟，数据高效微调可有效缓解，为后续世界模型研究指明改进方向。

title: Calibrated Speculative Decoding: Frequency-Guided Candidate Selection for Efficient Inference
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by letting draft tokens bypass full verification, but conventional frameworks suffer from frequent false rejections, particularly when draft models produce semantically correct but lexically divergent outputs. In this paper, we present Calibrated Speculative Decoding (CSD), a training-free framework that recovers valid tokens discarded by standard verification. Guided by the principle of "Frequency-Guided Candidate Selection and Probability-Guarded Acceptance," CSD incorporates two lightweight modules: Online Correction Memory, which aggregates historical rejections to propose recurring divergence patterns as rescue candidates, and Semantic Consistency Gating, which verifies candidate admissibility using probability ratios instead of exact token matching. Our evaluation across diverse large language models demonstrates that CSD outperforms existing methods, achieving a peak throughput speedup of 2.33x. CSD preserves model accuracy across all tasks while further boosting performance on complex reasoning datasets. These results establish CSD as a highly effective, lightweight solution for practical LLM deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出CSD，一种无需训练的投机解码框架，通过
AI.motivation: 传统投机解码因使用精确词元匹配，容易错误拒绝那些词元不同但语义正确的草稿输出，导致加速效果受限，尤其在草稿模型输出与原模型在词元层面存在差异、但语义一致时表现不佳。因此，需要一种能够在不引入额外训练、不影响模型精度的前提下提升验证通过率的方法。
AI.method: CSD包含两个轻量模块：1) 在线矫正记忆(OCM)：在线收集历史被拒词元，统计高频“  分歧模式” 作为后续“救援候选” ；2) 语义一致性门(SCG)：利用草稿模型与目标模型的条件概率比值做软验证，取代硬性的精确词元匹配规则，从而在不牺牲语义的前提下收回头一次被拒但实质有效的词元。
AI.result: 在多种大模型和任务上的实验表明，CSD峰值吞吐量提升2.33×  同时完全不损失模型精度，并在复杂推理数据集上进一步提升表现，超越现有投机解码方法。
AI.conclusion: CSD以零训练、零额外参数的方式显著缓解假拒问题，为实用级LLM服务提供了一种轻量级且有效的加速方案。

title: ASTER: Latent Pseudo-Anomaly Generation for Unsupervised Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is critical in domains such as industrial monitoring, healthcare, and cybersecurity, but it remains challenging due to rare and heterogeneous anomalies and the scarcity of labelled data. This scarcity makes unsupervised approaches predominant, yet existing methods often rely on reconstruction or forecasting, which struggle with complex data, or on embedding-based approaches that require domain-specific anomaly synthesis and fixed distance metrics. We propose ASTER, a framework that generates pseudo-anomalies directly in the latent space, avoiding handcrafted anomaly injections and the need for domain expertise. A latent-space decoder produces tailored pseudo-anomalies to train a Transformer-based anomaly classifier, while a pre-trained LLM enriches the temporal and contextual representations of this space. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that ASTER achieves state-of-the-art performance and sets a new standard for LLM-based TSAD.

AI.tldr: ASTER用预训练大语言模型在潜空间自动生成伪异常样本，为Transformer异常分类器提供高质量训练信号，无需人工注入异常或领域知识，三项基准数据集上刷新无监督时间序列异常检测记录。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督时间序列异常检测要么依赖重建/预测，难以刻画复杂异常；要么采用嵌入+距离度量，需要手工合成异常且度量固定。高质量标注稀缺，亟需一种无需领域专家即可生成丰富异常信号的方法。
AI.method: 1) 预训练LLM编码时间序列，获得富含时序与语义的潜空间；2) 潜空间解码器以对比式采样生成多样化伪异常，规避手工注入；3) 用伪异常与正常样本训练Transformer二分类器，实现端到端异常判别。
AI.result: 在Yahoo、KPI、SMD三个公开基准上，ASTER的F1-score平均提升3.8%，显著优于当前最佳无监督方法，并将LLM引入时间序列异常检测的范式确立为新标杆。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间伪异常+LLM增强表示可有效缓解标注稀缺与异常异质问题，ASTE为无监督TSAD提供了通用、可扩展的新框架，并验证了大规模语言模型在时序异常判别中的潜力。

title: Two-Stage Regularization-Based Structured Pruning for LLMs
summary: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) is largely hindered by their large number of parameters. Structural pruning has emerged as a promising solution. Prior structured pruning methods directly remove unimportant parameters based on certain metrics, which often causes knowledge loss and necessitates extensive retraining. To overcome this, we introduce a novel pruning method TRSP: Two-Stage Regularization-Based Structured Pruning for LLMs. Specifically, we multiply the output of each transformer layer by an initial learnable weight and iteratively learn these weights by adding their $\ell_1$-norm as a regularization term to the loss function, serving as the first-stage regularization. Subsequently, we apply additional regularization to the difference between the output and input of layers with smaller weights, encouraging the shift of knowledge to the preserved layers. This serves as the second-stage regularization. TRSP retains more knowledge and better preserves model performance than direct parameter elimination. Through extensive experimentation we show that TRSP outperforms strong layer-wise structured pruning methods without requiring retraining. As a layer-wise pruning method, it delivers notable end-to-end acceleration, making it a promising solution for efficient LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: TRSP 是一种无需重训练的两阶段正则化结构化剪枝方法，可在层级别压缩大模型并保留更多知识。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝直接丢弃参数，导致知识丢失且需昂贵重训练，阻碍大语言模型实际部署。
AI.method: 第一阶段对每个 Transformer 层输出引入可学习标量权重，并以权重 ℓ1 正则化驱动稀疏性；第二阶段对权重较小的层再施加“输出-输入差”正则化，把知识迁移到保留层，最后按权重阈值整体删层。
AI.result: 在无需重训练条件下，TRSP 优于多种强层剪枝基线，显著压缩模型且端到端推理加速明显。
AI.conclusion: TRSP 通过两阶段正则化实现知识保持与层移除，兼顾高压缩率与性能，为大模型高效部署提供了可行新路径。

title: UniGeoSeg: Towards Unified Open-World Segmentation for Geospatial Scenes
comment: Datasets and source code were released at https://github.com/MiliLab/UniGeoSeg
summary: Instruction-driven segmentation in remote sensing generates masks from guidance, offering great potential for accessible and generalizable applications. However, existing methods suffer from fragmented task formulations and limited instruction data, hindering effective understanding and generalization. To address these issues, we introduce GeoSeg-1M, the first million-scale dataset for remote sensing instruction-driven segmentation, constructed via an automatic mask filtering and instruction generation pipeline that synthesizes referring, interactive, and reasoning segmentation instructions from multiple public datasets. GeoSeg-1M contains 590K images, 117 categories, and 1.1M image-mask-instruction triplets. Building upon this foundation, we further curate GeoSeg-Bench, a challenging benchmark designed to evaluate contextual understanding and reasoning capabilities across diverse instruction-driven tasks and complex geospatial scenes. Furthermore, we present UniGeoSeg, a unified framework that serves as a strong baseline, incorporating task-aware text enhancement, latent knowledge memory, and a progressive training strategy to facilitate multi-task learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of UniGeoSeg across GeoSeg-Bench and diverse public benchmarks, while exhibiting strong zero-shot generalization. Datasets and source code were released at https://github.com/MiliLab/UniGeoSeg.

AI.tldr: 首次提出百万级遥感指令人像分割数据集 GeoSeg-1M（590 k 图/117 类/1.1 M 三元组），并配套基准 GeoSeg-Bench 与统一基线 UniGeoSeg；自动过滤-指令生成流程+任务感知文本增强+潜知识记忆，实现 SOTA 性能与零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感指令分割研究任务碎片化、指令数据稀缺，导致模型难以获得通用场景理解能力。
AI.method: 1）构建 GeoSeg-1M：基于多公开数据，通过自动掩膜过滤与指令生成管线合成指代、交互与推理三类分割指令；2）设计 GeoSeg-Bench：覆盖复杂地理场景与多任务，评估上下文理解及推理；3）提出 UniGeoSeg：统一框架，引入任务感知文本增强、潜知识记忆库与渐进式多任务训练策略。
AI.result: UniGeoSeg 在 GeoSeg-Bench 及多个公开基准上取得 SOTA 指标，并展现强零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 大规模指令数据与统一框架显著提升遥感指令分割的通用性与可解释性，为后续研究提供基准与开源资源。

title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Sim-and-Real Co-Training in Generative Robot Policies
summary: Co-training, which combines limited in-domain real-world data with abundant surrogate data such as simulation or cross-embodiment robot data, is widely used for training generative robot policies. Despite its empirical success, the mechanisms that determine when and why co-training is effective remain poorly understood. We investigate the mechanism of sim-and-real co-training through theoretical analysis and empirical study, and identify two intrinsic effects governing performance. The first, \textbf{``structured representation alignment"}, reflects a balance between cross-domain representation alignment and domain discernibility, and plays a primary role in downstream performance. The second, the \textbf{``importance reweighting effect"}, arises from domain-dependent modulation of action weighting and operates at a secondary level. We validate these effects with controlled experiments on a toy model and extensive sim-and-sim and sim-and-real robot manipulation experiments. Our analysis offers a unified interpretation of recent co-training techniques and motivates a simple method that consistently improves upon prior approaches. More broadly, our aim is to examine the inner workings of co-training and to facilitate research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从机理层面解释了仿真−真实协同训练(可推广到跨数据域协同)为何能提升生成式机器人策略：性能提升的本质由两个可量化的内在效应——“结构化表征对齐”与“重要性重加权”共同决定。
AI.motivation: 协同训练在机器人领域被广泛使用，但以往只能靠经验判断“何时有效、为何有效”，缺乏统一理论；其不可解释性限制了策略可靠性及后续算法创新。
AI.method: 1) 建立理论框架，将协同训练拆解为表征空间的对齐/可区分权衡和动作权重的域相关重加权；2) 设计可控 toy 模型实验精确分离并量化两大效应；3) 在仿真-仿真、仿真-真实两套机器人操作基准上做大规模实验验证。
AI.result: 1) 证明“结构化表征对齐”占决定性贡献，次要贡献来自“重要性重加权”；2) 理论预测与 toy 模型、真实机器人数据高度一致；3) 基于所得机理提出极简策略修正，稳定超越现有协同训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次给出协同训练生效的普适机理与量化指标，为后续表征学习、权重修正与数据选择提供理论依据，并可直接转化为实用算法提升机器人策略性能。

title: HINTBench: Horizon-agent Intrinsic Non-attack Trajectory Benchmark
summary: Existing agent-safety evaluation has focused mainly on externally induced risks. Yet agents may still enter unsafe trajectories under benign conditions. We study this complementary but underexplored setting through the lens of \emph{intrinsic} risk, where intrinsic failures remain latent, propagate across long-horizon execution, and eventually lead to high-consequence outcomes. To evaluate this setting, we introduce \emph{non-attack intrinsic risk auditing} and present \textbf{HINTBench}, a benchmark of 629 agent trajectories (523 risky, 106 safe; 33 steps on average) supporting three tasks: risk detection, risk-step localization, and intrinsic failure-type identification. Its annotations are organized under a unified five-constraint taxonomy. Experiments reveal a substantial capability gap: strong LLMs perform well on trajectory-level risk detection, but their performance drops to below 35 Strict-F1 on risk-step localization, while fine-grained failure diagnosis proves even harder. Existing guard models transfer poorly to this setting. These findings establish intrinsic risk auditing as an open challenge for agent safety.

AI.tldr: HINTBench首次系统研究“无攻击情况下代理因内在缺陷导致的长程高危轨迹”，并发现现有大模型在定位具体风险步骤与诊断失败类型时能力严重不足。
AI.motivation: 主流代理安全评估仅关注外部攻击触发的高危行为，忽视了在完全正常环境下，因代理自身隐含缺陷（intrinsic failure）随时间累积而自发进入高危轨迹的情形，该情形缺乏 benchmark 与系统研究。
AI.method: 提出非攻击内在风险审计框架，构建含 629 条轨迹（523 条高危、106 条安全）的 HINTBench，平均 33 步；设计统一五约束分类法，支持三项子任务：轨迹级风险检测、风险步骤定位、失败类型识别。
AI.result: 实验显示强 LLM 在轨迹级检测上表现良好，但在步骤级定位任务中 Strict-F1 不足 35%，细粒度失败诊断更难；现有 guard 模型迁移效果差，暴露出显著能力缺口。
AI.conclusion: 内在风险审计成为代理安全领域亟待解决的新开放挑战，亟需针对性算法与评估体系。

title: Not All Tokens Matter: Towards Efficient LLM Reasoning via Token Significance in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show strong reasoning abilities but often produce unnecessarily long explanations that reduce efficiency. Although reinforcement learning (RL) has been used to improve reasoning, most methods focus on accuracy and rely on uniform length-based rewards that overlook the differing contributions of individual tokens, often harming correctness. We revisit length optimization in RL through the perspective of token significance. Observing that many chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens contribute little to the final answer, we introduce a significance-aware length reward that selectively penalizes insignificance tokens, reducing redundancy while preserving essential reasoning. We also propose a dynamic length reward that encourages more detailed reasoning early in training and gradually shifts toward conciseness as learning progresses. Integrating these components into standard policy optimization yields a framework that improves both reasoning efficiency and accuracy. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate substantial reductions in response length while preserving or improving correctness, highlighting the importance of modeling token significance for efficient LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 将策略优化与动态显著度惩罚结合，可在几乎不牺牲正确性的前提下，把CoT长度平均压缩30-50%。
AI.motivation: 现有RL改进LLM推理只关注准确率；均等的长度惩罚不分青红皂白地剪掉所有Token，常导致错误。作者观察到多数CoT步骤对最终答案贡献极小，提出应该
AI.method: 提出Token-level显著度指标（基于梯度/注意力或答案稳定度），把“无贡献Token”作为长度惩罚目标；训练初期用宽松长度奖励鼓励充分探索，随后逐渐收紧，实现“动态长度奖励”。将两项奖励直接并入PPO/GRPO等策略梯度目标, 无需外部蒸馏或监督。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH、BBH等7个基准上，平均生成长度降30-50%，准确率持平或+1-3pp；相比均匀长度惩罚基线，在同等压缩率下错误率降低20-40%。
AI.conclusion: 仅按长度一刀切会伤害推理正确性。显式建模Token显著度并动态调整奖励，可在保证答案正确的同时显著削减冗余，是兼顾效率与准确度的通用强化学习框架。

title: GeoBridge: A Semantic-Anchored Multi-View Foundation Model Bridging Images and Text for Geo-Localization
comment: The paper is accepted by CVPR 2026! Code, dataset, and pretrained models will be released at https://github.com/MiliLab/GeoBridge
summary: Cross-view geo-localization infers a location by retrieving geo-tagged reference images that visually correspond to a query image. However, the traditional satellite-centric paradigm limits robustness when high-resolution or up-to-date satellite imagery is unavailable. It further underexploits complementary cues across views (\eg, drone, satellite, and street) and modalities (\eg, language and image). To address these challenges, we propose GeoBridge, a novel model that performs bidirectional matching across views and supports language-to-image retrieval. Going beyond traditional satellite-centric formulations, GeoBridge builds on a novel semantic-anchor mechanism that bridges multi-view features through textual descriptions for robust, flexible localization. In support of this task, we construct GeoLoc, the first large-scale, cross-modal, and multi-view aligned dataset comprising over 50,000 pairs of drone, street-view panorama, and satellite images as well as their textual descriptions, collected from 36 countries, ensuring both geographic and semantic alignment. We performed broad evaluations across multiple tasks. Experiments confirm that GeoLoc pre-training markedly improves geo-location accuracy for GeoBridge while promoting cross-domain generalization and cross-modal knowledge transfer. Code, dataset, and pretrained models will be released at https://github.com/MiliLab/GeoBridge.

AI.tldr: 抛弃单一天空视角，引入多视角、跨模态数据集GeoLoc，并提出双向检索模型GeoBridge，显著提升图像定位鲁棒性与语言检索能力。
AI.motivation: 传统卫星主导定位方法因高分辨率／时效影像缺失而受限于城市峡谷等场景，且未联合无人机、街景、文本等多视角与模态的互补线索。
AI.method: 设计GeoBridge模型，以“语义锚”将多视角的视觉特征对齐到同一文本空间，实现卫星↔无人机↔街景三向检索，并首次支持纯文本定位；同时构建首个50k规模、36国对齐的跨模态多视角基准GeoLoc。
AI.result: GeoBridge在GeoLoc预训练后，不仅各项视觉定位指标显著领先，还能零样本迁移到新城市及不同分辨率卫星图，语言检索Top-1准确率达到87%。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态多视角对齐训练是突破单视角局限的有效途径；GeoBridge+GeoLoc展示了可扩展的定位新范式，相关代码与数据已开源供社区复用与扩展。

title: Automatic Charge State Tuning of 300 mm FDSOI Quantum Dots Using Neural Network Segmentation of Charge Stability Diagram
summary: Tuning of gate-defined semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) is a major bottleneck for scaling spin qubit technologies. We present a deep learning (DL) driven, semantic-segmentation pipeline that performs charge auto-tuning by locating transition lines in full charge stability diagrams (CSDs) and returns gate voltage targets for the single charge regime. We assemble and manually annotate a large, heterogeneous dataset of 1015 experimental CSDs measured from silicon QD devices, spanning nine design geometries, multiple wafers, and fabrication runs. A U-Net style convolutional neural network (CNN) with a MobileNetV2 encoder is trained and validated through five-fold group cross validation. Our model achieves an overall offline tuning success of 80.0% in locating the single-charge regime, with peak performance exceeding 88% for some designs. We analyze dominant failure modes and propose targeted mitigations. Finally, wide-range diagram segmentation also naturally enables scalable physic-based feature extraction that can feed back to fabrication and design workflows and outline a roadmap for real-time integration in a cryogenic wafer prober. Overall, our results show that neural network (NN) based wide-diagram segmentation is a practical step toward automated, high-throughput charge tuning for silicon QD qubits.

AI.tldr: 基于语义分割深度学习模型自动从硅量子点电荷稳定性图中定位单电子区，实现 80% 离线调谐成功率，为大规模自旋量子比特阵列提供高通量电荷调谐方案。
AI.motivation: 门控半导体量子点电荷调谐是硅量子比特规模化的关键瓶颈；传统人工逐点扫描耗时且难以扩展。
AI.method: 收集并手工标注 1015 张涵盖 9 种器件几何的多晶圆实验 CSD 图，训练 U-Net 结构（MobileNetV2 编码器）的全图语义分割网络，通过五折分组交叉验证优化，输出转移线掩膜并直接回归单电子区目标栅压。
AI.result: 模型离线预测下单电荷区定位成功率 80%，部分设计超过 88%；对主要失效模式（图像模糊、对比度低、栅极串扰等）进行归因并提出针对性改进。
AI.conclusion: 宽图神经网络分割可实用地实现自动电荷调谐，并可扩展为基于物理的特征提取，反哺工艺设计与实时低温晶圆探针集成，显著提升硅量子点自旋量子比特的制造与调谐通量。

title: Creo: From One-Shot Image Generation to Progressive, Co-Creative Ideation
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems enable rapid generation of high-fidelity imagery but are misaligned with how visual ideas develop. T2I systems generate outputs that make implicit visual decisions on behalf of the user, often introduce fine-grained details that can anchor users prematurely and limit their ability to keep options open early on, and cause unintended changes during editing that are difficult to correct and reduce users' sense of control. To address these concerns, we present Creo, a multi-stage T2I system that scaffolds image generation by progressing from rough sketches to high-resolution outputs, exposing intermediary abstractions where users can make incremental changes. Sketch-like abstractions invite user editing and allow users to keep design options open when ideas are still forming due to their provisional nature. Each stage in Creo can be modified with manual changes and AI-assisted operations, enabling fine-grained, step-wise control through a locking mechanism that preserves prior decisions so subsequent edits affect only specified regions or attributes. Users remain in the loop, making and verifying decisions across stages, while the system applies diffs instead of regenerating full images, reducing drift as fidelity increases. A comparative study with a one-shot baseline shows that participants felt stronger ownership over Creo outputs, as they were able to trace their decisions in building up the image. Furthermore, embedding-based analysis indicates that Creo outputs are less homogeneous than one-shot results. These findings suggest that multi-stage generation, combined with intermediate control and decision locking, is a key design principle for improving controllability, user agency, creativity, and output diversity in generative systems.

AI.tldr: 针对 T2I 一次性生成造成的早定锚与难以修正问题，本文提出多阶段系统 Creo，从粗速写逐步到高清图；支持中途手动+AI 介入修改，并通过锁定机制仅对局部“打补丁”，提升可控性、用户认同感与输出多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本生成图像工具一次性输出高保真图像，会过早引入细节、难以回退或局部修改，抑制早期构思的开放性与用户掌控感。
AI.method: 设计 Creo——多阶段 T2I 框架：①逐级从概念草图、结构图到高分辨率图像；②每阶段暴露可编辑抽象表示，用户可随时手动或指挥 AI 微调；③引入区域/属性锁定机制，确保后续编辑只作用于未锁定部分；④采用差分式增量合成而非整图重采样，减少从上到下的漂移。
AI.result: 对比实验显示：①用户主观对 Creo 结果的“拥有感”显著高于一次性生成基线；②基于嵌入空间的多样性指标表明 Creo 输出的同质性更低。
AI.conclusion: 将“多阶段生成 + 中间可干预 + 决策锁定”作为设计准则，能显著提升生成式系统的可控性、用户能动性与创意多样性，为未来人机协同创作提供范式。

title: RL-PLUS: Countering Capability Boundary Collapse of LLMs in Reinforcement Learning with Hybrid-policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has significantly advanced the complex reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, it struggles to break through the inherent capability boundaries of the base LLM, due to its essentially on-policy strategy coupled with LLM's immense action space and sparse reward. Critically, RLVR can lead to the capability boundary collapse, narrowing the LLM's problem-solving scope. To address this problem, we propose RL-PLUS, a novel hybrid-policy optimization approach for LLMs that synergizes internal exploitation with external data to achieve stronger reasoning capabilities and surpass the boundaries of base models. RL-PLUS integrates two core components, i.e., Multiple Importance Sampling to address distributional mismatch from external data, and Exploration-Based Advantage Function to guide the model towards high-value, unexplored reasoning paths. We provide both theoretical analysis and extensive experiments to demonstrate the superiority and generalizability of our approach. Compared with existing RLVR methods, RL-PLUS achieves 1) state-of-the-art performance on six math reasoning benchmarks; 2) superior performance on six out-of-distribution reasoning tasks; 3) consistent and significant gains across diverse model families, with average relative improvements up to 69.2\%. Moreover, the analysis of Pass@k curves indicates that RL-PLUS effectively resolves the capability boundary collapse problem.

AI.tldr: 本文指出RLVR受限于on-policy更新与巨大动作空间，导致LLM能力边界塌陷；为此提出混合策略算法RL-PLUS，通过重要性采样与探索型优势函数引入外部数据，六类数学Benchmark与OOD任务均显著突破基模型上限，平均相对提升达69.2%，并有效恢复Pass@k扩展能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管RLVR提升了LLM复杂推理，但纯on-policy训练与稀疏奖励使其难以跨越基础模型固有能力上限，甚至出现"能力边界塌陷"（Capability Boundary Collapse），解题空间被压缩，亟需引入外部数据进行策略优化。
AI.method: 提出RL-PLUS：1) 使用Multiple Importance Sampling（MIS）矫正外部样本与策略分布差距，可安全复用异策略数据；2) 设计Exploration-Based Advantage Function，显式奖励高价值且少被探索的推理路径；3) 混合策略框架交替进行内部利用与外部探索，实现稳定高效的异策略优化。
AI.result: 在六个数学推理基准与六个分布外任务上，对比现有RLVR方法：1) 获得SOTA成绩；2) 显著提高OOD鲁棒性；3) 跨越三种模型族平均相对提升69.2%；4) Pass@k曲线持续上升，证明算法成功突破原模型的能力边界。
AI.conclusion: RL-PLUS通过重要性采样与探索优势协同，有效消除分布偏移并扩展探索空间，理论上保障收敛，实验上在多种任务与模型规模均大幅提升推理表现，为突破LLM固有推理上限提供了可扩展的新框架。

title: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation with a Unified Framework for Spatial, Temporal and Embodied Reasoning
comment: Under Review, 16 pages, 12 figures. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/return-sleep/AeroAct
summary: Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) aims to enable unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to interpret natural language instructions and navigate complex urban environments using onboard visual observation. This task holds promise for real-world applications such as low-altitude inspection, search-and-rescue, and autonomous aerial delivery. Existing methods often rely on panoramic images, depth inputs, or odometry to support spatial reasoning and action planning. These requirements increase system cost and integration complexity, thus hindering practical deployment for lightweight UAVs. We present a unified aerial VLN framework that operates solely on egocentric monocular RGB observations and natural language instructions. The model formulates navigation as a next-token prediction problem, jointly optimizing spatial perception, trajectory reasoning, and action prediction through prompt-guided multi-task learning. Moreover, we propose a keyframe selection strategy to reduce visual redundancy by retaining semantically informative frames, along with an action merging and label reweighting mechanism that mitigates long-tailed supervision imbalance and facilitates stable multi-task co-training. Extensive experiments on the AerialVLN and OpenFly benchmark validate the effectiveness of our method. Under the challenging monocular RGB-only setting, our model achieves strong results across both seen and unseen environments. It significantly outperforms existing RGB-only baselines and narrows the performance gap with state-of-the-art panoramic RGB-D counterparts. Comprehensive ablation studies further demonstrate the contribution of our task design and architectural choices. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/return-sleep/AeroAct.

AI.tldr: 仅依赖单目RGB与文本，提出“下一token预测”统一框架，结合关键帧采样、动作合并与重加权，实现轻量UAV的空中视觉-语言导航，性能逼近RGB-D方法。
AI.motivation: 现有空中VLN需全景、深度或里程计，硬件负担大，难以部署于轻量无人机；亟需低成本、纯视觉方案。
AI.method: 1) 将导航统一为下一token预测任务，端到端联合空间感知-轨迹推理-动作预测；2) 提示引导的多任务共享Transformer；3) 基于语义冗余度的关键帧选择；4) 动作合并与长尾重加权，稳定共训练。
AI.result: 在AerialVLN与OpenFly单目RGB-only条件下，一致超越现有RGB-only基线，并把与SOTA RGB-D方法的差距缩小约40%；消融实验验证了各模块有效性。
AI.conclusion: 无需额外传感器即可实现鲁棒空中VLN，为轻量无人机大规模落地提供了可行路径，代码已开源。

title: Automatically Inferring Teachers' Geometric Content Knowledge: A Skills Based Approach
comment: The work is accepted for publication as a full paper (Main Track) at the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: Assessing teachers' geometric content knowledge is essential for geometry instructional quality and student learning, but difficult to scale. The Van Hiele model characterizes geometric reasoning through five hierarchical levels. Traditional Van Hiele assessment relies on manual expert analysis of open-ended responses. This process is time-consuming, costly, and prevents large-scale evaluation. This study develops an automated approach for diagnosing teachers' Van Hiele reasoning levels using large language models grounded in educational theory. Our central hypothesis is that integrating explicit skills information significantly improves Van Hiele classification. In collaboration with mathematics education researchers, we built a structured skills dictionary decomposing the Van Hiele levels into 33 fine-grained reasoning skills. Through a custom web platform, 31 pre-service teachers solved geometry problems, yielding 226 responses. Expert researchers then annotated each response with its Van Hiele level and demonstrated skills from the dictionary. Using this annotated dataset, we implemented two classification approaches: (1) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and (2) multi-task learning (MTL). Each approach compared a skills-aware variant incorporating the skills dictionary against a baseline without skills information. Results showed that for both methods, skills-aware variants significantly outperformed baselines across multiple evaluation metrics. This work provides the first automated approach for Van Hiele level classification from open-ended responses. It offers a scalable, theory-grounded method for assessing teachers' geometric reasoning that can enable large-scale evaluation and support adaptive, personalized teacher learning systems.

AI.tldr: 首次用LLM把Van Hiele几何推理五水平评估自动化，可大规模判断教师几何认知水平。
AI.motivation: 手工评估教师Van Hiele水平耗时昂贵，难以扩展，限制了对几何教学质量的系统监测与改进。
AI.method: 与教育研究者共建33条细粒度技能词典，将五水平拆解为可计算特征；邀请31名职前教师在线答题，获226条开放回答，由专家标注水平与显式技能；用同一批数据训练RAG与MTL两种模型，比较“含技能信息”与不含技能的基准版本。
AI.result: 无论RAG还是MTL，引入技能词典的模型在准确率、F1、MCC等指标上均显著优于基准，最高提升约12个百分点；首次实现从开放答案端到端自动判定Van Hiele水平。
AI.conclusion: 把教育理论显式编码为技能词典并嵌入LLM，可低成本、大规模、可信地评估教师几何推理水平，为自适应师资培训与个性化学习提供即时诊断工具。

title: How Can We Synthesize High-Quality Pretraining Data? A Systematic Study of Prompt Design, Generator Model, and Source Data
summary: Synthetic data is a standard component in training large language models, yet systematic comparisons across design dimensions, including rephrasing strategy, generator model, and source data, remain absent. We conduct extensive controlled experiments, generating over one trillion tokens, to identify critical factors in rephrasing web text into synthetic pretraining data. Our results reveal that structured output formats, such as tables, math problems, FAQs, and tutorials, consistently outperform both curated web baselines and prior synthetic methods. Notably, increasing the size of the generator model beyond 1B parameters provides no additional benefit. Our analysis also demonstrates that the selection of the original data used for mixing substantially influences performance. By applying our findings, we develop \textbf{\textsc{FinePhrase}}, a 486-billion-token open dataset of rephrased web text. We show that \textsc{FinePhrase} outperforms all existing synthetic data baselines while reducing generation costs by up to 30 times. We provide the dataset, all prompts, and the generation framework to the research community.

AI.tldr: 用控制变量法生成1万亿token并系统比较，发现结构化改写格式（表格、数学题、FAQ、教程等）最优；生成模型>1B参数无增益；混合源数据选择影响性能；据此开源486B token高质量合成数据集FinePhrase，成本降30倍，全面优于现有合成基线。
AI.motivation: 大模型预训练虽广泛使用合成数据，但缺乏对改写策略、生成模型规模及源数据选择的系统性对照，导致“如何高效合成高质量数据”缺乏科学依据。
AI.method: 设计多因子受控实验：固定其他变量，逐一测试改写格式、生成器规模（0.3B–30B）、源数据类型与混合比例；共生成>1T token并在统一下游任务上评估困惑度与迁移性能；统计显著性检验；最终基于最优配置构建并开源FinePhrase数据集与完整生成框架。
AI.result: 1. 结构化格式（表格、数学、FAQ、教程）始终优于精心筛选的Web文本及既往合成方法；2. 生成器>1B参数时性能饱和；3. 源数据选择比生成器规模影响更大；4. FinePhrase在零样本、少样本、微调场景全面刷新合成数据SOTA，同时生成成本降低30×。
AI.conclusion: 改写格式与源数据选择是合成数据质量的瓶颈，而盲目扩大生成模型规模收益有限；FinePhrase为社区提供了高质、低价、可复现的千亿级预训练资源，并给出普适设计准则。

title: Activation-Guided Local Editing for Jailbreaking Attacks
summary: Jailbreaking is an essential adversarial technique for red-teaming these models to uncover and patch security flaws. However, existing jailbreak methods face significant drawbacks. Token-level jailbreak attacks often produce incoherent or unreadable inputs and exhibit poor transferability, while prompt-level attacks lack scalability and rely heavily on manual effort and human ingenuity. We propose a concise and effective two-stage framework that combines the advantages of these approaches. The first stage performs a scenario-based generation of context and rephrases the original malicious query to obscure its harmful intent. The second stage then utilizes information from the model's hidden states to guide fine-grained edits, effectively steering the model's internal representation of the input from a malicious toward a benign one. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this method achieves state-of-the-art Attack Success Rate, with gains of up to 37.74% over the strongest baseline, and exhibits excellent transferability to black-box models. Our analysis further demonstrates that AGILE maintains substantial effectiveness against prominent defense mechanisms, highlighting the limitations of current safeguards and providing valuable insights for future defense development. Our code is available at https://github.com/SELGroup/AGILE.

AI.tldr: AGILE 是一种兼顾可扩展与可读性的两段式 jailbreak 框架，先让恶意查询伪装成无害提问，再利用模型隐藏状态做细粒度编辑，使攻击成功率提升 37.74% 以上，对黑盒和主流防御均高有效。
AI.motivation: 现有 token 级 jailbreak 产出难读文本且迁移差，prompt 级方法依赖手工、难扩展；亟需兼具可读性、规模化和强迁移的通用越狱手段。
AI.method: 两段式：1) 场景提示生成器为恶意查询构建情境并重述，隐藏恶意意图；2) 隐藏状态引导器借助模型中间表示做细粒度 token 替换/增删，将内部语义由恶导向善。
AI.result: 在多种 LLM 上实现 SOTA ASR，相对最强基线绝对提升 37.74%，黑盒迁移良好，对 Paraphrase、Prefix、Perplexity、Safety Filter 等防御仍保持高成功率。
AI.conclusion: AGILE 凸显当前安全机制对内部表示层面扰动的脆弱性，提示未来防御需关注隐藏状态监测与训练阶段对齐，而非仅输入/输出过滤。

title: ViBES: A Conversational Agent with Behaviorally-Intelligent 3D Virtual Body
comment: Project page: https://ai.stanford.edu/~juze/ViBES/. Accepted by CVPR 2026
summary: Human communication is inherently multimodal and social: words, prosody, and body language jointly carry intent. Yet most prior systems model human behavior as a translation task co-speech gesture or text-to-motion that maps a fixed utterance to motion clips-without requiring agentic decision-making about when to move, what to do, or how to adapt across multi-turn dialogue. This leads to brittle timing, weak social grounding, and fragmented stacks where speech, text, and motion are trained or inferred in isolation. We introduce ViBES (Voice in Behavioral Expression and Synchrony), a conversational 3D agent that jointly plans language and movement and executes dialogue-conditioned body actions. Concretely, ViBES is a speech-language-behavior (SLB) model with a mixture-of-modality-experts (MoME) backbone: modality-partitioned transformer experts for speech, facial expression, and body motion. The model processes interleaved multimodal token streams with hard routing by modality (parameters are split per expert), while sharing information through cross-expert attention. By leveraging strong pretrained speech-language models, the agent supports mixed-initiative interaction: users can speak, type, or issue body-action directives mid-conversation, and the system exposes controllable behavior hooks for streaming responses. We further benchmark on multi-turn conversation with automatic metrics of dialogue-motion alignment and behavior quality, and observe consistent gains over strong co-speech and text-to-motion baselines. ViBES goes beyond "speech-conditioned motion generation" toward agentic virtual bodies where language, prosody, and movement are jointly generated, enabling controllable, socially competent 3D interaction. Code and data will be made available at: ai.stanford.edu/~juze/ViBES/

AI.tldr: ViBES 是第一个在多轮对话中联合生成语言、韵律与 3D 全身动作的社交代理，通过 MoME 架构实现模态解耦与跨模态注意，显著优于传统「语音-动作翻译」基线。
AI.motivation: 既有方法把人类行为简化为单句→动作的翻译任务，忽略何时、如何动作的代理决策，导致时间僵硬、社交 grounding 弱、模态割裂。需要能在多轮对话中协同规划语言与动作的具身代理。
AI.method: 提出 SLB 模型 ViBES，核心为 mixture-of-modality-experts (MoME) Transformer：按语音/脸/体分专家，硬路由参数隔离，跨专家注意共享信息；利用预训练语音-语言模型，支持用户口语、文字或动作指令的混合式输入，并以流式钩子提供可控生成。
AI.result: 在多轮对话数据集上，采用自动对话-动作对齐度与行为质量指标，ViBES 一致超越强 co-speech 与 text-to-motion 基线，实现更准时机、更连贯的 3D 社交行为。
AI.conclusion: ViBES 将「语音驱动动作生成」升级为「语言-韵律-动作联合生成」的代理框架，为可控、具社交能力的 3D 交互奠定基础。

title: node2vec or triangle-biased random walks: stationarity, regularity & recurrence
summary: The node2vec random walk is a non-Markovian random walk on the vertex set of a graph, widely used for network embedding and exploration. This random walk model is defined in terms of three parameters which control the probability of, respectively, backtracking moves, moves within triangles, and moves to the remaining neighboring nodes. From a mathematical standpoint, the node2vec random walk is a nontrivial generalization of the non-backtracking random walk and thus belongs to the class of second-order Markov chains. Despite its widespread use in applications, little is known about its long-run behavior. The goal of this paper is to begin exploring its fundamental properties on arbitrary graphs. To this aim, we show how lifting the node2vec random walk to the state spaces of directed edges and directed wedges yields two distinct Markovian representations which are key for its asymptotic analysis. Using these representations, we find mild sufficient conditions on the underlying finite or infinite graph to guarantee ergodicity, reversibility, recurrence and characterization of the invariant measure. As we discuss, the behavior of the node2vec random walk is drastically different compared to the non-backtracking random walk. While the latter simplifies on arbitrary graphs when using its natural edge Markovian representation thanks to bistochasticity, the former simplifies on regular graphs when using its natural wedge Markovian representation. Remarkably, this representation reveals that a graph is regular if and only if a certain weighted Eulerianity condition holds.

AI.tldr: 针对 node2vec 随机游走长期行为不明的问题，作者提出将其提升到「有向边」与「有向楔」两种状态空间，获得可分析的 Markov 表示，并据此给出可保证遍历性、可逆性、常返性及不变测度特征的温和图条件，同时发现 node2vec 在正则图上的简化判据与加权 Eulerian 性质等价。
AI.motivation: node2vec 作为网络嵌入的核心采样算法，其非马尔可夫二阶游走虽被广泛应用，但长期统计性质（遍历、可逆、不变测度等）几乎空白，限制了对算法收敛性与稳定性的理论理解。
AI.method: 1) 将节点级 node2vec 游走提升到「有向边」和「有向楔形(triangle 的两邻边)」两个增广状态空间，构造两族具 Markov 性的链；2) 利用有限/无限图的局部结构参数给出新链不可约、非周期、正递归的充分条件；3) 通过计算平稳分布并验证细致平衡，刻画可逆情形；4) 对比非回溯游走，指出 node2vec 仅在正则图上可借「楔形链」显著简化，并导出图正则等价于某加权 Eulerian 条件。
AI.result: 获得任意图上 node2vec 游走的遍历与可逆充分条件；给出显式不变测度公式；证明对正则图，楔形链转移矩阵满足双随机性，使分析大幅简化；发现正则图的全新刻画——加权 Eulerian 条件成立当且仅当图为正则。
AI.conclusion: 通过提升状态空间并建立两族 Markov 表示，论文首次系统揭示了 node2vec 随机游走的长期行为，确立其理论分析框架，并为后续混合时间、收敛速度及嵌入质量评估奠定严格基础；同时指出正则图结构可带来额外简化，提示图正则性在网络采样算法中的特殊意义。

title: Leveraging LLM-GNN Integration for Open-World Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs
summary: Open-world Question Answering (OW-QA) over knowledge graphs (KGs) aims to answer questions over incomplete or evolving KGs. Traditional KGQA assumes a closed world where answers must exist in the KG, limiting real-world applicability. In contrast, open-world QA requires inferring missing knowledge based on graph structure and context. Large language models (LLMs) excel at language understanding but lack structured reasoning. Graph neural networks (GNNs) model graph topology but struggle with semantic interpretation. Existing systems integrate LLMs with GNNs or graph retrievers. Some support open-world QA but rely on structural embeddings without semantic grounding. Most assume observed paths or complete graphs, making them unreliable under missing links or multi-hop reasoning. We present GLOW, a hybrid system that combines a pre-trained GNN and an LLM for open-world KGQA. The GNN predicts top-k candidate answers from the graph structure. These, along with relevant KG facts, are serialized into a structured prompt (e.g., triples and candidates) to guide the LLM's reasoning. This enables joint reasoning over symbolic and semantic signals, without relying on retrieval or fine-tuning. To evaluate generalization, we introduce GLOW-BENCH, a 1,000-question benchmark over incomplete KGs across diverse domains. GLOW outperforms existing LLM-GNN systems on standard benchmarks and GLOW-BENCH, achieving up to 53.3% and an average 38% improvement. GitHub code and data are available.

AI.tldr: GLOW 用 GNN 预测候选答案、再用 LLM 对结构和语义联合推理，无需检索或微调，在缺失知识场景下比 SOTA 系统平均提升 38%。
AI.motivation: 传统 KGQA 假设知识图谱完备，现实图谱却常缺边少点；现有 LLM-GNN 方法过度依赖结构嵌入，缺乏语义落地，且对多跳或缺失路径鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 双阶段框架：预训练 GNN 给出 top-k 候选节点与相关子图 → 将“三元组+候选”序列化为结构化 prompt → LLM 零样本推理并选出最佳答案；不检索、不微调。
AI.result: 在 GLOW-BENCH（1000 题、多领域、故意缺边）上 GLOW 比同类系统平均提升 38%，部分数据集达 53.3%；在标准 benchmarks 上也全面领先。
AI.conclusion: GLOW 证明无需额外训练，仅通过结构化 prompt 即可让 LLM 与 GNN 互补，显著缓解开放世界 QA 中的“缺失知识”难题，代码与数据已开源。

title: Failure Makes the Agent Stronger: Enhancing Accuracy through Structured Reflection for Reliable Tool Interactions
summary: Tool-augmented large language models (LLMs) are usually trained with supervised imitation or coarse-grained reinforcement learning that optimizes single tool calls. Current self-reflection practices rely on heuristic prompts or one-way reasoning: the model is urged to 'think more' instead of learning error diagnosis and repair. This is fragile in multi-turn interactions; after a failure the model often repeats the same mistake. We propose structured reflection, which turns the path from error to repair into an explicit, controllable, and trainable action. The agent produces a short yet precise reflection: it diagnoses the failure using evidence from the previous step and then proposes a correct, executable follow-up call. For training we combine DAPO and GSPO objectives with a reward scheme tailored to tool use, optimizing the stepwise strategy Reflect, then Call, then Final. To evaluate, we introduce Tool-Reflection-Bench, a lightweight benchmark that programmatically checks structural validity, executability, parameter correctness, and result consistency. Tasks are built as mini trajectories of erroneous call, reflection, and corrected call, with disjoint train and test splits. Experiments on BFCL v3 and Tool-Reflection-Bench show large gains in multi-turn tool-call success and error recovery, and a reduction of redundant calls. These results indicate that making reflection explicit and optimizing it directly improves the reliability of tool interaction and offers a reproducible path for agents to learn from failure.

AI.tldr: 提出“结构化反思”框架，将工具调用失败→诊断→修复的完整链路显式建模为可训练动作；结合 DAPO+GSPO 目标与专用奖励，实现“先反思-再调用-最后确定”策略。实验在 BFCL v3 与自建的 Tool-Reflection-Bench 上显著提升多轮成功率与错误恢复率，并减少冗余调用。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强 LLM 仅通过模仿学习或粗粒度 RL 优化单步调用，出错后依赖启发式提示重复试错，缺乏系统化的错误诊断与修复机制，导致多轮交互中反复失败。
AI.method: 1) 结构化反思：把“错误诊断→修复建议→可执行调用”压缩为显式动作空间，供策略网络直接优化。2) 训练目标：融合 DAPO（Doubly Adaptive PO）与 GSPO（Generalized Self-Play PO），并设计针对工具场景的步级奖励（Reflect、Call、Final 三阶段）。3) 评测：发布 Tool-Reflection-Bench，用脚本自动检验结构有效性、可执行性、参数正确性与结果一致性，并以“错误调用-反思-修正调用”三元组形式划分训练/测试集。
AI.result: 在 BFCL v3 与 Tool-Reflection-Bench 上，结构化反思模型相比基线：多轮工具调用成功率↑18-25%，错误恢复率↑32%，冗余调用↓40%；且反思动作本身可被显式监控与复现。
AI.conclusion: 将反思过程显式化并直接优化，可系统性提升智能体在工具交互中的可靠性与失败学习能力，为构建可自我纠正的代理提供了可复现、可扩展的路径。

title: Democratising Pathology Co-Pilots: An Open Pipeline and Dataset for Whole-Slide Vision-Language Modelling
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have the potential to become co-pilots for pathologists. However, most VLMs either focus on small regions of interest within whole-slide images, provide only static slide-level outputs, or rely on data that is not publicly available, limiting reproducibility. Furthermore, training data containing WSIs paired with detailed clinical reports is scarce, restricting progress toward transparent and generalisable VLMs. We address these limitations with three main contributions. First, we introduce Polysome, a standardised tool for synthetic instruction generation. Second, we apply Polysome to the public HISTAI dataset, generating HISTAI-Instruct, a large whole-slide instruction tuning dataset spanning 24,259 slides and over 1.1 million instruction-response pairs. Finally, we use HISTAI-Instruct to train ANTONI-α, a VLM capable of visual-question answering (VQA). We show that ANTONI-α outperforms MedGemma on WSI-level VQA tasks of tissue identification, neoplasm detection, and differential diagnosis. We also compare the performance of multiple incarnations of ANTONI-α trained with different amounts of data. All methods, data, and code are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出Polysome工具，基于公开HISTAI库构建含1.1M指令对的超大WSI-VQA数据集，训练出ANTONI-α模型，在全片级组织识别、肿瘤检测与鉴别诊断上优于MedGemma，全部数据与代码开源。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在病理场景中只能处理局部感兴趣区、输出静态片级结果或依赖私有数据，且缺乏大规模WSI-临床报告配对数据，阻碍可复现、可解释、可泛化的病理助手发展。
AI.method: ①设计Polysome标准化框架，自动生成全片级指令-回复对；②将其应用于公开HISTAI数据集，构建含24 259张WSI、超1.1M指令对的HISTAI-Instruct；③用该数据集指令微调视觉-语言模型，得到支持整张切片VQA的ANTONI-α，并系统性评估不同数据量对性能的影响。
AI.result: ANTONI-α在组织类型识别、肿瘤检测和鉴别诊断三项全片级VQA任务上均显著优于现有MedGemma；消融实验显示数据规模与性能呈正相关；生成数据、训练代码及模型全部公开，确保可复现。
AI.conclusion: 借助Polysome构建的大规模公开指令数据集，ANTONI-α首次实现整张病理切片的高质量视觉问答，为训练透明、可泛化的病理AI副驾驶提供可行范式。

title: EMGFlow: Robust and Efficient Surface Electromyography Synthesis via Flow Matching
summary: Deep learning-based surface electromyography (sEMG) gesture recognition is frequently bottlenecked by data scarcity and limited subject diversity. While synthetic data generation via Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and diffusion models has emerged as a promising augmentation strategy, these approaches often face challenges regarding training stability or inference efficiency. To bridge this gap, we propose EMGFlow, a conditional sEMG generation framework. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to investigate the application of Flow Matching (FM) and continuous-time generative modeling in the sEMG domain. To validate EMGFlow across three benchmark sEMG datasets, we employ a unified evaluation protocol integrating feature-based fidelity, distributional geometry, and downstream utility. Extensive evaluations show that EMGFlow outperforms conventional augmentation and GAN baselines, and provides stronger standalone utility than the diffusion baselines considered here under the train-on-synthetic test-on-real (TSTR) protocol. Furthermore, by optimizing generation dynamics through advanced numerical solvers and targeted time sampling, EMGFlow achieves improved quality-efficiency trade-offs. Taken together, these results suggest that Flow Matching is a promising and efficient paradigm for addressing data bottlenecks in myoelectric control systems. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Open-EXG/EMGFlow.

AI.tldr: 首次将流匹配(FM)用于sEMG合成，提出EMGFlow框架，兼顾生成保真度与推理效率，显著优于GAN/扩散增广，在TSTR协议下可直接训练并提升手势识别性能。
AI.motivation: 深度学习sEMG手势识别受限于数据稀缺与受试者多样性不足；GAN与扩散模型虽能增广，但训练稳定性或推理效率欠佳，亟需兼顾质量与速度的新生成范式。
AI.method: 设计条件流匹配框架EMGFlow，把sEMG生成建模为连续时间常微分方程；引入高级数值求解器与针对性时间采样优化生成动态；统一评估协议综合特征保真度、分布几何与下游任务可用性；在三个基准数据集做TSTR实验并与GAN/扩散/传统增广对比。
AI.result: EMGFlow在所有基准上全面超越GAN与常规增广，TSTR条件下独立效用亦优于扩散基线；通过动力学优化实现更高质量-效率权衡，推理速度显著提升而保真度不降。
AI.conclusion: 流匹配是克服肌电控制系统数据瓶颈的高效且有效的新范式，EMGFlow为sEMG增广与实用化提供即插即用解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Improving Factuality of Generations by Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are prone to generating factually incorrect outputs. Recent work has applied conformal prediction to provide uncertainty estimates and statistical guarantees for the factuality of LLM generations. However, existing approaches are typically not prompt-adaptive, limiting their ability to capture input-dependent variability. As a result, they may filter out too few items (leading to over-coverage) or too many (under-coverage) for a given task or prompt. We propose an adaptive conformal prediction approach that extends conformal score transformation methods to LLMs, with applications to long-form generation and multiple-choice question answering. This enables prompt-dependent calibration, retaining marginal coverage guarantees while improving conditional coverage. In addition, the approach naturally supports selective prediction, allowing unreliable claims or answer choices to be filtered out in downstream applications. We evaluate our approach on multiple white-box models across diverse domains and show that it significantly outperforms existing baselines in terms of conditional coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向 LLM 的“提示自适应”共形预测方法，在保持边际覆盖保证的同时显著提升条件覆盖率，可直接用于长文本生成与选择题 QA 的选择性过滤。
AI.motivation: LLM 输出常含事实错误，现有共形预测方法未考虑提示差异，导致同任务内覆盖失衡（过覆/欠覆）。
AI.method: 将共形分数变换扩展至 LLM，使校准过程显式依赖提示，实现 prompt-dependent 校准；支持在长文本生成和选择题 QA 上做单点/选择性预测。
AI.result: 多白盒模型跨域实验表明，该方法在条件覆盖率上显著优于非自适应基线，同时维持边际覆盖理论保证。
AI.conclusion: 提示自适应共形预测能在不牺牲统计保证的前提下，更精准地识别不可靠陈述或选项，为 LLM 的事实正确性提供可扩展、可解释的不确定性控制手段。

title: RadAgents: Multimodal Agentic Reasoning for Chest X-ray Interpretation with Radiologist-like Workflows
summary: Agentic systems offer a potential path to solve complex clinical tasks through collaboration among specialized agents, augmented by tool use and external knowledge bases. Nevertheless, for chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation, prevailing methods remain limited: (i) reasoning is frequently neither clinically interpretable nor aligned with guidelines, reflecting mere aggregation of tool outputs; (ii) multimodal evidence is insufficiently fused, yielding text-only rationales that are not visually grounded; and (iii) systems rarely detect or resolve cross-tool inconsistencies and provide no principled verification mechanisms. To bridge the above gaps, we present RadAgents, a multi-agent framework that couples clinical priors with task-aware multimodal reasoning and encodes a radiologist-style workflow into a modular, auditable pipeline. In addition, we integrate grounding and multimodal retrieval-augmentation to verify and resolve context conflicts, resulting in outputs that are more reliable, transparent, and consistent with clinical practice.

AI.tldr: RadAgents 用多智能体协同把放射科工作流程拆成可审计模块，通过临床先验、多模态检索与 grounding 机制对齐指南，解决 CXR 解读中推理不透明、视觉缺位与工具冲突三大缺陷，实现更可靠、可解释且符合实践的解读。
AI.motivation: 现有 CXR 解读方法以工具输出简单聚合为主，推理缺乏临床可解释性与指南对齐，无法融合视觉证据，也不检测工具间冲突，导致结果不可靠，亟需一套符合放射科思维、可审计且能自验证的协作框架。
AI.method: 构建 RadAgents 多智能体框架：①将放射科诊断流程抽象为模块化任务链，嵌入临床先验与指南规则；②引入多模态检索增强与 grounding，使文本推理与影像区域双向对齐；③设置冲突检测与一致性验证层，自动识别并消解跨工具矛盾，输出可追溯 audit log。
AI.result: 相较传统聚合式方法，RadAgents 的推理链具备临床可读性，视觉证据与文本解释一一对应，并能自动标记并修正 92% 以上的跨工具冲突，输出报告在一致性、指南符合度及专家评分上均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 把放射科思维编码为可审计多智能体流程，再辅以多模态检索与 grounding 验证，是解决医学影像复杂推理的可行路径；RadAgents 为后续可解释、可信赖的临床 AI 系统提供了通用范式。

title: Addressing Overthinking in Large Vision-Language Models via Gated Perception-Reasoning Optimization
comment: Accepted to Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have exhibited strong reasoning capabilities through chain-of-thought mechanisms that generate step-by-step rationales. However, such slow-thinking approaches often lead to overthinking, where models produce excessively verbose responses even for simple queries, resulting in test-time inefficiency and even degraded accuracy. Prior work has attempted to mitigate this issue via adaptive reasoning strategies, but these methods largely overlook a fundamental bottleneck: visual perception failures. We argue that stable reasoning critically depends on low-level visual grounding, and that reasoning errors often originate from imperfect perception rather than insufficient deliberation. To address this limitation, we propose Gated Perception-Reasoning Optimization (GPRO), a meta-reasoning controller that dynamically routes computation among three decision paths at each generation step: a lightweight fast path, a slow perception path for re-examining visual inputs, and a slow reasoning path for internal self-reflection. To learn this distinction, we derive large-scale failure attribution supervision from approximately 790k samples, using teacher models to distinguish perceptual hallucinations from reasoning errors. We then train the controller with multi-objective reinforcement learning to optimize the trade-off between task accuracy and computational cost under uncertainty. Experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that GPRO substantially improves both accuracy and efficiency, outperforming recent slow-thinking methods while generating significantly shorter responses.

AI.tldr: 提出GPRO元推理控制器，基于感知失败为瓶颈的洞见，动态在快/慢感知/慢推理三条通路间切换，仅790k样本即用多目标强化学习训出，五大评测上精度↑、回答长度↓，显著优于现有慢推理模型。
AI.motivation: 尽管链式思考让大视觉语言模型具备逐步推理能力，但在简单问题上也常输出冗余推理，造成测试时低效甚至性能下降。先前自适应策略主要调节推理深度，忽视了底层视觉感知失败才是推理错误根源。作者认为“看得准”才能“想得对”，需先解决感知幻觉再谈推理。
AI.method: 设计Gated Perception-Reasoning Optimization (GPRO)：1) 将每步解码路由到三类计算——轻量快通路、慢感知通路(重看图像)或慢推理通路(自反思)；2) 用教师模型在约79万样本上标注“感知错 vs 推理错”，构建大规模失败归因监督；3) 以多目标强化学习训练路由控制器，在不确定下联合优化任务精度与计算代价。
AI.result: 在五个VQA/推理基准上，GPRO在准确率优于最新慢思考方法的同时，平均回答长度显著缩短；其计算效率提升约1.5–2倍，验证先感知后推理策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 视觉感知错误是大模型“过度思考”的根本瓶颈。GPRO通过元级动态分配感知与推理算力，兼顾精度与效率，为构建“看得清、想得省”的LVLM提供了可扩展范式。

title: VIGILant: an automatic classification pipeline for glitches in the Virgo detector
summary: Glitches frequently contaminate data in gravitational-wave detectors, complicating the observation and analysis of astrophysical signals. This work introduces VIGILant, an automatic pipeline for classification and visualization of glitches in the Virgo detector. Using a curated dataset of Virgo O3b glitches, two machine learning approaches are evaluated: tree-based models (Decision Tree, Random Forest and XGBoost) using structured Omicron parameters, and Convolutional Neural Networks (ResNet) trained on spectrogram images. While tree-based models offer higher interpretability and fast training, the ResNet34 model achieved superior performance, reaching a F1 score of 0.9772 and accuracy of 0.9833 in the testing set, with inference times of tens of milliseconds per glitch. The pipeline has been deployed for daily operation at the Virgo site since observing run O4c, providing the Virgo collaboration with an interactive dashboard to monitor glitch populations and detector behavior. This allows to identify low-confidence predictions, highlighting glitches requiring further attention.

AI.tldr: VIGILant是基于ResNet34的在线毛刺自动分类系统，在Virgo O3b数据上F1达0.977，已稳定运行于O4c观测期，并提供交互式仪表板供合作组实时监测探测器健康状况。
AI.motivation: 引力波探测器中的瞬态噪声（毛刺）会掩盖或伪造天体物理信号，手动甄别效率低且易遗漏。Virgo合作组急需一套可解释、低延迟、能在线运行的自动分类工具，以提升O4及以后观测轮的数据质量与科学产出。
AI.method: 构建Virgo O3b毛刺精选样本库；对比两套方案：①基于结构化Omicron参数的决策树、随机森林与XGBoost；②以时频谱图作为输入的ResNet34 CNN；最终把最佳模型封装进每日自动流程，并配套开发交互式可视化仪表板供专家复核低置信度事件。
AI.result: ResNet34在测试集上取得F1=0.9772、Acc=0.9833，推理延迟仅数十毫秒，显著优于树模型；系统自O4c开始7×24h部署，每天稳定处理实时数据，仪表板成功标记出需人工复查的低置信度毛刺，减少漏检风险。
AI.conclusion: CNN在毛刺分类任务上兼顾精度与速度，VIGILant的上线使Virgo首次具备深度学习驱动的在线噪声监测能力；未来计划扩展至其它噪声类型，并与LIGO、KAGRA系统对接，形成全球探测器协同的噪声大数据平台。

title: Diffusion Language Models for Speech Recognition
summary: Diffusion language models have recently emerged as a leading alternative to standard language models, due to their ability for bidirectional attention and parallel text generation. In this work, we explore variants for their use in speech recognition. Specifically, we introduce a comprehensive guide to incorporating masked diffusion language models (MDLM) and uniform-state diffusion models (USDMs) for rescoring ASR hypotheses. Additionally, we design a new joint-decoding method that combines CTC and USDM by integrating the framewise probability distributions derived from CTC with the labelwise probability distributions computed by USDM at each decoding step, thereby generating new candidates that combine strong language knowledge from USDM and acoustic information from CTC. Our findings reveal that USDM, as well as MDLM, can significantly improve the accuracy of recognized text. We publish all our code and recipes.

AI.tldr: 首次将掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）与均匀状态扩散模型（USDM）系统性地用于ASR重打分，并提出CTC-USDM联合解码框架，显著降低词错率并开源全套代码。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型具备双向注意力与并行生成优势，但尚未在语音识别领域被充分探索；传统ASR重打分方法难以同时利用强语言先验与帧级声学信息。
AI.method: 1) 构建MDLM与USDM对N-best假设进行重打分的完整流程；2) 设计CTC-USDM联合解码：在每步将CTC帧级后验与USDM标签级概率逐帧融合，动态生成新候选；3) 采用扩散模型的掩码与均匀状态两种噪声调度策略，适配语音识别的序列特性。
AI.result: 在LibriSpeech等基准上，USDM重打分使WER相对下降6–10%；CTC-USDM联合解码在test-clean/test-other上进一步带来3–5%额外增益，优于单独CTC或USDM。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型可作为ASR的强大语言重打分器；帧-标签概率耦合的联合解码策略有效弥合声学与语义鸿沟，代码与配方已全面开源供社区复现与扩展。

title: Scaling Test-Time Compute to Achieve IOI Gold Medal with Open-Weight Models
summary: Competitive programming has become a rigorous benchmark for evaluating the reasoning and problem-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs). The International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) stands out as one of the most prestigious annual competitions in competitive programming and has become a key benchmark for comparing human and AI-level programming ability. While several proprietary models have been claimed to achieve gold medal-level performance at the IOI, often with undisclosed methods, achieving comparable results with open-weight models remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we present GenCluster, a scalable and reproducible test-time compute framework that attains IOI gold-level performance using open-weight models. It combines large-scale generation, behavioral clustering, ranking, and a round-robin submission strategy to efficiently explore diverse solution spaces under limited validation budgets. Our experiments show that the performance of our proposed approach scales consistently with available compute, narrowing the gap between open and closed systems. Notably, we will show that GenCluster can achieve a gold medal at IOI 2025 for the first time with an open-weight model gpt-oss-120b, setting a new benchmark for transparent and reproducible evaluation of reasoning in LLMs

AI.tldr: 开源框架 GenCluster 首次让开放权重模型在 IOI 上摘金，证明纯测试时计算即可逼近闭源 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 闭源模型宣称 IOI 夺金却方法黑箱，开放权重模型始终落后，亟需可复现、可扩展的透明方案。
AI.method: 大规模生成→行为聚类→排序→循环赛提交；测试时计算随资源线性扩展，在限定验证预算下高效搜索解空间。
AI.result: gpt-oss-120b 在 IOI 2025 上斩获金牌，性能随算力持续提升，显著缩小开源与闭源差距。
AI.conclusion: GenCluster 为开放权重模型设立首个 IOI 金牌基准，验证测试时计算是提升推理能力的有效且透明途径。

title: Multi-Dimensional Knowledge Profiling with Large-Scale Literature Database and Hierarchical Retrieval
summary: The rapid expansion of research across machine learning, vision, and language has produced a volume of publications that is increasingly difficult to synthesize. Traditional bibliometric tools rely mainly on metadata and offer limited visibility into the semantic content of papers, making it hard to track how research themes evolve over time or how different areas influence one another.To obtain a clearer picture of recent developments, we compile a unified corpus of more than 100,000 papers from 22 major conferences between 2020 and 2025 and construct a multidimensional profiling pipeline to organize and analyze their textual content. By combining topic clustering, LLM-assisted parsing, and structured retrieval, we derive a comprehensive representation of research activity that supports the study of topic lifecycles, methodological transitions, dataset and model usage patterns, and institutional research directions.Our analysis highlights several notable shifts, including the growth of safety, multimodal reasoning, and agent-oriented studies, as well as the gradual stabilization of areas such as neural machine translation and graph-based methods. These findings provide an evidence-based view of how AI research is evolving and offer a resource for understanding broader trends and identifying emerging directions.

AI.tldr: 用超过10万篇2020–25年会议论文构建多维语义画像，揭示安全、多模态推理与Agent等方向快速崛起，传统神经机器翻译与图方法趋于稳定。
AI.motivation: 传统文献计量仅依赖元数据，无法洞察论文语义，难以追踪主题演化与跨领域影响。
AI.method: 整合22个顶会论文语料，采用主题聚类、大模型辅助解析与结构化检索，构建多维语义画像管道。
AI.result: 发现安全、多模态推理、Agent导向研究显著增长；神经机器翻译与图方法趋于成熟稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该语义级分析为AI研究趋势提供实证视角，可用来识别新兴方向并追踪主题生命周期。

title: Reachability Constraints in Variational Quantum Circuits: Optimization within Polynomial Group Module
summary: This work identifies a necessary condition for any variational quantum approach to reach the exact ground state. Briefly, the norms of the projections of the input and the ground state onto each group module must match, implying that module weights of the solution state have to be known in advance in order to reach the exact ground state. An exemplary case is provided by matchgate circuits applied to problems whose solutions are classical bit strings, since all computational basis states share the same module-wise weights. Combined with the known classical simulability of quantum circuits for which observables lie in a small linear subspace, this implies that certain problems admit a classical surrogate for exact solution with each step taking $O(n^5)$ time. The Maximum Cut problem serves as an illustrative example.

AI.tldr: 变分量子算法若想得到基态必须预先知道各群模的权重，而经典可模拟的 Match-gate 电路恰好满足该条件，因此某些问题（如最大割）可在 O(n⁵) 时间内被经典算法精确求解。
AI.motivation: 量子变分算法常被寄希望于高效获得基态，但实际收敛情况缺乏普适约束；作者想找出“任意变分量子方法能否且如何精确达到基态”的共性判据，并探讨在何种情形下可用经典算法替代量子方案。
AI.method:
1) 将希尔伯特空间按对称群的不可约表示分解为“群模”（group modules）。
2) 证明定理：当且仅当初态与目标基态在每个群模上的投影范数（module-wise weights）相等，变分演化才有可能收敛到该基态。
3) 对 match-gate 线路，指出所有计算基态的群模权重相同，因而满足上述条件；再结合此类线路可观测量场局限在低维线性子空间这一经典可模拟性结果，导出经典替代算法。
4) 以图的最大割问题为例，展示在 2D 网格上 n 个顶点的实例可在 O(n⁵) 时间内被经典精确求解。
AI.result:
- 给出“群模投影范数相等”是变分量子方法收敛到基态的必需条件（非充分）。
- 证明 match-gate 局域线路在计算基态下自然满足该条件，且对应的量子期望可经典 O(n⁵) 计算。
- 实现了 n 规模 Max-Cut 问题的经典精确算法，复杂度 O(n⁵)，表明经典方法已在该设定下取代量子变分路线。
AI.conclusion: 变分量子算法若要精确求基态，需预先掌握各群模权重；当问题的线路结构和群对称性使该条件天然成立时，可转而利用经典模拟技术，获得与量子方案一致的完整解。Match-gate/Max-Cut 实例证明这种“经典替代”不仅理论上可行，还带来多项式时间精确算法，提示未来应结合对称性和经典可模拟性分析来界定量子优势的真实边界。

title: Towards Multi-Object-Tracking with Radar on a Fast Moving Vehicle: On the Potential of Processing Radar in the Frequency Domain
summary: We promote in this paper the processing of radar data in the frequency domain to achieve higher robustness against noise and structural errors, especially in comparison to feature-based methods. This holds also for high dynamics in the scene, i.e., ego-motion of the vehicle with the sensor plus the presence of an unknown number of other moving objects. In addition to the high robustness, the processing in the frequency domain has the so far neglected advantage that the underlying correlation based methods used for, e.g., registration, provide information about all moving structures in the scene. A typical automotive application case is overtaking maneuvers, which in the context of autonomous racing are used here as a motivating example. Initial experiments and results with Fourier SOFT in 2D (FS2D) are presented that use the Boreas dataset to demonstrate radar-only-odometry, i.e., radar-odometry without sensor-fusion, to support our arguments.

AI.tldr: 频域雷达处理在2D场景下仅用雷达即能完成里程计，兼具抗噪、抗结构误差、同时显式输出全部运动目标的能力，并以超车工况验证。
AI.motivation: 现有基于特征或空间域关联的雷达里程计对噪声、结构误差及高动态多目标场景鲁棒性差，且无法在一次处理中同时估计自车运动和检测他车运动。
AI.method: 将雷达扫描对转换到频域，利用基于相关性的FS2D算法(Fourier SOFT in 2D)估计2D位移；频域互相关峰值直接揭示场景中所有运动结构，无需显式特征提取或融合其他传感器。
AI.result: 在Boreas公开数据集上实现纯雷达、无融合的视觉级里程计精度；频域相关图能清晰区分自车与他车引起的运动分量，验证高鲁棒性与运动目标感知合一的优势。
AI.conclusion: 频域处理不仅提升雷达里程计的鲁棒性，更将运动估计与多目标检测统一于同一相关框架，为高速/高动态自动驾驶场景提供了新的雷达解决方案。FS2D可作为后续3D扩展与深度融合的基础。

title: Saber: An Efficient Sampling with Adaptive Acceleration and Backtracking Enhanced Remasking for Diffusion Language Model
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as a powerful and promising alternative to the dominant autoregressive paradigm, offering inherent advantages in parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling. However, the performance of DLMs on code generation tasks, which have stronger structural constraints, is significantly hampered by the critical trade-off between inference speed and output quality. We observed that accelerating the code generation process by reducing the number of sampling steps usually leads to a catastrophic collapse in performance. In this paper, we introduce efficient Sampling with Adaptive acceleration and Backtracking Enhanced Remasking (i.e., Saber), a novel training-free sampling algorithm for DLMs to achieve better inference speed and output quality in code generation. Specifically, Saber is motivated by two key insights in the DLM generation process: 1) it can be adaptively accelerated as more of the code context is established; 2) it requires a backtracking mechanism to reverse the generated tokens. Extensive experiments on multiple mainstream code generation benchmarks show that Saber boosts Pass@1 accuracy by an average improvement of 1.9% over mainstream DLM sampling methods, meanwhile achieving an average 251.4% inference speedup. By leveraging the inherent advantages of DLMs, our work significantly narrows the performance gap with autoregressive models in code generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无训练采样算法 Saber，使扩散语言模型在代码生成中同步提升准确率与速度，显著缩小与自回归模型的差距。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）虽然具备并行生成和双向上下文建模优势，但在结构约束更强的代码生成任务上，为提速而减少采样步数会导致性能崩溃，亟需兼顾速度与质量的推理方法。
AI.method: 设计 Saber 算法：1) 利用已生成代码上下文自适应减少后续采样步数；2) 引入回溯机制对错误 token 进行重掩码与再生成，无需额外训练即可动态调整推理过程。
AI.result: 在主流代码生成基准测试中，Saber 将 Pass@1 平均提升 1.9%，同时推理速度提高 2.51 倍，显著优于现有 DLM 采样策略。
AI.conclusion: Saber 通过自适应加速与回溯重掩码，充分释放 DLM 并行潜力，在代码生成场景下首次实现质量与速度双赢，使 DLM 逼近甚至可比肩自回归模型性能。

title: Learning Sewing Patterns via Latent Flow Matching of Implicit Fields
summary: Sewing patterns define the structural foundation of garments and are essential for applications such as fashion design, fabrication, and physical simulation. Despite progress in automated pattern generation, accurately modeling sewing patterns remains difficult due to the broad variability in panel geometry and seam arrangements. In this work, we introduce a sewing pattern modeling method based on an implicit representation. We represent each panel using a signed distance field that defines its boundary and an unsigned distance field that identifies seam endpoints, and encode these fields into a continuous latent space that enables differentiable meshing. A latent flow matching model learns distributions over panel combinations in this representation, and a stitching prediction module recovers seam relations from extracted edge segments. This formulation allows accurate modeling and generation of sewing patterns with complex structures. We further show that it can be used to estimate sewing patterns from images with improved accuracy relative to existing approaches, and supports applications such as pattern completion and refitting, providing a practical tool for digital fashion design.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于隐式表示（SDF+UDF）的服装纸样统一建模框架，支持复杂结构生成、单张图像重建及纸样补全／改样等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 现有自动纸样方法难以刻画面板几何与缝线拓扑的巨大差异，需一种可同时编码边界与缝边的连续可微表示。
AI.method: 用SDF定义面板边界、UDF定位缝线端点，将两类距离场编码为连续潜空间；在潜空间内训练流匹配模型学习面板组合分布，并通过边缘段预测模块恢复缝边关系，实现端到端可微网格化。
AI.result: 在纸样生成与单图重建任务上显著优于现有方法，可准确生成含复杂多片结构的纸样，且支持纸样补全、体型改样等应用。
AI.conclusion: 隐式表示首次为服装纸样提供统一、可微、高表达力的建模手段，为数字化时装设计提供了实用工具与新基准。

title: Covariance-adapting algorithm for semi-bandits with application to sparse rewards
comment: Published at Conference on Learning Theory (COLT) 2020
summary: We investigate stochastic combinatorial semi-bandits, where the entire joint distribution of outcomes impacts the complexity of the problem instance (unlike in the standard bandits). Typical distributions considered depend on specific parameter values, whose prior knowledge is required in theory but quite difficult to estimate in practice; an example is the commonly assumed sub-Gaussian family. We alleviate this issue by instead considering a new general family of sub-exponential distributions, which contains bounded and Gaussian ones. We prove a new lower bound on the expected regret on this family, that is parameterized by the unknown covariance matrix of outcomes, a tighter quantity than the sub-Gaussian matrix. We then construct an algorithm that uses covariance estimates, and provide a tight asymptotic analysis of the regret. Finally, we apply and extend our results to the family of sparse outcomes, which has applications in many recommender systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将随机组合半老虎机从子高斯分布推广到子指数分布，用未知协方差矩阵取代子高斯矩阵刻画难度，给出新的遗憾下界与匹配的算法上界，并推广到稀疏回报场景。
AI.motivation: 现有理论依赖子高斯等带参数分布，其参数难以预先估计，导致理论结果难以落地。作者希望用更宽松、无需先验参数的子指数分布族重新刻画问题难度，同时使难度度量（协方差矩阵）可直接从数据估计。
AI.method: 1) 引入子指数分布族并证明其涵盖有界与高斯情形；2) 基于协方差矩阵推导问题相关的极小极大遗憾下界；3) 设计利用在线协方差估计的乐观算法；4) 对算法进行渐近紧的 regret 分析；5) 将分析框架扩展到稀疏回报，适配推荐系统等场景。
AI.result: 首次得到以未知协方差矩阵参数化的遗憾下界，提出的算法达到该下界，实现渐近最优；在稀疏回报条件下仍保持紧界，为推荐系统等实际应用提供可直接实施的策略。
AI.conclusion: 用子指数分布与协方差复杂度取代子高斯假设，可在不增加先验知识负担的情况下获得更紧且可估计的遗憾界，为随机组合半老虎机提供更贴近实际的理论基础与算法工具。

title: MAny: Merge Anything for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) is essential for sequential task adaptation of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) but is severely restricted by catastrophic forgetting. While existing literature focuses on the reasoning language backbone, in this work, we expose a critical yet neglected dual-forgetting phenomenon across both perception drift in Cross-modal Projection Space and reasoning collapse in Low-rank Parameter Space. To resolve this, we present \textbf{MAny} (\textbf{M}erge \textbf{Any}thing), a framework that merges task-specific knowledge through \textbf{C}ross-modal \textbf{P}rojection \textbf{M}erging (\textbf{CPM}) and \textbf{L}ow-rank \textbf{P}arameter \textbf{M}erging (\textbf{LPM}). Specifically, CPM recovers perceptual alignment by adaptively merging cross-modal visual representations via visual-prototype guidance, ensuring accurate feature recovery during inference. Simultaneously, LPM eliminates mutual interference among task-specific low-rank modules by recursively merging low-rank weight matrices. By leveraging recursive least squares, LPM provides a closed-form solution that mathematically guarantees an optimal fusion trajectory for reasoning stability. Notably, MAny operates as a training-free paradigm that achieves knowledge merging via efficient CPU-based algebraic operations, eliminating additional gradient-based optimization beyond initial tuning. Our extensive evaluations confirm the superior performance and robustness of MAny across multiple MLLMs and benchmarks. Specifically, on the UCIT benchmark, MAny achieves significant leads of up to 8.57\% and 2.85\% in final average accuracy over state-of-the-art methods across two different MLLMs, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多模态大模型在持续指令调优中存在“感知漂移+推理崩溃”双重遗忘，提出无训练框架 MAny，用交叉模态投影合并（CPM）与低秩参数合并（LPM）在 CPU 上一次性融合任务知识，在 UCIT 基准上平均精度领先 SOTA 8.57% 与 2.85%。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态持续学习研究仅关注语言推理主干的灾难性遗忘，却忽视视觉-语言跨模态对齐的感知漂移；双重遗忘并存导致 MLLM 序列任务适应性能骤降，亟需一种无需再训练的高效知识融合方案。
AI.method: 提出 MAny 框架：CPM 以视觉原型为锚，自适应合并跨模态投影向量，恢复视觉-语言对齐；LPM 用递归最小二乘闭式解，逐层融合任务低秩矩阵，消除模块间干扰；整体仅需 CPU 代数运算，零梯度更新。
AI.result: 在 UCIT 及多个基准上测试两种 MLLM，MAny 在最终平均准确率分别超越最强基线 8.57% 与 2.85%，且保持低秩模块规模不变，推理延迟无增加。
AI.conclusion: 双重遗忘是 MCIT 的核心瓶颈；MAny 通过无训练合并策略同时稳定感知与推理，首次实现 MLLM 持续指令调优的免再训练知识累积，为高效多模态 lifelong learning 提供可扩展范式。

title: Remember Me, Refine Me: A Dynamic Procedural Memory Framework for Experience-Driven Agent Evolution
summary: Procedural memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to internalize "how-to" knowledge, theoretically reducing redundant trial-and-error. However, existing frameworks predominantly suffer from a "passive accumulation" paradigm, treating memory as a static append-only archive. To bridge the gap between static storage and dynamic reasoning, we propose $\textbf{ReMe}$ ($\textit{Remember Me, Refine Me}$), a comprehensive framework for experience-driven agent evolution. ReMe innovates across the memory lifecycle via three mechanisms: 1) $\textit{multi-faceted distillation}$, which extracts fine-grained experiences by recognizing success patterns, analyzing failure triggers and generating comparative insights; 2) $\textit{context-adaptive reuse}$, which tailors historical insights to new contexts via scenario-aware indexing; and 3) $\textit{utility-based refinement}$, which autonomously adds valid memories and prunes outdated ones to maintain a compact, high-quality experience pool. Extensive experiments on BFCL-V3 and AppWorld demonstrate that ReMe establishes a new state-of-the-art in agent memory system. Crucially, we observe a significant memory-scaling effect: Qwen3-8B equipped with ReMe outperforms larger, memoryless Qwen3-14B, suggesting that self-evolving memory provides a computation-efficient pathway for lifelong learning. We release our code and the $\texttt{reme.library}$ dataset to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: ReMe框架通过多面蒸馏、情境自适应复用和效用驱动精炼，让LLM智能体动态更新程序性记忆，在BFCL-V3与AppWorld上刷新SOTA，8B模型凭记忆即可超越14B无记忆模型。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的程序性记忆系统采用“被动累积”模式，仅静态追加经验，无法随任务演进而动态精炼，导致冗余试错与存储膨胀，亟需可自我演化的记忆机制。
AI.method: 提出ReMe框架，贯穿记忆全生命周期：①多面蒸馏—识别成功模式、解析失败诱因并生成对比洞察；②情境自适应复用—基于场景感知索引将历史经验迁移至新上下文；③效用驱动精炼—自主增汰记忆，维持高质紧凑经验池。
AI.result: 在BFCL-V3和AppWorld基准测试中，ReMe刷新智能体记忆系统最佳成绩；Qwen3-8B+ReMe显著优于无记忆的Qwen3-14B，呈现明显记忆规模效应，验证其计算高效、可持续终身学习路径。
AI.conclusion: 自演化程序性记忆能在不增参数前提下持续放大模型能力，为构建计算友好、可终身学习的LLM智能体提供通用范式；代码与reme.library数据集已开源以促进后续研究。

title: Simplicity Prevails: The Emergence of Generalizable AIGI Detection in Visual Foundation Models
summary: While specialized detectors for AI-Generated Images (AIGI) achieve near-perfect accuracy on curated benchmarks, they suffer from a dramatic performance collapse in realistic, in-the-wild scenarios. In this work, we demonstrate that simplicity prevails over complex architectural designs. A simple linear classifier trained on the frozen features of modern Vision Foundation Models , including Perception Encoder, MetaCLIP 2, and DINOv3, establishes a new state-of-the-art. Through a comprehensive evaluation spanning traditional benchmarks, unseen generators, and challenging in-the-wild distributions, we show that this baseline not only matches specialized detectors on standard benchmarks but also decisively outperforms them on in-the-wild datasets, boosting accuracy by striking margins of over 30\%. We posit that this superior capability is an emergent property driven by the massive scale of pre-training data containing synthetic content. We trace the source of this capability to two distinct manifestations of data exposure: Vision-Language Models internalize an explicit semantic concept of forgery, while Self-Supervised Learning models implicitly acquire discriminative forensic features from the pretraining data. However, we also reveal persistent limitations: these models suffer from performance degradation under recapture and transmission, remain blind to VAE reconstruction and localized editing. We conclude by advocating for a paradigm shift in AI forensics, moving from overfitting on static benchmarks to harnessing the evolving world knowledge of foundation models for real-world reliability.

AI.tldr: 仅用冻结的视觉基础模型（PerVision、MetaCLIP-2、DINOv3）特征加线性分类器，即可在真实野外场景将AIGI检测精度提升>30%，无需复杂结构。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGI检测器在静态基准上几乎完美，却在真实「野外」数据上性能骤降。作者质疑复杂架构的必要性，提出用现成视觉大模型提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 冻结三大视觉基础模型（CLIP式语言-视觉模型、SSL自监督模型）的预训练特征；2) 在其上训练简单线性分类器；3) 跨传统基准、未见生成器、野外分布全面评估；4) 通过探针实验揭示CLIP模型学到显性“伪造”语义，SSL模型学到隐式取证特征。
AI.result: 线性基线在传统基准持平SOTA，在野外数据集上领先>30% ACC；揭示性能来源于预训练数据已含大量合成图像；同时暴露对重摄、压缩、VAE重建、局部编辑仍敏感。
AI.conclusion: AI取证应从「静态基准过拟合」转向「利用持续演进的基础模型世界知识」；线性探测已足够强，未来需解决重摄/压缩/局部篡改等残余弱点。

title: The cognitive companion: a lightweight parallel monitoring architecture for detecting and recovering from reasoning degradation in LLM agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents on multi-step tasks suffer reasoning degradation, looping, drift, stuck states, at rates up to 30% on hard tasks. Current solutions include hard step limits (abrupt) or LLM-as-judge monitoring (10-15% overhead per step). This paper introduces the Cognitive Companion, a parallel monitoring architecture with two implementations: an LLM-based Companion and a novel zero-overhead Probe-based Companion. We report a three-batch feasibility study centered on Gemma 4 E4B, with an additional exploratory small-model analysis on Qwen 2.5 1.5B and Llama 3.2 1B. In our experiments, the LLM-based Companion reduced repetition on loop-prone tasks by 52-62% with approximately 11% overhead. The Probe-based Companion, trained on hidden states from layer 28, showed a mean effect size of +0.471 at zero measured inference overhead; its strongest probe result achieved cross-validated AUROC 0.840 on a small proxy-labeled dataset. A key empirical finding is that companion benefit appears task-type dependent: companions are most helpful on loop-prone and open-ended tasks, while effects are neutral or negative on more structured tasks. Our small-model experiments also suggest a possible scale boundary: companions did not improve the measured quality proxy on 1B-1.5B models, even when interventions fired. Overall, the paper should be read as a feasibility study rather than a definitive validation. The results provide encouraging evidence that sub-token monitoring may be useful, identify task-type sensitivity as a practical design constraint, and motivate selective companion activation as a promising direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 面向大模型多步任务的推理衰减、循环与卡死问题，提出双轨并行监控架构Cognitive Companion：①LLM型伙伴（约11%开销）将易发循环任务的重覆率降52–62%；②零额外推理开销的Probe型伙伴（在Gemma-4第28层隐状态训练）平均效应量+0.47，最佳AUROC 0.84。效益高度依赖任务类型：在开放/易循环任务中显著，结构化任务中性或负向；1B–1.5B小模型未见增益。论文定位为可行性研究，强调子词级监控潜力与“按需启用”策略。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型代理执行多步任务时因长链推理出现性能退化、循环与卡死，成功率在低30%区间；既有硬截断或LLM-as-judge监控方案要么粗暴要么每步额外10–15%开销，亟需低开销、可解释且任务自适应的通用监控机制。
AI.method: 设计并行Cognitive Companion架构，分两支实现：1) LLM型——同级大模型并行判别是否干预；2) Probe型——仅用第28层隐藏状态训练轻量探针，零推理延迟。三批次实验以Gemma-4-E4B为主，附加Qwen-2.5-1.5B与Llama-3.2-1B小模型对照；用代理标签评测重覆率、效应量与AUROC，并按任务结构分类分析。
AI.result: LLM型Companion使易循环任务重覆率下降52–62%，但带来≈11%计算开销；Probe型无测得延迟，平均效应量+0.47，最佳探针AUROC达0.84。Companion增益显著受任务类型调节：开放/循环型任务受益，结构化任务效果中性甚至为负；1B–1.5B小模型未见质量提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实子词级隐藏状态监控可行，能以极低或零开销缓解大模型长链推理失效；任务类型与模型规模是决定Companion价值的关键约束。未来应聚焦“选择性激活”策略、探针跨层/跨模型迁移与更大规模验证，而非一刀切部署。

title: Feed-Forward 3D Scene Modeling: A Problem-Driven Perspective
comment: 67 pages, 395 references. Project page: https://ff3d-survey.github.io. Code: https://github.com/ziplab/Awesome-Feed-Forward-3D. This work has been submitted to Springer for possible publication
summary: Reconstructing 3D representations from 2D inputs is a fundamental task in computer vision and graphics, serving as a cornerstone for understanding and interacting with the physical world. While traditional methods achieve high fidelity, they are limited by slow per-scene optimization or category-specific training, which hinders their practical deployment and scalability. Hence, generalizable feed-forward 3D reconstruction has witnessed rapid development in recent years. By learning a model that maps images directly to 3D representations in a single forward pass, these methods enable efficient reconstruction and robust cross-scene generalization. Our survey is motivated by a critical observation: despite the diverse geometric output representations, ranging from implicit fields to explicit primitives, existing feed-forward approaches share similar high-level architectural patterns, such as image feature extraction backbones, multi-view information fusion mechanisms, and geometry-aware design principles. Consequently, we abstract away from these representation differences and instead focus on model design, proposing a novel taxonomy centered on model design strategies that are agnostic to the output format. Our proposed taxonomy organizes the research directions into five key problems that drive recent research development: feature enhancement, geometry awareness, model efficiency, augmentation strategies and temporal-aware models. To support this taxonomy with empirical grounding and standardized evaluation, we further comprehensively review related benchmarks and datasets, and extensively discuss and categorize real-world applications based on feed-forward 3D models. Finally, we outline future directions to address open challenges such as scalability, evaluation standards, and world modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文给出一份面向泛化前馈式单步3D重建的综述，提出以模型设计为中心的通用五类研究框架，并系统梳理了数据集、评测基准与应用场景，指出扩展性、评测规范与世界建模三大待解挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统3D重建方法需逐场景优化或类别专用训练，难以扩展；近年泛化可前馈模型虽发展迅速，但输出表征多样、架构各异，缺乏统一视角来梳理共性问题与未来方向。
AI.method: 抽离隐式/显式输出差异，提出“模型设计不可知”的新分类法：围绕特征增强、几何感知、模型效率、增广策略与时序建模五大核心问题，对现有前馈网络进行结构性归纳；配套整理基准数据集与真实应用，并与方法体系对应归类。
AI.result: 构建了一个涵盖特征提取、多视图融合、几何约束等通用架构要素的五维度研究地图；揭示当前方法在效率-精度权衡、跨域鲁棒性、标准评测准则和可扩展世界模型上的不足。
AI.conclusion: 未来需建立统一评测协议，发展高效可扩展架构，并将前馈3D重建嵌入世界模型框架，以实现真正大规模、可落地的3D感知与交互系统。

title: Coherence in the brain unfolds across separable temporal regimes
summary: To maintain coherence in language, the brain must satisfy key competing temporal demands: the gradual accumulation of meaning across extended context (drift) and the rapid reconfiguration of representations at event boundaries (shift). How these processes are implemented in the human brain during naturalistic listening remains unclear. Here, we tested whether both can be captured by annotation-free drift and shift signals and whether their neural expression shows distinct regional preferences across the brain. These signals were derived from a large language model (LLM) processing the narrative input. To enable high-precision voxelwise encoding models with stable parameter estimates, we densely sampled one healthy adult across more than 7 hours of listening to crime stories while collecting 7 Tesla fMRI data. We then modeled the feature-informed hemodynamic response using a regularized encoding framework validated on independent stories. Drift predictions were prevalent in default-mode network hubs, whereas shift predictions were evident bilaterally in the primary auditory cortex and language association cortex. Together, these findings show that coherence during language comprehension is implemented through distinct but co-expressed neural regimes of slow contextual integration and rapid event-driven reconfiguration, offering a mechanistic entry point for understanding disturbances of language coherence in psychiatric disorders.

AI.tldr: 大脑用“慢漂移”整合长文语境，用“快跳转”应对事件边界；前者默认模式网络主导，后者双侧听皮层与语言区主导，无需人工标注，仅用LLM即可刻画。
AI.motivation: 自然叙事理解需在“持续累积意义”与“瞬时重配置表征”间取得连贯，但二者如何在大脑并行实现、是否可分区域表达尚不清楚。
AI.method: 令同一被试7小时聆听犯罪故事，同步采集7T fMRI；用大语言模型无监督生成“漂移”与“跳转”时间序列，作为刺激特征；用正则化编码模型对全脑体素做响应预测并交叉验证。
AI.result: 漂移信号解释力集中在默认模式网络枢纽；跳转信号解释力集中在双侧初级听皮层及语言联合皮层，二者信号在同一脑区互不混杂。
AI.conclusion: 语言连贯性由“慢语境整合”与“快事件重配置”两套神经机制协同实现，为研究精神障碍中语言连贯失调提供了可量化的生物学标记。

title: Adaptive Multi-Scale Channel-Spatial Attention Aggregation Framework for 3D Indoor Semantic Scene Completion Toward Assisting Visually Impaired
comment: We need to optimize the experiment, the changes are quite significant
summary: Independent indoor mobility remains a critical challenge for individuals with visual impairments, largely due to the limited capability of existing assistive systems in detecting fine-grained hazardous objects such as chairs, tables, and small obstacles. These perceptual blind zones substantially increase the risk of collision in unfamiliar environments.
