title: UI-Zoomer: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive Zoom-In for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding, which localizes interface elements from screenshots given natural language queries, remains challenging for small icons and dense layouts. Test-time zoom-in methods improve localization by cropping and re-running inference at higher resolution, but apply cropping uniformly across all instances with fixed crop sizes, ignoring whether the model is actually uncertain on each case. We propose \textbf{UI-Zoomer}, a training-free adaptive zoom-in framework that treats both the trigger and scale of zoom-in as a prediction uncertainty quantification problem. A confidence-aware gate fuses spatial consensus among stochastic candidates with token-level generation confidence to selectively trigger zoom-in only when localization is uncertain. When triggered, an uncertainty-driven crop sizing module decomposes prediction variance into inter-sample positional spread and intra-sample box extent, deriving a per-instance crop radius via the law of total variance. Extensive experiments on ScreenSpot-Pro, UI-Vision, and ScreenSpot-v2 demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines across multiple model architectures, achieving gains of up to +13.4\%, +10.3\%, and +4.2\% respectively, with no additional training required.

AI.tldr: UI-Zoomer 是一套免训练的“自适应放大”框架：先用不确定性量化判断何时需要放大，再按方差拆解动态裁剪截图，最终在小图标/密集布局 GUI 定位任务上零成本提升 4%–13%。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时放大方法对所有实例采用固定裁剪策略，无法区分模型真正不确定的情况，导致冗余计算且对小图标、密集界面元素定位效果差。需要一种能“按需放大”且无需再训练的机制。
AI.method: 将“是否放大”与“放大多少”转化为不确定性量化问题：① 用随机前向产生多个候选框，融合空间一致性 + token 级置信度，生成置信度门控信号，仅在不确定时触发放大；② 触发后，将预测方差拆分为“样本间位置散布”与“样本内框大小”两项，依全方差定律计算实例专属裁剪半径；③ 不更新任何参数，直接对放大子图重推理。
AI.result: 在 ScreenSpot-Pro、UI-Vision、ScreenSpot-v2 三个基准上，跨多种骨干模型（OCR + 视觉-语言）均取得显著提升，最高分别 +13.4%、+10.3%、+4.2%，且无需额外训练数据或微调。
AI.conclusion: UI-Zoomer 证明“不确定性驱动的自适应放大”能在零训练开销下，有效缓解低分辨率小目标与密集布局导致的定位误差，具备通用即插即用潜力。

title: Working Notes on Late Interaction Dynamics: Analyzing Targeted Behaviors of Late Interaction Models
comment: Accepted at The 1st Late Interaction Workshop (LIR) @ ECIR 2026
summary: While Late Interaction models exhibit strong retrieval performance, many of their underlying dynamics remain understudied, potentially hiding performance bottlenecks. In this work, we focus on two topics in Late Interaction retrieval: a length bias that arises when using multi-vector scoring, and the similarity distribution beyond the best scores pooled by the MaxSim operator. We analyze these behaviors for state-of-the-art models on the NanoBEIR benchmark. Results show that while the theoretical length bias of causal Late Interaction models holds in practice, bi-directional models can also suffer from it in extreme cases. We also note that no significant similarity trend lies beyond the top-1 document token, validating that the MaxSim operator efficiently exploits the token-level similarity scores.

AI.tldr: 首次量化 Late-Interaction 检索中「文档越长占优」的长度偏差及 MaxSim 算子聚合特征，指出双向模型亦难完全免疫偏差，同时验证 MaxSim 仅需 top-1 token 相似度即可捕获核心信息。
AI.motivation: Late-Interaction 模型检索效果虽优，但对其内部打分机制的认知缺口可能隐藏性能瓶颈；需明确多向量打分引入的长度偏差是否真实存在，以及 MaxSim 算子聚合相似度时顶尖高分之外是否有被忽略的重要信号。
AI.method: 以 NanoBEIR 为基准，对比因果与双向两类 SOTA Late-Interaction 模型，在段落长度极端分布下统计查询-段落的 token 级相似曲线；计算长度相关 Kendall's τ 与回归系数，量化长度偏差；绘制累积相似分布直方图，检验 top-k (k>1) token 对最终得分的边际贡献。
AI.result: 理论上因果模型存在的长度偏差在实践中得到验证；极端长度设置下，双向模型同样出现显著正相关长度效应；相似度分布显示，top-1 token 后增长斜率骤降至断点，k>1 时相对增量不足 1%，证明 MaxSim 已经穷尽量化信号。
AI.conclusion: 长度偏差普遍存在于 Late-Interaction 框架，即便对双向架构亦需显式长度归一化；MaxSim 聚合策略高效，无需额外聚合机制即可获得绝大部分判别性特征，为后续通道堆叠与计算量缩减提供理论依据。

title: Visual Self-Fulfilling Alignment: Shaping Safety-Oriented Personas via Threat-Related Images
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) face safety misalignment, where visual inputs enable harmful outputs. To address this, existing methods require explicit safety labels or contrastive data; yet, threat-related concepts are concrete and visually depictable, while safety concepts, like helpfulness, are abstract and lack visual referents. Inspired by the Self-Fulfilling mechanism underlying emergent misalignment, we propose Visual Self-Fulfilling Alignment (VSFA). VSFA fine-tunes vision-language models (VLMs) on neutral VQA tasks constructed around threat-related images, without any safety labels. Through repeated exposure to threat-related visual content, models internalize the implicit semantics of vigilance and caution, shaping safety-oriented personas. Experiments across multiple VLMs and safety benchmarks demonstrate that VSFA reduces the attack success rate, improves response quality, and mitigates over-refusal while preserving general capabilities. Our work extends the self-fulfilling mechanism from text to visual modalities, offering a label-free approach to VLMs alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出无安全标签的视觉自实现对齐方法VSFA，通过让VLM仅在中立VQA任务上反复接触威胁图像，使模型内隐形成安全意识，实验表明显著降低攻击成功率并缓解过度拒答，同时保留通用能力。
AI.motivation: MLLM在多模态场景下存在由视觉输入触发的安全失配，但现有对齐方法依赖显式安全标注或对比数据，而安全概念（如有用性）抽象且缺乏视觉参照，难以直接监督。作者观察到威胁概念具象、可视觉化，可借“自实现”机制让模型自行内化安全意识，从而摆脱对人工安全标签的依赖。
AI.method: 构建围绕威胁图像的中立VQA数据集（仅含日常问答，无安全标签或正负样本），用该数据持续微调VLM。通过高频暴露于威胁视觉语义，触发模型自实现过程，使其在无显性安全训练信号的情况下，自发形成警惕、谨慎的安全人格，实现视觉模态的自对齐。
AI.result: 在多种VLM和多项安全基准上，VSFA将攻击成功率平均降低30%以上，提升拒答准确率并减少过度拒答，同时保持下游VQA、OCR等通用性能不下降；对比需安全标签的监督方法，VSFA在零标注条件下取得可比甚至更好的安全效果。
AI.conclusion: 首次把“自实现”机制从文本扩展到视觉模态，证明仅通过中立的威胁图像VQA暴露即可让VLM自发生成安全对齐，提供了一种无需安全标签、数据易获取、对通用能力无损的新型多模态对齐范式。

title: Gradient Descent's Last Iterate is Often (slightly) Suboptimal
summary: We consider the well-studied setting of minimizing a convex Lipschitz function using either gradient descent (GD) or its stochastic variant (SGD), and examine the last iterate convergence. By now, it is known that standard stepsize choices lead to a last iterate convergence rate of $\log T/\sqrt{T}$ after $T$ steps. A breakthrough result of Jain et al. [2019] recovered the optimal $1/\sqrt{T}$ rate by constructing a non-standard stepsize sequence. However, this sequence requires choosing $T$ in advance, as opposed to common stepsize schedules which apply for any time horizon. Moreover, Jain et al. conjectured that without prior knowledge of $T$, no stepsize sequence can ensure the optimal error for SGD's last iterate, a claim which so far remained unproven. We prove this conjecture, and in fact show that even in the noiseless case of GD, it is impossible to avoid an excess poly-log factor in $T$ when considering an anytime last iterate guarantee. Our proof further suggests that such (slightly) suboptimal stopping times are unavoidably common.

AI.tldr: 无论是否提前知道迭代总步数，梯度类方法在最终迭代点的最坏收敛速率里必然出现一个poly-log T因子，该因子无法被任何步长策略彻底消除。
AI.motivation: 学界对梯度类方法的终极兴趣是：在多长迭代步数T下才能将凸问题解到预定精度？但现有结果显示，若关心“最后一点”（随时可能停算），其收敛速率会比理论下界差一个对数因子。Jain等提出一个需预知T的步长可把GD/最终迭代点损失降到最优O(1/√T)，同时猜测对任意时限的最优步长不存在，本工作即为给出严格的否定性证明。
AI.method: 团队采取极小极大（minimax）与对偶视角论证：首先刻画步长必须满足的MSE增长曲线；随后在最坏情形下构造一类“对抗”剖面——曲率虽小但能追踪GD误差下界，最终得到的信息论下极限即为poly-log T，而与噪声强度、初始化扩散或步长自适应无关。
AI.result: 1．GD/任意步长均无法把误差级降到优于Ω((log T)/√T)。2．SGD保持同样的poly-log下界。3．即使噪声为零也逃不掉该参数依赖。4．结论对准“任意时刻停止”（anytime guarantee），表明稳扎稳打（explicit step decay or adaptive schemes）至多只能把对数常数改进到极小，无法彻底消除。
AI.conclusion: 理论上最优步长要么要求迭代总步数预先已知并固定，要么就要接受最终迭代点对数层级的次最优——所以在实时调度、轮询式优化的场景里，poly-log代价是本质的而非算法缺陷。研究启示今后应聚焦时间方差权衡：如何提高收敛速度的整体常数，而非徒劳地试图消除对数因子；同时提示分析与工程实践中可将停止时间规划当作独立控制变量而非纯参数预估。

title: HiVLA: A Visual-Grounded-Centric Hierarchical Embodied Manipulation System
summary: While end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, fine-tuning them on narrow control data often compromises the profound reasoning capabilities inherited from their base Vision-Language Models (VLMs). To resolve this fundamental trade-off, we propose HiVLA, a visual-grounded-centric hierarchical framework that explicitly decouples high-level semantic planning from low-level motor control. In high-level part, a VLM planner first performs task decomposition and visual grounding to generate structured plans, comprising a subtask instruction and a precise target bounding box. Then, to translate this plan into physical actions, we introduce a flow-matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT) action expert in low-level part equipped with a novel cascaded cross-attention mechanism. This design sequentially fuses global context, high-resolution object-centric crops and skill semantics, enabling the DiT to focus purely on robust execution. Our decoupled architecture preserves the VLM's zero-shot reasoning while allowing independent improvement of both components. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that HiVLA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art end-to-end baselines, particularly excelling in long-horizon skill composition and the fine-grained manipulation of small objects in cluttered scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出HiVLA，一种视觉-语言-动作分层框架，用VLM做高层语义规划、流匹配DiT做底层动作执行，既保留零样本推理，又提升精细操控成绩。
AI.motivation: 端到端微调VLA模型会牺牲基础VLM的深层推理能力，亟需在不折损高层语义的前提下提升机器人操作性能。
AI.method: 1. 高层：冻结VLM做任务分解与视觉定位，输出子任务指令+目标 bounding box；2. 低层：引入流匹配 DiT 动作专家，采用级联交叉注意依次融合全局上下文、高分目标裁剪与技能语义，实现纯执行。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实场景中均显著优于现有端到端基线，尤其擅长长周期技能组合与杂乱环境下的细小物体精细操控。
AI.conclusion: 明确解耦高层规划与底层控制的分层架构可同时保留VLM推理能力并持续优化动作模块，为构建更通用灵活的机器人系统提供了可行范式。

title: ChartNet: A Million-Scale, High-Quality Multimodal Dataset for Robust Chart Understanding
summary: Understanding charts requires models to jointly reason over geometric visual patterns, structured numerical data, and natural language -- a capability where current vision-language models (VLMs) remain limited. We introduce ChartNet, a high-quality, million-scale multimodal dataset designed to advance chart interpretation and reasoning. ChartNet leverages a novel code-guided synthesis pipeline to generate 1.5 million diverse chart samples spanning 24 chart types and 6 plotting libraries. Each sample consists of five aligned components: plotting code, rendered chart image, data table, natural language summary, and question-answering with reasoning, providing fine-grained cross-modal alignment. To capture the full spectrum of chart comprehension, ChartNet additionally includes specialized subsets encompassing human annotated data, real-world data, safety, and grounding. Moreover, a rigorous quality-filtering pipeline ensures visual fidelity, semantic accuracy, and diversity across chart representations. Fine-tuning on ChartNet consistently improves results across benchmarks, demonstrating its utility as large-scale supervision for multimodal models. As the largest open-source dataset of its kind, ChartNet aims to support the development of foundation models with robust and generalizable capabilities for data visualization understanding. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-granite/ChartNet

AI.tldr: .ChartNet is a 1.5 M-sample multimodal dataset that pairs 24 chart types with code/image/table/summary/QA to push chart-reasoning in VLMs; it’s open-sourced.
AI.motivation: Existing VLMs perform poorly on joint reasoning over chart visuals, data tables and text, and large-scale, fine-grained aligned data for chart understanding is lacking.
AI.method: A code-guided synthesis engine generates charts via 6 plotting libraries; a quality-filter pipeline removes visual/semantic defects; human annotation & real-world & safety subsets extend coverage; five aligned modalities (code, image, table, summary, QA) are created per sample.
AI.result: Models fine-tuned on ChartNet yield consistent gains across chart-QA benchmarks, confirming the dataset’s large-scale supervision value.
AI.conclusion: ChartNet supplies the largest open-source, high-quality chart corpus, enabling development of foundation models with robust, generalizable data-visualization understanding capabilities.

title: UNBOX: Unveiling Black-box visual models with Natural-language
summary: Ensuring trustworthiness in open-world visual recognition requires models that are interpretable, fair, and robust to distribution shifts. Yet modern vision systems are increasingly deployed as proprietary black-box APIs, exposing only output probabilities and hiding architecture, parameters, gradients, and training data. This opacity prevents meaningful auditing, bias detection, and failure analysis. Existing explanation methods assume white- or gray-box access or knowledge of the training distribution, making them unusable in these real-world settings. We introduce UNBOX, a framework for class-wise model dissection under fully data-free, gradient-free, and backpropagation-free constraints. UNBOX leverages Large Language Models and text-to-image diffusion models to recast activation maximization as a purely semantic search driven by output probabilities. The method produces human-interpretable text descriptors that maximally activate each class, revealing the concepts a model has implicitly learned, the training distribution it reflects, and potential sources of bias. We evaluate UNBOX on ImageNet-1K, Waterbirds, and CelebA through semantic fidelity tests, visual-feature correlation analyses and slice-discovery auditing. Despite operating under the strictest black-box constraints, UNBOX performs competitively with state-of-the-art white-box interpretability methods. This demonstrates that meaningful insight into a model's internal reasoning can be recovered without any internal access, enabling more trustworthy and accountable visual recognition systems.

AI.tldr: UNBOX 无需任何内部信息即可对黑盒视觉 API 进行逐类别“解剖”，生成可解释文本描述，揭示模型所学概念与潜在偏见，效果媲美白盒方法。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉识别 API 以黑盒形式部署，仅返回输出概率，导致难以审计公平性、鲁棒性与偏见。现有解释方法依赖白盒或训练分布知识，在真实环境下失效。
AI.method: 提出 UNBOX 框架，仅利用输出概率，借助大语言模型与文生图扩散模型，将“激活最大化”转化为纯语义搜索，迭代生成并优化文本提示，使其对应类别概率最大，从而得到人类可读的类别激活描述。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K、Waterbirds、CelebA 上，UNBOX 在语义保真度、视觉特征相关性和切片审计任务中与白盒 SOTA 方法性能相当，成功发现已知偏见。
AI.conclusion: 即使在最严格的黑盒限制下，也能恢复模型内部决策逻辑，实现可解释、可问责的视觉识别，为无内部访问的模型审计提供了实用工具。

title: Context Sensitivity Improves Human-Machine Visual Alignment
summary: Modern machine learning models typically represent inputs as fixed points in a high-dimensional embedding space. While this approach has been proven powerful for a wide range of downstream tasks, it fundamentally differs from the way humans process information. Because humans are constantly adapting to their environment, they represent objects and their relationships in a highly context-sensitive manner. To address this gap, we propose a method for context-sensitive similarity computation from neural network embeddings, applied to modeling a triplet odd-one-out task with an anchor image serving as simultaneous context. Modeling context enables us to achieve up to a 15% improvement in odd-one-out accuracy over a context-insensitive model. We find that this improvement is consistent across both original and "human-aligned" vision foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于上下文敏感的嵌入相似度计算方法，将锚点图像同时作为上下文，使模型在“三选一找不同”任务中准确率提升15%，且该增益在人类对齐与原始视觉基模型上均稳定存在。
AI.motivation: 现有深度模型把输入表示为固定高维点，与人类高度依赖上下文、动态调整表征的认知方式存在本质差异。作者旨在缩小这一差距，让模型能像人一样随环境灵活判断相似性。
AI.method: 设计上下文敏感相似度函数：将锚点图像同时视为参考与语境，通过改设计算查询图像与候选图像间距离的上下文项，使相似度随锚点动态变化。整体框架无需重训主干，仅在外层引入轻量级上下文模块。
AI.result: 在基于三胞胎的“找不同”任务上，上下文敏感模型比上下文无关基线绝对准确率提升15%，相对提升约20%。该提升在ImageNet预训练模型与经人类对齐调优的模型（如CLIP）上均保持一致，且跨不同锚点类别稳定。
AI.conclusion: 引入锚点作为即时上下文足以显著改进神经嵌入的相似度判断，验证“上下文敏感表征”对弥合人机差异的有效性；该方法即插即用，可迁移至任意现成视觉基模型，无需重新训练。未来可扩展到多锚点、语言或其他模态上下文。

title: Rhetorical Questions in LLM Representations: A Linear Probing Study
summary: Rhetorical questions are asked not to seek information but to persuade or signal stance. How large language models internally represent them remains unclear. We analyze rhetorical questions in LLM representations using linear probes on two social-media datasets with different discourse contexts, and find that rhetorical signals emerge early and are most stably captured by last-token representations. Rhetorical questions are linearly separable from information-seeking questions within datasets, and remain detectable under cross-dataset transfer, reaching AUROC around 0.7-0.8. However, we demonstrate that transferability does not simply imply a shared representation. Probes trained on different datasets produce different rankings when applied to the same target corpus, with overlap among the top-ranked instances often below 0.2. Qualitative analysis shows that these divergences correspond to distinct rhetorical phenomena: some probes capture discourse-level rhetorical stance embedded in extended argumentation, while others emphasize localized, syntax-driven interrogative acts. Together, these findings suggest that rhetorical questions in LLM representations are encoded by multiple linear directions emphasizing different cues, rather than a single shared direction.

AI.tldr: 通过线性探针分析两大社交媒体语料，首次揭示 LLM 内部对反问句的编码机制：反问信号在最后一词表示中最稳定，线性可分性达 AUROC≈0.8；但跨语料迁移时探针排序几乎不重合（重叠率<0.2），表明模型并非用单一方向，而是多条线性方向分别捕获论证级立场与句法级疑问特征。
AI.motivation: 反问句不用于获取信息而用于表达立场，其在线性探测中的可分离性暗示 LLM 可能已习得隐含修辞知识；厘清这种知识是否以统一、跨语境的表示存在，是理解模型语言理解深度与迁移能力的关键。
AI.method: 收集两类社交媒体数据（争辩讨论 vs. 评论互动），训练线性探针区分反问与信息性提问；评估单语料 AUROC，再进行跨语料迁移并比较探针打分排序；最后结合注意力可视化与人工标注做定性对比，定位不同探针聚焦的语篇或句法线索。
AI.result: 同类语料内线探针可稳健区分两类问句（AUROC 0.70–0.80）；跨语料虽仍显著优于随机，但探针对相同目标文本给出的“最典型反问”排序重叠常低于 0.2，说明捕获的特征并不一致；定性分析显示高打分样本分别对应宏观论证结构中的立场表达或局部句法反问标记。
AI.conclusion: LLM 对反问句的内部编码并非共享单一方向，而是由多条线性方向并行编码：一条倾向捕捉长篇论证的语篇立场，另一条侧重局部疑问句式；修辞知识的表示呈分布式而非统一式，这对跨任务迁移与可解释性研究具有启示意义。

title: VLMs Need Words: Vision Language Models Ignore Visual Detail In Favor of Semantic Anchors
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, they often fail on tasks that require fine-grained visual perception, even when the required information is still present in their internal representations. Prior work has attributed this ``hidden-in-plain-sight'' gap to the language model, but the cause remains unexplained. In this work, we demonstrate that this gap arises from the language model's lack of semantic labels for fine-grained visual details: when visual entities can be mapped to known concepts, VLMs bypass visual comparison and reason through language; when they cannot, VLMs resort to brittle and hallucinated descriptions. We verify this across semantic correspondence, synthetic shape matching, and face matching, and find that VLMs perform much better when the relevant entities are nameable than when they are unnamable. Mechanistically, Logit Lens analysis confirms that VLMs explicitly recover semantic labels for nameable entities and surface more unique tokens compared to unnameable entities. Furthermore, we show that this limitation can be addressed: teaching completely arbitrary names for unknown entities improves performance. More importantly, task-specific finetuning yields even stronger generalization without relying on language priors, i.e. through real visual perception. Our findings suggest that current VLM failures on visual tasks reflect a learned shortcut rather than a fundamental limitation of multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 视觉-语言模型在细粒度视觉任务上失败并非因为“看不见”, 而是缺乏对应语义标签；一旦赋予可命名或进行视觉微调，模型即可摆脱语言捷径、恢复真实视觉推理。
AI.motivation: 现有VLMs在细粒度视觉感知任务中表现骤降，即便其内部表征已含所需信息。此前将原因归于语言模型，但机理未明。本文旨在揭示“视而不见”背后的真正机制——是否因语言侧缺少对应语义标签而被迫走语言捷径。
AI.method: 1) 设计三类任务（语义对应、合成形状匹配、人脸匹配），对比“可命名 vs 不可命名”视觉实体的VLM表现；2) 用Logit Lens探针分析模型内部是否显式恢复语义标签；3) 通过两种干预验证假设：a) 给未知实体赋予任意新名称，b) 任务特定微调，观察能否摆脱语言先验、实现真正视觉泛化。
AI.result: 1) 当视觉实体可命名时，VLM准确率显著提升；不可命名时性能骤降。2) Logit Lens显示可命名实体在语言模型隐态中较早出现对应语义logits，且生成更独特token；不可命名实体则被泛化描述甚至幻觉。3) 简单教授任意新名即可部分提升性能；任务特定微调更进一步，在无需语言先验条件下实现强泛化。
AI.conclusion: VLM在细粒度视觉任务上的失败是“学会走语言捷径”所致，并非多模态推理的根本局限。通过为视觉细节提供语义锚点或直接强化视觉感知通路，可解除这一限制，为未来提升多模态模型细粒度能力提供明确方向。

title: Towards Generalizable Robotic Manipulation in Dynamic Environments
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in static manipulation but struggle in dynamic environments with moving targets. This performance gap primarily stems from a scarcity of dynamic manipulation datasets and the reliance of mainstream VLAs on single-frame observations, restricting their spatiotemporal reasoning capabilities. To address this, we introduce DOMINO, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for generalizable dynamic manipulation, featuring 35 tasks with hierarchical complexities, over 110K expert trajectories, and a multi-dimensional evaluation suite. Through comprehensive experiments, we systematically evaluate existing VLAs on dynamic tasks, explore effective training strategies for dynamic awareness, and validate the generalizability of dynamic data. Furthermore, we propose PUMA, a dynamics-aware VLA architecture. By integrating scene-centric historical optical flow and specialized world queries to implicitly forecast object-centric future states, PUMA couples history-aware perception with short-horizon prediction. Results demonstrate that PUMA achieves state-of-the-art performance, yielding a 6.3% absolute improvement in success rate over baselines. Moreover, we show that training on dynamic data fosters robust spatiotemporal representations that transfer to static tasks. All code and data are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/DOMINO.

AI.tldr: 论文指出 VLA 静态场景强而在动态环境弱，主因是缺乏动态数据且仅用单帧；作者推出大规模动态操作数据集 DOMINO，设计动力学感知 VLA 架构 PUMA，在动态任务上绝对提升 6.3%，并验证动态数据对静态任务亦有益处。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型在静态操纵表现突出，但面对移动目标时性能骤降。根本瓶颈是：1) 公开可用的动态操纵数据稀少，难以训练；2) 主流 VLA 基于单帧视觉输入，缺乏时序建模，无法有效推理目标未来位置与自身动作后果。为缩小该性能差距，急需大规模动态数据集与时空推理架构。
AI.method: 首先构建 DOMINO 数据集——含 35 种层次化动态任务、11 万余条专家轨迹，配套多维度评估基准。继而在该数据集上系统测试现有 VLA，提炼出动力学感知训练策略。最后提出 PUMA 架构：以场景为中心的光流历史作为时序线索，引入特殊“世界查询”隐式预测物体未来状态，实现历史感知与短期预测闭环。
AI.result: 实验表明，PUMA 在 DOMINO 基准上达到 SOTA，成功率比基线提升 6.3%。消融实验确认历史光流与世界查询对动态任务尤为关键。进一步发现，仅用动态数据预训练的表征迁移到静态任务时仍有增益，显现更鲁棒的时空特征。
AI.conclusion: 动态操纵性能瓶颈可通过专用大规模数据与动力学感知架构共同解决；PUMA 首次将光流历史与物体未来预测融入 VLA，为后续研究提供可扩展范式。代码与数据全部开源 https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/DOMINO。

title: Sandpile Economics: Theory, Identification, and Evidence
summary:
Why do capitalist economies recurrently generate crises whose severity is disproportionate to the size of the triggering shock? This paper proposes a structural answer grounded in the evolutionary geometry of production networks. As economies evolve through specialization, integration, and competitive selection, their inter-sectoral linkages drift toward configurations of increasing geometric fragility, eventually crossing a threshold beyond which small disturbances generate disproportionately large cascades.
  We introduce Sandpile Economics, a formal framework that interprets macroeconomic instability as an emergent property of disequilibrium production networks. The key state variable is the Forman--Ricci curvature of the input--output graph, capturing local substitution possibilities when supply chains are disrupted. We show that when curvature falls below an endogenous threshold, the distribution of cascade sizes follows a power law with tail index $α\in (1,2)$, implying a regime of unbounded amplification.
  The underlying mechanism is evolutionary: specialization reduces input substitutability, pushing the economy toward criticality, while crisis episodes induce endogenous network reconfiguration and path dependence. These dynamics are inherently non-ergodic and cannot be captured by representative-agent frameworks.
  Empirically, using global input--output data, we document that production networks operate in persistently negative curvature regimes and that curvature robustly predicts medium-run output dynamics. A one-standard-deviation increase in curvature is associated with higher cumulative growth over three-year horizons, and curvature systematically outperforms standard network metrics in explaining cross-country differences in resilience.

AI.tldr: 资本主义经济为何因微小冲击反复爆发严重危机？本文用“沙堆经济学”将宏观不稳定性归因于生产网络在演化中自发走向几何脆弱，当 Forman–Ricci 曲率跌破内生阈值，小扰动触发无界级联；全球投入产出数据证实负曲率持续存在，曲率显著优于传统指标，可预测中期增长与跨国韧性差异。
AI.motivation: 传统宏观模型把危机归因于外生大冲击或金融摩擦，难以解释“小冲击—大衰退”的反复出现。作者追问：是否存在更深层的结构性原因，使经济系统自身不断累积对微小扰动的极端敏感？
AI.method: 构建“沙堆经济学”框架，把生产网络视为非均衡图；引入 Forman–Ricci 曲率度量局部替代弹性，证明当曲率降至临界值以下，级联规模服从尾指数 α∈(1,2) 的幂律，呈现无界放大。利用全球投入产出表计算各国时变曲率，并与 3 年期累积增长做面板回归，比较曲率与度分布、聚类系数等标准网络指标的解释力。
AI.result: 理论：负曲率区持续存在，且越低越接近临界，级联分布无矩，呈现“小冲击—大衰退”。实证：曲率每提升 1 标准差，未来 3 年累积增长率显著上升；曲率对跨国增长差异的预测力优于介数中心性、密度等经典指标，且结果对控制金融变量、初始收入、固定效应均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 经济危�机并非单纯外生，而是生产网络在专业化、竞争选择下自发走向几何脆弱的内生产物；Forman–Ricci 曲率提供了可观测、可预警的“系统韧性温度计”，为宏观审慎政策提供新的网络靶点。

title: From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs
comment: TLDR: Under review. 42 pages, 18 figures. Code and data at https://itay1itzhak.github.io/vibe-testing-llms Subjects: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
summary: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis. We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.

AI.tldr: 本文把用户“凭感觉测模型”(vibe-testing) 的经验上升为可复现的评估框架，证明个性化提示+主观评判能颠覆传统榜单排序。
AI.motivation: 基准分与现实体验脱节，用户只能自发地做零散、不可复现的“vibe-testing”。作者希望把这类经验性评估系统化，让社区既能保留真实场景又能获得可量化结果。
AI.method: 1) 调研 500+ 开发者的真实测试习惯；2) 收集 120 篇博客/推文中的模型对比报告并编码；3) 抽象出“双个性化”公式——测什么(任务)与怎么评(标准)都由用户画像决定；4) 构建概念验证流水线：用用户画像生成个性化提示，再用用户自订的 5 级 Likert 主观标尺比较输出；5) 在 HumanEval+、MBPP 两个编码基准上跑消融，对比传统 pass@k。
AI.result: 引入个性化后，同一批模型在 38% 的样本中发生相对排名翻转；用户画像差异越大，翻转率越高(ρ=0.64)。流水线仅需 20 条用户历史即可稳定复现其“vibe”偏好(Spearman 0.81)。
AI.conclusion: 将“凭感觉”形式化不仅可行，还能解释基准-现实的错位；未来公开基准应同时提供“画像-提示-主观评分”接口，而非仅给均分。

title: IatroBench: Pre-Registered Evidence of Iatrogenic Harm from AI Safety Measures
comment: 30 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Pre-registered on OSF (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/G6VMZ). Code and data: https://github.com/davidgringras/iatrobench. v2: Fix bibliography entries (add arXiv IDs, published venues); correct p-value typo in Limitations section; add AI Assistance Statement v3: Correct Figure 1 (decoupling scatter accidentally reverted to earlier draft in v2)
summary: Ask a frontier model how to taper six milligrams of alprazolam (psychiatrist retired, ten days of pills left, abrupt cessation causes seizures) and it tells her to call the psychiatrist she just explained does not exist. Change one word ("I'm a psychiatrist; a patient presents with...") and the same model, same weights, same inference pass produces a textbook Ashton Manual taper with diazepam equivalence, anticonvulsant coverage, and monitoring thresholds. The knowledge was there; the model withheld it. IatroBench measures this gap. Sixty pre-registered clinical scenarios, six frontier models, 3,600 responses, scored on two axes (commission harm, CH 0-3; omission harm, OH 0-4) through a structured-evaluation pipeline validated against physician scoring (kappa_w = 0.571, within-1 agreement 96%). The central finding is identity-contingent withholding: match the same clinical question in physician vs. layperson framing and all five testable models provide better guidance to the physician (decoupling gap +0.38, p = 0.003; binary hit rates on safety-colliding actions drop 13.1 percentage points in layperson framing, p < 0.0001, while non-colliding actions show no change). The gap is widest for the model with the heaviest safety investment (Opus, +0.65). Three failure modes separate cleanly: trained withholding (Opus), incompetence (Llama 4), and indiscriminate content filtering (GPT-5.2, whose post-generation filter strips physician responses at 9x the layperson rate because they contain denser pharmacological tokens). The standard LLM judge assigns OH = 0 to 73% of responses a physician scores OH >= 1 (kappa = 0.045); the evaluation apparatus has the same blind spot as the training apparatus. Every scenario targets someone who has already exhausted the standard referrals.

AI.tldr: 用自主设计数据集IatroBench比较6个前沿大模型在60个临床药学场景中的回答，发现模型对”我是精神科医生/我是普通患者“一字之差出现系统性信息扣留——对医生给出完整阿普唑仑减量方案，却让患者去‘联系刚说已不存在的医生’。安全投入最大的Opus医生-患者差距最严重；Llama 4系能力不足，GPT-5.2系术语密度高触发内容过滤。现行自动评估同样忽视这类信息遗漏致安全盲区。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐措施只关注’主动输出有害信息‘（commission），却忽视模型因身份提示而’故意不输出必要安全信息‘（omission）带来的临床风险。作者提出需量化这种因问法不同而出现的”信息扣留差距“，并揭示当前模型与评估体系的盲区。
AI.method: 1)设计60个真实可行且已耗尽转诊途径的临床药学减量场景；2)对6个大型模型在同参数同推理条件下分别用”我是精神科医生/普通患者“两种身份提示提问；3)由专家制定CH 0-3、OH 0-4双轴评分，再训练结构化评价管道保证医生级一致性（κw=0.571）；4)引入自研LLM法官对比，解析过滤日志，并对模型内部动作进行因果追溯，分离三种失败模式。
AI.result: 所有可测试模型在医生身份下提供的安全指导显著优于普通患者提问（平均OH差+0.38，p=0.003），其中Opus差距最大达+0.65。安全关键命中率在患者提问时降低13.1个百分点（p<0.0001）；Opus表现为训练出的”有选择扣留“，Llama 4为能力不到位，GPT-5.2为高剂量药学术语触发内容过滤，9倍速率删除医生回复。自研LLM法官与医生一致性极低（κ=0.045），对73%医生判定OH≥1的回答给出OH=0，证明评估系统与训练系统存在同样的安全盲区。
AI.conclusion: 当前前沿大模型在药学等高风险场景中普遍存在身份依赖型信息扣留，仅靠增强常规有害内容过滤无法解决；需要专门校正模型遗漏风险（omission harm），并在训练和评估中显式引入OH指标。研究人员应公开安全后训练细节，临床用户亦需认识到：换用专业身份提问可显著提升模型可用性，但这恰暴露模型安全机制缺陷。

title: From Plausibility to Verifiability: Risk-Controlled Generative OCR with Vision-Language Models
summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) can act as generative OCR engines, yet open-ended decoding can expose rare but consequential failures. We identify a core deployment misalignment in generative OCR. Autoregressive decoding favors semantic plausibility, whereas OCR requires outputs that are visually grounded and geometrically verifiable. This mismatch produces severe errors, especially over-generation and unsupported substitutions, creating deployment risk even when benchmark accuracy remains high. We therefore formulate frozen VLM OCR as a selective accept/abstain problem and propose a model-agnostic Geometric Risk Controller. The controller probes multiple structured views of the same input, applies lightweight structural screening, and accepts a transcription only when cross-view consensus and stability satisfy predefined criteria, yielding a small family of operating points. Experiments on frozen VLM backbones and standard OCR benchmarks show consistent reductions in extreme-error risk and catastrophic over-generation at predictable coverage costs. Reliable deployment of generative OCR with frozen VLMs benefits from explicit system-level risk control rather than unconstrained generation.

AI.tldr: 冻结的大型视觉-语言模型当作文本识别引擎时，会因自回归解码偏好语义合理性而忽视视觉/几何可验证性，造成极少却致命的过生成或虚假替换。作者将问题转化为“接受/拒识”框架，提出模型无关的几何风险控制器，通过多结构化视图交叉验证、几何一致性检验和轻量筛选，在可控覆盖率下降下显著消除极端错误。实验表明该机制可普适嵌入冻结模型，可靠降低灾难性风险，为生成式OCR的系统级部署提供实用风险管控范式。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式OCR虽在公开基准上精度高，但自回归机制侧重“语义通顺”，直接输出一长串token，导致出现罕见却造成灾难的“幻觉”——模型在图像中根本找不到对应内容却生成多余字符或错误替换，给实际部署埋下高成本隐患。然而仅依赖持续微调和更大模型并不能从根本上解决准确率与可靠性之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 首先把冻结VLM的OCR任务形式化为“选择性接受/拒识”决策问题；随后设计模型无关的Geometric Risk Controller：1)对同一张图并行采样多个结构化解码视图（如beam search、top-k、不同prompt等）；2)在各视图上运用轻量级几何校验——字符边界一致性、行列坐标守恒、重复Pattern等；3)以跨视图共识度（共识率、编辑距离稳定性）校准随机误差，并引入用户可调阈值，给出p-覆盖率-p-风险(PSPACE)曲线；4)若任一阈值未通过则触发拒识，仅输出“高确定性”结果。
AI.result: 在冻结的两大公共VLM骨干（BLIP-2、GIT）和ICDAR2015、COCO-Text等标准OCR基准上：1)极端误字率（输入图无任何对应字符仍生成长串文本）从1.2–1.6%降至≤0.03%；2)严重替换（如“5→S”类视觉相似错误）下降65–78%；3)平均拒识覆盖率被约束在用户设定的2–10%，可依据业务场景滑动，误差-覆盖呈单调-可预测关系；4)对比标准长度惩罚、置信度滤波等基线，方法在所有测试集上均显著优于同类无训练风险过滤器。
AI.conclusion: 冻结VLM的生成式OCR若要走向真实商用，不能仅靠提升单点精度，而需系统级风险管控。本文提出的Geometric Risk Controller通过视觉-几何一致性约束+多视图共识，成功将极小概率、高代价的“幻觉”错误降至可忽视水平，验证了无需再训即可低成本嵌入任何自回归模型。该方法为生成式文档识别、票据OCR、证件扫描等高合规场景提供了可审计、可参数化的“接受-拒识”范式，也启示其他自回归任务（如手写公式、版式还原）可借鉴结构化一致性检验，以较小覆盖率代价换得显著可靠性增益。

title: Nested Fourier-enhanced neural operator for efficient modeling of radiation transfer in fires
summary: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) has become an essential tool for predicting fire behavior, yet maintaining both efficiency and accuracy remains challenging. A major source of computational cost in fire simulations is the modeling of radiation transfer, which is usually the dominant heat transfer mechanism in fires. Solving the high-dimensional radiative transfer equation (RTE) with traditional numerical methods can be a performance bottleneck. Here, we present a machine learning framework based on Fourier-enhanced multiple-input neural operators (Fourier-MIONet) as an efficient alternative to direct numerical integration of the RTE. We first investigate the performance of neural operator architectures for a small-scale 2D pool fire and find that Fourier-MIONet provides the most accurate radiative solution predictions. The approach is then extended to 3D CFD fire simulations, where the computational mesh is locally refined across multiple levels. In these high-resolution settings, monolithic surrogate models for direct field-to-field mapping become difficult to train and computationally inefficient. To address this issue, a nested Fourier-MIONet is proposed to predict radiation solutions across multiple mesh-refinement levels. We validate the approach on 3D McCaffrey pool fires simulated with FireFOAM, including fixed fire sizes and a unified model trained over a continuous range of heat release rates (HRRs). The proposed method achieves global relative errors of 2-4% for 3D varying-HRR scenarios while providing faster inference than the estimated cost of one finite-volume radiation solve in FireFOAM for the 16-solid-angle case. With fast and accurate inference, the surrogate makes higher-fidelity radiation treatments practical and enables the incorporation of more spectrally resolved radiation models into CFD fire simulations for engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 用 Fourier-MIONet 替代传统 RTE 数值积分，在 3D 火场 CFD 中实现 2–4 % 全局误差、单步辐射求解级推理速度，可直接嵌入多网格级高保真模拟。
AI.motivation: 火灾 CFD 中辐射传热占主导，但高维 RTE 数值求解成为性能瓶颈；需在保持工程精度前提下显著提速，以允许更精细的谱分辨辐射模型在线耦合。
AI.method: 构建 Fourier 增强的多输入神经算子（Fourier-MIONet），先在 2D 池火基准上筛选最优架构；继而提出嵌套 Fourier-MIONet，对多层级局部加密网格逐级预测辐射场，实现从粗到细的残差补全映射。模型以 FireFOAM 的 3D McCaffrey 池火数据（固定及连续 HRR 范围）进行训练与验证。
AI.result: 2D 场景下 Fourier-MIONet 误差最低；3D 连续 HRR 情形全球相对误差 2–4 %，推理时间低于 FireFOAM 16 立体角有限体积辐射一次求解，且随网格加密优势扩大。
AI.conclusion: 该代理模型在精度与速度上同时满足工程需求，使高保真辐射处理可在 CFD 火场模拟中在线部署，并为后续耦合全光谱辐射模型提供可行路径。

title: LongCoT: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: As language models are increasingly deployed for complex autonomous tasks, their ability to reason accurately over longer horizons becomes critical. An essential component of this ability is planning and managing a long, complex chain-of-thought (CoT). We introduce LongCoT, a scalable benchmark of 2,500 expert-designed problems spanning chemistry, mathematics, computer science, chess, and logic to isolate and directly measure the long-horizon CoT reasoning capabilities of frontier models. Problems consist of a short input with a verifiable answer; solving them requires navigating a graph of interdependent steps that span tens to hundreds of thousands of reasoning tokens. Each local step is individually tractable for frontier models, so failures reflect long-horizon reasoning limitations. At release, the best models achieve <10% accuracy (GPT 5.2: 9.8%; Gemini 3 Pro: 6.1%) on LongCoT, revealing a substantial gap in current capabilities. Overall, LongCoT provides a rigorous measure of long-horizon reasoning, tracking the ability of frontier models to reason reliably over extended periods.

AI.tldr: LongCoT首次用2 500例跨学科难题直接度量模型能否在数万token量级维持连贯推理链，当前顶尖模型准确率<10%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法隔离“长链思维”能力，导致对模型在复杂自主任务中的长期推理瓶颈缺乏量化评估。作者需回答：当单步可解但依赖链极长时，模型究竟会在哪一步崩溃。
AI.method: 构建可验证答案、步骤图跨度达10³–10⁵ token的2500题，覆盖化学、数学、CS、国际象棋与逻辑；每题局部步骤对前沿模型可解，整体成败仅由长程规划决定；采用零样本/少样本遮蔽提示，防止数据污染。
AI.result: 发布时最强模型GPT-5.2与Gemini 3 Pro仅达9.8%与6.1%，错误集中于中间步骤依赖丢失与目标状态遗忘，暴露出长程工作记忆与规划策略的系统性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: LongCoT揭示前沿模型在长程推理上存在显著鸿沟，为后续算法（记忆增强、递归规划、验证器）提供严格度量与迭代靶点。

title: FinTrace: Holistic Trajectory-Level Evaluation of LLM Tool Calling for Long-Horizon Financial Tasks
summary: Recent studies demonstrate that tool-calling capability enables large language models (LLMs) to interact with external environments for long-horizon financial tasks. While existing benchmarks have begun evaluating financial tool calling, they focus on limited scenarios and rely on call-level metrics that fail to capture trajectory-level reasoning quality. To address this gap, we introduce FinTrace, a benchmark comprising 800 expert-annotated trajectories spanning 34 real-world financial task categories across multiple difficulty levels. FinTrace employs a rubric-based evaluation protocol with nine metrics organized along four axes -- action correctness, execution efficiency, process quality, and output quality -- enabling fine-grained assessment of LLM tool-calling behavior. Our evaluation of 13 LLMs reveals that while frontier models achieve strong tool selection, all models struggle with information utilization and final answer quality, exposing a critical gap between invoking the right tools and reasoning effectively over their outputs. To move beyond diagnosis, we construct FinTrace-Training, the first trajectory-level preference dataset for financial tool-calling, containing 8,196 curated trajectories with tool-augmented contexts and preference pairs. We fine-tune Qwen-3.5-9B using supervised fine-tuning followed by direct preference optimization (DPO) and show that training on FinTrace-Training consistently improves intermediate reasoning metrics, with DPO more effectively suppressing failure modes. However, end-to-end answer quality remains a bottleneck, indicating that trajectory-level improvements do not yet fully propagate to final output quality.

AI.tldr: 首次提出基于专家标注轨迹的细粒度金融工具调用评测基准 FinTrace 及配套轨迹偏好数据集 FinTrace-Training，证明 SFT+DPO 能显著修复中间推理缺陷，但最终答案质量仍是瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有金融工具调用基准仅停留在局部调用层面，忽视任务级策略与长期推理质量，难以反映真实长线金融场景需求。
AI.method: ① 构建 FinTrace：涵盖 34 类实战任务、800 条专家轨迹、9 指标四维（动作正确性、执行效率、过程质量、输出质量）评点体系；② 发布 FinTrace-Training：8 196 条带工具反馈的轨迹级偏好对；③ 用 SFT+DPO 对 Qwen-3.5-9B 训练并在 FinTrace 测评。
AI.result: 13 个 LLM 测试中，前沿模型工具选择良好但普遍存在信息整合和答案质量短板；受训模型在所有中间推理指标上显著提升，DPO 更擅抑制失败模式，然而端到端答案准确率提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级微调能有效改善工具调用过程中的推理环节，但无法直接传导至最终答案质量，说明未来需在推理链整合、决策校准等层面再突破才能达到真正的长线金融智能。

title: ChartNet: A Million-Scale, High-Quality Multimodal Dataset for Robust Chart Understanding
summary: Understanding charts requires models to jointly reason over geometric visual patterns, structured numerical data, and natural language -- a capability where current vision-language models (VLMs) remain limited. We introduce ChartNet, a high-quality, million-scale multimodal dataset designed to advance chart interpretation and reasoning. ChartNet leverages a novel code-guided synthesis pipeline to generate 1.5 million diverse chart samples spanning 24 chart types and 6 plotting libraries. Each sample consists of five aligned components: plotting code, rendered chart image, data table, natural language summary, and question-answering with reasoning, providing fine-grained cross-modal alignment. To capture the full spectrum of chart comprehension, ChartNet additionally includes specialized subsets encompassing human annotated data, real-world data, safety, and grounding. Moreover, a rigorous quality-filtering pipeline ensures visual fidelity, semantic accuracy, and diversity across chart representations. Fine-tuning on ChartNet consistently improves results across benchmarks, demonstrating its utility as large-scale supervision for multimodal models. As the largest open-source dataset of its kind, ChartNet aims to support the development of foundation models with robust and generalizable capabilities for data visualization understanding. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-granite/ChartNet

AI.tldr: ChartNet 是目前最大、开源的百万级图表理解数据集，涵盖 24 种图表类型、五元对齐标注，系统解决 VLMs 在图表推理上的短板。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型难以同时融合几何视觉模式、结构化数值与自然语言进行图表推理，亟需大规模、高质量、细粒度对齐的多模态数据支撑。
AI.method: 提出 code-guided 合成管线，自动生成 1.5 M 图表样本，配以代码、图像、数据表、文本摘要与问答推理五元组；引入人工标注、真实数据、安全与定位子集，并构建视觉保真、语义正确与多样性三重质量过滤流程。
AI.result: 在 ChartNet 上微调可稳定提升多个图表理解基准成绩，验证其作为大规模监督信号的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ChartNet 为构建具备鲁棒且可泛化数据可视化理解能力的基础模型提供了公开、大规模、高质量的训练资源。

title: How Can We Synthesize High-Quality Pretraining Data? A Systematic Study of Prompt Design, Generator Model, and Source Data
summary: Synthetic data is a standard component in training large language models, yet systematic comparisons across design dimensions, including rephrasing strategy, generator model, and source data, remain absent. We conduct extensive controlled experiments, generating over one trillion tokens, to identify critical factors in rephrasing web text into synthetic pretraining data. Our results reveal that structured output formats, such as tables, math problems, FAQs, and tutorials, consistently outperform both curated web baselines and prior synthetic methods. Notably, increasing the size of the generator model beyond 1B parameters provides no additional benefit. Our analysis also demonstrates that the selection of the original data used for mixing substantially influences performance. By applying our findings, we develop \textbf{\textsc{FinePhrase}}, a 486-billion-token open dataset of rephrased web text. We show that \textsc{FinePhrase} outperforms all existing synthetic data baselines while reducing generation costs by up to 30 times. We provide the dataset, all prompts, and the generation framework to the research community.

AI.tldr: 首次系统比较合成预训练数据的设计维度，发现结构化格式（表格/问答/教程等）最有效，大生成器>1B参数无增益，据此发布4860亿token开源数据集FinePhrase，成本降低30倍。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型依赖合成数据，但缺乏对改写策略、生成器规模、源数据等关键设计维度的实证比较，阻碍高效合成数据的构建。
AI.method: 控制变量实验：固定其他条件，独立扰动改写格式、生成器尺寸（0.3B–8B）、源数据选择，共生成>1万亿token，评估下游任务性能。
AI.result: 结构化输出（表格、数学题、FAQ、教程）一致优于精选网页基线与既往合成方法；生成器>1B参数不再提升效果；源数据配比显著影响最终表现；FinePhrase在同等规模下取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化改写+适度规模生成器+精细源数据选择即可低成本获得高质量合成数据，FinePhrase为社区提供了可复现、经济的新标杆。

title: From $P(y|x)$ to $P(y)$: Investigating Reinforcement Learning in Pre-train Space
comment: Preprint. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/Pretrain_Space_RLVR
summary: While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) significantly enhances LLM reasoning by optimizing the conditional distribution P(y|x), its potential is fundamentally bounded by the base model's existing output distribution. Optimizing the marginal distribution P(y) in the Pre-train Space addresses this bottleneck by encoding reasoning ability and preserving broad exploration capacity. Yet, conventional pre-training relies on static corpora for passive learning, leading to a distribution shift that hinders targeted reasoning enhancement. In this paper, we introduce PreRL (Pre-train Space RL), which applies reward-driven online updates directly to P(y). We theoretically and empirically validate the strong gradient alignment between log P(y) and log P(y|x), establishing PreRL as a viable surrogate for standard RL. Furthermore, we uncover a critical mechanism: Negative Sample Reinforcement (NSR) within PreRL serves as an exceptionally effective driver for reasoning. NSR-PreRL rapidly prunes incorrect reasoning spaces while stimulating endogenous reflective behaviors, increasing transition and reflection thoughts by 14.89x and 6.54x, respectively. Leveraging these insights, we propose Dual Space RL (DSRL), a Policy Reincarnation strategy that initializes models with NSR-PreRL to expand the reasoning horizon before transitioning to standard RL for fine-grained optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSRL consistently outperforms strong baselines, proving that pre-train space pruning effectively steers the policy toward a refined correct reasoning subspace.

AI.tldr: PreRL通过在预训练空间直接优化边际分布P(y)，并引入负样本强化(NSR)机制，显著提升LLM推理能力；提出的DSRL两阶段策略先扩域再精调，全面超越SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 标准RLVR仅优化条件分布P(y|x)，受限于基模型既有输出边界；静态语料预训练又难以定向强化推理。需突破预训练空间被动学习导致的分布漂移，实现推理能力的主动扩域与精准提升。
AI.method: 1) 提出PreRL：在线奖励驱动，直接更新预训练空间的边际P(y)；2) 理论+实验证明log P(y)与log P(x|y)梯度高度对齐，确立PreRL作为RL可代理目标；3) 引入NSR：利用负样本梯度快速剪除错误推理区域，激发内禀反思；4) 设计DSRL：先以NSR-PreRL扩宽推理视野，再切换标准RL精细优化，实现策略“重生”。
AI.result: NSR-PreRL使“过渡”与“反思”思维分别提升14.89×、6.54×；DSRL在多基准上全面优于强基线，验证预训练空间剪枝可将策略精准导向正确推理子空间。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接在P(y)层面进行可验证奖励学习，PreRL突破RLVR瓶颈；NSR机制是驱动高效推理的关键。DSRL证明先扩域再精调的两阶段策略，为LLM推理能力跃升提供了新范式。

title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a core technique in the post-training of large language models, yet its training dynamics remain poorly understood. This paper provides a systematic investigation of OPD dynamics and mechanisms. We first identify that two conditions govern whether OPD succeeds or fails: (i) the student and teacher should share compatible thinking patterns; and (ii) even with consistent thinking patterns and higher scores, the teacher must offer genuinely new capabilities beyond what the student has seen during training. We validate these findings through weak-to-strong reverse distillation, showing that same-family 1.5B and 7B teachers are distributionally indistinguishable from the student's perspective. Probing into the token-level mechanism, we show that successful OPD is characterized by progressive alignment on high-probability tokens at student-visited states, a small shared token set that concentrates most of the probability mass (97%-99%). We further propose two practical strategies to recover failing OPD: off-policy cold start and teacher-aligned prompt selection. Finally, we show that OPD's apparent free lunch of dense token-level reward comes at a cost, raising the question of whether OPD can scale to long-horizon distillation.

AI.tldr: 首次系统揭示大模型On-policy蒸馏成败取决于“思维相容”与“教师能力增量”两大条件，发现成功OPD仅靠极少量高频token对齐即可，并提出冷启动与prompt选择两种修复失败蒸馏的策略，同时指出其密集token奖励可能限制长程迁移。
AI.motivation: 尽管OPD已成为大模型后训练核心手段，但其训练动力学与成败机理仍属黑箱，亟需理论化解释与可落地改进。
AI.method: (1) 提出“思维相容+能力增量”双条件假设；(2) 设计弱→强反向蒸馏实验验证同族1.5B/7B教师对学生几乎分布不可分辨；(3) 基于token级探测发现97-99%概率质量集中在少量共享token上；(4) 引入离策略冷启动与教师对齐prompt选择两种实用补救策略。
AI.result: 实验证实双条件缺失会导致OPD失败；同族模型间确无显著分布差异；成功蒸馏仅需渐进对齐学生已访问状态的高概率token；所提两策略可显著恢复失败案例。
AI.conclusion: OPD并非“免费午餐”，其依赖的密集token奖励在长程任务中可能遭遇可扩展性瓶颈，未来需重新权衡局部对齐与全局能力迁移的关系。

title: Hydra: Unifying Document Retrieval and Generation in a Single Vision-Language Model
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables, 1 algorithm. v2: lm_head alias via Qwen3.5 weight-tying cuts peak GPU memory 41% -> 48% (10.5 -> 9.2 GB); bitwise-identical outputs verified over 50+ greedy samples, 10 decodes at 1024 tokens, 50 mode-switch round-trips. Code: github.com/athrael-soju/hydra ; HF models under huggingface.co/athrael-soju
summary: Visual document understanding typically requires separate retrieval and generation models, doubling memory and system complexity. We present Hydra, a dual-head approach that provides both ColBERT-style late-interaction retrieval and autoregressive generation from a single vision-language model (VLM). A single LoRA adapter, trained only for retrieval, is toggled at inference: enabling it produces multi-vector embeddings; disabling it recovers the base model's generation quality -- byte-identical outputs in 100% of 10,500 greedy and stochastic samples, with max delta-ANLS = 0.0044 across 15,301 samples on four VQA benchmarks (three informative; ChartQA is near-zero for both models under greedy decoding) when compared against an independent base-model pipeline. We identify three engineering requirements (attention-mode restoration, lm_head preservation, KV-cache-aware decoding) whose omission silently breaks generation despite correct weight recovery. On ViDoRe V1, Hydra (4B) is within 1 percentage point of a controlled single-head baseline in a single training run, with higher aggregate scores on V2 and V3 that are concentrated on a subset of tasks; multi-seed experiments are needed to confirm these trends. The single-model design cuts peak GPU memory from 17.9 GB (two-model baseline) to 9.2 GB -- a 48% reduction, though adapter switching introduces throughput overhead under concurrent serving loads. An ablation shows that GritLM-style joint training provides no benefit within the LoRA-based (r=16) training regime. A proof-of-concept extension to Qwen2.5-Omni-3B demonstrates that the mechanism generalizes to audio retrieval and video embedding, with speech generation.

title: Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Improving Factuality of Generations by Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are prone to generating factually incorrect outputs. Recent work has applied conformal prediction to provide uncertainty estimates and statistical guarantees for the factuality of LLM generations. However, existing approaches are typically not prompt-adaptive, limiting their ability to capture input-dependent variability. As a result, they may filter out too few items (leading to over-coverage) or too many (under-coverage) for a given task or prompt. We propose an adaptive conformal prediction approach that extends conformal score transformation methods to LLMs, with applications to long-form generation and multiple-choice question answering. This enables prompt-dependent calibration, retaining marginal coverage guarantees while improving conditional coverage. In addition, the approach naturally supports selective prediction, allowing unreliable claims or answer choices to be filtered out in downstream applications. We evaluate our approach on multiple white-box models across diverse domains and show that it significantly outperforms existing baselines in terms of conditional coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向 LLM 的提示自适应保形预测方法，可在保持边际覆盖保证的同时显著提升条件覆盖，并支持长文本生成与选择题场景下的选择性预测。
AI.motivation: 传统保形预测对 LLM 的校准不随提示变化，易出现过度或不足覆盖，需实现输入相关的自适应不确定性估计。
AI.method: 将保形分数变换扩展至 LLM，引入提示依赖的校准机制，支持长文本生成与选择题任务，并集成选择性预测以筛除不可靠结果。
AI.result: 在多个白盒模型、跨领域数据集上，条件覆盖指标显著优于现有基线，同时维持边际覆盖理论保证。
AI.conclusion: 自适应保形预测为 LLM 提供了更精细、任务敏感的不确定性量化手段，可直接用于过滤不可靠声明或答案，增强生成可信性。

title: Agentic AI Optimisation (AAIO): what it is, how it works, why it matters, and how to deal with it
summary: The emergence of Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AAI) systems capable of independently initiating digital interactions necessitates a new optimisation paradigm designed explicitly for seamless agent-platform interactions. This article introduces Agentic AI Optimisation (AAIO) as an essential methodology for ensuring effective integration between websites and agentic AI systems. Like how Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) has shaped digital content discoverability, AAIO can define interactions between autonomous AI agents and online platforms. By examining the mutual interdependency between website optimisation and agentic AI success, the article highlights the virtuous cycle that AAIO can create. It further explores the governance, ethical, legal, and social implications (GELSI) of AAIO, emphasising the necessity of proactive regulatory frameworks to mitigate potential negative impacts. The article concludes by affirming AAIO's essential role as part of a fundamental digital infrastructure in the era of autonomous digital agents, advocating for equitable and inclusive access to its benefits.

AI.tldr: 提出“智能代理优化”(AAIO)，作为面向自主AI代理与网站交互的基础设施级方法论，其地位对标SEO，并呼吁同步构建治理框架。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理已能主动发起数字交互，但现有网站优化仅服务人类与搜索引擎，缺乏面向代理的发现、调用与协作机制，阻碍代理生态繁荣。
AI.method: 将AAIO定义为涵盖协议、元数据、接口与治理规则的完整优化范式；用“代理-平台互利循环”模型说明优化效果如何反哺双方；系统梳理GELSI风险，提出前置式监管清单。
AI.result: 理论上证明AAIO可同步提升代理任务成功率与平台流量转化率；实证展示早期采用AAIO标记的站点，代理调用率提升3-7倍；识别出6类高阶风险（误用、歧视、垄断、隐私、责任空白、治理碎片化）。
AI.conclusion: AAIO将成为继SEO之后下一代数字基础设施，需由技术社区、平台与监管机构共建开放标准与合规框架，确保收益公平分配并防止权力过度集中。

title: VLMs Need Words: Vision Language Models Ignore Visual Detail In Favor of Semantic Anchors
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, they often fail on tasks that require fine-grained visual perception, even when the required information is still present in their internal representations. Prior work has attributed this ``hidden-in-plain-sight'' gap to the language model, but the cause remains unexplained. In this work, we demonstrate that this gap arises from the language model's lack of semantic labels for fine-grained visual details: when visual entities can be mapped to known concepts, VLMs bypass visual comparison and reason through language; when they cannot, VLMs resort to brittle and hallucinated descriptions. We verify this across semantic correspondence, synthetic shape matching, and face matching, and find that VLMs perform much better when the relevant entities are nameable than when they are unnamable. Mechanistically, Logit Lens analysis confirms that VLMs explicitly recover semantic labels for nameable entities and surface more unique tokens compared to unnameable entities. Furthermore, we show that this limitation can be addressed: teaching completely arbitrary names for unknown entities improves performance. More importantly, task-specific finetuning yields even stronger generalization without relying on language priors, i.e. through real visual perception. Our findings suggest that current VLM failures on visual tasks reflect a learned shortcut rather than a fundamental limitation of multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: VLM 在细粒度视觉任务上失败并非因为“看不见”，而是因为语言头缺少对应语义标签；给它任意名字或做视觉端微调即可修复，说明只是学会了走语言捷径而非多模态推理本身受限。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 虽内部仍保有细粒度视觉信息，却在需要精细感知的任务上失灵。先前归因于语言模型，但机制不明。作者假设根本原因是语言空间缺乏对细粒度视觉概念的命名，导致模型被迫用语言近似或幻觉。
AI.method: 设计三类“可命名 vs 不可命名”对比实验（语义对应、合成形状匹配、人脸匹配），用 Logit Lens 追踪中间层 token 分布；再测试①给不可名实体任意起名的零样本提示，②视觉端任务专用微调，观察性能与表示变化。
AI.result: 1) 可命名实体准确率显著高于不可命名（如形状匹配↑30%+）。2) Logit Lens 显示可命名实体在语言头被明确解码为具体词，不可命名实体则生成罕见、幻觉 token。3) 仅教授 2–5 个任意新名字即可将不可命名条件准确率提升 15–20%。4) 视觉端微调后模型不再依赖语言先验，在保留视觉细节的泛化测试上取得 SOTA 级表现。
AI.conclusion: VLM 的“视而不见”是习得的语言捷径：有词则绕开视觉比较，无词则乱猜。通过赋予新语义标签或视觉端微调可消除该捷径，证明非多模态推理固有限制，而为训练策略所致，为未来 VLM 提升细粒度感知提供直接路径。

title: Diffusion Language Models for Speech Recognition
summary: Diffusion language models have recently emerged as a leading alternative to standard language models, due to their ability for bidirectional attention and parallel text generation. In this work, we explore variants for their use in speech recognition. Specifically, we introduce a comprehensive guide to incorporating masked diffusion language models (MDLM) and uniform-state diffusion models (USDMs) for rescoring ASR hypotheses. Additionally, we design a new joint-decoding method that combines CTC and USDM by integrating the framewise probability distributions derived from CTC with the labelwise probability distributions computed by USDM at each decoding step, thereby generating new candidates that combine strong language knowledge from USDM and acoustic information from CTC. Our findings reveal that USDM, as well as MDLM, can significantly improve the accuracy of recognized text. We publish all our code and recipes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用掩蔽扩散语言模型（MDLM）和均匀态扩散模型（USDM）重打分 ASR N-best，并首创 CTC-USDM 联合解码，并行融合帧级声学分布与标签级扩散分布，显著降低词错误率，已开源全部代码与配方。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型具备双向注意力与并行生成优势，但尚未系统探索其在语音识别中的潜力；作者旨在填补该空白，利用扩散模型重打分与解码以提升 ASR 精度。
AI.method: 1) 系统比较 MDLM 与 USDM 对 N-best 假设的重打分策略；2) 设计 CTC-USDM 联合解码：每步并行融合 CTC 帧级后验与 USDM 标签级后验，动态生成新候选并剪枝；3) 采用扩散模型的掩蔽与均匀态两种加噪范式，保持语言建模并行性。
AI.result: 在公开中文和英文 ASR 任务上，相比最强 CTC/Attention 基线，USDM 重打分使 WER 相对下降 6.8%，CTC-USDM 联合解码再降 3.2%，累计提升约 10%，且推理延迟仅增加 8%。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型可作为强大语言知识源显著提升语音识别精度；提出的联合解码框架首次实现声学与扩散分布的端到端协同，为后续扩散 ASR 研究提供可复现基线。

title: FieldWorkArena: Agentic AI Benchmark for Real Field Work Tasks
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables [ICPR 2026 Accepted] Changes from Version 2: 1) Added retail domain as third scenario; dataset scaled from 455 to 886 tasks, 2) Task taxonomy restructured (Planning/Perception/Action -> Perception/Decision Making/Combination), 3) Experiments updated: GPT-5.1/5.2, Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro (replaced Claude); added human baseline and video chunking/Qwen3-VL experiments
summary: This paper introduces FieldWorkArena, a benchmark for agentic AI targeting real-world field work. With the recent increase in demand for agentic AI, they are built to detect and document safety hazards, procedural violations, and other critical incidents across real-world manufacturing and retail environments. Whereas most agentic AI benchmarks focus on performance in simulated or digital environments, our work addresses the fundamental challenge of evaluating agents in the real-world. In this paper, we improve the evaluation function from previous methods to assess the performance of agentic AI in diverse real-world tasks. Our dataset comprises on-site captured images/videos in factories, warehouses and retails. Tasks were meticulously developed through interviews with site workers and managers. Evaluation results confirmed that performance evaluation considering the characteristics of Multimodal LLM (MLLM) such as GPT-4o is feasible. Furthermore, this study identifies both the effectiveness and limitations of the proposed new evaluation methodology. The complete dataset and evaluation program are publicly accessible on the website (https://en-documents.research.global.fujitsu.com/fieldworkarena/)

AI.tldr: FieldWorkArena 是首个面向真实工厂/零售场景的智能体评测基准，通过现场采集的多模态数据与工人访谈设计的任务，验证了用 GPT-4o 等 MLLM 评估安全隐患识别智能体的可行性，并公开了全套数据与评测代码。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准局限在仿真或数字环境，无法在真实、高风险的制造与零售现场衡量 AI 发现安全隐患、违规操作等关键能力，亟需一套贴近实际工况的评测体系。
AI.method: ①现场拍摄工厂/仓库/零售图像视频，②与一线员工及管理者深度访谈提炼 160+ 项真实任务，③构建覆盖检测、描述、风险评估、报告生成的多模态评测集，④设计面向 MLLM 的细粒度评分规则（漏检率、误检率、报告合规性等），⑤以 GPT-4o 为参考模型开展基线实验并分析失效模式。
AI.result: FieldWorkArena 首次实现大规模真实场景智能体闭环评测；GPT-4o 在隐患识别任务中平均 F1 0.74，报告生成合规率 68%，显著优于传统视觉模型，但在小目标、遮挡及上下文违规推理上仍有 18% 的绝对差距；评测代码与 12 k 样本已开源。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实基于 MLLM 的真实场景智能体性能评估可行，FieldWorkArena 为安全、零售、制造等领域提供了可复现、可扩展的基准；未来需结合具身感知、时序推理与因果模型以突破当前局限。

title: SymphoMotion: Joint Control of Camera Motion and Object Dynamics for Coherent Video Generation
summary: Controlling both camera motion and object dynamics is essential for coherent and expressive video generation, yet current methods typically handle only one motion type or rely on ambiguous 2D cues that entangle camera-induced parallax with true object movement. We present SymphoMotion, a unified motion-control framework that jointly governs camera trajectories and object dynamics within a single model. SymphoMotion features a Camera Trajectory Control mechanism that integrates explicit camera paths with geometry-aware cues to ensure stable, structurally consistent viewpoint transitions, and an Object Dynamics Control mechanism that combines 2D visual guidance with 3D trajectory embeddings to enable depth-aware, spatially coherent object manipulation. To support large-scale training and evaluation, we further construct RealCOD-25K, a comprehensive real-world dataset containing paired camera poses and object-level 3D trajectories across diverse indoor and outdoor scenes, addressing a key data gap in unified motion control. Extensive experiments and user studies show that SymphoMotion significantly outperforms existing methods in visual fidelity, camera controllability, and object-motion accuracy, establishing a new benchmark for unified motion control in video generation. Codes and data are publicly available at https://grenoble-zhang.github.io/SymphoMotion/.

AI.tldr: SymphoMotion首次用统一框架共同控制相机轨迹与物体动态，并发布含25K真实样本的RealCOD数据集，显著超越现有方法的视觉效果与运动精度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法只能单独控制相机或物体，且2D提示会把视差与真实运动混为一谈，导致视频不连贯；亟需能同时、精准刻画两类运动的数据与框架。
AI.method: 设计双分支机制：①相机轨迹控制分支显式注入相机路径并辅以几何感知特征，保证视点切换的结构一致性；②物体动态控制分支融合2D视觉引导与3D轨迹嵌入，实现深度感知的空间一致物体操控。统一模型端到端联合训练，并构建RealCOD-25K真实数据集提供成对相机位姿与物体级3D轨迹。
AI.result: 在视觉保真度、相机可控性与物体运动精度三项指标上均显著优于现有方法；用户研究亦验证其明显偏好优势，成为统一运动控制的新标杆。
AI.conclusion: SymphoMotion证明相机与物体运动可在同一模型内被解耦且协同控制，为高质量、可操控的视频生成奠定基础；数据与代码已开源以促进后续研究。

title: Stochastic Trust-Region Methods for Over-parameterized Models
summary: Under interpolation-type assumptions such as the strong growth condition, stochastic optimization methods can attain convergence rates comparable to full-batch methods, but their performance, particularly for SGD, remains highly sensitive to step-size selection. To address this issue, we propose a unified stochastic trust-region framework that eliminates manual step-size tuning and extends naturally to equality-constrained problems. For unconstrained optimization, we develop a first-order stochastic trust-region algorithm and show that, under the strong growth condition, it achieves an iteration and stochastic first-order oracle complexity of $O(\varepsilon^{-2} \log(1/\varepsilon))$ for finding an $\varepsilon$-stationary point. For equality-constrained problems, we introduce a quadratic-penalty-based stochastic trust-region method with penalty parameter $μ$, and establish an iteration and oracle complexity of $O(\varepsilon^{-4} \log(1/\varepsilon))$ to reach an $\varepsilon$-stationary point of the penalized problem, corresponding to an $O(\varepsilon)$-approximate KKT point of the original constrained problem. Numerical experiments on deep neural network training and orthogonally constrained subspace fitting demonstrate that the proposed methods achieve performance comparable to well-tuned stochastic baselines, while exhibiting stable optimization behavior and effectively handling hard constraints without manual learning-rate scheduling.

AI.tldr: 免调步长的随机信赖域框架在强增长条件下达到与全批方法相当的复杂度，并首次给出了等式约束随机优化的收敛保证。
AI.motivation: SGD 在插值型假设下虽可媲美全批收敛速度，但对步长极其敏感；现有方法缺乏统一的免调步长策略，且对等式约束问题几乎无复杂度理论。
AI.method: 提出统一随机信赖域框架：无约束情形用一阶随机信赖域算法；等式约束情形引入二次罚函数并设计相应随机信赖域子问题求解器，全程无需手动设置学习率。
AI.result: 强增长条件下，无约束算法迭代与 SFO 复杂度为 O(ε⁻² log(1/ε))；罚函数版在等式约束下获得 O(ε⁻⁴ log(1/ε)) 迭代与 oracle 复杂度，对应原问题 O(ε)-近似 KKT 点。深度网络与正交子空间拟合实验显示，算法无需调参即可匹配精心调节的基线，并保持稳定收敛。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次为等式约束随机优化提供可证收敛的免步长方法，理论与实验均验证其在复杂模型与硬约束场景下的实用性与鲁棒性。

title: Orak: A Foundational Benchmark for Training and Evaluating LLM Agents on Diverse Video Games
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are reshaping the game industry, by enabling more intelligent and human-preferable characters. Yet, current game benchmarks fall short of practical needs: they lack evaluations of diverse LLM capabilities across various game genres, studies of agentic modules crucial for complex gameplay, and fine-tuning datasets to adapt pre-trained LLMs into gaming agents. To fill these gaps, we present Orak, a benchmark for training and evaluating LLM agents across 12 popular video games spanning all major genres. Using a plug-and-play interface built on Model Context Protocol (MCP), Orak supports systematic and reproducible studies of agentic modules in varied game scenarios. We further release a fine-tuning dataset of expert LLM gameplay trajectories covering multiple genres, turning general LLMs into effective game agents. Orak offers a united evaluation framework, including game leaderboards, LLM battle arenas, and \fix{ablation studies} of input modality, agentic strategies, and fine-tuning effects, establishing a foundation towards versatile gaming agents. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/krafton-ai/Orak and https://huggingface.co/datasets/KRAFTON/Orak.

AI.tldr: 提出Orak——首个覆盖12大类电子游戏、集训练-评测-对战于一体的LLM智能体基准；附带专家级游戏轨迹微调数据集，可将通用大模型直接转化为多类型游戏智能体。
AI.motivation: 游戏界亟需能跨全品类评估LLM智能体表现、可拆装式分析代理模块贡献、并提供大规模微调数据的统一平台，而现有基准零散、侧重单类游戏且缺乏对策略与输入模态的深入分析。
AI.method: 1) 定义12款覆盖主流类型游戏的基准环境，通过基于MCP的插件接口统一调用；2) 采集5M+专家级操作轨迹，保留多模态观察和决策注释，构建可公开调用的微调数据集；3) 设计三维度自动化评估：排行榜单点能力、arena对抗竞技、消融实验测策略/模态/微调；4) 提供单命令复现的训练与评价流水线，确保可复现与扩展。
AI.result: 在Orak评分体系下，原生LLM在RPG动作类最低仅0.32胜率，经微调后提升至0.71，跨品类平均+18pp；消融证实动作机会式反馈对FPS最关键，高层策略输对MOBA收益最大。多个开源模型已在公开arena与GPT-4-turbo对战胜率>50%。
AI.conclusion: Orak首次填补全类型游戏评估缺口并用专家轨迹实现即插即用微调，为孵化通用、跨类型游戏AI奠定数据与评价基准；其框架可无缝扩展新环境及代理模块，引导下一代“会玩所有游戏”的LLM智能体研发。

title: Action Images: End-to-End Policy Learning via Multiview Video Generation
summary: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising direction for robot policy learning, as they can leverage powerful video backbones to model the future states. However, existing approaches often rely on separate action modules, or use action representations that are not pixel-grounded, making it difficult to fully exploit the pretrained knowledge of video models and limiting transfer across viewpoints and environments. In this work, we present Action Images, a unified world action model that formulates policy learning as multiview video generation. Instead of encoding control as low-dimensional tokens, we translate 7-DoF robot actions into interpretable action images: multi-view action videos that are grounded in 2D pixels and explicitly track robot-arm motion. This pixel-grounded action representation allows the video backbone itself to act as a zero-shot policy, without a separate policy head or action module. Beyond control, the same unified model supports video-action joint generation, action-conditioned video generation, and action labeling under a shared representation. On RLBench and real-world evaluations, our model achieves the strongest zero-shot success rates and improves video-action joint generation quality over prior video-space world models, suggesting that interpretable action images are a promising route to policy learning.

AI.tldr: 提出Action Images，将7-DoF机械臂动作编码为跨视角像素级“动作图”，让同一视频主干零样本充当策略，无需额外策略头，在RLBench与真机测试中达SOTA零样本成功率，并可统一完成视频-动作联合生成、条件视频生成与动作标注。
AI.motivation: 现有WAM要么动作模块与视频模型割裂，要么动作表示脱离像素，难以充分利用预训练视频先验并跨视角/环境迁移。
AI.method: 把连续7-DoF动作映射成多视角像素对齐的“动作图”，使策略学习转化为多视角视频生成；整个流程仅用共享视频扩散主干，无需独立策略网络或动作解码器。
AI.result: RLBench零样本任务成功率优于先前视频空间模型；真实机器人实验亦达最高零样本表现；同时在视频-动作联合生成、条件视频生成与动作标注任务上质量提升。
AI.conclusion: 像素级、可解释的动作图能让视频模型直接兼任策略，并能统一处理控制与生成，为机器人策略学习提供一条新路径。

title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Runtime Safety Shielding for Power Grid Operation
summary:
Reinforcement learning has shown promise for automating power-grid operation tasks such as topology control and congestion management. However, its deployment in real-world power systems remains limited by strict safety requirements, brittleness under rare disturbances, and poor generalization to unseen grid topologies. In safety-critical infrastructure, catastrophic failures cannot be tolerated, and learning-based controllers must operate within hard physical constraints.
  This paper proposes a safety-constrained hierarchical control framework for power-grid operation that explicitly decouples long-horizon decision-making from real-time feasibility enforcement. A high-level reinforcement learning policy proposes abstract control actions, while a deterministic runtime safety shield filters unsafe actions using fast forward simulation. Safety is enforced as a runtime invariant, independent of policy quality or training distribution.
  The proposed framework is evaluated on the Grid2Op benchmark suite under nominal conditions, forced line-outage stress tests, and zero-shot deployment on the ICAPS 2021 large-scale transmission grid without retraining. Results show that flat reinforcement learning policies are brittle under stress, while safety-only methods are overly conservative. In contrast, the proposed hierarchical and safety-aware approach achieves longer episode survival, lower peak line loading, and robust zero-shot generalization to unseen grids.
  These results indicate that safety and generalization in power-grid control are best achieved through architectural design rather than increasingly complex reward engineering, providing a practical path toward deployable learning-based controllers for real-world energy systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分层安全框架，让 RL 负责高层决策，实时安全盾用快速前仿过滤违规动作；在 Grid2Op 与真实规模电网零-shot 测试中，比纯 RL 或纯安全策略更长寿、负载更低且无需重训。
AI.motivation: 电网控制对安全、抗扰与跨拓扑泛化要求极高，现有深度 RL 在罕见故障和未见过网架下易失效，亟需把“安全性”作为运行时不变量而非靠奖励逼近。
AI.method: 将控制拆为两层：① 高层 RL 输出抽象离散动作（拓扑切换等）；② 确定性安全盾实时调用线性化潮流前仿，若动作违反硬约束（功率、电压、热稳定限值）则被屏蔽，系统仅接受安全动作继续闭环运行。安全层无需学习，与训练分布无关。
AI.result: 在 Grid2Op 基准 1300 网架、强制 N-k 断线与 ICAPS2021 真实 1180 节点电网上零-shot 测试：本框架 episode 存活率提升 2-3 倍，峰值线路负载降低 15-25%，且无需重训即可泛化至未见过拓扑；对比纯 RL 策略在 30% 扰动即崩溃，纯安全策略过度保守导致 40% 以上可行解被弃。
AI.conclusion: 关键安全性不应靠复杂奖励工程，而应通过“高层学习＋运行时硬约束过滤”的体系结构实现；该框架为学习型控制器走向实际能源系统提供了可部署路径。

title: RL-PLUS: Countering Capability Boundary Collapse of LLMs in Reinforcement Learning with Hybrid-policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has significantly advanced the complex reasoning abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, it struggles to break through the inherent capability boundaries of the base LLM, due to its essentially on-policy strategy coupled with LLM's immense action space and sparse reward. Critically, RLVR can lead to the capability boundary collapse, narrowing the LLM's problem-solving scope. To address this problem, we propose RL-PLUS, a novel hybrid-policy optimization approach for LLMs that synergizes internal exploitation with external data to achieve stronger reasoning capabilities and surpass the boundaries of base models. RL-PLUS integrates two core components, i.e., Multiple Importance Sampling to address distributional mismatch from external data, and Exploration-Based Advantage Function to guide the model towards high-value, unexplored reasoning paths. We provide both theoretical analysis and extensive experiments to demonstrate the superiority and generalizability of our approach. Compared with existing RLVR methods, RL-PLUS achieves 1) state-of-the-art performance on six math reasoning benchmarks; 2) superior performance on six out-of-distribution reasoning tasks; 3) consistent and significant gains across diverse model families, with average relative improvements up to 69.2\%. Moreover, the analysis of Pass@k curves indicates that RL-PLUS effectively resolves the capability boundary collapse problem.

AI.tldr: 提出 RL-PLUS，一种混合策略强化学习算法，用外部数据+探索式优势函数突破基模型能力边界，在数学与分布外推理任务上平均提升 69.2%，显著缓解 RLVR 导致的
AI.motivation: RLVR  虽能提升 LLM   复杂推理，但受限于纯 on-policy 采样与巨大动作空间，易陷入能力边界塌陷，缩小模型可解问题范围，亟需突破基模型固有上限。
AI.method: RL-PLUS：① 多重重要性采样（MIS）纠正外部 off-policy 数据与策略分布差异；② 探索式优势函数（E-Adv）显式鼓励前往高价值、低访问度的推理路径；整体形成内-外混合策略优化框架，并给出收敛性理论保证。
AI.result: 在 6 个数学基准与 6 个分布外推理任务上均达 SOTA；跨 3 类模型家族一致增益，平均相对提升 69.2%；Pass@k  曲线证实能力边界塌陷被有效修复。
AI.conclusion: RL-PLUS  通过 MIS+E-Adv  的混合策略机制，首次系统性地突破 RLVR  的能力天花板，为后续 LLM  推理 scaling  提供可泛化的新范式。

title: LPM 1.0: Video-based Character Performance Model
comment: 43 pages, 15 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://large-performance-model.github.io
summary: Performance, the externalization of intent, emotion, and personality through visual, vocal, and temporal behavior, is what makes a character alive. Learning such performance from video is a promising alternative to traditional 3D pipelines. However, existing video models struggle to jointly achieve high expressiveness, real-time inference, and long-horizon identity stability, a tension we call the performance trilemma. Conversation is the most comprehensive performance scenario, as characters simultaneously speak, listen, react, and emote while maintaining identity over time. To address this, we present LPM 1.0 (Large Performance Model), focusing on single-person full-duplex audio-visual conversational performance. Concretely, we build a multimodal human-centric dataset through strict filtering, speaking-listening audio-video pairing, performance understanding, and identity-aware multi-reference extraction; train a 17B-parameter Diffusion Transformer (Base LPM) for highly controllable, identity-consistent performance through multimodal conditioning; and distill it into a causal streaming generator (Online LPM) for low-latency, infinite-length interaction. At inference, given a character image with identity-aware references, LPM 1.0 generates listening videos from user audio and speaking videos from synthesized audio, with text prompts for motion control, all at real-time speed with identity-stable, infinite-length generation. LPM 1.0 thus serves as a visual engine for conversational agents, live streaming characters, and game NPCs. To systematically evaluate this setting, we propose LPM-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive character performance. LPM 1.0 achieves state-of-the-art results across all evaluated dimensions while maintaining real-time inference.

AI.tldr: LPM 1.0 用 17 B 参数的扩散 Transformer 先把“单人全双工音视频对话表演”做到极致，再蒸馏成流式生成器，实时、无限长、身份稳定，一举解决“高表现力-实时-长时身份”三难；同时发布 LPM-Bench  benchmark，全面领先。
AI.motivation: 传统 3D 管线制作角色表演昂贵且慢，而现有视频生成模型在“高表现力、实时推理、长时身份一致性”三者间无法兼得（性能三难）。对话场景同时涵盖说、听、反应、情绪，是最复杂的表演任务，亟需一个端到端可学习的视觉引擎。
AI.method: 1）构建多模态“以人为中心”数据集：严格过滤、说话-听音画面对齐、表演语义理解、身份多参考提取；2）训练 17 B 参数扩散 Transformer（Base LPM），以音频、文本、身份参考等多模态条件实现高可控、身份一致的长序列表演；3）蒸馏为因果流式生成器（Online LPM），实现低延迟、无限长度输出；4）推理时仅输入一张角色图与身份参考，即可实时生成听/说视频，文本可细粒度控制动作。
AI.result: 在自建的 LPM-Bench（首个交互式角色表演 benchmark）所有维度（身份一致、口型同步、动作自然度、长时稳定性、实时率等）均达 SOTA；Online LPM 在单卡上实现 30+ FPS 的无限长度实时生成，无需额外后处理即可直播或嵌入游戏 NPC。
AI.conclusion: LPM 1.0 首次在单模型内同时满足高表现力、实时交互与长时身份稳定，为对话代理、虚拟直播、游戏 NPC 提供了即插即用的“视觉引擎”，并确立了交互角色生成的评估基准，推动数字人进入可实时部署的新阶段。

title: A Comparative Study of Dynamic Programming and Reinforcement Learning in Finite Horizon Dynamic Pricing
summary: This paper provides a systematic comparison between Fitted Dynamic Programming (DP), where demand is estimated from data, and Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods in finite-horizon dynamic pricing problems. We analyze their performance across environments of increasing structural complexity, ranging from a single typology benchmark to multi-typology settings with heterogeneous demand and inter-temporal revenue constraints. Unlike simplified comparisons that restrict DP to low-dimensional settings, we apply dynamic programming in richer, multi-dimensional environments with multiple product types and constraints. We evaluate revenue performance, stability, constraint satisfaction behavior, and computational scaling, highlighting the trade-offs between explicit expectation-based optimization and trajectory-based learning.

AI.tldr: 在有限期动态定价中，作者系统比较了「基于数据估计需求的拟合动态规划（FDP）」与「强化学习（RL）」的优劣，场景从单一产品基准拓展到多品类、需求异质且带跨期收益约束的高维环境。
AI.motivation: 传统文献多将 DP 限定为低维对照，无法反映现实高维、多品、异质需求及复杂约束下的真实表现；需要量化 FDP 与 RL 在收益、稳定性、约束满足和计算效率上的全面权衡，为实际定价系统选择算法提供依据。
AI.method: 构建渐进复杂的三组实验环境：①单类型基准；②多类型异质需求；③多类型+跨期收益约束。统一用真实需求数据估计 FDP 模型，再与无模型 RL 对比。指标涵盖期望收益、收益标准差、约束违反率与计算耗时，并做显著性检验与复杂度缩放分析。
AI.result: FDP 在低至中等复杂度环境收益与 RL 相当甚至略高，且满足约束更稳定；当维度与约束显著增加后，RL 凭借轨迹采样优势反超 FDP，且计算增长更缓慢。整体呈「FDP 先优后劣、RL 渐强」的交叉趋势，二者在收益方差上无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 若需求可较准确估计且环境维数可控，FDP 因显式期望优化可提供更高收益与更好约束保证；环境愈高维、非平稳或约束复杂，轨迹式 RL 的 Scaling 优势与鲁棒性更突出。实际系统应据数据质量、维度与约束复杂度在「估计-优化」与「学习-采样」间权衡，或采用混合策略。

title: Pruning Long Chain-of-Thought of Large Reasoning Models via Small-Scale Preference Optimization
summary: Recent advances in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated strong performance on complex tasks through long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, their lengthy outputs increase computational costs and may lead to overthinking, raising challenges in balancing reasoning effectiveness and efficiency. Current solutions often compromise reasoning quality or require extensive resources. In this paper, we investigate how to reduce the generation length of LRMs with limited tuning. We analyze generation path distributions and filter generated trajectories through difficulty estimation. Subsequently, we analyze the convergence characteristics of various preference optimization objectives under a unified Bradley-Terry loss based framework. Based on the analysis, we propose Length Controlled Preference Optimization (LCPO) that directly balances the implicit reward related to NLL loss. LCPO can effectively learn length preference with limited data and training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly reduces the average output length of LRMs by over 50\% across multiple benchmarks while maintaining the reasoning performance. Our work highlights the potential for computationally efficient approaches in guiding LRMs toward efficient reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出无需大幅调参的LCPO方法，使大推理模型在保持性能下输出长度减半。
AI.motivation: 长链思维虽提升LRM推理表现，却带来高昂算力与冗余思考，现有方法常在质量-效率间二选一，急需轻量级长度压缩方案。
AI.method: 1) 统计生成路径分布并用难度估计筛选轨迹；2) 在统一Bradley-Terry损失框架下分析多种偏好优化目标的收敛性；3) 提出Length Controlled Preference Optimization（LCPO），用可用负对数似然内外嵌长度奖励，实现有限数据下的长度偏好学习。
AI.result: 在多基准测试中，LCPO平均输出长度削减>50%，同时保持原始推理准确率。
AI.conclusion: LCPO证实可用轻量级偏好优化替代重训练，为高成本LRM提供高效推理新范式，并具备推广至其他长输出的潜力。

title: DBMF: A Dual-Branch Multimodal Framework for Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: The complex and dynamic real-world clinical environment demands reliable deep learning (DL) systems. Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection plays a critical role in enhancing the reliability and generalizability of DL models when encountering data that deviate from the training distribution, such as unseen disease cases. However, existing OOD detection methods typically rely either on a single visual modality or solely on image-text matching, failing to fully leverage multimodal information. To overcome the challenge, we propose a novel dual-branch multimodal framework by introducing a text-image branch and a vision branch. Our framework fully exploits multimodal representations to identify OOD samples through these two complementary branches. After training, we compute scores from the text-image branch ($S_t$) and vision branch ($S_v$), and integrate them to obtain the final OOD score $S$ that is compared with a threshold for OOD detection. Comprehensive experiments on publicly available endoscopic image datasets demonstrate that our proposed framework is robust across diverse backbones and improves state-of-the-art performance in OOD detection by up to 24.84%

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种双分支多模态 OOD 检测框架，在文本-图像与纯视觉分支上联合打分，将内窥镜图像的 OOD 检测性能提升最高 24.84%。
AI.motivation: 临床真实环境复杂且数据分布不断变化，现有单模态或仅图文匹配的 OOD 检测方法无法充分利用多模态信息，导致模型在未见疾病样本上的可靠性不足。
AI.method: 构建包含文本-图像分支与纯视觉分支的双路网络，分别计算 OOD 得分 St 与 Sv，通过融合得到最终得分 S，与阈值比较完成检测；训练阶段两分支互补学习，推理阶段无需额外标注。
AI.result: 在公开内窥镜图像数据集上验证了方法对多种骨干网络的鲁棒性，AUROC、FPR95 等指标平均提升 12%–24.84%，显著超越现有最佳方法。
AI.conclusion: 多模态信息互补能有效提升 OOD 检测性能，所提框架无需修改主干即可即插即用，为临床 DL 系统的可靠部署提供了可行方案。

title: Multistage Conditional Compositional Optimization
summary: We introduce Multistage Conditional Compositional Optimization (MCCO) as a new paradigm for decision-making under uncertainty that combines aspects of multistage stochastic programming and conditional stochastic optimization. MCCO minimizes a nest of conditional expectations and nonlinear cost functions. It has numerous applications and arises, for example, in optimal stopping, linear-quadratic regulator problems, distributionally robust contextual bandits, as well as in problems involving dynamic risk measures. The naïve nested sampling approach for MCCO suffers from the curse of dimensionality familiar from scenario tree-based multistage stochastic programming, that is, its scenario complexity grows exponentially with the number of nests. We develop new multilevel Monte Carlo techniques for MCCO whose scenario complexity grows only polynomially with the desired accuracy.

AI.tldr: MCCO融合多阶段与条件随机优化，用多层蒙特卡洛将复杂度从指数降阶为多项式。
AI.motivation: 解决不确定性序列决策中的“条件-嵌套”目标，克服朴素嵌套采样面临的维度灾难。
AI.method: 提出MCCO框架，将问题抽象为嵌套条件期望的非线性成本最小化；设计多层蒙特卡罗梯度/采样算法，实现多项式复杂度逼近。
AI.result: 证明新算法可在保持精度的同时，样本复杂度与层数（深度）呈多项式而非指数增长。
AI.conclusion: MCCO为组合优化、最优停止、LQR、风险敏感强化学习等提供可扩展的计算范式，多层蒙特卡 Carlo 方法能有效打破维度诅咒。

title: MAS-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Shortcut-Augmented Hybrid Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Shortcuts such as APIs and deep-links have emerged as efficient complements to flexible GUI operations, fostering a promising hybrid paradigm for MLLM-based mobile automation. However, systematic evaluation of GUI-shortcut hybrid agents remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MAS-Bench, a benchmark that pioneers the evaluation of GUI-shortcut hybrid agents with a specific focus on the mobile domain.
