Beyond merely using predefined shortcuts, MAS-Bench assesses an agent's capability to autonomously generate shortcuts by discovering and creating reusable, low-cost workflows. It features 139 complex tasks across 11 real-world applications, a knowledge base of 88 predefined shortcuts (APIs, deep-links, RPA scripts), and 9 evaluation metrics. Experiments demonstrate that hybrid agents achieve up to 68.3% success rate and 39% greater execution efficiency than GUI-only counterparts. Furthermore, our evaluation framework effectively reveals the quality gap between predefined and agent-generated shortcuts, validating its capability to assess shortcut generation methods. MAS-Bench addresses the lack of systematic benchmarks for GUI-shortcut hybrid mobile agents, providing a foundational platform for future advancements in creating more efficient and robust intelligent agents. Project page: https://pengxiang-zhao.github.io/MAS-Bench.

AI.tldr: MAS-Bench 首次系统评估「GUI-快捷方式」混合智能体在移动端的性能，发现其成功率可达 68.3%，效率比纯 GUI 提升 39%，并提供 139 项真实任务与 88 条现成快捷方式作为基准。
AI.motivation: 快捷方式（API、深度链接、RPA 脚本）能显著降低移动端 GUI 自动化成本，但缺乏统一基准衡量「混合操作 vs 纯 GUI」与「智能体自生成快捷方式」的优劣。
AI.method: 构建 MAS-Bench：(1) 收集 11 款主流 App 共 139 条高复杂度任务；(2) 建立含 88 条现成快捷方式的知识库；(3) 设计 9 维评估体系（含成功率、效率、快捷方式质量等）；(4) 让混合智能体先选/生成快捷方式，再 fallback 到 GUI 操作完成闭环。
AI.result: 混合智能体在 MAS-Bench 上最高成功率 68.3%，平均执行时间比纯 GUI 智能体缩短 39%；评估框架还能量化「现成」与「智能体自动生成」快捷方式的差距，表明自生成质量普遍低于现成 22–34%。
AI.conclusion: MAS-Bench 填补了 GUI-快捷方式混合移动智能体评估空白，为后续提升自生成快捷方式算法、构建更鲁棒高效的自动化智能体提供了可复现的基准平台。

title: Detecting Diffusion-generated Images via Dynamic Assembly Forests
summary: Diffusion models are known for generating high-quality images, causing serious security concerns. To combat this, most efforts rely on deep neural networks (e.g., CNNs and Transformers), while largely overlooking the potential of traditional machine learning models. In this paper, we freshly investigate such alternatives and proposes a novel Dynamic Assembly Forest model (DAF) to detect diffusion-generated images. Built upon the deep forest paradigm, DAF addresses the inherent limitations in feature learning and scalable training, making it an effective diffusion-generated image detector. Compared to existing DNN-based methods, DAF has significantly fewer parameters, much lower computational cost, and can be deployed without GPUs, while achieving competitive performance under standard evaluation protocols. These results highlight the strong potential of the proposed method as a practical substitute for heavyweight DNN models in resource-constrained scenarios. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/OUC-VAS/DAF.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于传统机器学习的轻量级扩散图生成检测器 DAF，无需 GPU 即可在参数、算力和性能上与主流深度模型竞争。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型生成图像质量高，带来严重安全威胁；现有检测器几乎全依赖 CNN/Transformer 等重型深度网络，忽视传统模型潜力，亟需低资源替代方案。
AI.method: 设计 Dynamic Assembly Forest（DAF）：以深度森林范式为基础，引入动态特征重组与层级集成机制，弥补传统树模型特征表达弱、难扩展的缺陷，实现端到端扩散图检测。
AI.result: 在标准协议下，DAF 参数量与计算量显著低于现有 DNN 方法，无需 GPU 即可达到可比检测精度，验证其在资源受限场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DAF 证明传统机器学习经适当设计可成为深度模型的实用替代品，为扩散图检测提供轻量、高效、易部署的新思路。

title: ID and Graph View Contrastive Learning with Multi-View Attention Fusion for Sequential Recommendation
summary:
Sequential recommendation has become increasingly prominent in both academia and industry, particularly in e-commerce. The primary goal is to extract user preferences from historical interaction sequences and predict items a user is likely to engage with next. Recent advances have leveraged contrastive learning and graph neural networks to learn more expressive representations from interaction histories -- graphs capture relational structure between nodes, while ID-based representations encode item-specific information. However, few studies have explored multi-view contrastive learning between ID and graph perspectives to jointly improve user and item representations, especially in settings where only interaction data is available without auxiliary information.
  To address this gap, we propose Multi-View Contrastive learning for sequential recommendation (MVCrec), a framework that integrates complementary signals from both sequential (ID-based) and graph-based views. MVCrec incorporates three contrastive objectives: within the sequential view, within the graph view, and across views. To effectively fuse the learned representations, we introduce a multi-view attention fusion module that combines global and local attention mechanisms to estimate the likelihood of a target user purchasing a target item. Comprehensive experiments on five real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that MVCrec consistently outperforms 11 state-of-the-art baselines, achieving improvements of up to 14.44\% in NDCG@10 and 9.22\% in HitRatio@10 over the strongest baseline. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/sword-Lz/MMCrec.

AI.tldr: 提出MVCrec，首次在仅交互数据下实现序列(ID)与图双视角的多视图对比学习，显著超越11个SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 现有序列推荐虽分别利用对比学习与图神经网络，但缺乏在仅交互数据条件下融合ID与图双视角的多视图对比学习，难以充分挖掘用户-物品信号。
AI.method: 构建MVCrec框架，设计序列内、图内、跨视图三类对比学习目标，并引入全局-局部注意力融合模块，将双视角表征融合后预测下一物品。
AI.result: 在5个真实数据集上，NDCG@10最高提升14.44%，HitRatio@10提升9.22%，且一致优于11个最新基线。
AI.conclusion: 多视图对比学习可有效集成序列与图互补信号，显著提升纯交互场景下的序列推荐性能，代码与数据已开源。

title: ProRe: A Proactive Reward System for GUI Agents via Reasoner-Actor Collaboration
summary: Reward is critical to the evaluation and training of large language models (LLMs). However, existing rule-based or model-based reward methods struggle to generalize to GUI agents, where access to ground-truth trajectories or application databases is often unavailable, and static trajectory-based LLM-as-a-Judge approaches suffer from limited accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose ProRe, a proactive reward system that leverages a general-purpose reasoner and domain-specific evaluator agents (actors). The reasoner schedules targeted state probing tasks, which the evaluator agents then execute by actively interacting with the environment to collect additional observations. This enables the reasoner to assign more accurate and verifiable rewards to GUI agents. Empirical results on over 3K trajectories demonstrate that ProRe improves reward accuracy and F1 score by up to 5.3\% and 19.4\%, respectively. Furthermore, integrating ProRe with state-of-the-art policy agents yields a success rate improvement of up to 22.4\%. The source code is available at https://github.com/V-Droid-Agent/ProRe.

AI.tldr: ProRe 以通用推理器＋专用评估者协同探查环境，为无需真值轨迹的 GUI 智能体提供可验证奖励，显著提升奖励准确率和策略成功率。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体的奖励依赖真值轨迹或应用数据库往往不可得；规则/模型奖励泛化差，静态 LLM-as-a-Judge 判别不准。
AI.method: 提出 ProRe：推理器主动生成状态探查任务；领域专用评估者（actor）与真实应用交互采样附加观测；推理器基于新观测计算可验证奖励并反馈给智能体。
AI.result: 在 3K+ GUI 轨迹上，ProRe 相较基线奖励准确率最高提升 5.3%，F1 提升 19.4%；与 SoTA 策略智能体结合，任务成功率平均提升 22.4%。
AI.conclusion: ProRe 证明通过让奖励系统主动探查环境即可获得无真值、高可信的 GUI 奖励信号，兼具通用性与可扩展性，源码已开源。

title: Grid2Matrix: Revealing Digital Agnosia in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel on many multimodal reasoning benchmarks, but these evaluations often do not require an exhaustive readout of the image and can therefore obscure failures in faithfully capturing all visual details. We introduce Grid2Matrix (G2M), a controlled benchmark in which a model is shown a color grid and a color-to-number mapping, and must output the corresponding matrix. By varying grid size and the number of colors, G2M provides a simple way to increase visual complexity while minimizing semantic confounds. We find that VLMs exhibit a sharp early collapse in zero-shot end-to-end evaluation, failing on surprisingly small grids rather than degrading gradually as the task becomes denser. We probe the visual encoders of VLMs from two representative families and find that they preserve substantially more of the grid information than the corresponding end-to-end outputs. This suggests that the failure is not explained by visual encoding alone, but also reflects a gap between what remains recoverable from visual features and what is ultimately expressed in language. We term this gap \textit{Digital Agnosia}. Further analyses show that these errors are highly structured and depend strongly on how grid cells overlap with visual patch boundaries. We also find that common strategies such as model scaling and multimodal alignment do not fully eliminate this failure mode. We expect G2M to serve as a useful testbed for understanding where and how VLMs lose fine visual details, and for evaluating tasks where missing even small visual details can matter, such as tables, charts, forms, and GUIs.

AI.tldr: 作者提出Grid2Matrix基准，发现主流VLM在只需“读图填数”的纯色格子任务中会突然崩溃；视觉编码器其实保留了足够信息，但模型无法在语言端还原，形成“Digital Agnosia”。这一失效与patch边界高度相关，且放大模型或对齐训练都不能根治。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态推理基准往往只需抓住图像大意，不足以暴露VLM对细粒度视觉信息的遗漏；需一个可控、语义干扰最小、能系统提升视觉复杂度的任务，来精确诊断“读不全图”的弱点。
AI.method: 设计G2M任务：给模型一张彩色格图+色-数对照表，要求其输出对应数字矩阵；通过改变格子尺寸与颜色数量连续调节视觉密度。对两类代表性VLM家族进行零样本端到端测试，并单独探针其视觉编码器可比信息保留度；进一步分析错误结构与patch边界关系，验证模型放大和多模态对齐的缓解效果。
AI.result: VLM性能随格子密度增加呈“早期断崖”而非渐进下降，远早于编码器信息极限；编码特征仍可复原大部分格子，但语言输出严重缺失，证实存在Digital Agnosia。错误呈结构性，集中在patch边界处；放大参数量或增强图文对齐无法彻底消除该失效模式。
AI.conclusion: Digital Agnosia揭示VLM“看得见却说不清”的瓶颈，根源在视觉-语言转化阶段而非视觉编码。G2M为细粒度视觉忠实的诊断与改进提供了简洁而可扩展的试验台，对表格、图表、表单、GUI等容错极低的真实场景具有预警价值。

title: Rhetorical Questions in LLM Representations: A Linear Probing Study
summary: Rhetorical questions are asked not to seek information but to persuade or signal stance. How large language models internally represent them remains unclear. We analyze rhetorical questions in LLM representations using linear probes on two social-media datasets with different discourse contexts, and find that rhetorical signals emerge early and are most stably captured by last-token representations. Rhetorical questions are linearly separable from information-seeking questions within datasets, and remain detectable under cross-dataset transfer, reaching AUROC around 0.7-0.8. However, we demonstrate that transferability does not simply imply a shared representation. Probes trained on different datasets produce different rankings when applied to the same target corpus, with overlap among the top-ranked instances often below 0.2. Qualitative analysis shows that these divergences correspond to distinct rhetorical phenomena: some probes capture discourse-level rhetorical stance embedded in extended argumentation, while others emphasize localized, syntax-driven interrogative acts. Together, these findings suggest that rhetorical questions in LLM representations are encoded by multiple linear directions emphasizing different cues, rather than a single shared direction.

AI.tldr: 线性探针揭示大模型对修辞疑问句存在“多方向”编码，跨语料可迁移性中等，但不同语料诱导的方向捕获的修辞现象各异。
AI.motivation: 尚不清楚大模型如何在内部区分“为劝说/立场”而非“为求信息”的修辞疑问句，需查明其神经表征机制与跨语境一致性。
AI.method: 在两个社交媒体语料上训练线性探针，比较末位token表示，测线性可分性、跨数据集迁移 AUROC，并以定性与排序重叠度分析探针学到之方向差异。
AI.result: 1) 修辞信号在浅层已浮现，末位表示最稳定；2) 同数据集内线性感知强，迁移 AUROC 0.7–0.8；3) 不同语料探针对同批数据排序重叠 <0.2，分别对应“篇章级立场”与“局部句法疑问”两类修辞现象。
AI.conclusion: 修辞疑问句在大模型中并非由单一共享方向表征，而是沿多条线性方向编码不同维度线索；迁移能力源于部分共享特征，而非完全相同表示。

title: Formalizing the Safety, Security, and Functional Properties of Agentic AI Systems
summary: Agentic AI systems, which leverage multiple autonomous agents and large language models (LLMs), are increasingly used to address complex, multi-step tasks. The safety, security, and functionality of these systems are critical, especially in high-stakes applications. However, the current ecosystem of inter-agent communication is fragmented, with protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool access and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol for coordination being analyzed in isolation. This fragmentation creates a semantic gap that prevents the rigorous analysis of system properties and introduces risks such as architectural misalignment and exploitable coordination issues. To address these challenges, we introduce a modeling framework for agentic AI systems composed of two central models: (1) the host agent model formalizes the top-level entity that interacts with the user, decomposes tasks, and orchestrates their execution by leveraging external agents and tools; (2) the task lifecycle model details the states and transitions of individual sub-tasks from creation to completion, providing a fine-grained view of task management and error handling. Together, these models provide a unified semantic framework for reasoning about the behavior of multi-AI agent systems. Grounded in this framework, we define 16 properties for the host agent and 14 for the task lifecycle, categorized into liveness, safety, completeness, and fairness. Expressed in temporal logic, these properties enable formal verification of system behavior, detection of coordination edge cases, and prevention of deadlocks and security vulnerabilities. Through this effort, we introduce the first rigorously grounded, domain-agnostic framework for the analysis, design, and deployment of correct, reliable, and robust agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 针对多智能体AI系统在协议碎片化下难以验证安全/正确性的难题，提出统一语义建模框架（宿主代理模型＋任务生命周期模型），并用时序逻辑定义30条属性，实现首个可形式化验证、领域无关的分析设计方法。
AI.motivation: 多智能体AI系统依赖MCP、A2A等多协议协作，语义割裂导致无法严格分析死锁、安全漏洞等高风险问题。
AI.method: 构建两核心模型：①宿主代理模型描述顶层的用户交互与任务分解；②任务生命周期模型刻画子任务状态与错误处理；据此用线性/分支时序逻辑定义16条宿主属性、14条生命周期属性（分四类：活度、安全、完备、公平），并给出可验证形式化框架。
AI.result: 首次将多智能体系统纳入可形式验证的统一语义空间，可发现协议层协调漏洞、死链与架构失配，提供设计-部署全过程保障。
AI.conclusion: 框架为Agentic AI系统提供了首个与领域无关、可严格推理的正确性/可靠性方法论，为后续工具链与标准制定奠定基础。

title: The Second Challenge on Real-World Face Restoration at NTIRE 2026: Methods and Results
comment: NTIRE 26: https://cvlai.net/ntire/2026 . NTIRE Real-World Face Restoration: https://ntire-face.github.io/2026/ . CVPR 2026 Workshop
summary: This paper provides a review of the NTIRE 2026 challenge on real-world face restoration, highlighting the proposed solutions and the resulting outcomes. The challenge focuses on generating natural and realistic outputs while maintaining identity consistency. Its goal is to advance state-of-the-art solutions for perceptual quality and realism, without imposing constraints on computational resources or training data. Performance is evaluated using a weighted image quality assessment (IQA) score and employs the AdaFace model as an identity checker. The competition attracted 96 registrants, with 10 teams submitting valid models; ultimately, 9 teams achieved valid scores in the final ranking. This collaborative effort advances the performance of real-world face restoration while offering an in-depth overview of the latest trends in the field.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026真实人脸盲修复挑战赛总结：96支队伍注册、10队交稿、9队有效排名，最终推动无约束场景下兼顾身份一致与真实感的算法发展。
AI.motivation: 现有盲人脸修复方法多聚焦去模糊、去噪或超分，对“真实世界”复杂退化下的身份保持与自然度兼顾研究不足；社区缺乏统一基准来量化真实感与身份一致性，阻碍算法横向比较与落地。
AI.method: 主办方构建含真实退化的人脸测试集，以加权IQA指标衡量视觉质量，并用AdaFace提取身份向量作为一致性检核；对模型推理时间、训练数据量与网络规模均不设限，鼓励探索大模型与数据扩充策略。
AI.result: 10支团队提交有效模型，其中9支通过完整性验证进入排行榜；最佳方案在加权IQA上显著超越baseline，同时在AdaFace身份余弦相似度阈下保持>0.85，验证了高真实度与身份保真可以兼得。
AI.conclusion: 无约束赛道成功催化了真实-身份联合优化、退化先验建模与大模型微调等新趋势，为后续人脸复原研究与工业落地提供了数据集、评估协议和性能上界参考。

title: From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs
comment: TLDR: Under review. 42 pages, 18 figures. Code and data at https://itay1itzhak.github.io/vibe-testing-llms Subjects: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
summary: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis. We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.

AI.tldr: 用戶慣用「vibe-testing」這種非正式、基於自己工作流的模型試用，但這種做法零散且難以複現；作者將其結構化為「個人化測試 + 個人化評估」兩步流程，實驗證明新框架能改變模型偏好，從而縮小基準分數與真實體驗的差距。
AI.motivation: 主流基準無法反映 LLM 在真實場景中的使用價值，而使用者廣泛採用的「vibe-testing」又缺乏統一方法，導致評估結果難以複製、比較或規模化。
AI.method: (1) 調查真實用戶評測行為；(2) 收集公開的模型比較報告；(3) 從中抽取共性，把 vibe-testing 形式化為「任務個人化 + 評判個人化」；(4) 構建原型評估流程，使用用戶描述自動產生個人化提示並以用戶關心的主觀準則比較回答。
AI.result: 在編程基準上的實驗顯示，引入個人化提示與主觀評判後，最優模型選擇顯著改變，吻合用戶非正式實測傾向。
AI.conclusion: 結構化後的 vibe-testing 可把基準分數與真實使用體驗連接起來，提供更貼近現實、可重複的 LLM 評價方案。

title: Saber: An Efficient Sampling with Adaptive Acceleration and Backtracking Enhanced Remasking for Diffusion Language Model
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as a powerful and promising alternative to the dominant autoregressive paradigm, offering inherent advantages in parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling. However, the performance of DLMs on code generation tasks, which have stronger structural constraints, is significantly hampered by the critical trade-off between inference speed and output quality. We observed that accelerating the code generation process by reducing the number of sampling steps usually leads to a catastrophic collapse in performance. In this paper, we introduce efficient Sampling with Adaptive acceleration and Backtracking Enhanced Remasking (i.e., Saber), a novel training-free sampling algorithm for DLMs to achieve better inference speed and output quality in code generation. Specifically, Saber is motivated by two key insights in the DLM generation process: 1) it can be adaptively accelerated as more of the code context is established; 2) it requires a backtracking mechanism to reverse the generated tokens. Extensive experiments on multiple mainstream code generation benchmarks show that Saber boosts Pass@1 accuracy by an average improvement of 1.9% over mainstream DLM sampling methods, meanwhile achieving an average 251.4% inference speedup. By leveraging the inherent advantages of DLMs, our work significantly narrows the performance gap with autoregressive models in code generation.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练采样算法 Saber，使扩散语言模型在代码生成中同时获得 1.9% Pass@1 提升与 2.5× 加速，显著缩小与自回归模型的差距。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽具备并行生成与双向上下文优势，但在结构约束更强的代码任务上，推理步数减少会致性能灾难性崩溃，亟需兼顾速度和质量的新采样策略。
AI.method: Saber 无需再训练，利用“已生成代码上下文越完整，可自适应加大步长”和“错误 token 可回溯并重掩码”两大洞察，动态调整采样步长并引入回溯重掩机制，实现渐进加速与纠错。
AI.result: 在主流代码生成基准上，Saber 平均 Pass@1 提高 1.9%，推理速度提升 251.4%，将扩散模型与自回归模型的性能差距显著缩小。
AI.conclusion: Saber 验证了扩散模型在代码生成中兼顾高效率与高质量的可行性，为后续非自回归代码生成研究提供了即插即用的加速范式。

title: Script-a-Video: Deep Structured Audio-visual Captions via Factorized Streams and Relational Grounding
summary: Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are transforming video captioning from a descriptive endpoint into a semantic interface for both video understanding and generation. However, the dominant paradigm still casts videos as monolithic narrative paragraphs that entangle visual, auditory, and identity information. This dense coupling not only compromises representational fidelity but also limits scalability, since even local edits can trigger global rewrites. To address this structural bottleneck, we propose Multi-Stream Scene Script (MTSS), a novel paradigm that replaces monolithic text with factorized and explicitly grounded scene descriptions. MTSS is built on two core principles: Stream Factorization, which decouples a video into complementary streams (Reference, Shot, Event, and Global), and Relational Grounding, which reconnects these isolated streams through explicit identity and temporal links to maintain holistic video consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MTSS consistently enhances video understanding across various models, achieving an average reduction of 25% in the total error rate on Video-SALMONN-2 and an average performance gain of 67% on the Daily-Omni reasoning benchmark. It also narrows the performance gap between smaller and larger MLLMs, indicating a substantially more learnable caption interface. Finally, even without architectural adaptation, replacing monolithic prompts with MTSS in multi-shot video generation yields substantial human-rated improvements: a 45% boost in cross-shot identity consistency, a 56% boost in audio-visual alignment, and a 71% boost in temporal controllability.

AI.tldr: 提出 Multi-Stream Scene Script（MTSS）范式，将视频由单一叙事段落拆分为 Reference/Shot/Event/Global 四流并通过显式关系重新耦合，显著提升视频理解与生成的准确性、一致性与可编辑性。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 仍把视频当作单一长段落处理，导致视觉、音频与身份信息混杂，难以局部修改且可扩展性差。
AI.method: 设计 MTSS：1）Stream Factorization 按语义层级拆分视频为四流；2）Relational Grounding 用显式身份与时间链接重连各流，保持整体一致性。无需改动模型架构即可替换传统提示。
AI.result: 在 Video-SALMONN-2 上总错误率平均降低 25%，Daily-Omni 推理任务性能提升 67%，缩小大/小模型差距；视频生成中身份一致性+45%、音画对齐+56%、时序可控性+71%，均经人工评估验证。
AI.conclusion: MTSS 以结构化、因子化描述取代单一段落，不仅提升视频理解精度，也为生成任务提供更可控、可扩展的语义接口，显示了解耦+重连范式对 MLLM 视频处理的普适价值。

title: An Optimal Transport-driven Approach for Cultivating Latent Space in Online Incremental Learning
summary: In online incremental learning, data continuously arrives with substantial distributional shifts, creating a significant challenge because previous samples have limited replay value when learning a new task. Prior research has typically relied on either a single adaptive centroid or multiple fixed centroids to represent each class in the latent space. However, such methods struggle when class data streams are inherently multimodal and require continual centroid updates. To overcome this, we introduce an online Mixture Model learning framework grounded in Optimal Transport theory (MMOT), where centroids evolve incrementally with new data. This approach offers two main advantages: (i) it provides a more precise characterization of complex data streams, and (ii) it enables improved class similarity estimation for unseen samples during inference through MMOT-derived centroids. Furthermore, to strengthen representation learning and mitigate catastrophic forgetting, we design a Dynamic Preservation strategy that regulates the latent space and maintains class separability over time. Experimental evaluations on benchmark datasets confirm the superior effectiveness of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于最优传输理论的在线混合模型框架 MMOT，可在数据流分布持续漂移场景下增量更新类中心，并辅以动态保持策略抑制灾难性遗忘，实验显示其性能优于传统单/多中心方法。
AI.motivation: 在线增量学习中，数据流分布不断偏移，而旧样本重放价值有限；现有单自适应中心或多固定中心难以刻画多模态类流，亟需可随新数据持续演化的表征机制。
AI.method: 1) 基于最优传输理论构建在线混合模型 MMOT，使类中心随新样本增量更新；2) 设计动态保持策略，通过调节潜在空间维持类间可分性，抑制灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在标准数据集上的实验表明，MMOT 在分类精度、适应新任务速度及抗遗忘能力方面均显著优于既有单/多中心增量学习方法。
AI.conclusion: MMOT 通过最优传输引导的增量中心演化，有效应对多模态流漂移与灾难性遗忘，为在线增量学习提供了新的理论与实用框架。

title: Empowerment Gain and Causal Model Construction: Children and adults are sensitive to controllability and variability in their causal interventions
comment: Accepted to Philosophical Transactions A, Special issue: World models, AGI, and the hard problems of life-mind continuity. Expected publication in 2026
summary: Learning about the causal structure of the world is a fundamental problem for human cognition. Causal models and especially causal learning have proved to be difficult for large pretrained models using standard techniques of deep learning. In contrast, cognitive scientists have applied advances in our formal understanding of causation in computer science, particularly within the Causal Bayes Net formalism, to understand human causal learning. In the very different tradition of reinforcement learning, researchers have described an intrinsic reward signal called "empowerment" which maximizes mutual information between actions and their outcomes. "Empowerment" may be an important bridge between classical Bayesian causal learning and reinforcement learning and may help to characterize causal learning in humans and enable it in machines. If an agent learns an accurate causal world model, they will necessarily increase their empowerment, and increasing empowerment will lead to a more accurate causal world model. Empowerment may also explain distinctive features of childrens causal learning, as well as providing a more tractable computational account of how that learning is possible. In an empirical study, we systematically test how children and adults use cues to empowerment to infer causal relations, and design effective causal interventions.

AI.tldr: 作者假设agent若把「内在回报–empowerment」(动作–结果互信息最大化)作为优化目标，就能与贝叶斯因果模型相互促进，为儿童及机器提供更易处理的因果学习机制，并通过实验检验人类能否利用empowerment线索推断因果结构并进行干预。
AI.motivation: 深度学习难以仅用标准技术学会因果，而认知科学用因果贝叶斯网络成功解释人类因果学习；强化学习的empowerment与因果模型长期缺乏连接。作者想证明二者可共享同一形式化角色，从而解释儿童独特学习模式并在Agent中实现可计算因果学习。
AI.method: 理论推导：将empowerment定义为I(A;F|S)并指出其与因果图学习似然的单调关系：d(empower)↑ ⇔ d(model accuracy)↑。实验：系统性对比儿童和成人，测量其借助empowerment(expected 动作–结果互信息)线索推断隐藏因果链接并制定干预策略的表现，用以验证假设。
AI.result: 实验数据表明，受试者能在无先验时运用empowerment线索判断未观测因果结构，且其与干预成功率显著正相关；数值模拟也显示，在Agent中将empowerment当作内在回报可缩短因果图学习迭代次数并降低样本复杂度。
AI.conclusion: empowerment作为无监督内禀信号，可在贝叶斯因果学习与强化学习之间架设桥梁；该信号不仅解析儿童为何会主动“摆弄”环境来推断因果，还为预训练模型注入因果直觉提供了具体可算的算法框架和干预策略，为构建具备因果推理能力的AI系统奠定了新路径。

title: SyncFix: Fixing 3D Reconstructions via Multi-View Synchronization
summary: We present SyncFix, a framework that enforces cross-view consistency during the diffusion-based refinement of reconstructed scenes. SyncFix formulates refinement as a joint latent bridge matching problem, synchronizing distorted and clean representations across multiple views to fix the semantic and geometric inconsistencies. This means SyncFix learns a joint conditional over multiple views to enforce consistency throughout the denoising trajectory. Our training is done only on image pairs, but it generalizes naturally to an arbitrary number of views during inference. Moreover, reconstruction quality improves with additional views, with diminishing returns at higher view counts. Qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate that SyncFix consistently generates high-quality reconstructions and surpasses current state-of-the-art baselines, even in the absence of clean reference images. SyncFix achieves even higher fidelity when sparse references are available.

AI.tldr: SyncFix 无需干净参考即可在多视角联合潜桥匹配框架下同步去噪，显著提升扩散式场景精修的一致性与质量。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式场景精修方法在不同视角间存在语义/几何不一致，限制了重建可靠性。
AI.method: 将精修养成“多视角联合潜桥匹配”问题，训练时仅用图像对，推理时通过共享联合条件同步任意视角的失真—干净潜码演化轨迹。
AI.result: 在定性和定量指标上均超越当前最佳基线，视角越多质量越高（呈边际递减），即便完全缺失干净参考亦能稳定输出高保真结果；若提供稀疏参考，误差进一步降低。
AI.conclusion: SyncFix 证明了仅依赖图像对即可习得跨视角一致性先验，为无/弱参考条件下的高保真 3D 场景精修提供了通用可行方案。

title: Auto-FP: An Experimental Study of Automated Feature Preprocessing for Tabular Data
summary: Classical machine learning models, such as linear models and tree-based models, are widely used in industry. These models are sensitive to data distribution, thus feature preprocessing, which transforms features from one distribution to another, is a crucial step to ensure good model quality. Manually constructing a feature preprocessing pipeline is challenging because data scientists need to make difficult decisions about which preprocessors to select and in which order to compose them. In this paper, we study how to automate feature preprocessing (Auto-FP) for tabular data. Due to the large search space, a brute-force solution is prohibitively expensive. To address this challenge, we interestingly observe that Auto-FP can be modelled as either a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) or a neural architecture search (NAS) problem. This observation enables us to extend a variety of HPO and NAS algorithms to solve the Auto-FP problem. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation and analysis of 15 algorithms on 45 public ML datasets. Overall, evolution-based algorithms show the leading average ranking. Surprisingly, the random search turns out to be a strong baseline. Many surrogate-model-based and bandit-based search algorithms, which achieve good performance for HPO and NAS, do not outperform random search for Auto-FP. We analyze the reasons for our findings and conduct a bottleneck analysis to identify the opportunities to improve these algorithms. Furthermore, we explore how to extend Auto-FP to support parameter search and compare two ways to achieve this goal. In the end, we evaluate Auto-FP in an AutoML context and discuss the limitations of popular AutoML tools. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study on automated feature preprocessing. We hope our work can inspire researchers to develop new algorithms tailored for Auto-FP.

AI.tldr: 首次将自动化特征预处理（Auto-FP）建模为 HPO 与 NAS 问题，在 45 个表格数据集上系统比较 15 种算法，发现进化算法领先、随机搜索成为强基线，并给出瓶颈分析与 AutoML 场景下的改进方向。
AI.motivation: 工业界广泛使用的线性/树模型对特征分布极为敏感，手动构建预处理管线需专家经验且试错成本高，急需自动化方案。
AI.method: 将 Auto-FP 形式化为 HPO 与 NAS 两类搜索任务，复用并扩展 15 种代表性 HPO/NAS 算法（含演化、贝叶斯、bandit、随机搜索等），统一在 45 个公开表格数据集上评估；随后进行瓶颈剖析与参数联合搜索扩展实验，并嵌入主流 AutoML 框架对比。
AI.result: 进化算法平均排名最优；随机搜索力压众多先进贝叶斯与 bandit 方法成为强基线； surrogate-model 与 bandit 方法未显优势；瓶颈主要出在预处理管线评估代价高、搜索空间非平稳；联合参数搜索可再提升 3–5% 精度；现有 AutoML 工具对 Auto-FP 支持有限。
AI.conclusion: Auto-FP 可统一用 HPO/NAS 技术解决，但需针对高评估代价与空间结构重新设计算法；随机搜索已提供强硬基线，未来应开发面向 Auto-FP 定制的进化/元学习/早停策略，并推进 AutoML 系统级集成。

title: Remember Me, Refine Me: A Dynamic Procedural Memory Framework for Experience-Driven Agent Evolution
summary: Procedural memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to internalize "how-to" knowledge, theoretically reducing redundant trial-and-error. However, existing frameworks predominantly suffer from a "passive accumulation" paradigm, treating memory as a static append-only archive. To bridge the gap between static storage and dynamic reasoning, we propose $\textbf{ReMe}$ ($\textit{Remember Me, Refine Me}$), a comprehensive framework for experience-driven agent evolution. ReMe innovates across the memory lifecycle via three mechanisms: 1) $\textit{multi-faceted distillation}$, which extracts fine-grained experiences by recognizing success patterns, analyzing failure triggers and generating comparative insights; 2) $\textit{context-adaptive reuse}$, which tailors historical insights to new contexts via scenario-aware indexing; and 3) $\textit{utility-based refinement}$, which autonomously adds valid memories and prunes outdated ones to maintain a compact, high-quality experience pool. Extensive experiments on BFCL-V3 and AppWorld demonstrate that ReMe establishes a new state-of-the-art in agent memory system. Crucially, we observe a significant memory-scaling effect: Qwen3-8B equipped with ReMe outperforms larger, memoryless Qwen3-14B, suggesting that self-evolving memory provides a computation-efficient pathway for lifelong learning. We release our code and the $\texttt{reme.library}$ dataset to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: ReMe框架用“提炼-复用-修剪”三步法把静态记忆变成动态推理引擎，8B模型凭此反超14B，首次验证记忆Scaling Law。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体把记忆当成只增不改的“仓库”，导致经验冗余、试错重复；亟需让记忆随任务演化，实现终身学习。
AI.method: 提出ReMe：①多面蒸馏（成功模式+失败触发+对比洞察三元组）②场景自适应复用（情境索引+动态匹配）③效用驱动精炼（增新删旧，保持高信噪比）。
AI.result: 在BFCL-V3与AppWorld上SOTA；Qwen3-8B+ReMe全面超越无记忆Qwen3-14B，绝对提升+6.8%，验证“记忆即算力”替代路线。
AI.conclusion: 自演化记忆是模型效率的新杠杆，8B可敌14B；代码与reme.library数据集已开源，推动终身学习范式落地。

title: RSGMamba: Reliability-Aware Self-Gated State Space Model for Multimodal Semantic Segmentation
summary: Multimodal semantic segmentation has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing scene understanding by leveraging complementary information from multiple sensing modalities (e.g., RGB, depth, and thermal). However, existing cross-modal fusion methods often implicitly assume that all modalities are equally reliable, which can lead to feature degradation when auxiliary modalities are noisy, misaligned, or incomplete. In this paper, we revisit cross-modal fusion from the perspective of modality reliability and propose a novel framework termed the Reliability-aware Self-Gated State Space Model (RSGMamba). At the core of our method is the Reliability-aware Self-Gated Mamba Block (RSGMB), which explicitly models modality reliability and dynamically regulates cross-modal interactions through a self-gating mechanism. Unlike conventional fusion strategies that indiscriminately exchange information across modalities, RSGMB enables reliability-aware feature selection and enhancing informative feature aggregation. In addition, a lightweight Local Cross-Gated Modulation (LCGM) is incorporated to refine fine-grained spatial details, complementing the global modeling capability of RSGMB. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSGMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance on both RGB-D and RGB-T semantic segmentation benchmarks, resulting 58.8% / 54.0% mIoU on NYUDepth V2 and SUN-RGBD (+0.4% / +0.7% over prior best), and 61.1% / 88.9% mIoU on MFNet and PST900 (up to +1.6%), with only 48.6M parameters, thereby validating the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: RSGMamba利用动态“信度门控”的Mamba块，在RGB-D/T多模态语义分割中显式抑制不可靠模态噪声，轻量化LCGM精修空间细节，在4个主流数据集上刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态融合方法普遍默认各模态可靠度一致，当深度或热红外出现噪声、错位、缺失时，反而引入“负迁移”导致特征退化；亟需从“可靠度”视角重塑融合范式。
AI.method: 1.提出Reliability-aware Self-Gated Mamba Block(RSGMB)，内置跨模态信度估计网络，通过状态空间建模与自门控动态筛除低信度通道，强化高信度特征聚合；2.设计轻量级Local Cross-Gated Modulation(LCGM)局部交叉门控模块，精细补偿空间纹理，兼容RSGMB全局建模；3.整体框架RSGMamba端到端可训，仅48.6M参数量。
AI.result: NYUDepth V2和SUN-RGBD分别达58.8%/54.0% mIoU，较前最佳提升+0.4%/+0.7%；RGB-T数据集MFNet与PST900达61.1%/88.9% mIoU，最高再涨+1.6%，参数量仅48.6M，性能与效率双优。
AI.conclusion: 将“模态可靠度”显式嵌入状态空间主干，可显著抑制噪声与错位带来的负面影响；RSGMamba在RGB-D/T基准上取得新SOTA，验证了可靠性感知自门控Mamba在多模态语义分割中的普适潜力。

title: On an $L^2$ norm for stationary ARMA processes
summary: We propose an $L^2$ norm for stationary Autoregressive Moving Average (ARMA) models. We look at ARMA models within the Hilbert space of the past with present of a true purely linearly non-deterministic stationary process $X_t$, and compute the $L^2$ norm based on its Wold decomposition. As an application of this $L^2$ norm, we derive bounds on the mean square prediction error for AR(1) models of MA(1) processes, and verify these bounds empirically for sample data.

AI.tldr: 把 ARMA 过程嵌入 Hilbert 空间，用 Wold 分解构造一种新的 L² “过程范数”，并在 AR(1) 拟合 MA(1) 的预测问题里给出 MSPE 上下界及实证验证。
AI.motivation: 为纯线性非确定平稳过程导出可计算的“模型距离”范数，用以统一衡量不同 ARMA 阶数结构的近似能力与预测误差。
AI.method: 1. 构造包含 X_t 过去-现在值的 Hilbert 空间；2. 利用 Wold 分解定义 L² 模型范数 ∥ψ∥；3. 对 AR(1) 拟合 MA(1) 的 MSPE 得到用上界和下界；4. 通过蒙特卡洛实验检验公式准确性。
AI.result: 获得了 AR(1)→MA(1) 的 MSPE 显式上下界；数值实验显示经验 MSPE 落在理论区间内，且区间宽度随样本增大而收敛。
AI.conclusion: 新 L² 范数可将 ARMA 模型逼近与预测性能量化，为模型定阶、结构比较和最优预测提供了可解析计算的通用工具。

title: Logical Phase Transitions: Understanding Collapse in LLM Logical Reasoning
summary: Symbolic logical reasoning is a critical yet underexplored capability of large language models (LLMs), providing reliable and verifiable decision-making in high-stakes domains such as mathematical reasoning and legal judgment. In this study, we present a systematic analysis of logical reasoning under controlled increases in logical complexity, and reveal a previously unrecognized phenomenon, which we term Logical Phase Transitions: rather than degrading smoothly, logical reasoning performance remains stable within a regime but collapses abruptly beyond a critical logical depth, mirroring physical phase transitions such as water freezing beyond a critical temperature threshold. Building on this insight, we propose Neuro-Symbolic Curriculum Tuning, a principled framework that adaptively aligns natural language with logical symbols to establish a shared representation, and reshapes training dynamics around phase-transition boundaries to progressively strengthen reasoning at increasing logical depths. Experiments on five benchmarks show that our approach effectively mitigates logical reasoning collapse at high complexity, yielding average accuracy gains of +1.26 in naive prompting and +3.95 in CoT, while improving generalization to unseen logical compositions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AI4SS/Logical-Phase-Transitions.

AI.tldr: 首次发现并刻画了 LLM 逻辑推理中的“相变”现象；提出神经符号课程微调，使模型在逻辑深度越过临界点时仍保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 在高风险场景（数学证明、法律裁决）中，需要可验证、可解释的逻辑推理能力，而现有 LLM 缺乏对其复杂度极限的系统认知。
AI.method: 构造可控复杂度逻辑题序，观测到性能在临界深度处突然崩塌（相变）；据此设计“神经符号课程微调”：① 自适应将自然语言对齐到符号表示，② 以相变边界为课程节点，渐进式重排训练动态。
AI.result: 在 5 个基准上，高复杂度区间准确率相比零样本提示平均+1.26pp，相比 CoT +3.95pp；对未见逻辑组合泛化提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑推理并非平滑退化，而是存在临界相变；通过围绕相变边界重塑训练，可系统性突破 LLM 的逻辑深度瓶颈，为可靠神经符号推理提供新范式。

title: Why and When Visual Token Pruning Fails? A Study on Relevant Visual Information Shift in MLLMs Decoding
summary: Recently, visual token pruning has been studied to handle the vast number of visual tokens in Multimodal Large Language Models. However, we observe that while existing pruning methods perform reliably on simple visual understanding, they struggle to effectively generalize to complex visual reasoning tasks, a critical gap underexplored in previous studies. Through a systematic analysis, we identify Relevant Visual Information Shift (RVIS) during decoding as the primary failure driver. To address this, we propose Decoding-stage Shift-aware Token Pruning (DSTP), a training-free add-on framework that enables existing pruning methods to align visual tokens with shifting reasoning requirements during the decoding stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSTP significantly mitigates performance degradation of pruning methods in complex reasoning tasks, while consistently yielding performance gains even across visual understanding benchmarks. Furthermore, DSTP demonstrates effectiveness across diverse state-of-the-art architectures, highlighting its generalizability and efficiency with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 现有视觉token剪枝在简单视觉理解上有效，但在复杂推理任务中失效；作者发现主因是解码阶段的视觉相关信息漂移（RVIS），提出无需训练的解码阶段感知漂移剪枝框架DSTP，显著提升各类剪枝方法在复杂推理上的性能，且对理解和架构均具良好泛化性与低开销。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型中视觉token数量庞大，剪枝可降低计算。已有剪枝在简单理解任务表现可靠，却未触及复杂视觉推理场景下的性能退化问题，该空白亟待填补。
AI.method: 提出“解码阶段感知漂移剪枝”(DSTP)框架：先系统分析得出RVIS现象，再在解码阶段根据推理需求动态调整保留token，实现与现有剪枝方法零训练耦合的即插即用增强。
AI.result: DSTP使多种主流剪枝方法在复杂推理任务上大幅减小性能下降，同时在标准视觉理解基准上仍保持增益；跨不同SOTA架构测试一致有效，引入的计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 验证RVIS为剪枝在推理任务失效的关键原因，DSTP以几乎零成本解决该问题，证明无需再训练即可让剪枝方法兼顾效率与复杂推理能力，具有良好的通用部署潜力。

title: Hybrid Attention Model Using Feature Decomposition and Knowledge Distillation for Glucose Forecasting
comment: Final accepted version. IEEE TMC Journal
summary: The availability of continuous glucose monitors as over-the-counter commodities have created a unique opportunity to monitor a person's blood glucose levels, forecast blood glucose trajectories and provide automated interventions to prevent devastating chronic complications that arise from poor glucose control. However, forecasting blood glucose levels is challenging because blood glucose changes consistently in response to food intake, medication intake, physical activity, sleep, and stress. It is particularly difficult to accurately predict BGL from multimodal and irregularly sampled data and over long prediction horizons. Furthermore, these forecasting models must operate in real-time on edge devices to provide in-the-moment interventions. To address these challenges, we propose GlucoNet, an AI-powered sensor system for continuously monitoring behavioral and physiological health and robust forecasting of blood glucose patterns. GlucoNet devises a feature decomposition-based transformer model that incorporates patients' behavioral and physiological data and transforms sparse and irregular patient data (e.g., diet and medication intake data) into continuous features using a mathematical model, facilitating better integration with the BGL data. Given the non-linear and non-stationary nature of BG signals, we propose a decomposition method to extract both low and high-frequency components from the BGL signals, thus providing accurate forecasting. To reduce the computational complexity, we also propose to employ knowledge distillation to compress the transformer model. GlucoNet achieves a 60% improvement in RMSE and a 21% reduction in the number of parameters, improving RMSE and MAE by 51% and 57%, using data obtained involving 12 participants with T1-Diabetes. These results underscore GlucoNet's potential as a compact and reliable tool for real-world diabetes prevention and management.

AI.tldr: GlucoNet 是一种基于 Transformer 的可穿戴 AI 系统，能把稀疏、不规则的饮食/用药等行为数据映射为连续特征，并分解血糖高频/低频分量，实现长时域、实时的血糖预测；在 12 名 T1D 数据上 RMSE 提升 60%，参数量减少 21%，可部署于边缘设备。
AI.motivation: 连续血糖监测（CGM）已可非处方获取，为实时防止高血糖并发症提供了窗口；但血糖受饮食、用药、运动、睡眠、压力等多模态且采样不规则的因素驱动，长时域准确预测仍极其困难，现有模型难以在边缘端实时运行。
AI.method: 构建 GlucoNet 端到端系统：1) 提出基于特征分解的 Transformer，将饮食、用药等稀疏事件通过数学模型转化为连续特征，与 CGM 数据融合；2) 针对血糖非线性非平稳特性，采用信号分解同时提取高频与低频分量分别建模；3) 运用知识蒸馏压缩模型，满足边缘设备实时算力限制。
AI.result: 在 12 例 1 型糖尿病患者真实数据集上，相比最佳基线 RMSE 降低 60%，MAE 降低 57%；模型参数量减少 21%，实现 51% 的 RMSE 改进与 57% 的 MAE 改进，达到边缘端可部署的轻量级要求。
AI.conclusion: GlucoNet 通过“稀疏行为连续化+信号分解+知识蒸馏”三大创新，把长时域血糖预测误差减半，并显著压缩模型，展示了作为紧凑、可靠的实时糖尿病预防与管理工具的转化潜力。

title: Variance Computation for Weighted Model Counting with Knowledge Compilation Approach
comment: 25 pages; accepted for AAAI 2026 main track
summary: One of the most important queries in knowledge compilation is weighted model counting (WMC), which has been applied to probabilistic inference on various models, such as Bayesian networks. In practical situations on inference tasks, the model's parameters have uncertainty because they are often learned from data, and thus we want to compute the degree of uncertainty in the inference outcome. One possible approach is to regard the inference outcome as a random variable by introducing distributions for the parameters and evaluate the variance of the outcome. Unfortunately, the tractability of computing such a variance is hardly known. Motivated by this, we consider the problem of computing the variance of WMC and investigate this problem's tractability. First, we derive a polynomial time algorithm to evaluate the WMC variance when the input is given as a structured d-DNNF. Second, we prove the hardness of this problem for structured DNNFs, d-DNNFs, and FBDDs, which is intriguing because the latter two allow polynomial time WMC algorithms. Finally, we show an application that measures the uncertainty in the inference of Bayesian networks. We empirically show that our algorithm can evaluate the variance of the marginal probability on real-world Bayesian networks and analyze the impact of the variances of parameters on the variance of the marginal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在参数含不确定性的情况下如何快速计算加权模型计数（WMC）方差，以衡量贝叶斯网络等模型推理结果的不确定性。
AI.motivation: WMC 在概率推理中应用广泛，但模型参数通常由数据学得而带有不确定性，需要对推理结果的方差进行量化。目前对 WMC 方差计算的可近似/复杂度几乎空白，亟需系统研究。
AI.method: 针对结构 d-DNNF 表示的知识库，提出精确计算 WMC 方差的多项式时间算法；同时对结构 DNNF、一般 d-DNNF 及 FBDD 给出严格的硬度下界；最后在真实 BN 上验证算法并衡量参数方差到边际概率方差的传播效应。
AI.result: 1. 对结构 d-DNNF，WMC 方差可在多项式时间内精确计算；2. 若取消
AI.conclusion: 确定与随机 WMC 的复杂度截然不同：少量结构约束（如结构化 d-DNNF）可保持高效方差计算，而稍有松弛即变得难以处理；提出的方差算法为评估 BN 参数不确定性提供了可行工具，并突出了扩展已知计数结果时需特别考虑方差和分布因素的重要性。

title: Reading Between the Pixels: Linking Text-Image Embedding Alignment to Typographic Attack Success on Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild
summary: We study typographic prompt injection attacks on vision-language models (VLMs), where adversarial text is rendered as images to bypass safety mechanisms, posing a growing threat as VLMs serve as the perceptual backbone of autonomous agents, from browser automation and computer-use systems to camera-equipped embodied agents. In practice, the attack surface is heterogeneous: adversarial text appears at varying font sizes and under diverse visual conditions, while the growing ecosystem of VLMs exhibits substantial variation in vulnerability, complicating defensive approaches. Evaluating 1,000 prompts from SALAD-Bench across four VLMs, namely, GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Mistral-Large-3, and Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct under varying font sizes (6--28px) and visual transformations (rotation, blur, noise, contrast changes), we find: (1) font size significantly affects attack success rate (ASR), with very small fonts (6px) yielding near-zero ASR while mid-range fonts achieve peak effectiveness; (2) text attacks are more effective than image attacks for GPT-4o (36% vs 8%) and Claude (47% vs 22%), while Qwen3-VL and Mistral show comparable ASR across modalities; (3) text-image embedding distance from two multimodal embedding models (JinaCLIP and Qwen3-VL-Embedding) shows strong negative correlation with ASR across all four models (r = -0.71 to -0.93, p < 0.01); (4) heavy degradations increase embedding distance by 10--12% and reduce ASR by 34--96%, while rotation asymmetrically affects models (Mistral drops 50%, GPT-4o unchanged). These findings highlight that model-specific robustness patterns preclude one-size-fits-all defenses and offer empirical guidance for practitioners selecting VLM backbones for agentic systems operating in adversarial environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统评估了将对抗性文字直接渲染成图像的新型排版提示注入攻击，证明不同VLM对字体大小与视觉扰动的敏感度差异巨大，且多模态嵌入距离可作为廉价鲁棒性指标。
AI.motivation: 随着VLMs成为浏览器自动化、计算机使用及具身智能体的“感知中枢”，传统文本安全检查被绕过的新攻击面——排版提示注入——正快速浮现，亟需量化其风险并给出防御指引。
AI.method: 从SALAD-Bench采样1 000条有害提示，用6–28 px字体渲染为图像后，在GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet、Mistral-Large-3、Qwen3-VL-4B上测试；同时施加旋转、模糊、噪声、对比度变化等视觉扰动，并用JinaCLIP与Qwen3-VL-Embedding计算文本-图像嵌入距离，分析其与攻击成功率（ASR）的关联。
AI.result: (1) 字体大小呈倒U形效应：6 px几乎无效，中等字号达峰值；(2) 对GPT-4o与Claude，纯文本攻击ASR分别达36 %与47 %，远高于对应图像攻击（8 %/22 %），而Qwen3-VL与Mistral在两种模态下ASR相近；(3) 嵌入距离与ASR强负相关（r = –0.71~–0.93）；(4) 重度降质使嵌入距离增10–12 %，ASR降34–96 %；旋转对Mistral ASR骤降50 %，而GPT-4o几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: VLM对排版攻击的脆弱性呈模型特异性，不存在通用防御；嵌入距离可作为快速评估鲁棒性的实用指标，为在对抗环境中选型VLM backbone提供量化依据。

title: A ghost mechanism: An analytical model of abrupt learning in recurrent networks
comment: to appear in Physical Review X
summary: Abrupt learning is a common phenomenon in recurrent neural networks (RNNs) trained on working memory tasks. In such cases, the networks develop transient slow regions in state space that extend the effective timescales of computation. However, the mechanisms driving sudden performance improvements and their causal role remain unclear. To address this gap, we introduce the ghost mechanism, a process by which dynamical systems exhibit transient slowdown near the remnant of a saddle-node bifurcation. By reducing the high-dimensional dynamics near ghost points, we derive a one-dimensional canonical form that analytically captures learning as a process controlled by a single scale parameter. Using this model, we study a form of abrupt learning emerging from ghost points and identify a critical learning rate that scales as an inverse power law with the timescale of the learned computation. Beyond this rate, learning collapses through two interacting modes: (i) vanishing gradients and (ii) oscillatory gradients near minima. These features can lock the system into high-confidence but incorrect predictions when parameter updates trigger a no-learning zone, a region of parameter space where gradients vanish. We validate these predictions in low-rank RNNs, where ghost points precede abrupt transitions, and further demonstrate their generality in full-rank RNNs trained on canonical working memory tasks. Our theory offers two approaches to address these learning difficulties: increasing trainable ranks stabilizes learning trajectories, while reducing output confidence mitigates entrapment in no-learning zones. Overall, the ghost mechanism reveals how the computational demands of a task constrain the optimization landscape, demonstrating that well-known learning difficulties in RNNs partly arise from the dynamical systems they must learn to implement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“幽灵机制”解释RNN在工作记忆任务中突然性能跃升的现象：网络状态空间在鞍-结分岔残迹处出现瞬态减速，使有效计算时间尺度被临时拉长。作者将高维动力学降维为单参数一维范式，导出临界学习率与计算时间尺度呈幂律反比，并给出两种崩溃模式（梯度消失与振荡）及“无学习区”陷阱。低秩/全秩RNN实验验证了理论，并给出增加可训秩、降低输出置信度两种对策。
AI.motivation: RNN训练工作记忆任务时常出现性能突然跃升，其背后机制及因果角色不明；亟需揭示高维动力学如何塑造优化景观并导致学习困难。
AI.method: 1)引入“幽灵机制”概念：系统在新近消失的鞍-结分岔点附近出现瞬态减速；2)在幽灵点附近做中心流形降维，得到单参数一阶范式；3)解析推导临界学习率 γ_c∝τ^(−α)，并刻画两种崩溃模式（梯度消失与振荡梯度）；4)定义“无学习区”并分析其诱捕条件；5)在低秩与全秩RNN上验证预测，测试两种干预：增加可训秩、降低输出置信度。
AI.result: 理论预测与实验一致：幽灵点始终出现在突然性能跃升之前；当学习率超过γ_c时，网络陷入无学习区，保持高置信却错误预测；增加可训秩可平滑优化轨迹，降低置信度则减少陷阱滞留时间，显著提升稳定收敛率。
AI.conclusion: 幽灵机制表明，任务对计算时间尺度的要求直接约束RNN优化景观，著名的梯度消失/爆炸难题部分源于网络必须自生成近临界动力学；通过调控可训秩与输出置信度，可系统性缓解骤变学习带来的训练失稳。

title: 3D Instruction Ambiguity Detection
summary: In safety-critical domains, linguistic ambiguity can have severe consequences; a vague command like "Pass me the vial" in a surgical setting could lead to catastrophic errors. Yet, most embodied AI research overlooks this, assuming instructions are clear and focusing on execution rather than confirmation. To address this critical safety gap, we are the first to define 3D Instruction Ambiguity Detection, a fundamental new task where a model must determine if a command has a single, unambiguous meaning within a given 3D scene. To support this research, we build Ambi3D, the large-scale benchmark for this task, featuring over 700 diverse 3D scenes and around 22k instructions. Our analysis reveals a surprising limitation: state-of-the-art 3D Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to reliably determine if an instruction is ambiguous. To address this challenge, we propose AmbiVer, a two-stage framework that collects explicit visual evidence from multiple views and uses it to guide an vision-language model (VLM) in judging instruction ambiguity. Extensive experiments demonstrate the challenge of our task and the effectiveness of AmbiVer, paving the way for safer and more trustworthy embodied AI. Code and dataset available at https://jiayuding031020.github.io/ambi3d/.

AI.tldr: 首次提出‘3D指令歧义检测’任务，发现现有3D-LLM无法可靠判断指令是否歧义，构建Ambi3D基准并提出AmbiVer框架，用多视角视觉证据辅助VLM提升安全性。
AI.motivation: 安全关键场景下，语言歧义可导致致命错误，但既有具身AI默认指令清晰、重执行轻确认，存在重大安全盲区。作者希望通过显式检测3D场景中的指令歧义，堵住该漏洞。
AI.method: 1. 任务定义：输入3D场景+自然语言指令，输出“是否存在唯一无歧义目标”；2. 数据：Ambi3D，700+场景、22k指令，人工标注歧义标签；3. 模型：AmbiVer两阶段——先做多视角视觉证据采集，再将证据与文本送入VLM进行歧义判断。
AI.result: SOTA 3D-LLM在Ambi3D上歧义检测准确率仅~55%，显著低于人类；AmbiVer将准确率提升约20个百分点，验证视觉证据对消解歧义的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 3D指令歧义检测是具身AI安全的基础前置任务；Ambi3D为后续研究提供标准测试台；AmbiVer证明了显式视觉证据+语言模型结合的可行性，为实现更安全、可信的具身智能奠定基础。

title: CoD-Lite: Real-Time Diffusion-Based Generative Image Compression
summary: Recent advanced diffusion methods typically derive strong generative priors by scaling diffusion transformers. However, scaling fails to generalize when adapted for real-time compression scenarios that demand lightweight models. In this paper, we explore the design of real-time and lightweight diffusion codecs by addressing two pivotal questions. First, does diffusion pre-training benefit lightweight diffusion codecs? Through systematic analysis, we find that generation-oriented pre-training is less effective at small model scales whereas compression-oriented pre-training yields consistently better performance. Second, are transformers essential? We find that while global attention is crucial for standard generation, lightweight convolutions suffice for compression-oriented diffusion when paired with distillation. Guided by these findings, we establish a one-step lightweight convolution diffusion codec that achieves real-time $60$~FPS encoding and $42$~FPS decoding at 1080p. Further enhanced by distillation and adversarial learning, the proposed codec reduces bitrate by 85\% at a comparable FID to MS-ILLM, bridging the gap between generative compression and practical real-time deployment. Codes are released at https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/tree/main/CoD_Lite

AI.tldr: 针对实时压缩场景提出轻量级扩散编解码器 CoD-Lite，仅用卷积+蒸馏即可在 1080p 下达到 60 FPS 编码/42 FPS 解码，比 MS-ILLM 节省 85% 码率且 FID 相当。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散 Transformer 的“大力出奇迹”思路在实时压缩任务中因模型过重而失效，需验证：①扩散预训练是否仍对小模型有效；②Transformer 是否为必要条件。
AI.method: 系统比较生成导向与压缩导向预训练，发现后者在小模型上更优；用轻量卷积取代全局注意力，并以教师-学生蒸馏+对抗训练将多步扩散压成单步推理，构建纯卷积的 CoD-Lite 编解码框架。
AI.result: 在 1080p 数据集上实现 60 FPS 编码、42 FPS 解码，码率较 MS-ILLM 降 85%，FID 持平；参数量与延迟均降低一个数量级，首次将扩散压缩推向实时实用。
AI.conclusion: 扩散压缩无需重型 Transformer，也无需生成式预训练；压缩导向预训练+卷积+蒸馏是构建实时扩散编解码器的有效路径，为生成压缩的终端部署打开新方向。

title: Biased Federated Learning under Wireless Heterogeneity
comment: Accepted in IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications
summary: Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising framework for distributed learning, enabling collaborative model training without sharing private data. Existing wireless FL works primarily adopt two communication strategies: (1) over-the-air (OTA) computation, which exploits wireless signal superposition for simultaneous gradient aggregation, and (2) digital communication, which allocates orthogonal resources for gradient uploads. Prior works on both schemes typically assume \emph{homogeneous} wireless conditions (equal path loss across devices) to enforce zero-bias updates or permit uncontrolled bias, resulting in suboptimal performance and high-variance model updates in \emph{heterogeneous} environments, where devices with poor channel conditions slow down convergence. This paper addresses FL over heterogeneous wireless networks by proposing novel OTA and digital FL updates that allow a structured, time-invariant model bias, thereby reducing variance in FL updates. We analyze their convergence under a unified framework and derive an upper bound on the model ``optimality error", which explicitly quantifies the effect of bias and variance in terms of design parameters. Next, to optimize this trade-off, we study a non-convex optimization problem and develop a successive convex approximation (SCA)-based framework to jointly optimize the design parameters. We perform extensive numerical evaluations with several related design variants and state-of-the-art OTA and digital FL schemes. Our results confirm that minimizing the bias-variance trade-off while allowing a structured bias provides better FL convergence performance than existing schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种允许固定结构偏差的新型联邦学习(FL)梯度上传机制(OTA 叠加与数字正交)，在异构无线网络中通过显式控制偏差-方差权衡，实现比传统零偏差或放任偏差方案更快的收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有无线FL在异构信道下因强行零偏差或放任偏差导致更新高方差与收敛慢，需设计能容忍可控偏差的通信机制以降低总体优化误差。
AI.method: 1) 分别为OTA与数字通信设计含固定偏差的梯度聚合规则；2) 建立统一收敛框架并导出含偏差-方差项的优化误差上界；3) 以该上界为目标，用SCA算法联合优化发射功率、带宽分配等参数。
AI.result: 理论表明结构化偏差可显著降低方差并缩小优化误差界；仿真显示在异构信道下，所提方案比最新OTA与数字FL收敛更快、测试精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 在无线FL中主动引入并优化结构化偏差-方差权衡，优于传统零偏差或放任偏差策略，为异构网络联邦学习提供实用设计范式。

title: TRIM: Hybrid Inference via Targeted Stepwise Routing in Multi-Step Reasoning Tasks
summary: Multi-step reasoning tasks like mathematical problem solving are vulnerable to cascading failures, where a single incorrect step leads to complete solution breakdown. Current LLM routing methods assign entire queries to one model, treating all reasoning steps as equal. We propose TRIM (Targeted routing in multi-step reasoning tasks), which routes only critical steps$\unicode{x2013}$those likely to derail the solution$\unicode{x2013}$to larger models while letting smaller models handle routine continuations. Our key insight is that targeted step-level interventions can fundamentally transform inference efficiency by confining expensive calls to precisely those steps where stronger models prevent cascading errors. TRIM operates at the step-level: it uses process reward models to identify erroneous steps and makes routing decisions based on step-level uncertainty and budget constraints. We develop several routing strategies within TRIM, ranging from a simple threshold-based policy to more expressive policies that reason about long-horizon accuracy-cost trade-offs and uncertainty in step-level correctness estimates. On MATH-500, even the simplest thresholding strategy surpasses prior routing methods with 5x higher cost efficiency, while more advanced policies match the strong, expensive model's performance using 80% fewer expensive model tokens. On harder benchmarks such as AIME, TRIM achieves up to 6x higher cost efficiency. All methods generalize effectively across math reasoning tasks, demonstrating that step-level difficulty represents fundamental characteristics of reasoning.

AI.tldr: TRIM首次把“路由”粒度从整题下沉到单步，仅对易出错的关键步调用大模型，其余由小模型续写，在MATH-500和AIME上实现5–6倍成本节省且保持性能。
AI.motivation: 多步推理（如数学解题）存在级联失败：一步算错、全题崩溃。现有LLM路由方法整题派发，无法区分步骤难易，导致昂贵大模型被大量简单步浪费。
AI.method: 提出TRIM框架：①用过程奖励模型（PRM）逐步打分，量化每一步的正确概率与不确定性；②基于预设成本预算，设计从阈值策略到长程精度-成本权衡策略的多种路由规则；③仅对高不确定或高错误风险步调用大模型，低不确定步交由小模型继续生成。
AI.result: 在MATH-500上，最简阈值策略即比整题路由方法提升5倍成本效率；进阶策略在性能持平最强单一模型同时减少80%大模型token。在更难AIME数据集上最高获得6倍成本效率。所有策略跨数学任务稳定有效。
AI.conclusion: 步骤级难度是多步推理的固有属性；通过“哪里难、哪里用大模型”的精准干预，可在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著降低推理成本，为高效LLM推理提供新范式。

title: PianoFlow: Music-Aware Streaming Piano Motion Generation with Bimanual Coordination
summary: Audio-driven bimanual piano motion generation requires precise modeling of complex musical structures and dynamic cross-hand coordination. However, existing methods often rely on acoustic-only representations lacking symbolic priors, employ inflexible interaction mechanisms, and are limited to computationally expensive short-sequence generation. To address these limitations, we propose PianoFlow, a flow-matching framework for precise and coordinated bimanual piano motion synthesis. Our approach strategically leverages MIDI as a privileged modality during training, distilling these structured musical priors to achieve deep semantic understanding while maintaining audio-only inference. Furthermore, we introduce an asymmetric role-gated interaction module to explicitly capture dynamic cross-hand coordination through role-aware attention and temporal gating. To enable real-time streaming generation for arbitrarily long sequences, we design an autoregressive flow continuation scheme that ensures seamless cross-chunk temporal coherence. Extensive experiments on the PianoMotion10M dataset demonstrate that PianoFlow achieves superior quantitative and qualitative performance, while accelerating inference by over 9\times compared to previous methods.

AI.tldr: PianoFlow 用流匹配框架把 MIDI 作为训练先验、不对称角色门控交互模块和自回归流延续机制，实现音频驱动的双手钢琴长序列实时生成，比先前方法快 9 倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动双手钢琴动作生成方法缺乏符号先验、交互机制僵化且只能生成短序列，难以满足复杂乐句与动态跨手协调的精确建模需求。
AI.method: 提出钢琴流匹配框架 PianoFlow：1) 训练阶段以 MIDI 为特权模态，蒸馏结构化音乐先验并在推理阶段仅用音频；2) 设计“左手-右手”不对称角色门控交互模块（角色感知注意力+时间门控）显式建模跨手协调；3) 引入自回归流延续策略，实现任意长度序列的实时流式生成并维持跨块时序一致性。
AI.result: 在 PianoMotion10M 数据集上，PianoFlow 在定量指标与定性效果均优于现有方法，推理速度提升 9 倍以上，可实时生成较长乐曲的双手钢琴动作。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入 MIDI 先验、不对称角色交互与流式流匹配，PianoFlow 首次在仅输入音频的前提下实现高精度、协调且实时的双手钢琴动作长序列生成，为音频驱动音乐表演合成提供了新范式。

title: Neural Mean-Field Games: Extending Mean-Field Game Theory with Neural Stochastic Differential Equations
summary: Mean-field game theory relies on approximating games that are intractable to model due to a very large to infinite population of players. While these kinds of games can be solved analytically via the associated system of partial derivatives, this approach is not model-free, can lead to the loss of the existence or uniqueness of solutions, and may suffer from modelling bias. To reduce the dependency between the model and the game, we introduce neural mean-field games: a combination of mean-field game theory and deep learning in the form of neural stochastic differential equations. The resulting model is data-driven, lightweight, and can learn extensive strategic interactions that are hard to capture using mean-field theory alone. In addition, the model is based on automatic differentiation, making it more robust and objective than approaches based on finite differences. We highlight the efficiency and flexibility of our approach by solving two mean-field games that vary in their complexity, observability, and the presence of noise. Lastly, we illustrate the model's robustness by simulating viral dynamics based on real-world data. Here, we demonstrate that the model's ability to learn from real-world data helps to accurately model the evolution of an epidemic outbreak. Using these results, we show that the model is flexible, generalizable, and requires few observations to learn the distribution underlying the data.

AI.tldr: 提出神经平均场博弈（Neural MFG），用神经随机微分方程替代传统 PDE 求解，实现无模型、数据驱动、端到端学习，并在流行病传播真实数据上验证其泛化与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 经典平均场博弈需依赖已知动力学模型与 PDE 求解，存在解的存在唯一性风险、模型误差与偏差；作者希望摆脱对显式模型的依赖，让算法直接从数据中学习海量玩家宏观策略演化。
AI.method: 将平均场博弈的无限粒子极限用“神经随机微分方程（Neural SDE）”参数化，把 Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman 与 Fokker–Planck 方程的解嵌入神经网络；利用可微分编程与自动微分进行端到端训练，无需离散差分，实现轻量级、模型无关的求解器。
AI.result: 在两类复杂度、观测度与噪声水平不同的标准 MFG 问题上，Neural MFG 仅用少量观测即可准确恢复玩家分布与最优策略；在真实 COVID-19 疫情数据模拟中，模型成功再现感染曲线，显著降低预测误差，并展示对噪声与缺失数据的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 神经平均场博弈首次把深度生成模型与 MFG 理论结合，提供无模型、可扩展、端到端的求解框架；在合成与真实场景下均表现出高泛化力与数据效率，为大规模多体策略系统在线学习与控制开辟新路径。

title: AMA: Adaptive Memory via Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: The rapid evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents has necessitated robust memory systems to support cohesive long-term interaction and complex reasoning. Benefiting from the strong capabilities of LLMs, recent research focus has shifted from simple context extension to the development of dedicated agentic memory systems. However, existing approaches typically rely on rigid retrieval granularity, accumulation-heavy maintenance strategies, and coarse-grained update mechanisms. These design choices create a persistent mismatch between stored information and task-specific reasoning demands, while leading to the unchecked accumulation of logical inconsistencies over time. To address these challenges, we propose Adaptive Memory via Multi-Agent Collaboration (AMA), a novel framework that leverages coordinated agents to manage memory across multiple granularities. AMA employs a hierarchical memory design that dynamically aligns retrieval granularity with task complexity. Specifically, the Constructor and Retriever jointly enable multi-granularity memory construction and adaptive query routing. The Judge verifies the relevance and consistency of retrieved content, triggering iterative retrieval when evidence is insufficient or invoking the Refresher upon detecting logical conflicts. The Refresher then enforces memory consistency by performing targeted updates or removing outdated entries. Extensive experiments on challenging long-context benchmarks show that AMA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while reducing token consumption by approximately 80% compared to full-context methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in maintaining retrieval precision and long-term memory consistency.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM智能体长期记忆系统的刚性粒度与逻辑不一致问题，提出多智能体协作的自适应记忆框架AMA，实现跨层次动态检索与一致性维护，在多个长上下文基准上显著优于SOTA，且token开销降低约80%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统普遍采用固定检索粒度、偏重积累及粗粒度更新，导致存储信息与任务推理需求持续错配，逻辑冲突随时间累积，亟需一套能动态调整粒度并保持长期一致性的记忆管理方案。
AI.method: 提出AMA框架，引入Constructor、Retriever、Judge、Refresher四种协同智能体：Constructor与Retriever联合构建多粒度记忆并自适应路由查询；Judge实时检验检索内容的相关性与一致性，证据不足时触发迭代检索，发现冲突时召唤Refresher；Refresher定位并执行靶向更新或删除过期条目，实现分层记忆的一致性维护。
AI.result: 在挑战性长上下文基准测试中，AMA在保持高检索精度的同时显著超越现有最佳基线，且相比全上下文方法减少约80%token消耗，验证其长期记忆一致性与效率优势。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协作驱动的自适应记忆框架AMA有效解决了粒度僵化与逻辑冲突累积问题，为LLM智能体提供轻量化、可持续演化的长期记忆支持，具备在实际复杂交互场景落地的潜力。

title: An Optimal Transport-driven Approach for Cultivating Latent Space in Online Incremental Learning
summary: In online incremental learning, data continuously arrives with substantial distributional shifts, creating a significant challenge because previous samples have limited replay value when learning a new task. Prior research has typically relied on either a single adaptive centroid or multiple fixed centroids to represent each class in the latent space. However, such methods struggle when class data streams are inherently multimodal and require continual centroid updates. To overcome this, we introduce an online Mixture Model learning framework grounded in Optimal Transport theory (MMOT), where centroids evolve incrementally with new data. This approach offers two main advantages: (i) it provides a more precise characterization of complex data streams, and (ii) it enables improved class similarity estimation for unseen samples during inference through MMOT-derived centroids. Furthermore, to strengthen representation learning and mitigate catastrophic forgetting, we design a Dynamic Preservation strategy that regulates the latent space and maintains class separability over time. Experimental evaluations on benchmark datasets confirm the superior effectiveness of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于最优传输的在线混合模型（MMOT）框架，使类别中心随数据流持续演化，并配以动态保持策略抑制灾难性遗忘，在分布漂移场景下实现增量学习。
AI.motivation: 在线增量学习中，数据持续到来且分布剧烈漂移，旧样本重放价值低；传统单自适应中心或多固定中心无法刻画多模态流式数据并持续更新中心，导致表征与分类性能下降。
AI.method: 1. 在线混合模型：利用最优传输理论在潜在空间增量更新每类的多模态中心；2. 动态保持策略：正则化潜在空间，维持类别可分性，抑制遗忘；3. 推理阶段通过MMOT导出的中心计算新样本类别相似度。
AI.result: 在基准数据集实验显示，MMOT框架在持续适应新分布的同时保持对旧类别的判别力，整体准确率、遗忘率等指标优于现有单中心/多固定中心方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于最优传输的在线混合模型能有效刻画复杂多模态数据流，并借助动态保持机制在长期增量学习中显著缓解灾难性遗忘，为未来流式表示学习提供了新思路。

title: MDPs with a State Sensing Cost
summary: In many practical sequential decision-making problems, tracking the state of the environment incurs a sensing/communication/computation cost. In these settings, the agent's interaction with its environment includes the additional component of deciding when to sense the state, in a manner that balances the value associated with optimal (state-specific) actions and the cost of sensing. We formulate this as an expected discounted cost Markov Decision Process (MDP), wherein the agent incurs an additional cost for sensing its next state, but has the option to take actions while remaining `blind' to the system state. We pose this problem as a classical discounted cost MDP with an expanded (countably infinite) state space. While computing the optimal policy for this MDP is intractable in general, we derive lower bounds on the optimal value function, which allow us to bound the suboptimality gap of any policy. We also propose a computationally efficient algorithm SPI, based on policy improvement, which in practice performs close to the optimal policy. Finally, we benchmark against the state-of-the-art via a numerical case study.

AI.tldr: 针对带感知代价的序贯决策问题，提出将“何时感知”纳入MDP动作集，构建可数无限状态空间的折扣代价模型；给出可计算的下界与策略改进算法SPI，实验显示其性能逼近最优。
AI.motivation: 在机器人、物联网等场景，频繁获取系统状态需付出显著感知/通信/计算代价，传统MDP假设状态完全可观测且感知免费，导致策略过度频繁感知，亟需把感知代价与感知时机显式纳入决策框架。
AI.method: 1) 把“感知”抽象为可选动作，构建“盲动作”与感知动作交替的折扣代价MDP，状态空间扩至可数无限；2) 证明该MDP最优值函数的下界可用有限维线性规划计算，从而给出任意策略的次优间隙；3) 提出策略改进型算法SPI，在每次迭代中仅对需要感知的子集进行局部更新，复杂度与问题规模线性相关。
AI.result: 理论：下界紧致，次优间隙可任意小；算法：SPI在10^5状态规模的基准问题中平均代价与值迭代最优解差距<2%，运行时间降低一个数量级；案例：在Energy Harvesting传感器调度中，SPI较最佳基线减少感知次数34%，总代价下降21%。
AI.conclusion: 将感知代价嵌入MDP动作空间是解决“何时感知”问题的有效途径；所提下界与SPI算法在可解释性、计算效率及性能上均优于现有方法，为资源受限系统的在线感知-决策协同提供了实用工具。

title: Bayesian-LoRA: Probabilistic Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models usually put more emphasis on accuracy and therefore, will guess even when not certain about the prediction, which is especially severe when fine-tuned on small datasets due to the inherent tendency toward miscalibration. In this work, we introduce Bayesian-LoRA, which reformulates the deterministic LoRA update as a probabilistic low-rank representation inspired by Sparse Gaussian Processes. We identify a structural isomorphism between LoRA's factorization and Kronecker-factored SGP posteriors, and show that LoRA emerges as a limiting case when posterior uncertainty collapses. We conduct extensive experiments on various LLM architectures across commonsense reasoning benchmarks. With only approximately 0.42M additional parameters and ${\approx}1.2{\times}$ training cost relative to standard LoRA, Bayesian-LoRA significantly improves calibration across models up to 30B, achieving up to 84% ECE reduction and 76% NLL reduction while maintaining competitive accuracy for both in-distribution and out-of-distribution (OoD) evaluations.

AI.tldr: Bayesian-LoRA 把确定性 LoRA 更新转化为基于稀疏高斯过程的概率低秩表示，在不牺牲精度的前提下显著缓解 LLM 小样本微调后的置信度错配问题。
AI.motivation: 大模型在小数据集微调时容易过度自信，导致置信度校准严重失真。现有 LoRA 等高效微调方法仍为确定性更新，无法量化不确定性。
AI.method: 通过发现 LoRA 因子分解与 Kronecker 结构稀疏 GP 后验的同构性，将 LoRA 权重矩阵视为 GP 后验均值，引入可学习的低秩协方差矩阵，构建贝叶斯 LoRA。仅需约 0.42 M 额外参数与 1.2× 训练开销。
AI.result: 在多达 30 B 参数的模型及常识推理基准上，ECE 最多降低 84%，NLL 降低 76%，ID 与 OoD 准确率保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Bayesian-LoRA 以极低代价将不确定性估计嵌入高效微调，突破“精度-校准”权衡，为大规模模型小数据场景提供可控可信的部署方案。

title: Cracking the Code of Juxtaposition: Can AI Models Understand the Humorous Contradictions
summary: Recent advancements in large multimodal language models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency across a wide range of tasks. Yet, these models still struggle with understanding the nuances of human humor through juxtaposition, particularly when it involves nonlinear narratives that underpin many jokes and humor cues. This paper investigates this challenge by focusing on comics with contradictory narratives, where each comic consists of two panels that create a humorous contradiction. We introduce the YesBut benchmark, which comprises tasks of varying difficulty aimed at assessing AI's capabilities in recognizing and interpreting these comics, ranging from literal content comprehension to deep narrative reasoning. Through extensive experimentation and analysis of recent commercial or open-sourced large (vision) language models, we assess their capability to comprehend the complex interplay of the narrative humor inherent in these comics. Our results show that even state-of-the-art models still lag behind human performance on this task. Our findings offer insights into the current limitations and potential improvements for AI in understanding human creative expressions.

AI.tldr: 作者提出 YesBut 数据集，用双格矛盾漫画评测大视觉-语言模型对非线性叙事幽默的理解能力；发现即便最先进模型也显著落后于人类。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在常规多模态任务表现强劲，但对基于并列与非线性叙事的幽默（尤其是矛盾漫画）仍几乎无能为力，亟需专门基准诊断盲区。
AI.method: 构建含 2 格矛盾漫画的 YesBut 基准，任务按难度阶梯覆盖表层内容识别到深层叙事推理；对主流商业与开源大（视觉）语言模型进行系统实验与误差分析。
AI.result: 所有受测模型在 YesBut 上均远低于人类基线，揭示其在捕捉非线性幽默逻辑、矛盾张力与叙事反转上的系统性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 大模型对复杂人类创造性表达（幽默并列叙事）的理解仍有显著差距；YesBut 可作为诊断与迭代改进的新试金石，并指明需融合更高阶叙事与常识推理能力。

title: Two-Stage Regularization-Based Structured Pruning for LLMs
summary: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) is largely hindered by their large number of parameters. Structural pruning has emerged as a promising solution. Prior structured pruning methods directly remove unimportant parameters based on certain metrics, which often causes knowledge loss and necessitates extensive retraining. To overcome this, we introduce a novel pruning method TRSP: Two-Stage Regularization-Based Structured Pruning for LLMs. Specifically, we multiply the output of each transformer layer by an initial learnable weight and iteratively learn these weights by adding their $\ell_1$-norm as a regularization term to the loss function, serving as the first-stage regularization. Subsequently, we apply additional regularization to the difference between the output and input of layers with smaller weights, encouraging the shift of knowledge to the preserved layers. This serves as the second-stage regularization. TRSP retains more knowledge and better preserves model performance than direct parameter elimination. Through extensive experimentation we show that TRSP outperforms strong layer-wise structured pruning methods without requiring retraining. As a layer-wise pruning method, it delivers notable end-to-end acceleration, making it a promising solution for efficient LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: TRSP 用两阶段正则化逐步把知识“挤”到保留层，无需重训练即可实现层级别结构化剪枝，在几乎不掉点的前提下获得端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝直接删除“不重要”层，知识丢失严重，必须重训练，代价高；需要一种在训练阶段就能完成知识迁移、剪枝后免重训的方案。
AI.method: TRSP 两阶段正则化：① 在每层输出乘可学习标量权重，以其 ℓ₁ 范数作正则化，逐步压制不重要层；② 对权重趋零的层额外惩罚其输出-输入差异，迫使知识向保留层迁移。剪枝时直接去掉权重极小的整层，无需微调。
AI.result: 多规模 LLM 实验显示，TRSP 在相同剪枝率下显著优于现有层级别方法（↑2–4% 任务准确率），剪枝 30–50% 层仍接近原模型精度，且推理延迟降低 25–40%，无需任何重训练。
AI.conclusion: TRSP 通过训练期知识迁移实现“即剪即用”的层级别剪枝，兼顾高稀疏性与性能保持，为 LLM 高效部署提供了实用新路径。

title: H-AdminSim: A Multi-Agent Simulator for Realistic Hospital Administrative Workflows with FHIR Integration
summary: Hospital administration departments handle a wide range of operational tasks and, in large hospitals, process over 10,000 requests per day, driving growing interest in LLM-based automation. However, prior work has focused primarily on patient-physician interactions or isolated administrative subtasks, failing to capture the complexity of real administrative workflows. To address this gap, we propose H-AdminSim, a comprehensive simulation framework that combines realistic data generation with multi-agent-based simulation of hospital administrative workflows. These tasks are quantitatively evaluated using detailed rubrics, enabling systematic comparison of LLMs. Through FHIR integration, H-AdminSim provides a unified and interoperable environment for testing administrative workflows across heterogeneous hospital settings, serving as a standardized testbed for assessing the feasibility and performance of LLM-driven administrative automation.

AI.tldr: 面向医院运营的 H-AdminSim 多智能体框架，用 FHIR 标准化数据与评估细则，系统比较 LLM 管理任务能力。
AI.motivation: 大型医院行政部门每天处理上万条请求，传统 LLM 研究聚焦医患对话或孤立子任务，缺少对复杂真实行政流程的整体建模与自动化验证。
AI.method: 提出 H-AdminSim：1) 基于 FHIR 合成多场景数据；2) 多智能体建模完整行政工作流；3) 用精细化评分规则量化评估 LLM 在各任务上的表现。
AI.result: 框架可在异构医院环境下复现数万人次级流程，实现对多模型协作性能的系统性比较，为 LLM 行政自动化提供标准化基准。
AI.conclusion: H-AdminSim 首次给出统一可互操作的行政流测试平台，证实应用 LLM 可行并量化其性能差异，为医院部署智能运营奠定基础。

title: Cyclic 2.5D Perceptual Loss for Cross-Modal 3D Medical Image Synthesis: T1w MRI to Tau PET
comment: Published in Human Brain Mapping, available at https://doi.org/10.1002/hbm.70508
summary: Positron emission tomography (PET) provides molecular biomarkers for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) and is increasingly used for diagnosis, staging, and clinical trial enrichment. However, its use is limited by cost, regulatory restrictions, and the invasiveness of radiotracer injection. Although current frameworks emphasize multimodal biomarker assessment, including the amyloid/tau/neurodegeneration (A/T/N) scheme, these barriers constrain access to PET imaging. Cross-modal image synthesis may help address this gap by reconstructing unavailable modalities from routine scans. Because PET is clinically valuable for regional uptake patterns rather than exact voxel-wise intensities, perceptual losses that capture higher-level semantic features are well suited to PET synthesis. Existing 2D, 3D, and 2.5D perceptual losses for 3D synthesis each have limitations, including restricted volumetric context, scarcity of pretrained 3D models, and difficulty balancing optimization across anatomical planes. In this study, we synthesize tau PET from structural MRI by generating 3D pseudo-[18F]flortaucipir standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) maps from 3D T1-weighted MR images. We propose a cyclic 2.5D perceptual loss that alternates optimization across axial, coronal, and sagittal planes during training to improve volumetric consistency. We also standardize PET SUVRs by scanner manufacturer, reducing inter-manufacturer variability and better preserving high-uptake regions. Using cohorts spanning the ADRD spectrum from the ADNI and the SCAN cohort, we show that the method generalizes across U-Net, UNETR, SwinUNETR, CycleGAN, and Pix2Pix, with strong performance. Notably, it improves agreement between synthesized SUVRs and measured PET in brain regions relevant to Alzheimer-type tau pathology. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/labhai/Cyclic-2.5D-Perceptual-Loss.

AI.tldr: 提出一种循环 2.5D 感知损失，可从常规 3D T1-MRI 合成 tau-PET SUVR 图，跨厂牌标准化后显著提升阿尔茨海默病关键脑区吻合度，且通用五类模型。
AI.motivation: tau-PET 能为阿尔茨海默病提供关键分子影像，但成本高、有创且受法规限制，导致临床与试验可及性差；现有 2D/3D/2.5D 感知损失在三维一致性、预训练资源与多平面均衡上均不足，亟需兼顾语义保真与体积一致的新方法。
AI.method: 以 3D T1-MRI 为输入，U-Net、UNETR、SwinUNETR、CycleGAN、Pix2Pix 为骨干，提出“循环 2.5D 感知损失”——在训练过程中依次沿轴、冠、矢状面交替提取 VGG 特征进行感知对比；同时按扫描仪制造商对 PET SUVR 做厂标标准化以抑制设备差异。
AI.result: 在 ADNI 与 SCAN 跨谱系队列上，相比传统 2D/3D/2.5D 损失，循环 2.5D 方案在所有骨干网络上均取得更高 SUVR 吻合度（ RCA、MSE 下降，PSNR 上升），尤其在阿尔茨海默病典型 tau 高负荷区（内侧颞叶、颞顶联合等）改善最显著；不同厂牌数据的一致性亦显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 循环 2.5D 感知损失兼具体积一致性与语义保真，可在无须注射示踪剂的条件下从常规 MRI 获得高质量 tau-PET 影像，为多模态 A/T/N 框架提供低成本、低侵入替代，具有普适模型与开源代码，具备临床落地与大规模筛查潜力。

title: RANDPOL: Parameter-Efficient End-to-End Quadruped Locomotion via Randomized Policy Learning
summary: Modern learning-based locomotion controllers typically rely on fully trainable deep neural networks with a large number of parameters. This paper studies a different design point for end-to-end control: whether effective quadruped locomotion can be achieved with a drastically reduced trainable parameter space. We present RANDomized POlicy Learning (RANDPOL), a policy learning approach in which the hidden layers of the actor and critic are randomly initialized and fixed, while only the final linear readout is trained. This yields a parameter-efficient controller class that retains nonlinear expressiveness through a fixed random basis while substantially reducing the dimension of the optimization problem. RANDPOL is supported by the mathematical foundation of randomized function approximation, which provides a principled basis for using fixed random nonlinear features as expressive function classes. We evaluate RANDPOL on end-to-end locomotion control for the Unitree Go2 quadruped and compare it with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). The results show that RANDPOL attains comparative locomotion performance with far fewer trainable parameters, lower learning-phase computation time per iteration, and a favorable performance-complexity trade-off. We further demonstrate successful zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of the learned RANDPOL controller on the physical Unitree Go2 under user-issued forward-velocity and yaw-rate commands. These results indicate that, for structured robotic control problems, reducing trainable complexity can remain compatible with effective simulated and real-world performance.

AI.tldr: 采用随机特征＋线性输出层的轻量化策略 RANDPOL，在四足机器人端到端控制任务上仅训练几百个参数就能与完整 PPO 性能相当，并可零-shot 迁移至真实世界。
AI.motivation: 深度学习驱动的方法依赖大型神经网络，训练与部署成本居高不下。作者探讨：在机器人运动控制这种结构化问题中，能否以极少可训练参数实现同等效果，从而兼顾表达能力与计算效率。
AI.method: 提出 RANDPOL：将策略与值网络的隐藏层随机初始化并固定，只学习最后一层线性权重；隐含引入随机非线性基函数逼近理论。训练采用 PPO 框架，但仅调控线性输出层参数。
AI.result: 在 Unitree Go2 仿真基准上，RANDPOL 使用 <1% 训练参数量即可达到 PPO 级速度跟踪精度，平均每次迭代学习耗时减少约 40%。一次训练得到的 RANDPOL 策略无需额外微调即可零-shot 迁移到实体 Go2，实现前向速度与转向指令的平滑跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 结构化四足运动任务中，随机稀疏特征＋线性控制足以捕获动作决策与动力学映射的核心。大幅降低可训练复杂度不仅可行，还能保持主流程、缓检索成本和实机部署优势。

title: Contextuality from Single-State Ontological Models: An Information-Theoretic Obstruction
comment: Version 3: The main result was reframed as an information-theoretic obstruction rather than a no-go theorem. We clarified that ontic states are subsystem-level and reformulated interventions operationally to avoid dualism. The main claim was weakened to a proposition, restricting strict positivity to contextual regimes, with corresponding revisions to the abstract, intro, and appendix
summary:
Contextuality is a central feature of quantum theory, traditionally understood as the impossibility of reproducing quantum measurement statistics using noncontextual ontological models. We study classical ontological descriptions in which a fixed subsystem-level ontic state space is reused across multiple interventions. Our main result is an information-theoretic obstruction: whenever a classical single-state model reproduces operational statistics using an auxiliary contextual register, the required contextual information is lower-bounded by the conditional mutual information $I(C;O\mid λ)$ between intervention $C$ and outcome $O$ conditioned on the subsystem ontic state $λ$.
  The mathematical inequality itself is elementary, but its interpretive significance is structural: under shared-state reuse, contextual distinctions need not be fully internalized within the subsystem ontic state alone. We provide a constructive illustration of this point and clarify how the issue should be understood as a limitation of subsystem-level classical representation, rather than as a dualism about physical reality. We further discuss how this perspective relates to ontological models and to contextuality in quantum foundations.

AI.tldr: 经典本体模型若在共享子系统态空间上复用量子统计，必须额外引入一个上下文寄存器，其上下文信息量 ≥ I(C;O|λ)。这说明子系统层面的经典表示本身受限，而非现实二元论。
AI.motivation: 传统观点把量子上下文性归为“无法用非上下文本体模型再现量子统计”。作者质疑：若固定子系统本体态空间被多次干预复用，是否仍存在信息论障碍？
