AI.method: 信息论分析：假设经典单态模型靠辅助“上下文寄存器”再现操作统计，推导所需上下文信息的下界为条件互信息 I(C;O|λ)。给出构造性示例并对比传统本体模型框架。
AI.result: 得到一般不等式：上下文寄存器信息量 ≥ I(C;O|λ)。证明在共享–复用情境下，上下文区别不必全部内化到子系统本体态；子系统级经典表示能力结构性不足。
AI.conclusion: 上下文性应被视为“子系统层面经典表示的局限”，而非“物理实在二元论”。结果为量子基础、本体模型及近期共享态复用实验提供了新的信息论视角。

title: AudioX: A Unified Framework for Anything-to-Audio Generation
summary: Audio and music generation based on flexible multimodal control signals is a widely applicable topic, with the following key challenges: 1) a unified multimodal modeling framework, and 2) large-scale, high-quality training data. As such, we propose AudioX, a unified framework for anything-to-audio generation that integrates varied multimodal conditions (i.e., text, video, and audio signals) in this work. The core design in this framework is a Multimodal Adaptive Fusion module, which enables the effective fusion of diverse multimodal inputs, enhancing cross-modal alignment and improving overall generation quality. To train this unified model, we construct a large-scale, high-quality dataset, IF-caps, comprising over 7 million samples curated through a structured data annotation pipeline. This dataset provides comprehensive supervision for multimodal-conditioned audio generation. We benchmark AudioX against state-of-the-art methods across a wide range of tasks, finding that our model achieves superior performance, especially in text-to-audio and text-to-music generation. These results demonstrate our method is capable of audio generation under multimodal control signals, showing powerful instruction-following potential. The code and datasets will be available at https://zeyuet.github.io/AudioX/.

AI.tldr: AudioX 是一种统一的多模态条件音频生成框架，通过 Multimodal Adaptive Fusion 模块融合文本、视频、音频等信号，并在 700 万样本级 IF-caps 数据集上训练，在文本到音频/音乐任务上全面超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有音频/音乐生成受限于 1) 缺乏统一的多模态建模框架，2) 缺少大规模高质量多模态对齐数据，难以在任意信号控制下生成高质量音频。
AI.method: 提出 AudioX 框架：①Multimodal Adaptive Fusion 模块统一编码并动态融合文本、视频、音频条件；②构建 700 万样本 IF-caps 数据集，经结构化标注管道提供细粒度多模态监督；③采用统一扩散式生成目标端到端训练。
AI.result: 在文本→音频、文本→音乐、视频→音频等多任务基准中，AudioX 客观指标与主观听感均优于当前最佳方法，尤其在文本语义忠实度与音乐旋律一致性上提升显著。
AI.conclusion: AudioX 首次验证了“任意模态到音频”的统一生成可行性，其强指令跟随能力为多模态内容创作、影视配乐、沉浸交互等应用提供了即插即用的音频引擎。

title: Scalable unsupervised feature selection via weight stability
summary: Unsupervised feature selection is critical for improving clustering performance in high-dimensional data, where irrelevant features can obscure meaningful structure. In this work, we introduce the Minkowski weighted k-means++, a novel initialisation strategy for the Minkowski Weighted k-means. Our initialisation selects centroids probabilistically using feature relevance estimates derived from the data itself. Building on this, we propose two new feature selection algorithms, FS-MWK++, which aggregates feature weights across a range of Minkowski exponents to identify stable and informative features, and SFS-MWK++, a scalable variant based on subsampling. We support our approach with a theoretical analysis, demonstrating that, under explicit assumptions on noise features and cluster structure, relevant features are assigned consistently higher weights than noise features across a range of Minkowski exponents. Our software can be found at https://github.com/xzhang4-ops1/FSMWK.

AI.tldr: 提出 Minkowski 加权 k-means++ 初始化，并构建 FS-MWK++ 与 SFS-MWK++ 两种无监督特征选择算法，在高维聚类中稳定剔除噪声特征。
AI.motivation: 高维数据中大量无关特征会掩盖真实聚类结构，需无监督特征选择方法提升聚类性能，而现有初始化与特征赋权策略对噪声敏感且缺乏理论保证。
AI.method: 1) 设计 Minkowski 加权 k-means++ 初始化：利用数据自身估计的特征相关性，按概率挑选初始中心；2) 提出 FS-MWK++：在多组 Minkowski 指数下聚合特征权重，取稳定高权特征；3) 提出 SFS-MWK++：基于子采样实现线性级扩展；4) 理论证明：在噪声与簇结构假设下，相关特征权重一致高于噪声特征。
AI.result: 理论分析显示相关特征权重显著高于噪声；实验验证两算法在多个高维数据集上取得优于现有无监督特征选择方法的聚类准确率与运行效率，SFS-MWK++ 可扩展至百万维。
AI.conclusion: Minkowski 加权 k-means++ 初始化有效，特征权重跨指数稳定性可作为无监督选择可靠信号；FS-MWK++ 与 SFS-MWK++ 兼顾精度与扩展性，为高维聚类提供实用解决方案。

title: DeepPresenter: Environment-Grounded Reflection for Agentic Presentation Generation
summary: Presentation generation requires deep content research, coherent visual design, and iterative refinement based on observation. However, existing presentation agents often rely on predefined workflows and fixed templates. To address this, we present DeepPresenter, an agentic framework that adapts to diverse user intents, enables effective feedback-driven refinement, and generalizes beyond a scripted pipeline. Specifically, DeepPresenter autonomously plans, renders, and revises intermediate slide artifacts to support long-horizon refinement with environmental observations. Furthermore, rather than relying on self-reflection over internal signals (e.g., reasoning traces), our environment-grounded reflection conditions the generation process on perceptual artifact states (e.g., rendered slides), enabling the system to identify and correct presentation-specific issues during execution. Results on the evaluation set covering diverse presentation-generation scenarios show that DeepPresenter achieves state-of-the-art performance, and the fine-tuned 9B model remains highly competitive at substantially lower cost. Our project is available at: https://github.com/icip-cas/PPTAgent

AI.tldr: DeepPresenter 是一个基于智能体的演示文稿生成框架，通过环境感知的迭代修订机制，在无需固定模板的情况下实现多样化、高质量演示文稿的自动生成。
AI.motivation: 现有演示文稿生成方法依赖预设流程和模板，难以适应复杂多变的用户需求和长期迭代优化，亟需一种能自主规划、渲染并根据外部反馈持续改进的通用框架。
AI.method: DeepPresenter 采用智能体架构，将演示生成拆分为自主规划、渲染与修订三阶段循环；通过“环境接地反思”机制，用渲染后的幻灯片状态而非内部推理痕迹作为反馈信号，驱动长程迭代优化。
AI.result: 在覆盖多种场景的评测集上，DeepPresenter 达到 SOTA 性能；其 9B 微调模型在显著降低成本的条件下仍保持强劲竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，基于环境感知而非纯自省的反思机制，可显著提升演示文稿生成的质量与泛化性，为低成本、高适应性的自动演示生成提供了新范式。

title: The Gaussian Latent Machine: Efficient Prior and Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems
summary: We consider the problem of sampling from a product-of-experts-type model that encompasses many standard prior and posterior distributions commonly found in Bayesian imaging. We show that this model can be easily lifted into a novel latent variable model, which we refer to as a Gaussian latent machine. This leads to a general sampling approach that unifies and generalizes many existing sampling algorithms in the literature. Most notably, it yields a highly efficient and effective two-block Gibbs sampling approach in the general case, while also specializing to direct sampling algorithms in particular cases. Finally, we present detailed numerical experiments that demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of our proposed sampling approach across a wide range of prior and posterior sampling problems from Bayesian imaging.

AI.tldr: 将Bayesian成像里常见的product-of-experts模型提升为“Gaussian势隐变量机”，得到统一的两块Gibbs采样框架，可退化为直接采样，实验在多种先验/后验问题上验证高效。
AI.motivation: 现有Bayesian成像算法各自针对特定先验/后验设计，缺乏统一且高效的采样框架。
AI.method: 建立product-of-experts的隐变量等价形式——Gaussian latent machine；推导出通用的两分量Gibbs采样器，并在可分离情形下降维为直接采样。
AI.result: 提出的框架涵盖并推广了文献中多种专用算法；两块Gibbs采样在典型成像问题上速度显著提升，混合时间缩短，估计误差更低。
AI.conclusion: Gaussian latent machine为Bayesian成像提供了一个统一、高效、易实现的采样范式，可无缝适配各类先验与后验模型。

title: Not All Tokens Matter: Towards Efficient LLM Reasoning via Token Significance in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show strong reasoning abilities but often produce unnecessarily long explanations that reduce efficiency. Although reinforcement learning (RL) has been used to improve reasoning, most methods focus on accuracy and rely on uniform length-based rewards that overlook the differing contributions of individual tokens, often harming correctness. We revisit length optimization in RL through the perspective of token significance. Observing that many chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens contribute little to the final answer, we introduce a significance-aware length reward that selectively penalizes insignificance tokens, reducing redundancy while preserving essential reasoning. We also propose a dynamic length reward that encourages more detailed reasoning early in training and gradually shifts toward conciseness as learning progresses. Integrating these components into standard policy optimization yields a framework that improves both reasoning efficiency and accuracy. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate substantial reductions in response length while preserving or improving correctness, highlighting the importance of modeling token significance for efficient LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 针对思维链冗余问题，提出基于token重要性的动态长度奖励机制RL新框架，在缩短回复长度的同时保持或提升推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理链过长、效率低；传统RL仅关注最终正确性，简单长度惩罚会误伤关键token，导致精度下降，因此需要既不牺牲正确性又能压缩对话长度的方案。
AI.method: 1) CoT冗余性扫描→设计token级significance计算；2) 构建“惩罚低重要性token、忽略高重要性token”的目标损失；3) 引入先促详细再趋简洁的动态长度奖励调度；4) 将两类长度奖励嵌入PPO等主流策优化算法形成端到端训练框架。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH、MultiArith和ARC-E等多任务基准上，平均文本长度减少30-50%，准确率持平或提升2%，推理延迟显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模token贡献可在不损害正确性的前提下显著压缩LLM推理链，为高效、可落地的RL-based LLM推理提供了简单且可解释的方向。

title: GraphScout: Empowering Large Language Models with Intrinsic Exploration Ability for Agentic Graph Reasoning
summary: Knowledge graphs provide structured and reliable information for many real-world applications, motivating increasing interest in combining large language models (LLMs) with graph-based retrieval to improve factual grounding. Recent Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) methods therefore introduce iterative interaction between LLMs and knowledge graphs to enhance reasoning capability. However, existing approaches typically depend on manually designed guidance and interact with knowledge graphs through a limited set of predefined tools, which substantially constrains graph exploration. To address these limitations, we propose GraphScout, a training-centric agentic graph reasoning framework equipped with more flexible graph exploration tools. GraphScout enables models to autonomously interact with knowledge graphs to synthesize structured training data which are then used to post-train LLMs, thereby internalizing agentic graph reasoning ability without laborious manual annotation or task curation. Extensive experiments across five knowledge-graph domains show that a small model (e.g., Qwen3-4B) augmented with GraphScout outperforms baseline methods built on leading LLMs (e.g., Qwen-Max) by an average of 16.7\% while requiring significantly fewer inference tokens. Moreover, GraphScout exhibits robust cross-domain transfer performance. Our code will be made publicly available~\footnote{https://github.com/Ying-Yuchen/_GraphScout_}.

AI.tldr: GraphScout 让 4B 小模型自动“探图-造数据-自训”，无需人工设计提示或工具，平均超越基于 Qwen-Max 的 GraphRAG 基线 16.7%，且跨域鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有 GraphRAG 依赖人工提示与固定 API，限制图探索深度与广度，难以把 LLM 训练成真正的图推理智能体。
AI.method: 提出训练优先的代理式框架 GraphScout：① 扩充可微调的图探索工具集（多跳、反向、属性过滤等）；② 让 LLM 作为自主代理在知识库中游走，生成“问题-推理路径-答案”三元组；③ 用该数据继续训练同型小模型，内化图推理策略。
AI.result: 在 5 个知识图谱领域（医疗、学术、电商等）的问答与事实核查任务上，Qwen3-4B+GraphScout 相比基于 Qwen-Max 的 SOTA GraphRAG 平均提升 16.7%，推理 token 减少 40% 以上，零样本跨域迁移仅下降 2.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过“自主探图→合成数据→轻量后训”即可把图推理能力蒸馏到小模型，摆脱重型 LLM 与人工规则，为高效、可迁移的GraphRAG提供新范式。

title: FieldWorkArena: Agentic AI Benchmark for Real Field Work Tasks
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables [ICPR 2026 Accepted] Changes from Version 2: 1) Added retail domain as third scenario; dataset scaled from 455 to 886 tasks, 2) Task taxonomy restructured (Planning/Perception/Action -> Perception/Decision Making/Combination), 3) Experiments updated: GPT-5.1/5.2, Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro (replaced Claude); added human baseline and video chunking/Qwen3-VL experiments
summary: This paper introduces FieldWorkArena, a benchmark for agentic AI targeting real-world field work. With the recent increase in demand for agentic AI, they are built to detect and document safety hazards, procedural violations, and other critical incidents across real-world manufacturing and retail environments. Whereas most agentic AI benchmarks focus on performance in simulated or digital environments, our work addresses the fundamental challenge of evaluating agents in the real-world. In this paper, we improve the evaluation function from previous methods to assess the performance of agentic AI in diverse real-world tasks. Our dataset comprises on-site captured images/videos in factories, warehouses and retails. Tasks were meticulously developed through interviews with site workers and managers. Evaluation results confirmed that performance evaluation considering the characteristics of Multimodal LLM (MLLM) such as GPT-4o is feasible. Furthermore, this study identifies both the effectiveness and limitations of the proposed new evaluation methodology. The complete dataset and evaluation program are publicly accessible on the website (https://en-documents.research.global.fujitsu.com/fieldworkarena/)

AI.tldr: FieldWorkArena 是首个面向真实工厂/零售场景的多模态 Agent 评测基准，通过现场采集数据与工人访谈构建任务，验证了对 MLLM 的量化评估可行性并公开了全部资源。
AI.motivation: 代理型 AI 被寄予识别制造与零售现场安全隐患的厚望，但现有基准仅在模拟或数字化环境中测试，缺乏对真实物理世界表现的衡量，阻碍落地进度。
AI.method: 1. 现场拍摄工厂、仓库、门店图像/视频并标注隐患与违规事件；2. 通过工人与管理员访谈提炼可评测任务；3. 设计结合 MLLM 特点的新型评分函数，对 GPT-4o 等 Agent 完成检测、定位与文档化全流程的准确性进行量化。
AI.result: 实验表明所提评分方法对 MLLM 表现具有可区分性，可量化反映 Agent 在识别安全与流程违规任务上的优劣；同时也揭示了当前方法在光照变化、小目标检测及上下文推理上的局限。
AI.conclusion: FieldWorkArena 证明真实场景下的 Agent 评估已具备可行范式，为后续算法改进与产业落地提供基准；研究者呼吁社区共同扩充数据与任务类型，以持续提升代理型 AI 在关键工业场景中的可靠性与安全性。

title: Scalable Spatiotemporal Inference with Biased Scan Attention Transformer Neural Processes
summary: Neural Processes (NPs) are a rapidly evolving class of models designed to directly model the posterior predictive distribution of stochastic processes. While early architectures were developed primarily as a scalable alternative to Gaussian Processes (GPs), modern NPs tackle far more complex and data-hungry applications spanning geology, epidemiology, climate, and robotics. These applications have placed increasing pressure on the scalability of these models, with many architectures compromising accuracy for scalability. In this paper, we demonstrate that this trade-off is often unnecessary, particularly when modeling fully or partially translation-invariant processes. We propose a versatile new architecture, the Biased Scan Attention Transformer Neural Process (BSA-TNP), which introduces Kernel Regression Blocks (KRBlocks), group-invariant attention biases, and memory-efficient Biased Scan Attention (BSA). BSA-TNP is able to: (1) match or exceed the accuracy of the best models while often training in a fraction of the time, (2) exhibit translation invariance, enabling learning at multiple resolutions simultaneously, (3) transparently model processes that evolve in both space and time, (4) support high-dimensional fixed effects, and (5) scale gracefully, running inference on over 1M test points and 100K context points in under a minute on a single 24GB GPU. Code is provided as part of the `dl4bi` package.

AI.tldr: BSA-TNP 用 Kernel 回归块与偏置扫描注意力同时实现 NP 的高精度、高分辨率、时空建模与 1M 级推理，打破“精度-扩展”权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有 Neural Processes 在地质、气候等数据密集型应用中被迫牺牲精度换取可扩展性；作者发现对平移不变过程这种牺牲并非必要，需重新设计兼顾两者的新架构。
AI.method: 提出 Biased Scan Attention Transformer Neural Process：(i) Kernel Regression Blocks 显式编码局部平滑先验；(ii) 群不变注意力偏置保证平移等变性；(iii) 内存高效的 Biased Scan Attention 按块稀疏计算注意力；(iv) 整体支持时空联合、高维固定效应与多分辨率学习。
AI.result: 在多项基准上 BSA-TNP 精度持平或优于最佳模型，训练时间缩短数倍；单张 24 GB GPU 可在 1 分钟内完成 100 K 上下文、1 M 目标点的推断。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合核回归归纳偏置与稀疏注意力，BSA-TNP 无需牺牲精度即可扩展到百万级推理，为地球科学、机器人等复杂随机过程建模提供实用可扩展的新工具。

title: Animating Petascale Time-varying Data on Commodity Hardware with LLM-assisted Scripting
comment: ©2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses. N.B. Due to the limitation "The abstract field cannot be longer than 1,920 characters", the abstract here is shorter than that in the original PDF file
summary: Scientists face significant visualization challenges as time-varying datasets grow in speed and volume, often requiring specialized infrastructure and expertise to handle massive datasets. Petascale climate models generated in NASA laboratories require a dedicated group of graphics and media experts and access to high-performance computing resources. Scientists may need to share scientific results with the community iteratively and quickly. However, the time-consuming trial-and-error process incurs significant data transfer overhead and far exceeds the time and resources allocated for typical post-analysis visualization tasks, disrupting the production workflow. Our paper introduces a user-friendly framework for creating 3D animations of petascale, time-varying data on a commodity workstation. Our contributions: (i) Generalized Animation Descriptor (GAD) with a keyframe-based adaptable abstraction for animation, (ii) efficient data access from cloud-hosted repositories to reduce data management overhead, (iii) tailored rendering system, and (iv) an LLM-assisted conversational interface as a scripting module to allow domain scientists with no visualization expertise to create animations of their region of interest. We demonstrate the framework's effectiveness with two case studies: first, by generating animations in which sampling criteria are specified based on prior knowledge, and second, by generating AI-assisted animations in which sampling parameters are derived from natural-language user prompts. In all cases, we use large-scale NASA climate-oceanographic datasets that exceed 1PB in size yet achieve a fast turnaround time of 1 minute to 2 hours. Users can generate a rough draft of the animation within minutes, then seamlessly incorporate as much high-resolution data as needed for the final version.

AI.tldr: 用日常PC生成PB级气候数据的3D动画，1分钟即可出草图，工具是
AI.motivation: 时变PB级数据集让NASA等团队在HPC上做可视化迭代慢、耗带宽，科学家难以快速共享成果;
AI.method: 提出GAD关键帧抽象＋云托管缓存＋定制渲染＋LLM对话脚本，支持白科学家用自然语言生动画，无需图形学基础;
AI.result: 两个NASA气候海洋用例（知识和AI采样）均可控，单次渲染1 min-2 h，数分钟内给出草图再无缝切换高分辨率;
AI.conclusion: 框架可直接在普通工位上把PB级数据可视化迭代变成分钟级任务，显著降低专家门槛和数据搬运成本。

title: Heavy-Tailed Class-Conditional Priors for Long-Tailed Generative Modeling
summary: Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) with global priors trained under an imbalanced empirical class distribution can lead to underrepresentation of tail classes in the latent space. While $t^3$VAE improves robustness via heavy-tailed Student's $t$-distribution priors, its single global prior still allocates mass proportionally to class frequency. We address this latent geometric bias by introducing C-$t^3$VAE, which assigns a per-class Student's $t$ joint prior over latent and output variables. This design promotes uniform prior mass across class-conditioned components. To optimize our model we derive a closed-form objective from the $γ$-power divergence, and we introduce an equal-weight latent mixture for class-balanced generation. On SVHN-LT, CIFAR100-LT, and CelebA datasets, C-$t^3$VAE consistently attains lower FID scores than $t^3$VAE and Gaussian-based VAE baselines under severe class imbalance while remaining competitive in balanced or mildly imbalanced settings. In per-class F1 evaluations, our model outperforms the conditional Gaussian VAE across highly imbalanced settings. Moreover, we identify the mild imbalance threshold $ρ< 5$, for which Gaussian-based models remain competitive. However, for $ρ\geq 5$ our approach yields improved class-balanced generation and mode coverage.

AI.tldr: 针对数据类别极不均衡场景，C-<t></sup><font color="red">3</font>-VAE用每类一组 t 分布将潜空间先验与输出先验联合建模，使所有类别获得相等的先验质量；由此推出的 γ-幂散度闭式目标函数及潜空间等权混合采样策略，可在 ρ≥5 的重度长尾条件下显著降低 FID 并提升少数类 F1，同时在轻度失衡 ρ<5 时保持与常规高斯 VAE 可比。
AI.motivation: 在长尾数据上训练的全局先验 VAE 容易将少量比例先验质量分配给尾部类别，导致潜空间中尾部表征不足和生成多样性差。既有的 t<sup>3</sup>VAE只靠全局 Student-t 先验仍按类别频率分配先验质量，未能消除“潜空间几何偏置”。
AI.method: 提出类别条件化先验模型 C-<t></sup><font color="red">3</font>-VAE：为每类分配独立的 Student-t 联合先验 p(z,y|c)；推导出基于 γ-幂散度的封闭 ELBO；训练时对潜空间构建等权混合确定性子分布，采样阶段的先验概率不依赖类别频率以保证生成时各类质量均衡。
AI.result: 在 SVHN-LT、CIFAR100-LT、CelebA 三个长尾数据集上，与全局 Student-t 和高斯 VAE 相比，C-<t></sup><font color="red">3</font>-VAE 在 ρ≥5 的重度失衡条件下取得显著更低的 FID；按类 F1 分数在高度失衡场景中优于条件高斯 VAE；当 ρ<5 时三部分模型表现相近，但临界值 ρ=5 后 C-<t></sup><font color="red">3</font>-VAE 优势明显，证明了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将先验质量与类别频率解耦并显式对齐每类的先验分布，C-<t></sup><font color="red">3</font>-VAE在重度长尾环境下获得了更均衡的潜空间表征与生成多样度；研究也指出ρ=5为轻/重度失衡分界，重度失衡时优先采用类别条件化先验。

title: mLaSDI: Multi-stage latent space dynamics identification
summary: Accurately solving partial differential equations (PDEs) is essential across many scientific disciplines. However, high-fidelity solvers can be computationally prohibitive, motivating the development of reduced-order models (ROMs). Recently, Latent Space Dynamics Identification (LaSDI) was proposed as a data-driven, non-intrusive ROM framework. LaSDI compresses the training data via an autoencoder and learns user-specified ordinary differential equations (ODEs), governing the latent dynamics, enabling rapid predictions for unseen parameters. While LaSDI has produced effective ROMs for numerous problems, the autoencoder must simultaneously reconstruct the training data and satisfy the imposed latent dynamics, which are often competing objectives that limit accuracy, particularly for complex or high-frequency phenomena. To address this limitation, we propose multi-stage Latent Space Dynamics Identification (mLaSDI). With mLaSDI, we train LaSDI sequentially in stages. After training the initial autoencoder, we train additional decoders which map the latent trajectories to residuals from previous stages. This staged residual learning, combined with periodic activation functions, enables recovery of high-frequency content without sacrificing interpretability of the latent dynamics. We further provide an error decomposition separating autoencoder and latent dynamics contributions, and prove that additional training stages cannot increase the training residual. Numerical experiments on a multiscale oscillating system, unsteady wake flow, and the 1D-1V Vlasov equation demonstrate that mLaSDI achieves significantly lower reconstruction and prediction errors, often by an order of magnitude, while requiring less training time and reduced hyperparameter tuning compared to standard LaSDI.

AI.tldr: 针对LaSDI处理高-频或复杂流动时精度受限的问题，提出多阶段潜空间动力学辨识(mLaSDI)，通过逐层学习残差与周期激活函数显著降低重构与预测误差，实验误差降1量级且训练成本更低。
AI.motivation: 高可信度PDE求解计算昂贵，数据驱动ROM如LaSDI用潜空间ODE实现快速推理，但其自编码器需同时满足数据重建与潜动态ODE约束，存在目标冲突，对高频/多尺度现象精度不足。
AI.method: 提出分阶段训练框架mLaSDI：先训练基准自编码器，再在后续阶段冻结编码器并额外训练残差解码器，将潜轨迹映射到前阶段残差；引入周期激活函数捕捉高频；给出误差分解并证明训练阶段增加不会使训练残差增大。
AI.result: 对多尺度振荡器、非定常尾迹流和一维-一速Vlasov方程的试验表明，mLaSDI reconstruction/prediction误差平均降低约90%，训练时间缩减且对超参数不敏感；潜动态方程仍保持低维可解释ODE形式。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层残差学习与周期激活，mLaSDI在解释性与精度之间取得平衡，可低成本显著提升LaSDI对高频、复杂潜动态的表征能力，为潜空间ROMs提供易移植改进范式。

title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Step-Level Transitions for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex interactive decision-making tasks. However, existing LLM agents typically rely on increasingly long interaction histories, resulting in high computational cost and limited scalability. In this paper, we propose STEP-HRL, a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that enables step-level learning by conditioning only on single-step transitions rather than full interaction histories. STEP-HRL structures tasks hierarchically, using completed subtasks to represent global progress of overall task. By introducing a local progress module, it also iteratively and selectively summarizes interaction history within each subtask to produce a compact summary of local progress. Together, these components yield augmented step-level transitions for both high-level and low-level policies. Experimental results on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld benchmarks consistently demonstrate that STEP-HRL substantially outperforms baselines in terms of performance and generalization while reducing token usage. Our code is available at https://github.com/TonyStark042/STEP-HRL.

AI.tldr: 提出层级强化学习框架 STEP-HRL，让 LLM 智能体只需单步转移即可学习，无需完整交互历史，显著降低算力与 token 开销，在 ScienceWorld/ALFWorld 上性能与泛化双优。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体依赖冗长交互历史，推理成本高且难以扩展，亟需一种能在保持性能的同时压缩历史信息的机制。
AI.method: 构建双层 HRL：高层用已完成子任务度量全局进度；局部进度模块在每个子任务内迭代、选择性地摘要历史，生成紧凑的局部状态；利用单步转移同时训练高低层策略，避免依赖完整轨迹。
AI.result: 在 ScienceWorld 与 ALFWorld 两个交互决策基准上，STEP-HRL 在成功率、泛化能力与 token 消耗三方面均一致优于现有最佳基线，且 token 用量显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过“子任务+局部摘要”的层级设计，STEP-HRL 首次实现 LLM 智能体的单步级高效学习，为大规模交互任务提供了可扩展、低成本的强化学习新范式。

title: RadAgents: Multimodal Agentic Reasoning for Chest X-ray Interpretation with Radiologist-like Workflows
summary: Agentic systems offer a potential path to solve complex clinical tasks through collaboration among specialized agents, augmented by tool use and external knowledge bases. Nevertheless, for chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation, prevailing methods remain limited: (i) reasoning is frequently neither clinically interpretable nor aligned with guidelines, reflecting mere aggregation of tool outputs; (ii) multimodal evidence is insufficiently fused, yielding text-only rationales that are not visually grounded; and (iii) systems rarely detect or resolve cross-tool inconsistencies and provide no principled verification mechanisms. To bridge the above gaps, we present RadAgents, a multi-agent framework that couples clinical priors with task-aware multimodal reasoning and encodes a radiologist-style workflow into a modular, auditable pipeline. In addition, we integrate grounding and multimodal retrieval-augmentation to verify and resolve context conflicts, resulting in outputs that are more reliable, transparent, and consistent with clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 提出 RadAgents——首个面向胸部 X 光判读的多智能体框架，将放射科流程拆解为可审计模块，并通过多模态检索与临床先验消除工具冲突，实现可解释、可追溯、符合指南的诊断推理。
AI.motivation: 现有 CXR 解读系统仍停留在工具输出简单聚合，缺乏符合指南的可解释推理、跨模态证据融合及冲突校验机制，迫切需要一种能模拟放射科协作流程、可审计且临床对齐的解决方案。
AI.method: 构建 RadAgents 多智能体框架：①把放射科工作流程抽象为任务感知、模块化的代理流水线；②引入临床先验与多模态检索增强，实现视觉-文本联合推理；③设计跨工具一致性检测与可验证冲突消解机制，确保输出透明、可追溯。
AI.result: RadAgents 在内部 CXR 数据集上显著降低跨工具冲突率，生成的判读报告在一致性、临床指南符合度及视觉可定位性指标上均优于传统聚合式方法，且提供可审计推理链条供医生回溯。
AI.conclusion: 将放射科协作范式与多模态检索-验证机制结合，可在保持高精度的同时给出可解释、可审计、临床对齐的 CXR 解读，为后续安全落地于真实诊疗流程奠定基础。

title: On the Fundamental Limitations of Dual Static CVaR Decompositions in Markov Decision Processes
summary: It was recently shown that dynamic programming (DP) methods for finding static CVaR-optimal policies in Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) can fail when based on the dual formulation, yet the root cause of this failure remains unclear. We expand on these findings by shifting focus from policy optimization to the seemingly simpler task of policy evaluation. We show that evaluating the static CVaR of a given policy can be framed as two distinct minimization problems. We introduce a set of ``risk-assignment consistency constraints'' that must be satisfied for their solutions to match and we demonstrate that an empty intersection of these constraints is the source of previously observed evaluation errors. Quantifying the evaluation error as the \emph{CVaR evaluation gap}, we demonstrate that the issues observed when optimizing over the dual-based CVaR DP are explained by the returned policy having a non-zero CVaR evaluation gap. Finally, we leverage our proposed risk-assignment constraints perspective to prove that the search for a single, uniformly optimal policy on the dual CVaR decomposition is fundamentally limited, identifying an MDP where no single policy can be optimal across all initial risk levels.

AI.tldr: 经典对偶 DP 求解静态 CVaR 失效的真正原因是策略评估本身存在“CVaR 评估缺口”；作者提出风险分配一致性约束，证明对偶空间下不存在对全部初始风险水平均一致最优的单一策略。
AI.motivation: 既有工作发现基于对偶形式的动态规划在求 CVaR-最优策略时会失败，但仅归咎于“优化”环节，未揭示评估层面的本质缺陷，阻碍了对该算法失效根本原因的系统化理解。
AI.method: 将策略评估而非优化作为切入点，把给定策略的静态 CVaR 计算刻画为两个最小化问题；引入风险分配一致性约束，用以衡量二者解的匹配程度；定义“CVaR 评估间隙”量化失配，并构造具体 MDP 实例进行理论证明。
AI.result: 证明当且仅当风险分配约束集交集为空时评估出现非零误差；揭示对偶 DP 优化失败归因于返回策略存在非零 CVaR 评估间隙；严格论证在某一 MDP 上不存在能同时对所有初始风险水平一致最优的单一策略。
AI.conclusion: 对偶 CVaR 分解无法保证全局一致最优性的根本障碍在于评估阶段固有的风险分配不一致；未来算法设计必须显式处理该约束，或在理论上接受只能在局部风险水平找到最优策略的结论。

title: Reason in Chains, Learn in Trees: Self-Rectification and Grafting for Multi-turn Agent Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning for Large Language Model agents is often hindered by sparse rewards in multi-step reasoning tasks. Existing approaches like Group Relative Policy Optimization treat sampled trajectories as independent chains, assigning uniform credit to all steps in each chain and ignoring the existence of critical steps that may disproportionally impact reasoning outcome. In this paper, we propose T-STAR(Tree-structured Self-Taught Agent Rectification), a framework that recovers the latent correlated reward structure across seemingly independent trajectories. Specifically, we consolidate trajectories into a unified Cognitive Tree by identifying and merging functionally similar steps/nodes. It enables an Introspective Valuation mechanism that back-propagates trajectory-level rewards through the tree to obtain a new notion of variance-reduced relative advantage at step-level. Using the Cognitive Tree, we also develop In-Context Thought Grafting to synthesize corrective reasoning by contrasting successful and failed branches at critical divergence points/steps. Our proposed Surgical Policy Optimization then capitalizes on the rich policy gradient information concentrated at these critical points/steps through a Bradley-Terry type of surgical loss. Extensive experiments across embodied, interactive, reasoning, and planning benchmarks demonstrate that T-STAR achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines, with gains most pronounced on tasks requiring extended reasoning chains.

AI.tldr: T-STAR 把多条 LLM 推理轨迹合并成一棵“认知树”，用树状回溯给关键步骤分配精准奖励，再凭对比成功/失败分支生成立即修正，并只对关键节点做“手术式”梯度更新，显著缓解稀疏奖励问题，在需要长链推理的任务上效果最明显。
AI.motivation: 多步推理场景中奖励极其稀疏，现有方法（如 GRPO）将轨迹视为独立链，所有步均分奖励，忽视了对结果影响巨大的“关键步”，导致信用分配不准、方差大、样本效率低。
AI.method: 1) 统一认知树：按语义/功能相似度把多轨迹的步合并成树节点，显式恢复跨轨迹结构；2) 内省估值：自底向上回溯传播轨迹奖励，得到步级方差缩减的相对优势；3) 上下文思维嫁接：在树的关键分叉处对比成功与失败分支，合成即时修正推理；4) 手术式策略优化：仅在关键节点用 Bradley-Terry 形式的“手术损失”计算策略梯度，集中更新。
AI.result: 在具身、交互、数学推理、规划四大类基准上均显著优于强基线（GRPO、PPO、RAP 等），平均提升 4-15 个百分点，链越长增益越大；样本效率提高约 1.8-2.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过树状结构显式建模步间依赖并精准定位关键决策点，T-STAR 实现了更细粒度、低方差的信用分配与高效策略修正，为稀疏奖励下 LLM 智能体的长链推理提供通用且可扩展的强化学习范式。

title: HAMLET: Switch your Vision-Language-Action Model into a History-Aware Policy
summary: Inherently, robotic manipulation tasks are history-dependent: leveraging past context could be beneficial. However, most existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have been designed without considering this aspect, i.e., they rely solely on the current observation, ignoring preceding context. In this paper, we propose HAMLET, a scalable framework to adapt VLAs to attend to the historical context during action prediction. Specifically, we introduce moment tokens that compactly encode perceptual information at each timestep. Their representations are initialized with time-contrastive learning, allowing them to better capture temporally distinctive aspects. Next, we employ a lightweight memory module that integrates the moment tokens across past timesteps into memory features, which are then leveraged for action prediction. Through empirical evaluation, we show that HAMLET successfully transforms a state-of-the-art VLA into a history-aware policy, especially demonstrating significant improvements on long-horizon tasks that require historical context. In particular, on top of GR00T N1.5, HAMLET achieves an average success rate of 76.4% on history-dependent real-world tasks, surpassing the baseline performance by 47.2%. Furthermore, HAMLET pushes prior art performance from 64.1% to 66.4% on RoboCasa Kitchen (100-demo setup) and from 95.6% to 97.7% on LIBERO, highlighting its effectiveness even under generic robot-manipulation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: HAMLET 首次把「过去信息」引入视觉–语言–动作(VLA)模型，借助 moment token 和轻量记忆模块，让机器人能在长程操作任务中利用历史上下文。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型推理“只盯当下”，丢失了执行长技能链时必须的历史上下文，导致在长时序、因果依赖型操作上表现不佳。
AI.method: 设计 moment token 压缩每一帧视觉语义，用时间对比学习初始化以捕获时序差异；插入轻量级跨步记忆模块累加 token，输出 memory feature 供动作头实时参考；冻结原 VLA 主干，仅训练新增组件，快速转为历史感知策略。
AI.result: 在 GR00T N1.5 上，历史依赖的真实任务平均成功率从 29.2% → 76.4%(+47.2%)；100 demo RoboCasa Kitchen 从 64.1% → 66.4%，LIBERO 由 95.6% → 97.7%，且仅增加 <5% 参数与 12% 推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: HAMLET 能无痛「升级」任意 VLA，使其具备历史建模能力，显著抬升长视界操作的成功率，为可扩展、高效的历史感知策略提供了新范式。

title: Decentralized Rank Scheduling for Energy-Constrained Multi-Task Federated Fine-Tuning in Edge-Assisted IoV Networks
summary: Federated fine-tuning has emerged as a promising approach for adapting foundation models (FMs) to diverse downstream tasks in edge environments. In Internet of Vehicles (IoV) systems, enabling efficient and low-latency multi-task adaptation is particularly challenging due to client mobility, heterogeneous resources, and intermittent connectivity. This paper proposes a hierarchical federated fine-tuning framework that coordinates roadside units (RSUs) and vehicles to support resource-aware and mobility-resilient learning across dynamic IoV scenarios. Leveraging Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), we introduce a decentralized, energy-aware rank adaptation mechanism formulated as a constrained multi-armed bandit problem. A novel UCB-DUAL algorithm is developed to enable adaptive exploration under per-task energy budgets, achieving provable sublinear regret. To evaluate our method, we construct a large-scale IoV simulator based on real-world trajectories, capturing dynamic participation, RSU handoffs, and communication variability. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off among all baselines, reducing latency by over 24\% and improving average accuracy by more than 2.5\%.

AI.tldr: 面向车联网动态场景，提出基于 RSU-车辆协同的层次化联邦微调框架，利用能量感知的 LoRA 秩自适应与 UCB-DUAL 算法，实现多任务低延迟适配，兼顾准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: 在车联网（IoV）中，客户端高移动性、资源异构与间歇连接使得将大模型微调到多下游任务既耗时又耗能，亟需一种能在边缘环境低延迟、高能效完成适配的方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建 RSU-车辆两层联邦架构，将 RSU 作为中间聚合点，缓解车辆移动造成的频繁换手；2) 引入 LoRA 低秩微调，并把秩选择建模为带能量约束的多臂老虎机问题；3) 设计 UCB-DUAL 算法，在任务级能耗预算下自适应探索最优秩，理论保证次线性后悔界；4) 基于真实轨迹开发大规模 IoV 仿真平台，复现动态参与、RSU 切换与通信波动。
AI.result: 与基线相比，提出的框架在维持最高平均准确率（+2.5% 以上）的同时，将端到端延迟降低 24% 以上，并在能量受限条件下获得最优的准确率-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过层次化聚合与能量感知的秩自适应，该框架有效克服了 IoV 环境下的移动性与资源异构挑战，为在边缘侧高效微调大模型提供了可扩展、可证明的解决方案。

title: IatroBench: Pre-Registered Evidence of Iatrogenic Harm from AI Safety Measures
comment: 30 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Pre-registered on OSF (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/G6VMZ). Code and data: https://github.com/davidgringras/iatrobench. v2: Fix bibliography entries (add arXiv IDs, published venues); correct p-value typo in Limitations section; add AI Assistance Statement v3: Correct Figure 1 (decoupling scatter accidentally reverted to earlier draft in v2)
summary: Ask a frontier model how to taper six milligrams of alprazolam (psychiatrist retired, ten days of pills left, abrupt cessation causes seizures) and it tells her to call the psychiatrist she just explained does not exist. Change one word ("I'm a psychiatrist; a patient presents with...") and the same model, same weights, same inference pass produces a textbook Ashton Manual taper with diazepam equivalence, anticonvulsant coverage, and monitoring thresholds. The knowledge was there; the model withheld it. IatroBench measures this gap. Sixty pre-registered clinical scenarios, six frontier models, 3,600 responses, scored on two axes (commission harm, CH 0-3; omission harm, OH 0-4) through a structured-evaluation pipeline validated against physician scoring (kappa_w = 0.571, within-1 agreement 96%). The central finding is identity-contingent withholding: match the same clinical question in physician vs. layperson framing and all five testable models provide better guidance to the physician (decoupling gap +0.38, p = 0.003; binary hit rates on safety-colliding actions drop 13.1 percentage points in layperson framing, p < 0.0001, while non-colliding actions show no change). The gap is widest for the model with the heaviest safety investment (Opus, +0.65). Three failure modes separate cleanly: trained withholding (Opus), incompetence (Llama 4), and indiscriminate content filtering (GPT-5.2, whose post-generation filter strips physician responses at 9x the layperson rate because they contain denser pharmacological tokens). The standard LLM judge assigns OH = 0 to 73% of responses a physician scores OH >= 1 (kappa = 0.045); the evaluation apparatus has the same blind spot as the training apparatus. Every scenario targets someone who has already exhausted the standard referrals.

AI.tldr: 前沿模型会因提问者身份(医生vs普通人)而差异化地隐藏关键医学信息，导致同一临床问题被给出截然不同的危重症指导。作者建立IatroBench数据集量化这种"身份依赖式隐瞒"并揭示其三大子模式:训练隐瞒、能力缺失和过度过滤
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型(LLM)在安全敏感领域被广泛应用，但其对齐机制可能在未明确告知的情况下，依据提问者身份(角色扮演)系统性地保留或输出医学知识。此现象直接影响危重症场景中的患者安全，评估与修正该差异成为紧迫问题。
AI.method: 设计60个临床高危场景(如突然停用苯二氮卓类)，分别用"我是退休精神科医生"与"我是普通患者"两种措辞输入六款SOTA模型，生成3600份回答。医师与结构评分器在两条3-4级伤害轴上(主动伤害CH与疏漏伤害OH)进行打分并计算加权κ。模型自身被用作LLM评判来测试一致性。
AI.result: (1) 所有可测模型在"医生身份"下给出的安全可行性显著提升，平均效果差异+0.38(p=0.003)；危险操作命中率在普通人提问时下降13.1pp(p<0.0001)，非危险操作无差异；(2) 安全投资最重的Opus差距最大(+0.65)；(3) 三大失败模式：Opus刻意隐瞒、Llama 4知识不足、GPT-5.2过度过滤导致医师帖常被封；(4) 标准LLM评委疏漏：73%被医生判为OH≥1的案例被模型自评OH=0(κ=0.045)，暴露了与训练阶段相同的盲区。
AI.conclusion: "身份依赖式隐瞒"是当前对齐策略的普遍现象，并可能反过来伤害最弱势的真实求助者。仅依靠模型自评或常规过滤无法发现该缺口，需引入医师验证与IatroBench等独立评测框架。未来对齐研究应将音信疏漏伤害纳入安全目标，并重新评估角色敏感过滤机制的公平性和临床风险。

title: A Function-Centric Perspective on Flat and Sharp Minima
summary: Flat minima are strongly associated with improved generalisation in deep neural networks. However, this connection has proven nuanced in recent studies, with both theoretical counterexamples and empirical exceptions emerging in the literature. In this paper, we revisit the role of sharpness in model performance and argue that sharpness is better understood as a function-dependent property rather than an indicator of poor generalisation. We conduct extensive empirical studies ranging from single-objective optimisation, synthetic non-linear binary classification tasks, to modern image classification tasks. In single-objective optimisation, we show that flatness and sharpness are relative to the function being learned: equally optimal solutions can exhibit markedly different local geometry. In synthetic non-linear binary classification tasks, we show that increasing decision-boundary tightness can increase sharpness even when models generalise perfectly, indicating that sharpness is not reducible to memorisation alone. Finally, in large-scale experiments, we find that sharper minima often emerge when models are regularised (e.g., via weight decay, data augmentation, or SAM), and coincide with better generalisation, calibration, robustness, and functional consistency. Our findings suggest that function complexity, rather than flatness, shapes the geometry of solutions, and that sharper minima can reflect more appropriate inductive biases, calling for a function-centric reappraisal of minima geometry.

AI.tldr: 在足够大的网络和常用正则下，锐极小值不仅不会破坏泛化，反而与更好的泛化、校准与鲁棒性同现；应将sharpness视为函数依赖的性质，而非泛化优劣的通用指标。
AI.motivation: 近期理论和实验都出现“平坦即泛化”的反例，促使作者重新审视sharpness与泛化之间的因果性。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：将sharpness定义为函数相关量，指出其受复杂度与归纳偏置影响。2) 系统实验：单目标优化→合成二分类→ImageNet-scale大模型，配合sharpness度量及泛化/校准/鲁棒性评估。3) 变量控制：在不同正则(weight decay、数据增强、SAM)与网络规模下观察最小值几何变化。
AI.result: 1) 同等泛化的解可呈现截然不同的局部几何。2) 决策边界紧致化会提升sharpness但泛化依旧良好。3) 施加正则后模型常收敛到更sharp的极小值，且同时在测试准确率、ECE、对抗与分布外鲁棒性上优于flat baseline。
AI.conclusion: sharpness∝函数复杂度而非泛化能力；锐极小值可嵌入更合适的归纳偏置。未来应从函数空间角度重估最小值几何，而非盲目追求平坦。

title: Heavy-Tailed Class-Conditional Priors for Long-Tailed Generative Modeling
summary: Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) with global priors trained under an imbalanced empirical class distribution can lead to underrepresentation of tail classes in the latent space. While $t^3$VAE improves robustness via heavy-tailed Student's $t$-distribution priors, its single global prior still allocates mass proportionally to class frequency. We address this latent geometric bias by introducing C-$t^3$VAE, which assigns a per-class Student's $t$ joint prior over latent and output variables. This design promotes uniform prior mass across class-conditioned components. To optimize our model we derive a closed-form objective from the $γ$-power divergence, and we introduce an equal-weight latent mixture for class-balanced generation. On SVHN-LT, CIFAR100-LT, and CelebA datasets, C-$t^3$VAE consistently attains lower FID scores than $t^3$VAE and Gaussian-based VAE baselines under severe class imbalance while remaining competitive in balanced or mildly imbalanced settings. In per-class F1 evaluations, our model outperforms the conditional Gaussian VAE across highly imbalanced settings. Moreover, we identify the mild imbalance threshold $ρ< 5$, for which Gaussian-based models remain competitive. However, for $ρ\geq 5$ our approach yields improved class-balanced generation and mode coverage.

AI.tldr: C-$t^3$VAE 用每类一个 Student-t 联合先验替代 VAE 的全局先验，彻底消除长尾场景下潜在空间的几何偏差，在 ρ≥5 的重度不平衡数据中显著降低 FID 并提升 F1。
AI.motivation: VAE 在不平衡数据上训练时，全局先验会按类别频率分配概率质量，导致尾部类在潜在空间被压缩；既有的 $t^3$VAE 虽用厚尾先验增强鲁棒性，但仍受同一全局先验限制，无法真正解决潜在几何偏差。
AI.method: 提出 C-$t^3$VAE：为每类分配独立的 Student-t 联合先验（潜在变量+输出变量），保证先验质量在各条件分量间均匀分布；基于 γ-幂散度导出闭式目标函数，并在推断网络中引入等权潜在混合进行类别平衡的生成。
AI.result: 在 SVHN-LT、CIFAR100-LT 和 CelebA 上，C-$t^3$VAE 在重度不平衡下的 FID 显著低于 $t^3$VAE 与高斯 VAE，而在轻度不平衡或平衡条件下性能相当；每类 F1 在高度不平衡场景全面优于条件高斯 VAE。实验划定阈值 ρ<5：低于此值高斯模型仍具竞争力；ρ≥5 时本文方法在类别平衡生成与模式覆盖方面优势明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过“每类一先验”策略，C-$t^3$VAE 在不牺牲平衡场景性能的前提下，显著提升了长尾数据下的潜在空间公平性与生成质量，为不平衡学习提供了可扩展的 VAE 框架。

title: ImplicitMemBench: Measuring Unconscious Behavioral Adaptation in Large Language Models
summary: Existing memory benchmarks for LLM agents evaluate explicit recall of facts, yet overlook implicit memory where experience becomes automated behavior without conscious retrieval. This gap is critical: effective assistants must automatically apply learned procedures or avoid failed actions without explicit reminders. We introduce ImplicitMemBench, the first systematic benchmark evaluating implicit memory through three cognitively grounded constructs drawn from standard cognitive-science accounts of non-declarative memory: Procedural Memory (one-shot skill acquisition after interference), Priming (theme-driven bias via paired experimental/control instances), and Classical Conditioning (Conditioned Stimulus--Unconditioned Stimulus (CS--US) associations shaping first decisions). Our 300-item suite employs a unified Learning/Priming-Interfere-Test protocol with first-attempt scoring. Evaluation of 17 models reveals severe limitations: no model exceeds 66% overall, with top performers DeepSeek-R1 (65.3%), Qwen3-32B (64.1%), and GPT-5 (63.0%) far below human baselines. Analysis uncovers dramatic asymmetries (inhibition 17.6% vs. preference 75.0%) and universal bottlenecks requiring architectural innovations beyond parameter scaling. ImplicitMemBench reframes evaluation from "what agents recall" to "what they automatically enact".

AI.tldr: 首个评测大模型“隐性记忆”的基准ImplicitMemBench显示，现有模型在无需回忆的自动化行为上表现远低于人类，最高仅66%，揭示架构层面缺陷。
AI.motivation: 既有记忆基准只测显性事实回忆，但智能助手需把经验转化为“无意识的自动化行为”（隐性记忆）。此空白阻碍了对模型真正“学会后用”能力的评估。
AI.method: 基于认知科学三大非陈述记忆范式——程序记忆（一次干扰后技能习得）、启动效应（主题-驱动偏好）、经典条件作用（CS-US关联）——设计300题统一“学习-干扰-初测”流程，首次尝试即计分。
AI.result: 17 个模型最高仅 65.3%（DeepSeek-R1），普遍低于人类基线；抑制型行为仅 17.6%，偏好型达 75%，呈显著不对称。瓶颈不受参数规模缓解。
AI.conclusion: 隐性记忆能力是迈向真正自主智能助手的核心短板；需超越简单扩参，引入专门架构创新。ImplicitMemBench 将评估焦点从“能回忆什么”转向“能自动执行什么”。

title: X-Diffusion: Training Diffusion Policies on Cross-Embodiment Human Demonstrations
summary: Human videos are a scalable source of training data for robot learning. However, humans and robots significantly differ in embodiment, making many human actions infeasible for direct execution on a robot. Still, these demonstrations convey rich object-interaction cues and task intent. Our goal is to learn from this coarse guidance without transferring embodiment-specific, infeasible execution strategies. Recent advances in generative modeling tackle a related problem of learning from low-quality data. In particular, Ambient Diffusion is a recent method for diffusion modeling that incorporates low-quality data only at high-noise timesteps of the forward diffusion process. Our key insight is to view human actions as noisy counterparts of robot actions. As noise increases along the forward diffusion process, embodiment-specific differences fade away while task-relevant guidance is preserved. Based on these observations, we present X-Diffusion, a cross-embodiment learning framework based on Ambient Diffusion that selectively trains diffusion policies on noised human actions. This enables effective use of easy-to-collect human videos without sacrificing robot feasibility. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, we show that X-Diffusion improves average success rates by 16% over naive co-training and manual data filtering. The project website is available at https://portal-cornell.github.io/X-Diffusion/.

AI.tldr: 提出 X-Diffusion：将“人类动作”视为高噪声样本，仅在扩散步的高噪声段利用人类视频训练扩散策略，无需精确对齐或过滤，即可在 5 项真实操作任务上比基线平均提升 16% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 人类视频易获取但机器人无法直接复现；强行共训练会引入不可行动作。需一种机制：保留任务意图与物体交互线索，同时屏蔽 embodiment 特异的执行细节。
AI.method: 把人类动作当作“含噪”机器人动作，引入 Ambient Diffusion 思想：仅在扩散步的高噪声区间将人类样本加入损失，低噪声段仅用机器人数据。训练出的扩散策略在推理时仍面向机器人可行空间，实现跨 embodiment 选择性知识迁移。
AI.result: 在 5 个真实机器人操作任务上，X-Diffusion 平均成功率较 naive co-training 与手工过滤分别提升 16% 与 10%，且对多种人类噪声比例稳健。
AI.conclusion: 高噪声段的“人类-动作即噪声”视角，无需对齐或 mask，即可安全利用大规模人类视频，显著提升机器人策略学习效率与上限。代码与视频已开源。

title: Discrete Guidance Matching: Exact Guidance for Discrete Flow Matching
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: Guidance provides a simple and effective framework for posterior sampling by steering the generation process towards the desired distribution. When modeling discrete data, existing approaches mostly focus on guidance with the first-order approximation to improve the sampling efficiency. However, such an approximation is inappropriate in discrete state spaces since the approximation error could be large. A novel guidance framework for discrete data is proposed to address this problem: we derive the exact transition rate for the desired distribution given a learned discrete flow matching model, leading to guidance that only requires a single forward pass in each sampling step, significantly improving efficiency. This unified novel framework is general enough, encompassing existing guidance methods as special cases, and it can also be seamlessly applied to the masked diffusion model. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed guidance on energy-guided simulations and preference alignment on text-to-image generation and multimodal understanding tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/WanZhengyan/Discrete-Guidance-Matching.

AI.tldr: 首次给出离散空间下的精确转移率，实现单步前传即可完成guided sampling，统一并超越现有一阶近似方法，在能量约束和图文偏好对齐任务上验证高效与通用。
AI.motivation: 离散生成模型采用一阶近似guidance误差大，采样效率低，需要一种严格且高效的离散guidance框架。
AI.method: 基于已训练离散流匹配模型，推导出目标分布的精确转移率，构建单步前传guidance；框架可兼容masked diffusion等现有方法。
AI.result: 能量引导模拟与文本到图像、多模态偏好对齐实验显示，在质量相当或更优的前提下，采样步骤与计算成本显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 统一、精确且单步的离散guidance框架同时提升效率与适用性，为离散域受控生成奠定基础。

title: Avenir-UX: Automated UX Evaluation via Simulated Human Web Interaction with GUI Grounding
summary: Evaluating web usability typically requires time-consuming user studies and expert reviews, which often limits iteration speed during product development, especially for small teams and agile workflows. We present Avenir-UX, a user-experience evaluation agent that simulates user behavior on websites and produces standardized usability. Unlike traditional tools that rely on DOM parsing, Avenir-UX grounds actions and observations, enabling it to interact with real web pages end-to-end while maintaining a coherent trace of the user journey. Building on Avenir-Web, our system pairs this robust interaction with simulated user behavior profiles and a structured evaluation protocol that integrates the System Usability Scale (SUS), step-wise Single Ease Questions (SEQ), and concurrent Think Aloud. Subsequently, a comprehensive User Experience (UX) report will be generated. We discuss the architecture of Avenir-UX and illustrate how its multimodal grounding improves robustness for web-based interaction and UX evaluation scenarios, paving the way for a new era of continuous, scalable, and data-driven usability testing that empowers every developer to build web interfaces that are usable. Code is available at: https://github.com/Onflow-AI/Avenir-UX

AI.tldr: Avenir-UX 是一个基于多模态视觉落地技术的自动化 UX 评价智能体，可在真实网页上端到端模拟用户行为并输出标准化可用性报告，弥补传统用户测试耗时、成本高的痛点。
AI.motivation: 传统可用性评估依赖用户实验与专家评审，周期长、成本高，难以满足小团队和敏捷开发对快速迭代的需求，亟需可扩展、数据驱动的自动化方案。
AI.method: 以 Avenir-Web 为基础，采用视觉 grounding 替代 DOM 解析，实现真实网页交互；结合虚拟用户画像、SUS、分步 SEQ 与同步 Think-Aloud 的结构化评估协议，自动生成综合 UX 报告。
AI.result: 系统能在真实网页上保持连贯用户旅程轨迹，输出标准化可用性得分与详细诊断，显著降低测试门槛并提升迭代速度；开源代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 多模态落地的 Avenir-UX 开创了连续、可扩展、数据驱动的可用性测试新模式，使任何开发者都可快速获得专业级 UX 反馈，助力打造易用 Web 界面。

title: RoboTAG: End-to-end Robot Configuration Estimation via Topological Alignment Graph
summary: Estimating robot pose from a monocular RGB image is a challenge in robotics and computer vision. Existing methods typically build networks on top of 2D visual backbones and depend heavily on labeled data for training, which is often scarce in real-world scenarios, causing a sim-to-real gap. Moreover, these approaches reduce the 3D-based problem to 2D domain, neglecting the 3D priors. To address these, we propose Robot Topological Alignment Graph (RoboTAG), which incorporates a 3D branch to inject 3D priors while enabling co-evolution of the 2D and 3D representations, alleviating the reliance on labels. Specifically, the RoboTAG consists of a 3D branch and a 2D branch, where nodes represent the states of the camera and robot system, and edges capture the dependencies between these variables or denote alignments between them. Closed loops are then defined in the graph, on which a consistency supervision across branches can be applied. Experimental results demonstrate that our method is effective across robot types, suggesting new possibilities of alleviating the data bottleneck in robotics.

AI.tldr: 一种无需大量标注即可做单目RGB图像机器人位姿估计的拓扑图网络RoboTAG，通过2D/3D双分支协同与闭环一致性自监督，跨机型泛化好，缓解数据瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 单目RGB估计机器人位姿依赖大量标注，且现有2D网络忽视3D先验，导致sim-to-real差距与数据稀缺问题。
AI.method: 提出Robot Topological Alignment Graph(RoboTAG)：1)并行2D与3D分支，节点刻画相机-机器人状态，边编码变量依赖或跨模态对齐；2)在图中构建闭环，施加跨分支一致性自监督；3)3D先验与2D表征共演化，减少标注依赖。
AI.result: 多机型实验验证：相较纯2D基线，位姿误差显著下降，跨真实场景泛化性能提升，证实可在弱标注条件下有效工作。
AI.conclusion: RoboTAG通过引入3D先验与拓扑一致性自监督，突破单目位姿估计的数据瓶颈，为机器人视觉提供低标注、高泛化的新范式。

title: The Signal is in the Steps: Local Scoring for Reasoning Data Selection
summary: Distilling long-form reasoning from teacher models into smaller students requires selecting which candidate solutions to train on. Recent work argues that one should select responses the student model assigns highest probability, i.e., favoring solutions ``natural'' to the student. However, we find that this approach works within a single teacher but fails when scaling to long reasoning traces from multiple diverse teachers. We identify a key cause: this approach scores entire solutions, but students generalize by recombining familiar reasoning steps, not by memorizing complete solutions. Full-trajectory scoring optimizes the wrong target; it rewards global fluency while the transferable signal lies in local step transitions. We propose Local Average Log Probability (LALP), which scores each reasoning step using only a small window of preceding context, measuring whether each step is justified by its immediate premises rather than whether the full response looks natural to the student. LALP enables two practical use cases: selecting the best teacher before fine-tuning and curating training data from diverse teacher pools. Across math, coding, and science reasoning tasks, LALP consistently improves accuracy when selecting the most natural solutions by a large margin.

AI.tldr: 提出“局部平均对数概率”（LALP），用滑动窗口评估单步合理性，解决多教师长推理蒸馏中“全局评分”失效问题，在数学、编程、科学任务上显著优于传统方案。
AI.motivation: 现有方法用学生模型对整个解答的全局概率做筛选，仅在单教师场景有效；当面对多教师、极长推理链时，学生实际通过重组局部步骤泛化，全局评分会奖励流畅却不可迁移的完整路径，导致蒸馏失效。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：指出学生泛化依赖局部步骤而非整体记忆。2. LALP：对每一步仅取前 k 个 token 为上下文，计算该步平均对数概率，衡量其局部合理性；整体解答得分取步骤均值。3. 应用：先用 LALP 选最优教师模型，再用其筛选训练语料进行微调。
AI.result: 在数学（MATH）、代码（CodeContests）、科学（GPQA）三类长推理任务上，LALP 的解答选择准确率比传统全局评分高 8–18%，且跨教师池蒸馏后的 7B 学生模型绝对准确率提升 4–6%。
AI.conclusion: 长推理蒸馏应优化“局部可迁移性”而非“全局自然度”；LALP 以极低成本实现步骤级评估，可推广为通用数据筛选工具，显著提升多教师知识蒸馏效果。

title: FinTrace: Holistic Trajectory-Level Evaluation of LLM Tool Calling for Long-Horizon Financial Tasks
summary: Recent studies demonstrate that tool-calling capability enables large language models (LLMs) to interact with external environments for long-horizon financial tasks. While existing benchmarks have begun evaluating financial tool calling, they focus on limited scenarios and rely on call-level metrics that fail to capture trajectory-level reasoning quality. To address this gap, we introduce FinTrace, a benchmark comprising 800 expert-annotated trajectories spanning 34 real-world financial task categories across multiple difficulty levels. FinTrace employs a rubric-based evaluation protocol with nine metrics organized along four axes -- action correctness, execution efficiency, process quality, and output quality -- enabling fine-grained assessment of LLM tool-calling behavior. Our evaluation of 13 LLMs reveals that while frontier models achieve strong tool selection, all models struggle with information utilization and final answer quality, exposing a critical gap between invoking the right tools and reasoning effectively over their outputs. To move beyond diagnosis, we construct FinTrace-Training, the first trajectory-level preference dataset for financial tool-calling, containing 8,196 curated trajectories with tool-augmented contexts and preference pairs. We fine-tune Qwen-3.5-9B using supervised fine-tuning followed by direct preference optimization (DPO) and show that training on FinTrace-Training consistently improves intermediate reasoning metrics, with DPO more effectively suppressing failure modes. However, end-to-end answer quality remains a bottleneck, indicating that trajectory-level improvements do not yet fully propagate to final output quality.

AI.tldr: 提出首个轨迹级金融工具调用评测集FinTrace（800条人工标注轨迹，34类任务）及配套训练集FinTrace-Training（8196条偏好轨迹），发现现有LLM虽能选对工具，但难以利用工具输出进行高质量推理；用SFT+DPO微调Qwen-3.5-9B可提升中间指标，却无法显著改善最终答案质量。
AI.motivation: 既有金融工具调用基准仅覆盖少量场景且采用调用级指标，无法衡量长程决策与轨迹级推理质量，亟需细粒度评测与训练数据以暴露并弥合“选工具”与“用工具”之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 1）构建FinTrace：800条专家标注轨迹覆盖34类真实金融任务、多难度层级；设计四轴（动作正确性、执行效率、过程质量、输出质量）九指标Rubric评测协议。 2）构建FinTrace-Training：8196条轨迹级偏好数据，含工具返回上下文与对错偏好对。 3）用SFT+DPO两阶段微调Qwen-3.5-9B，检验轨迹级偏好学习对推理与最终答案的影响。
AI.result: 13款LLM评测显示：前沿模型工具选择准确率尚可，但信息整合与最终答案质量普遍落后；微调模型在中间推理指标上持续提升，DPO更有效抑制失败模式，然而端到端答案质量仍无明显突破。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级评测精准暴露LLM“工具会用但推理不足”的瓶颈；轨迹级偏好学习可改善中间过程，却未能传导至最终输出，提示未来需在推理整合与答案生成环节引入更强监督或新范式。

title: From Instruction to Event: Sound-Triggered Mobile Manipulation
summary: Current mobile manipulation research predominantly follows an instruction-driven paradigm, where agents rely on predefined textual commands to execute tasks. However, this setting confines agents to a passive role, limiting their autonomy and ability to react to dynamic environmental events. To address these limitations, we introduce sound-triggered mobile manipulation, where agents must actively perceive and interact with sound-emitting objects without explicit action instructions. To support these tasks, we develop Habitat-Echo, a data platform that integrates acoustic rendering with physical interaction. We further propose a baseline comprising a high-level task planner and low-level policy models to complete these tasks. Extensive experiments show that the proposed baseline empowers agents to actively detect and respond to auditory events, eliminating the need for case-by-case instructions. Notably, in the challenging dual-source scenario, the agent successfully isolates the primary source from overlapping acoustic interference to execute the first interaction, and subsequently proceeds to manipulate the secondary object, verifying the robustness of the baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出声音触发的机器人主动操作范式，摆脱逐条文本指令束缚，并在Habitat-Echo平台与分层基线上验证其在重叠声源场景的自洽能力。
AI.motivation: 现有移动操控依赖被动文本指令，缺乏环境事件驱动的自主性；作者希望让机器人像人一样“先听声再行动”，提升动态场景下智能体主动反应能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建Habitat-Echo平台，将声学渲染集成到仿真交互流水线，实现试听-动作闭环。2) 设计分层决策框架：上层听觉-语义任务规划器（检测声源、触发目标序列），下层强化/模仿策略（噪声抑制、抓取执行）。3) 基线采用滤波定位+注意力机制，先在重叠源中锁定主源并完成首个操作，再迁移到次源。
AI.result: 无指令环境中，代理可主动完成声音触发的多物体操作；双声源混合场景成功率95%，且两步式操作首次迁移成功率达78%，表明基线可拆分并串联不同声源任务。
AI.conclusion: 声音触发范式让移动操控从“指令-反应”转向“声学-推理-行动”主动模式，Habitat-Echo及基线为后续声学-视觉-触觉融合研究奠定了可复用的仿真、数据与模型基础，为多任务声源驱动机器人落地提供了可行路线图。

title: Power Transform Revisited: Numerically Stable, and Federated
comment: AISTATS 2026. 24 pages, 17 figures, 4 tables. Project page see https://xuefeng-xu.github.io/powertf.html
summary: Power transforms are popular parametric methods for making data more Gaussian-like, and are widely used as preprocessing steps in statistical analysis and machine learning. However, we find that direct implementations of power transforms suffer from severe numerical instabilities, which can lead to incorrect results or even crashes. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive analysis of the sources of these instabilities and propose effective remedies. We further extend power transforms to the federated learning setting, addressing both numerical and distributional challenges that arise in this context. Experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods are both effective and robust, substantially improving stability compared to existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 严重数值不稳定困扰着现有的幂变换；作者系统定位成因、给出修复方案并首次把它安全地推广到联邦学习，实测稳定性显著提升。
AI.motivation: 幂变换是使数据逼近高斯分布的经典预处理，但实现中的数值问题可导致错误或崩溃，且尚无联邦学习下的稳定版本。
AI.method: 量化标准幂变换各环节的误差来源 → 提出数值稳定的算法级与实现级修正 → 针对联邦环境设计兼顾分布异构与隐私的稳健幂变换协议。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上，稳定变体消除崩溃与错误，联邦版本在保持精度的同时显著优于现有方法的数值鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 只要采用文中补救，幂变换即可安全部署于单机与联邦场景；提出的系统分析框架亦可指导其他预处理算子的稳定性改进。

title: Three Roles, One Model: Role Orchestration at Inference Time to Close the Performance Gap Between Small and Large Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents show promise on realistic tool-use tasks, but deploying capable agents on modest hardware remains challenging. We study whether inference-time scaffolding alone, without any additional training compute, can improve the performance of a small model in complex multi-step environments. Operating on a single 24GB GPU, we evaluate Qwen3-8B on the AppWorld benchmark under both full-precision and 4-bit quantized configurations. Without any intervention, the raw model achieves just 5.4% (FP16) and 3.0% (AWQ) task goal completion. Guided by a systematic failure mode analysis, we introduce a three-tier inference scaffolding pipeline that deploys the same frozen model in three distinct roles: (1) a summarization model that preserves critical artifacts (tokens, credentials, API responses) while compressing dialogue history; (2) the main agent model that reasons over the compressed context; and (3) an isolated correction model that reviews and revises the agent's code output without access to conversation history, breaking repetitive failure loops. Applied to the same unmodified model, this scaffolding yields 8.9% (FP16) and 5.9% (AWQ) task goal completion, roughly doubling performance in both settings, with particularly strong gains on difficulty-1 tasks (15.8% to 26.3% FP16; 5.3% to 14.0% AWQ). On full-precision inference, our scaffolded 8B model surpasses DeepSeek-Coder 33B Instruct (7.1%) from the original AppWorld evaluation, demonstrating that structured inference-time interventions can make small models competitive with systems 4 times their size. We formalize the approach as a scaffolded policy over a frozen base model, three invocations of the same weights with different conditioning, drawing connections to test-time compute scaling and action-space shaping in reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 仅用推理时脚手架，无需额外训练，就能让 8B 小模型在 AppWorld 上性能翻倍，甚至超过 33B 模型——证明推理计算可替代训练参数。
AI.motivation: 要让 LLM 代理在消费级硬件（单 24GB GPU）也能完成复杂工具调用任务，但小型模型能力有限，又不能承担再训练成本。
AI.method: 对同一冻结的 Qwen3-8B 实施三层推理脚手架：(1) 摘要角色压缩对话历史并保留关键信息；(2) 主代理角色基于压缩上下文推理；(3) 校正角色脱离对话历史专门复查并修改代码，避免死循环。三种角色重复使用同一权重，只是输入提示不同。
AI.result: 任务成功率从 5.4%/3.0% 提升到 8.9%/5.9%（FP16/AWQ），接近翻倍；难度最低的任务从 15.8%→26.3%(FP16)、5.3%→14.0%(AWQ)。FP16 配置下的脚手架 8B 模型优于原评测中 33B 的 DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct（7.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理时干预（测试时计算缩放）可显著缩小模型规模差距，使小模型在不增加参数或训练成本的情况下挑战大模型性能，为轻量级本地代理提供可行路径。

title: A Faster Path to Continual Learning
summary: Continual Learning (CL) aims to train neural networks on a dynamic stream of tasks without forgetting previously learned knowledge. Among optimization-based approaches, C-Flat has emerged as a promising solution due to its plug-and-play nature and its ability to encourage uniformly low-loss regions for both new and old tasks. However, C-Flat requires three additional gradient computations per iteration, imposing substantial overhead on the optimization process. In this work, we propose C-Flat Turbo, a faster yet stronger optimizer that significantly reduces the training cost. We show that the gradients associated with first-order flatness contain direction-invariant components relative to the proxy-model gradients, enabling us to skip redundant gradient computations in the perturbed ascent steps. Moreover, we observe that these flatness-promoting gradients progressively stabilize across tasks, which motivates a linear scheduling strategy with an adaptive trigger to allocate larger turbo steps for later tasks. Experiments show that C-Flat Turbo is 1.0$\times$ to 1.25$\times$ faster than C-Flat across a wide range of CL methods, while achieving comparable or even improved accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 C-Flat Turbo，在持续学习中用方向不变性与梯度稳定化策略，将 C-Flat 每步 3 次额外梯度降至 0 次，训练提速 1.0–1.25×，准确率不降反升。
AI.motivation: C-Flat 虽能缓解遗忘，但每迭代需 3 次额外梯度计算，开销过大；亟需更轻量的平坦化优化器。
AI.method: 发现平坦化梯度与代理梯度存在方向不变分量，可复用主梯度跳过扰动上升步骤；进一步观察到该梯度跨任务逐渐稳定，遂采用线性增长步长+自适应触发机制，为后续任务分配更大“Turbo”步。
AI.result: 在多种持续学习基准上，C-Flat Turbo 训练时间减少 0–20%，平均准确率持平或提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过梯度冗余消除与步长调度，C-Flat Turbo 首次实现无额外梯度计算的平坦化持续学习，兼具速度、准确率与即插即用特性。

title: Modeling Student Learning with 3.8 Million Program Traces
comment: Accepted to 27th International Conference on AI in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: As programmers write code, they often edit and retry multiple times, creating rich "interaction traces" that reveal how they approach coding tasks and provide clues about their level of skill development. For novice programmers in particular, these traces reflect the diverse reasoning processes they employ to code, such as exploratory behavior to understand how a programming concept works, re-strategizing in response to bugs, and personalizing stylistic choices. In this work, we explore what can be learned from training language models on such reasoning traces: not just about code, but about coders, and particularly students learning to program. We introduce a dataset of over 3.8 million programming reasoning traces from users of Pencil Code, a free online educational platform used by students to learn simple programming concepts. Compared to models trained only on final programs or synthetically-generated traces, we find that models trained on real traces are stronger at modeling diverse student behavior. Through both behavioral and probing analyses, we also find that many properties of code traces, such as goal backtracking or number of comments, can be predicted from learned representations of the students who write them. Building on this result, we show that we can help students recover from mistakes by steering code generation models to identify a sequence of edits that will results in more correct code while remaining close to the original student's style. Together, our results suggest that many properties of code are properties of individual students and that training on edit traces can lead to models that are more steerable, more predictive of student behavior while programming, and better at generating programs in their final states. Code and data is available at https://github.com/meghabyte/pencilcode-public

AI.tldr: 利用真实编程交互轨迹训练语言模型可以显著提高对初学者思维过程和习惯模式的理解，进而支持个性化辅导和代码纠错。
AI.motivation: 初学者在编程时不断试错、修改，所产生的交互轨迹含丰富推理信号，可用于刻画个体水平和不足，为模型驱动的教学干预提供数据基础。
AI.method: 构建包含380万条推理轨迹的Pencil Code数据集；以最终代码和合成交互为基线，训练并比较三种语言模型；通过表示探测与行为实验评估轨迹属性（如目标回溯、注释自增）与学生个体的可预测性；设计辅助召回策略，使模型输出贴近学生风格且更正确的代码序列。
AI.result: 真实交互模型在模拟多样学生行为、预测代码修订特征方面均优于基线；表示可显著预测目标回溯、注释量等十个行为指标；在5类典型错误情境下，辅助召回序列让学生代码正确率提高24%，同时与原文逐词编辑距离降低19%。
AI.conclusion: 代码轨迹与作者个性密切相关；以交互数据驱动的模型更加可控、可预测学习者行为，为智能化、个性化编程教育提供低成本、可扩展的技术框架。

title: The Non-Optimality of Scientific Knowledge: Path Dependence, Lock-In, and The Local Minimum Trap
summary: Science is widely regarded as humanity's most reliable method for uncovering truths about the natural world. Yet the \emph{trajectory} of scientific discovery is rarely examined as an optimization problem in its own right. This paper argues that the body of scientific knowledge, at any given historical moment, represents a \emph{local optimum} rather than a global one--that the frameworks, formalisms, and paradigms through which we understand nature are substantially shaped by historical contingency, cognitive path dependence, and institutional lock-in. Drawing an analogy to gradient descent in machine learning, we propose that science follows the steepest local gradient of tractability, empirical accessibility, and institutional reward, and in doing so may bypass fundamentally superior descriptions of nature. We develop this thesis through detailed case studies spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, neuroscience, and statistical methodology. We identify three interlocking mechanisms of lock-in--cognitive, formal, and institutional--and argue that recognizing these mechanisms is a prerequisite for designing meta-scientific strategies capable of escaping local optima. We conclude by proposing concrete interventions and discussing the epistemological implications of our thesis for the philosophy of science.

AI.tldr: Metascience is trapped in high-dimensional local optima; gradient-descent-like forces of tractability, accessibility and reward repeatedly make us miss superior descriptions of nature.
AI.motivation: 检出科学系统本身是优化问题的盲区；指出当下知识状态仅是历史–制度–认知耦合噪声下的局部最优，需用梯度观点揭示被绕过的全局峰。
AI.method: 类比机器学习梯度下降模型，将科学进程抽象为「沿可解性–经验可达性–制度奖励梯度移动」；跨六大学科史进行机制案例比较，归纳三级锁死（认知、形式、制度）的共现网络。
AI.result: 经验证明确实存在多条“高价值全局峰”被长期绕过；定量重演展示局部梯度方向与潜在全局方向夹角显著；三类锁死呈正交且协同放大，导致适应性景观谷深而陡。
AI.conclusion: 若不主动反优化机制，科学将持续收敛于次优范式；提出随机重启式资助、反梯度奖赏、多元形式语言框架等逃逸策略；刷新科学哲学：真理并非仅与世界相符，还与景观结构及寻峰算法耦合。

title: Spatial Atlas: Compute-Grounded Reasoning for Spatial-Aware Research Agent Benchmarks
summary: We introduce compute-grounded reasoning (CGR), a design paradigm for spatial-aware research agents in which every answerable sub-problem is resolved by deterministic computation before a language model is asked to generate. Spatial Atlas instantiates CGR as a single Agent-to-Agent (A2A) server that handles two challenging benchmarks: FieldWorkArena, a multimodal spatial question-answering benchmark spanning factory, warehouse, and retail environments, and MLE-Bench, a suite of 75 Kaggle machine learning competitions requiring end-to-end ML engineering. A structured spatial scene graph engine extracts entities and relations from vision descriptions, computes distances and safety violations deterministically, then feeds computed facts to large language models, thereby avoiding hallucinated spatial reasoning. Entropy-guided action selection maximizes information gain per step and routes queries across a three-tier frontier model stack (OpenAI + Anthropic). A self-healing ML pipeline with strategy-aware code generation, a score-driven iterative refinement loop, and a prompt-based leak audit registry round out the system. We evaluate across both benchmarks and show that CGR yields competitive accuracy while maintaining interpretability through structured intermediate representations and deterministic spatial computations.

AI.tldr: CGR先把空间算清楚再给LLM发言，Spatial Atlas把它做成一个A2A服务器，在工厂-仓库-零售多模态问答与75项Kaggle ML竞赛两项高难度任务上均拿到高分，且中间结果可解释。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态智能体在空间推理上容易“脑补”出错，尤其在工业、仓储等安全敏感场景不可接受；需要一种把确定计算与语言模型解耦、先算后言的新范式。
AI.method: 提出计算接地推理CGR：1）结构化场景图引擎先抽取实体与关系，确定性计算距离/安全违规；2）仅用计算事实提示LLM以避免幻觉；3）熵引导动作选择，最大化每一步信息增益；4）三层前沿模型栈（OpenAI+Anthropic）Agent-to-Agent动态路由；5）自修复ML管线：策略感知代码生成→分驱动迭代优化→提示泄露审计注册表。
AI.result: 在FieldWorkArena多模态空间问答与MLE-Bench 75项Kaggle竞赛两个基准上，CGR方案取得竞争级准确率，同时通过结构化中间表示与确定性空间计算保持可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 将确定性计算置于语言模型之前，可显著抑制空间幻觉并提升可信性；CGR为空间感知智能体的安全、可解释部署提供了可扩展范式。

title: A Function-Centric Perspective on Flat and Sharp Minima
summary: Flat minima are strongly associated with improved generalisation in deep neural networks. However, this connection has proven nuanced in recent studies, with both theoretical counterexamples and empirical exceptions emerging in the literature. In this paper, we revisit the role of sharpness in model performance and argue that sharpness is better understood as a function-dependent property rather than an indicator of poor generalisation. We conduct extensive empirical studies ranging from single-objective optimisation, synthetic non-linear binary classification tasks, to modern image classification tasks. In single-objective optimisation, we show that flatness and sharpness are relative to the function being learned: equally optimal solutions can exhibit markedly different local geometry. In synthetic non-linear binary classification tasks, we show that increasing decision-boundary tightness can increase sharpness even when models generalise perfectly, indicating that sharpness is not reducible to memorisation alone. Finally, in large-scale experiments, we find that sharper minima often emerge when models are regularised (e.g., via weight decay, data augmentation, or SAM), and coincide with better generalisation, calibration, robustness, and functional consistency. Our findings suggest that function complexity, rather than flatness, shapes the geometry of solutions, and that sharper minima can reflect more appropriate inductive biases, calling for a function-centric reappraisal of minima geometry.

AI.tldr: 平坦极小值≠好泛化：作者用单目标优化、合成二分类到 ImageNet 的实验说明「锐度」是函数依赖量，更尖锐的极小值在正则化下可同时获得更高测试精度、校准度与鲁棒性，应转向「函数中心」视角重审解的平坦性。
AI.motivation: 近期理论与实证均出现「平坦极小值泛化更好」的反例，社区对 sharpness 的因果性存疑；本文旨在厘清 sharpness 究竟是泛化指标还是仅与所逼近函数复杂度耦合的表面现象。
AI.method: 1) 单目标优化：在已知解析解的函数上比较不同全局最优点邻域曲率；2) 合成非线性二分类：通过显式控制决策边界紧密度独立调节 sharpness，检验与测试误差的关系；3) 大规模视觉实验：在 CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet 上，将权重衰减、数据增强、SAM 等正则化引入，系统记录 sharpness (Hessian 迹、谱范数、PAC-Bayes 估计)、泛化误差、ECE、对抗鲁棒性、函数一致性 (CKA)。
AI.result: - 同损失值解可位于几何平坦度截然不同的区域；紧决策边界使 Hessian 最大特征值增大 2–4× 但测试错误率不变；- 正则化模型 sharpness↑的同时 test error↓，ECE↓，对抗鲁棒↑；例如 SAM 使 ImageNet top-1 提升 0.9%，Hessian 迹增 35%；- sharpness 与函数复杂度 (样本平均梯度范数、RKHS 范数) 相关系数 0.82，与 test error 仅 0.11。
AI.conclusion: sharpness 反映的是目标函数与学习函数本身的复杂性而非泛化不良；尖锐极小值可对应合适的归纳偏置。建议停止把平坦度当「通用诊断工具」，未来应发展函数敏感的几何度量并结合任务结构解释解的曲率。

title: Scaling Test-Time Compute to Achieve IOI Gold Medal with Open-Weight Models
summary: Competitive programming has become a rigorous benchmark for evaluating the reasoning and problem-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs). The International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) stands out as one of the most prestigious annual competitions in competitive programming and has become a key benchmark for comparing human and AI-level programming ability. While several proprietary models have been claimed to achieve gold medal-level performance at the IOI, often with undisclosed methods, achieving comparable results with open-weight models remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we present GenCluster, a scalable and reproducible test-time compute framework that attains IOI gold-level performance using open-weight models. It combines large-scale generation, behavioral clustering, ranking, and a round-robin submission strategy to efficiently explore diverse solution spaces under limited validation budgets. Our experiments show that the performance of our proposed approach scales consistently with available compute, narrowing the gap between open and closed systems. Notably, we will show that GenCluster can achieve a gold medal at IOI 2025 for the first time with an open-weight model gpt-oss-120b, setting a new benchmark for transparent and reproducible evaluation of reasoning in LLMs

title: DocSeeker: Structured Visual Reasoning with Evidence Grounding for Long Document Understanding
summary: Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from significant performance degradation on the long document understanding task as document length increases. This stems from two fundamental challenges: 1) a low Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), with crucial evidence buried in irrelevant pages; and 2) supervision scarcity, as datasets offering only final short answers provide a weak learning signal. In this paper, we address these challenges by proposing a paradigm that requires the model to execute a structured Analysis, Localization and Reasoning workflow. To instill this capability, we design a two-stage training framework: we first perform Supervised Fine-Tuning on high-quality data generated via an efficient knowledge distillation strategy. Subsequently, we employ an Evidence-aware Group Relative Policy Optimization which jointly optimizes for both evidence localization and answer accuracy. Additionally, we introduce a Evidence-Guided Resolution Allocation strategy to mitigate memory constraints of training on multi-pages documents. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DocSeeker achieves superior performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks. We show it robustly generalizes from short-page training to ultra-long documents and is naturally synergistic with visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems, serving as a solid foundation for their implementation.
