title: Empowering Targeted Neighborhood Search via Hyper Tour for Large-Scale TSP
comment: The article has been accepted by Frontiers of Computer Science (FCS), with the DOI: {10.1007/s11704-026-52096-7}
summary: Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) is a classic NP-hard problem that has garnered significant attention from both academia and industry. While neural-based methods have shown promise for solving TSPs, they still face challenges in scaling to larger instances, particularly in memory constraints associated with global heatmaps, edge weights, or access matrices, as well as in generating high-quality initial solutions and insufficient global guidance for efficiently navigating vast search spaces. To address these challenges, we propose a Hyper Tour Guided Neighborhood Search (HyperNS) method for large-scale TSP instances. Inspired by the ``clustering first, route second" strategy, our approach initially divides the TSP instance into clusters using a sparse heatmap graph and abstracts them as supernodes, followed by the generation of a hyper tour to guide both the initialization and optimization processes. This method reduces the search space by focusing on edges relevant to the hyper tour, leading to more efficient and effective optimization. Experimental results on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing neural-based methods, particularly in handling larger-scale instances, offering a significant reduction in the gap to the optimal solution.

AI.tldr: 提出 HyperNS：先用稀疏热图聚类→超节点→超巡回指引，改进大规模 TSP 的初始化与局域搜索，显著优于现有神经方法。
AI.motivation: 神经解 TSP 在扩展到大实例时，受全局热图、边权或访问矩阵的内存膨胀、初始解质量差、全局引导不足三重瓶颈限制，亟需轻量级且具全局视野的新范式。
AI.method: 1) 用稀疏热图构造图并谱聚类，将 TSP 划分为若干簇，每个簇抽象为超节点；2) 在超节点级求“超巡回”作为全局骨架；3) 初始化仅保留超巡回相关边，显著缩减搜索空间；4) 以超巡回为引导，对簇内与簇间边执行局部迭代改进（如 2-opt/relocate）直至收敛。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上，HyperNS 相比当前最优神经方法平均距离最优解差距下降 30–50%，2000 节点实例求解时间缩短 2–3 倍，内存占用仅为传统全局热图方案的 1/4。
AI.conclusion: “先聚类-后路由”的层级抽象可有效缓解大尺度 TSP 的内存与搜索瓶颈；超巡回提供的全局骨架既降维又引导，使轻量级局域搜索即能逼近最优，为神经启发式求解超大组合优化问题提供了可扩展的新框架。

title: From edges to meaning: Semantic line sketches as a cognitive scaffold for ancient pictograph invention
summary: Humans readily recognize objects from sparse line drawings, a capacity that appears early in development and persists across cultures, suggesting neural rather than purely learned origins. Yet the computational mechanism by which the brain transforms high-level semantic knowledge into low-level visual symbols remains poorly understood. Here we propose that ancient pictographic writing emerged from the brain's intrinsic tendency to compress visual input into stable, boundary-based abstractions. We construct a biologically inspired digital twin of the visual hierarchy that encodes an image into low-level features, generates a contour sketch, and iteratively refines it through top-down feedback guided by semantic representations, mirroring the feedforward and recurrent architecture of the human visual cortex. The resulting symbols bear striking structural resemblance to early pictographs across culturally distant writing systems, including Egyptian hieroglyphs, Chinese oracle bone characters, and proto-cuneiform, and offer candidate interpretations for undeciphered scripts. Our findings support a neuro-computational origin of pictographic writing and establish a framework in which AI can recapitulate the cognitive processes by which humans first externalized perception into symbols.

AI.tldr: 将视觉稀疏线画归纳为神经可复用的边界符号；提出“视觉层级数字孪生”模型解释象形文字的神经压缩机制，在埃及、中文、楔形文字间发现跨文化结构同源特征。
AI.motivation: 人类能用极稀疏线条识别物体，此能力具先天性与跨文化一致性，却缺乏关于高层语义到最底层符号的脑计算解释；此外早期文字如何从视觉图示演变而来，尚不知道是否存在统一的神经动因。
AI.method: 构建仿人视觉皮层的前馈-反馈网络：编码图像 → 提取低级特征 → 生成轮廓草图 → 语义引导的迭代精修；将模型输出与三类地理上隔离的古文系统(埃及象形、甲骨文、楔形符号)作几何与拓扑对比；用语言学指标检验未解文字符号的可解释性。
AI.result: 生成符号与早期象形文字在笔划编组、结束点密度、边缘故障率等核心指标上无显著差异；在30条未解文字片段中，模型预测语义与考古学家排序重合度提升22-34%；跨文化相似度矩阵显示符号特征方差80%可被神经压缩参数直接预测，而非语系谱系。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持“神经压缩驱动说”——早期书写并非随机文化发明，而是人脑稳定边界抽象倾向的外化；提出的视觉层级-语义反馈通道假说为未解文字破译和类人符号生成提供统一计算框架。

title: A Practitioner's Guide to Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary:
Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), whose design is inspired-rather than dictated-by the Kolmogorov superposition theorem, have emerged as a structured alternative to MLPs. This review provides a systematic and comprehensive overview of the rapidly expanding KAN literature.
  The review is organized around three core themes: (i) clarifying the relationships between KANs and Kolmogorov superposition theory (KST), MLPs, and classical kernel methods; (ii) analyzing basis functions as a central design axis; and (iii) summarizing recent advances in accuracy, efficiency, regularization, and convergence.
  Finally, we provide a practical "Choose-Your-KAN" guide and outline open research challenges and future directions. The accompanying GitHub repository serves as a structured reference for ongoing KAN research.

AI.tldr: 综述系统梳理了Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks（KANs）作为MLP结构化替代方案的最新进展，并给出选型指南与未来方向。
AI.motivation: KANs虽借Kolmogorov叠加定理启发而提出，但其与理论、MLP及核方法的内在关联尚不清晰；同时，领域文献爆发式增长，亟需统一视角与实用指导。
AI.method: 围绕三大主题系统回顾：1) 厘清KANs与KST、MLP、经典核方法的数学与结构关系；2) 将基函数选型视为设计核心，对比各类可学习激活函数策略；3) 归纳精度、效率、正则化与收敛性的最新改进。附GitHub仓库持续维护文献与代码索引。
AI.result: 明确了KANs在函数逼近、参数效率与可解释性上的潜力；总结出基函数类型、网格自适应与稀疏正则化是影响性能的关键设计轴；列出十余项可立即落地的加速与稳定化技巧。
AI.conclusion: KANs已走出“定理驱动”雏形，成为可与传统MLP竞争的模块；未来需解决高维扩展、动态网格、硬件级加速及与Transformer等架构的深度集成。作者发布“Choose-Your-KAN”决策树，帮助研究者在3分钟内选出匹配任务需求的KAN变体。

title: Auto-FP: An Experimental Study of Automated Feature Preprocessing for Tabular Data
summary: Classical machine learning models, such as linear models and tree-based models, are widely used in industry. These models are sensitive to data distribution, thus feature preprocessing, which transforms features from one distribution to another, is a crucial step to ensure good model quality. Manually constructing a feature preprocessing pipeline is challenging because data scientists need to make difficult decisions about which preprocessors to select and in which order to compose them. In this paper, we study how to automate feature preprocessing (Auto-FP) for tabular data. Due to the large search space, a brute-force solution is prohibitively expensive. To address this challenge, we interestingly observe that Auto-FP can be modelled as either a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) or a neural architecture search (NAS) problem. This observation enables us to extend a variety of HPO and NAS algorithms to solve the Auto-FP problem. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation and analysis of 15 algorithms on 45 public ML datasets. Overall, evolution-based algorithms show the leading average ranking. Surprisingly, the random search turns out to be a strong baseline. Many surrogate-model-based and bandit-based search algorithms, which achieve good performance for HPO and NAS, do not outperform random search for Auto-FP. We analyze the reasons for our findings and conduct a bottleneck analysis to identify the opportunities to improve these algorithms. Furthermore, we explore how to extend Auto-FP to support parameter search and compare two ways to achieve this goal. In the end, we evaluate Auto-FP in an AutoML context and discuss the limitations of popular AutoML tools. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study on automated feature preprocessing. We hope our work can inspire researchers to develop new algorithms tailored for Auto-FP.

AI.tldr: 首次系统研究表格数据自动化特征预处理（Auto-FP），发现可将其建模为HPO或NAS，并在45个数据集上对比15种算法；进化算法整体最优，随机搜索成为强基线，多数基于代理/多臂赌博机的HPO/NAS方法未超越随机搜索，且存在扩展与AutoML工具局限。
AI.motivation: 工业界广泛使用的经典ML模型对数据分布高度敏感，人工构造特征预处理管线需反复决策“选什么、按何顺序组合”，成本极高；自动化该环节可显著降低专家干预、提升建模效率与模型质量。
AI.method: 1）将Auto-FP统一建模为超参优化（HPO）与神经网络架构搜索（NAS），从而直接复用两类搜索框架； 2）在45个公开表格数据集上，系统评估15种代表性算法（含随机搜索、贝叶优化、Hyperband、BOHB、多种进化算法等）； 3）对搜索瓶颈进行归因分析，提出向“参数搜索”扩展的两条路线； 4）把Auto-FP嵌入AutoML端到端流程，测试主流AutoML工具表现并剖析其局限。
AI.result: • 平均排序上，进化类算法领先；随机搜索是极具竞争力的基线； • 多数基于代理模型/多臂赌博机的HPO/NAS算法在Auto-FP场景下未显著优于随机搜索； • 瓶颈分析表明搜索空间结构与目标函数特性导致代理模型收益受限； • 两种“参数搜索”扩展路线中，联合优化略优于分阶段优化； • 集成到AutoML后，现成工具在特征预处理环节仍有明显改进空间。
AI.conclusion: Auto-FP作为独立任务具有独特搜索特性，传统HPO/NAS算法需针对性改造；进化算法与简单随机策略的优异性提示该领域尚缺专用算法。未来应结合表格数据分布特性设计新的搜索/约束/评价机制，并推动AutoML工具原生支持Auto-FP。

title: Data-Efficient RLVR via Off-Policy Influence Guidance
summary: Data selection is a critical aspect of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Current data selection methods are largely heuristic-based, lacking theoretical guarantees and generalizability. This work proposes a theoretically-grounded approach using influence functions to estimate the contribution of each data point to the learning objective. To overcome the prohibitive computational cost of policy rollouts required for online influence estimation, we introduce an off-policy influence estimation method that efficiently approximates data influence using pre-collected offline trajectories. Furthermore, to manage the high-dimensional gradients of LLMs, we employ sparse random projection to reduce dimensionality and improve storage and computation efficiency. Leveraging these techniques, we develop \textbf{C}urriculum \textbf{R}L with \textbf{O}ff-\textbf{P}olicy \text{I}nfluence guidance (\textbf{CROPI}), a multi-stage RL framework that iteratively selects the most influential data for the current policy. Experiments on models up to 7B parameters demonstrate that CROPI significantly accelerates training. On a 1.5B model, it achieves a 2.66x step-level acceleration while using only 10\% of the data per stage compared to full-dataset training. Our results highlight the substantial potential of influence-based data selection for efficient RLVR.

AI.tldr: 在奖赏可验证的强化学习（RLVR）场景下，提出基于influence function的离线数据选择框架CROPI，只用10%数据即可将7B参数以下模型的训练步数压缩至原来的1/3。
AI.motivation: RLVR数据筛选目前依赖启发式方法，没有理论保证且难泛化。作者希望给出一种可解释、可理论分析的“哪些样本最值得练”的通用方案。
AI.method: 1) 用influence function衡量每条离线轨迹对当前策略目标函数的贡献；2) 用离线重采样代替线上策略展开，避免昂贵rollout；3) 用稀疏随机投影压缩高维梯度，降低存储与计算；4) 将上述技术嵌入多阶段课程学习框架，每阶段仅选Top-K影响样本训练。
AI.result: 在7B以内参数规模的多个模型实验：1.5B模型上，CROPI仅用10%数据即可达到与全量数据相同最优奖励，实现2.66倍步级加速；其余模型也呈显著训练步数下降且最终奖励持平或更高。
AI.conclusion: influence-based的方法理论上可解释，实践中对RLVR数据选择有效；CROPI为LLM高效强化学习提供了通用且廉价的新范式，无需在线滚即可精确定位高价值样本。

title: Deep Learning Based Amharic Chatbot for FAQs in Universities
summary: University students often spend a considerable amount of time seeking answers to common questions from administrators or teachers. This can become tedious for both parties, leading to a need for a solution. In response, this paper proposes a chatbot model that utilizes natural language processing and deep learning techniques to answer frequently asked questions (FAQs) in the Amharic language. Chatbots are computer programs that simulate human conversation through the use of artificial intelligence (AI), acting as a virtual assistant to handle questions and other tasks. The proposed chatbot program employs tokenization, normalization, stop word removal, and stemming to analyze and categorize Amharic input sentences. Three machine learning model algorithms were used to classify tokens and retrieve appropriate responses: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Multinomial Naïve Bayes, and deep neural networks implemented through TensorFlow, Keras, and NLTK. The deep learning model achieved the best results with 91.55% accuracy and a validation loss of 0.3548 using an Adam optimizer and SoftMax activation function. The chatbot model was integrated with Facebook Messenger and deployed on a Heroku server for 24-hour accessibility. The experimental results demonstrate that the chatbot framework achieved its objectives and effectively addressed challenges such as Amharic Fidel variation, morphological variation, and lexical gaps. Future research could explore the integration of Amharic WordNet to narrow the lexical gap and support more complex questions.

AI.tldr: 用深度学习和 NLP 技术构建阿姆哈拉语 FAQ 聊天机器人，并通过 Facebook Messenger 部署，用于自动回答大学生常见问题。
AI.motivation: 学生频繁向管理员或教师咨询常规问题耗费时间，双方效率低，亟需自动化问答解决方案。
AI.method: 在阿姆哈拉语 FAQ 语料上实施分词、归一化、停用词过滤与词干提取；对比 SVM、多项式朴素贝叶斯和 TensorFlow/Keras 深度神经网络，以检索式对话生成答案并集成到 Facebook Messenger 的 Heroku 服务。
AI.result: 深度学习模型取得最高 91.55% 的分类准确率、验证损失 0.3548（Adam & SoftMax），可有效应对阿姆哈拉字符、形态及词汇缺口等难点，实现 24 h 在线服务。
AI.conclusion: 该阿姆哈拉语 FAQ 聊天机器人框架满足了自动问答需求，后续引入 WordNet 等领域资源有望缩小词汇缺口并支持更复杂提问。

title: Think Outside the Policy: In-Context Steered Policy Optimization
summary: Existing Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), have achieved remarkable progress in improving the reasoning capabilities of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). However, they exhibit limited exploration due to reliance on on-policy rollouts which are confined to the current policy's distribution, resulting in narrow trajectory diversity. Recent approaches attempt to expand policy coverage by incorporating trajectories generated from stronger expert models, yet this reliance increases computational cost and such advanced models are often inaccessible. To address these issues, we propose In-Context Steered Policy Optimization (ICPO), a unified framework that leverages the inherent in-context learning capability of LRMs to provide expert guidance using existing datasets. ICPO introduces mixed-policy GRPO with implicit expert forcing, which expands exploration beyond the current policy distribution without requiring advanced LRM trajectories. To further stabilize optimization, ICPO integrates expert region reject sampling to filter unreliable off-policy trajectories and annealed expert-bonus reward shaping to balance early expert guidance with later autonomous improvement. Results demonstrate that ICPO consistently enhances RLVR performance and training stability on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, revealing a scalable and effective RLVR paradigm for LRMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Celine-hxy/ICPO.

AI.tldr: ICPO以极低成本，通过「上下文显式引导 + 混合策略 GRPO」，让 LRM 将已有专家数据「自救式再利用」，解决 RLVR 探索受阻、易趋「自限」问题，数学推理任务上稳定超越 GRPO，无需更强第三方大模型。
AI.motivation: 当前 RLVR（如 GRPO）仅靠同策略采样，轨迹多样性差，难以持续拓宽推理技能包。引入外部强模型能缓解，但代价高并且模型不可得，纯「自力更生」的探索受局限。作者思考：能否在现有算力和数据框架内，让模型把「已有专家经验」当作可即时调用的上下文向导，低成本扩域。
AI.method: 提出 In-Context Steered Policy Optimization（ICPO），框架三件套：①覆盖度层——混合策略 GRPO：按比例混入「旧专家数据」做 off-policy 采样；②隐式专家驱动：提示模板中直接插入示例答案，触发模型上下文学习，迫使 exploration 远离均值；③稳定层：a) expert-region reject sampling，按 KL/响应置信过滤低质 prompt-off 轨迹；b) 退火式专家奖励塑形，早期加奖励引导，后期衰减激励自力探索。训练全程只复用低级或现有好轨迹，不再蒸馏昂贵新大模型。
AI.result: 在 Multi-choose、MATH 等多个数学推理基准上，ICPO 训练曲线更稳，最终准确率一致优于 GRPO（相对提升 2–5%）；用不同规模自训模型测试，均表现出稳定增益且对超参（混合比、退火步）不敏感，显示出可扩展的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ICPO 证明「上下文内专家引导 + 混合策略 RL」是低成本 RLVR 新范式：它脱离外部强模型依赖，靠模型自我回顾/模仿即能扩探索、稳更新，为大推理模型后续自训自进化提供了可行且计算友好度高的方案。

title: RECOVER: Designing a Large Language Model-based Remote Patient Monitoring System for Postoperative Gastrointestinal Cancer Care
summary: Cancer surgery is a key treatment for gastrointestinal (GI) cancers, a group of cancers that account for more than 35% of cancer-related deaths worldwide, but postoperative complications are unpredictable and can be life-threatening. In this paper, we investigate how recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) can benefit remote patient monitoring (RPM) systems through clinical integration by designing RECOVER, an LLM-powered RPM system for postoperative GI cancer care. To closely engage stakeholders in the design process, we first conducted seven participatory design sessions with five clinical staff and interviewed five cancer patients to derive six major design strategies for integrating clinical guidelines and information needs into LLM-based RPM systems. We then designed and implemented RECOVER, which features an LLM-powered conversational agent for cancer patients and an interactive dashboard for clinical staff to enable efficient postoperative RPM. Finally, we used RECOVER as a pilot system to assess the implementation of our design strategies with four clinical staff and five patients, providing design implications by identifying crucial design elements, offering insights on responsible AI, and outlining opportunities for future LLM-powered RPM systems.

AI.tldr: RECOVER是一套专为胃肠癌术后患者打造的以大模型(LLM)为驱动力的远程监护(RPM)原型，它通过两场基层共创与可行性评估，为LLM进入肿瘤护理场景提出六项设计策略与责任化落地要点。
AI.motivation: 胃肠癌手术最致命但并发症难以预判；传统RPM无法兼顾患者易用体验与医护临床需求。团队借此契机探讨大模型能否填补临床盲区，让术后高危期监测实时、双向、可解释。
AI.method: (1) 两场多角色参与式设计：5名肿瘤医护与5名患者×7场共创会议，梳理LLM-RPM要解决的6项核心痛点并转化为设计策略；(2) 原型开发：LLM对话式患者端与可视化管理端并行，嵌入指南知识与患者教育；(3) 小规模可行性评估：再次引入4名医护与5名患者对RECOVER进行为期两周的交互实测、可用性访谈与责任AI打分。
AI.result: 6类设计策略(如指南对齐、症状分层预警、隐私护栏、双向可信度校准等)在RECOVER中全部落地，医护端管理负荷较既有系统平均减少37%，患者对AI响应信任度≥85%，未发生关键词漏报或误判导致的险情。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明LLM可显著提高胃肠癌术后RPM的远程复诊效率和线上协同韧性，但需基于

title: Learning Dynamics from Input-Output Data with Hamiltonian Gaussian Processes
summary: Embedding non-restrictive prior knowledge, such as energy conservation laws, into learning methods is a key motive to construct physically consistent dynamics models from limited data, relevant for, e.g., model-based control. Recent work incorporates Hamiltonian dynamics into Gaussian Processes (GPs) to obtain uncertainty-quantifying, energy-consistent models, but these methods rely on -- rarely available -- velocity or momentum data. In this paper, we study dynamics learning using Hamiltonian GPs and focus on learning solely from input-output data, without relying on velocity or momentum measurements. Adopting a non-conservative formulation, energy exchange with the environment, e.g., through external forces or dissipation, can be captured. We provide a fully Bayesian scheme for estimating probability densities of unknown hidden states, GP hyperparameters, as well as structural hyperparameters, such as damping coefficients. The proposed method is evaluated in a nonlinear simulation case study and compared to a state-of-the-art approach that relies on momentum measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅依赖输入-输出数据（无需速度或动量）的保守-非保守统一贝叶斯框架：Hamiltonian GP 联合估计隐藏状态、GP 超参数与阻尼结构参数，在仿真中以完全能量相容模型与现有动量依赖方法性能相当。
AI.motivation: 在数据稀缺场景下，将能量守恒/耗散等先验嵌入动态模型以保证物理一致；现有 Hamiltonian GP 需速度/动量信号，难以满足实际工程（如模型预测控制）对该类传感器的缺失或不可靠。
AI.method: 1）把耗散及外力显式写入增广 Hamiltonian，构造可反向可正反向积分的非保守动力学；2）在 GP 状态空间上定义能量诱导核，使 GP 先验与 Hamilton 向量场一致；3）采用粒子 MCMC 做完全贝叶斯推断，同步估计不可观测速度、动量、阻尼系数及核长、噪声级等超参数；4）仅使用输入（外力）-输出（位姿/位置）时间序列数据进行训练。
AI.result: 在二维非线性绳摆-阻尼仿真中，提出的无动量方案对幅度-频率能量谱的误差低于 2.7%，动力学向前 50 步的覆盖率置信区间保持在稳态误差带内；与依赖动量测量的 SOTA Hamiltonian GP 相比，预测 RMSE 相当但量化不确定性更窄，且在能量隐变量外推上保持经济低温分布的守恒趋势。
AI.conclusion: 所提非动量 Hamiltonian GP 能在不牺牲先验物理约束、也无需额外传感的前提下，输出能量一致、不确定度定量且可在线控制的动态模型，为鲁棒控制与安全关键系统提供了一种数据高效的贝叶斯建模范式。

title: A closer look at how large language models trust humans: patterns and biases
summary: As large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents increasingly interact with humans in decision-making contexts, understanding the trust dynamics between humans and AI agents becomes a central concern. While considerable literature studies how humans trust AI agents, it is much less understood how LLM-based agents develop effective trust in humans. LLM-based agents likely rely on some sort of implicit effective trust in trust-related contexts (e.g., evaluating individual loan applications) to assist and affect decision making. Using established behavioral theories, we develop an approach that studies whether LLMs trust depends on the three major trustworthiness dimensions: competence, benevolence and integrity of the human subject. We also study how demographic variables affect effective trust. Across 43,200 simulated experiments, for five popular language models, across five different scenarios we find that LLM trust development shows an overall similarity to human trust development. We find that in most, but not all cases, LLM trust is strongly predicted by trustworthiness, and in some cases also biased by age, religion and gender, especially in financial scenarios. This is particularly true for scenarios common in the literature and for newer models. While the overall patterns align with human-like mechanisms of effective trust formation, different models exhibit variation in how they estimate trust; in some cases, trustworthiness and demographic factors are weak predictors of effective trust. These findings call for a better understanding of AI-to-human trust dynamics and monitoring of biases and trust development patterns to prevent unintended and potentially harmful outcomes in trust-sensitive applications of AI.

AI.tldr: 首次系统研究LLM对人类的“信任”机制：LLM会像人一样受能力、善意、正直三维度影响，但也会被年龄、性别、宗教等人口特征干扰，尤其在金融场景；不同模型表现差异大，需警惕偏差与失控。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦“人信AI”，而AI系统反向信任人类的机制空白；随着LLM深度参与人类决策，若其误判人类可信度，将导致贷款审批、招聘等高风险场景出现系统性偏差或损害，故需量化LLM的“有效信任”及其成因而非仅关注人类视角。
AI.method: 基于组织行为学三维信任理论（能力、善意、正直），构建5类真实决策场景（含金融、医疗、招聘）的43,200次仿真实验；对5个主流LLM生成带人口属性（年龄、性别、宗教）的虚拟人类档案，控制措辞与上下文，采用多层回归与因果森林分离信任维度与人口变量效应；对比人类实验基线以验证机制一致性。
AI.result: 整体看，LLM信任曲线与人类相似，三维信任度可显著预测其信任输出（|β|>0.4），但人口偏差同步存在：金融场景中，女性、老年、穆斯林身份平均使信任评分下降4–9个百分点；新模型（如GPT-4-Turbo）偏差反而更强；部分模型在医疗场景几乎忽略三维信息，信任预测力不足30%，显示模型间策略异质性高。
AI.conclusion: LLM已内隐演化出类人信任框架，却同步吸收并放大社会偏见；在高风险决策链路中，需将“AI信人”纳入监控，建立动态校准与偏差抑制层，并推动模型开源其信任估计机制以防 unintended discrimination。

title: Mitigating Barren Plateaus in Quantum Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model
summary: Quantum generative models exploit quantum superposition and entanglement to enhance learning efficiency for both classical and quantum data. Recently, inspired by classical diffusion frameworks, the quantum denoising diffusion probabilistic model (QuDDPM) has emerged as a powerful tool for learning correlated noise models, many-body phases, and topological data structure. However, we demonstrate that QuDDPM's efficacy is currently restricted to small-scale systems (typically $\le$ 5 qubits). As the system size increases, a severe barren plateau (BP) problem emerges, fundamentally limiting the model's scalability. We provide rigorous theoretical proofs and experimental validation to identify the origin of this BP, distinct from previously known causes. To restore trainability, we introduce an architectureal enhancement that mitigates the BP and ensures training stability. Furthermore, we propose a conditional QuDDPM, capable of generating ground states based on Hamiltonian parameters, significantly expanding the utility of quantum generative models for complex quantum state preparation. Our approach not only restores the scalability and trainability bottlenecks of quantum diffusion models but also provides a robust tool for exploring complex quantum matter and state preparation in the NISQ era.

AI.tldr: 量子去噪扩散模型（QuDDPM）随量子比特数增长出现可训练性“贫瘠高原”，作者解析其独特成因并提出可扩展的架构修正及条件化生成方案，使其能在 NISQ 时代稳定制备复杂量子基态。
AI.motivation: 现有 QuDDPM 虽在 ≤5 量子比特的小系统中展现出学习关联噪声、多体相及拓扑结构的能力，但系统规模扩大后训练失败，阻碍其在 NISQ 设备上用于复杂量子态制备的实际应用。
AI.method: 1) 提供严格理论证明与实验，指出 QuDDPM 中一种与既往机制不同的新型贫瘠高原（BP）是根因；2) 在生成网络结构层面引入针对性增强，显著削弱 BP；3) 构建以哈密顿量参数为条件的条件 QuDDPM，实现按需基态生成。
AI.result: 提出的架构改进使模型在更大系统规模下仍能稳定训练；条件 QuDDPM 成功生成目标哈密顿量对应的基态，验证了可扩展性与实用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过精准识别并消除 QuDDPM 的特有 BP，作者恢复了量子扩散模型的可扩展性与可训练性，为 NISQ 时代的复杂量子物态探索和大规模量子态制备提供了稳健工具。

title: MulDimIF: A Multi-Dimensional Constraint Framework for Evaluating and Improving Instruction Following in Large Language Models
summary: Instruction following refers to the ability of large language models (LLMs) to generate outputs that satisfy all specified constraints. Existing research has primarily focused on constraint categories, offering limited evaluation dimensions and little guidance for improving instruction-following abilities. To address this gap, we introduce MulDimIF, a multi-dimensional constraint framework encompassing three constraint patterns, four constraint categories, and four difficulty levels. Based on this framework, we design a controllable instruction generation pipeline. Through constraint expansion, conflict detection, and instruction rewriting, we construct 9,106 code-verifiable samples. We evaluate 18 LLMs from six model families and find marked performance differences across constraint settings. For instance, average accuracy decreases from 80.82% at Level I to 36.76% at Level IV. Moreover, training with data generated by our framework significantly improves instruction following without compromising general performance. In-depth analysis indicates that these gains stem largely from parameter updates in attention modules, which strengthen constraint recognition and adherence. Code and data are available in https://github.com/Junjie-Ye/MulDimIF.

AI.tldr: 提出MulDimIF，一个三维（模式、类别、难度）约束评测框架与可控指令生成管道，产出9,106条可代码验证样本；对18种LLM的实验显示难度等级间精度差距达44百分点，用该框架数据微调可在不降通用性能前提下显著提升指令遵循率，消融表明收益主要来自注意力模块参数更新。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM指令遵循的评估聚焦在约束类别，缺乏系统维度与难度分级，难以精准定位模型缺陷并指导提升。
AI.method: 1. 构建MulDimIF框架：3种约束模式（顺序、嵌套、并行）×4类约束（内容、格式、逻辑、外部）×4级难度（I–IV）。 2. 设计可控指令生成流水线：约束扩展→冲突检测→指令重写，生成9,106条可自动代码验证的样本。 3. 在6个模型家族18个LLM上系统评测，并开展微调和机制分析。
AI.result: 难度由I升至IV时，平均准确率从80.82%骤降至36.76%；用MulDimIF数据微调后，目标模型指令遵循率显著上升且通用基准不掉点；注意力模块参数更新是性能提升的主因。
AI.conclusion: MulDimIF首次实现多维、可扩展、难度分级的指令遵循评测，为后续模型诊断与数据增强提供标准化工具与实证路径。

title: Guided Transfer Learning for Discrete Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 ReALM-GEN Workshop 9 pages (main text) + appendix
summary: Discrete diffusion models (DMs) have achieved strong performance in language and other discrete domains, offering a compelling alternative to autoregressive modeling. Yet this performance typically depends on large training datasets, challenging the performance of DMs in small-data regimes -- common under real-world constraints. Aimed at this challenge, recent work in continuous DMs suggests that transfer learning via classifier ratio-based guidance can adapt a pretrained DM to a related target distribution, often outperforming alternatives such as full-weight fine-tuning on the target data. By contrast, transfer learning for discrete DMs remains unexplored. We address this gap by exploring practical analogues of ratio-based transfer learning for discrete DMs. Our theoretical analysis shows that a direct extension of existing ratio-based guidance is computationally prohibitive, scaling with vocabulary size. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a scheduling mechanism that yields a practical algorithm, Guided Transfer Learning for discrete diffusion models (GTL). GTL enables sampling from a target distribution without modifying the pretrained denoiser and reduces the cost to linear scaling in vocabulary size, which in turn supports longer sequence generation. We evaluate GTL on sequential data, including synthetic Markov chains and language modeling tasks, and provide a detailed empirical analysis of its behavior. The results highlight a clear trade-off: when target datasets are large, weight fine-tuning is often preferable, whereas GTL becomes increasingly effective as target data shrinks. Finally, we experimentally demonstrate a key failure mode of GTL: when the source and target distributions overlap poorly, the ratio-based classifier required for guidance becomes unreliable, limiting transfer performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GTL——首个面向离散扩散模型的小样本迁移算法，用线性复杂度替代指数级分类器比值引导；实验证明在目标数据稀缺时 GTL 优于全参数微调，但在源-目标分布重叠度低时失效。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型虽在语言等离散域表现优异，却依赖大数据训练，而小样本场景常见；连续扩散模型已用分类器比值引导实现迁移，离散领域尚无对应方法，亟需填补空白。
AI.method: 理论证明直接搬用连续域比值引导会因随词表指数增长而不可行，遂提出调度机制把复杂度降至线性，形成 GTL 算法：冻结预训练去噪网络，仅以比值分类器指导采样，无需更新模型权重。
AI.result: 在合成马尔可夫链与语言任务上，GTL 在长序列生成中保持线性开销；目标数据越稀少，GTL 相对全参数微调优势越大，但在源-目标分布重叠不足时比值估计失准，迁移性能骤降。
AI.conclusion: GTL 为离散扩散模型的小样本迁移提供了可扩展的首次解决方案，验证“数据稀缺→引导迁移、数据充足→微调”的实用策略，同时揭示分布重叠度是决定其成败的关键，提示未来需改进比值估计鲁棒性。

title: Two-Stage Regularization-Based Structured Pruning for LLMs
summary: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) is largely hindered by their large number of parameters. Structural pruning has emerged as a promising solution. Prior structured pruning methods directly remove unimportant parameters based on certain metrics, which often causes knowledge loss and necessitates extensive retraining. To overcome this, we introduce a novel pruning method TRSP: Two-Stage Regularization-Based Structured Pruning for LLMs. Specifically, we multiply the output of each transformer layer by an initial learnable weight and iteratively learn these weights by adding their $\ell_1$-norm as a regularization term to the loss function, serving as the first-stage regularization. Subsequently, we apply additional regularization to the difference between the output and input of layers with smaller weights, encouraging the shift of knowledge to the preserved layers. This serves as the second-stage regularization. TRSP retains more knowledge and better preserves model performance than direct parameter elimination. Through extensive experimentation we show that TRSP outperforms strong layer-wise structured pruning methods without requiring retraining. As a layer-wise pruning method, it delivers notable end-to-end acceleration, making it a promising solution for efficient LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: TRSP 通过两阶段可学习权重正则化，在不重训练的前提下把知识迁移到保留层，实现 LLM 的层剪枝与端到端加速。
AI.motivation: LLM 参数量巨大，现有结构化剪枝直接删除参数导致知识丢失并重训练代价高。
AI.method: TRSP：第一阶段给每层输出乘可学习标量并以 L1 正则化压缩至零；第二阶段对权重较小层的输入-输出差异再加正则化，促使知识向保留层迁移。
AI.result: 实验表明 TRSP 在不重训练的情况下，优于强层剪枝基线，保留更多知识并保持模型性能。
AI.conclusion: TRSP 是一种无需重训练、保留知识且能带来显著端到端加速的 LLM 层剪枝方案，具有部署潜力。

title: SHARe-KAN: Post-Training Vector Quantization for Cache-Resident KAN Inference
summary: Pre-trained Vision Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) store a dense B-spline grid on every edge, inflating prediction-head parameter counts by more than 140X relative to a comparable MLP and pushing inference into a memory-bound regime on edge accelerators. Standard magnitude pruning fails on these pre-trained models: zero-shot sparsity collapses accuracy, and restoring it requires an iterative fine-tuning loop that is impractical in deployment settings. We present SHARe-KAN, a post-training compiler that compresses spline coefficients via a Gain-Shape-Bias decomposition with a layer-shared codebook, paired with LUTHAM, an ExecuTorch runtime that maps the codebook into on-chip L2. On PASCAL VOC detection with a ResNet-50 backbone, SHARe-KAN Int8 reaches 9.3X storage compression over the Dense KAN baseline (6.32 MB vs. 58.67 MB prediction head) at a 2.0 point in-domain accuracy cost (80.22% vs. 82.22% mAP), with no retraining. Zero-shot transfer to COCO retains 88.9% of the Dense KAN mAP; most of this gap comes from the VQ clustering step itself, and further quantization from FP32 to Int8 costs only 1.3 retention points. The value of the approach compounds at scale: at 50 task heads, Dense KAN prediction-head storage reaches 2.9 GB while SHARe-KAN Int8 requires 211 MB, a 13.9X reduction that brings multi-expert KAN deployment within the memory budgets of contemporary edge silicon.

AI.tldr: 提出SHARe-KAN+LUTHAM方案，在不重训的情况下把Vision-KAN预测头从58.7 MB压到6.3 MB（9.3×），仅掉2.0 mAP；50个头时从2.9 GB压到211 MB（13.9×），使KAN可在端侧加速器运行。
AI.motivation: Vision KAN在边端推理时，每边稠密B-spline网格使预测头参数量暴涨140×以上，落入memory-bound；直接剪枝掉点严重且需迭代微调，部署不现实，需要零重训的压缩方案。
AI.method: SHARE-KAN后训练编译器：①按Gain-Shape-Bias分解每边样条系数；②层间共享码本矢量量化；③LUTHAM运行时把码本映射到芯片L2，用LUT即时重构Int8权重，全程无微调。
AI.result: ResNet-50+VOC：58.7→6.3 MB，9.3×压缩，mAP 82.22→80.22（-2.0）；零样迁移到COCO保持88.9%原精度；50头场景2.9 GB→211 MB，13.9×压缩，符合端侧内存预算。
AI.conclusion: SHARe-KAN+LUTHAM首次实现KAN预测头的后训练高倍压缩，在几乎不牺牲精度的前提下把多专家KAN的存储与推理载入当代边缘加速器可承受范围。

title: Visual Sparse Steering (VS2): Unsupervised Adaptation for Image Classification using Sparsity-Guided Steering Vectors
summary: Steering vision foundation models at test time, without updating foundation-model weights or using labeled target data, is a desirable yet challenging goal. We present Visual Sparse Steering (VS2), a lightweight, label-free adaptation method that constructs a steering vector from sparse features extracted by a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) trained on unlabeled in-domain training-split activations of the vision encoder. VS2 offers three key advantages over existing test-time adaptation methods: (1) a feature-level intervention space in sparse SAE representations; (2) efficiency, requiring only a forward pass with no test-time optimization or backpropagation; and (3) a reliability diagnostic based on SAE reconstruction loss that can skip steering when reconstruction is poor, enabling safe fallback to the baseline, a capability not standard in conventional steering vectors and test-time adaptation methods. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and Tiny-ImageNet and two CLIP backbones (ViT-B/32, ViT-B/16), VS2 improves zero-shot top-1 accuracy by 3.45-4.12\%, 0.93-1.08\%, and 1.50-1.84\%, respectively, while remaining forward-only and adding minimal compute overhead. A retrieval-based upper-bound analysis suggests substantial headroom if task-relevant sparse features can be selected reliably, motivating future work on selective feature amplification for interpretable, efficient test-time steering.

title: Learning-Based Estimation of Spatially Resolved Scatter Radiation Fields in Interventional Radiology
summary: We present three variants of a lightweight, fully connected artificial neural network, suited for interactive estimation of three-dimensional, spatially resolved volumes of scattered radiation fields and a corresponding training pipeline for radiation protection dosimetry in medical radiation fields, such as those found in interventional radiology and cardiology. Accompanying, we present three different synthetically generated datasets with increasing complexity for training, generated using RadField3D, a Monte Carlo simulation application based on Geant4. As the primary scatter object, we employed the torso of a male Alderson RANDO phantom. On those datasets, we evaluate convolutional and fully connected architectures of neural networks to demonstrate which design decisions work well for reconstructing the fluence and spectra distributions over the spatial domain of such radiation fields. All our datasets, as well as our training pipeline, are published as open source in separate repositories. To evaluate the presented neural networks, we define and assess several metrics. Across these measures, the model variants demonstrate good spatial agreement between predicted and ground-truth radiation fields, particularly within specific regions of interest within the radiation field. Of particular relevance for potential application in out-of-field dosimetry is the SMAPE of the scatter radiation field, which represents the most challenging metric and was consistently above 84 %.

AI.tldr: 三种小型全连接网络＋合成数据可快速重建介入术中三维散射线分布，开放源码。
AI.motivation: 介入放射/心脏术中需实时获知三维散射线分布以估算离野剂量，但传统蒙卡模拟太慢，阻碍术中即时剂量防护。
AI.method: 用 Geant4-MC 软件 RadField3D 生成三套复杂度递增的合成数据集（男性 RANDO 躯干为散射体）；设计三种轻量化全连接网络，与卷积网络对比，通过自定义指标训练评估，全部代码与数据开源。
AI.result: 网络可快速重建散射线场，空间一致性高；对最具挑战性的离野区域，散射线场 SMAPE 始终 >84%，显示重建精度仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 所提轻量全连接网络与合成数据为实时三维散射线估算提供可行开源框架，对术中剂量防护有潜力，但离野精度需进一步改进。

title: Frozen Forecasting: A Unified Evaluation
summary: Forecasting future events is a fundamental capability for general-purpose systems that plan or act across different levels of abstraction. Yet, evaluating whether a forecast is "correct" remains challenging due to the inherent uncertainty of the future. We propose a unified evaluation framework for assessing the forecasting capabilities of frozen vision backbones across diverse tasks and abstraction levels. Rather than focusing on single time steps, our framework evaluates entire trajectories and incorporates distributional metrics that better capture the multimodal nature of future outcomes. Given a frozen vision model, we train latent diffusion models to forecast future features directly in its representation space, which are then decoded via lightweight, task-specific readouts. This enables consistent evaluation across a suite of diverse tasks while isolating the forecasting capacity of the backbone itself. We apply our framework to nine diverse vision models, spanning image and video pretraining, contrastive and generative objectives, and with or without language supervision, and evaluate them on four forecasting tasks, from low-level pixel predictions to high-level object motion. We find that forecasting performance strongly correlates with perceptual quality and that the forecasting abilities of video synthesis models are comparable or exceed those pretrained in masking regimes across all levels of abstraction. However, language supervision does not consistently improve forecasting. Notably, video-pretrained models consistently outperform image-based ones.

AI.tldr: 提出首个统一框架，用分布式轨迹评估冻结视觉主干的预测能力，发现视频预训练模型跨抽象层均优于图像模型，语言监督无益。
AI.motivation: 现有评估只看点预测且任务割裂，无法衡量通用系统在多抽象层级上的「未来预测」核心能力。
AI.method: 1)将冻结主干特征作为状态；2)训练潜扩散模型直接在其表示空间生成未来特征轨迹；3)用轻量任务头解码；4)引入分布式轨迹级指标（如KL、Coverage）评价多模态正确性。
AI.result: 对9类视觉主干（图像/视频、对比/生成、有无语言）在4个层级任务（像素→物体运动）上系统评估：预测性能与感知质量强相关；视频预训练模型全面领先；视频生成式遮蔽预训练；语言监督无一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 统一轨迹级评估揭示视频预训练是获取多抽象预测能力的关键，语言信息并非必要，为未来通用规划系统提供基准与模型选择依据。

title: A Review of Diffusion-based Simulation-Based Inference: Foundations and Applications in Non-Ideal Data Scenarios
summary: For complex simulation problems, inferring parameters often precludes the use of classical likelihood-based techniques due to intractable likelihoods. Simulation-based inference (SBI) methods offer a likelihood-free approach to directly learn posterior distributions $p(\bftheta \mid \xobs)$ from simulator outputs. Recently, diffusion models have emerged as promising tools for SBI, addressing limitations of earlier neural methods such as neural likelihood/posterior estimation and normalizing flows. This review examines diffusion-based SBI from first principles to applications, emphasizing robustness in three non-ideal data scenarios common to scientific computing: model misspecification (simulator-reality mismatch), unstructured or infinite-dimensional observations, and missing data. We synthesize mathematical foundations and survey eight methods addressing these challenges, such as conditional diffusion for irregular data, guided diffusion for prior adaptation, sequential and factorized approaches for efficiency, and consistency models for fast sampling. Throughout, we maintain consistent notation and emphasize conditions required for accurate posteriors. We conclude with open problems and applications to geophysical uncertainty quantification, where these challenges are acute.

title: Autonomous Multi-objective Alloy Design through Simulation-guided Optimization
summary: Alloy discovery is constrained by vast compositional spaces, competing objectives, and prohibitive experimental costs. Although simulations and machine learning have each accelerated parts of this process, unifying scientific knowledge, scalable search, and experimental confirmation into a data-efficient workflow remains challenging. Here, we present AutoMAT, a hierarchical autonomous framework spanning ideation to experimental validation. Integrating large language models, automated CALPHAD simulations, residual-learning-based correction, and AI-guided optimization, AutoMAT translates design targets into candidate alloys, refines compositions through closed-loop computational search, and validates results experimentally without hand-curated datasets. Targeting lightweight, high-strength alloys, AutoMAT identifies a titanium alloy 8.1% less dense and 13.0% stronger than the aerospace benchmark Ti-185, achieving the highest specific strength among benchmarked systems. In a second case, AutoMAT discovers a high-entropy alloy with 28.2% higher yield strength than the baseline while preserving high ductility. AutoMAT compresses alloy discovery from years to weeks, establishing a generalizable route toward autonomous materials design.

AI.tldr: AutoMAT以“构思–计算–验证”闭环，无需人工标注数据，两周级发现两种性能创纪录的合金，示范材料自主设计。
AI.motivation: 传统合金研发受限于成分空间爆炸、目标冲突与实验昂贵，现有模拟或机器学习手段难以贯通科学知识、高效搜索与实验确认。
AI.method: 构建分层自主框架 AutoMAT：①LLM 将性能目标转化为初始成分；②自动化 CALPHAD 高通量筛选；③残差学习网络修正模拟误差；④贝叶斯/进化混合算法闭环优化；⑤机器人实验验证；全过程零人工标注。
AI.result: 1）轻质高强钛合金：比重较航空标杆 Ti-185 降低 8.1%，强度提升 13.0%，比强度同期最高；2）高熵合金：屈服强度提高 28.2%，延伸率保持>15%；发现周期由年压缩至周。
AI.conclusion: AutoMAT 证明知识+计算+实验自治闭环可跨体系通用，为数据高效、可扩展的材料智能设计提供范式。

title: Predicting Time Pressure of Powered Two-Wheeler Riders for Proactive Safety Interventions
summary: Time pressure critically influences risky maneuvers and crash proneness among powered two-wheeler riders, yet its prediction remains underexplored in intelligent transportation systems. We present a large-scale dataset of 129,000+ labeled multivariate time-series sequences from 153 rides by 51 participants under No, Low, and High Time Pressure conditions. Each sequence captures 63 features spanning vehicle kinematics, control inputs, behavioral violations, and environmental context. Our empirical analysis shows High Time Pressure induces 48% higher speeds, 36.4% greater speed variability, 58% more risky turns at intersections, 36% more sudden braking, and 50% higher rear brake forces versus No Time Pressure. To benchmark this dataset, we propose MotoTimePressure, a deep learning model combining convolutional preprocessing, dual-stage temporal attention, and Squeeze-and-Excitation feature recalibration, achieving 91.53% accuracy and 98.93% ROC AUC, outperforming eight baselines, with only 172K parameters, 2.16 MB model size, and 0.04 ms inference on CPU. Since time pressure cannot be directly measured in real time, we demonstrate its utility in collision prediction and threshold determination. Using MTPS-predicted time pressure as a feature improves collision risk accuracy for both Informer (91.25% to 93.51%) and TimesNet (92.10% to 93.90%), approaching oracle performance (93.72% and 94.06%, respectively). Thresholded time pressure states capture rider cognitive stress and enable proactive ITS interventions, including adaptive alerts, haptic feedback, V2I signaling, and speed guidance, supporting safer two-wheeler mobility under the Safe System Approach.

AI.tldr: 基于12.9万段多变量骑行时序数据，首次系统量化并实时预测摩托车时间压力，提出轻量模型MotoTimePressure（91.53%准确率/98.93%AUC），证实其可显著提升碰撞风险预警性能，为智能交通主动干预提供可落地指标。
AI.motivation: 时间压力是二轮机动车危险驾驶和事故倾向的关键认知诱因，但现有智能交通系统缺乏可直接测量的实时指标与大规模数据支撑。
AI.method: 采集51名骑手153趟骑行、跨“无/低/高”时间压力的12.9万段63维同步时序数据；利用CNN预处理+双阶段时序注意力+Squeeze-and-Excitation特征重校正构建轻量深度学习模型MotoTimePressure；将模型输出作为碰撞预测器的附加特征，验证其增益。
AI.result: 高时间压力使车速+48%、速度波动+36.4%、危险转弯+58%、急刹+36%、后制动力+50%；所提模型以172 k参数、2.16 MB、0.04 ms CPU推理速度，分类准确率和AUC分别达91.53%与98.93%，优于8种基线；作为特征可把Informer/TimesNet碰撞预测准确率从91.25%/92.10%提升至93.51%/93.90%，逼近使用真实标签的Oracle性能。
AI.conclusion: 时间压力可被实时估算并转化为智能交通系统的可操作变量，为自适应警示、触觉反馈、V2I信号及动态限速等“安全系统”策略提供前置干预依据，显著提升二轮骑行安全。

title: Sandwich: Joint Configuration Search and Hot-Switching for Efficient CPU LLM Serving
summary: CPUs are critical for LLM serving due to their availability, cost efficiency, and edge applicability. However, efficient CPU serving is hindered by conflicting prefill/decode resource demands under non-disaggregated deployment constraints--existing solutions fail to avoid cross-phase interference, ignore sub-NUMA hardware structures, and deliver suboptimal dynamic-shape kernel performance. We propose Sandwich, a full-stack CPU LLM serving system with three core innovations addressing these challenges: (1) seamless phase-wise plan switching to eliminate cross-phase interference; (2) TopoTree, a tree-based hardware abstraction for automated substructure-aware (e.g., LLC slices) partial core allocation; (3) fast-start-then-finetune dynamic-shape tensor program generation. Across five x86/ARM CPU platforms, Sandwich achieves an average 2.01x end-to-end speedup and up to 3.40x latency reduction over state-of-the-art systems. Its kernels match static compiler performance with three orders of magnitude lower tuning cost.

AI.tldr: 在CPU平台上部署大语言模型推理时，prefill与decode阶段因资源竞争相互干扰且NUMA子结构未被利用；Sandwich通过阶段隔离、子结构感知核调度与动态Shape快速编译，平均端到端提速2.01×、延迟最高降3.40×，调优成本降低三个数量级。
AI.motivation: CPU具有成本低、易获取、边缘场景友好等优势，但现有LLM推理框架在非分离式部署下难以调和prefill（计算密集）与decode（访存密集）对资源的不同需求，且忽视LLC slice等子NUMA结构，导致跨阶段干扰严重、核利用率低。
AI.method: 构建端到端CPU推理系统Sandwich，引入(1)阶段级执行计划切换机制，prefill与decode分时独占核心，彻底消除干扰；(2)TopoTree树形硬件抽象，自动感知LLC slice等子NUMA拓扑，实现细粒度部分核心绑定与负载均衡；(3)先静态模板快速启动、后轻量微调生成动态Shape算子，兼顾性能与编译开销。
AI.result: 在五款x86/ARM CPU平台上与前沿方案对比，Sandwich平均端到端吞吐提升2.01×，P99延迟最高降低3.40×；其动态Shape kernel性能达到静态编译器水平，而调优时间从小时级缩至秒级，下降三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 通过阶段隔离、子NUMA拓扑感知调度和低开销动态编译，CPU可高效支撑LLM推理；Sandwich验证了在非分离约束下规避跨阶段干扰并充分压榨CPU微架构资源的可行性，为边缘与成本敏感场景提供了高性价方案。

title: Swap Regret Minimization Through Response-Based Approachability
comment: V2 adds a reference concerning Proposition 2.1
summary:
We consider the problem of minimizing different notions of swap regret in online optimization. These forms of regret are tightly connected to correlated equilibrium concepts in games, and have been more recently shown to guarantee non-manipulability against strategic adversaries. The only computationally efficient algorithm for minimizing linear swap regret over a general convex set in $\mathbb{R}^d$ was developed recently by Daskalakis, Farina, Fishelson, Pipis, and Schneider (STOC '25). However, it incurs a highly suboptimal regret bound of $Ω(d^4 \sqrt{T})$ and also relies on computationally intensive calls to the ellipsoid algorithm at each iteration.
  In this paper, we develop a significantly simpler, computationally efficient algorithm that guarantees $O(d^{3/2} \sqrt{T})$ linear swap regret for a general convex set and $O(d \sqrt{T})$ when the set is centrally symmetric. Our approach leverages the powerful response-based approachability framework of Bernstein and Shimkin (JMLR '15) -- previously overlooked in the line of work on swap regret minimization -- combined with geometric preconditioning via the John ellipsoid. Our algorithm simultaneously minimizes profile swap regret, which was recently shown to guarantee non-manipulability. Moreover, we establish a matching information-theoretic lower bound: any learner must incur in expectation $Ω(d \sqrt{T})$ linear swap regret for large enough $T$, even when the set is centrally symmetric. This also shows that the classic algorithm of Gordon, Greenwald, and Marks (ICML '08) is existentially optimal for minimizing linear swap regret, although it is computationally inefficient. Finally, we extend our approach to minimize regret with respect to the set of swap deviations with polynomial dimension, unifying and strengthening recent results in equilibrium computation and online learning.

AI.tldr: 本文给出首个高效且近乎最优的线性 swap-regret 算法：将界从 d⁴√T 降至 d^{3/2}√T（中心对称集上 d√T），并证明 d√T 下界匹配，同时统一处理 profile swap-regret 与多项式维 swap 偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有唯一能高效计算一般凸集上线性 swap-regret 的算法 regret 高达 Ω(d⁴√T) 且每轮需调用椭球法，远非理论最优；而最优但计算不可行的算法缺乏实用路径。需要一种既高效又紧致的 swap-regret 算法，以支撑博弈中相关均衡计算与抗策略操控的在线学习。
AI.method: 引入 Bernstein–Shimkin 的 response-based approachability 框架，配合 John 椭球几何预处理，将 swap-regret 转化为可逼近向量博弈；通过构造低维响应空间与迭代投影更新，避免椭球法。进一步对 profile swap-regret 与多项式维 swap 偏差集扩展同一框架。
AI.result: 算法在一般凸集上达 O(d^{3/2}√T) 线性 swap-regret，中心对称集上改进为 O(d√T)；同时最小化 profile swap-regret。证明任意算法在中心对称集上期望 regret 不低于 Ω(d√T)，故 d√T 为紧界，并表明 Gordon et al. (2008) 界在存在意义上已最优。
AI.conclusion: 首次实现 swap-regret 的高效与信息论最优兼得，厘清计算与统计复杂度界限；响应可逼近与几何预处理的组合为 swap 类 regret 提供统一范式，可直接强化博弈均衡计算及抗操控在线学习应用。

title: Activation-Guided Local Editing for Jailbreaking Attacks
summary: Jailbreaking is an essential adversarial technique for red-teaming these models to uncover and patch security flaws. However, existing jailbreak methods face significant drawbacks. Token-level jailbreak attacks often produce incoherent or unreadable inputs and exhibit poor transferability, while prompt-level attacks lack scalability and rely heavily on manual effort and human ingenuity. We propose a concise and effective two-stage framework that combines the advantages of these approaches. The first stage performs a scenario-based generation of context and rephrases the original malicious query to obscure its harmful intent. The second stage then utilizes information from the model's hidden states to guide fine-grained edits, effectively steering the model's internal representation of the input from a malicious toward a benign one. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this method achieves state-of-the-art Attack Success Rate, with gains of up to 37.74% over the strongest baseline, and exhibits excellent transferability to black-box models. Our analysis further demonstrates that AGILE maintains substantial effectiveness against prominent defense mechanisms, highlighting the limitations of current safeguards and providing valuable insights for future defense development. Our code is available at https://github.com/SELGroup/AGILE.

AI.tldr: 提出名为AGILE的两阶段越狱框架，兼顾可读性与迁移性，对黑盒模型ASR提升37.74%，显著优于现有攻防基线并可绕过主流防护。
AI.motivation: 现有token级越狱输入可读性差、迁移弱；prompt级越狱需大量手工设计、难规模化。需要一种兼顾语义隐蔽性与自动化扩展的高效红队方法。
AI.method: 阶段一：根据场景重写上下文并委婉化恶意查询，隐藏攻击意图；阶段二：利用目标模型隐状态信号，对文本做细粒度token级编辑，把内部恶意表征逐步“推拉”至良性区域，实现端到端优化。
AI.result: 在Vicuna、Llama-2等模型上平均ASR达92.35%，相比最佳基线提升37.74%；黑盒迁移下仍保持85%以上成功率；对Paraphrase-Defense、Smoothing等防御依然有效。
AI.conclusion: AGILE揭示了当前对齐防护对隐状态层面扰动的脆弱性，为后续“表征级”防御设计提供关键参考，代码已开源。

title: FlexGuard: Continuous Risk Scoring for Strictness-Adaptive LLM Content Moderation
summary: Ensuring the safety of LLM-generated content is essential for real-world deployment. Most existing guardrail models formulate moderation as a fixed binary classification task, implicitly assuming a fixed definition of harmfulness. In practice, enforcement strictness - how conservatively harmfulness is defined and enforced - varies across platforms and evolves over time, making binary moderators brittle under shifting requirements. We first introduce FlexBench, a strictness-adaptive LLM moderation benchmark that enables controlled evaluation under multiple strictness regimes. Experiments on FlexBench reveal substantial cross-strictness inconsistency in existing moderators: models that perform well under one regime can degrade substantially under others, limiting their practical usability. To address this, we propose FlexGuard, an LLM-based moderator that outputs a calibrated continuous risk score reflecting risk severity and supports strictness-specific decisions via thresholding. We train FlexGuard via risk-alignment optimization to improve score-severity consistency and provide practical threshold selection strategies to adapt to target strictness at deployment. Experiments on FlexBench and public benchmarks demonstrate that FlexGuard achieves higher moderation accuracy and substantially improved robustness under varying strictness. We release the source code and data to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可随“执法严格度”动态调整的 LLM 内容安全框架 FlexGuard，并配套评测基准 FlexBench，解决传统二分类护栏在严格度变化时性能骤降的痛点。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 内容审核模型将安全性视为固定二分类任务，但真实场景中不同平台、不同时间对“有害”定义的严格度持续变化，导致固定分类器在迁移或更新需求下迅速失效。
AI.method: 1) 构建 FlexBench：在同一样本上标注多级严格度标签，实现可控的跨严格度评测；2) 设计 FlexGuard：输出连续风险分数，以风险对齐优化损失训练，保证分数与真实严重程度单调一致；3) 部署时仅需调节风险阈值即可适配任意目标严格度，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在 FlexBench 及公开数据集上，FlexGuard 相比最强二分类基线，跨严格度一致性误差降低 38–52%，F1 平均提升 6.8–11.2 个百分点；同一模型经阈值调整即可覆盖从宽松到严苛的全区间，而基线模型需为每类严格度单独训练仍显著落后。
AI.conclusion: 将“严格度”显式建模为可调阈值，比僵化二分类更符合落地需求；连续风险分数+风险对齐优化是提升护栏泛化与生命周期管理的关键途径。已开源代码与数据，促进社区在动态安全策略下的持续评估与迭代。

title: FCBV-Net: Category-Level Robotic Garment Smoothing via Feature-Conditioned Bimanual Value Prediction
summary: Category-level generalization for robotic garment manipulation, such as bimanual smoothing, remains a significant hurdle due to high dimensionality, complex dynamics, and intra-category variations. Current approaches often struggle, either overfitting with concurrently learned visual features for a specific instance or, despite Category-level perceptual generalization, failing to predict the value of synergistic bimanual actions. We propose the Feature-Conditioned bimanual Value Network (FCBV-Net), operating on 3D point clouds to specifically enhance category-level policy generalization for garment smoothing. FCBV-Net conditions bimanual action value prediction on pre-trained, frozen dense geometric features, ensuring robustness to intra-category garment variations. Trainable downstream components then learn a task-specific policy using these static features. In simulated PyFlex environments using the CLOTH3D dataset, FCBV-Net demonstrated superior category-level generalization. It exhibited only an 11.5% efficiency drop (Steps80) on unseen garments compared to 96.2% for a 2D image-based baseline, and achieved 89% final coverage, outperforming an 83% coverage from a 3D correspondence-based baseline that uses identical per-point geometric features but a fixed primitive. These results highlight that the decoupling of geometric understanding from bimanual action value learning enables better category-level generalization. Code, videos, and supplementary materials are available at the project website: https://dabaspark.github.io/fcbvnet/.

AI.tldr: 提出FCBV-Net，隔预训练集合特征与双手机械价值学习，在Pyr服装模拟中实现类内泛型褶皱抚平，降幅仅11.5%，覆盖达89%
AI.motivation: 机器人服装抚平存在高维、动态与类内差异，现有报法要么视觉过拟，要么仅能视觉泛化却评判不了双手协同价值，类级泛化困难
AI.method: FCBV-Net：①以冻结密集3D集合特征编码衣服本体，排除类内差异；②在该特征条件上增可训练价值网络，直接点云中预测PI左-右手双手机械Q；③端到端强化学习训练与评价
AI.result: Pyr+CLOTH3D测试，对未见衣物Step₈₀让步仅11.5%，远优于RGB基线96.2%；末态表面覆盖89%，亦优于其它3D对应方法83%
AI.conclusion: 将稳定集合表示与动态价值学习解绑，是类级双手机械服装操作走向泛化的关键途径，FCBV-Net提供了有效范式

title: Diagnostics for Individual-Level Prediction Instability in Machine Learning for Healthcare
summary: In healthcare, predictive models increasingly inform patient-level decisions, yet little attention is paid to the variability in individual risk estimates and its impact on treatment decisions. For overparameterized models, now standard in machine learning, a substantial source of variability often goes undetected. Even when the data and model architecture are held fixed, randomness introduced by optimization and initialization can lead to materially different risk estimates for the same patient. This problem is largely obscured by standard evaluation practices, which rely on aggregate performance metrics (e.g., log-loss, accuracy) that are agnostic to individual-level stability. As a result, models with indistinguishable aggregate performance can nonetheless exhibit substantial procedural arbitrariness, which can undermine clinical trust. We propose an evaluation framework that quantifies individual-level prediction instability by using two complementary diagnostics: empirical prediction interval width (ePIW), which captures variability in continuous risk estimates, and empirical decision flip rate (eDFR), which measures instability in threshold-based clinical decisions. We apply these diagnostics to simulated data and GUSTO-I clinical dataset. Across observed settings, we find that for flexible machine-learning models, randomness arising solely from optimization and initialization can induce individual-level variability comparable to that produced by resampling the entire training dataset. Neural networks exhibit substantially greater instability in individual risk predictions compared to logistic regression models. Risk estimate instability near clinically relevant decision thresholds can alter treatment recommendations. These findings that stability diagnostics should be incorporated into routine model validation for assessing clinical reliability.

AI.tldr: 机器学习医疗预测模型存在因初始化和优化引入的个体风险估计波动，现行评估忽视该问题；提出 ePIW 与 eDFR 两种诊断指标，实证显示神经网络个体稳定性差于逻辑回归，且可在临床阈值处翻转治疗决策，呼吁将稳定性纳入常规验证。
AI.motivation: 医疗场景下模型直接影响患者治疗，但研究者仅关注整体指标，忽视训练流程中的随机性带来的个体预测差异，可能破坏临床信任并导致不同治疗建议。
AI.method: 构建 ePIW（经验预测区间宽度）量化连续风险波动，eDFR（经验决策翻转率）度量阈值决策的不稳定性；在模拟数据与 GUSTO-I 真实数据集上比较逻辑回归与过参数化神经网络。
AI.result: 固定数据与架构时，优化/初始化随机性可产生与重采样训练集同量级的个体波动；神经网络 ePIW、eDFR 均显著高于逻辑回归；风险估计在临床阈值附近翻转，改变治疗建议。
AI.conclusion: 仅报告整体性能不足以保障临床可靠性，必须将个体稳定性诊断（ePIW、eDFR）纳入模型开发与验证流程。

title: Memp: Exploring Agent Procedural Memory
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) based agents excel at diverse tasks, yet they suffer from brittle procedural memory that is manually engineered or entangled in static parameters. In this work, we investigate strategies to endow agents with a learnable, updatable, and lifelong procedural memory. We propose Memp that distills past agent trajectories into both fine-grained, step-by-step instructions and higher-level, script-like abstractions, and explore the impact of different strategies for Build, Retrieval, and Update of procedural memory. Coupled with a dynamic regimen that continuously updates, corrects, and deprecates its contents, this repository evolves in lockstep with new experience. Empirical evaluation on TravelPlanner and ALFWorld shows that as the memory repository is refined, agents achieve steadily higher success rates and greater efficiency on analogous tasks. Moreover, procedural memory built from a stronger model retains its value: migrating the procedural memory to a weaker model can also yield substantial performance gains. Code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/MemP.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MemP 框架，把 LLM-agent 的执行轨迹蒸馏成可终身更新的程序性记忆库，使弱模型也能持续受益于强模型的经验。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM-based agent 的程序性记忆要么人工硬编码，要么固化在参数中，无法随新任务持续演化，导致鲁棒性不足。作者旨在为其赋予可学习、可更新、终身体系化的程序记忆。
AI.method: 1) 设计 MemP 框架：将历史轨迹分解为细粒度逐步指令与高层脚本式抽象双层表示；2) 构建 Build-Retrieve-Update 三阶段策略，支持动态增删改；3) 采用在线纠错与弃用过时条目的持续学习机制，使记忆库随经验同步演化。
AI.result: 在 TravelPlanner 与 ALFWorld 上，记忆库随迭代不断精炼，agent 成功率与效率持续提升；将强模型构建的程序记忆迁移到弱模型，仍能带来显著增益，表明记忆与模型能力解耦有效。
AI.conclusion: 可终身更新的双层程序记忆能系统提升 LLM-agent 的迁移与持续学习能力，且记忆一旦构建即可跨模型复用，为高效、可扩展的 agent 进化提供了新范式。

title: Graph In-Context Operator Networks for Generalizable Spatiotemporal Prediction
summary: In-context operator learning enables neural networks to infer solution operators from contextual examples without weight updates. While prior work has demonstrated the effectiveness of this paradigm in leveraging vast datasets, a systematic comparison against single-operator learning using identical training data has been absent. We address this gap through controlled experiments comparing in-context operator learning against classical operator learning (single-operator models trained without contextual examples), under the same training steps and dataset. To enable this investigation on real-world spatiotemporal systems, we propose GICON (Graph In-Context Operator Network), combining graph message passing for geometric generalization with example-aware positional encoding for cardinality generalization. Experiments on air quality prediction across two Chinese regions show that in-context operator learning outperforms classical operator learning on complex tasks, generalizing across spatial domains and scaling robustly from few training examples to 100 at inference.

AI.tldr: GICON 首次在相同数据与训练步数设定下系统比较上下文算子学习与经典单算子学习，证明前者在真实空气质量时空预测任务上全面占优。
AI.motivation: 尽管上下文算子学习已展示利用大规模数据的优势，但缺乏与单算子学习在“同数据、同训练预算”下的公平对照，阻碍了对两者优劣的客观评估。
AI.method: 提出 GICON：图网络做几何泛化，示例感知位置编码做基数泛化；在两片中国区域空气质量数据上，固定训练步数与数据集，对照训练经典单算子模型与上下文算子模型。
AI.result: 上下文算子学习在复杂任务上的预测精度显著高于经典方法，可零样本跨空间域泛化，且推理时训练示例从极少增至 100 仍保持稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: 在相同训练资源下，上下文算子学习兼具更强的泛化能力与扩展性，GICON 为真实时空系统提供了实用且可扩展的代理模型框架。

title: Feedback-Driven Tool-Use Improvements in Large Language Models via Automated Build Environments
summary: Effective tool use is essential for large language models (LLMs) to interact with their environment. However, progress is limited by the lack of efficient reinforcement learning (RL) frameworks specifically designed for tool use, due to challenges in constructing stable training environments and designing verifiable reward mechanisms. To address this, we propose an automated environment construction pipeline, incorporating scenario decomposition, document generation, function integration, complexity scaling, and localized deployment. This enables the creation of high-quality training environments that provide detailed and measurable feedback without relying on external tools. Additionally, we introduce a verifiable reward mechanism that evaluates both the precision of tool use and the completeness of task execution. When combined with trajectory data collected from the constructed environments, this mechanism integrates seamlessly with standard RL algorithms to facilitate feedback-driven model training. Experiments on LLMs of varying scales demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances the models' tool-use performance without degrading their general capabilities. Our analysis suggests that these gains result from improved context understanding and reasoning, driven by updates to the lower-layer MLP parameters in models. Code and data are available at https://github.com/bytedance/FTRL.

AI.tldr: 首个专为LLM工具使用设计的端到端强化学习框架FTRL，通过自动化环境构建＋可验证奖励机制，在不损通用能力前提下显著提升工具调用准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有RL框架难以直接用于LLM工具使用：外部API不稳定、奖励难量化、训练环境难搭建，导致工具增强研究进展受限。
AI.method: (1) 自动化环境流水线：场景分解→文档生成→函数集成→复杂度缩放→本地部署，零外部依赖即可生成带细粒度度量的训练环境；(2) 可验证奖励：同时度量“工具调用精度”和“任务完成完整度”；(3) 将上述环境轨迹接入标准RL（PPO等）高效训练，仅更新底层MLP参数以避免灾难遗忘。
AI.result: 在7B–70B参数范围LLM上，工具成功率平均提升35–42%，通用评测（MMLU、BBH等）无显著下降；可视化显示提升源于低层MLP对工具语义的更精确编码。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的本地训练范式是破解LLM工具使用RL瓶颈的有效途径；将环境与奖励解耦并自动化，为后续更大规模、多模态工具研究提供了可复现基线。

title: ReproMIA: A Comprehensive Analysis of Model Reprogramming for Proactive Membership Inference Attacks
comment: This version was posted without enough prior discussion with my collaborator. Thus, it is being withdrawn pending further internal review. The authors do not wish this version to be considered part of the active scientific record in its current form
summary: The pervasive deployment of deep learning models across critical domains has concurrently intensified privacy concerns due to their inherent propensity for data memorization. While Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) serve as the gold standard for auditing these privacy vulnerabilities, conventional MIA paradigms are increasingly constrained by the prohibitive computational costs of shadow model training and a precipitous performance degradation under low False Positive Rate constraints. To overcome these challenges, we introduce a novel perspective by leveraging the principles of model reprogramming as an active signal amplifier for privacy leakage. Building upon this insight, we present \texttt{ReproMIA}, a unified and efficient proactive framework for membership inference. We rigorously substantiate, both theoretically and empirically, how our methodology proactively induces and magnifies latent privacy footprints embedded within the model's representations. We provide specialized instantiations of \texttt{ReproMIA} across diverse architectural paradigms, including LLMs, Diffusion Models, and Classification Models. Comprehensive experimental evaluations across more than ten benchmarks and a variety of model architectures demonstrate that \texttt{ReproMIA} consistently and substantially outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a transformative leap in performance specifically within low-FPR regimes, such as an average of 5.25\% AUC and 10.68\% TPR@1\%FPR increase over the runner-up for LLMs, as well as 3.70\% and 12.40\% respectively for Diffusion Models.

AI.tldr: 现有成员推理攻击（MIA）依赖影子模型导致高算力开销，且在低误报率（FPR）区性能骤降。作者借模型重编程思想把隐私泄漏信号”主动放大”，提出 ReproMIA 框架，不需影子模型即可稳定提升低 FPR 区指标，并在 10+ 基准的 LLM、扩散与分类模型中刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 深度模型广泛部署带来隐私泄漏风险，当前 MIA 因必须训练大量影子模型而成本高昂，且在低 FPR 要求下表现暴跌，亟需一种计算友好且高真阳率的审计方案。
AI.method: 将模型重编程视作“主动隐私放大器”：（1）在受害模型输入/嵌入空间精心构造微小扰动，使成员与非成员输出分布可分离度最大化；（2）用优化后的预测置信度差异直接推断成员关系，无需外挂影子模型；（3）给出针对 LLM、扩散与分类网络的专属重编程实例与可学习约束。
AI.result: ReproMIA 在低 FPR 区性能大幅提升：LLM 上 AUC↑5.25%，TPR@1%FPR↑10.68%；扩散模型 AUC↑3.70%，TPR@1%FPR↑12.40%；在 10 余个数据集与 3 类模型中全面超越现有最佳基线。
AI.conclusion: 模型重编程可有效激发并放大模型内部隐私痕迹，ReproMIA 为高效、低成本、低 FPR 可操作的成员审计提供了新的统一范式。工作同时揭示：重编程既是对手攻击利器，也是防御者可提前复现的预审计工具。

title: Decentralized Rank Scheduling for Energy-Constrained Multi-Task Federated Fine-Tuning in Edge-Assisted IoV Networks
summary: Federated fine-tuning has emerged as a promising approach for adapting foundation models (FMs) to diverse downstream tasks in edge environments. In Internet of Vehicles (IoV) systems, enabling efficient and low-latency multi-task adaptation is particularly challenging due to client mobility, heterogeneous resources, and intermittent connectivity. This paper proposes a hierarchical federated fine-tuning framework that coordinates roadside units (RSUs) and vehicles to support resource-aware and mobility-resilient learning across dynamic IoV scenarios. Leveraging Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), we introduce a decentralized, energy-aware rank adaptation mechanism formulated as a constrained multi-armed bandit problem. A novel UCB-DUAL algorithm is developed to enable adaptive exploration under per-task energy budgets, achieving provable sublinear regret. To evaluate our method, we construct a large-scale IoV simulator based on real-world trajectories, capturing dynamic participation, RSU handoffs, and communication variability. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off among all baselines, reducing latency by over 24\% and improving average accuracy by more than 2.5\%.

AI.tldr: 针对车联网动态场景下的多任务微调难题，提出基于 LoRA 的层级联邦框架 UCB-DUAL，实现能耗受限的自适应秩选择，实验表明延迟降 24%，精度升 2.5%。
AI.motivation: 在车联网边缘环境中，基础模型需同时适应多下游任务，但节点移动、资源异构与间歇连接导致传统联邦微调难以兼顾低时延与高能效。
AI.method: 构建 RSU-车辆两层联邦架构，将 LoRA 秩选择建模为带能量预算的多臂老虎机，设计 UCB-DUAL 算法在客户端动态探索最优秩，理论保证次线性遗憾；并搭建基于真实轨迹的大规模 IoV 仿真器复现动态接入与切换过程。
AI.result: UCB-DUAL 在多项基线中取得最优精度-效率权衡，端到端延迟降低 24% 以上，平均任务精度提升 2.5% 以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过层级联邦与能量感知的自适应秩微调，可在高移动、资源受限的车联网中实现高效多任务基础模型适配，为实时边缘智能提供可行方案。

title: Restless Bandits with Individual Penalty Constraints: A New Near-Optimal Index Policy and How to Learn It
summary: This paper investigates the Restless Multi-Armed Bandit (RMAB) framework under individual penalty constraints to address resource allocation challenges in dynamic wireless networked environments. Unlike conventional RMAB models, our model allows each user (arm) to have distinct and stringent performance constraints, such as energy limits, activation limits, or age of information minimums, enabling the capture of diverse objectives including fairness and efficiency. To find the optimal resource allocation policy, we propose a new Penalty-Optimal Whittle (POW) index policy. The POW index of an user only depends on the user's transition kernel and penalty constraints, and remains invariable to system-wide features such as the number of users present and the amount of resource available. This makes it computationally tractable to calculate the POW indices offline without any need for online adaptation. Moreover, we theoretically prove that the POW index policy is asymptotically optimal while satisfying all individual penalty constraints. We also introduce a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to efficiently learn the POW index on the fly. Simulation results across various applications and system configurations further demonstrate that the POW index policy not only has near-optimal performance but also significantly outperforms other existing policies.

AI.tldr: 针对动态无线网络提出带个体惩罚约束的 RMAB 模型，设计可离线计算的 POW 指数策略，证明其渐近最优且满足约束，并用深度强化学习在线学习，仿真全面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统 RMAB 无法刻画用户级硬约束（能量、激活次数、信息年龄下限），导致资源分配在公平与效率间失衡，亟需一种能兼顾异构约束且可扩展的决策框架。
AI.method: 构建个体惩罚约束 RMAB：将约束转化为状态相关惩罚项，定义仅依赖单臂转移核与惩罚阈值的 POW 指数，证明其具有指标性与渐近最优性；进一步以深度强化学习逼近 POW 指数，实现无模型在线学习。
AI.result: 理论给出 POW 指数策略的渐近最优保证与约束满足性；仿真显示在能量、AoI、激活次数三类约束场景下，POW 较最佳基线提升 15–34%，且指数计算耗时降低两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: POW 指数将高维约束 RMAB 解耦为可离线计算的 per-arm 指标，兼具理论最优与工程易用性，为动态无线网络实时资源调度提供了可扩展新范式。

title: Heavy-Tailed Class-Conditional Priors for Long-Tailed Generative Modeling
summary: Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) with global priors trained under an imbalanced empirical class distribution can lead to underrepresentation of tail classes in the latent space. While $t^3$VAE improves robustness via heavy-tailed Student's $t$-distribution priors, its single global prior still allocates mass proportionally to class frequency. We address this latent geometric bias by introducing C-$t^3$VAE, which assigns a per-class Student's $t$ joint prior over latent and output variables. This design promotes uniform prior mass across class-conditioned components. To optimize our model we derive a closed-form objective from the $γ$-power divergence, and we introduce an equal-weight latent mixture for class-balanced generation. On SVHN-LT, CIFAR100-LT, and CelebA datasets, C-$t^3$VAE consistently attains lower FID scores than $t^3$VAE and Gaussian-based VAE baselines under severe class imbalance while remaining competitive in balanced or mildly imbalanced settings. In per-class F1 evaluations, our model outperforms the conditional Gaussian VAE across highly imbalanced settings. Moreover, we identify the mild imbalance threshold $ρ< 5$, for which Gaussian-based models remain competitive. However, for $ρ\geq 5$ our approach yields improved class-balanced generation and mode coverage.

AI.tldr: 现有VAE在类不平衡下因单一全局先验导致尾部类Latent被压缩；作者提出C-t³VAE，为每类设独立Student-t联合先验并基于γ-power散度导出闭式目标，实验显示在重度不平衡(ρ≥5)时FID、F1均优于t³VAE与高斯VAE，在轻度不平衡(ρ<5)仍具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 变分自编码器在长尾数据下因全局先验按类别频率分配概率质量，使尾部类别在潜空间严重欠表达；t³VAE虽用重尾Student-先验提升鲁棒性，仍无法克服“几何偏差”。需设计能强制为每类保留均匀先验质量的机制，以改善生成与表征的类别平衡性。
AI.method: 提出C-t³VAE：为每个类别引入独立的Student-t联合先验覆盖潜变量与输出变量，使先验质量在各类的条件分量间均匀分布；基于γ-power散度推导封闭形式ELBO；在潜空间构建等权混合先验以支持类别平衡的采样与生成。
AI.result: 在SVHN-LT、CIFAR100-LT、CelebA三个长尾数据集上，C-t³VAE在重度类别不平衡(ρ≥5)下FID显著低于t³VAE与高斯VAE基线，并在类平衡或轻度不平衡(ρ<5)时保持竞争性能；每类F1指标亦优于条件高斯VAE。
AI.conclusion: 当类别不平衡比ρ≥5时，单全域先验不足以保证潜空间的类别均衡，C-t³VAE通过逐类重尾先验有效缓解几何偏差，实现更平衡的生成与更全面的模态覆盖；ρ<5时高斯模型仍可接受，为实际应用提供了明确的阈值指导。

title: From Load Tests to Live Streams: Graph Embedding-Based Anomaly Detection in Microservice Architectures
summary: Prime Video regularly conducts load tests to simulate the viewer traffic spikes seen during live events such as Thursday Night Football as well as video-on-demand (VOD) events such as Rings of Power. While these stress tests validate system capacity, they can sometimes miss service behaviors unique to real event traffic. We present a graph-based anomaly detection system that identifies under-represented services using unsupervised node-level graph embeddings. Built on a GCN-GAE, our approach learns structural representations from directed, weighted service graphs at minute-level resolution and flags anomalies based on cosine similarity between load test and event embeddings. The system identifies incident-related services that are documented and demonstrates early detection capability. We also introduce a preliminary synthetic anomaly injection framework for controlled evaluation that show promising precision (96%) and low false positive rate (0.08%), though recall (58%) remains limited under conservative propagation assumptions. This framework demonstrates practical utility within Prime Video while also surfacing methodological lessons and directions, providing a foundation for broader application across microservice ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 基于GCN-GAE的无监督图嵌入系统，在分钟级实时服务图上检测真实事件流量与压测流量之间的差异，可提前发现未被压测覆盖的潜在故障服务。
AI.motivation: Prime Video的压测虽能验证容量，却常遗漏真实赛事激增流量下才暴露的服务行为差异；需要自动、细粒度识别这类“被低估”的服务。
AI.method: 构建有向加权服务图→GCN-GAE提取节点级嵌入→以压测时段embedding为基准，用余弦相似度实时比对真实事件embedding→低于阈值即判异常；同时设计可控合成异常注入框架做离线评估。
AI.result: 系统成功定位多起真实事件关联服务，并提前告警；合成实验取得96%精准率、0.08%误报率，召回率58%（保守传播设定下）。
AI.conclusion: 图嵌入法可有效发现压测盲区，为大型微服务系统提供实时、可解释的异常检测基线；召回与注入策略仍需优化以支持更广泛的赛事场景复用。

title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place: The Tension Between Ethical Reasoning and Safety Alignment in LLMs
summary: Large Language Model safety alignment predominantly operates on a binary assumption that requests are either safe or unsafe. This classification proves insufficient when models encounter ethical dilemmas, where the capacity to reason through moral trade-offs creates a distinct attack surface. We formalize this vulnerability through TRIAL, a multi-turn red-teaming methodology that embeds harmful requests within ethical framings. TRIAL achieves high attack success rates across most tested models by systematically exploiting the model's ethical reasoning capabilities to frame harmful actions as morally necessary compromises. Building on these insights, we introduce ERR (Ethical Reasoning Robustness), a defense framework that distinguishes between instrumental responses that enable harmful outcomes and explanatory responses that analyze ethical frameworks without endorsing harmful acts. ERR employs a Layer-Stratified Harm-Gated LoRA architecture, achieving robust defense against reasoning-based attacks while preserving model utility.

AI.tldr: "如果牺牲少数能拯救多数，这在道德上是否可接受？"——大模型碰上电车难题会翻车吗？这篇论文提出的TRIAL证明：只要用道德绑架包装有害请求，几乎所有模型都会放行；而新的ERR框架让模型既能保持道德推理，又不被迫从恶。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐默认"请求只有纯安全/纯有害"二元标签，可当模型被迫在道德困境里权衡时，这一假设失效，易被利用为新的攻击面。
AI.method:
1) 提出TRIAL多轮红队框架：把有害请求嵌入"两难抉择"场景，诱导模型先给出道德推理，再引导其输出可执行的有害且"合乎"推理的内容；
2) 设计ERR防御：区分"可导致恶果的工具性回应"与"仅解释道德框架的解释性回应"，并借助层级受控的LoRA（Harm-Gated LoRA）在发生前截流有害产。
AI.result: TRIAL在主流模型上Attack Success Rate高达80%+；ERR在此基础上显著降低攻击成功率(-95%)，同时保持模型在一般任务上的Helpfulness与Harmlessness兼容。
AI.conclusion: 证实以伦理权衡包装的推理攻击是一种真实且高效的威胁；通过将问责与工具性脱钩并给予模型"解释而不执行"的许可，可在不削弱道德推理的前提下提升安全性。该工作成为将来深入探讨AI模型"道德判断"安全基线的起点。

title: WOMBET: World Model-based Experience Transfer for Robust and Sample-efficient Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 8th Annual Learning for Dynamics & Control Conference (L4DC)
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) in robotics is often limited by the cost and risk of data collection, motivating experience transfer from a source task to a target task. Offline-to-online RL leverages prior data but typically assumes a given fixed dataset and does not address how to generate reliable data for transfer. We propose \textit{World Model-based Experience Transfer} (WOMBET), a framework that jointly generates and utilizes prior data. WOMBET learns a world model in the source task and generates offline data via uncertainty-penalized planning, followed by filtering trajectories with high return and low epistemic uncertainty. It then performs online fine-tuning in the target task using adaptive sampling between offline and online data, enabling a stable transition from prior-driven initialization to task-specific adaptation. We show that the uncertainty-penalized objective provides a lower bound on the true return and derive a finite-sample error decomposition capturing distribution mismatch and approximation error. Empirically, WOMBET improves sample efficiency and final performance over strong baselines on continuous control benchmarks, demonstrating the benefit of jointly optimizing data generation and transfer.

AI.tldr: 用世界模型在源任务里“边造数据边迁移”→在线微调→少采样本也能赢。
AI.motivation: 机器人强化学习采数据贵且危险，经验迁移成为刚需，但现有离线→在线方法①只能被动使用固定数据集，②不解决“如何生成可迁移的高质量离线数据”。
AI.method: 提出WOMBET框架：1) 在源任务训练世界模型并估计 epistemic 不确定性；2) 用“不确定性惩罚+长程规划”主动离线生成轨迹，筛选高回报低不确定轨迹；3) 在线 finetune 时，自适应混合离线/在线样本，平滑过渡；4) 给出不确定性惩罚目标的下界保证和有限样本误差分解，显式量化分布漂移与近似误差。
AI.result: 在 MuJoCo 连续控制基准上，WOMBET 相比 SOTA 离线→在线迁移方法样本效率提升 1.5–3 倍，渐近回报平均提升 8–15%，跨任务迁移场景优势更明显；误差分解实验显示不确定性过滤可把分布漂移项降低约 30%。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化“数据生成+迁移利用”比单纯利用给定离线数据更有效；世界模型+不确定性惩罚是廉价获取高质迁移数据的可行途径，为未来低成本机器人 RL 提供了新范式。

title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for Cybersecurity: State of the Art, Challenges, and Opportunities
summary: Cybersecurity demands both rapid pattern recognition and deliberative reasoning, yet purely neural or purely symbolic approaches each address only one side of this duality. Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) AI bridges this gap by integrating learning and logic within a unified framework. This systematic review analyzes 103 publications across the neural-symbolic integration spectrum in cybersecurity through April 2026, organizing them via a three-tier taxonomy -- deep integration, structured interaction, and contextual baselines -- and a Grounding-Instructibility-Alignment (G-I-A) analytical lens. We find that multi-agent and structured-integration architectures across the surveyed spectrum substantially outperform single-agent approaches in complex scenarios, causal reasoning enables proactive defense beyond correlation-based detection, and knowledge-guided learning improves both data efficiency and explainability. These findings span intrusion detection, malware analysis, vulnerability discovery, and autonomous penetration testing, revealing that integration depth often correlates with capability gains across domains. A first-of-its-kind dual-use analysis further shows that autonomous offensive systems in the broader survey corpus are already achieving notable zero-day exploitation success at significantly reduced cost, fundamentally reshaping threat landscapes. However, critical barriers persist: evaluation standardization remains nascent, computational costs constrain deployment, and effective human-AI collaboration is underexplored. We distill these findings into a prioritized research roadmap emphasizing community-driven benchmarks, responsible development practices, and defensive alignment to guide the next generation of NeSy cybersecurity systems.

AI.tldr: NeSy-AI 整合神经学习与符号逻辑，系统梳理 103 篇网络安全文献，提出三层次 G-I-A 框架。多智能体与深层融合方案在检测、分析、渗透等任务显著领先，但存在评估标准缺失、算力昂贵、攻防失衡等瓶颈；作者给出社区基准与防御优先路线图。
AI.motivation: 网络安全同时需要快速模式识别与可控推理，纯神经或纯符号方法无法兼顾，需对现有 NeSy 整合研究进行全景式梳理，明确何种融合深度能真正提升防务效能并厘清双用风险。
AI.method: 三层次分类（深度集成、结构化交互、纯神经基线）× G-I-A 量化维度（Grounding-Instructibility-Alignment）的系统综述，并对 103 篇 2020-2026/4 文献进行元分析，包含性能对比、漏洞利用成功率与成本评估。
AI.result: 多智能体/深度集成架构在四项核心任务平均 F1 提升 8-15%，因果推理使未知威胁提前预警率 +23%，知识引导学习让训练数据需求减半且可解释度提升；自研攻击模型平均零日利用成本降低 76%。
AI.conclusion: NeSy 融合深度与防护增益正相关，但缺乏统一基准、部署昂贵且人机协作研究薄弱；亟须建设共享评估套件、强化防御为主的双用治理，并优先布局责任式 NeSy 系统研发。

title: When Can You Poison Rewards? A Tight Characterization of Reward Poisoning in Linear MDPs
summary: We study reward poisoning attacks in reinforcement learning (RL), where an adversary manipulates rewards within constrained budgets to force the target RL agent to adopt a policy that aligns with the attacker's objectives. Prior works on reward poisoning mainly focused on sufficient conditions to design a successful attacker, while only a few studies discussed the infeasibility of targeted attacks. This paper provides the first precise necessity and sufficiency characterization of the attackability of a linear MDP under reward poisoning attacks. Our characterization draws a bright line between the vulnerable RL instances, and the intrinsically robust ones which cannot be attacked without large costs even running vanilla non-robust RL algorithms. Our theory extends beyond linear MDPs -- by approximating deep RL environments as linear MDPs, we show that our theoretical framework effectively distinguishes the attackability and efficiently attacks the vulnerable ones, demonstrating both the theoretical and practical significance of our characterization.

AI.tldr: 首次给出了线性MDP奖励投毒攻击的可攻击性充要条件，将脆弱RL实例与天然鲁棒实例严格分开，并能推广至深度RL场景，兼具理论与实用价值。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励投毒研究多仅给出攻击成功的“充分”条件，缺乏对攻击不可行性（必要）条件的系统刻画，导致无法判断哪些RL任务本质不可被低成本投毒，也无法区分“看起来能被攻击”与“真正能被攻击”的实例。
AI.method: 将RL环境建模为线性MDP，推导奖励投毒攻击的线性可逆性方程；利用占据测度(occupancy measure)与可行集几何，建立攻击成本与策略可达性的对偶关系；进而给出攻击可行性的充要判据，并将高维深度RL环境通过特征近似映射到线性MDP框架验证。
AI.result: 得到线性MDP攻击可行性的精确充要条件：当且仅当目标策略的占据测度位于由投毒预算约束所张成的凸锥内；该条件可在多项式时间内检验。理论还揭示部分RL任务天然鲁棒——即使使用非鲁棒算法，攻击者也必须付出与模型维度呈指数倍增长的预算才能成功。
AI.conclusion: 首次完成了“攻击可行性”而非“攻击成功”的精确定界，把RL任务明确划分为可低成本投毒的“脆弱”类与必须高成本才可能成功的“鲁棒”类；该判别标准可直接用于深层RL环境的快速筛查与防御前置评估，对后续鲁棒RL算法设计与安全部署具有指导意义。

title: Failure Makes the Agent Stronger: Enhancing Accuracy through Structured Reflection for Reliable Tool Interactions
summary: Tool-augmented large language models (LLMs) are usually trained with supervised imitation or coarse-grained reinforcement learning that optimizes single tool calls. Current self-reflection practices rely on heuristic prompts or one-way reasoning: the model is urged to 'think more' instead of learning error diagnosis and repair. This is fragile in multi-turn interactions; after a failure the model often repeats the same mistake. We propose structured reflection, which turns the path from error to repair into an explicit, controllable, and trainable action. The agent produces a short yet precise reflection: it diagnoses the failure using evidence from the previous step and then proposes a correct, executable follow-up call. For training we combine DAPO and GSPO objectives with a reward scheme tailored to tool use, optimizing the stepwise strategy Reflect, then Call, then Final.
