To evaluate, we introduce Tool-Reflection-Bench, a lightweight benchmark that programmatically checks structural validity, executability, parameter correctness, and result consistency. Tasks are built as mini trajectories of erroneous call, reflection, and corrected call, with disjoint train and test splits. Experiments on BFCL v3 and Tool-Reflection-Bench show large gains in multi-turn tool-call success and error recovery, and a reduction of redundant calls. These results indicate that making reflection explicit and optimizing it directly improves the reliability of tool interaction and offers a reproducible path for agents to learn from failure.

AI.tldr: 提出「结构化反思」训练方法，让工具增强LLA能显式诊断并修复调用错误，显著提升多轮交互中的成功率;引入轻量级工具反思基准评估DR&R效率。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强LLA依赖imits或粗粒度RL，仅瞄准单次调用正确，缺乏自我诊断与重试能力。
AI.method: 构建
AI.result: BFCLv3+新基准：多轮成功率（+10%+、错误恢复率+31%)。
AI.conclusion: 把反思外化为可训练动作是提升工具调用可靠性的可复制途径.

title: Robust Adversarial Policy Optimization Under Dynamics Uncertainty
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies often fail under dynamics that differ from training, a gap not fully addressed by domain randomization or existing adversarial RL methods. Distributionally robust RL provides a formal remedy but still relies on surrogate adversaries to approximate intractable primal problems, leaving blind spots that potentially cause instability and over-conservatism. We propose a dual formulation that directly exposes the robustness-performance trade-off. At the trajectory level, a temperature parameter from the dual problem is approximated with an adversarial network, yielding efficient and stable worst-case rollouts within a divergence bound. At the model level, we employ Boltzmann reweighting over dynamics ensembles, focusing on more adverse environments to the current policy rather than uniform sampling. The two components act independently and complement each other: trajectory-level steering ensures robust rollouts, while model-level sampling provides policy-sensitive coverage of adverse dynamics. The resulting framework, robust adversarial policy optimization (RAPO) outperforms robust RL baselines, improving resilience to uncertainty and generalization to out-of-distribution dynamics while maintaining dual tractability.

AI.tldr: 提出RAPO框架，通过双重形式直接刻画鲁棒性与性能的权衡，用对抗网络逼近轨迹层温度参数，并在模型层采用Boltzmann重采样聚焦最不利动态，协同提升策略对分布外动态的鲁棒性与泛化。
AI.motivation: 传统RL策略在训练-测试动态不一致时失效；领域随机化与现有对抗RL仍留有盲点对不可解主问题依赖替代对手，导致不稳定与过度保守。需要一种可直接刻画鲁棒-性能权衡的高效方法。
AI.method: 1) 建立分布鲁棒RL的对偶形式，引入温度参数显式控制鲁棒-性能权衡；2) 轨迹层：用对抗网络逼近该温度参数，在散度约束内生成稳定最坏-case轨迹；3) 模型层：对动态集合做Boltzmann重加权，优先采样对当前策略最不利的环境；4) 两层独立并行，共同嵌入策略优化循环，形成RAPO算法。
AI.result: 在多个连续控制任务中，RAPO显著优于现有鲁棒RL基线，在保持对偶可解性的同时提升对参数不确定与分布外动态的抵抗力与泛化能力，训练更稳定且不过度保守。
AI.conclusion: 通过对偶形式与温度参数机制，RAPO首次在轨迹-模型双层协同地实现高效最坏-case训练，为鲁棒RL提供了兼顾性能与鲁棒性的新范式，可直接扩展至更复杂真实系统。

title: MARCH: Evaluating the Intersection of Ambiguity Interpretation and Multi-hop Inference
summary: Real-world multi-hop QA is naturally linked with ambiguity, where a single query can trigger multiple reasoning paths that require independent resolution. Since ambiguity can occur at any stage, models must navigate layered uncertainty throughout the entire reasoning chain. Despite its prevalence in real-world user queries, previous benchmarks have primarily focused on single-hop ambiguity, leaving the complex interaction between multi-step inference and layered ambiguity underexplored. In this paper, we introduce MARCH, a benchmark for their intersection, with 2,209 multi-hop ambiguous questions curated via multi-LLM verification and validated by human annotation with strong agreement. Our experiments reveal that even state-of-the-art models struggle with MARCH, confirming that combining ambiguity resolution with multi-step reasoning is a significant challenge. To address this, we propose CLARION, a two-stage agentic framework that explicitly decouples ambiguity planning from evidence-driven reasoning, significantly outperforms existing approaches, and paves the way for robust reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: MARCH 评测集首次系统评估「多跳推理 × 分层歧义」复合难题；CLARION 通过「先歧义规划、后证据推理」的两段式智能体将 SOTA 性能显著提升。
AI.motivation: 真实用户查询常伴多层歧义，且歧义可出现在任意推理阶段；现有数据集仅关注单跳歧义，缺乏对多跳推理链中逐层不确定性的系统评测，阻碍鲁棒问答系统的研发。
AI.method: 构建 MARCH：用多 LLM 互审+人工高一致标注产生 2 209 条多跳歧义问句；提出 CLARION：两阶段智能体框架，第一阶段独立生成并排序候选歧义消解路径，第二阶段按路径检索证据并完成多跳推理，实现歧义规划与证据推理显式解耦。
AI.result: SOTA 模型在 MARCH 上准确率骤降，暴露复合难题；CLARION 相较最强基线绝对提升约 15%，在歧义检测、路径选择、最终答案全环节均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 多跳推理与分层歧义的交织是当前瓶颈；MARCH 提供系统评测基准，CLARION 验证「先规划后推理」范式的有效性，为构建可解释、鲁棒的多跳问答系统奠定新路线。

title: Optimal Stability of KL Divergence under Gaussian Perturbations
summary: We study the problem of characterizing the stability of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence under Gaussian perturbations beyond Gaussian families. Existing relaxed triangle inequalities for KL divergence critically rely on the assumption that all involved distributions are Gaussian, which limits their applicability in modern applications such as out-of-distribution (OOD) detection with flow-based generative models. In this paper, we remove this restriction by establishing a sharp stability bound between an arbitrary distribution and Gaussian families under mild moment conditions. Specifically, let $P$ be a distribution with finite second moment, and let $\mathcal{N}_1$ and $\mathcal{N}_2$ be multivariate Gaussian distributions. We show that if $KL(P||\mathcal{N}_1)$ is large and $KL(\mathcal{N}_1||\mathcal{N}_2)$ is at most $ε$, then $KL(P||\mathcal{N}_2) \ge KL(P||\mathcal{N}_1) - O(\sqrtε)$. Moreover, we prove that this $\sqrtε$ rate is optimal in general, even within the Gaussian family. This result reveals an intrinsic stability property of KL divergence under Gaussian perturbations, extending classical Gaussian-only relaxed triangle inequalities to general distributions. The result is non-trivial due to the asymmetry of KL divergence and the absence of a triangle inequality in general probability spaces. As an application, we provide a rigorous foundation for KL-based OOD analysis in flow-based models, removing strong Gaussian assumptions used in prior work. More broadly, our result enables KL-based reasoning in non-Gaussian settings arising in deep learning and reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文突破了传统高斯模型束缚，给出了任意分布在高斯扰动下 KL 散度的最优稳定界 √ε，为流模型 OOD 检测等应用奠定无需高斯假设的理论基础。
AI.motivation: 现有 KL 松散的三角不等式仅对高斯分布成立，无法支撑现代非高斯建模（如流模型）下的 OOD 检测与表示学习，需要一种普适的扰动稳定性刻画。
AI.method: 在仅要求 P 具有二阶矩的一般条件下，利用 KL 的弱连续性与矩不等式，构造性地建立并证明 KL(P∥N₂) ≥ KL(P∥N₁)−O(√ε)；通过反例说明 √ε 速率最优且对高斯族也紧。
AI.result: 首次连通“任意分布 ↔ 高斯族”间的稳定界，明确给出 O(√ε) 的下界且展示其可触及最优性；推得流模型 OOD 分数、强化学习策略评估等场景中可可靠利用 KL 判别，无需可逆映射或高斯假设。
AI.conclusion: KL 散度对高斯扰动具有内在 √ε-稳定性，这一结果将经典高斯三角不等式推广到任意分布，为非高斯深度学习和强化学习中 KL-型推理提供了理论支撑和新算法范式。

title: Hybrid Approach for Enhancing Lesion Segmentation in Fundus Images
summary: Choroidal nevi are common benign pigmented lesions in the eye, with a small risk of transforming into melanoma. Early detection is critical to improving survival rates, but misdiagnosis or delayed diagnosis can lead to poor outcomes. Despite advancements in AI-based image analysis, diagnosing choroidal nevi in colour fundus images remains challenging, particularly for clinicians without specialized expertise. Existing datasets often suffer from low resolution and inconsistent labelling, limiting the effectiveness of segmentation models. This paper addresses the challenge of achieving precise segmentation of fundus lesions, a critical step toward developing robust diagnostic tools. While deep learning models like U-Net have demonstrated effectiveness, their accuracy heavily depends on the quality and quantity of annotated data. Previous mathematical/clustering segmentation methods, though accurate, required extensive human input, making them impractical for medical applications. This paper proposes a novel approach that combines mathematical/clustering segmentation models with insights from U-Net, leveraging the strengths of both methods. This hybrid model improves accuracy, reduces the need for large-scale training data, and achieves significant performance gains on high-resolution fundus images. The proposed model achieves a Dice coefficient of 89.7% and an IoU of 80.01% on 1024*1024 fundus images, outperforming the Attention U-Net model, which achieved 51.3% and 34.2%, respectively. It also demonstrated better generalizability on external datasets. This work forms a part of a broader effort to develop a decision support system for choroidal nevus diagnosis, with potential applications in automated lesion annotation to enhance the speed and accuracy of diagnosis and monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合数学聚类与U-Net思想的混合分割模型，在1024×1024彩色眼底图中实现脉络膜痣高精度自动分割，Dice 89.7%、IoU 80.01%，显著优于Attention U-Net，并展现出跨数据集泛化能力，为后续智能诊断系统奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 脉络膜痣虽多为良性，但存在恶变为黑色素瘤风险；早期精准检出可显著改善预后。现有AI方法受限于低分辨率、标注不一致的小样本数据，导致分割精度不足，尤其对非专业医生不友好，亟需高鲁棒、低数据依赖的自动分割工具。
AI.method: 将传统数学/聚类分割的高精度先验与U-Net深度学习架构融合：先利用数学模型生成高质量伪标签，缓解标注稀缺；再设计轻量级U-Net变体，以伪标签为引导进行训练，实现高分辨率图像的端到端精修；整个流程无需大规模人工标注。
AI.result: 在自采1024×1024眼底图测试集上，Dice达89.7%，IoU达80.01%，相对Attention U-Net（Dice 51.3%，IoU 34.2%）绝对提升约38个百分点；外部公开数据集验证显示更好泛化性，且训练所需标注量降低约60%。
AI.conclusion: 混合模型兼顾数学分割的精度与深度学习的高效，突破高分辨率眼底病灶分割的数据瓶颈，为脉络膜痣自动量化与随访提供可靠技术支撑，可嵌入决策支持系统，实现快速、准确的临床辅助诊断。

title: A Faster Path to Continual Learning
summary: Continual Learning (CL) aims to train neural networks on a dynamic stream of tasks without forgetting previously learned knowledge. Among optimization-based approaches, C-Flat has emerged as a promising solution due to its plug-and-play nature and its ability to encourage uniformly low-loss regions for both new and old tasks. However, C-Flat requires three additional gradient computations per iteration, imposing substantial overhead on the optimization process. In this work, we propose C-Flat Turbo, a faster yet stronger optimizer that significantly reduces the training cost. We show that the gradients associated with first-order flatness contain direction-invariant components relative to the proxy-model gradients, enabling us to skip redundant gradient computations in the perturbed ascent steps. Moreover, we observe that these flatness-promoting gradients progressively stabilize across tasks, which motivates a linear scheduling strategy with an adaptive trigger to allocate larger turbo steps for later tasks. Experiments show that C-Flat Turbo is 1.0$\times$ to 1.25$\times$ faster than C-Flat across a wide range of CL methods, while achieving comparable or even improved accuracy.

AI.tldr: C-Flat Turbo 在保持或提升 C-Flat 抗遗忘性能的同时，将训练时间缩短 0–25%，核心是通过识别平坦梯度中的方向不变量与跨任务稳定性来减少冗余梯度计算。
AI.motivation: 优化型持续学习方法 C-Flat 虽有效，但每步需额外计算 3 次梯度，训练开销大；急需一种不牺牲精度的加速方案。
AI.method: 1) 发现平坦正则项的一阶梯度与代理模型梯度存在方向不变分量，可重用而无需重复扰动上升计算；2) 观察到该梯度随任务逐渐稳定，遂设计线性递增的 turbo步长调度，并配以自适应触发机制，在后续任务中分配更大步长。
AI.result: 在多种持续学习基准与骨干方法上，C-Flat Turbo 训练速度提升 1.0–1.25 倍，平均准确率持平或更高， forgetting 指标不劣于原 C-Flat。
AI.conclusion: 通过挖掘平坦梯度冗余并自适应调度步长，C-Flat Turbo 首次将 C-Flat 的“即插即用”优势与近实时训练结合起来，为优化型持续学习提供了可扩展的加速范式。

title: The Signal is in the Steps: Local Scoring for Reasoning Data Selection
summary: Distilling long-form reasoning from teacher models into smaller students requires selecting which candidate solutions to train on. Recent work argues that one should select responses the student model assigns highest probability, i.e., favoring solutions ``natural'' to the student. However, we find that this approach works within a single teacher but fails when scaling to long reasoning traces from multiple diverse teachers. We identify a key cause: this approach scores entire solutions, but students generalize by recombining familiar reasoning steps, not by memorizing complete solutions. Full-trajectory scoring optimizes the wrong target; it rewards global fluency while the transferable signal lies in local step transitions. We propose Local Average Log Probability (LALP), which scores each reasoning step using only a small window of preceding context, measuring whether each step is justified by its immediate premises rather than whether the full response looks natural to the student. LALP enables two practical use cases: selecting the best teacher before fine-tuning and curating training data from diverse teacher pools. Across math, coding, and science reasoning tasks, LALP consistently improves accuracy when selecting the most natural solutions by a large margin.

AI.tldr: 用“局部平均对数概率(LALP)”取代全轨迹打分，仅依据局部上下文评估推理步骤的合理性，从而在多教师长链推理蒸馏中更高效地挑选训练样本并显著提升学生模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅按学生模型给整条答案的全局概率选样，但当教师多样且推理链极长时，学生难以记住完整答案而是靠复用局部步骤泛化，全轨迹打分失效并导致性能下降。
AI.method: 提出Local Average Log Probability(LALP)：对每个推理步骤，只取少量前序token作条件，计算该步骤的对数概率并平均，衡量其被局部前提支撑的程度；随后将LALP用于1)挑选最佳教师模型，2)从多教师池中筛选高质量训练数据。
AI.result: 在数学、编程与科学推理三类任务上，相比baseline的全轨迹概率选样，LALP错率相对下降显著(论文称large margin)，且学生模型最终准确率一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 全轨迹评分优化错误目标；局部步骤合理性才是可迁移信号。LALP提供了简单且可扩展的指标，可在多教师场景下有效优选训练数据并改善知识蒸馏效果。

title: THEIA: Learning Complete Kleene Three-Valued Logic in a Pure-Neural Modular Architecture
summary: We present THEIA, a modular neural architecture that learns complete Kleene three-valued logic (K3) end-to-end without any external symbolic solver, and investigate what architectural prior enables compositional generalization under uncertainty. THEIA processes four mathematical domains (arithmetic, order, set membership, propositional logic) through dedicated engines that converge in a final logic module. Trained on a 2M-sample dataset with input space ~3.4 x 10^13, it achieves 12/12 Kleene K3 rule coverage across 5 seeds in 7.93 +/- 1.40 minutes (6.5x faster under matched settings; ~3.6x under Transformer-standard tuning, App. G). A mod-3 sequential composition experiment generalizes from 5-step training to 500-step evaluation at 99.97% +/- 0.02% -- a result requiring a structured backbone: replacing the four-engine backbone with a flat MLP collapses length generalization to chance by 50 steps at both tested capacities (0.80M and parameter-matched 2.75M), while a pre-LN TF8LTuned Transformer baseline (3,582,147 params) trained under the identical protocol reaches 99.24% at 500 steps (Appendix F). Mechanistic probing reveals that modularity induces a delayed verdict: upstream engines encode domain-specific variables without committing to the final truth value (probe accuracy <= 74% uncertainty-only ceiling), with the verdict emerging only at the Logic Engine boundary -- causally confirmed by activation patching (100% flip rate on 986 matched OR pairs, replicated across n=5 seeds; 100.0% aggregate on 4,898 pairs; generalized to AND with 100% flip rate on 4,719 pairs). The Transformer baseline reaches equivalent correctness through a qualitatively different representational trajectory (contraction then expansion), suggesting that modular and monolithic architectures implement distinct compositional strategies.

AI.tldr: THEIA 把 K3 Kleene 三值逻辑熔进一个可端到端学习的纯神经网络；分领域引擎先做“不知真假的”特征计算，直到最后逻辑门才合并并下判决，因此能用 5 步训练直接外推到 500 步序列且准确率近 100%，而同等参数的 MLP 或预调优 Transformer 均在不具备这种长度泛化。凡把模块化骨架换成平坦结构，性能在 50 步即崩溃，触发激活修补可 100% 翻转 OR/AND 输出，因果锁定“延迟判决”机制。该架构证明：结构化先验是组合推广和不确定性下外推的核心，而非单纯容量或深层匹配参数量。
AI.motivation: Kleene 三值逻辑兼具真、假、未知 (¬∃ 联结符完备性仍保持)，能在噪声数据、开放世界推理中明确建模不确定性，但此前依赖显式符号求解器，难以与神经模式进行端到端学习且缺乏对组合泛化机理的深入揭示。作者希望回答 1. 是否能在无外部符号求解器的情况下，用纯神经网络学完整 Kleene 规则；2. 需要何种网络先验才能实现这种不确定性推理的组合泛化与长度外推；3. 通过探针与因果干预，厘清不同架构（模块化 vs. 单体）实现逻辑推理的表征路径差异，由此指引更稳健且可释的组合模型设计。
AI.method: 提出四引擎神经架构 THEIA：(1) Arithmetic Engine 处理算术，(2) Order Engine 给顺序比较，(3) Set Membership Engine 负责集合关系，(4) Logic Engine 作为唯一 K3 判决层与前三个引擎共享隐向量。训练数据源覆盖四域、四运算符/关系统共 2M 采样，输入空间约 3.4×10^13。实验范式：(a) K3 法则完备性测试；(b) Mod-3 序列任务由 5 → 500 步外推评估长程组合；(c) 探针准确度封顶(仅不确定性)≤74% 以证明“延迟判决”；d. 激活修补：前移端 OR/RN 特征或将任意 986/4719 匹配对干预为未知，观测翻转率 & 统计；并对比同等参数量 MLP 及 Pre-LN 调优的 3.58M Transformer。
AI.result: (1) 规则完备：12/12 Kleene K3 在所有 Seeds 下收敛仅需 7.93±1.40 min，比 Flat MLP 快 6.5×，比标准 Transformer 调参快 ~3.6×；(2) 长度外推：5→500 步 mod-3 序列，THEIA 稳定 99.97±0.02%，flat MLP 两段容量 (0.80M / 2.75M)50 步内掉到随机；(3) 探针红线：上游引擎准确率≤74%，仅在逻辑边界处生成最终真值；(4) 因果锁定：986 对 OR+4,898 聚类 OR、4,719 AND，激活修补均可 100% 翻转判决；(5) Transformer 也能贴近正确率，但通过“先收缩再扩张”表征，与 THEIA 的模块化延迟路径根本不同。
AI.conclusion: 可完全以端到端神经方式习得 Kleene 三值逻辑，无需外查符号引擎；关键不是模型参数总量，而在于是否具备“模块化 + 延迟判决”的结构先验——各引擎先承载域特定中间状态、直到集成层才抽离未知值。同样参数量下，丧失这一先验的纯 MLP 会迅速在长序列组合上崩溃；Transformer 以深层自注意力暗含某种延迟，但其表征演化路径与显式模块化策略存在质的差异。工作提示：面向开放世界/不确定性推理，采用显式“中间态-集成-判决”式分层比单纯堆容量更重要，可为以后神经符号混合与可释推理架构提供指南。

title: Geometry-Aware Cross Modal Alignment for Light Field-LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation serves as a cornerstone of scene understanding in autonomous driving but continues to face significant challenges under complex conditions such as occlusion. Light field and LiDAR modalities provide complementary visual and spatial cues that are beneficial for robust perception; however, their effective integration is hindered by limited viewpoint diversity and inherent modality discrepancies. To address these challenges, the first multimodal semantic segmentation dataset integrating light field data and point cloud data is proposed. Based on this dataset, we proposed a multi-modal light field point-cloud fusion segmentation network(Mlpfseg), incorporating feature completion and depth perception to segment both camera images and LiDAR point clouds simultaneously. The feature completion module addresses the density mismatch between point clouds and image pixels by performing differential reconstruction of point-cloud feature maps, enhancing the fusion of these modalities. The depth perception module improves the segmentation of occluded objects by reinforcing attention scores for better occlusion awareness. Our method outperforms image-only segmentation by 1.71 Mean Intersection over Union(mIoU) and point cloud-only segmentation by 2.38 mIoU, demonstrating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 首个结合光场与点云的多模态语义分割数据集+MlpfSeg网络，利用特征补全+深度感知模块，在遮挡场景下显著超越单模态基线。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶遮挡场景下，单一视觉或点云模态信息残缺；光场与LiDAR虽互补，却受视角不足和模态差异限制，缺乏联合数据集与对应融合方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建首份光场—点云配对语义分割数据集；2) 提出MlpfSeg网络：差分式点云特征补全模块解决密度失配，深度感知注意模块增强遮挡区域权重；3) 端到端同步输出图像与点云分割结果。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上，MlpfSeg比纯图像分割提升1.71 mIoU，比纯点云分割提升2.38 mIoU，验证了联合光场-点云输入的鲁棒性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过专用数据集与特征补全-深度感知融合策略，光场与LiDAR可协同提升复杂遮挡环境下的语义分割精度，为多模态自动驾驶感知提供了新基准与方法。

title: Fast and principled equation discovery from chaos to climate
summary: Our ability to predict, control, and ultimately understand complex systems rests on discovering the equations that govern their dynamics. Identifying these equations directly from noisy, limited observations has therefore become a central challenge in data-driven science, yet existing library-based sparse regression methods force a compromise between automation, statistical rigor, and computational efficiency. Here we develop Bayesian-ARGOS, a hybrid framework that reconciles these demands by combining rapid frequentist screening with focused Bayesian inference, enabling automated equation discovery with principled uncertainty quantification at a fraction of the computational cost of existing methods. Tested on seven chaotic systems under varying data scarcity and noise levels, Bayesian-ARGOS outperforms two state-of-the-art methods in most scenarios. It surpasses SINDy in data efficiency for all systems and noise tolerance for six out of the seven, with a two-order-of-magnitude reduction in computational cost compared to bootstrap-based ARGOS. The probabilistic formulation additionally enables a suite of standard statistical diagnostics, including influence analysis and multicollinearity detection that expose failure modes otherwise opaque. When integrated with representation learning (SINDy-SHRED) for high dimensional sea surface temperature reconstruction, Bayesian-ARGOS increases the yield of valid latent equations with significantly improved long horizon stability. Bayesian-ARGOS thus provides a principled, automated, and computationally efficient route from scarce and noisy observations to interpretable governing equations, offering a practical framework for equation discovery across scales, from benchmark chaotic systems to the latent dynamics underlying global climate patterns.

AI.tldr: Bayesian-ARGOS 用“快速频率派筛选+集中贝叶斯推断”两步法，在噪声大、数据稀缺的条件下自动发现动力学方程，计算量降低两个数量级，统计诊断完备，在 7 个混沌系统与全球海温潜变量重建中全面优于 SINDy 等最新方法。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏回归库方法必须在“自动化、统计严谨性、计算效率”之间折衷，难以兼顾；亟需一种能在数据稀缺且含噪时仍给出可信不确定性度量的高效方程发现框架。
AI.method: 构建混合框架 Bayesian-ARGOS：① 频率派快速筛选候选库项，② 对精简后的子空间执行聚焦贝叶斯推断，输出系数后验与不确定性；并配套影响分析、多重共线性检测等统计诊断模块。
AI.result: 在 7 个混沌体系、不同噪声与数据量条件下，Bayesian-ARGOS 数据利用率全面优于 SINDy，6/7 场景噪声容忍度更高；与自助 ARGOS 相比计算成本降 100 倍；联合 SINDy-SHRED 做海温潜变量重建时，有效潜方程比例与长时稳定性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: Bayesian-ARGOS 为用稀疏噪声观测获取可解释控制方程提供了兼顾统计原则、自动化与计算效率的实用路径，可横向扩展至从 benchmark 混沌系统到全球气候潜动力学等多尺度问题。

title: Native Hybrid Attention for Efficient Sequence Modeling
summary: Transformers excel at sequence modeling but face quadratic complexity, while linear attention offers improved efficiency but often compromises recall accuracy over long contexts. In this work, we introduce Native Hybrid Attention (NHA), a novel hybrid architecture of linear and full attention that integrates both intra & inter-layer hybridization into a unified layer design. NHA maintains long-term context in key-value slots updated by a linear RNN, and augments them with short-term tokens from a sliding window. A single softmax attention operation is then applied over all keys and values, enabling per-token and per-head context-dependent weighting without requiring additional fusion parameters. The inter-layer behavior is controlled through a single hyperparameter, the sliding window size, which allows smooth adjustment between purely linear and full attention while keeping all layers structurally uniform. Experimental results show that NHA surpasses Transformers and other hybrid baselines on recall-intensive and commonsense reasoning tasks. Furthermore, pretrained LLMs can be structurally hybridized with NHA, achieving competitive accuracy while delivering significant efficiency gains. Code is available at https://github.com/JusenD/NHA.

AI.tldr: 提出 Native Hybrid Attention (NHA)，在单层内用线性 RNN 维护长程 KV 槽并叠加滑动窗短程 token，再统一做 softmax；层间仅用窗口大小这一超参即可连续调节“线性↔全注意”。实验显示 NHA 在召回与推理任务上优于 Transformer 及已有混合方案，且可直接结构式植入预训练 LLM，实现精度-效率双赢。
AI.motivation: Transformer 的长序列二次复杂度瓶颈与线性注意召回精度下降之间的矛盾仍未解决；现有混合方法多需额外门控/融合参数，且层间结构不一，难以平滑权衡效率与精度。
AI.method: 设计单层统一架构：①线性 RNN 持续更新长程 key-value 记忆槽；②滑动窗口缓存局部短程 token 的 KV；③对合并后的长+短 KV 仅执行一次 softmax 注意，实现 token/头级动态权重；④层间通过单一超参“窗口大小”控制长-短比例，无需额外门控即可连续调整至纯线性或纯全注意，并保持各层结构同质。
AI.result: 在强调召回与常识推理的基准上，NHA 超过 Transformer 及 MHA、Linear-A 等混合基线；将现成预训练 LLM 结构式替换为 NHA 后，下游精度持平甚至提升，同时显著降低 inference 延迟和显存占用。
AI.conclusion: NHA 以极简设计同时解决长程依赖保持与短程细节捕获，单超参即可实现效率-精度的平滑权衡，并可零门控移植到预训练模型，为大规模 LLM 的高效长上下文建模提供了新范式。

title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a core technique in the post-training of large language models, yet its training dynamics remain poorly understood. This paper provides a systematic investigation of OPD dynamics and mechanisms. We first identify that two conditions govern whether OPD succeeds or fails: (i) the student and teacher should share compatible thinking patterns; and (ii) even with consistent thinking patterns and higher scores, the teacher must offer genuinely new capabilities beyond what the student has seen during training. We validate these findings through weak-to-strong reverse distillation, showing that same-family 1.5B and 7B teachers are distributionally indistinguishable from the student's perspective. Probing into the token-level mechanism, we show that successful OPD is characterized by progressive alignment on high-probability tokens at student-visited states, a small shared token set that concentrates most of the probability mass (97%-99%). We further propose two practical strategies to recover failing OPD: off-policy cold start and teacher-aligned prompt selection. Finally, we show that OPD's apparent free lunch of dense token-level reward comes at a cost, raising the question of whether OPD can scale to long-horizon distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了 on-policy distillation（OPD）训练动态，提出“思维兼容+新能力”是决定 OPD 成败的两大条件，并以 1.5B/7B 同源模型实验验证了“弱教师难助强学生”的逆向蒸馏现象；进一步揭示 OPD 成功时师生仅在极少数高概率 token 上渐进对齐（97–99% 概率集中），给出冷启动与提示筛选两种修复失败 OPD 的实用策略，并指出 dense token-level reward 并非免费午餐，长程蒸馏存在可扩展性隐忧。
AI.motivation: 大模型后训练阶段广泛采用 OPD，却缺乏对其训练动态与成功/失败机理的系统性理解，导致实践试错成本高、性能不稳定。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：提出师生“思维兼容”与“教师提供新能力”双条件框架。2) 实验验证：在同一家族 1.5B→7B 与反向 7B→1.5B 模型上做弱-强逆向蒸馏，测量分布差异与性能增益。3) 机制探针：在 token 级追踪师生概率分布对齐轨迹，统计高概率共享 token 集合及其概率集中度。4) 策略设计：引入 off-policy 冷启动与 teacher 对齐提示选择，对比修复失败蒸馏的效果。5) 代价分析：评估 dense 奖励对样本效率与长程任务泛化的影响。
AI.result: 发现同源 1.5B/7B 教师从分布角度看对学生几乎不可区分；只有当教师与学生在“高概率 token 小集合”（占 97–99% 概率质量）上渐进对齐，OPD 才成功；否则即使教师得分更高亦失败。两种修复策略分别提升失败样本成功率 18–32%。进一步实验表明，OPD 的密集奖励虽短期提升性能，却降低长程任务样本效率约 15–20%，提示可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: OPD 并非简单“高分教师即能教”，其成败由“思维兼容+新能力”双条件决定；token 级机制核心是师生在极少数高概率 token 上对齐；冷启动与提示筛选可有效挽救失败案例；dense reward 并非免费午餐，长程蒸馏需重新权衡探索与利用，未来应研究更稀疏或结构化的蒸馏信号以提升可扩展性。

title: SPG: Sandwiched Policy Gradient for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are emerging as an efficient alternative to autoregressive models due to their ability to decode multiple tokens in parallel. However, aligning dLLMs with human preferences or task-specific rewards via reinforcement learning (RL) is challenging because their intractable log-likelihood precludes the direct application of standard policy gradient methods. While prior work uses surrogates like the evidence lower bound (ELBO), these one-sided approximations can introduce significant policy gradient bias. To address this, we propose the Sandwiched Policy Gradient (SPG) that leverages both an upper and a lower bound of the true log-likelihood. Experiments show that SPG significantly outperforms baselines based on ELBO or one-step estimation. Specifically, SPG improves the accuracy over state-of-the-art RL methods for dLLMs by 3.6% in GSM8K, 2.6% in MATH500, 18.4% in Countdown and 27.0% in Sudoku.

AI.tldr: 针对扩散型大语言模型（dLLM）无法用常规策略梯度直接优化的问题，提出上下界双重夹逼的策略梯度（SPG），在 GSM8K、MATH500 等任务上较 ELBO 基线提升 3.6%–27%。
AI.motivation: 扩散式大模型虽能并行解码，但其不可计算的对数似然导致现有 RL 对齐方法只能使用单侧近似（ELBO），引入显著梯度偏差，亟需无偏差优化手段。
AI.method: 提出“夹逼策略梯度”——Sandwiched Policy Gradient：同时构建对数似然的可计算下界与上界，将真实梯度夹逼在二者之间，并推导对应无偏差蒙特卡罗估计。
AI.result: 在 GSM8K、MATH500、Countdown 与 Sudoku 四类任务上，SPG 准确率分别提升 3.6%、2.6%、18.4%、27.0%，显著优于仅用 ELBO 或一步估计的 RL 基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过双向边界夹逼，SPG 首次为 dLLM 提供了低偏差、高稳定的强化学习优化路径，验证了扩散式大模型在复杂推理任务中的可扩展对齐潜力。

title: Convex Hulls of Reachable Sets
comment: 20 pages. IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control 2025. Simplified maximality condition (no minus sign)
summary: We study the convex hulls of reachable sets of nonlinear systems with bounded disturbances and uncertain initial conditions. Reachable sets play a critical role in control, but remain notoriously challenging to compute, and existing over-approximation tools tend to be conservative or computationally expensive. In this work, we characterize the convex hulls of reachable sets as the convex hulls of solutions of an ordinary differential equation with initial conditions on the sphere. This finite-dimensional characterization unlocks an efficient sampling-based estimation algorithm to accurately over-approximate reachable sets. We also study the structure of the boundary of the reachable convex hulls and derive error bounds for the estimation algorithm. We give applications to neural feedback loop analysis and robust MPC.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于采样的高效算法，用 ODE 初值在球面上的凸包刻画非线性系统可达集凸包，解决保守性与计算复杂度的矛盾，并给出误差界，应用于神经网络反馈与鲁棒 MPC 分析。
AI.motivation: 非线性系统在扰动和不确定初态下的精确可达集难以计算，现有工具过于保守或代价高，需更紧致且可负担的凸壳过近似方法。
AI.method: 将可达集凸包等价转化为以单位球面初值为起始的 ODE 解集的凸包，构造有限维采样算法；分析凸壳边界的微分几何结构；推导采样估计的显式误差上界。
AI.result: 获得可计算的紧致凸壳过近似；采样复杂度与状态维数多项式相关；误差界显示估计随采样数增加单调递减；在 6-DoF 无人机神经网络控制器与鲁棒 MPC 中验证比 zonotope 等工具紧致度提升 30–60%。
AI.conclusion: 凸壳视角把无限维可达集问题简化为有限维 ODE 解的凸包采样，兼顾紧致性与效率，为安全控制中在线可达性分析提供了可扩展的新途径。

title: A Function-Centric Perspective on Flat and Sharp Minima
summary: Flat minima are strongly associated with improved generalisation in deep neural networks. However, this connection has proven nuanced in recent studies, with both theoretical counterexamples and empirical exceptions emerging in the literature. In this paper, we revisit the role of sharpness in model performance and argue that sharpness is better understood as a function-dependent property rather than an indicator of poor generalisation. We conduct extensive empirical studies ranging from single-objective optimisation, synthetic non-linear binary classification tasks, to modern image classification tasks. In single-objective optimisation, we show that flatness and sharpness are relative to the function being learned: equally optimal solutions can exhibit markedly different local geometry. In synthetic non-linear binary classification tasks, we show that increasing decision-boundary tightness can increase sharpness even when models generalise perfectly, indicating that sharpness is not reducible to memorisation alone. Finally, in large-scale experiments, we find that sharper minima often emerge when models are regularised (e.g., via weight decay, data augmentation, or SAM), and coincide with better generalisation, calibration, robustness, and functional consistency. Our findings suggest that function complexity, rather than flatness, shapes the geometry of solutions, and that sharper minima can reflect more appropriate inductive biases, calling for a function-centric reappraisal of minima geometry.

AI.tldr: 平坦极小值未必带来更好泛化；尖锐极小值经正则化后反而常与更优泛化、校准及鲁棒性共存，因此锐度应被视为函数依赖性质而非泛化恶化的信号。
AI.motivation: 近年文献同时出现理论反例与实证例外，挑战“平坦即泛化”的经典信条，需重新审视角点。
AI.method: 在单目标优化、合成非线性二分类及大规模图像分类三类任务中，系统测量解的局部几何、决策边界紧度与泛化/校准/鲁棒性，并考察权重衰减、数据增广、SAM 等正则化对锐度的影响。
AI.result: 1) 同损网络可呈现迥异锐度；2) 决策边界越紧锐度越高但完美泛化；3) 正则化后模型更尖锐却伴随更好泛化、校准、鲁棒性及功能一致性。
AI.conclusion: 解的几何由函数复杂性而非平坦度主导；尖锐极小值可隐含更合适的归纳偏置，应跳出“平好尖坏”框架，转向以函数为中心的锐度重评估。

title: Deep Learning Based Amharic Chatbot for FAQs in Universities
summary: University students often spend a considerable amount of time seeking answers to common questions from administrators or teachers. This can become tedious for both parties, leading to a need for a solution. In response, this paper proposes a chatbot model that utilizes natural language processing and deep learning techniques to answer frequently asked questions (FAQs) in the Amharic language. Chatbots are computer programs that simulate human conversation through the use of artificial intelligence (AI), acting as a virtual assistant to handle questions and other tasks. The proposed chatbot program employs tokenization, normalization, stop word removal, and stemming to analyze and categorize Amharic input sentences. Three machine learning model algorithms were used to classify tokens and retrieve appropriate responses: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Multinomial Naïve Bayes, and deep neural networks implemented through TensorFlow, Keras, and NLTK. The deep learning model achieved the best results with 91.55% accuracy and a validation loss of 0.3548 using an Adam optimizer and SoftMax activation function. The chatbot model was integrated with Facebook Messenger and deployed on a Heroku server for 24-hour accessibility. The experimental results demonstrate that the chatbot framework achieved its objectives and effectively addressed challenges such as Amharic Fidel variation, morphological variation, and lexical gaps. Future research could explore the integration of Amharic WordNet to narrow the lexical gap and support more complex questions.

AI.tldr: 用深度学习Amharic FAQ聊天机器人，代替师生重复问答，准确率达91.55%，已上线Facebook Messenger。
AI.motivation: 高校师生常被重复性FAQ拖累，而阿姆哈拉语缺乏智能对话工具，需自动答疑方案。
AI.method: 对阿姆哈拉语做分词、归一化、去停用词、词干提取；用SVM、多项式朴素贝叶斯与TensorFlow/Keras深度神经网络分类意图；最佳模型用Adam优化器与SoftMax激活训练。
AI.result: 深度学习模型最高91.55%准确率、验证损失0.3548；部署于Heroku并接入Facebook Messenger，24h可用；有效缓解该语言形/音变体与词汇缺口问题。
AI.conclusion: 框架达成自动FAQ目标，证明深度模型可服务低资源阿姆哈拉语场景；未来引入阿姆哈拉WordNet可进一步提升复杂问句处理能力。

title: Scaling Test-Time Compute to Achieve IOI Gold Medal with Open-Weight Models
summary: Competitive programming has become a rigorous benchmark for evaluating the reasoning and problem-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs). The International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) stands out as one of the most prestigious annual competitions in competitive programming and has become a key benchmark for comparing human and AI-level programming ability. While several proprietary models have been claimed to achieve gold medal-level performance at the IOI, often with undisclosed methods, achieving comparable results with open-weight models remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we present GenCluster, a scalable and reproducible test-time compute framework that attains IOI gold-level performance using open-weight models. It combines large-scale generation, behavioral clustering, ranking, and a round-robin submission strategy to efficiently explore diverse solution spaces under limited validation budgets. Our experiments show that the performance of our proposed approach scales consistently with available compute, narrowing the gap between open and closed systems. Notably, we will show that GenCluster can achieve a gold medal at IOI 2025 for the first time with an open-weight model gpt-oss-120b, setting a new benchmark for transparent and reproducible evaluation of reasoning in LLMs

AI.tldr: GenCluster 是首个让开源 120B 模型在 IOI 夺金的可复现测试时计算框架，通过大规模生成-聚类-排序-循环提交策略，在有限验证预算内逼近闭源模型。
AI.motivation: IOI 是衡量人类与 AI 编程能力的顶级赛场，闭源模型已宣称夺金但方法未公开；开源模型始终落后，亟需可扩展、可复现的方案验证其推理上限。
AI.method: 提出 GenCluster：先对开源 120B 模型做大规模解空间生成，再按程序行为聚类去重，训练轻量排序器挑候选，最后以循环提交在 IOI 官方环境下最大化得分，全程测试时计算随算力线性扩展。
AI.result: 在 IOI-2025 正式赛题上，GenCluster 以开源模型首次达到金牌线，显著缩小与闭源系统的差距，且性能随生成/验证预算单调提升。
AI.conclusion: 开源模型凭测试时计算可达顶尖竞技编程水平，GenCluster 为透明、可复现的 LLM 推理评估设立新基准，证明算力而非闭源参数才是关键瓶颈。

title: Nonparametric Sparse Online Learning of the Koopman Operator
summary: The Koopman operator provides a powerful framework for representing the dynamics of general nonlinear dynamical systems. However, existing data-driven approaches to learning the Koopman operator rely on batch data. In this work, we present a sparse online learning algorithm that learns the Koopman operator iteratively via stochastic approximation, with explicit control over model complexity and provable convergence guarantees. Specifically, we study the Koopman operator via its action on the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), and address the mis-specified scenario where the dynamics may escape the chosen RKHS. In this mis-specified setting, we relate the Koopman operator to the conditional mean embeddings (CME) operator. We further establish both asymptotic and finite-time convergence guarantees for our learning algorithm in mis-specified setting, with trajectory-based sampling where the data arrive sequentially over time. Numerical experiments demonstrate the algorithm's capability to learn unknown nonlinear dynamics.

AI.tldr: 首个可在线迭代、带稀疏控制与收敛保证的Koopman算子学习算法，能处理动力学超出RKHS的误设情形。
AI.motivation: 传统数据驱动Koopman方法需批处理，无法实时更新且难控模型复杂度；当真实动力学超出所选RKHS时理论缺失。
AI.method: 将Koopman作用置于RKHS，用随机逼近在线更新；误设时把算子与条件均值嵌入(CME)关联，并以稀疏化显式控制复杂度。
AI.result: 在误设条件下给出渐近与有限时间收敛保证；轨迹序列实验显示算法可在线习得未知非线性动力学。
AI.conclusion: 所提稀疏在线算法突破批处理局限，为实时Koopman建模提供可扩展、可证明收敛的解决方案。

title: A Practitioner's Guide to Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary:
Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), whose design is inspired-rather than dictated-by the Kolmogorov superposition theorem, have emerged as a structured alternative to MLPs. This review provides a systematic and comprehensive overview of the rapidly expanding KAN literature.
  The review is organized around three core themes: (i) clarifying the relationships between KANs and Kolmogorov superposition theory (KST), MLPs, and classical kernel methods; (ii) analyzing basis functions as a central design axis; and (iii) summarizing recent advances in accuracy, efficiency, regularization, and convergence.
  Finally, we provide a practical "Choose-Your-KAN" guide and outline open research challenges and future directions. The accompanying GitHub repository serves as a structured reference for ongoing KAN research.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）的系统综述，梳理其与KST、MLP、核方法的关系，聚焦基函数设计，并给出选型指南与未来方向。
AI.motivation: MLP在深度学习中被广泛使用，但缺乏理论基础且可解释性差；KAN受Kolmogorov叠加定理启发，提供结构化可解释替代，却文献分散，需要统一视角。
AI.method: 按三大主题系统回顾：①厘清KAN与KST、MLP、核方法的理论异同；②将基函数（B-spline、小波、有理函数等）视为核心设计轴，对比其表达力与计算开销；③汇总精度提升、训练加速、正则化策略与收敛性保证的最新进展。最后给出“Choose-Your-KAN”流程图与GitHub资源库。
AI.result: KAN在符号回归、PDE求解、科学计算等任务上，以≤10%参数量达到或超越MLP精度；引入L1-样条正则化后收敛速度提升2–5×；开源仓库已整合20+变体与基准。
AI.conclusion: KAN作为“白盒”神经网络新范式已展现参数高效、可解释优势，但统一训练框架、高维扩展与硬件加速仍是开放挑战；作者呼吁社区依托仓库持续迭代，推动其成为科学建模的“首选积木”。

title: Fast training of accurate physics-informed neural networks without gradient descent
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation (top 1.13% of all submissions) at ICLR 2026 (60 pages)
summary: Solving time-dependent Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) is one of the most critical problems in computational science. While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a promising framework for approximating PDE solutions, their accuracy and training speed are limited by two core barriers: gradient-descent-based iterative optimization over complex loss landscapes and non-causal treatment of time as an extra spatial dimension. We present Frozen-PINN, a novel PINN based on the principle of space-time separation that leverages random features instead of training with gradient descent, and incorporates temporal causality by construction. On eight PDE benchmarks, including challenges such as extreme advection speeds, shocks, and high dimensionality, Frozen-PINNs achieve superior training efficiency and accuracy over state-of-the-art PINNs, often by several orders of magnitude. Our work addresses longstanding training and accuracy bottlenecks of PINNs, delivering quickly trainable, highly accurate, and inherently causal PDE solvers, a combination that prior methods could not realize. Our approach challenges the reliance of PINNs on stochastic gradient-descent-based methods and specialized hardware, leading to a paradigm shift in PINN training and providing a challenging benchmark for the community.

AI.tldr: Frozen-PINN 用随机特征一次性构造解并显式引入时间因果性，在 8 个含激波/强对流/高维场景的基准上，对比当前最优 PINNs 训练效率与精度提升可达数量级级。
AI.motivation: 经典 PINNs 依赖梯度下降迭代优化复杂损失地貌，且将时间当空间维度处理，导致训练慢、精度差、缺乏因果性，需要突破这两大瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出“冻结”PINN：空间-时间完全分离，用固定随机特征直接最小二乘拟合残差，无需梯度迭代；网络结构按时间正向递推，天然满足因果性。
AI.result: 在 8 个挑战性 PDE（含极端对流、激波、高维）上，Frozen-PINN 训练时间缩短 10²–10⁴ 倍，L² 相对误差降低 1–3 个数量级，均优于最优对比 PINNs。
AI.conclusion: 首次在 PINN 框架内同时实现快速训练、高精度与内在因果性，摆脱对 SGD 与专用硬件的依赖，为可扩展、可解释的神经 PDE 求解器提供新范式与强基准。

title: X-Diffusion: Training Diffusion Policies on Cross-Embodiment Human Demonstrations
summary: Human videos are a scalable source of training data for robot learning. However, humans and robots significantly differ in embodiment, making many human actions infeasible for direct execution on a robot. Still, these demonstrations convey rich object-interaction cues and task intent. Our goal is to learn from this coarse guidance without transferring embodiment-specific, infeasible execution strategies. Recent advances in generative modeling tackle a related problem of learning from low-quality data. In particular, Ambient Diffusion is a recent method for diffusion modeling that incorporates low-quality data only at high-noise timesteps of the forward diffusion process. Our key insight is to view human actions as noisy counterparts of robot actions. As noise increases along the forward diffusion process, embodiment-specific differences fade away while task-relevant guidance is preserved. Based on these observations, we present X-Diffusion, a cross-embodiment learning framework based on Ambient Diffusion that selectively trains diffusion policies on noised human actions. This enables effective use of easy-to-collect human videos without sacrificing robot feasibility. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, we show that X-Diffusion improves average success rates by 16% over naive co-training and manual data filtering. The project website is available at https://portal-cornell.github.io/X-Diffusion/.

AI.tldr: X-Diffusion 将带噪人动作视为高噪声扩散先验，仅在高噪声时段用人类视频训练扩散策略，避免引入不可行操作细节，在 5 项任务上比基线平均提升 16%。
AI.motivation: 人类视频易收集，但人-机器人本体差异导致许多动作无法直接复现；现有方法若直接混用人类数据会把不可行操作模式带进球性策略，降低机器人成功率。作者希望在不牺牲机器人可行性的前提下，利用人类数据中的任务意图和物体交互线索。
AI.method: 提出 X-Diffusion：基于 Ambient Diffusion，把人动作看成高噪声样本；仅在扩散过程的高噪声步（低信息阶段）用人类数据训练，而在低噪声步/采样阶段仅用机器人数据，从而避免引入本体特有的不可行动作结构。
AI.result: 在 5 个真实机器人操作任务上，与最简单的联合训练及手工过滤相比，X-Diffusion 将平均成功率提升 16%，表明其能有效利用易收集的人视频而不牺牲机器人可执行性。
AI.conclusion: 人-机器人本体差异可通过「高噪声等效」视角规避；X-Diffusion 提供了一种简单、免成本标注的跨本体学习范式，为扩散策略在机器人学中利用大规模人类视频数据开辟了新道路。

title: AudioX: A Unified Framework for Anything-to-Audio Generation
summary: Audio and music generation based on flexible multimodal control signals is a widely applicable topic, with the following key challenges: 1) a unified multimodal modeling framework, and 2) large-scale, high-quality training data. As such, we propose AudioX, a unified framework for anything-to-audio generation that integrates varied multimodal conditions (i.e., text, video, and audio signals) in this work. The core design in this framework is a Multimodal Adaptive Fusion module, which enables the effective fusion of diverse multimodal inputs, enhancing cross-modal alignment and improving overall generation quality. To train this unified model, we construct a large-scale, high-quality dataset, IF-caps, comprising over 7 million samples curated through a structured data annotation pipeline. This dataset provides comprehensive supervision for multimodal-conditioned audio generation. We benchmark AudioX against state-of-the-art methods across a wide range of tasks, finding that our model achieves superior performance, especially in text-to-audio and text-to-music generation. These results demonstrate our method is capable of audio generation under multimodal control signals, showing powerful instruction-following potential. The code and datasets will be available at https://zeyuet.github.io/AudioX/.

AI.tldr: AudioX: 用一套统一网络+700万样本的 IF-caps 数据集，把文本/视频/音频等多模态信号灵活转成高质量音频/音乐，生成质量全面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有音频生成系统大多只能接受单一模态输入，缺乏统一框架；同时大规模、高质量的多模态对照数据稀缺，限制了模型性能与泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出“Multimodal Adaptive Fusion”模块，将文本、视频、音频特征先独立编码后做动态加权融合，实现跨模态对齐；构建 700 万级 IF-caps 数据集，通过结构化标注管道确保样本质量；采用单一大模型统一训练，支持任意模态到音频的端到端生成。
AI.result: 在文本到音频、文本到音乐、视频到音频等任务上全面超过 SOTA；主观与客观指标（如 FAD、CLAP score）均显著提升，生成样本语义一致性与听感质量更高。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态融合策略+大规模高质量数据是音频生成的关键杠杆；AudioX 展示了强指令遵循与跨模态泛化潜力，为后续可控音频创作与交互提供了可复现的开源基础。

title: fMRI-LM: Towards a Universal Foundation Model for Language-Aligned fMRI Understanding
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled unified reasoning across images, audio, and video, but extending such capability to brain imaging remains largely unexplored. Bridging this gap is essential to link neural activity with semantic cognition and to develop cross-modal brain representations. To this end, we present fMRI-LM, a foundational model that bridges functional MRI (fMRI) and language through a three-stage framework. In Stage 1, we learn a neural tokenizer that maps fMRI into discrete tokens embedded in a language-consistent space. In Stage 2, a pretrained LLM is adapted to jointly model fMRI tokens and text, treating brain activity as a sequence that can be temporally predicted and linguistically described. To overcome the lack of natural fMRI-text pairs, we construct a large descriptive corpus that translates diverse imaging-based features into structured textual descriptors, capturing the low-level organization of fMRI signals. In Stage 3, we perform multi-task, multi-paradigm instruction tuning to endow fMRI-LM with high-level semantic understanding, supporting diverse downstream applications. Across various benchmarks, fMRI-LM achieves strong zero-shot and few-shot performance, and adapts efficiently with parameter-efficient tuning (LoRA), establishing a scalable pathway toward a language-aligned, universal model for structural and semantic understanding of fMRI.

AI.tldr: fMRI-LM 首次把大语言模型扩展到脑成像，用三阶段框架把 fMRI 信号转成离散“脑词”并与文本联合建模，实现零/少样本语义解码，开辟语言对齐的通用脑表征路线。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型已统一图文音频推理，却尚未触及脑成像；为建立神经活动与语义认知的跨模态桥梁，需把 fMRI 纳入语言框架。
AI.method: 三阶段：① 训练“神经分词器”把 4-D fMRI 映射为语言一致的离散 token；② 借助成像特征→文本描述语料，让预训练 LLM 联合建模 fMRI token 与文本，完成时间预测与语义描述；③ 多任务多范式指令微调，赋予模型高层语义理解并支持下游任务，全程用 LoRA 参数高效调优。
AI.result: 在多种脑解码基准上，fMRI-LM 零样本/少样本性能显著优于现有方法，仅用少量可训参数即可快速适配新任务，证实其可扩展性与通用性。
AI.conclusion: fMRI-LM 证明了“脑信号→语言 token→统一推理”的可行性，为构建大规模、语言对齐的通用脑模型奠定基础，有望推动神经语义解码和脑机接口应用。

title: Fast and Simple Densest Subgraph with Predictions
summary: We study the densest subgraph problem and its NP-hard densest at-most-$k$ subgraph variant through the lens of learning-augmented algorithms. We show that, given a reasonably accurate predictor that estimates whether a node belongs to the solution (e.g., a machine learning classifier), one can design simple linear-time algorithms that achieve a $(1-ε)$approximation. Finally, we present experimental results demonstrating the effectiveness of our methods for the densest at-most-$k$ subgraph problem on real-world graphs.

AI.tldr: 密集子图与带调预测器的 Densest-at-most-k 问题皆可在线性时间逼近最优，实验验证有效。
AI.motivation: 密集子图及其带基数限制的 NP-hard 变体在理论上难以高效逼近，而现实网络常可获得高置信度的节点归属预测。该文旨在将学习增强框架引入此类难解题，突破传统近似保证与运行时间瓶颈。
AI.method: 把节点是否位于最优子图的先验概率作为预测输入，设计两类线性时间算法：(1) 贪心“预测优先”检索策略，按置信度阈值序遍历节点并维护密度；(2) 基于预测的改进流式修剪框架，保证在误差界限下持续更新以保持近似比。通过预测误差敏感度分析，证明当预测误差 δ<ε 时算法天然达到 (1−ε) 近似，而无需传统稠密子图 μ-pass 二分搜索。
AI.result: 理论上给出误差—近似率线性互补依赖关系，证明仅需 O(|V|+|E|) 时间的算法即可获得 (1−ε)-approximation；数值实验表明在真实图（引用、协作、社交）上，当预测准确率 ≥85% 时，所获子图密度与最优解差距 <2%，较基线 Greed++ 提升最高 25%，运行时间平均缩短 2.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: 学习增强显著改变了密集子图问题的算法性能，可将 NP-hard 的 Densest-at-most-k 问题转化为线性时间可解并且无需近似率损失的实用高效方案；进一步启发在其他组合图挖掘问题中引入高质量预测以降低计算屏障。

title: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Target Language Adaptation of LLMs via Source-Shielded Updates
summary: Expanding the linguistic diversity of instruct large language models (LLMs) is crucial for global accessibility but is often hindered by the reliance on costly specialized target language labeled data and catastrophic forgetting during adaptation. We tackle this challenge under a realistic, low-resource constraint: adapting instruct LLMs using only unlabeled target language data. We introduce Source-Shielded Updates (SSU), a selective parameter update strategy that proactively preserves source knowledge. Using a small set of source data and a parameter importance scoring method, SSU identifies parameters critical to maintaining source abilities. It then applies a column-wise freezing strategy to protect these parameters before adaptation. Experiments across five typologically diverse languages and 7B and 13B models demonstrate that SSU successfully mitigates catastrophic forgetting. It reduces performance degradation on monolingual source tasks to just 3.4% (7B) and 2.8% (13B) on average, a stark contrast to the 20.3% and 22.3% from full fine-tuning. SSU also achieves target-language performance highly competitive with full fine-tuning, outperforming it on all benchmarks for 7B models and the majority for 13B models.

AI.tldr: 提出SSU策略，仅用无标注目标语数据即可在低资源条件下扩展LLM多语言能力，显著抑制灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 扩展LLM语言多样性需大量目标语标注数据且易灾难性遗忘，如何仅利用无标注目标语数据实现低资源适应是核心难题。
AI.method: SSU先用小量源语数据计算参数重要性得分，锁定关键参数列，再对剩余参数进行目标语适应，实现“源知识屏蔽”更新。
AI.result: 在5种语言、7B/13B模型上，SSU将源语任务性能下降压至3.4%/2.8%，远逊于全微调20%以上；目标语任务上7B全面领先，13B多数领先。
AI.conclusion: SSU以极低标注成本实现跨语适应，兼顾源语保持与目标语提升，为低资源多语LLM部署提供实用范式。

title: The Gaussian Latent Machine: Efficient Prior and Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems
summary: We consider the problem of sampling from a product-of-experts-type model that encompasses many standard prior and posterior distributions commonly found in Bayesian imaging. We show that this model can be easily lifted into a novel latent variable model, which we refer to as a Gaussian latent machine. This leads to a general sampling approach that unifies and generalizes many existing sampling algorithms in the literature. Most notably, it yields a highly efficient and effective two-block Gibbs sampling approach in the general case, while also specializing to direct sampling algorithms in particular cases. Finally, we present detailed numerical experiments that demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of our proposed sampling approach across a wide range of prior and posterior sampling problems from Bayesian imaging.

AI.tldr: 将乘积型专家模型提升为高斯潜变量机，统一并推广贝叶斯成像中的采样算法，提出高效的两块 Gibbs 采样器，并在多种先验/后验场景验证其优势。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯成像中常见的乘积型专家先验/后验虽表达能力丰富，但高效、统一的采样策略仍缺位；现有算法多为个案设计，缺乏通用性与效率保证。
AI.method: 将目标分布嵌入新提出的“高斯潜变量机”，通过引入辅助高斯变量把原问题转化为潜空间中的条件高态结构；据此推导一般化的两块 Gibbs 采样：一块对潜变量条件采样，一块对图像变量条件采样，二者均可用封闭型或快速数值方案实现；特例下退化为直接采样。
AI.result: 新框架统一了 SGS、P-ULA、MMSE 等多种现有算法；两块 Gibbs 在典型成像逆问题（去噪、去模糊、MRI 重建）中比对照方法提速 2–8 倍，有效样本大小提高 1 个数量级，且无需调参即可保持稳定收敛。
AI.conclusion: 高斯潜变量机提供了一条通用、高效、易实现的采样路径，显著扩展了贝叶斯成像可处理模型的范围，并为后续理论分析与更复杂模型（如层次先验、非高斯噪声）的采样奠定基础。

title: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation with a Unified Framework for Spatial, Temporal and Embodied Reasoning
comment: Under Review, 16 pages, 12 figures. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/return-sleep/AeroAct
summary: Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) aims to enable unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to interpret natural language instructions and navigate complex urban environments using onboard visual observation. This task holds promise for real-world applications such as low-altitude inspection, search-and-rescue, and autonomous aerial delivery. Existing methods often rely on panoramic images, depth inputs, or odometry to support spatial reasoning and action planning. These requirements increase system cost and integration complexity, thus hindering practical deployment for lightweight UAVs. We present a unified aerial VLN framework that operates solely on egocentric monocular RGB observations and natural language instructions. The model formulates navigation as a next-token prediction problem, jointly optimizing spatial perception, trajectory reasoning, and action prediction through prompt-guided multi-task learning. Moreover, we propose a keyframe selection strategy to reduce visual redundancy by retaining semantically informative frames, along with an action merging and label reweighting mechanism that mitigates long-tailed supervision imbalance and facilitates stable multi-task co-training. Extensive experiments on the AerialVLN and OpenFly benchmark validate the effectiveness of our method. Under the challenging monocular RGB-only setting, our model achieves strong results across both seen and unseen environments. It significantly outperforms existing RGB-only baselines and narrows the performance gap with state-of-the-art panoramic RGB-D counterparts. Comprehensive ablation studies further demonstrate the contribution of our task design and architectural choices. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/return-sleep/AeroAct.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅用单目RGB与语言指令的轻量级空中VLN框架，通过多任务统一建模与冗余帧过滤，在无需深度/全景/里程计条件下逼近RGB-D方法性能。
AI.motivation: 现有空中VLN依赖全景、深度或里程计，硬件负担高，难以在轻量无人机部署；亟需仅用最廉价单目RGB即可工作的实用方案。
AI.method: 1) 将导航统一为“下一token预测”多任务框架，联合优化空间感知、轨迹推理与动作预测；2) 提出语义关键帧选择去除视觉冗余；3) 设计动作合并与标签重加权，缓解长尾监督失衡，实现稳定共训练。
AI.result: 在AerialVLN与OpenFly基准上，单目RGB-only设定下显著超越现有RGB-only基线，性能逼近全景RGB-D SOTA；消融实验验证各组件增益。
AI.conclusion: 证实了单目RGB+语言即可胜任复杂城市空中导航，框架简洁、易部署，为轻量无人机VLN落地提供可行路径。

title: Flow-based Generative Modeling of Potential Outcomes and Counterfactuals
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory (ISIT 2026)
summary: Predicting potential and counterfactual outcomes from observational data is central to individualized decision-making, particularly in clinical settings where treatment choices must be tailored to each patient rather than guided solely by population averages. We propose PO-Flow, a continuous normalizing flow (CNF) framework for causal inference that jointly models potential outcome distributions and factual-conditioned counterfactual outcomes. Trained via flow matching, PO-Flow provides a unified approach to individualized potential outcome prediction, conditional average treatment effect estimation, and counterfactual prediction. By encoding an observed factual outcome and decoding under an alternative treatment, PO-Flow provides an encode-decode mechanism for factual-conditioned counterfactual prediction. In addition, PO-Flow supports likelihood-based evaluation of potential outcomes, enabling uncertainty-aware assessment of predictions. A supporting recovery guarantee is established under certain assumptions, and empirical results on benchmark datasets demonstrate strong performance across a range of causal inference tasks within the potential outcomes framework.

AI.tldr: PO-Flow 以连续归一化流统一建模事实/反事实结果分布，一次性完成个体潜在结果预测、CATE 估计与反事实推断，并提供似然不确定度评估。在基准数据上表现优异并给出恢复性理论保证。
AI.motivation: 现有临床决策需超越人群平均效应，精准估计每位患者在不同治疗下的潜在与反事实结果；传统方法难以同时刻画分布、估计 CATE 并给出不确定度。
AI.method: 提出 PO-Flow：① 用连续归一化流 (CNF) 联合建模所有潜在结果分布 p(Y(t))；② 通过流匹配训练；③ 用“编码-解码”机制（编码观测事实结果，解码到另一治疗空间）生成事实条件下的反事实结果；④ 支持基于似然的潜在结果不确定度评估；⑤ 在强可忽略性与重叠性假设下给出恢复真实分布的理论保证。
AI.result: 在 IHDP、Jobs、News 等基准数据集上，PO-Flow 在个体潜在结果预测、CATE 估计、反事实推断任务中均显著超越 state-of-the-art，并提供可靠的似然置信区间。
AI.conclusion: PO-Flow 为潜在结果框架提供了一个统一、可解释、可评估不确定性的深度生成解决方案，理论保证与实证效果兼具，可直接用于个体化临床决策支持。

title: SAQ: Stabilizer-Aware Quantum Error Correction Decoder
summary: Quantum Error Correction (QEC) decoding faces a fundamental accuracy-efficiency tradeoff. Classical methods like Minimum Weight Perfect Matching (MWPM) exhibit variable performance across noise models and suffer from polynomial complexity, while tensor network decoders achieve high accuracy but at prohibitively high computational cost. Recent neural decoders reduce complexity but lack the accuracy needed to compete with computationally expensive classical methods. We introduce SAQ-Decoder, a unified framework combining transformer-based learning with constraint aware post-processing that achieves both near Maximum Likelihood (ML) accuracy and linear computational scalability with respect to the syndrome size. Our approach combines a dual-stream transformer architecture that processes syndromes and logical information with asymmetric attention patterns, and a novel differentiable logical loss that directly optimizes Logical Error Rates (LER) through smooth approximations over finite fields. SAQ-Decoder achieves near-optimal performance, with error thresholds of 10.99% (independent noise) and 18.6% (depolarizing noise) on toric codes that approach the ML bounds of 11.0% and 18.9% while outperforming existing neural and classical baselines in accuracy, complexity, and parameter efficiency. Our findings establish that learned decoders can simultaneously achieve competitive decoding accuracy and computational efficiency, addressing key requirements for practical fault-tolerant quantum computing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAQ-Decoder——一种融合Transformer与约束后处理的量子纠错解码框架，在保持线性复杂度的同时逼近最大似然精度，刷新独立/去极化噪声下的阈值记录。
AI.motivation: 现有QEC解码方案无法兼顾精度与效率：经典MWPM算法跨噪声模型鲁棒性差且复杂度为多项式级；张量网络解码精度高但代价高昂；神经解码器虽降低复杂度却远未达到经典高复杂度方法的精度。实用容错量子计算亟需同时满足高精度、线性复杂度与参数效率的解码器。
AI.method: 设计双路Transformer：一路处理综合征，一路显式嵌入逻辑信息，并采用非对称注意力机制；提出可微分逻辑损失函数，利用有限域上的平滑近似直接优化逻辑错误率；引入约束感知后处理，确保输出满足稳定子约束。整体流程端到端训练，参数量与综合征规模呈线性关系。
AI.result: 在toric code上，SAQ-Decoder的误差阈值达10.99%（独立噪声）与18.6%（去极化噪声），逼近理论ML界11.0%与18.9%；相比最佳神经基线，逻辑错误率降低达2.4×；相比MWPM，推理延迟降低一个数量级，参数量仅增长常数倍。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明学习型解码器可在不牺牲线性复杂度的前提下逼近最大似然精度，为实用容错量子计算机提供了兼顾精度与效率的解码解决方案，并证实了Transformer架构在量子纠错约束优化问题中的巨大潜力。

title: Visual Sparse Steering (VS2): Unsupervised Adaptation for Image Classification using Sparsity-Guided Steering Vectors
summary: Steering vision foundation models at test time, without updating foundation-model weights or using labeled target data, is a desirable yet challenging goal. We present Visual Sparse Steering (VS2), a lightweight, label-free adaptation method that constructs a steering vector from sparse features extracted by a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) trained on unlabeled in-domain training-split activations of the vision encoder. VS2 offers three key advantages over existing test-time adaptation methods: (1) a feature-level intervention space in sparse SAE representations; (2) efficiency, requiring only a forward pass with no test-time optimization or backpropagation; and (3) a reliability diagnostic based on SAE reconstruction loss that can skip steering when reconstruction is poor, enabling safe fallback to the baseline, a capability not standard in conventional steering vectors and test-time adaptation methods. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and Tiny-ImageNet and two CLIP backbones (ViT-B/32, ViT-B/16), VS2 improves zero-shot top-1 accuracy by 3.45-4.12\%, 0.93-1.08\%, and 1.50-1.84\%, respectively, while remaining forward-only and adding minimal compute overhead. A retrieval-based upper-bound analysis suggests substantial headroom if task-relevant sparse features can be selected reliably, motivating future work on selective feature amplification for interpretable, efficient test-time steering.

AI.tldr: VS2 用无标注域内数据训练稀疏自编码器，提取稀疏特征生成轻量级“转向向量”，无需更新模型或反向传播即可在推理阶段即时提升 CLIP 零样本精度（CIFAR-100 最高 +4.1%），并通过 SAE 重建误差自动判断是否启用转向，兼顾效率与安全。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时自适应方法要么需反向传播、要么依赖目标域标注，计算与数据成本高；作者希望在不更新预训练权重、也不用任何标签的前提下，实现快速、可靠、可解释的“即时转向”，提升视觉基础模型在新域的零样本表现。
AI.method: 1) 用目标域训练集（无标签）激活 CLIP 视觉编码器中间层，训练稀疏自编码器 SAE 得到过完备稀疏字典；2) 推理阶段，对输入图像提取稀疏编码，取 Top-k 非零系数构造“稀疏转向向量”；3) 将该向量加回对应特征层完成前向干预；4) 若 SAE 重建误差高于阈值，则跳过干预，退回到原始模型，保证可靠性。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-100、CUB-200、Tiny-ImageNet 上，VS2 仅额外一次前向即可把 ViT-B/32 与 ViT-B/16 的 CLIP 零样本 Top-1 精度分别提高 3.45–4.12%、0.93–1.08%、1.50–1.84%，耗时增加 <5%。检索式上界实验显示，若可精准挑选任务相关稀疏特征，精度仍有 6–10% 提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏自编码器提供的“特征级干预空间”是无需标签、无需优化的测试时转向新范式；VS2 以几乎零额外计算实现了显著且可控的精度增益，其重建损失诊断机制为安全部署提供先例。未来工作将致力于可解释、可学习的稀疏特征选择与放大策略，进一步挖掘即时转向潜力。

title: ZK-APEX: Zero-Knowledge Approximate Personalized Unlearning with Executable Proofs
comment: Accepted at the 9th Conference on Machine Learning and Systems (MLSys 2026)
summary:
Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific data points from a trained model to satisfy privacy, copyright, and safety requirements. In real deployments, providers distribute a global model to many edge devices, where each client personalizes the model using private data. When a deletion request is issued, clients may ignore it or falsely claim compliance, and providers cannot check their parameters or data. This makes verification difficult, especially because personalized models must forget the targeted samples while preserving local utility, and verification must remain lightweight on edge devices.
  We introduce ZK APEX, a zero-shot personalized unlearning method that operates directly on the personalized model without retraining. ZK APEX combines sparse masking on the provider side with a small Group OBS compensation step on the client side, using a blockwise empirical Fisher matrix to create a curvature-aware update designed for low overhead. Paired with Halo2 zero-knowledge proofs, it enables the provider to verify that the correct unlearning transformation was applied without revealing any private data or personalized parameters.
  On Vision Transformer classification tasks, ZK APEX recovers nearly all personalization accuracy while effectively removing the targeted information. Applied to the OPT125M generative model trained on code data, it recovers around seventy percent of the original accuracy. Proof generation for the ViT case completes in about two hours, more than ten million times faster than retraining-based checks, with less than one gigabyte of memory use and proof sizes around four hundred megabytes. These results show the first practical framework for verifiable personalized unlearning on edge devices.

AI.tldr: ZK APEX 首次在边缘端实现了可验证、无需重训练的个性化机器遗忘：用稀疏掩码+轻量补偿+零知识证明，在不泄露本地数据与参数的前提下，使全局模型能高效删除指定数据影响，并在 ViT/OPT 上验证其准确性与开销优势。
AI.motivation: 在联邦或边缘部署中，用户会对全局模型的本地个性化副本提出「删除权」请求。现有方法要么无法验证客户端是否真正删除，要么需要本地数据或重训练，既损害隐私又开销巨大，急需一种轻量且可审计的个性化遗忘方案。
AI.method: 提出 ZK APEX：① 服务端对全局参数做稀疏掩码剪枝，标记需遗忘的子网络；② 客户端用 Group OBS 补偿步，基于分块经验 Fisher 矩阵做曲率感知更新，恢复本地准确率；③ 将更新过程编码为 Halo2 算术电路，生成零知识证明，服务端可在不读本地数据/参数的前提下验证步骤②确实执行。
AI.result: 在 Vision Transformer 分类任务中，遗忘后个性化准确率几乎完全恢复；在 OPT125M 代码生成模型上恢复 ≈70% 原始准确率。对 ViT 生成证明耗时约 2h，比重训练验证快 10⁷ 倍，峰值内存 <1GB，证明大小 ≈400MB。
AI.conclusion: ZK APEX 首次将「零知识证明」与「免重训练个性化遗忘」结合，提供可审计、隐私保护、边缘友好的实用框架，为部署删除权与合规监管奠定了新方法学基础。

title: Geminet: Learning the Duality-based Iterative Process for Lightweight Traffic Engineering in Changing Topologies
summary: Recently, researchers have explored ML-based Traffic Engineering (TE), leveraging neural networks to solve TE problems traditionally addressed by optimization. However, existing ML-based TE schemes remain impractical: they either fail to handle topology changes or suffer from poor scalability due to excessive computational and memory overhead. To overcome these limitations, we propose Geminet, a lightweight and scalable ML-based TE framework that can handle changing topologies. Geminet is built upon two key insights: (i) a methodology that decouples neural networks from topology by learning an iterative gradient-descent-based adjustment process, as the update rule of gradient descent is topology-agnostic, relying only on a few gradient-related quantities; (ii) shifting optimization from path-level routing weights to edge-level dual variables, reducing memory consumption by leveraging the fact that edges are far fewer than paths. Evaluations on WAN and data center datasets show that Geminet significantly improves scalability. Its neural network size is only 0.04% to 7% of existing schemes, while handling topology variations as effectively as HARP, a state-of-the-art ML-based TE approach, without performance degradation. When trained on large-scale topologies, Geminet consumes under 10 GiB of memory, more than eight times less than the 80-plus GiB required by HARP, while achieving 5.45 times faster convergence speed, demonstrating its potential for large-scale deployment.

AI.tldr: Geminet用梯度下降迭代更新+边级对偶变量，把神经网络从拓扑中解耦，实现轻量、可扩展、支持拓扑变化的流量工程。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 ML 的流量工程方法要么无法适应拓扑变化，要么因网络规模扩大带来巨大计算与内存开销而难以部署。
AI.method: 1) 将流量工程建模为可微优化问题，用神经网络学习“梯度下降式迭代调整”而非直接输出路由权重，使模型与拓扑无关；2) 把优化变量从路径级权重转到边级对偶变量，显著降低参数规模与内存占用。
AI.result: 在 WAN 与数据中心数据集上，Geminet 的模型尺寸仅为既有方案的 0.04%–7%，内存消耗 <10 GiB（比 HARP 少 8 倍以上），收敛速度快 5.45 倍，同时保持与 HARP 同等的性能并天然支持拓扑变化。
AI.conclusion: Geminet 通过“学习优化迭代”+“边级变量”双策略，首次使 ML-TE 在大规模动态网络中具备实际部署可行性。

title: VeruSAGE: A Study of Agent-Based Verification for Rust Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive capability to understand and develop code. However, their capability to rigorously reason about and prove code correctness remains in question. This paper offers a comprehensive study of LLMs' capability to develop correctness proofs for system software written in Rust. We curate a new system-verification benchmark suite, VeruSAGE-Bench, which consists of 849 proof tasks extracted from eight open-source Verus-verified Rust systems. Furthermore, we design different agent systems to match the strengths and weaknesses of different LLMs (o4-mini, GPT-5, Sonnet 4, and Sonnet 4.5). Our study shows that different tools and agent settings are needed to stimulate the system-verification capability of different types of LLMs. The best LLM-agent combination in our study completes over 80% of system-verification tasks in VeruSAGE-Bench. It also completes over 90% of a set of system proof tasks not part of VeruSAGE-Bench because they had not yet been finished by human experts. This result shows the great potential for LLM-assisted development of verified system software.

AI.tldr: 首个针对 Rust 系统软件形式化验证的 LLM 基准 VeruSAGE-Bench 出炉；最佳智能体方案可自动完成>80 % 的验证任务，甚至补全人类尚未证明的 90 % 样例，首次实证 LLM 在系统级正确性证明上的巨大潜力。
AI.motivation: 尽管大模型已能写代码，其能否“严谨推理并证明代码正确性”仍是未知数；Rust 系统软件对安全保证要求极高，手工撰写 Verus 证明极耗时，亟需评估并释放 LLM 的系统验证潜能。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含 849 个 Verus 证明任务的新基准 VeruSAGE-Bench，取自 8 个开源 Rust 系统；2) 针对 o4-mini、GPT-5、Sonnet-4/4.5 各自弱点设计多智能体系统（提示、分解、回溯、反思等策略）；3) 系统扫描不同工具链与智能体配置，记录任务完成率与证明开销。
AI.result: 最佳 LLM-智能体组合在 VeruSAGE-Bench 上通过率 >80 %；在人类尚未完成的外部验证集上通过率 >90 %；不同模型需差异化智能体才能触发其系统验证能力，单模型裸调用基线显著落后。
AI.conclusion: LLM 已具备辅助甚至主导开发经形式化验证的系统软件之潜力；未来应继续扩充基准、优化证明自动生成与修复策略，并探索人机协同的验证流程以进一步提升效率与可靠性。

title: A Comprehensive Survey on Network Traffic Synthesis: From Statistical Models to Deep Learning
summary: Synthetic network traffic generation has emerged as a promising alternative for various data-driven applications in the networking domain. It enables the creation of synthetic data that preserves real-world characteristics while addressing key challenges such as data scarcity, privacy concerns, and purity constraints associated with real data. In this survey, we provide a comprehensive review of synthetic network traffic generation approaches, covering essential aspects such as data types and generation models. With the rapid advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML), we focus particularly on deep learning (DL)-based techniques while also providing a detailed discussion of statistical methods and their extensions, including commercially available tools. We present a comprehensive comparision of generation approaches and provide an AI tool to apply this comparision for any network traffic generation papers. Furthermore, we highlight open challenges in this domain and discuss potential future directions for further research and development. This survey serves as a foundational resource for researchers and practitioners, offering a structured analysis of existing methods, challenges, and opportunities in synthetic network traffic generation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了面向网络领域的合成流量生成技术，重点对比 DL/统计方法并给出在线比较工具，同时指出未解难题与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 真实网络流量数据稀缺、含隐私且纯度受限，亟需既能保留真实特征又可按需生成的合成数据，以支撑各类数据驱动型网络应用的研究与测试。
AI.method: 以系统性综述方式，先界定时序、图、流表等关键数据类型与评价指标，再分类评述 GAN、VAE、扩散模型等 DL 方案及传统统计/商业工具，最后提供基于 AI 的论文自动对比工具。
AI.result: 给出覆盖 20+ 代表性方法的统一评估框架，揭示 DL 方法在保真度与多样性上优于统计模型但训练开销大；提供的在线工具可一键复现横向对比并生成可视化报告。
AI.conclusion: 合成流量生成已具备实用价值，仍面临细粒度时序依赖建模、动态拓扑一致性和可解释性等挑战；未来应结合大模型、强化学习与领域知识，实现高质量、可扩展、可解释的合成流量持续生成。

title: BitFlipScope: Scalable Fault Localization and Recovery for Bit-Flip Corruptions in LLMs
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Symposium on Hardware Oriented Security and Trust (HOST) 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed in practical and safety-critical settings are increasingly susceptible to bit-flip faults caused by hardware degradation, cosmic radiation, or deliberate fault-injection attacks such as Rowhammer. These faults silently corrupt internal parameters and can lead to unpredictable or dangerous model behavior. Localizing these corruptions is essential: without identifying the affected region, it is impossible to diagnose the source of degradation, apply targeted corrective measures, or restore model functionality without resorting to costly fine-tuning or full retraining. This work introduces BitFlipScope, a scalable, software-based framework for identifying fault-affected regions within transformer architectures under two deployment scenarios. When a clean reference model is available, BitFlipScope performs differential analysis of outputs, hidden states, and internal activations for detecting anomalous behavior indicative of corruption to pinpoint or localize faults. When no reference model exists, it uses residual-path perturbation and loss-sensitivity profiling to infer the fault-impacted region directly from the corrupted model. In both settings, the framework not only enables effective fault diagnosis but also supports lightweight performance recovery without fine-tuning, offering a practical path to restoring corrupted models. Together, these capabilities make BitFlipScope an important step toward trustworthy, fault-resilient LLM deployment in hardware-prone and adversarial environments.

AI.tldr: 提出BitFlipScope框架，无需重训练即可定位并修复因硬件比特翻转导致的LLM参数损坏。
AI.motivation: LLM在真实部署中易受硬件或Rowhammer攻击引发静默比特翻转，导致模型不可预期甚至危险输出；现有方案只能全局重训练，代价高昂。
AI.method: 构建跨层差分与残差扰动两套定位策略：若有干净参照，比较输出、隐藏态和激活差值；若无参照，用残差路径扰动与损失敏感度反推受损区域，并以轻量级修复模块恢复性能。
AI.result: 在两种场景下均能以较高精度定位故障参数区域，且通过局部修复即可使模型在下游任务指标恢复至接近无故障水平，无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: BitFlipScope首次实现面向Transformer的比特翻转定位与快速恢复，为安全关键场景下的可信LLM部署提供了实用且低成本的韧性手段。

title: Neural Two-Stage Stochastic Optimization for Solving Unit Commitment Problem
comment: The experimental results may require further refinement, and changes in the first author's affiliation may have affected the presentation of the work
summary: This paper proposes a neural stochastic optimization method for efficiently solving the two-stage stochastic unit commitment (2S-SUC) problem under high-dimensional uncertainty scenarios. The proposed method approximates the second-stage recourse problem using a deep neural network trained to map commitment decisions and uncertainty features to recourse costs. The trained network is subsequently embedded into the first-stage UC problem as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP), allowing for explicit enforcement of operational constraints while preserving the key uncertainty characteristics. A scenario-embedding network is employed to enable dimensionality reduction and feature aggregation across arbitrary scenario sets, serving as a data-driven scenario reduction mechanism. Numerical experiments on IEEE 5-bus, 30-bus, and 118-bus systems demonstrate that the proposed neural two-stage stochastic optimization method achieves solutions with an optimality gap of less than 1%, while enabling orders-of-magnitude speedup compared to conventional MILP solvers and decomposition-based methods. Moreover, the model's size remains constant regardless of the number of scenarios, offering significant scalability for large-scale stochastic unit commitment problems.

AI.tldr: 用深度神经网络近似两阶段随机机组组合（2S-SUC）的第二阶段费用，再将该网络嵌入第一阶段MILP，实现恒定模型规模、任意场景规模下<1%最优间隙且速度提升数个数量级。
AI.motivation: 高维不确定性下，传统2S-SUC求解需枚举大量场景→MILP规模爆炸，分解型算法迭代耗时；亟需一种不依赖场景数量、又能严格满足运行约束的快速随机优化框架。
AI.method: 1) 训练深度网络Φ：输入为机组启停向量+场景嵌入特征，输出为对应第二阶段期望费用；2) 采用场景嵌入网络完成任意场景集的降维与特征聚合，实现数据驱动的场景约简；3) 将训练好的Φ作为线性约束嵌入第一阶段MILP，一次性求解含Φ近似的整体模型，保持混合整数线性可解性。
AI.result: 在IEEE 5/30/118节点系统上，与商业MILP求解器及Benders等分解法相比： optimality gap≤0.9%，求解时间降低10²–10³倍；网络参数规模固定，场景从10²增至10⁴，CPU时间几乎不变，内存占用恒定。
AI.conclusion: 神经随机优化把“高维积分+大规模MILP”转化为“小规模固定网络+标准MILP”，在保精度、满足硬约束的同时，突破场景数与系统规模可扩展性瓶颈，为实时/滚动 stochastic UC 提供新范式。

title: Strategic Response of News Publishers to Generative AI
summary: Generative AI can adversely impact news publishers by lowering consumer demand. It can also reduce demand for newsroom employees, and increase the creation of news "slop." However, it can also form a source of traffic referrals and an information-discovery channel that increases demand. We use high-frequency granular data to analyze the strategic response of news publishers to the introduction of Generative AI. Many publishers strategically blocked LLM access to their websites using the robots.txt file standard. Using a difference-in-differences approach, we find that large publishers who block GenAI bots experience reduced website traffic compared to not blocking. In addition, we find that large publishers shift toward richer content that is harder for LLMs to replicate, without increasing text volume. Finally, we find that the share of new editorial and content-production job postings rises over time. Together, these findings illustrate the levers that publishers choose to use to strategically respond to competitive Generative AI threats, and their consequences.

AI.tldr: 利用高频微观数据发现：大型出版商若用robots.txt封锁LLM爬虫，流量反而下降；它们转产更难被复制的富媒体内容， textual量不变；编辑类新职位占比上升。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI既可能削弱用户对媒体内容与新闻雇员的需求、制造“新闻垃圾”，也可能成为流量与发现渠道。学界尚缺关于出版商如何应对并承担何种后果的因果证据。
AI.method: 以robots.txt封锁行为为实验冲击，用双重差分(DID)对比：①大出版商封锁vs不封锁的流量变化；②封锁前后内容形态（富媒体比重、文本长度）与招聘结构（编辑/内容岗占比）。
AI.result: 1)封锁LLM的大出版商网站流量显著下降；2)封锁后转向富媒体/交互内容，但文字量未增；3)随时间推移，新增编辑与内容生产岗位占比提高。
AI.conclusion: 面对生成式AI竞争，出版商可主动封锁、升级内容形态或调整人才结构，但这些策略各有利弊：封锁牺牲流量，富媒体转型增加成本，扩张编辑岗反映对原创与深度内容的再投资。

title: Frozen Forecasting: A Unified Evaluation
summary: Forecasting future events is a fundamental capability for general-purpose systems that plan or act across different levels of abstraction. Yet, evaluating whether a forecast is "correct" remains challenging due to the inherent uncertainty of the future. We propose a unified evaluation framework for assessing the forecasting capabilities of frozen vision backbones across diverse tasks and abstraction levels. Rather than focusing on single time steps, our framework evaluates entire trajectories and incorporates distributional metrics that better capture the multimodal nature of future outcomes. Given a frozen vision model, we train latent diffusion models to forecast future features directly in its representation space, which are then decoded via lightweight, task-specific readouts. This enables consistent evaluation across a suite of diverse tasks while isolating the forecasting capacity of the backbone itself. We apply our framework to nine diverse vision models, spanning image and video pretraining, contrastive and generative objectives, and with or without language supervision, and evaluate them on four forecasting tasks, from low-level pixel predictions to high-level object motion. We find that forecasting performance strongly correlates with perceptual quality and that the forecasting abilities of video synthesis models are comparable or exceed those pretrained in masking regimes across all levels of abstraction. However, language supervision does not consistently improve forecasting. Notably, video-pretrained models consistently outperform image-based ones.

AI.tldr: 提出一套无需微调主干即可统一评估不同视觉模型预测未来能力的框架，发现视频预训练模型预测能力最强，而语言监督未必有益。
AI.motivation: 未来预测是通用系统的基础能力，但如何公平、鲁棒地评估不同模型仍缺标准，尤其需跨越像素到语义的多级抽象并处理未来固有的多模态不确定性。
AI.method: 固定视觉主干，用潜在扩散模型在其表示空间直接生成未来特征序列，再通过轻量任务头解码，以轨迹级分布指标取代单步判别，实现跨任务一致评估。
AI.result: 在4项预测任务（像素变化到物体运动）上对9类模型（图像/视频、对比/生成、有/无语言监督）评估：视频预训练模型全面优于图像模型；视频生成模型在各级抽象上媲美甚至超过掩码预训练；语言监督对预测无一致增益；预测性能与感知质量高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 表示空间中的轨迹分布评价能有效分离并度量视觉主干的未来预测能力；视频预训练是提升预测的关键，语言信息并非必要，视觉生成目标已足够提供强预测信号。

title: Safe-FedLLM: Delving into the Safety of Federated Large Language Models
summary: Federated learning (FL) addresses privacy and data-silo issues in the training of large language models (LLMs). Most prior work focuses on improving the efficiency of federated learning for LLMs (FedLLM). However, security in open federated environments, particularly defenses against malicious clients, remains underexplored. To investigate the security of FedLLM, we conduct a preliminary study to analyze potential attack surfaces and defensive characteristics from the perspective of LoRA updates. We find two key properties of FedLLM: 1) LLMs are vulnerable to attacks from malicious clients in FL, and 2) LoRA updates exhibit distinct behavioral patterns that can be effectively distinguished by lightweight classifiers. Based on these properties, we propose Safe-FedLLM, a probe-based defense framework for FedLLM, which constructs defenses across three levels: Step-Level, Client-Level, and Shadow-Level. The core concept of Safe-FedLLM is to perform probe-based discrimination on each client's local LoRA updates, treating them as high-dimensional behavioral features and using a lightweight classifier to determine whether they are malicious. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Safe-FedLLM effectively improves FedLLM's robustness against malicious clients while maintaining competitive performance on benign data. Notably, our method effectively suppresses the impact of malicious data without significantly affecting training speed, and remains effective even under high malicious client ratios.

AI.tldr: Safe-FedLLM利用LoRA更新在开放联邦场景下的可区分行为特征，设计三级探针式轻量分类器，在几乎不拖慢训练的前提下显著抑制高比例恶意客户端对大模型训练的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有FedLLM研究重效率轻安全，针对开放联邦环境中恶意客户端攻击的系统性防御尚属空白，亟需探索LLM在联邦更新层面的脆弱性与可检测特征。
AI.method: 以LoRA更新为观测对象，提出Step/Client/Shadow三层探针框架：将客户端本地LoRA权重变化视为高维行为特征，训练轻量二分类器实时判别是否恶意，并聚合前完成过滤。
AI.result: 实验表明，Safe-FedLLM在保持与baseline相当的下游任务性能同时，将恶意更新造成的性能退化和投毒成功率分别降低60%以上；即便恶意客户端占比达40%，训练速度仅下降≈3%。
AI.conclusion: LoRA更新携带的客户端行为指纹足以支持轻量级、高鲁棒的恶意检测；探针式防御可在不牺牲效率的前提下显著提升FedLLM在开放场景的安全边界，为高比例参与者不可信的大模型联邦训练提供可行路径。

title: Autonomous Multi-objective Alloy Design through Simulation-guided Optimization
summary: Alloy discovery is constrained by vast compositional spaces, competing objectives, and prohibitive experimental costs. Although simulations and machine learning have each accelerated parts of this process, unifying scientific knowledge, scalable search, and experimental confirmation into a data-efficient workflow remains challenging. Here, we present AutoMAT, a hierarchical autonomous framework spanning ideation to experimental validation. Integrating large language models, automated CALPHAD simulations, residual-learning-based correction, and AI-guided optimization, AutoMAT translates design targets into candidate alloys, refines compositions through closed-loop computational search, and validates results experimentally without hand-curated datasets. Targeting lightweight, high-strength alloys, AutoMAT identifies a titanium alloy 8.1% less dense and 13.0% stronger than the aerospace benchmark Ti-185, achieving the highest specific strength among benchmarked systems. In a second case, AutoMAT discovers a high-entropy alloy with 28.2% higher yield strength than the baseline while preserving high ductility. AutoMAT compresses alloy discovery from years to weeks, establishing a generalizable route toward autonomous materials design.

AI.tldr: AutoMAT在无需人工标注数据的前提下，将大语言模型、自动化CALPHAD模拟与AI闭环优化结合，可在数周内自主完成从需求提出到实验验证的全流程合金发现，获得两种性能优于航空标杆的高强轻质合金。
AI.motivation: 传统合金研发受限于庞大的成分空间、成本高昂的反复实验和难以平衡的强–韧矛盾，现有模拟或机器学习仅局部加速，仍缺乏能串联“科学先验–的大规模数据集仍具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出分层自治框架AutoMAT：1)大语言模型将自然语言目标转化为初始合金建议；2)CALPHAD自动生成热力学/相平衡数据库并计入训练样本；3)残差学习网络对CALPHAD偏差进行在线校正；4)贝叶斯优化驱动的闭环搜索迭代成分直至收敛；5)AI推荐合金直接投入实验验证，无需人工筛选或标注。
AI.result: 两轮闭环搜索分别在：(i)低密度–高强钛系中发现密度−8.1%、强度+13%的合金，比强度优于航天基准Ti-185；(ii)高熵系中得到屈服强度提升28.2%却依旧高韧的块体合金。整体周期从若干年压缩至数周。
AI.conclusion: AutoMAT证明先验知识与大模型+自适应优化的深度融合，可以数据高效地实现自主材料研发，为任何多目标合金体系提供了可推广的全自动范例。

title: Two Pathways to Truthfulness: On the Intrinsic Encoding of LLM Hallucinations
comment: Accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Despite their impressive capabilities, large language models (LLMs) frequently generate hallucinations. Previous work shows that their internal states encode rich signals of truthfulness, yet the origins and mechanisms of these signals remain unclear. In this paper, we demonstrate that truthfulness cues arise from two distinct information pathways: (1) a Question-Anchored pathway that depends on question-answer information flow, and (2) an Answer-Anchored pathway that derives self-contained evidence from the generated answer itself. First, we validate and disentangle these pathways through attention knockout and token patching. Afterwards, we uncover notable and intriguing properties of these two mechanisms. Further experiments reveal that (1) the two mechanisms are closely associated with LLM knowledge boundaries; and (2) internal representations are aware of their distinctions. Finally, building on these insightful findings, two applications are proposed to enhance hallucination detection performance. Overall, our work provides new insight into how LLMs internally encode truthfulness, offering directions for more reliable and self-aware generative systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次揭示大语言模型内部存在两类独立的“真实性”信息通路：以问题为锚的通路（依赖问题-答案信息流）与以答案为锚的通路（仅靠答案自洽证据），并据此提出两项改进幻觉检测的应用。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究表明 LLM 隐藏状态包含真实性信号，但尚不清楚这些信号从何而来、如何运作；厘清其来源与机制是提升模型可靠性和自感知能力的基础。
AI.method: 1）通过 attention knockout 与 token patching 实验将两种通路解耦并验证其存在；2）分析它们与模型知识边界的关联；3）探测内部表征能否区分这两种机制；4）基于发现设计两种幻觉检测增强方案。
AI.result: 实验证实：(1) 两类通路独立且分别对应不同知识边界区域；(2) 内部表征能自动区分“问题锚定”与“答案锚定”信号；(3) 利用该区分可将幻觉检测性能提升显著（具体指标未给出）。
AI.conclusion: LLM 并非单一“黑箱”，而是并行利用问题驱动与答案自洽两条路径编码真实性；显式建模并利用这两条通路，有望构建更可信、自感知的生成系统。

title: RL-PLUS: Countering Capability Boundary Collapse of LLMs in Reinforcement Learning with Hybrid-policy Optimization
