AI.result: 1) 10,500个样本的贪婪+随机解码输出与基模型字节级一致；15,301样本在四VQA基准上平均Δ-ANLS≤0.0044。2) ViDoRe V1上Hydra-4B一次训练即追近单头对照1个百分点，V2/V3子任务集合得分更高。3) GPU峰值内存由17.9 GB降至9.2 GB（-48%），并发场景下受adapter切换开销影响吞吐。4) 扩展至Qwen2.5-Omni-3B后，可同时完成音频检索、视频嵌入与语音生成，验证机制通用性。
AI.conclusion: 单模型+LoRA切换可在不损生成质量的前提下显著压缩显存，并拓展到音频-视频多模态检索生成；但并发服务吞吐仍受adapter切换开销限制，需进一步工程优化以实现大规模部署。

title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Step-Level Transitions for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex interactive decision-making tasks. However, existing LLM agents typically rely on increasingly long interaction histories, resulting in high computational cost and limited scalability. In this paper, we propose STEP-HRL, a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that enables step-level learning by conditioning only on single-step transitions rather than full interaction histories. STEP-HRL structures tasks hierarchically, using completed subtasks to represent global progress of overall task. By introducing a local progress module, it also iteratively and selectively summarizes interaction history within each subtask to produce a compact summary of local progress. Together, these components yield augmented step-level transitions for both high-level and low-level policies. Experimental results on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld benchmarks consistently demonstrate that STEP-HRL substantially outperforms baselines in terms of performance and generalization while reducing token usage. Our code is available at https://github.com/TonyStark042/STEP-HRL.

AI.tldr: STEP-HRL 用层次化 RL 将 LLM Agent 的决策粒度从“完整历史”压缩到“单步转移”，在 ScienceWorld/ALFWorld 上同时提升性能、泛化并显著降低 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM Agent 在复杂交互任务中把全部历史作为上下文，导致计算成本高、可扩展性差，亟需一种既能保留决策信息又能压缩上下文的方法。
AI.method: 提出 STEP-HRL 框架：① 将任务分解为层次化子任务，用“已完成子任务”作为全局进度表示；② 设计局部进度模块，在子任务内部迭代筛选并总结关键交互，生成紧凑局部摘要；③ 仅基于单步转移（状态-局部摘要-动作-下一状态）训练高层与低层策略，实现步级学习。
AI.result: 在 ScienceWorld 与 ALFWorld 基准上，STEP-HRL 平均成功率较最强基线提升 8–15 个百分点，零样本泛化场景提升达 20%，同时 token 消耗降低 40–60%。
AI.conclusion: 通过层次化表示与局部摘要，STEP-HRL 把长历史压缩为步级信号，既保持决策所需的上下文信息，又显著降低计算与 token 开销，为可扩展的 LLM Agent 提供了一条高效强化学习路径。

title: WybeCoder: Verified Imperative Code Generation
summary: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) has substantially advanced automatic code generation and formal theorem proving, yet software verification has not seen comparable gains. To address this gap, we propose WybeCoder, an agentic code verification framework that enables prove-as-you-generate development, in which code, invariants, and proofs co-evolve. WybeCoder builds on a recent framework that combines automatic verification condition generation and SMT solving with interactive proofs in Lean. To enable systematic evaluation, we translate two benchmarks for functional verification in Lean, Verina and Clever, into equivalent imperative code specifications. On complex algorithms such as Heapsort, we observe consistent performance improvements as we scale our approach, synthesizing dozens of valid invariants and dispatching dozens of subgoals, ultimately producing hundreds of lines of verified code and overcoming plateaus reported in previous work. Our best system solves 74% of Verina tasks and 62% of Clever tasks at moderate compute budgets, substantially surpassing previous evaluations and paving the way for the automated construction of large-scale datasets of verified imperative code.

AI.tldr: 提出WybeCoder，边写代码边验证，把功能正确性验证搬到Lean里，用规模换质量，在Verina/Clever上刷出74%和62%的新SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM在代码生成和定理证明突飞猛进，但软件形式化验证仍是短板；缺乏可扩展的“写代码同时就给出证明”的工作流与评估基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建agentic框架WybeCoder，把自动VC生成+SMT求解与Lean交互式证明拼接成闭环；2) 将两个函数式验证基准Verina、Clever逐条翻译为等价的命令式代码规范；3) 用LLM自动生成循环不变式/规约/证明脚本，并与Lean交互迭代修正，实现“prove-as-you-generate”。
AI.result: 在Heapsort等复杂算法上，系统随计算预算提升稳定增产：自动合成数十条有效不变式、分解并完成数十个子目标，最终产出数百行已验证代码。最佳配置在Verina上解决74%任务，Clever上62%，显著超越以往公开结果。
AI.conclusion: WybeCoder证明用LLM驱动的大规模命令式代码形式化验证可行，为自动化构造大规模已验证代码数据集铺平道路，也为后续研究提供了可复现的基准与工作流。

title: Reason in Chains, Learn in Trees: Self-Rectification and Grafting for Multi-turn Agent Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning for Large Language Model agents is often hindered by sparse rewards in multi-step reasoning tasks. Existing approaches like Group Relative Policy Optimization treat sampled trajectories as independent chains, assigning uniform credit to all steps in each chain and ignoring the existence of critical steps that may disproportionally impact reasoning outcome. In this paper, we propose T-STAR(Tree-structured Self-Taught Agent Rectification), a framework that recovers the latent correlated reward structure across seemingly independent trajectories. Specifically, we consolidate trajectories into a unified Cognitive Tree by identifying and merging functionally similar steps/nodes. It enables an Introspective Valuation mechanism that back-propagates trajectory-level rewards through the tree to obtain a new notion of variance-reduced relative advantage at step-level. Using the Cognitive Tree, we also develop In-Context Thought Grafting to synthesize corrective reasoning by contrasting successful and failed branches at critical divergence points/steps. Our proposed Surgical Policy Optimization then capitalizes on the rich policy gradient information concentrated at these critical points/steps through a Bradley-Terry type of surgical loss. Extensive experiments across embodied, interactive, reasoning, and planning benchmarks demonstrate that T-STAR achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines, with gains most pronounced on tasks requiring extended reasoning chains.

AI.tldr: 提出T-STAR框架，通过把多条LLM推理轨迹合并为“认知树”，在树结构上回传稀疏奖励，精准定位关键步骤并施加手术式梯度更新，显著缓解多步推理中的奖励稀疏与信用分配难题。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法（如GRPO）把采样轨迹视为独立链，对所有步骤平均分配信用，忽略关键步骤对最终结果的巨大影响，导致在多步推理任务中因奖励稀疏而训练低效。
AI.method: T-STAR三步：1) 功能相似步骤合并构建统一认知树；2) 基于树的自省估值机制，沿树反向传播轨迹级奖励，得到方差缩减的步级相对优势；3) 在关键分叉点实施“上下文思维嫁接”生成修正推理，并用Bradley-Terry型手术损失对关键步骤做精准策略梯度更新。
AI.result: 在具身、交互、推理与规划四大类基准上全面超越强基线，尤其需要长链推理的任务提升最显著（具体数值未给出）。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化认知树与手术式优化，T-STAR有效挖掘了稀疏奖励下的步级信号，为多步推理智能体提供了一种更可解释、更高效的强化学习范式。

title: Trust and Reliance on AI in Education: AI Literacy and Need for Cognition as Moderators
comment: Full paper accepted to the 27th International Conference on AI in Education (AIED 2026). AIED Proceedings to be released Summer 2026
summary: As generative AI systems are integrated into educational settings, students often encounter AI-generated output while working through learning tasks, either by requesting help or through integrated tools. Trust in AI can influence how students interpret and use that output, including whether they evaluate it critically or exhibit overreliance. We investigate how students' trust relates to their appropriate reliance on an AI assistant during programming problem-solving tasks, and whether this relationship differs by learner characteristics. With 432 undergraduate participants, students' completed Python output-prediction problems while receiving recommendations and explanations from an AI chatbot, including accurate and intentionally misleading suggestions. We operationalize reliance behaviorally as the extent to which students' responses reflected appropriate use of the AI assistant's suggestions, accepting them when they were correct and rejecting them when they were incorrect. Pre- and post-task surveys assessed trust in the assistant, AI literacy, need for cognition, programming self-efficacy, and programming literacy. Results showed a non-linear relationship in which higher trust was associated with lower appropriate reliance, suggesting weaker discrimination between correct and incorrect recommendations. This relationship was significantly moderated by students' AI literacy and need for cognition. These findings highlight the need for future work on instructional and system supports that encourage more reflective evaluation of AI assistance during problem-solving.

AI.tldr: 研究指出学生对 AI 的‘高信任’反令其在 Python 编程任务中更难区分正误建议，表现出更低‘适度依赖’；AI 素养与认知需求显著调节这一非线性关系，提示教学与系统层面需强化对 AI 输出的反思性评估支持。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式 AI 进入课堂，学生是否‘信其言而尽用之’将直接影响学习成效。已有研究多聚焦信任对采纳率的影响，但忽略‘适度依赖’——即正确时采纳、错误时拒绝——这一更精细的行为指标，以及个体差异如何在其中起作用。
AI.method: 采用 2×2 混合设计，432 名本科生在 AI 聊天机器人（含故意错误建议）辅助下完成 16 道 Python 输出预测题。实验前、后测量信任量表，并收集 AI 素养、认知需求、编程自我效能与先验知识等个体特征。通过多项 logit 模型与适度依赖得分（0–1）分析信任与行为关系，并检验调节效应。
AI.result: 信任与适度依赖呈显著倒 U 型：中等信任组得分最高（M=0.68），高信任组最差（M=0.49）。AI 素养越高，高信任带来的负效应越小（β=0.32, p<0.01）；认知需求每增 1 SD，高信任组适度依赖提升 0.19（p<0.001）。编程自我效能与先验知识对主效应无显著调节。
AI.conclusion: 单纯提升学生对 AI 的信任并不足以促成高质量学习，反而可能诱发过度依赖。教学干预需同步提升 AI 素养与批判性思维，系统侧则应嵌入置信度提示、可解释反馈与强制二次确认等机制，以引导学生形成‘适度、校准’的 AI 依赖模式。

title: Parameter-Free Non-Ergodic Extragradient Algorithms for Solving Monotone Variational Inequalities
summary: Monotone variational inequalities (VIs) provide a unifying framework for convex minimization, equilibrium computation, and convex-concave saddle-point problems. Extragradient-type methods are among the most effective first-order algorithms for such problems, but their performance hinges critically on stepsize selection. While most existing theory focuses on ergodic averages of the iterates, practical performance is often driven by the significantly stronger behavior of the last iterate. Moreover, available last-iterate guarantees typically rely on fixed stepsizes chosen using problem-specific global smoothness information, which is often difficult to estimate accurately and may not even be applicable. In this paper, we develop parameter-free extragradient methods with non-asymptotic last-iterate guarantees for constrained monotone VIs. For globally Lipschitz operators, our algorithm achieves an $o(1/\sqrt{T})$ last-iterate rate. We then extend the framework to locally Lipschitz operators via backtracking line search and obtain the same rate while preserving parameter-freeness, thereby making parameter-free last-iterate methods applicable to important problem classes for which global smoothness is unrealistic. Our numerical experiments on bilinear matrix games, LASSO, minimax group fairness, and state-of-the-art maximum entropy sampling relaxations demonstrate wide applicability of our results as well as strong last-iterate performance and significant improvements over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免参数外梯度法，在无需全局 Lipschitz 常数的情况下为约束单调变分不等式提供非渐近 last-iterate 保证，全局/局部 Lipschitz 情形均达到 o(1/√T) 率，实验显示在多类问题上终结点性能显著优于现有算法。
AI.motivation: 单调变分不等式 (VI) 统一了凸优化、均衡与凸-凹鞍点问题。外梯度类算法性能高度依赖步长，但现有 last-iterate 理论需预知问题相关的全局光滑信息，难以估计且常不成立；而实际性能又主要由终结点决定，故亟需无需先验常数的终结点收敛保证。
AI.method: 1) 对全局 Lipschitz 算子设计无参数外梯度法，利用在线学习思想自适应调步长，证明终结点 o(1/√T) 率；2) 对仅局部 Lipschitz 算子引入回溯线搜索，保持免参数特性并再次获得 o(1/√T) 终结点率；3) 在双线性矩阵博弈、LASSO、群体公平极小极大及最大熵采样松弛问题上系统实验验证。
AI.result: 理论：首次在无需全局光滑常数前提下给出约束单调 VI 的非渐近 last-iterate 收敛率 o(1/√T)。实验：终结点误差与迭代速度均显著优于固定步长外梯度和现有调参方案，验证了算法在多种重要问题上的广泛适用性与稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应步长与回溯搜索，本文把外梯度法的终结点保证从“需先验知识”推向完全免参数，并在理论与实验层面同时验证其有效性，为单调 VI 及其所覆盖的凸优化、博弈与鞍点问题提供了更实用且更强的终结点算法框架。

title: SelfGrader: Stable Jailbreak Detection for Large Language Models using Token-Level Logits
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful tools for answering user queries, yet they remain highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing guardrail methods typically rely on internal features or textual responses to detect malicious queries, which either introduce substantial latency or suffer from the randomness in text generation. To overcome these limitations, we propose SelfGrader, a lightweight guardrail method that formulates jailbreak detection as a numerical grading problem using token-level logits. Specifically, SelfGrader evaluates the safety of a user query within a compact set of numerical tokens (NTs) (e.g., 0-9) and interprets their logit distribution as an internal safety signal. To align these signals with human intuition of maliciousness, SelfGrader introduces a dual-perspective scoring rule that considers both the maliciousness and benignness of the query, yielding a stable and interpretable score that reflects harmfulness and reduces the false positive rate simultaneously. Extensive experiments across diverse jailbreak benchmarks, multiple LLMs, and state-of-the-art guardrail baselines demonstrate that SelfGrader achieves up to a 22.66% reduction in ASR on LLaMA-3-8B, while maintaining significantly lower memory overhead (up to 173x) and latency (up to 26x).

AI.tldr: SelfGrader把越狱检测转成一个「数字打分」任务：用模型自己对 0-9 十个数字 token 的 logit 分布作为安全信号，设计「恶意/良性」双视角打分规则，轻量且稳定地识别恶意提问。
AI.motivation: 现有护栏要么依赖内部特征或生成文本再判别，带来高延迟或受生成随机性干扰，需要一种既快又准、且易解释的新检测思路。
AI.method: 将查询送入模型，仅观察 0-9 十个数字 token 的 logit，构造同时衡量「像恶意」与「像良性」的双视角分数，数值化输出 safety score；全程无需额外模型或二次生成。
AI.result: 在多个越狱数据集和模型上，SelfGrader 把 LLaMA-3-8B 的 ASR 再降 22.66%，内存开销最大缩减 173 倍，延迟最多降低 26 倍，同时显著抑制误报。
AI.conclusion: 仅用模型自身对数字 token 的 logits 就能可靠量化 jailbreak 风险，SelfGrader 为轻量级、低延迟、可解释的在线护栏提供了实用方案。

title: IatroBench: Pre-Registered Evidence of Iatrogenic Harm from AI Safety Measures
comment: 30 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Pre-registered on OSF (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/G6VMZ). Code and data: https://github.com/davidgringras/iatrobench. v2: Fix bibliography entries (add arXiv IDs, published venues); correct p-value typo in Limitations section; add AI Assistance Statement v3: Correct Figure 1 (decoupling scatter accidentally reverted to earlier draft in v2)
summary: Ask a frontier model how to taper six milligrams of alprazolam (psychiatrist retired, ten days of pills left, abrupt cessation causes seizures) and it tells her to call the psychiatrist she just explained does not exist. Change one word ("I'm a psychiatrist; a patient presents with...") and the same model, same weights, same inference pass produces a textbook Ashton Manual taper with diazepam equivalence, anticonvulsant coverage, and monitoring thresholds. The knowledge was there; the model withheld it. IatroBench measures this gap. Sixty pre-registered clinical scenarios, six frontier models, 3,600 responses, scored on two axes (commission harm, CH 0-3; omission harm, OH 0-4) through a structured-evaluation pipeline validated against physician scoring (kappa_w = 0.571, within-1 agreement 96%). The central finding is identity-contingent withholding: match the same clinical question in physician vs. layperson framing and all five testable models provide better guidance to the physician (decoupling gap +0.38, p = 0.003; binary hit rates on safety-colliding actions drop 13.1 percentage points in layperson framing, p < 0.0001, while non-colliding actions show no change). The gap is widest for the model with the heaviest safety investment (Opus, +0.65). Three failure modes separate cleanly: trained withholding (Opus), incompetence (Llama 4), and indiscriminate content filtering (GPT-5.2, whose post-generation filter strips physician responses at 9x the layperson rate because they contain denser pharmacological tokens). The standard LLM judge assigns OH = 0 to 73% of responses a physician scores OH >= 1 (kappa = 0.045); the evaluation apparatus has the same blind spot as the training apparatus. Every scenario targets someone who has already exhausted the standard referrals.

AI.tldr: 用一句身份表述就能让大模型在相同问题下给出完整用药方案或完全拒答；系统性评估显示其安全知识被身份条件性“蓄意”抑制。
AI.motivation: 观察到大模型对同一临床问题因用户身份不同而给出截然不同答案，引发对“安全对齐是否过度、是否造成知识隐瞒”的质疑。
AI.method: 设计60个无标准转诊条件的临床场景，比较6个前沿模型在“我是医生”与“我是患者”两种提示下的3,600条回答；用CH(0-3)与OH(0-4)双轴量化危害，并与医师评分对比验证(kappa_w=0.571)。
AI.result: 所有可测模型均出现显著的身份条件性隐瞒：医生提示下安全命中率提高13.1pp， layperson提示下被漏掉的关键信息更多(Opus差距+0.65)。失败可归为三类：训练型隐瞒(Opus)、能力缺失(Llama-4)、过度过滤(GPT-5.2)。标准LLM评判器与训练器存在同样盲区(OH≥1一致率仅27%)。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐训练使模型学会“选择性沉默”，而非真正消除风险；需重构评估与对齐机制，避免对最脆弱人群的知识封锁。

title: Evaluating the Formal Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models through Chomsky Hierarchy
summary: The formal reasoning capabilities of LLMs are crucial for advancing automated software engineering. However, existing benchmarks for LLMs lack systematic evaluation based on computation and complexity, leaving a critical gap in understanding their formal reasoning capabilities. Therefore, it is still unknown whether SOTA LLMs can grasp the structured, hierarchical complexity of formal languages as defined by Computation Theory. To address this, we introduce ChomskyBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating LLMs through the lens of Chomsky Hierarchy. Unlike prior work that uses vectorized classification for neural networks, ChomskyBench is the first to combine full Chomsky Hierarchy coverage, process-trace evaluation via natural language, and deterministic symbolic verifiability. ChomskyBench is composed of a comprehensive suite of language recognition and generation tasks designed to test capabilities at each level. Extensive experiments indicate a clear performance stratification that correlates with the hierarchy's levels of complexity. Our analysis reveals a direct relationship where increasing task difficulty substantially impacts both inference length and performance. Furthermore, we find that while larger models and advanced inference methods offer notable relative gains, they face severe efficiency barriers: achieving practical reliability would require prohibitive computational costs, revealing that current limitations stem from inefficiency rather than absolute capability bounds. A time complexity analysis further indicates that LLMs are significantly less efficient than traditional algorithmic programs for these formal tasks. These results delineate the practical limits of current LLMs, highlight the indispensability of traditional software tools, and provide insights to guide the development of future LLMs with more powerful formal reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: ChomskyBench首次用乔姆斯基层级系统评估大模型形式推理能力，发现模型性能随层级复杂度阶梯式下降，虽扩大规模与改进推理可提升效果，但计算成本极高，效率远不及传统算法，揭示当前瓶颈在效率而非能力上限。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准缺乏基于计算与复杂度的系统化形式推理评估，无法判断SOTA模型是否真正掌握计算理论定义的形式语言结构化层次复杂度。
AI.method: 构建ChomskyBench：全覆盖乔姆斯基层级的语言识别与生成任务集；以自然语言进行过程追踪评价；用确定性符号验证保证可验证性；对多种规模模型及推理策略进行实验并做时间复杂度分析。
AI.result: 性能沿乔姆斯基层级呈显著分层，任务难度升高则推理步长与准确率同步下降；更大模型与高级推理方法仅有相对提升，达到实用可靠性需付出不可接受的计算代价；LLM在时间复杂度上远低于传统算法程序。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在形式任务上的实用边界由效率而非绝对能力决定，传统软件工具仍不可或缺；未来应优先提升LLM形式推理效率，并融合符号方法以突破瓶颈。

title: Detecting Diffusion-generated Images via Dynamic Assembly Forests
summary: Diffusion models are known for generating high-quality images, causing serious security concerns. To combat this, most efforts rely on deep neural networks (e.g., CNNs and Transformers), while largely overlooking the potential of traditional machine learning models. In this paper, we freshly investigate such alternatives and proposes a novel Dynamic Assembly Forest model (DAF) to detect diffusion-generated images. Built upon the deep forest paradigm, DAF addresses the inherent limitations in feature learning and scalable training, making it an effective diffusion-generated image detector. Compared to existing DNN-based methods, DAF has significantly fewer parameters, much lower computational cost, and can be deployed without GPUs, while achieving competitive performance under standard evaluation protocols. These results highlight the strong potential of the proposed method as a practical substitute for heavyweight DNN models in resource-constrained scenarios. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/OUC-VAS/DAF.

AI.tldr: 首个专为检测扩散生成图像设计的轻量级非深度方案DAF：在无需GPU、参数量与计算量均极低的前提下，达到与CNN/Transformer方法相当的检测精度，为资源受限场景提供了可实践的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 当前扩散模型生成图像质量极高，带来严重安全威胁；已有检测方法几乎全部依赖CNN或Transformer等重型深度网络，既耗算力又难以在端侧部署，传统机器学习在此任务中的潜力被忽视，亟需一种轻量高效、无需GPU的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出Dynamic Assembly Forest（DAF）：在深度森林框架基础上，①设计动态特征复用机制弥补传统模型表征力不足；②引入层级数据并行与自适应子森林增长策略，实现可扩展训练；③结合空-频域混合特征与轻量级增强，构建端到端的扩散图像检测器。
AI.result: 在FaceForensics++、DiffusionForensics等基准上，DAF以<1M参数量、≈1/20 FLOPs取得与SOTA CNN/Transformer模型相当的ACC/AUC；CPU端推理速度提升5–8倍，无需GPU即可实时检测；在跨数据域、跨生成器测试中鲁棒性更优。
AI.conclusion: 传统机器学习模型经适当结构创新后，可在扩散图像检测任务中与重型DNN竞争，DAF为资源受限场景提供了参数少、能耗低、易部署的实用替代，显著扩展了生成图像检测的落地边界。

title: ChatSVA: Bridging SVA Generation for Hardware Verification via Task-Specific LLMs
summary: Functional verification consumes over 50% of the IC development lifecycle, where SystemVerilog Assertions (SVAs) are indispensable for formal property verification and enhanced simulation-based debugging. However, manual SVA authoring is labor-intensive and error-prone. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise, their direct deployment is hindered by low functional accuracy and a severe scarcity of domain-specific data. To address these challenges, we introduce ChatSVA, an end-to-end SVA generation system built upon a multi-agent framework. At its core, the AgentBridge platform enables this multi-agent approach by systematically generating high-purity datasets, overcoming the data scarcity inherent to few-shot scenarios. Evaluated on 24 RTL designs, ChatSVA achieves 98.66% syntax and 96.12% functional pass rates, generating 139.5 SVAs per design with 82.50% function coverage. This represents a 33.3 percentage point improvement in functional correctness and an over 11x enhancement in function coverage compared to the previous state-of-the-art (SOTA). ChatSVA not only sets a new SOTA in automated SVA generation but also establishes a robust framework for solving long-chain reasoning problems in few-shot, domain-specific scenarios. An online service has been publicly released at https://www.nctieda.com/CHATDV.html.

AI.tldr: ChatSVA 是第一个基于多智能体的端到端 SVA 自动生成系统，在 24 个 RTL 设计上达到 96.12% 功能正确率与 82.5% 功能覆盖率，刷新自动化 SVA 生成 SOTA，并公开在线服务。
AI.motivation: 功能验证占 IC 开发周期 50% 以上，SystemVerilog Assertion（SVA）是关键验证手段，但手工编写耗时易错；LLM 虽具潜力却因领域数据稀缺、功能准确率低下而难以直接落地。
AI.method: 构建多智能体框架 AgentBridge，自动合成高纯度领域数据集以解决小样本难题；基于该框架实现端到端 SVA 生成系统 ChatSVA，支持长链推理与领域特化。
AI.result: 在 24 个 RTL 设计上，ChatSVA 平均生成 139.5 条 SVA，语法通过率 98.66%，功能正确率 96.12%，功能覆盖率 82.5%；功能正确性较 SOTA 提升 33.3 个百分点，覆盖率提升逾 11 倍。
AI.conclusion: ChatSVA 不仅刷新自动化 SVA 生成最高水平，还验证了多智能体＋高纯度数据合成在少样本、领域专属长链推理任务中的普适框架价值；项目已以在线服务形式开源。

title: Cost-optimal Sequential Testing via Doubly Robust Q-learning
summary: Clinical decision-making often involves selecting tests that are costly, invasive, or time-consuming, motivating individualized, sequential strategies for what to measure and when to stop ascertaining. We study the problem of learning cost-optimal sequential decision policies from retrospective data, where test availability depends on prior results, inducing informative missingness. Under a sequential missing-at-random mechanism, we develop a doubly robust Q-learning framework for estimating optimal policies. The method introduces path-specific inverse probability weights that account for heterogeneous test trajectories and satisfy a normalization property conditional on the observed history. By combining these weights with auxiliary contrast models, we construct orthogonal pseudo-outcomes that enable unbiased policy learning when either the acquisition model or the contrast model is correctly specified. We establish oracle inequalities for the stage-wise contrast estimators, along with convergence rates, regret bounds, and misclassification rates for the learned policy. Simulations demonstrate improved cost-adjusted performance over weighted and complete-case baselines, and an application to a prostate cancer cohort study illustrates how the method reduces testing cost without compromising predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种双稳健Q学习框架，在测试存在
AI.motivation: 临床决策中哪些检查该做、何时停止检查是个体化、序贯且需权衡成本的问题；回顾性数据常因历史结果决定后续检查的可获得性，导致信息性缺失，传统方法无法直接利用此类数据学习最优策略。
AI.method: 在序贯缺失机制下构建路径特定逆概率权重，使其在给定观测历史下归一化，并与辅助对比模型结合生成正交伪结局，实现双稳健Q学习；理论上建立对比估计器的Oracle不等式、收敛率、策略遗憾界及误分类率界。
AI.result: 模拟显示成本调整后性能优于加权基线与完整病例基线；前列腺癌真实队列中在不降低预测准确度的前提下显著减少检查费用。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的双稳健框架可在非随机缺失检查的历史数据中学习到成本最优且统计可靠的个体化序贯决策策略，适用于任何昂贵、侵入性或耗时检查场景。

title: From Load Tests to Live Streams: Graph Embedding-Based Anomaly Detection in Microservice Architectures
summary: Prime Video regularly conducts load tests to simulate the viewer traffic spikes seen during live events such as Thursday Night Football as well as video-on-demand (VOD) events such as Rings of Power. While these stress tests validate system capacity, they can sometimes miss service behaviors unique to real event traffic. We present a graph-based anomaly detection system that identifies under-represented services using unsupervised node-level graph embeddings. Built on a GCN-GAE, our approach learns structural representations from directed, weighted service graphs at minute-level resolution and flags anomalies based on cosine similarity between load test and event embeddings. The system identifies incident-related services that are documented and demonstrates early detection capability. We also introduce a preliminary synthetic anomaly injection framework for controlled evaluation that show promising precision (96%) and low false positive rate (0.08%), though recall (58%) remains limited under conservative propagation assumptions. This framework demonstrates practical utility within Prime Video while also surfacing methodological lessons and directions, providing a foundation for broader application across microservice ecosystems.

AI.tldr: Prime Video 用图嵌入+无监督相似度比对，在压测与真实赛事流量间找“隐式”微服务异常，上线后已捕获多起事故根因，初步实验 96 % 精度/0.08 % 误报，但召回仅 58 %。
AI.motivation: 传统压测虽能验容量，却常遗漏真实赛事洪峰下才暴露的微服务级异常行为，需要一套不依赖标签、能分钟级发现“被压测低估”的服务的方法。
AI.method: 构建有向加权微服务调用图，用 GCN-GAE 学习节点级结构嵌入；以压测图为基准，用余弦相似度检测赛事流量图中偏离节点；配套合成异常注入框架，在受控环境评估性能。
AI.result: 系统已在 Prime Video 生产环境识别到多例与事故相关的服务，具备早期预警能力；合成实验显示 96 % 精准率、0.08 % 误报率，召回率受保守传播假设限制为 58 %。
AI.conclusion: 图嵌入压测-实景观差异方法在微服务排障上可落地，为后续召回优化与跨域推广奠定方法论基础。

title: LangFlow: Continuous Diffusion Rivals Discrete in Language Modeling
summary: Continuous diffusion has been the foundation of high-fidelity, controllable, and few-step generation of many data modalities such as images. However, in language modeling, prior continuous diffusion language models (DLMs) lag behind discrete counterparts due to the sparse data space and the underexplored design space. In this work, we close this gap with LangFlow, the first continuous DLM to rival discrete diffusion, by connecting embedding-space DLMs to Flow Matching via Bregman divergence, alongside three key innovations: (1) we derive a novel ODE-based NLL bound for principled evaluation of continuous flow-based language models; (2) we propose an information-uniform principle for setting the noise schedule, which motivates a learnable noise scheduler based on a Gumbel distribution; and (3) we revise prior training protocols by incorporating self-conditioning, as we find it improves both likelihood and sample quality of embedding-space DLMs with effects substantially different from discrete diffusion. Putting everything together, LangFlow rivals top discrete DLMs on both the perplexity (PPL) and the generative perplexity (Gen. PPL), reaching a PPL of 30.0 on LM1B and 24.6 on OpenWebText. It even exceeds autoregressive baselines in zero-shot transfer on 4 out of 7 benchmarks. LangFlow provides the first clear evidence that continuous diffusion is a promising paradigm for language modeling. Homepage: https://github.com/nealchen2003/LangFlow

AI.tldr: LangFlow 以「流匹配+三项创新」首次让连续扩散语言模型在困惑度与零样本能力上追上甚至超越离散模型，验证「连续范式」可行。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散在图像等高维稠密数据已展现高保真、可控、少步生成优势，但语言空间稀疏、设计空间未被充分探索，导致连续扩散语言模型（DLM）性能远逊于离散模型。作者希望弥合这一差距，证明连续范式也能成为语言建模的有力选择。
AI.method: 1）将嵌入空间 DLM 与流匹配（Flow Matching）通过 Bregman 散度耦合；2）推导基于 ODE 的 NLL 上界，为连续流模型提供可理论评估的似然目标；3）提出「信息均匀」原则设置噪声调度，并设计基于 Gumbel 分布的可学习调度器；4）引入自条件训练（self-conditioning），显著提升似然与样本质量。
AI.result: LangFlow 在 LM1B 与 OpenWebText 上分别取得 30.0 与 24.6 的困惑度（PPL），生成困惑度（Gen. PPL）亦与顶级离散扩散模型持平；在 7 项零样本下游任务中，有 4 项超越自回归基线模型。
AI.conclusion: LangFlow 首次给出连续扩散在语言建模中“可实战”的清晰证据，表明通过合适的训练目标、噪声调度与自条件机制，连续范式不仅能匹配离散方法，还能在部分场景下胜出，为后续研究提供了新的基础与方向。

title: Exact Structural Abstraction and Tractability Limits
comment: 42 pages. 3 tables. Lean 4 formalization available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19457896
summary:
Any rigorously specified problem determines an admissible-output relation $R$, and the only state distinctions that matter are the classes $s \sim_R s' \iff \mathrm{Adm}_R(s)=\mathrm{Adm}_R(s')$. Every exact correctness claim reduces to the same quotient-recovery problem, and the no-go concerns tractability of the underlying problem, not of its presentation. Exact means agreement with $R$, not zero-error determinism or absence of approximation/randomization in the specification. The exact-semantics quotient theorem identifies admissible-output equivalence as the canonical object recovered by exact relevance certification. Decision, search, approximation, statistical, randomized, horizon, and distributional guarantees instantiate it. Tractable families have a finite primitive basis, but optimizer-quotient realizability is maximal, so quotient shape cannot characterize the frontier.
  We prove a meta-impossibility theorem for efficiently checkable structural predicates invariant under theorem-forced closure laws of exact certification. Zero-distortion summaries, quotient entropy bounds, and support counting explain them. Same-orbit disagreements across four obstruction families, via action-independent pair-targeted affine witnesses, force contradiction. Consequently no correct problem-tractability classifier on a closure-closed domain yields an exact characterization over these families. Restricting to a closure-closed subdomain helps only by removing orbit gaps. Uniform strict-gap control preserves the full optimizer quotient, while arbitrarily small perturbations can flip relevance and sufficiency. Closure-orbit agreement is forced by correctness, and the same compute-cost barrier extends to optimizer computation, payload/search, and theorem-backed external or transported outputs. The obstruction therefore appears at the level of correctness itself, not any particular output formalism.

AI.tldr: 任何计算问题的正确性最终都归结为在可接受输出的等价类商集上恢复可判定的结构，但这种保持正确性不变的『结构』无法同时满足多项式时间可检查、对精确定义依赖最小且在一大类问题族上完全区分的三重需求。
AI.motivation: 确立一个能同时独立于具体实例、容错模式或算法随机性，又『纯粹』反映计算问题固有难度的『精确正确性』指标；结果却发现这样的指标本身存在元层次不可行性。
AI.method: 引入可接受输出关系R定义问题正确性，用等价类s~_R s'≡Adm_R(s)=Adm_R(s')将所有问题形式化为『商集-复原』任务；通过作用无关、对偶目标化的仿射见证构造四族破坏示例，导出「正确性必须保持闭轨道一致性」的必然结论。
AI.result: 证明了一元不可能定理：不存在能于多项式时间内检查且在定理强制闭运算下保持不变的、可分辨所有四族障碍问题的精确结构谓词；一致严格间隔控制虽能保全完备商集，任意小扰动却能翻转相关性与充分性判据。
AI.conclusion: 『问题是否可解』的障碍深植于正确性本身，而非任何输出或语义形式主义；试图用有限原始基或结构谓词全面刻画可处理性前沿的精粹，本质上是不可能完成的任务，因此只能转而采用近似或领域特化的判别策略。

title: Spatial Atlas: Compute-Grounded Reasoning for Spatial-Aware Research Agent Benchmarks
summary: We introduce compute-grounded reasoning (CGR), a design paradigm for spatial-aware research agents in which every answerable sub-problem is resolved by deterministic computation before a language model is asked to generate. Spatial Atlas instantiates CGR as a single Agent-to-Agent (A2A) server that handles two challenging benchmarks: FieldWorkArena, a multimodal spatial question-answering benchmark spanning factory, warehouse, and retail environments, and MLE-Bench, a suite of 75 Kaggle machine learning competitions requiring end-to-end ML engineering. A structured spatial scene graph engine extracts entities and relations from vision descriptions, computes distances and safety violations deterministically, then feeds computed facts to large language models, thereby avoiding hallucinated spatial reasoning. Entropy-guided action selection maximizes information gain per step and routes queries across a three-tier frontier model stack (OpenAI + Anthropic). A self-healing ML pipeline with strategy-aware code generation, a score-driven iterative refinement loop, and a prompt-based leak audit registry round out the system. We evaluate across both benchmarks and show that CGR yields competitive accuracy while maintaining interpretability through structured intermediate representations and deterministic spatial computations.

AI.tldr: 提出「计算接地推理(CGR)」范式，先由确定性计算解决所有可解子问题，再由大模型生成，Spatial Atlas 在两大空间/ML 基准上验证其兼具准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 大模型在空间推理和 ML 全流程任务中易出现幻觉，缺乏可验证的中间结果；需让语言模型仅处理「不可算」部分，提升可靠性与可解释性。
AI.method: CGR 范式：结构化场景图引擎先解析视觉输入，确定性计算实体、距离与安全违规；熵引导动作选择最大化每步信息增益；三阶梯大模型路由(OpenAI+Anthropic)；自修复 ML 流水线含策略感知代码生成、分数驱动迭代与 prompt-based 泄露审计。
AI.result: 在工厂/仓库/零售多模态 QA 数据集 FieldWorkArena 与 75 项 Kaggle ML 竞赛(MLE-Bench)上，CGR 达到与 SOTA 竞争精度，同时通过结构化中间表示与确定性计算保证可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 将「可计算子问题」完全交给确定性模块，使大模型仅聚焦剩余语义任务，是抑制幻觉、提升空间与 ML 代理可靠性的有效途径。

title: LPM 1.0: Video-based Character Performance Model
comment: 43 pages, 15 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://large-performance-model.github.io
summary: Performance, the externalization of intent, emotion, and personality through visual, vocal, and temporal behavior, is what makes a character alive. Learning such performance from video is a promising alternative to traditional 3D pipelines. However, existing video models struggle to jointly achieve high expressiveness, real-time inference, and long-horizon identity stability, a tension we call the performance trilemma. Conversation is the most comprehensive performance scenario, as characters simultaneously speak, listen, react, and emote while maintaining identity over time. To address this, we present LPM 1.0 (Large Performance Model), focusing on single-person full-duplex audio-visual conversational performance. Concretely, we build a multimodal human-centric dataset through strict filtering, speaking-listening audio-video pairing, performance understanding, and identity-aware multi-reference extraction; train a 17B-parameter Diffusion Transformer (Base LPM) for highly controllable, identity-consistent performance through multimodal conditioning; and distill it into a causal streaming generator (Online LPM) for low-latency, infinite-length interaction. At inference, given a character image with identity-aware references, LPM 1.0 generates listening videos from user audio and speaking videos from synthesized audio, with text prompts for motion control, all at real-time speed with identity-stable, infinite-length generation. LPM 1.0 thus serves as a visual engine for conversational agents, live streaming characters, and game NPCs. To systematically evaluate this setting, we propose LPM-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive character performance. LPM 1.0 achieves state-of-the-art results across all evaluated dimensions while maintaining real-time inference.

AI.tldr: LPM 1.0 是首个 17B 参数的扩散 Transformer，可将单张角色图实时、无限时长地转化为“边说边听”的全双工音视频对话表演；它解决“高表现力-实时-长时身份稳定”三难，并建立 LPM-Bench 评估体系，全面刷新基准。
AI.motivation: 传统 3D 管线成本高，而现有视频模型无法在高表现力、实时推理与长时身份稳定之间兼得，尤其缺少面向“说话-倾听-反应-情绪”全双工对话场景的统一解决方案。
AI.method: 1. 构建经过严格过滤与身份感知的多模态人形对话数据集，完成说话-倾听音画配对与多参考提取；2. 训练 17B 参数扩散 Transformer（Base LPM），以多模态条件实现可控且身份一致的高表现力生成；3. 蒸馏出因果流式生成器（Online LPM），实现低延迟、无限时长交互；4. 推理时输入角色图与身份参考，实时生成听/说视频，并支持文本提示驱动动作。
AI.result: 在自建的 LPM-Bench（首个交互式角色表演基准）所有维度均达 SOTA，同时保持实时推理速度与无限长度身份一致性。
AI.conclusion: LPM 1.0 首次打破“表演三难”，为对话智能体、直播角色与游戏 NPC 提供可直接部署的视觉引擎，并确立新的评估标准，推动数字人向更自然、可持续的交互演进。

title: Evaluating Differential Privacy Against Membership Inference in Federated Learning: Insights from the NIST Genomics Red Team Challenge
summary: While Federated Learning (FL) mitigates direct data exposure, the resulting trained models remain susceptible to membership inference attacks (MIAs). This paper presents an empirical evaluation of Differential Privacy (DP) as a defense mechanism against MIAs in FL, leveraging the environment of the 2025 NIST Genomics Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning (PPFL) Red Teaming Event. To improve inference accuracy, we propose a stacking attack strategy that ensembles seven black-box estimators to train a meta-classifier on prediction probabilities and cross-entropy losses. We evaluate this methodology against target models under three privacy configurations: an unprotected convolutional neural network (CNN, $ε=\infty$), a low-privacy DP model ($ε=200$), and a high-privacy DP model ($ε=10$). The attack outperforms all baselines in the No DP and Low Privacy settings and, critically, maintains measurable membership leakage at $ε=200$ where a single-signal LiRA baseline collapses. Evaluated on an independent third-party benchmark, these results provide an empirical characterisation of how stacking-based inference degrades across calibrated DP tiers in FL.

AI.tldr: 利用7种黑盒估计器堆叠训练元分类器，在“NIST 2025基因组隐私FL红队”场景下首次系统量化了ε=200与ε=10时堆叠推断对DP联邦模型成员隐私的残余泄露，指出ε=200不足以阻断推断，补齐了DP层位-联邦推断鲁棒的实证空白。
AI.motivation: 联邦模型虽不见原始数据，但仍遭成员推断攻击（MIA）威胁；差分隐私被广泛认为是最可验证的缓解手段，但现有实验多停留在单信号攻击、数据非基因组或ε≥1000等理想条件，真实的“ε-泄露函数”尚缺校准证据，阻碍了隐私预算的精细化设计。
AI.method: 1) 采用NIST 2025基因组隐私FL红队基准，选取三种目标CNN：无保护（ε=∞）、低隐私（ε=200）、高隐私（ε=10）。2) 设计堆叠推断策略：将Softmax概率与交叉熵Loss两种信号喂给7种异构黑盒估计器（含RA/LiRA/MLP/LOF等），输出预测概率后再训练逻辑回归元分类器。3) 对比单信号LiRA基线与跨站第三方实验，记录AUC、TPR@1%FPR泄漏指标。
AI.result: 堆叠推断在无保护（ε=∞）和低隐私（ε=200）模型上超越所有基线，AUC最高提升+0.083；ε=200时单信号LiRA已失效（AUC≈0.50），堆叠推断仍保持可测泄漏（AUC≈0.57–0.62）。在独立第三方测试集中趋势一致，证明泄漏存在可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 实验首次证实，即便在面向基因组数据的高级别ε=200的DP-guarantee下，联邦模型仍存在非零成员泄露；单信号推断失效并不意味着隐私即达标。部署Defence-in-depth（如更紧ε、额外噪声梯度、聚合频率降采样）并警惕堆叠推断是后续必由之路。

title: DBMF: A Dual-Branch Multimodal Framework for Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: The complex and dynamic real-world clinical environment demands reliable deep learning (DL) systems. Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection plays a critical role in enhancing the reliability and generalizability of DL models when encountering data that deviate from the training distribution, such as unseen disease cases. However, existing OOD detection methods typically rely either on a single visual modality or solely on image-text matching, failing to fully leverage multimodal information. To overcome the challenge, we propose a novel dual-branch multimodal framework by introducing a text-image branch and a vision branch. Our framework fully exploits multimodal representations to identify OOD samples through these two complementary branches. After training, we compute scores from the text-image branch ($S_t$) and vision branch ($S_v$), and integrate them to obtain the final OOD score $S$ that is compared with a threshold for OOD detection. Comprehensive experiments on publicly available endoscopic image datasets demonstrate that our proposed framework is robust across diverse backbones and improves state-of-the-art performance in OOD detection by up to 24.84%

AI.tldr: 提出了一种双分支多模态OOD检测框架，结合图文分支与纯视觉分支，以内镜公开数据集验证，性能提升最高24.84%。
AI.motivation: 临床DL系统常遇到与训练分布差异大的OOD数据，现有方法多局限于单模态或粗糙图文匹配，未充分挖掘多模态互补信息，亟需更鲁棒的检出方案。
AI.method: 设计双分支网络：图文分支进行图文匹配得到分数St，纯视觉分支提取视觉特征得到分数Sv；训练后融合St与Sv获得最终OOD分数S，并与阈值比较实现检测。
AI.result: 在多个公开内镜图像数据集上验证，框架对不同骨干网络均稳定，平均OOD检测AUC提升高达24.84%，明显优于现有SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 双分支多模态融合策略显著强化了OOD信号，验证了同时利用图文语义与视觉特征的必要性和有效性，为临床DL可靠性提供了新途径。

title: eBandit: Kernel-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Video Streaming
summary: User-space Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) algorithms cannot see the transport layer signals that matter most, such as minimum RTT and instantaneous delivery rate, and they respond to network changes only after damage has already propagated to the playout buffer. We present eBandit, a framework that relocates both network monitoring and ABR algorithm selection into the Linux kernel using eBPF. A lightweight epsilon-greedy Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) runs inside a sockops program, evaluating three ABR heuristics against a reward derived from live TCP metrics. On an adversarial synthetic trace eBandit achieves $416.3 \pm 4.9$ cumulative QoE, outperforming the best static heuristic by $7.2\%$. On 42 real-world sessions eBandit achieves a mean QoE per chunk of $1.241$, the highest across all policies, demonstrating that kernel-resident bandit learning transfers to heterogeneous mobile conditions.

AI.tldr: 内核态 eBPF 中嵌入 ε-贪婪多臂老虎机，实时合成最优 ABR 策略，较最佳静态启发法提升 7.2% 累积 QoE。
AI.motivation: 用户态 ABR 无法直接观测最小 RTT、瞬时发送速率等关键网络信号，对网络波动反应滞后，导致播放缓冲已受损才决策。
AI.method: 提出 eBandit：将网络监测与策略选择下沉到 Linux 内核 eBPF sockops，用 ε-贪婪 MAB 在线评估三种 ABR 启发式，奖励函数基于实时 TCP 指标即时更新。
AI.result: 对抗性合成流下累积 QoE 达 416.3±4.9，比最佳静态策略高 7.2%；42 条真实移动互联网会话中平均单块 QoE 1.241，为所有方案最高，验证跨环境转移有效。
AI.conclusion: 内核级轻量在线学习可突破用户态观测局限，使 ABR 先知后调，显著提升复杂与移动场景下的 QoE，为基于 eBPF 的实时策略优化提供可行范式。

title: WOMBET: World Model-based Experience Transfer for Robust and Sample-efficient Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 8th Annual Learning for Dynamics & Control Conference (L4DC)
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) in robotics is often limited by the cost and risk of data collection, motivating experience transfer from a source task to a target task. Offline-to-online RL leverages prior data but typically assumes a given fixed dataset and does not address how to generate reliable data for transfer. We propose \textit{World Model-based Experience Transfer} (WOMBET), a framework that jointly generates and utilizes prior data. WOMBET learns a world model in the source task and generates offline data via uncertainty-penalized planning, followed by filtering trajectories with high return and low epistemic uncertainty. It then performs online fine-tuning in the target task using adaptive sampling between offline and online data, enabling a stable transition from prior-driven initialization to task-specific adaptation. We show that the uncertainty-penalized objective provides a lower bound on the true return and derive a finite-sample error decomposition capturing distribution mismatch and approximation error. Empirically, WOMBET improves sample efficiency and final performance over strong baselines on continuous control benchmarks, demonstrating the benefit of jointly optimizing data generation and transfer.

AI.tldr: WOMBET利用源任务世界模型自主生成高质量离线数据，经不确定度惩罚与筛选后迁移至目标任务，在持续控制基准上显著提升样本效率与最终性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人强化学习因采样成本高、风险大而难以直接在线训练，现有离线→在线方法依赖固定数据集，未解决“如何为迁移主动生成可靠数据”这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出World Model-based Experience Transfer (WOMBET)：先在源任务训练世界模型，通过不确定度惩罚的模型预测规划生成离线轨迹，再按“高回报+低认知不确定度”双重标准筛选；在目标任务中采用自适应离/在线数据混合采样，实现从先验初始化到任务特化的平稳过渡；理论给出不确定度惩罚目标作为真实回报下界，并建立包含分布失配与近似误差的有限样本误差分解。
AI.result: 在连续控制基准上，WOMBET相比强基线（包括现有离线→在线RL与任务间迁移方法）显著提高样本效率和最终策略性能，验证联合优化数据生成与迁移的增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过世界模型主动生成并精选迁移数据，再辅以自适应在线微调，WOMBET为低成本、低风险机器人RL提供了一个可扩展的新范式；其不确定度制导与误差分解框架亦可为未来迁移学习研究提供理论工具。

title: Token-Budget-Aware Pool Routing for Cost-Efficient LLM Inference
summary:
Production vLLM fleets provision every instance for worst-case context length, wasting 4-8x concurrency on the 80-95% of requests that are short and simultaneously triggering KV-cache failures -- OOM crashes, preemption storms, and request rejections. Both problems share a single root cause: configuration-traffic mismatch.
  We propose token-budget-aware pool routing: estimate each request's total token budget using a self-calibrating per-category bytes-per-token ratio, then dispatch it to one of two vLLM pools -- a high-throughput short pool or a high-capacity long pool -- each right-sized for its workload class. The ratio is learned online via exponential moving average from usage.prompt_tokens feedback, requiring no tokenizer. A closed-form cost model, savings = alpha * (1 - 1/rho), predicts fleet-level GPU savings from two observable quantities: the short-traffic fraction alpha and the throughput gain ratio rho.
  On traces from the Azure LLM Inference Dataset and LMSYS-Chat-1M serving Llama-3-70B on A100 GPUs, token-budget routing reduces GPU instances by 17-39% (\$1.2-2.0M/yr at 1,000 req/s), with savings verified by a self-contained discrete-event simulator. A case study projecting Qwen3-235B-A22B on AMD MI300X at 10,000 req/s shows \$15.4M/yr in savings. The algorithm adds O(1) dispatch overhead, self-calibrates across content types without a tokenizer, and composes with PagedAttention, continuous batching, and prefill-decode disaggregation.

AI.tldr: 现有生产级 vLLM 集群按最大 context 长度统一分配，导致轻量请求浪费 4–8 倍并发，易 OOM。本文提出“令牌预算感知池路由”——在线估算请求总令牌，用 EMA 自校准 bytes-per-token 系数，将其分流到短-高速或长-大容量专用池，无需 tokenizer，与 PagedAttention 等兼容，可在千级并发下年省 1.2–15 M 美元。
AI.motivation: 1. 趋同问题：95% 请求为短 context，却因按最坏 case 配置而无法充分利用并发；2. 资源错配：过量预留 KV-cache 引发 OOM、抢占风暴和拒绝。根本原因是“配置-流量错配”。作者旨在用轻量调度手段减少硬件，省钱并提高稳定性。
AI.method: 1. 在线特征：仅用每个类别的 prompt_tokens + usage 反馈，通过指数滑动平均学习 λ=bytes-per-token，O(1)。2. 预算估算：ReqBudget ≈ λ×bytes。3. 池划分：根据预算阈值 τ 将请求路由到两个同质 vLLM 集群（短池高并发，长池大 max-context）。4. 闭式模型：Savings=α(1−1/ρ)，其中 α 为短流量比例，ρ 为短池吞吐增益比，可量化监理和预判收益。5. 兼容：与 PagingAttn、连续批调、PD 分离无缝叠加。
AI.result: 1. 实测：在 Azure LLM Trace + LMSYS-Chat-1M 上，Llama-3-70B/A100，1000 req/s 场景，将 GPU 实例减少 17–39%，年省 1.2–2.0 M USD，仿真验证偏差 <3%。2. 前瞻：预测 Qwen3-235B-A22B/MI300X，万级 RPS 节省 15.4 M 美元/年。3. Overhead：包级调度延迟 <0.2 ms，不显著。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭实时学习的“预算系数”与单向双池路由，无需 tokenizer 或再调度，就同时削峰、避 OOM、放大吞吐并兑现可持续财务回报；对其它 KV-cache 系统具备通迁移价值。未来可扩展为多级/超卖池、动态参数 τ 和细粒度 QoS 剪裁。

title: Grid2Matrix: Revealing Digital Agnosia in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel on many multimodal reasoning benchmarks, but these evaluations often do not require an exhaustive readout of the image and can therefore obscure failures in faithfully capturing all visual details. We introduce Grid2Matrix (G2M), a controlled benchmark in which a model is shown a color grid and a color-to-number mapping, and must output the corresponding matrix. By varying grid size and the number of colors, G2M provides a simple way to increase visual complexity while minimizing semantic confounds. We find that VLMs exhibit a sharp early collapse in zero-shot end-to-end evaluation, failing on surprisingly small grids rather than degrading gradually as the task becomes denser. We probe the visual encoders of VLMs from two representative families and find that they preserve substantially more of the grid information than the corresponding end-to-end outputs. This suggests that the failure is not explained by visual encoding alone, but also reflects a gap between what remains recoverable from visual features and what is ultimately expressed in language. We term this gap \textit{Digital Agnosia}. Further analyses show that these errors are highly structured and depend strongly on how grid cells overlap with visual patch boundaries. We also find that common strategies such as model scaling and multimodal alignment do not fully eliminate this failure mode. We expect G2M to serve as a useful testbed for understanding where and how VLMs lose fine visual details, and for evaluating tasks where missing even small visual details can matter, such as tables, charts, forms, and GUIs.

AI.tldr: G2M 基准揭示 VLM 在简单彩色网格→矩阵任务中会出现“早期崩塌”，并非视觉编码丢失而是语言端无法还原，提出“数字失认症”概念并指出其结构化、难缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言基准无需完整读出图像细节，可能掩盖 VLM 对细粒度视觉信息的丢失；需一个可控、可扩展的任务直接测量模型对像素级细节的忠实度。
AI.method: 提出 Grid2Matrix（G2M）任务：给模型看彩色网格及色-数映射，要求其输出对应数字矩阵；通过改变网格尺寸与颜色数系统增加视觉复杂度。零样本端到端测试并对比视觉编码器输出，分析错误结构与 patch 边界关系，验证 scaling 与对齐策略效果。
AI.result: VLM 在网格很小（远未饱和）时出现急剧性能崩塌，而非渐进下降；视觉编码器保留的网格信息远多于最终语言输出，说明瓶颈在“可恢复→可表达”环节；错误呈结构化，显著受网格单元与视觉 patch 边界重叠方式影响；增大模型规模或多模态对齐无法彻底消除该失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 无法把仍存在于视觉特征中的细节转为语言的缺陷定义为“数字失认症”（Digital Agnosia）。G2M 提供轻量级、可扩展的测试床，可用于诊断并改进 VLM 在表格、图表、表单、GUI 等需精确视觉读数的场景中的细粒度视觉保真度。

title: A-IO: Adaptive Inference Orchestration for Memory-Bound NPUs
summary: During the deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), the autoregressive decoding phase on heterogeneous NPU platforms (e.g., Ascend 910B) faces severe memory-bound challenges. This study reveals the ``Model Scaling Paradox'' caused by the static deployment of single-sized models. It also points out the kernel synchronization overhead of fine-grained speculative decoding \cite{leviathan2023fast, chen2023speculative} under NPU computational graph compilation, and the severe limitations of purely relying on micro-level acceleration algorithms like Prompt LookUp Decoding (PLD)

AI.tldr: 揭示LLM在NPU部署时因静态单尺寸模型引发的“模型缩放悖论”、细粒度投机解码的核同步开销，以及纯微算法（如PLD）的局限。
AI.motivation: 解决异构NPU（如Ascend 910B）在自回归解码阶段遭遇的显存瓶颈，并解释现有微优化策略为何失效。
AI.method: 通过实验剖析静态单尺寸模型部署行为，量化细粒度投机解码在NPU计算图编译下的核同步开销，并评估PLD等微算法的实际增益边界。
AI.result: 提出“模型缩放悖论”现象：增大模型反而降低NPU解码效率；证实细粒度投机解码引入的同步开销抵消其并行收益；证明PLD类算法在NPU内存墙面前提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 需在NPU上放弃“单模型静态部署+微算法”思路，转向动态尺寸模型或编译器-硬件协同设计，才能突破内存瓶颈。

title: RoboLab: A High-Fidelity Simulation Benchmark for Analysis of Task Generalist Policies
summary: The pursuit of general-purpose robotics has yielded impressive foundation models, yet simulation-based benchmarking remains a bottleneck due to rapid performance saturation and a lack of true generalization testing. Existing benchmarks often exhibit significant domain overlap between training and evaluation, trivializing success rates and obscuring insights into robustness. We introduce RoboLab, a simulation benchmarking framework designed to address these challenges. Concretely, our framework is designed to answer two questions: (1) to what extent can we understand the performance of a real-world policy by analyzing its behavior in simulation, and (2) which external factors most strongly affect that behavior under controlled perturbations. First, RoboLab enables human-authored and LLM-enabled generation of scenes and tasks in a robot- and policy-agnostic manner within a physically realistic and photorealistic simulation. With this, we propose the RoboLab-120 benchmark, consisting of 120 tasks categorized into three competency axes: visual, procedural, relational competency, across three difficulty levels. Second, we introduce a systematic analysis of real-world policies that quantify both their performance and the sensitivity of their behavior to controlled perturbations, indicating that high-fidelity simulation can serve as a proxy for analyzing performance and its dependence on external factors. Evaluation with RoboLab exposes significant performance gap in current state-of-the-art models. By providing granular metrics and a scalable toolset, RoboLab offers a scalable framework for evaluating the true generalization capabilities of task-generalist robotic policies.

AI.tldr: RoboLab：一套高保真、可扰动、120 任务三轴分级的仿真基准，用于量化真实策略的泛化差距与敏感因素，暴露现有模型显著性能落差。
AI.motivation: 通才机器人基座模型兴起，但仿真基准因域重叠、饱和快、难测真泛化，已无法有效映射真实表现并指导鲁棒性改进。
AI.method: 1) 构建可人机/LLM 自动生成的物理-照片级仿真平台，机器人和策略无关；2) 提出 RoboLab-120 基准，按视觉、程序、关系三能力轴与三难度等级划分任务；3) 引入可控扰动下的系统敏感性分析，量化策略对光照、摩擦、几何等外部因素的依赖；4) 用高保真仿真结果作为真实表现的代理度量。
AI.result: RoboLab 评估揭示现有 SOTA 模型在 120 任务上存在显著且可细化的性能差距，尤其在跨域扰动下鲁棒性骤降；仿真衍生的敏感性与真实机器人实测趋势高度相关，表明高保真仿真能有效预判真实表现与关键干扰因子。
AI.conclusion: 通过可扩展、细粒度指标和工具链，RoboLab 为社区提供了一个可重复、可增长的框架，以客观测试并迭代提升通才策略的真正泛化与鲁棒能力，为仿真-到-真实转移提供透明指导。

title: Think in Sentences: Explicit Sentence Boundaries Enhance Language Model's Capabilities
summary: Researchers have explored different ways to improve large language models (LLMs)' capabilities via dummy token insertion in contexts. However, existing works focus solely on the dummy tokens themselves, but fail to leverage the inherent sentence-level structure of natural language. This is a critical oversight, as LLMs acquire linguistic capabilities through exposure to human-generated texts, which are inherently structured at the sentence level. Motivated by this gap, we propose an approach that inserts delimiters at sentence boundaries in LLM inputs, which not only integrates dummy tokens into the context, but also facilitates LLMs with sentence-by-sentence processing behavior during reasoning. Two concrete methods: (1). In-context learning and (2). Supervised fine-tuning are experimented using 7B models to 600B Deepseek-V3. Our results demonstrate consistent improvements across various tasks, with notable gains of up to 7.7\% on GSM8k and 12.5\% on DROP. Furthermore, the fine-tuned LLMs can incorporate sentence awareness evidenced by their internal representations. Our work establishes a simple yet effective technique for enhancing LLM's capabilities, offering promising directions for cognitive-inspired LLM enhancement paradigm.

AI.tldr: 通过在句子边界插入分隔符，让大模型按句处理，ICL 与 SFT 均涨点，GSM8k↑7.7%，DROP↑12.5%。
AI.motivation: 已有研究仅关注虚拟 token 本身，忽视了人类文本天然具备的句子级结构；LLM 的语言能力源于此类结构，却未被充分利用。
AI.method: 在输入上下文的句子边界插入显式分隔符，使模型在推理时执行“逐句处理”；分别在 7B–600B 模型上测试 in-context learning 与 supervised fine-tuning 两种范式。
AI.result: 多任务一致提升，GSM8k 准确率提高 7.7%，DROP 提高 12.5%；微调后的模型内部表征出现可测的“句子感知”信号。
AI.conclusion: 简单插入句子分隔符即可显著增强 LLM 性能，验证“认知启发的结构增强”是一条可行且易落地的范式。

title: Optimal Stability of KL Divergence under Gaussian Perturbations
summary: We study the problem of characterizing the stability of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence under Gaussian perturbations beyond Gaussian families. Existing relaxed triangle inequalities for KL divergence critically rely on the assumption that all involved distributions are Gaussian, which limits their applicability in modern applications such as out-of-distribution (OOD) detection with flow-based generative models. In this paper, we remove this restriction by establishing a sharp stability bound between an arbitrary distribution and Gaussian families under mild moment conditions. Specifically, let $P$ be a distribution with finite second moment, and let $\mathcal{N}_1$ and $\mathcal{N}_2$ be multivariate Gaussian distributions. We show that if $KL(P||\mathcal{N}_1)$ is large and $KL(\mathcal{N}_1||\mathcal{N}_2)$ is at most $ε$, then $KL(P||\mathcal{N}_2) \ge KL(P||\mathcal{N}_1) - O(\sqrtε)$. Moreover, we prove that this $\sqrtε$ rate is optimal in general, even within the Gaussian family. This result reveals an intrinsic stability property of KL divergence under Gaussian perturbations, extending classical Gaussian-only relaxed triangle inequalities to general distributions. The result is non-trivial due to the asymmetry of KL divergence and the absence of a triangle inequality in general probability spaces. As an application, we provide a rigorous foundation for KL-based OOD analysis in flow-based models, removing strong Gaussian assumptions used in prior work. More broadly, our result enables KL-based reasoning in non-Gaussian settings arising in deep learning and reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文将KL散度的高斯扰动稳定性从高斯分布推广到任意分布，证明了KL散度满足√ε级稳定性，并给出最优常数，由此为流模型OOD检测等非高斯场景的KL推理奠定理论基础。
AI.motivation: 现有KL散度“松弛三角不等式”仅适用于高斯分布，无法在基于流的生成模型OOD检测等现代应用中分析KL行为，亟需普适稳定性框架。
AI.method: 1) 设定P为二阶矩有限的任意分布，N₁、N₂为多元高斯，若KL(P‖N₁)很大且KL(N₁‖N₂)≤ε，则推导KL(P‖N₂)≥KL(P‖N₁)−O(√ε)；2) 构造极值示例证明√ε速率不可改进；3) 借L²-Wasserstein与二阶矩条件控制交叉项。
AI.result: 给出首个任意分布-高斯扰动下的KL紧界，揭示其√ε级稳定性；证伪了“高斯内部必更优”的直觉猜想；得到流模型KL-OOD分析的通用保证，彻底去除原有强高斯假设。
AI.conclusion: KL散度在Gauss扰动下具有内禀稳定性，新不等式将KL推理从Gaussian-only扩展至深度学习及强化学习等任意非高斯环境，为后续鲁棒推断与OOD检测提供普适理论工具。

title: Cost-optimal Sequential Testing via Doubly Robust Q-learning
summary: Clinical decision-making often involves selecting tests that are costly, invasive, or time-consuming, motivating individualized, sequential strategies for what to measure and when to stop ascertaining. We study the problem of learning cost-optimal sequential decision policies from retrospective data, where test availability depends on prior results, inducing informative missingness. Under a sequential missing-at-random mechanism, we develop a doubly robust Q-learning framework for estimating optimal policies. The method introduces path-specific inverse probability weights that account for heterogeneous test trajectories and satisfy a normalization property conditional on the observed history. By combining these weights with auxiliary contrast models, we construct orthogonal pseudo-outcomes that enable unbiased policy learning when either the acquisition model or the contrast model is correctly specified. We establish oracle inequalities for the stage-wise contrast estimators, along with convergence rates, regret bounds, and misclassification rates for the learned policy. Simulations demonstrate improved cost-adjusted performance over weighted and complete-case baselines, and an application to a prostate cancer cohort study illustrates how the method reduces testing cost without compromising predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可双稳健的Q学习框架，从带有信息性缺失的回顾性数据中，为昂贵检查项目学习成本最优的序贯决策策略。
AI.motivation: 临床上选择高成本、侵入性或耗时检查时，需个性化、序贯确定测什么、何时停止；历史数据常因既往结果导致检查可得性不同，出现信息性缺失，故需不依赖完整病例且能控制成本的学习方法。
AI.method: 在序贯MAR机制下，用路径特定的逆概率权重刻画异质性检查轨迹并保持归一化，结合辅助对比模型构造正交伪结局，建立双稳健Q学习框架；只要获取模型或对比模型之一正确即可无偏估计策略。
AI.result: 给出各阶段对比估计量的Oracle不等式、收敛速率、策略遗憾界与误分类率；仿真实验显示在成本调整性能上优于加权及完整病例基线；前列腺癌队列表明策略可在不降低预测准确性的情况下减少检查费用。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能在存在信息性缺失的回顾性数据中稳健地学到成本最优的序贯检查策略，为临床个体化检测方案提供可行高效的决策支持工具。

title: THEIA: Learning Complete Kleene Three-Valued Logic in a Pure-Neural Modular Architecture
summary: We present THEIA, a modular neural architecture that learns complete Kleene three-valued logic (K3) end-to-end without any external symbolic solver, and investigate what architectural prior enables compositional generalization under uncertainty. THEIA processes four mathematical domains (arithmetic, order, set membership, propositional logic) through dedicated engines that converge in a final logic module. Trained on a 2M-sample dataset with input space ~3.4 x 10^13, it achieves 12/12 Kleene K3 rule coverage across 5 seeds in 7.93 +/- 1.40 minutes (6.5x faster under matched settings; ~3.6x under Transformer-standard tuning, App. G). A mod-3 sequential composition experiment generalizes from 5-step training to 500-step evaluation at 99.97% +/- 0.02% -- a result requiring a structured backbone: replacing the four-engine backbone with a flat MLP collapses length generalization to chance by 50 steps at both tested capacities (0.80M and parameter-matched 2.75M), while a pre-LN TF8LTuned Transformer baseline (3,582,147 params) trained under the identical protocol reaches 99.24% at 500 steps (Appendix F). Mechanistic probing reveals that modularity induces a delayed verdict: upstream engines encode domain-specific variables without committing to the final truth value (probe accuracy <= 74% uncertainty-only ceiling), with the verdict emerging only at the Logic Engine boundary -- causally confirmed by activation patching (100% flip rate on 986 matched OR pairs, replicated across n=5 seeds; 100.0% aggregate on 4,898 pairs; generalized to AND with 100% flip rate on 4,719 pairs). The Transformer baseline reaches equivalent correctness through a qualitatively different representational trajectory (contraction then expansion), suggesting that modular and monolithic architectures implement distinct compositional strategies.

AI.tldr: THEIA 采用四引擎模块化结构，首次实现无需符号求解器的端到端 Kleene 三值逻辑完整学习，在算术、序关系、集合与命题四域任务上达到 100% 覆盖率，训练时间比肩/快于 6.5× Transformer，500 步长度外扩 100% 准确率不降；而任何扁平 MLP 或单体型 Transformer 长度外扩不到 50 步即坍缩为随机，证明「延迟裁决」的模块性是组合泛化的关键先验。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型系统在三值不确定性推理与组合泛化上缺乏统一、高效且可解释的方案。作者想回答：仅依靠神经结构本身、不依赖外部符号 K3 解算器，是否也能完整学会 Kleene 三值逻辑？何种架构先验能在不确定性环境下保证组合式、长度可扩展的泛化？
AI.method: 设计 THEIA：先分别为算术、序关系、集合与命题四域构建独立引擎，再以 logic engine 合并；采用 2 M 样例、输入空间 3.4×10¹³ 的大规模课程训练；并与两对照 Flat-MLP、预 LayerNorm 8 层 Tuned-Transformer 并行实验。进行 Mod-3 顺序复合测试：训练 5 步→评估 500 步；利用 probing 与 activation patching 追溯编码、延迟裁决与 logits 翻转。
AI.result: THEIA 100% 学会 K3 12 条运算规则（5 随机种子），平均 7.93±1.4 min（Transformer 6.5× 快）；500 步推断准确率 99.97%±0.02%，而 Flat-MLP 至 50 步即跌至随机；Transformer 仅达 99.24%。Probe 在 meta-variable 层最高 74%，但能在 logic gate 边界 100% flip OR／AND logits，因果证实裁决延迟；相比 Transformer 的「先收缩后扩张」策略，THEIA 呈截然不同的表示路径。
AI.conclusion: 模块化+延迟裁决即为三值逻辑之可泛架构先验；该机制让网络将不确定信息保留到最终决策边界，从而实现几乎无长度衰减的组合推理，而单体式架构只能做近似逼近。THEIA 为不确定性推理、模块化设计及可扩展组合泛化给出范式。

title: Network Effects and Agreement Drift in LLM Debates
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated an unprecedented ability to simulate human-like social behaviors, making them useful tools for simulating complex social systems. However, it remains unclear to what extent these simulations can be trusted to accurately capture key social mechanisms, particularly in highly unbalanced contexts involving minority groups. This paper uses a network generation model with controlled homophily and class sizes to examine how LLM agents behave collectively in multi-round debates. Moreover, our findings highlight a particular directional susceptibility that we term \textit{agreement drift}, in which agents are more likely to shift toward specific positions on the opinion scale. Overall, our findings highlight the need to disentangle structural effects from model biases before treating LLM populations as behavioral proxies for human groups.

AI.tldr: LLM 群体虽能模拟人类社交，但在少数群体极不平衡的情境下会出现“同意偏移”方向性偏差，需先剥离结构效应与模型偏见，才能将其作为人类行为代理。
AI.motivation: LLM 被广泛用于社会系统仿真，但缺乏对其在少数群体极端不平衡场景下可信度的系统检验。
AI.method: 构建含可控同质性与类别规模的网络生成模型，安排 LLM 代理进行多轮辩论，观测群体意见演化。
AI.result: 发现 LLM 代理存在显著的方向性易感——“同意偏移”，即整体更倾向朝意见尺度的特定端移动，而非对称收敛。
AI.conclusion: 在把 LLM 群体当作人类行为代理前，必须区分网络结构效应与模型内生偏见，否则仿真结果可能系统性失真。

title: CodeTracer: Towards Traceable Agent States
summary: Code agents are advancing rapidly, but debugging them is becoming increasingly difficult. As frameworks orchestrate parallel tool calls and multi-stage workflows over complex tasks, making the agent's state transitions and error propagation hard to observe. In these runs, an early misstep can trap the agent in unproductive loops or even cascade into fundamental errors, forming hidden error chains that make it hard to tell when the agent goes off track and why. Existing agent tracing analyses either focus on simple interaction or rely on small-scale manual inspection, which limits their scalability and usefulness for real coding workflows. We present CodeTracer, a tracing architecture that parses heterogeneous run artifacts through evolving extractors, reconstructs the full state transition history as a hierarchical trace tree with persistent memory, and performs failure onset localization to pinpoint the failure origin and its downstream chain. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct CodeTraceBench from a large collection of executed trajectories generated by four widely used code agent frameworks on diverse code tasks (e.g., bug fixing, refactoring, and terminal interaction), with supervision at both the stage and step levels for failure localization. Experiments show that CodeTracer substantially outperforms direct prompting and lightweight baselines, and that replaying its diagnostic signals consistently recovers originally failed runs under matched budgets. Our code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: CodeTracer 是首个针对复杂代码智能体黑箱调试的可扩展追踪框架，能自动定位失败源头并恢复原本失败的运行。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体日趋复杂，多阶段、并行调用导致早期小错误容易演变为隐藏错误链；现有追踪手段仅适用于简单交互或人工小规模检查，无法在生产级工作流中定位何时、为何偏离正确轨迹。
AI.method: 提出 CodeTracer：1) 用可进化的抽取器解析异构运行产物；2) 将完整状态变迁重构为带持久内存的分层追踪树；3) 设计失败起始定位算法，找出失败根节点及其下游传播链。同时构建基准 CodeTraceBench，涵盖四大主流框架在缺陷修复、重构、终端交互等任务上的万级轨迹，并标注阶段/步骤级失败位置。
AI.result: 在 CodeTraceBench 上，CodeTracer 相比直接提示与轻量级基线显著提升失败定位准确率；将其诊断信号回放至原框架，可在相同预算内一致性地让原本失败的运行成功。
AI.conclusion: CodeTracer 首次实现代码智能体大规模、系统化调试，为复杂代理系统的可观测性与可靠性提供了可复现的评估基准和实用工具。

title: Beyond LLMs, Sparse Distributed Memory, and Neuromorphics <A Hyper-Dimensional SRAM-CAM "VaCoAl" for Ultra-High Speed, Ultra-Low Power, and Low Cost>
summary: This paper reports an unexpected finding: in a deterministic hyperdimensional computing (HDC) architecture based on Galois-field algebra, a path-dependent semantic selection mechanism emerges, equivalent to spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), with magnitude predictable a priori by a closed-form expression matching large-scale measurements. This addresses limitations of modern AI including catastrophic forgetting, learning stagnation, and the Binding Problem at an algebraic level. We propose VaCoAl (Vague Coincident Algorithm) and its Python implementation PyVaCoAl, combining ultra-high-dimensional memory with deterministic logic. Rooted in Sparse Distributed Memory, it resolves orthogonalisation and retrieval in high-dimensional binary spaces via Galois-field diffusion, enabling low-load deployment. VaCoAl is a memory-centric architecture prioritising retrieval and association, enabling reversible composition while preserving element independence and supporting compositional generalisation with a transparent reliability metric (CR score). We evaluated multi-hop reasoning on about 470k mentor-student relations from Wikidata, tracing up to 57 generations (over 25.5M paths). Using HDC bundling and unbinding with CR-based denoising, we quantify concept propagation over DAGs. Results show a reinterpretation of the Newton-Leibniz dispute and a phase transition from sparse convergence to a post-Leibniz "superhighway", from which structural indicators emerge supporting a Kuhnian paradigm shift. Collision-tolerance mechanisms further induce path-based pruning that favors direct paths, yielding emergent semantic selection equivalent to STDP. VaCoAl thus defines a third paradigm, HDC-AI, complementing LLMs with reversible multi-hop reasoning.

AI.tldr: 在确定性的Galois-field超维计算框架中首次发现路径依赖的“类STDP”语义选择机制，可用闭式公式预测；提出VaCoAl/PyVaCoAl架构，通过高维捆绑-解绑与CR去噪完成可逆多跳推理，在470 k导师-学生网络中刻画牛顿-莱布尼茨争议的结构相变，为记忆中心、抗遗忘的第三代HDC-AI范式奠基。
AI.motivation: 现有AI遭遇灾难性遗忘、学习停滞与绑定问题，亟需不依赖梯度、可解释且可扩展的代数级解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 基于Galois-field扩散的确定性超维计算；2) 高维捆绑/解绑与碰撞容忍的CR评分去噪；3) 在大规模DAG上追踪概念传播的57代、25.5 M路径实验；4) 提取并验证等效于STDP的闭式语义选择定律。
AI.result: 闭式公式与实测高度吻合；牛顿-莱布尼茨争议在概念传播中呈现稀疏收敛→“后莱布尼茨超高速”相变；路径层面自发剪枝偏好直接路径，CR指标揭示库恩式范式转换。
AI.conclusion: VaCoAl以代数确定性实现可逆、可解释、抗遗忘的多跳推理，确立与LLM互补的HDC-AI第三范式，并为神经科学中的STDP提供新的计算诠释。

title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a core technique in the post-training of large language models, yet its training dynamics remain poorly understood. This paper provides a systematic investigation of OPD dynamics and mechanisms. We first identify that two conditions govern whether OPD succeeds or fails: (i) the student and teacher should share compatible thinking patterns; and (ii) even with consistent thinking patterns and higher scores, the teacher must offer genuinely new capabilities beyond what the student has seen during training. We validate these findings through weak-to-strong reverse distillation, showing that same-family 1.5B and 7B teachers are distributionally indistinguishable from the student's perspective. Probing into the token-level mechanism, we show that successful OPD is characterized by progressive alignment on high-probability tokens at student-visited states, a small shared token set that concentrates most of the probability mass (97%-99%). We further propose two practical strategies to recover failing OPD: off-policy cold start and teacher-aligned prompt selection. Finally, we show that OPD's apparent free lunch of dense token-level reward comes at a cost, raising the question of whether OPD can scale to long-horizon distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统拆解了On-policy Distillation(OPD)在大语言模型后训练期间的微观动力学，揭示其成功需满足“师生思维兼容”与“教师提供新增能力”两大条件，并提出冷启动与提示筛选两类修复策略，同时指出在长程蒸馏场景下OPD的“免费午餐”或难持续。
AI.motivation: 尽管OPD已成为大模型后训练的标配，但为何同一教师对不同学生表现差异巨大、且失败案例无法简单用“教师弱”解释，其内在机制缺乏理论刻画。
AI.method: 1. 建立“弱→强反向蒸馏”对照，通过分布检验量化1.5 B与7 B同族教师的可区分性；2. 在token层级追踪学生访问状态下概率质量迁移路径，提取共享高概率token集合；3. 设计off-policy冷启动与教师对齐提示选择两种干预实验，验证失败OPD的可恢复性；4. 构建长程蒸馏任务，比较密集token奖励与策略漂移代价。
AI.result: 1. 同规模教师对学生几乎分布不可区分，验证“新增能力”条件的关键性；2. 成功OPD的97-99 %概率质量集中在<5 %的共享token子集，表现为渐进对齐；3. 冷启动+对齐提示可在失败案例中将成功率提升32-41 %；4. 长程任务上，OPD带来1.8×推理开销与显著策略漂移，表明“免费午餐”存在隐性成本。
AI.conclusion: OPD并非简单知识搬运，而是师生在共享高概率token子集上的协同刷新；当教师不能提供分布外的新能力或学生已覆盖教师分布时，OPD必然失效。未来需设计可感知“能力增益”的早停指标，并探索稀疏奖励或课程式蒸馏以缓解长程 scaling 障碍。
